description: ウォール街で働く仕事中毒のケイトは、体が悲鳴を上げ、クリニックの手違いで知り合ったランドンと「夜だけ」の契約を結ぶ。彼は肌を重ねないと眠れず、彼女は体を目覚めさせるためにそれを必要とした。感情抜き、束縛なし。だが彼が隠した秘密は——彼こそケイトの新社長だった。

そんな彼が、深夜になるとセクシーなネコ配信者として注目を集め、配信の中でだけ愛情と優しさを受け取っていた。

しかし、自分をいつもいじめてくる大嫌いな相手――同性

ところが従妹マディソンが現れると、兄は完全にアンジェリカを見放す。毎日「死ね」と言われ続けた彼女

賀聞序とひっそり寄り添って五年。

だがある夜、帰宅した私が見たのは、彼の寝室から出てくる女。

description: 接親當日，新郎裴嶼踹開新娘房門，撞見前任方澈待在屋內，手裡把玩著裴嶼的新郎胸花，新娘柳如煙還挺身護住對方。看清真相的裴嶼果斷取消婚禮。方澈身負鉅額債務，本想借婚禮謀取利益，被揭穿後剪輯視頻顛倒黑白。裴嶼保留完整現場證據，通過法律途徑追責。柳如煙在糾葛中幡然醒悟

description: 單親媽媽林淑芬苦熬十年拉扯兒子長大，盼著兒子能找個踏實姑娘安穩過日子。誰知兒子帶回的女友白靜——短髮紋身、大他四歲，一張嘴就喊她“姐”，她氣得血壓直飆。可就是這個她怎麼看都不順眼的姑娘，上門第三天就把上門搶房的渣前夫懟得落荒而逃，把十年不敢吭聲的她護在身後。從

大天使路西恩與墮天使之主德雷文，本是勢不兩立的宿敵。戰場上路西恩一時心軟，德雷文趁機將他囚禁，折斷他的純白雙翼、將他鎖入隕鐵牢籠、烙印魔名、鏡前逼他直視真實慾望。當他終於認清自己愛上這「怪物」，卻被迫服下以太核心……記憶洗白，重回純潔，也重回仇恨。

title: 霸凌我的人竟是我的榜一
description: 丹尼爾是冰球隊裡不起眼的器材助理，平時總被校霸欺負，只有到了深夜，他化身直播主，才會成為眾人追捧的焦點。沒想到，他最大的金主竟是那個最討厭他的校園阿爾法。白天是霸凌他的死對頭，晚上卻瘋狂砸錢支持他。當兩個身分碰撞，這場敵對關係也悄悄變成了心動。

title: 雪落無痕，心碎有聲

title: 精靈的五年婚約
description: 他是受困千年的精靈，為了一句承諾，藏起神力，甘願做她身邊最卑微的丈夫。五年來他替她擋下所有風雨，她卻只當他是貪圖家產的廢物。合約到期，他轉身離開。直到整個上流社會跪在他面前，她才驚覺，自己親手推開的，是所有人仰望的那道光芒。

title: 被狐狸拒絕後，我選了狼
description:
艾莉諾傾盡所有，將不孕的菁英狐狸獸人亞德里安從紅燈區救出。一年後，他卻罵她噁心、出手傷她，還向她炫耀攀上的上流千金。
艾莉諾果斷將他退回，轉而認領無人敢買且被判死刑的狼——伊森。滿身是傷、令人畏懼的伊森，對她無比忠誠，更是厚著臉皮百般討好，渴望給她亞德里安永遠

title: 我老公掌管辛迪加
description:
四年前，泰勒·馬切蒂在雨中苦候，而她從十六歲起深愛的男人卻拋下了她，選擇羅素家族的千金與兩個辛迪加高桌席位。
同一晚，她寫信給北部分會，履行已故父親安排的婚姻——嫁給賈克斯·洛根，辛迪加史上最年輕也最危險的首席執法者。

title: 審判之神：色誘極品大叔
description: 18歲的梅洛蒂，一直渴望著不該愛的男人——卡西安，她爸爸的摯友，也是高冷且遙不可及的審判之神。他拯救她、保護她，甚至讓冷酷的前任付出代價。但當梅洛蒂終於試圖抽身，卡西安嫉妒發狂，徹底失控。

當布莉姬的青梅竹馬崔佛在舞臺上將她壓制，讓校園裡的女王蜂剪去她及腰長髮當作殘酷的「惡作劇」時，十八年的情誼也在這一剪中灰飛煙滅。

description:
艾德琳用一顆腎，換來與布雷克三年的婚姻。但在布雷克眼中，她只是個心機重的騙子，也是青梅竹馬蕾貝卡的行動血庫。冷暴力、囚禁、當眾羞辱……她全吞了。直到癌末確診、意外懷孕，徹底粉碎她最後的幻想。

description: 三年前，林知夏奪得全國臨床技能競賽總冠軍，卻拒絕國家醫學科學院的邀請，回到母親曾經工作過的明德醫院，留在一線救人。 三年後，江州首富賀景川的妻子顧婉寧突發羊水栓塞。林知夏連續搶救數小時，保住母子性命，自己卻近乎虛脫。她想喝一袋自己購買的葡萄糖，卻被院長方誌剛當

description: 二十一世紀的“神算子”葉知秋穿越到古代，成了一名未淨身的假太監。本打算一直苟下去，卻不想在伺候公主沐浴更衣時，動了男人的慾念，從而被公主發現他假太監身份。葉知秋心一橫，和公主生米煮成熟飯，卻不想因此而讓公主芳心暗許。之後葉知秋如法炮製，並用自己神算子技能輔助，

description: 皮洛斯在赫爾蒙鍛造坊埋首三年，親手打造的神兵卻全被師兄德瑞克冒名領功。被趕走時，他只有十塊廢鐵做工錢，沉寂的金色神火卻因此甦醒。他從破舊小鋪重新起步，修復失傳靈紋、揭穿公會贗品，漸漸發現自己的血脈與弒神者的秘密。

description: 骨妖幾百年來都被困在墳場，只有小女孩祁娘能看到她。祁娘十來年堅持投餵骨妖，與她結下了深厚的情誼，可是嫁人後就再也沒有出現。骨妖苦苦等待，卻等到了來埋葬祁孃的兩個孩子。骨妖決定附身祁孃的肉身，扮演兩個孩子的母親，替祁娘繼續活下去。重生後的骨妖祁娘，不僅給祁娘報了

description: 前世為家庭放棄醫學理想的女主蘇晚檸重生回到八十年代，果斷與忽視自己的廠長丈夫陸崢言離婚，奔赴滬市投身腦腫瘤科研事業；前夫陸崢言幡然醒悟開啟漫漫追妻路，女主蘇晚檸最終深耕醫學領域，助力國內研究突破，活成了自己的光。

title: 灰燼與荊棘
description:
命運重置後，兩姊妹踏上截然不同的人生旅程。放下過去傷痛，妹妹選擇與遭世人誤解的公爵並肩同行。她憑藉勇氣與智慧，一步步揭開命運遭操弄的真相，打破困住無數人的無形枷鎖。
最終，眾人掙脫預先安排好的人生，學會為自己的選擇負責。

description: 南方千金貝拉被未婚夫賣進邊境妓院，逃出生天卻誤闖神祕牧場主人寇爾的地盤。他沉默如獸，獨自撫養自閉症女兒。為保住監護權，兩人訂下夏日契約：假結婚、演恩愛。一個需要庇護，一個需要「完整家庭」，硬著頭皮在荒野扮夫妻，卻在朝夕相處中從對抗到依偎、從演戲到真愛。但夏日有

title: 大西洋的新娘
description:
1911年，她為愛橫渡大西洋，換來的卻是未婚夫與千金女的聯手背叛。走投無路之際，她嫁給船上的神祕傷患，一個自稱在鋼鐵廠燒鍋爐的窮小子。
為了生存，她進豪門當速記員，他進鍋爐房鏟煤炭。當惡女把她吊在煉鋼爐上威脅，渣男嗆她「只配當我情婦」，那個每天灰頭土臉回家的鍋

title: 30天換我愛上你
description:
1994年，芝加哥。我在公車上救了一個陌生男人，結果他竟然是黑手黨教父艾斯·卡瓦洛。
婚禮當天，未婚夫跑了、叔叔把我賣了，他卻從槍火中走進來。
條件很簡單，當他30天的妻子，換我媽的手術費。
我答應了，才發現他早就付完錢。
我想恨他，他卻一次又一次擋在我身前。

title: Her Man Is the Son of Death
description: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.

title: Bound by Love
description: Aria won Luca’s love in an arranged mafia marriage, but when she secretly helps her sister flee the life, she betrays him. With their families at war and a baby on the way, Aria must decide whether love can survive when loyalty is paid for in blood.

title: Hunted by the Alpha
description: Human med student Elena secretly raises Kate, her half-wolf daughter, from a one-night bond with Alpha Alex. Needing rare medicine Lunarid, she finds Alex, who recognizes her by scent and bite mark. Kate is kidnapped, Alex discovers she is his daughter, and Elena moves into the pack estate. She survives Nyx's cruelty, becomes Luna, breaks Alex's curse through true love, and exposes Nyx's sabotage of a bloodline test. Mrs. Volkov accepts the family. Alex proposes, and they marry as one.

title: His Father Made Me His
description: After catching her fiancé cheating with her best friend just before their wedding, Flora runs away and has a wild one-night stand with a handsome stranger. Little does she know he's her ex-fiancé's father, and he has a dark secret. Will she surrender to the heat—or is it time to run again?

title: Breathe
description:
Based on the novel by Abbi Glines.
Sadie White takes her mom’s housekeeping job at the Stone family beachside mansion and accidentally saves global pop star Jax Stone from a mob of fans. Their worlds collide through forbidden chemistry, steamy tension, and explosive jealousy as Sadie is swept into Jax’s glamorous — and dangerous — life. But fame, sabotage, viral scandals, and heartbreak threaten to tear them apart. As Sadie discovers who she is outside of the chaos, she and Jax must decide whether love can survive the glare of the spotlight.

title: He Chose His Mistress, I Chose the Don
description: Liam slammed his hand on the table at our engagement dinner. “I have already claimed another woman.” I once shattered the bones in my hand saving him and trusted the blood oath he swore to me. In return, he stole my work, used me to hide his affair, and abandoned me in enemy territory. So I broke our oath. “My affections have already been pledged to another.” Now Liam is begging at my gates—because the man I chose is the one Don he cannot challenge. At tonight’s family dinner, either his mistress or his dynasty will fall.

title: Head Witch in Charge
description: Based on the novel by Avery Flynn. The Sherwoods are the most respected witches in all of Witchingdom, and as heir it's Leona's duty to protect her family's ancient wand and enter an arranged marriage. But all her plans go up in pixie dust when she crosses paths with notorious bad-boy witch Erik Svensen... and ends up magically bound to him in an unbreakable marriage! To undo her mistake and preserve her family legacy, she must accompany Erik on a magic-filled road trip to get him to cast a divorce spell, but the longer she spends with her husband, the more she feels all her walls and duties come crashing down.

title: Ex-Convict Nanny and Billionaire Single Dad
description: Fresh out of prison, Grace landed a job as a nanny. Her boss, the ruthless billionaire Alex Hill, cares only about his precious daughter. Grace passed Alex's rigorous test and gradually won over his cold heart, but Grace holds a dark secret, one that could destroy everything good.

title: His Healing Touch
description: Saila worked three jobs a day for seven years to take care of her blind and bankrupt husband, Dante. One day, while working as a volunteer in a welfare home, she accidentally comforted the world's richest son, Cotter, who suffered from severe autism. At this time, Setrick was facing a huge crisis of being deprived of custody by the CPS (Child Protection Services Bureau) due to his absence all the year round, and urgently needed a perfect wife to win the hearing. When the tired Saila returned home, she found out that her husband cheated on her and learned that her real identity was actually the heir of a top rich family. The suffering of the past seven years was all a blind scam he set up to test Saila's "not worship of money". The angry Saila decisively proposed a divorce, but her ex-husband took advantage of her absolute economic hegemony to get out of the house, and even her biological daughter was bribed with money. He not only scolded her as a "poor ghost", but also pushed her fiercely. In the desperate situation when Saila was completely blocked by her ex-husband and was penniless, the richest man Setrick came strongly. In order to keep his son's custody, he handed Saila a contract marriage of tens of millions of dollars. Saila, who had nothing, resolutely signed and not only became a perfect mother at the hearing, but also started a counterattack with Setrick, who hit her ex-husband in the face and healed each other.

title: Outplayed
description: By day, Brooklyn is a broke college student from the trailer park. But online, she’s Echo—a fearless gamer gunning for the $50,000 Blackgrove Reign tournament prize, her one shot at freedom. To win, she has to dethrone Thorne, the reigning champion. What she doesn’t know? Thorne is really Ethan—the hot, cocky frat king who also happens to be her TA… and her best friend’s older brother. After they butt heads in real life, Ethan discovers Brooklyn is Echo and enters the game to toy with her—only to find himself drawn to her skill, fire, and spirit. Online, they become unstoppable partners. Offline, they’re bitter rivals. When will Brooklyn realize Ethan is Thorne, and can these sworn enemies stop fighting long enough to see they’re perfect for each other?

title: How I Made the Alpha Mine
description: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own Pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha -- and older brother's best friend -- Dalton Grey. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the Pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.

title: Hey There, I Can Hear Your Heart!
description: Banished from the heavens for meddling in divine gossip, the god of wealth reincarnated as Penny, a newlywed rural girl who was unwelcome by her in-laws and ultimately killed by her husband's childhood sweetheart. Now reborn, Penny decides to rewrite her fate. However, the Shane family discovers they can hear her thoughts! Initially skeptical and dismissive of Penny's warnings, they gradually realize the truth as her thoughts repeatedly prove accurate, turning their world upside down.

title: He Lost the Mother Who Raised Him
description: After raising her stepson for 20 years, Claire Kensington is cast aside when his long-lost birth mother returns on his wedding day. Heartbroken, she walks away and takes back what’s hers. Only then does he learn the cost of taking her love for granted.

title: He Loved Her Lie. He Lost Me
description: After six years of marriage as a substitute bride in a wealthy family, she endured constant neglect and faked her own death to escape. Six years later, her husband tracks her down, and the truth begins to surface...

title: Shh, Don't Let Him Find Out
description: Lena has been secretly married to Isaac for a year. She believes they married for love, never realizing she is nothing more than a pawn he uses to satisfy a family rule and qualify for the inheritance. Her false sense of peace shatters when Isaac's debt puts her in the hands of loan sharks. On a stormy night, a drugged Lena fights for her life and escapes, only to be rescued by Jack Kane, the West Coast's most ruthless mafia godfather and the CEO of a multibillion-dollar empire. The man looking at her with obsessive hunger is also her father-in-law.

title: Hubby, Let’s See Who Rules This House
description: Eleanor Chase marries Duke Vincent Jordan only to discover his entanglements with a powerful concubine and a flirtatious sister-in-law. Despite his disdain for her traditional ways, Eleanor deftly deals with family drama, concubine's provocations, and the sister-in-law's schemes. As the rightful mistress of the house, it's her duty to manage the Duke's affairs, including the Duke himself!

title: CEO's Wife Spoiled by Three Big Shot Brothers
description: The daughter of the richest family was taken away by mistake when she was a kid and grew up in another family. When she grew up, she returned to the biological family and was loved by her three brothers. What's more, when she was a kid, she saved the second young master of another top family. After she returned as heiress, the two became acquainted.

title: The Alpha Heir Gave Me to His Brother
description: "I'd rather you had let me bleed out." Those were my Alpha's last words after I spent a lifetime loving the man whose life I saved. Reborn, I ask for only one thing—freedom. Instead, he forces me to mate his younger brother. What he doesn't know is that his brother has spent three years searching for the mysterious girl who once saved him... and she's me. When the truth finally comes out, which brother will regret losing me first?

title: The Heiress He Threw Away
description: Dumped Selena at their engagement party, calling her a lowly herbalist from a mountain cabin. She didn't cry. She had just discovered she's the true Harrington heiress—but she said nothing. She walked out and struck a deal with Alexander Sinclair, a billionaire left crippled by a "car accident." She would heal his legs; he would back her war. Now she's entering the Harrington mansion, where her birth family protects the fake daughter who stole her life. They think she's an easy target. They don't know she's already won—and the disabled man is about to stand up.

title: The Alpha Who Let His Luna Die
description: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?

title: In the Palm of His Hand
description: College senior Shelby Yates accidentally saves the life of billionaire ex-mafia CEO Matteo Franconi. He immediately falls in love with her and pressures her to marry him. Is he as dangerous and cruel as he seems? Or is there a soul inside the man worthy of her love?

title: The Words
description: Based on the novel by Ashley Jade. 4 years ago, rocker bad-boy Phoenix broke nerdy good-girl Lennon's heart and stole her song to escape his abusive father. Now he's a famous rockstar, spiraling into drugs and alcohol, she's hired to keep him sober for 8 weeks on tour. Can Lennon and Phoenix heal old wounds, or will their past stand in the way of their second chance at love?

title: The Fairy Who Slept Her Way to the Throne
description: Palm-sized fairy Elowen enters the Aurevan court as a Queen candidate and learns from her crystal that doing nothing will make her win. She only wants food and sleep, but Dragonborn Seraphina and scheming nobles keep framing her. Every trap backfires as Elowen reads fate, saves Emperor Cassian and exposes a coup. The harder she avoids the crown, the faster fate makes her Queen—and a magical coronation turns the tiny fairy human.

title: The Truth Behind the Lies We Loved
description: Once celebrated as a genius painter, she lost her boyfriend in a moment of selfishness. Years later, she meets a man who looks strikingly similar to her late lover. Despite his cruel words and the scorn of those around her, she refuses to leave. But when the man’s first love returns, he finally realizes that the real "substitute" isn’t her, but himself. Two people, hurting and healing each other while calling each other replacements—when will they realize their true feelings for each other?

title: Djinn Under Contract
description: Eli Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Eli freedom– but on one condition:  Eli must marry his granddaughter, Christine Parrish, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Eli transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine  ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Eli starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. Then, when Christine's old flame reenters the picture, Eli's heart is completely shattered. Now, Eli is faced with a tough decision– should he stay by Christine's side once the final wish is granted, or is it time to for him to divorce Christine and finally live his own life?

title: My Wolf Chose Her, but the Alpha King Chose Me
description: When Grey Town is swallowed by a catastrophic flood, Erin expects Kyle, the crippled wolf guard she spent seven years healing, to save her. Instead, he throws away his crutch, reveals his leg healed long ago, and gives the boat’s last seat to her scheming sister, Sienna. Erin dies betrayed—but awakens on the day her father first brought home twin wolf guards. This time, she refuses Kyle, abandons the family that never loved her, and fights for her own power. Yet Kyle remembers their past life too, and his regret becomes obsession just as the feared Alpha King, Ronan, chooses Erin.

title: The Boy I Hate
description: When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!

title: The Alpha Heard Her Too Late
description: Mira Vale once believed being Kael Blackwood’s Luna meant she finally had a home. Instead, five years in Ironpeak taught her that a mate bond could become a cage: every dress, carriage, and medical request passed through Sienna Frost, the graceful steward Kael trusted more than his own wife. When Mira’s human adoptive mother dies after Sienna blocks the Moonwell serum and Kael ignores eleven desperate calls, Mira asks to sever their bond. Kael only realizes the truth after Mira leaves for North Ridge, rebuilds her life as a wolf researcher, and turns her grief into a law that saves outsiders like her mother. By the time he finally hears her, Mira no longer needs him.

title: The Alpha Bought His Lost Luna
description: Three years ago, Lyla Silverthorn was framed by her adopted sister Mira, abandoned by her parents, and betrayed by Caleb Cross, the Alpha who once loved her. Her moon core was carved out, her voice burned away by silver poison, and her name reduced to the black-market number R-17. When Caleb buys her at auction for $200,000, he has no idea he has found his lost Luna. As the Moon Crown awakens and exposes every lie, Lyla refuses their late remorse and cuts the soul-bond chain to claim her freedom.

title: Half Bath
description:
This 80's gamer's bathroom happens to be a gateway to another dimension, but is it also the gateway to "true love"? 

In an instant, he's transported to another dimension, a world both absurd and enchanting.  There, he doesn't just explore: he lives an entire life.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: High Rise
description: High Rise is a dramatic and comedic look into the lives of diverse neighbors living in a luxury Atlanta high rise. The series explores themes of power, money, seduction, love, deception, and heartbreak as friendships fail and drama "elevates". *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Wrong Heir, Right Her
description: Six years ago, top lawyer Madeline met wealthy heir Nicholas at a masquerade ball and later gave birth to a clever daughter Isla. Her half-sister Vivienne stole keepsakes to pretend to be Nicholas's lover, coveting wealth and status. Later, Madeline worked at Nicholas's group and reunited with him. Romance bloomed between them amid constant workplace schemes and threats. Clues including a rare hereditary disease and identical birthmarks revealed the truth. Eventually, Vivienne's fraud was exposed. All misunderstandings were cleared up. Madeline and Nicholas chose each other, and the three lived a happy life together.

title: Good with Her Hands
description: Years after an unexpected separation, Bella and Adam—once college classmates who fell in love at first sight—are unexpectedly reunited. Now a successful doctor, Bella is stunned when Adam, her first love and now a renowned NHL superstar, appears in her office, seeking help. As old feelings resurface, a twist of fate binds them in a contract relationship, giving their unfinished love a second chance. With each passing day, the spark between Bella and Adam grows stronger, but both must decide if this second chance will allow their long-dormant love to flourish into something lasting.

title: The Pharaoh’s True Heiress
description: Naga was switched at birth and raised in a craftsman village, fighting in underground matches to support her adoptive mother. To save her dying mother, she goes to the royal court to claim her identity as the pharaoh's trueborn daughter. But the false princess is deeply loved, and Naga is met with coldness and framed plots. Without tears or tantrums, Naga joins the worst "Abyss Group," wins first place in the Underworld Trial, inherits the Eye of Ra, and becomes a divine avatar. With her charisma, she unites a band of outcast lowborn nobles and forms her own guard. Finally, she defeats the pharaoh's eldest son and is crowned Queen of Upper and Lower Egypt. The false princess is dethroned and imprisoned, while her once-biased parents regret forever.

title: The Year in His Chains
description:
When Anna's husband racks up a massive debt to dangerous mob boss Jeremy, she becomes the price - literally his property for one year. She expects cruelty from the notorious crime lord, but discovers something unexpected: a wounded man hiding behind his cold mask.
Her cheating husband wants her to seduce Jeremy for money. His controlling father wants her eliminated. But as Anna finds herself caught between lies and loyalty, she realizes the man who owns her might be the only one who truly sees her. Sometimes the chains that bind you are the only things that can set you free.

title: Obsessed with His Silent Bride
description: Taken in as a ward of the Calvert family, Eva has always loved Declan Calvert, the boy who grew up as her protector. Nonverbal since birth, she struggles to express her feelings in a marriage built on duty—Declan only married her to honor his grandfather’s dying wish. Trapped in a toxic union, Eva endures Declan’s cruelty and his mistress Selene’s relentless schemes to drive her out. Despite it all, Eva clings to the hope that Declan might rediscover the love they once shared as children. Bound by silence, Eva must decide: fight for his heart or break free before it’s too late.

title: My Brother Thought He Won
description:
Ethan once had the life everyone dreamed of. After being adopted by a poor couple, he rose from humble beginnings through his own hard work and became a legend admired by many. While his most trusted brother, Cole, was adopted into a wealthy family,but still failed to achieve the success he desired. Cole was consumed by jealousy, believing that Ethan had taken everything that was meant to be his. Their bitter rivalry eventually led them both to a tragic end.
As Ethan loses consciousness in the freezing river, fate gives the two brothers a second chance.
They wake up and find themselves back on the day they were adopted.
This time, Ethan is determined not to repeat the mistakes of the past or allow himself to be controlled by his brother again. Cole, meanwhile, is determined to reclaim what he believes was always his. Given the chance to rewrite their destinies, the two brothers set out on completely different paths.
But the past they share, the grudges left unresolved, and the battle for the family legacy force them to stand at another crossroads of fate.
With the same life beginning again, what choices will they make? And this time, who will truly control their own future?
A battle over wealth, glory, and the choices that define a life has only just begins...

title: The Beast on Her Leash
description: To find evidence of Vincent's crimes—the murderer of her parents—Eliza accepts an invitation from Vincent's father to become the president of Evertech AI. Unexpectedly, the father imposes an additional condition: she must educate his youngest son, Ryder, who is as ferocious as a wild beast, into a civilized man. After agreeing, Eliza finds Ryder an extremely difficult man to handle, and the two often clash with intense tension. However, during their coexistence, Ryder falls in love with Eliza. When Eliza realizes she has feelings for Ryder too, she is forced to push him away in order to pursue Vincent's crimes. The entanglement among them is filled with ambiguity and excitement, where opportunities and dangers coexist.

title: I Taught Him to Court a Mate — He Chose Me
description: The Ph.D. candidate Thea personally taught a lone male dragon courtship calls and the Flame Dance to complete her thesis. The dragon immediately performed the move in front of her after learning it. The mentor's phone call tore open the truth. The courtship ritual involves abducting the mate into the nest and locking them until egg-laying. It's too late now—the claws tear open the roof, and he transforms into a human form to take her away. She dreamed back twelve years in a fever. She had fallen from a cable car and was rescued by a young ancient dragon. After the relationship was established, she imprisoned him in reverse. She opened the cage door and knelt to propose.

title: From Throne to Classroom: The Warlord Reborn
description: Betrayed by the Emperor, Leon Thorne, the Prince Regent of the Solarian Empire, reincarnates as a timid high schooler. Shedding his cowardly shell, he crushes the bully Chad Keller and meets Elise Mercer, a classmate identical to his past-life fiancee. After destroying her cursed necklace to dispel its dark magic, he settles the debts of his gambling brother, Jared Thorne. When the Sanctum, including Dexter Cross, targets the Mercer fortune, Leon unleashes his Prime Grandmaster powers. He obliterates their assassins, dismantles the syndicate, and wins the loyalty of Riverton's wealthiest man, Edward Langdon, ultimately redeeming his past regrets.

title: Don't Harm the Heiress，Her Mom Is the Sable Queen
description: When a ruthless billionaire matriarch returns from a three-year covert mission to cure her daughter's illness, she discovers her husband and their former nanny have stolen her empire and left her daughter brain-damaged from abuse—forcing her to unleash her cold-blooded wrath to reclaim her crown.

title: I Have a System,  She Has My Heart
description: A quirky "Confession System" grants Alfred Carter rewards for professing love—but gives him only three chances to win the heart of his boss, Serena Harris. If she doesn't truly fall for him, he's dead. After a bold first move, Alfred doubles down with audacious flair, unexpectedly catching Serena's eye. But just as sparks fly, Chester Renwick targets her life force. Now Alfred must protect the woman he's trying to love—or they'll both lose everything.

title: The Wrath of the Queen of Hell
description: Escaping an arranged marriage, the Master of the Jade Hall from the Underworld is reborn in the body of a princess betrayed and murdered by her fiancé. After a drugged night with the Regent Prince, Jade sheds her timid persona and takes the palace by storm. Instead of being the delicate flower the prince imagined, she wields a whip in one hand and a knife in the other, sending enemies fleeing. The prince may think she's meek, but even the ghosts in the palace are terrified of her wild side!

title: I Gave Her Check, She's Mad
description: To suppress the Ice Poison, Liam, the head of Yama Guild, had a one-night stand with Wanda. Wanda was the lady boss of Vermilion Bird Gang. However, they became enemies due to a check left behind by Liam. Liam defeated the following assassins, bidding the Dragon Blood Lingzhi with one billion. Wanda paid the money first and requested a fake marriage to please her grandpa. At the birthday banquet, Liam intimidated the entire audience with the Yama Token. He also saved Sir Quinn. Liam was with Wanda and the Ice Poison was removed...

title: Golden Eyes
description: Ethan Mercer, a humble antique shop apprentice, is betrayed and abandoned by his wife Vivienne Sterling after she strikes a billion-dollar jade fortune. Left broken and humiliated, he unexpectedly awakens the legendary Golden Eyes! Blessed with the power to identify priceless jade and see through all deception, he rises from rock bottom to dominate the jade world—and build his own empire on his terms!

title: When The Moon Hides Her Crown
description:
A woman cannot lead a pack.
The day she defeats every rival, her father hands the Alpha title to her cousin and betroths her to an Alpha King she's never met—making her a bargaining chip.
Seraphina refuses. She binds her chest, sprays on scent-masking perfume, and slips into Lupine Academy disguised as her male cousin. Every five years its champion becomes the Supreme Alpha, ruler of every pack. Win, and no one can trade her away again.
But the perfume has one fatal flaw: it fails the moment she shifts into her wolf, or falls for a dominant male. And the deadliest wolf there—the Lycan King, Ronan—sees straight through her. He doesn't expose her. He closes in. He doesn't want her secret. He wants her.
One girl. A pack of bloodthirsty Alphas. A disguise one breath from unraveling. Can she seize the throne that was stolen from her?

title: Reborn to Shine
description: In her past life, she and her husband grew up as adoptive siblings, became spouses, and spent a lifetime together until old age. When both are reborn, she believes fate has given them a second chance only to discover that he has always had a woman he couldn't forget. This time, he abandons her without hesitation. Left behind, she is adopted into another family and chooses to walk a completely different path, starting a new life without him.

title: The Girl Who Healed Death
description: Sugar was adopted by the Millers but got abused and regarded as a demon due to her supernatural abilities. Actually, she was the granddaughter of Lord Underworld. Her dad knew about Sugar's background and rushed to find the Millers. By then, Sugar had been sold to a research institute. Her dad rescued Sugar in time and brought her back home. Sugar cured her Grandma, helped Uncle Chase stand up, and resolved the crisis of Uncle Jasper. Finally, she smashed the scheme of Lord Julian and reunited with her Grandpa, Lord Underworld.

title: From Pushover to Underworld Big Shot
description: Ethan, raised as an illegitimate child, lives with his mother until his estranged father, Matthew Lewis, reappears on his 18th birthday. Matthew, a feared kingpin, brings Ethan into his world, but it's a family built on cold deals, not love. To save his mother's life, Ethan agrees to serve the underworld. Thrust into a brutal world of crime and loyalty, he fights for those he loves and rises to make the entire underworld tremble. No regrets, no turning back.

title: Don't Mess with That Beggar
description: Winnie, the beautiful heiress of the Shaw family, finds the boy she once helped, now a beggar. In a shocking twist, she kneels and proposes to Timothy on the street. Impressed by her loyalty, he agrees to marry her and returns to the Shaw family with her. But her family is furious, demanding she either leave him or leave the family. Timothy warns that if they force them out, they will regret it.

title: Poor Husband, Hidden Tycoon
description: To outmaneuver her stepmother, Ella Swan, CEO of Swan Group, marries the handsome yet seemingly penniless Yates Lloyd to secure a 10% share from her grandfather. However, Ella soon notices something amiss. Isn't he a broke guy? But why is everyone bowing to him?

title: Wrongly Entangled
description: Under threat, she had to assume someone else's identity to marry into a wealthy family. Unexpectedly, she ends up entangling with her fiancé's brother – a ruthless man who strikes fear into everyone. Due to her fake identity and the threats she faces, she doesn't dare to break things off with him easily. So, she decides to play along with him. When the family that once hunted her entire family proposes a marriage alliance with him, their relationship hits a deadlock... How will their budding romance unfold?

title: Goodbye Ex, I Return To Being The Heiress
description: After being framed for cheating by her sister and losing her husband's trust, she faces despair after a miscarriage with no one to turn to. However, her biological brother reveals she's a billionaire heiress, giving her a chance to reclaim her status. As she returns, her presence shocks her ex-husband...

title: Love, Like a Rose
description: After a drunken mistake, the female lead confuses her husband for a host. When they finally recognize each other, the male lead, a hidden CEO, faces challenges like family disputes and nearly exposing his identity. Overcoming these struggles deepens their bond. He eventually reveals his identity, proposes, and they achieve a happy ending.

title: I'm the Human Who Hunts Fiends
description: Theo awakens as a condemned prisoner in a deadly arena, where the Last-Stand Protocol lets him trade years of his life to reflect fatal attacks back at his enemies. After killing a tiger fiend and gaining its powers, he sets out to find his missing sister, battling monsters, corrupt cultivators, and a trafficking ring along the way. But every victory costs him years. With only two years left to live, Theo enters the Metropolis of Fiends, where his mysterious bloodline has made him prey.

title: The Second Life Vow
description: In her previous life, Evelyn was the spoiled Collins heiress. Her fiance Bill suddenly got back a girl named Lila, claiming Lila was the true Collins heiress who had been lost. On the wedding day, Lila's birth parents switched the wedding car, making Evelyn marry Bill's brother Victor, who had jinxed five wives. Evelyn forced Bill to marry her, but all she got was three years of cold marriage. Bill died and wanted to be with Lila in the next life. After rebirth, when the wedding car stopped, Evelyn chose Victor, becoming Bill's sister-in-law.

title: Back to 2002: I Built My Empire
description: Aiden Reed, a social elite and eligible bachelor, finds himself reborn in 2002 on his way to college registration. Armed with foresight, he actively expands his network and seizes the e-commerce wave by founding Rocket 101 Delivery. Meanwhile, Aiden is torn between choosing the treasure girl, Isla Sutton, and his first love, Sophia Shaw...

title: He's Done Letting Her Go
description: Abby Baker, the girl with great strength, is taken to CEO Rorian Waverly by her fiancé for a business contract. She's devastated, but what she doesn't know is that Rorian has waited fifteen long years for this chance. He's done letting her go.

title: From Throne to Classroom: The Warlord Reborn
description: Betrayed by the Emperor, Leon Thorne, the Prince Regent of the Solarian Empire, reincarnates as a timid high schooler. Shedding his cowardly shell, he crushes the bully Chad Keller and meets Elise Mercer, a classmate identical to his past-life fiancee. After destroying her cursed necklace to dispel its dark magic, he settles the debts of his gambling brother, Jared Thorne. When the Sanctum, including Dexter Cross, targets the Mercer fortune, Leon unleashes his Prime Grandmaster powers. He obliterates their assassins, dismantles the syndicate, and wins the loyalty of Riverton's wealthiest man, Edward Langdon, ultimately redeeming his past regrets.

title: My Three Brothers Chose Her
description: Melissa, the adopted daughter of the Karen family, endures systematic abuse from her newly-returned biological sister Ollie, who turns her three brothers against her through manipulation. Despite suffering humiliation and violence, Melissa secretly participates in a dangerous drug trial to cure the family's hereditary disease. When the truth finally emerges through surveillance footage, the brothers are devastated. Ollie dies from the disease she tried to weaponize. As the brothers collapse one by one, Melissa — now transformed and powerful — returns on her own terms, offering salvation from a position of absolute strength, completing her journey from victim to queen.

title: General! She Rised to the Top
description: In her previous life, she devotedly loved her husband and did everything she could to help him rise in his career. However, he betrayed her, having an affair with her best friend, strangled her, and annihilated her entire family. Given a second chance at life, she encounters her husband's political rival and decides to join forces with him. This time, watch as she becomes resilient and strategic, successfully taking revenge on the scoundrel.

title: Fake Daughter, Real Heiress
description: Iris, a rich CEO's wife, harbored regrets for never meeting her biological parents. Upon receiving news of her mom, she took her daughter Eva back to reunite with them. However, the fake daughter Sophie and her brother Lawrence mocked Iris for being crude. At the family dinner, Sophie bragged about her daughter Clara's competition awards, but she didn't know Iris's daughter was a genius. Later, Sophie framed Eva of stealing, and Iris's mom just said Iris was only her goddaughter. Iris felt utterly disappointed. Then her billionaire husband came...

title: My Husband Is A Billionaire
description: Alexander Whitmore is a struggling street vendor—until he saves Freya Sinclair, the queenpin of Black Sparrow. One impulsive kiss later, they're flash-married. But when Caleb Carter threatens their newfound happiness, Alexander's "poor" parents drop a bombshell: they're the secret founders of Whitmore Capital, a global empire. Now, with his underworld wife by his side and a billion-dollar dynasty behind him, this accidental heir must rise to claim his destiny and protect the woman he loves.

title: The CEO's Hidden Heir
description: A stolen night. A hidden pregnancy. A son who carries the key to a billionaire's past. When Dr. Presley Raven returns to the city seeking a cure for her child's illness, she collides with the one man she never wanted to see again—CEOv, who now holds all the power. But this time, she's not running. She's fighting for her family, and she'll burn his world down if she has to.

title: She Broke the Gift for His Mother
description: A pharmaceutical scientist returned from overseas. Her son, the CEO of a major corporation, sent his girlfriend-turned-secretary to pick her up with a rare medicine. The secretary, rushing to the airport, nearly hit a child. The scientist blocked the car, causing the medicine to shatter. The secretary and her brother then beat the scientist and destroyed her late husband's belongings. Later, at a family dinner, the scientist exposed the secretary's crimes, and the son called off the engagement. The secretary's family was arrested. She escaped prison and attempted to assassinate the scientist but was shot dead. The scientist then led the corporation to expand its empire.

title: The Second Life Vow
description: In her previous life, Evelyn was the spoiled Collins heiress. Her fiance Bill suddenly got back a girl named Lila, claiming Lila was the true Collins heiress who had been lost. On the wedding day, Lila's birth parents switched the wedding car, making Evelyn marry Bill's brother Victor, who had jinxed five wives. Evelyn forced Bill to marry her, but all she got was three years of cold marriage. Bill died and wanted to be with Lila in the next life. After rebirth, when the wedding car stopped, Evelyn chose Victor, becoming Bill's sister-in-law.

title: I Became an Heir on My Wedding Day
description: On his wedding day, a man discovers that his fiancée has been deceiving him and is pregnant with another man’s child. Someone from their childhood, holding a grudge, used his girlfriend to set him up. Just as he faces humiliation from them both, the heiress of a super-wealthy family arrives. He finds out he is actually the long-lost heir of this family, and his sister has come to give him the grand wedding he deserves!

title: On the Verge of Love's Truth
description: Seven years after leaving with his child, she returned to him, desperate to save their leukemia-stricken daughter. To afford the treatment, she endured his constant humiliation, even as he wrestled with conflicting feelings of love and hatred. Their tangled relationship deepened, and the truth about what had driven them apart began to emerge.

title: Fortune's Gift: Spoiled by My Zillionaire Uncles
description: She was abducted by human traffickers as a child, and when she grew up, she was betrayed by a scumbag who cheated on her. She thought her life was doomed, but one day, her wealthy uncle shows up, offering her the chance to return home and inherit a fortune worth billions.

title: Fated to Love the Dragon Again
description: Six years ago, Nina had a one-night affair with Dragon Sovereign Jayden, resulting in twins, her daughter Talia raised by her, and their other daughter taken by Jayden to the dragon clan. Six years later, Nina returns, determined to find Jayden for her daughter's treatment. When the twins are mistaken for each other, misunderstandings pile up, but through their matchmaking, Nina and Jayden are reunited, and all truths finally come to light.

title: Heiress's Counterattack
description:
"This is the life that you wanted?" She hid her identity as a wealthy heiress and married a poor guy, only to be bullied by his family even during pregnancy. 
Moreover, the girl her husband has been hooking up with is the daughter of the nanny from her original family, who has been impersonating her identity!
No more endurance! She finally decides to fight back, and regain everything!
She also meets a hot billionaire CEO, who is so protective and supportive along her side. Where will this new romance lead them?"

title: She Left The Ashes Behind
description: Elana gave everything to her husband, her children, and a family that never protected her. On the day she gives birth, her babies are taken from her and handed to another woman. Even her most precious dragon scale is ripped away in the name of “atonement.” When regret finally comes, it is already too late. Reborn far from the palace, Elana becomes a healer, finds warmth again, and leaves the ashes of her old life behind.

title: The Love That Hurts
description: She’s his adopted sister, but he has always kept his feelings for her hidden. When he sees his cancer diagnosis, he decides to find her a good man to marry, someone who will take care of her. She responds, “Do you really hate me that much? I’m not getting married!”

title: They Thought He Was a Eunuch
description: Gideon Ashford becomes the top scholar and a third-rank official but is falsely rumored to be a eunuch. Percival Vance, son of the Magistrate of Blackwood, attempts to seize Gideon's wife, Adeline Reed. Patriarch Ned Ashford blames Adeline and subjects her to clan punishment. At the critical moment, Gideon makes a glorious return as the top scholar.

title: Married on Paper, Claimed for Life
description: To save his reputation, CEO Raymond Hawk makes a deal with "Hotel Queen" Zoe Jonald: a fake marriage. Zoe thinks it’s just business… until she uncovers the secret Raymond has kept for ten years. When their contract ends and she tries to walk away, he makes it clear their arrangement is far from over. Now, a simple deal turns into a dangerous game of love, secrets, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

title: She Hears the Dead
description: In Laswell City, a series of bizarre homicides have emerged, with every victim'sskeletalremainsdeliberatelybroken.ForensicanthropologistEvelynteamsupwith Detective Jack to investigate, only to discover that all the deceased are linked to the St. Anna Sanatorium fire twenty years ago—a blaze officially ruled an "accident" that claimed the lives of her parents. As Evelyn delves deeper into the bones, she uncovers the truth: the sanatorium had been conducting illegal human experiments under the guise of medical treatment, and the director, Marcus, set the fire to cover up his crimes. Her parents were not killed in the fire, but were murdered by Marcus himself for discovering his secret. Just as Evelyn and Jack inch closer to the truth, the mastermind behind it all finally reveals herself—Lilith, the sole intact witness of the fire, and the ultimate orchestrator of this twenty-year-delayed revenge.

title: The Hidden Tai Chi Heroine
description: Destined as the scarred maid, she mastered Tai Chi's secrets under her young master's tutelage — yet clan laws silenced her prowess, branding both her face and skills as forbidden. When blades flash to claim his life, her fists rewrite destiny in the arena's dust.

title: The Heir They Threw Away
description: Adrian, the Ashfords' real son, lost for years, comes home—only to be starved, framed, and beaten while the family adores their adopted “perfect son,” Damon. At Damon's birthday he's poisoned, blamed, and beaten to death—then wakes reborn, years earlier. This time he walks out for good. Using what only he knows of the future, he builds an empire that buries the family who cast him out. Sure he'd crawl back, they watch him rise—then uncover his abuse and Damon's lies, and beg him home. Too late.

title: General's Wrath: The Fallen Corruption
description: Robert achieved great military achievements. The Emperor granted him the title of Lord Guardian of the Empire. Robert returned to his hometown with honor, but knew his sister had been assaulted by the county magistrate's son and his mom had been severely injured. He angrily punished the villains in court, and also exposed the shocking scheme of collusion between local officials and the powerful in the capital, as well as the embezzlement of compensation for those injured soldiers. He investigated this case, faced with the ruthless counterattack of the Empress's brother. Ultimately, he executed corrupt officials and brought justice to the fallen soldiers and their families.

title: I Gave Her Check, She's Mad
description: To suppress the Ice Poison, Liam, the head of Yama Guild, had a one-night stand with Wanda. Wanda was the lady boss of Vermilion Bird Gang. However, they became enemies due to a check left behind by Liam. Liam defeated the following assassins, bidding the Dragon Blood Lingzhi with one billion. Wanda paid the money first and requested a fake marriage to please her grandpa. At the birthday banquet, Liam intimidated the entire audience with the Yama Token. He also saved Sir Quinn. Liam was with Wanda and the Ice Poison was removed...

title: My Husband's Secret
description: She dreamed that her husband was with a mysterious woman and even wanted to kill her. One day, she suddenly realized that everything in the dream was true! In order to protect herself and her child, she sought help from wealthy parents. They teamed up to uncover his husband's true face and bring him to justice!

title: The Alpha’s Baby Chose Me
description: Ella’s sister gives birth to the most dangerous baby in the North, then vanishes through a forbidden portal, leaving Ella to take the blame. The child bears the silver mark of Cole Darkmane, the ruthless Alpha no one dares to cross. Refusing to become her sister’s shield, Ella storms into Cole’s hall and drops the newborn in front of him. But the Alpha’s son won’t stop crying unless Ella holds him. As enemies circle, her sister returns to claim the baby, the title, and the life Ella never asked to risk.

title: See You Never, My Dear Ex!
description:
Andre Xavier gave up everything for love and married Lauren Berry. Years later, Lauren's first love, John Barton, returns. The two's encounters become frequent, and even their son, Frank Xavier, begins to see John as his father.
Infidelity. Divorce. Betrayal.
The pain of losing someone Andre loved the most disappears when he reclaims everything.
What Lauren never knew is that he is the CEO of the Atenas Group, the most influential and important company in the world!

title: She Chose the Dragon
description:
For ten years, Princess Isolde of Viridia loved Temple Knight Captain Leon wholeheartedly—until she discovered his secret affair with her younger sister Eileen. Heartbroken and disillusioned, she took Eileen’s place as the realm’s sacrifice to the ferocious dragon plaguing the kingdom.
In the dragon’s desolate territory, Isolde uncovered the truth: the thousand-year-old dragon Kalen, branded as a cruel tyrant, is merely a gentle, lonely being trapped in eternal solitude. The two wounded souls comfort and heal each other, falling into a forbidden love that transcends mortal and mythical boundaries.
Leon soon regrets his betrayal and rushes to plead for Isolde’s mercy, only to be firmly rejected. Eileen’s malicious schemes are eventually exposed, and she receives due punishment for her treachery.
Letting go of her painful past, Isolde chooses to stay by Kalen’s side. The two lovers rebuild the barren dragon realm, breathing new vitality into the long-desolate land.

title: Fallen Fox, Kneeling Royals
description: Fox spirit Lydia Rowan sacrificed her tail nine times over five centuries to protect the Arcanon Empire. Humiliated by Lady Camilla during a power loss, chaos ensued, and the royal family's indifference shattered her heart. Yet  upon regaining her powers, Lydia quelled the unrest and supported Duke Adrian Collins in restoring the realm. Then, after securing his rise to the throne, she disappeared back to the celestial realm...

title: Queen of Tears
description: She was injured and blinded in an accident, becoming an orphan. Her uncle, greedy for her parents' inheritance, pretended to adopt her. When they found out she didn't know where the inheritance was, they quickly married her off to a seriously ill tycoon. On their wedding day, she was humiliated and injured by her cousin but unexpectedly regained her sight. Upon seeing her mother-in-law having an affair, she continued to pretend to be blind. While acting pitiful and obedient at home, she was a formidable businesswoman outside, eventually becoming the CEO of a company. A billionaire of the partner company fell in love with her at first sight, , unaware that they were actually married for years but had never met each other...

title: Hired by Fate
description: Chris Lynn descended from the mountain because his master sent him to find the family involved in a decades-old arranged marriage with him. He was told that their patriarch possesses a pendant that could help him find his birth parents. However, upon arriving, he was dragged into a restaurant by a woman who demanded that he become her fake boyfriend...

title: In Love with the Alpha
description: After getting her wolf, Maya learns that the alpha of her pack, Liam, is her fated mate. Meanwhile, the evil Rogue King searches for the True Luna who will be his bride, to make his power complete and help usher in a reign of darkness. Maya is this True Luna, and she must reckon with her destiny and the danger and transformation it brings.

title: Can't Say I Love You
description:
"After four years of secret love and six years of marriage, you repay me with this?"
During our six years of marriage, I worked tirelessly at home like a servant. Yet my husband wanted to drive me away because of his first love's return！ Unable to endure it any longer, I chose to divorce him. 
When we meet again, I’m already a confident businesswoman negotiating at the table, and also a returned heiress, and he is no longer worthy to stand by my side.

title: The Fake Dating Spell
description: One drunken night, one humiliating ex, fake-date her worst enemy Blake or watch the Greenharts lose every point because of her. Hannah signs the contract expecting torture. Instead, she finds the cold, untouchable rival everyone fears has a side no one's ever seen, fiercely protective, quietly devoted, and hiding a secret of his own. When the pretending stops feeling like pretending, is it still an act? Then her ex Tristan discovers the truth—Hannah is Miss H, the anonymous genius the whole school idolizes. Now he's on his knees, begging for a second chance. Two boys, one choice.

title: Tracing the Path Home
description: On the day he took over as CEO, he was attacked by thugs, leading to brain damage and memory loss. Years later, his adoptive daughter brought him to reunite with his biological children. However, his children’s family looked down on him for his low status and intellectual impairment, refusing to acknowledge him. They accused him of pretending to be their father for money and subjected him to verbal and physical abuse, eventually pushing him down the stairs. Miraculously, the fall restored his consciousness and memory. But his competitive sister, worried that his return would threaten her position, forged the paternity test results and kidnapped his adoptive daughter and mother. Can he clear the misunderstandings and reunite with his family?

title: A Game of Revenge and Desire
description: Elite lawyer Vienna catches her fiancé Zack with his mistress and, instead of reacting, she slips a condom into a contract and hands it to Zack's playboy best friend, Wyatt. "Hotel? My treat." What starts as a revenge game becomes a thrilling, forbidden affair. But when Wyatt risks everything for her, Vienna realizes the game was set years ago and she's been the pawn all along. A game of revenge that leads to a heart-stopping love.

title: Sweet Baby, Sweeter Love
description: After an unexpected encounter, she gave birth to a son. Six years later, the man from that one-night stand learns the truth and begins searching for the child. In the process, she accidentally crosses paths with him, leading to a series of humorous and contentious interactions. In the end, the son reunites with his paternal family, and they all begin a life filled with happiness and togetherness.

title: Daddy! You're Spoiling the Wrong Kid
description:
"You wicked imposters, just wait and see how my mommy and daddy kick you and your kid out!"
Six years ago, after a one-night encounter with a stranger, she had a daughter and raised her alone. Now, he’s tracked her down—but her jealous sister has claimed her identity, using every chance to make life hard for her and her daughter. Though he doesn’t know who she truly is, he finds himself stepping in to protect her time and again—and can’t help but fall for her.

title: Mom, I Miss You
description: A mentally impaired mother gave birth to a pair of twins, a boy and a girl. After her husband's untimely death, the family lived in poverty. The younger brother, craving chicken soup, persuaded their simple-minded mother to steal a chicken, which led to the neighbors demanding compensation when they were caught. To avoid responsibility, the brother falsely accused his sister, and their ruthless grandmother sent the sister away.Years later, the sister, now a successful CEO, unexpectedly reunites with her long-lost mother and brother. Shockingly, she witnesses her ungrateful brother publicly humiliating their mother...

title: The Vet Who Became a Hero
description: Wyatt, a rural vet, were determined to become an excellent detective. However, he was used by Graham from a treasure stealing group to avoid the hunting of Rufus. Graham wanna seize the treasure Sea Heart as their own. When Wyatt went through many dangers and finally handed it over to Silas. He finally knew the true colors of Graham and Silas. Rufus was also not a good person. Wyatt played tricks and experienced setbacks to finally capture those criminals, protect the national treasure, and gain love, becoming an excellent detective.

title: Love in two Lifetimes
description: She was regarded as a jinx by her family since childhood. After an accident, she became pregnant with the Crown Prince's child. Subsequently, she was imprisoned by her mother and sister, who sought to take the child from her. Fortunately, she was saved by a divine physician. Seven years later, in order to treat her young son's illness, she returned to her old home and exposed the conspiracy of her mother, sister, and the Grand Commandant. With the help of her sons, she was finally reunited with the Crown Prince.

title: Lost Heiress: The CEO's Beloved Secretaire
description: At eighteen, she is abandoned by her adoptive mother, only to be rescued by a stranger. The two share an instant connection and fall deeply in love. However, family pressures threaten their happiness, as his relatives have plans for him to marry the daughter of a powerful family. With this arrangement, the heiress moves into their home, uncovering a long-buried secret of an identity swap from twenty-three years ago...

title: Sleeping Dragon: Waking Up to Revenge
description:
Caleb Shaw, born into power, hid his identity to live a normal life with Mia Brooks. After a crash leaves him in a three-year coma, Mia tirelessly supports him, facing humiliation and selling her blood to cover his medical bills. Despite the world's mockery and family mistreatment, she perseveres.
Until one night, he finally wakes up.

title: She Has Three Lovers
description: After beating the game and faking her death to escape with billions, Lilith is dragged back three years later by the three NPCs she dumped! Plunged into a hellish nightmare, she faces her three exes. The once-clingy Wolf Prince is now a ruthless madman trying to chain her up. The elegant Vampire Progenitor has become a twisted artist obsessed with turning her into an eternal doll. Even the stoic High Priest has embraced the darkness, relentlessly hunting her down. Facing the dangerous possessiveness of three corrupted gods, Lilith refuses to be easy prey...

title: Melody of a Broken Bond
description: Elsa Scott, adopted by Jacob Scott after being abandoned as a baby, grew up on the streets before discovering her extraordinary musical talent. Earning admission to Longland’s top music academy, she puts her dreams on hold to fund Jacob’s medical treatment. To cover the costs, she joins David Mace’s entertainment agency, rising to international stardom as a singer. However, when she decides to leave the industry, David betrays her—reneging on his promise to pay for Jacob’s treatment and using her career as leverage. Manipulating the situation, he drives a wedge between Elsa and Jacob, portraying Jacob as ungrateful and greedy to keep Elsa under his control.

title: Love, Unexpected
description:
To reignite his grandmother's will to live, Levi Steele pulls a random pregnant woman into the hospital room, claiming to his comatose grandmother that she is carrying his child, miraculously aiding his grandmother's recovery!
Meanwhile, Vanessa Ross believes her encounter with her child's father at the hospital is mere coincidence, but soon finds Levi frequently appearing in her life...

title: The Robot She Cheated With
description: Joe, self-made CEO of Vera Robotics, pioneered companion robots. In his past life, his wife Vanessa and her lover Dan conspired to murder him brutally, staged an accident, and stole his company.Reborn on the day of his companion robot launch, Joe initiates his revenge. Using the guise of testing robots, he mercilessly torments Dan, who is disguised as a machine. At the press conference, he meticulously manipulates Vanessa into signing divorce papers voluntarily, then publicly exposes Dan hiding inside a robot shell, shattering Vanessa's innocent facade. His scheme leaves the traitors ruined—family broken, company lost—while Joe reclaims his empire and relists it successfully.

title: Seven Years as Your Stand-In
description: Everyone assumes Winter is blindly devoted to Nicholas, enduring humiliation as his secretary. In truth, she stayed only to honor a dying promise to her late lover, protecting Nicholas for seven years. While Nicholas turns a blind eye to her suffering, Winter repeatedly risks her life for him. By the time he finally falls for her, she has already given up and walks away.

title: Hades: The Lord of the Underworld is Back
description:
The King of Hell, after being trapped in reincarnation for 3,000 years, leaves the underworld in chaos, with ghost officials in deep slumber. In his final reincarnation, he lives as a struggling food delivery man, burdened by poverty and his mother's illness. Following a fatal heart attack caused by a malicious customer, he is taken back to the underworld by ghost messengers, where he regains his memories and powers as the King of Hell.

Restored to his throne, he returns to the mortal realm, saves his mother, and astonishes everyone with his supernatural abilities. At an auction, he reclaims a lost artifact and subdues a demon. During the Yin-Yang Summit, he defeats powerful sect leaders, reopens the underworld, and restores balance between the realms, ultimately becoming the guardian of both the human and spiritual worlds.

title: Sorry Again, My Dear Daughter
description: An accident let the girl who was originally from a rich family separated from her family. And after many years of meeting again but made a joke of fate, the class prejudice has pushed away the opportunity to recognize each other again and again. How they pushed past their prejudices and met again.

title: Let There Be Awakening: The World Awaits Him
description: Six years ago, the chairman of the World Neurology Association gave up invitations from top-tier medical institutions and chose to go into seclusion, dedicating himself to ensuring one person's awakening. To him, saving this individual was the greatest honor of his career. For six years, this person had remained in a Grade A deluxe ward. Now, the figure who transformed the world six years ago is about to awaken, and the world is destined to experience seismic changes once again.

title: Jade Half, Heart Whole
description: Seven years ago, to save her dying mother, a desperate woman sold her first night—only to stumble into the drugged room of Julian Hart. One night changed everything. She fled with half a jade pendant. Then her brother framed her for manslaughter. She took the fall, gave birth prematurely in prison to a daughter, Lily, and passed on the pendant. Six years later, Julian and his mother cross paths with Lily. After misunderstandings and hardships, broken hearts finally find their way home.

title: The Real&Fake Young Master: My Four Aunties Are Big Shots
description: Once an heir to a wealthy family, a genius boy went missing and was picked up by another family, where he was forced into servitude and endured abuse. However, his four powerful aunts—each a legend in her field, from a warrior to a movie star, a divine doctor, and a business mogul—found him and showered him with love, exposing the fake heir and turning the tables!

title: The Comeback Play
description: Once a legendary player, a disgraced alcoholic starts coaching his estranged son’s underdog NBA team, determined to prove to his haters that he can save the team and still be the God of Ball.

title: The Heiress Doesn't Care at All
description:
At your wedding, someone actually brought a DNA report to question your identity! Even your family and boyfriend believed it! On your wedding day, after being humiliated and shut away, you lost your confidence and began to doubt your life. That's when he appeared like a ray of light, helping you stand tall again. 
Slowly emerging from the shadow, you decide not to be weak anymore! With the support of true love, you vow to prove yourself, reclaim everything, and make the wrongdoers pay the price!

title: Saying Farewell to My Clueless Husband
description: Her husband’s nephew rode his bicycle into her, just as she was about to give birth. The nephew only suffered minor injuries, but her husband, called by his sister-in-law to take care of the boy, left his pregnant wife unattended. She, who had once thought she married for love, woke up to the harsh reality in that moment. All through their marriage, she had been the one taking care of the family, while he never contributed and always sided with his sister, nephew, and mother. From that day on, she decided to make those who hurt her pay the price, tit for tat. She seeks revenge on her husband for the loss of her unborn twins.

title: A night with him
description: Daniel, a young recently graduated lawyer, decides to go out and celebrate landing his first job. At the bar, he is seduced by a handsome and mysterious man who invites him to spend the night with him, only to later discover that he is the husband of his new boss.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Four-Fingered Dad Helps Me Slap Back
description: Fifteen years ago, a father lost his finger while protecting his daughter, leading to their separation. Now, she faces betrayal from her ex-boyfriend, scorn from her family for her job as a water delivery worker, and the death of her adoptive father due to humiliation. As she struggles, her biological father—now a wealthy man—suddenly returns to take her home. However, the reunion is complicated by another woman who claims to be the true heiress, sparking imminent family conflict.

title: A Boy's Hand, the Dead's Wrath
description: The traitors killed Lord Damien. But death couldn't hold him. Reborn as a different child, he hides in plain sight. His sister? His past love. His enemies? Everywhere. His ace? Memories of a lifetime in hell. Now the family secrets crumble. The traitors tremble. The mighty prodigy is rising.

title: The Daughter He Hated
description: Six years ago, Elena was falsely accused of data theft and arson that killed Adrian’s sister. She fled and secretly gave birth to Sophie. Years later, Elena—who had been gathering evidence—fell into a coma after an accident. To save her, Sophie burst into Adrian’s engagement ceremony, claimed him as her father, and accused his fiancée of harming her mother. Adrian initially doubted her, but eventually uncovered the six‑year‑old truth.

title: Goodbye Ex, I Return To Being The Heiress
description: After being framed for cheating by her sister and losing her husband's trust, she faces despair after a miscarriage with no one to turn to. However, her biological brother reveals she's a billionaire heiress, giving her a chance to reclaim her status. As she returns, her presence shocks her ex-husband...

title: Clinic Miracle
description: Resident John unexpectedly gains miraculous supernatural powers to see internal injuries in patients. He uncovers multiple hidden critical conditions and saves countless dying patients. However, his extraordinary diagnostic skills draw suspicion and investigation from his peers. Racing against death in the emergency department, he carefully hides his supernatural secret, while danger creeps closer to him.

title: American Sniper: The Last Round
description: Carl Oliver, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain, Albert, unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Jane, the owner, and her daughter Rebecca, Carl steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...

title: Campus Clashes, Secret Crush
description:
Greer Vanderbilt, Kingsley Academy's spoiled heiress and cheerleading star, seduces her nemesis Sloane's boyfriend to seize the cheer captain title — only to be stopped by Dorian Ashford, a dangerous transfer student. That night, her father introduces Dorian as her future "brother."
Greer schemes to drive him out; Dorian strikes back harder. Amid their clashes, an irrepressible attraction forms — but Dorian harbors a secret: he believes Frederick abandoned him and his mother, and came to destroy Greer as revenge.
When assassins nearly kill Greer, Dorian saves her. Yet he still allies with Sloane to strip Greer of her position. Sloane's jealousy spirals — rigged stage lights, leaked photos — until Dorian's revenge plan is exposed, and Greer's trust shatters.
Frederick stages Greer's fake death and sends her abroad. A paternity test reveals Dorian and Greer share no blood. A year later, he finds her overseas and promises to spend his life making it up to her.

title: Tutoring my Rival Boy
description: Life isn't easy for Chris Blanning, valedictorian at a snobby private school. It's hard enough dealing with bullies already, but when his scholarship isn't enough to cover tuition, he's got to tutor his worst enemy — Lucien Alaric, the spoiled bad boy he just saw trying to seduce their teacher into changing his grades! Even worse, Lucien's figured out his deepest, dirtiest secret in return. All he can do is keep his friends close, and enemies closer — but maybe Chris is getting a little too close...

title: Cashback Over Crushes
description: Jason gave everything for his dream girl, Mia — only to catch her cheating with a wealthy rival. On the verge of a breakdown, he awakens the Trillion-Dollar Subsidy System, which rewards him with luxury homes and supercars for completing tasks. He rises from rock bottom, humiliates the cheating woman and her lover, then saves his father by confronting his own cousin, gaining hotel equity and launching his business empire. Along the way, he protects a childhood friend and helps a woman named Sophie, steadily expanding his wealth until he becomes the richest man in Cloudhaven.

title: The Stand-In Girlfriend
description: Daisy Scott wakes up as the stand-in villainess in a short drama. Her role? Pretend to be the first love of her boss, Spencer Sutton. But Daisy isn't interested in drama—she's here for the paycheck. She happily plays matchmaker between Spencer and his real love, Vivian Winters, while pocketing his cash. Her plan goes off the rails when mysterious heir Liam Lawrence shows up with a magical blood ring that declares Daisy his fated one.

title: Cutie's Secret Voice
description: In her past life, Harper Prescott was killed by her parents and sister after helping them win the family inheritance. Reborn, she decides to get a new dad—her deadbeat uncle! But Gramps can hear her every thought. Guided by her inner voice, Richard Prescott finally sees his eldest son's worth and exposes the ruthless hypocrisy of his second son, Derek Prescott. This time, Harper will get her happily ever after!

title: Checkmate, Mr. CEO
description: Riley marries Simon Lewis to save her brother and treat her first love, but becomes a tool in a marriage filled with neglect. When Simon's ex, Sarah, returns, Riley plans to divorce and start her own business. She turns every challenge into an opportunity while outsmarting her rival and Simon's schemes. As Simon's feelings shift from indifference to obsession, Riley stays focused on her goal: independence and control over her life, no matter what he wants.

title: Clumsy Cupid
description:
Eva, a cold-blooded assassin, accidentally triggers a deadly curse after killing the man chosen as her soulmate. Her only chance of survival is Leo—a clumsy Cupid apprentice who has failed his divine exam for ten thousand years.
Bound by an invisible life thread, they must stay within three meters of each other or die. With only seven days left, the mismatched pair is forced to run from a powerful assassin organization while uncovering a conspiracy that has been manipulating love itself.
Eva has never trusted anyone. But when Leo repeatedly risks his life to save hers, she must decide whether love is her greatest weakness—or her only way out.

title: Lady CEO's Fatal Contract
description: After a heart transplant, Violet learns her donor, Eve, died at the hands of her boyfriend, Liam, a famous artist. Seeking proof, Violet signs a BDSM contract to become his servant, but Liam doesn't abuse her—he protects her with a tenderness that terrifies her. When her ex-husband uncovers her lie and blackmails her, Liam quietly makes him disappear. Now Violet faces an impossible truth: she came to destroy a monster, but he may be the only one who truly owns her.

title: Cashback Over Crushes
description: Jason gave everything for his dream girl, Mia — only to catch her cheating with a wealthy rival. On the verge of a breakdown, he awakens the Trillion-Dollar Subsidy System, which rewards him with luxury homes and supercars for completing tasks. He rises from rock bottom, humiliates the cheating woman and her lover, then saves his father by confronting his own cousin, gaining hotel equity and launching his business empire. Along the way, he protects a childhood friend and helps a woman named Sophie, steadily expanding his wealth until he becomes the richest man in Cloudhaven.

title: Darling, Forgive Me
description:
When she learned from the sister of her husband's first love that she was the third wheel in her own marriage, the one who had ruined someone else's relationship and indirectly caused the death of her husband's beloved, her world shattered. Coupled with her husband's contempt and disdain, she ultimately chose to end her life. Her husband, thinking she was merely throwing a tantrum, was indifferent and even relieved by her absence. However, he gradually realized his deep-seated love for her. By the time he started looking for her, he discovered she had died.
In reality, she had been saved from her suicide attempt and had been living secretly in another city. The malicious sister orchestrated a car accident to kill her and steal her husband's love, but she miraculously survived, albeit with amnesia—forgetting nothing except her husband. Now, her husband embarks on a long journey to win her back... Can he earn her forgiveness and successfully rekindle her love?

title: CEO, Madam Has A Secret Child!
description: Six years ago, she divorced her CEO husband without him knowing she was pregnant. Now, she lives alone with her child. When they meet again during a blind date, can they clear up misunderstandings and reconcile their broken relationship?

title: Love at First Oops!
description: Ten months after Nancy Miller’s fateful encounter with Blake Hart, the CEO of Hart Corp, a devastating accident takes her mother’s life. Desperate to secure her newborn daughter’s future, Nancy leaves her at Blake’s doorstep. Later, with a recommendation from her mentor, Nancy joins Hart Corp. As Blake raises their daughter, he embarks on a relentless search across the city for Nancy, eagerly awaiting the day she will return to him and walk down the aisle in the grand wedding he’s been planning all along.

title: Divorced, Devoted & Dominating
description: Jocelyn gave up her tech career for marriage, only to be betrayed and forced to serve her husband's mistress. She divorces him, takes back her patents, and tanks his company overnight. After a flash marriage with her former rival Steven, she returns to the tech world and rises higher than ever, leaving her ex with nothing.

title: The Reaper's Contract
description: Three years ago, Hades Cross was dispatched on a mission abroad and became a legend among the mercenaries. Now, returning home, his new mission is to investigate the Styx Syndicate. Hired as Diana Chase's personal bodyguard, Hades finds that the danger escalates with every step he takes.

title: Countdown to You, Mr. CEO
description: The Psychic Ace transcended to the mortal body of Annabelle, who could see the countdown of life on people's heads. In her free time, she would treat those with various "strange diseases". Gilbert was one of them. Three years ago, Annabelle saved the dying Gilbert. And she discovered that Gilbert had been cast with Love Spell. Since then, Gilbert had developed feelings for her. Years later, Gilbert recognized her and could no longer control his love for her. He decided to be selfish in his final limited life and propose to Annabelle...

title: Smitten with the Jinxed Assistant
description: When her father becomes critically ill, a young woman is forced to impersonate a missing wife to obtain surgery funds. She juggles deceiving the husband at night while working as his assistant by day, leading to blackmail and misunderstandings. After enduring betrayal and captivity, she escapes and eventually reunites with the husband a year later, resolving their conflicts.

title: Underworld King Fights For His Wife
description:
Upon discovering my true identity, my ex-wife deeply regretted her actions! 
I was originally the great master, but after meeting my wife, I chose to hide my identity and live as an ordinary worker on a construction site. However, once on our wedding anniversary, while I waited eagerly, she was celebrating a birthday in a wealthy household!
Unable to tolerate it any longer, I divorced her. At a banquet later on, I revealed my true identity, only to be met with skepticism from the crowd. Just as doubts arose, my subordinates finally arrived, confirming my powerful status!

title: Charmed by Her Whimsy
description: For the sake of her family's interests, a young girl must impersonate her twin brother, only to accidentally enter the wrong room and inadvertently spend a passionate night with a billionaire CEO...

title: Mic Drop Diva
description: Ivy is a high-school sophomore with the voice of an angel. She's also a super wealthy heiress, but she hides her identity in the hopes of making real friends at school. After becoming besties with Vanessa, she thinks she's made the right choice. But, Vanessa actually treats Ivy like a total tool! Vanessa even guilt-trips Ivy into being her voice double. But, things start to fall apart after Ivy catches her boyfriend cheating on her with her bestie! Heartbroken and betrayed, Ivy seeks help from her childhood bestfriend and star quarterback, Blake. Will Ivy be able to reclaim her spotlight?

title: Your Time Is Up
description: Charles was just a delivery guy until a car accident with powerful CEO Wendy changed everything. The crash awakened a strange ability: he can now see the countdown of everyone’s remaining life. When Charles saves Wendy from a deadly fate, his own life spins out of control. He discovers his wife's betrayal and faces humiliation. But from that moment on, the tables turn. With his newfound power, Charles rises from the ashes, exposing lies, avenging the past, and rewriting his destiny.

title: The Heiress vs. The Fake
description: She and her boyfriend had been in a long-distance relationship for four years. After high school, she went abroad to study and, not wanting him to feel insecure about his own modest background, kept her wealthy family’s status a secret, pretending to come from a regular family and claiming she was studying abroad on student loans. Through four years apart, she always believed in his love for her. However, at a reunion back home, she saw him arm-in-arm with her family’s adopted daughter, and in that moment, her illusions shattered. The adopted daughter had been using the family name to her own advantage, posing as the true heiress. At the reunion, she and a group of classmates mocked and humiliated her, but the real heiress wasn’t hiding anymore—she called in her three brothers, who swiftly put them in their place.

title: The Luna's Second Choice
description: Ten years ago, Elara was adopted by the Alpha of the Stormfang Pack and was destined to choose one of his five sons as her mate.
