However, the five brothers fall for a manipulative omega maid named Jenny, who schemes to humiliate and torment Elara. Heartbroken and exhausted, Elara publicly rejects her mate bond with the five brothers on her eighteenth birthday and announces her engagement to the mysterious and powerful Lycan Prince, Xavier Lockhart. As the brothers finally uncover Jenny's deception and desperately try to win Elara back, they realize it is too late. Elara finds her true mate in Xavier, breaking his deadly curse, and moves on to a new life, leaving her painful past behind.

title: The Heiress's Revenge
description: As a kid, the heiress was taken away but found her family later. Her foster sister got jealous and tricked her, causing her mom's death. But, she also got pregnant by a rich guy. Pretending to be dead, she came back after five years, determined to make those who hurt her pay for it.

title: Second Chance No More Mrs. Nice Girl
description: After spending three years suffering as the unwanted “real daughter” of the Davis family, Chloe is drowned by her scheming adopted sister Mia—while her own family rushes past her to save the impostor. Reborn three years earlier, Chloe refuses to be the family doormat again. She cuts ties with the Davises, returns to the only man who ever truly loved her—her adoptive uncle Julian—and rises as a genius hacker, prodigy designer, and the heiress they will all beg to win back.

title: Addicted to My CEO Doctor
description: Housewife Renee suffers from a long-term sexless marriage because her husband Ethan favors her older sister Kira. This repression triggers a compulsive sexual disorder, and she seeks medical help in shame, where she meets Damian—a elite professional with a double identity. In the consultation room, he sees through her pain and childhood family trauma. Using treatment as a pretext, he gets close to her, then unexpectedly joins her company as her new boss and promotes her to be his personal assistant. In public, he is restrained; in private, the tension between them is electric. Renee is repeatedly humiliated by her husband and framed—drugged and kidnapped by her sister—but Damian fiercely protects her at every turn, dismantling their enemies' power. Renee decisively divorces, and after a crisis involving a doppelgänger impersonating her, the two finally confess their true feelings and hold a wedding. In the end, Renee becomes pregnant. They heal each other's traumas, and she gains both a flourishing career and a fulfilling family.

title: Space Cowboy's Royal Escort
description: Caesar, the universe's strongest "Mechanical Man," honors a dying friend's wish by escorting Princess Shirley through deadly territory. Battling the Wild Grass Gang at every turn, he holds the line until reinforcements arrive—keeping his promise, and keeping the people he cares for safe.

title: The Simp Claps Back
description: Leo made Maisie the queen of Wall Street, only to be pushed off a roof by Maisie and Brad at his wedding to Maisie. When Leo opens his eyes again, he finds himself reborn in his college years. Living this life over, Leo swears to live only for himself, no more "Maisie's simp." He even finds someone new, the young heiress of the Hale family.

title: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?!
description:
I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?! is based on the novel published by Tapas Entertainment, Inc.
When Kaitlyn Sinclair moves into her off campus apartment with her high school sweetheart for her freshman year of college, she immediately catches him cheating on her. She is forced to move into her brother’s apartment and share a space with his best friend who is in grad school on the same campus. When her childhood crush reignites, Kaitlyn and Cole must navigate their newfound adult relationship while evil exes, mean girls, and worst of all- Kaitlyn’s brother, try to tear them apart.

title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise
description: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.

title: The CEO's Contract Wife
description: The CEO's Contract Wife:  Love doesn't cost a thing… until it costs you everything. When billionaire CEO Jasper Tate is fired by his own grandfather, he makes a desperate attempt to get his job back. A wife? An heir? No problem, sign a contract and any girl will do. Any girl being Khloe Adams, who is equally desperate because she needs money to save her sister's life. No love, no sex, no strings attached, but when Khloe ends up in Jasper's bed, he realizes that everything written in their contract... was meant to be broken.

title: Fly, Little Captain
description: Ace pilot Teddy wakes up in the body of his eight-year-old self on the very flight that once took his father's life. With the plane on fire, the captain unconscious, and hundreds of lives hanging in the balance, Teddy must use his adult mind in a child's body to change fate and save everyone before history repeats itself.

title: Chicken Game
description:
Invited to a secret streaming broadcast, Jae-in begins the "Falling Quiz Show," where she can win 1 billion won by answering only the truth. However, the host unexpectedly starts asking about the death of her younger brother Jae-ha, who recently died in an accident, leaving Jae-in flustered under suspicion that she may be connected to his death. Following the rules, the floor gradually opens while ropes tighten around Jae-in’s neck… Jae-in claims that Jang Doo-yeol, who had bullied Jae-ha since childhood, is the culprit.

Jang Doo-yeol, kidnapped and brought to participate in the quiz show after being named by Jae-in, points to the owner of the chicken shop where Jae-ha worked as the real culprit, while the owner in turn accuses Jae-in. Amid endless mutual accusations and revelations, a “Chicken Game” among the three protagonists—rushing toward a catastrophe that could have been avoided—truly begins.

title: The Husband She Took for Granted
description: A gifted scientist gave up his career to be a stay-at-home husband and dad for his baby, only to find out his wife had an abortion to save her business partner. He finally files for divorce, and returns to science. His wife who's taken him for granted now regrets it all.

title: Cure Code
description: A man with erased memories must outwit his captor, decode a deadly puzzle, and uncover his forgotten past before the lies surrounding him seal both his fate and the fate of the world. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: My Dead Ex Came Back Rich
description: Five years ago, she divorced him to save her family—then watched him fall from the sky. He didn't die. He came back as a billionaire, hungry for revenge. Now he owns her as his servant, never knowing she kept his son a secret. But the deeper he digs, the more he finds her painful truth: she sold everything to find him, even borrowed money for his grave. When his son is in danger, revenge turns into regret—and love rises from the ashes.

title: My Off-Limits Hockey Coach
description: Cole Sutton's private video accidentally plays in front of his hockey team, and Coach Vaughn Knox is the only one who stays calm. Everyone thinks Knox hates him, but Cole soon finds the truth: Knox has been watching, writing about him, and waiting to cross the line. When their forbidden relationship leaks, Cole's first-line spot is taken and Knox's career is at risk. The team thinks Cole slept his way up. Cole answers on the ice. He wins the game, proves Knox chose right, and walks straight into a relationship built on control, obsession, and a ring.

title: Cranky Call
description: One hot night in a big city, Llittle Butch flips through a phone book looking for trouble and lands on Gertie, a no-nonsense gal with a PhD in savage comebacks. Poor Butch does not have a chance!*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: The Cooking Queen: A Recipe for Divorce
description: Tiffany, once the legendary “Queen of Cuisine,” gave up her fame to support her husband Barry. But Barry betrays her, siding with his mistress Sera and treating Tiffany as if she's worthless. Heartbroken, Tiffany wanders aimlessly until fate leads her to Claude’s small restaurant. There, her hidden talent is reignited, and she dazzles her critics with her culinary prowess. Then, she crosses paths with Barry once again.

title: The Predator's Prey
description: Kelly was sent to the creditor Hector by her dad to offset debt. This seemingly well-designed trap was nothing more than a convenient opportunity in Hector's eyes. He calmly manipulated Kelly's father's weakness, yet in front of the pure and righteous Kelly, he played the role of an innocent victim. This two-faced man took every step carefully, setting traps gently, and ultimately firmly trapped the girl he had long loved in his life.

title: CEO, Madam Has A Secret Child!
description: Six years ago, she divorced her CEO husband without him knowing she was pregnant. Now, she lives alone with her child. When they meet again during a blind date, can they clear up misunderstandings and reconcile their broken relationship?

title: Charmed by Her Whimsy
description: For the sake of her family's interests, a young girl must impersonate her twin brother, only to accidentally enter the wrong room and inadvertently spend a passionate night with a billionaire CEO...

title: Chic Mama Drama
description:
CHIC MAMA DRAMA is a scripted comedy series about the behind-the-scenes of Anne Stedman making a talk show, running a fashion website, being an actress...all while being a mom.  Somehow always sorting out the hot mess that's in front of her.

Episode 1: When Anne arrives to pick up her Chic Mama Carpool guest, Laura Wasser she encounters a curious stranger and things begin to get a little too personal.

Episode 2: Anne gets locked out of her house an hour before an important meeting.  In an attempt to still make the meeting, she asks her judgemental neighbor for help.
*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: I Came Back for You
description: Ryan Carter was a billionaire—until he woke up as a high school nobody. Everyone still sees him as the clumsy kid crushing on the class queen, Olivia. But Ryan doesn't care about old reputations. He has one goal this time: save Grace Sinclair, the girl he lost to a fatal disease in his past life. While building a fortune, he'll rewrite the future, protect her at all costs, and finally win the love that slipped away. This life, he's playing for keeps.

title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise
description: When broke student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton and Amber Collins, and Audrey utterly captivated. After all, who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth?

title: Secret Crush
description: Wealthy heiress Audrey Hayes is forced into an engagement with trust fund playboy Logan Vance, but her true crush is her fiance's Uncle Dominic, the aloof CEO Dominic Vance. To break the engagement and pursue true love, Audrey sets a series of traps: hiring someone to seduce Logan, faking evidence of his cheating, and even pretending to be drunk to pounce on Dominic. During their hilarious romantic tug-of-war, Dominic sees through her schemes but still falls for her. Ultimately, Audrey successfully breaks off the engagement and gets Dominic to propose publicly, managing to turn the tables from the future niece-in-law into Aunt Audrey.

title: My Dead Ex Came Back Rich
description: While undergoing heavenly tribulation for ascension, Daoist Grandmaster Aurora transmigrates into a wicked villainess facing divorce. Handed a payoff check, a confused Aurora silently roasts the tragic fate of Christian Sterling's family, unaware they can hear her inner thoughts. With Aurora's help, Christian Sterling manages to defy the heavens and change fate, uncovering the true culprit and rewriting his family's destiny.

title: Brothers by Chance，Lover by Choice
description:
At an industry party, up-and-coming model Liam is nearly drugged—but celebrity photographer Ethan spots it and pulls him to safety. Sparks fly. Soon after, they discover they’ve become stepbrothers in a newly blended family. Even so, as consenting adults, they choose each other and fall in love.
As Liam’s career takes off, distance creeps in. Liam assumes Ethan resents his rise, while Ethan stays silent for reasons he can’t explain. During a meeting with producers, Liam narrowly escapes an attempted assault and finally understands what Ethan has been trying to protect him from—along with the hidden scars Ethan has carried all along.

title: Miss Secretary, You Stole His Heart
description: Opal is a smart, witty, and resilient young woman, navigating her career with ease as the indispensable secretary to CEO Silas. As she faces the persistent entanglements of a past love and family interference, Silas begins to be drawn to her. Caught in the whirlwind of work and romance, Opal bravely chooses her own path to happiness.

title: He Came Back for Me
description: Sally Saunder is forced to marry Quentin Sterling. Trapped in a gilded cage, she makes a shocking discovery: Quentin is actually Chase—the boy she once saved from death, now returned under a stolen identity to destroy the family that ruined his. As Quentin's obsession with Sally deepens, she is torn between the gentle memory of her childhood protector and the dangerous, vengeance-driven man he has become.

title: You've Been Replaced, First Love
description: To Jason, Tessa was only a disposable practice run for the girl he actually wanted. After the blood on the sheets became a public trophy and her dignity a ghost, young Tessa finally stops trying to mend the shards. She is done with her first love. She is leaving him behind for a future that doesn't taste like salt and shame. But at the edge of the wreckage stands the one person who shouldn’t be there: another boy with no intention of letting her go alone.

title: Seduce My Ex's CEO Uncle After Rebirth
description: In her past life, her husband ruined her family, causing them to go bankrupt, resulting in the death of both parents and leaving her unable to conceive. She died on the night she decided to divorce after learning the truth. Reborn, she vows to protect her family and cherish herself. However, she unintentionally attracts the attention of her ex-husband's younger uncle. Initially considered just a transaction, she finds herself entangled in a deep love with this billionaire...

title: Second Chance With My Mr.CEO
description:
Jennifer, a celebrated Best Actress, was killed in a fire at an awards ceremony in her past life — a plot masterminded by her scumbag boyfriend Aidan and her backstabbing best friend Beatrice. Reborn on the very night she was supposed to elope with Aidan, she resolutely dumps the worthless man and boldly pursues Cassian, a paranoid and domineering CEO.
She gives both the sanctimonious hypocrite and the scumbag a taste of their own medicine, dishing out ruthless retribution. Furthermore, during a life-or-death showdown aboard a luxury cruise ship, her shocking secret lineage — granddaughter of a powerful mafia kingpin — is unveiled. Ultimately, she and her beloved share a fully reciprocated, deeply devoted love, and their story culminates in a warm, perfect proposal.

title: Reborn: My Sweet Princess Era
description: Elaine Kelly donated her marrow to save her neglecting father James Chapman, but became too ill and died full of regrets. She was reborn and was determined to take control of her own fate this time. Elaine attended an audition and landed the leading role, beating her half-sister Rachel. Conflict ensued at the audition, leading Elaine to want to leave her dad to live with her new manager, Tracy Ford. It was only then that James started to show more concern towards Elaine. The pair gradually resolved past misunderstandings and started their new happy life.

title: The Royal Chef’s Comeback
description: Henry, a culinary genius with ancestral imperial-chef recipes, spent eight years building the high-end Starlight Feast for his childhood friend Jasper—only to be betrayed. Jasper coveted the recipes, shortchanged him, and humiliated him publicly. With his mother gravely ill, Henry turned to a street stall, but Jasper’s men smashed it and injured his best friend Cole. At his lowest, Iloen, owner of the rival restaurant Voss, offered help—covering his mother’s surgery and inviting him to run her failing restaurant. Bound by cuisine and business, they fought Jasper’s attacks: supply cuts, chef sabotage, and online smears. Henry’s mother gave him a ticket to a cruise culinary exchange. On board, Jasper kidnapped Henry’s sister, forcing a deadly wager: loser loses wrist tendons. Through two rounds, Henry exposed every scheme, bringing the villains to justice. A month later, Voss thrived, his mother recovered, and Henry found family, friendship, and mutual love with Iloen.

title: Bound by the Past
description: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. 8 years after Dante took a bullet for Valentina, a mafia war rages between Chicago and Las Vegas. With a world of bloodshed knocking on their door, they must decide how to protect their daughter, and their marriage.

title: He Came Back Rich and Cold
description:
Five years ago, Lena Harrington, an heiress, dumped poor genius Adrian Cole without looking back. Now he’s a billionaire. She’s drowning in debt. When they meet again, he’s her boss—and everyone’s waiting for his revenge.
But what no one knows? The girl who broke his heart… is still the one he never let go.

title: Dirt & Diamonds
description: Jack Lewis is a construction worker. On the day of his girlfriend's graduation, he buys a ring to propose—but she suddenly has a change of heart and gets engaged to his best friend instead. Amara Green, the president of the Green Group, happens to witness the entire scene. Moved by Jack's kindness and genuine heart, she decides to enter into a flash marriage with him.

title: My Homeless Hubby Is a Trillionaire
description: On the eve of her wedding, she discovers her fiancé's infidelity. In a fit of anger, she marries a stranger on a whim. Little did she know that her handsome homeless husband is actually a trillionaire CEO!

title: Babe, Don't Escape
description:
"I wish you are the first person I see once I regained my vision." I am a wealthy heir. Five years ago, I became blind in a car accident and was taken in and cared for by a girl who refused to reveal her identity. I fell in love with her. 
But when I regained my sight, she disappeared. I reclaimed my billionaire CEO status and vowed to find her before entering into a contracted marriage. Gradually, I discovered clues pointing towards my assistant... Could she be the love I've been searching for all along?

title: Giant Croc Attack
description:
A bloody prophetic dream warns Ivy her fiancé and best friend will betray her and push her into Storm River to be devoured by a prehistoric giant crocodile.
The nightmare unfolds at a typhoon-trapped resort. Tourists vanish, the crocodile hunts, yet everyone calls her crazy.
Fed up with mockery and betrayal, Ivy readies supplies and deadly traps to fight back with Marcus.
Two ancient crocodiles lurk in the river. Survival turns brutal. Can Ivy escape alive and rewrite her fate?

title: Her Rejection, My Chance
description: When the proud Evelyn rejects wealthy Adrian's charity, the desperate Natalie seizes the chance he offers: secure Evelyn's acceptance, and he'll fund her education. Natalie succeeds, but the price is becoming Adrian's kept woman—a substitute for the one who refused him. As she navigates a gilded cage of obligation, a startling shift begins: Adrian's fascination with the woman he couldn't have transforms into a longing for the one he took for granted. Now, Natalie holds a power she never sought—the key to his regret.

title: The Master in Hiding
description: Eight years ago, Finn defeated all 22 martial arts schools in Heatherfield to prove his boxing supreme, but he lost his wife in the aftermath. He vanished to raise his infant daughter as a humble rickshaw puller. When Vanguard Martial Arts School targets him and endangers his child, Finn steps back into the ring, tearing through their ranks to bring his daughter home.

title: My Cyber Beau, My CEO
description: A young graduate applied for a job as a fashion designer, but the CEO thought she was a marriage candidate his mother sent him. The CEO was thus really picky and mean to her, and they didn't get along. But what he didn't know was that she was actually his online girlfriend...

title: Second Chance: A Prince's Obsession
description: Sophie unexpectedly time-traveled to ancient times, and she was to be buried! Then she kicked open the coffin, shocking everyone! Her property was being stolen? She found a man to use as a sperm donor to have a child, and then came back to seek justice! What? The man she randomly found was actually a prince? This is perfect! With the royal family's backing, she can also promote her profession! After all, she is best at... making women pregnant.

title: His Second-Chance Bride
description: In his past life, Felipe, a wealthy heir, was strung along by Myrtle, only to watch his family fall apart after their marriage. Reborn with a second chance, he turns away from his past and chooses Reana, a serene woman he believes he's never met. But what Felipe doesn't know is that this mysterious woman is no stranger at all. They shared a beautiful, forgotten childhood memory.

title: God of Pain
description: A sheltered mafia princess tries to escape an arranged marriage, only to fall for the school’s most dangerous bad boy. But he refuses to love her… Until he can’t let her go.

title: Too Close to Touch
description: Caleb Vance, the rebellious man of underground street races, has a new stepsister—Simone. He sees her as an unwelcome intruder, a reminder of his fractured family. For Simone, Caleb is the storm she's irresistibly drawn to. Between street races, family drama, and buried secrets, they fight their forbidden attraction. But when the line between brother and lover blurs, will they dare to cross it?

title: I Came Back for You
description: Ryan Carter was a billionaire—until he woke up as a high school nobody. Everyone still sees him as the clumsy kid crushing on the class queen, Olivia. But Ryan doesn't care about old reputations. He has one goal this time: save Grace Sinclair, the girl he lost to a fatal disease in his past life. While building a fortune, he'll rewrite the future, protect her at all costs, and finally win the love that slipped away. This life, he's playing for keeps.

title: Fate's Second Chance
description: Isolde Corven, mute after a car crash, married Cassian Thorne. She thought he was the love of her life, until she overheard the maids gossiping—turned out he had only married her to bear a child for his infertile first love, Selene Vennor. Heartbroken, she got into another car accident. Due to Selene's scheme, Cassian believed Isolde was dead. Six years later, Isolde returned as Ismena, a top architect, with a baby boy, Leif. Fate continually drew her and Cassian together, yet layers of misunderstanding and pain kept them apart. Finally, Leif's kidnapping forced them to work together, and the truth was eventually unraveled...

title: His Humble Badass Wife
description: Everyone was scared of him in the city, but he married a countryside woman who turned out to know medicine, fighting, and even owned part of a big company. The CEO gets scared of his wife, "I'm sorry, I won't snoop into your secret identities again!"

title: Luck Magnet Girl
description:
Little Alodia had a tough start. At just five years old, she was stuck living with her mean aunt Rhea who only cared about boys. Life was lonely until she met Jade, the fiery widow everyone in Loess Village talked about.

A funny thing happened after Jade took Alodia in. Suddenly, Jade's struggling herb business took off. Bills got paid. Good things just kept happening. Turns out the quiet little girl was what folks called a "luck magnet" - where she went, fortune followed.

Of course, nasty aunt Rhea came sniffing around when she heard. The village chief, Larry Greene, heard the rumors, trying to take Alodia back. But Jade wasn't having it. With help from folks like Osmond and the neighbors, they showed Rhea for the cruel woman she was.

In the end, Jade got to keep her lucky little girl, proving sometimes the family you choose is better than the one you're born into.

title: Little Guardian? No, That’s My Big Boss!
description: The ice-cold CEO Chris Preston finds himself in danger due to corporate rivalries. Desperate and with nowhere to turn, he is introduced to a legendary master, only to discover she is a six-year-old girl named Momo who needs hugs and ice cream. Standing no taller than his knee and clutching a worn-out doll, Momo seems out of place. However, when she effortlessly takes down top assassins with a lollipop and her bunny doll, Chris is forced to accept this absurd reality...

title: Mama's Second Chance
description: In her first life, Anna Young tricked Cyrus Lewis into marriage, only to lose him and their son Leo to her gambling debts. Reborn at the start of her mistakes, Anna is determined to rewrite her destiny. Now, she must use her foreknowledge of the 1980s economic boom to build an empire from scratch, while desperately trying to win back the trust of the family she once destroyed. But her vengeful rival, Cindy Yates, won't make it easy.

title: Don't Cross Clara
description: Clara Yates did the time for a crime she didn't commit, and now she's out—with Julian Payne's baby, his ring, and a burning desire for payback. But her quest for vengeance gets complicated when she develops real feelings for her powerful husband, forcing her to reveal the artistic genius she's kept hidden for years.

title: Mecha Era: I Can Contract Unlimited Mecha Girls
description: Blaze Xander was dumped by his girlfriend as soon as he entered the world of mecha girls. "An F-rank loser like you is not good enough for me, Blaze!" Right after his ex-girlfriend, Snow, said that, Blaze bound the system and awakened the SSS-rank talent, 'Infinite Recharge'. When Blaze controlled the SSS-grade mecha and stood at the pinnacle of the human race, Snow asked, "Blaze, can we go back to how things were?" Blaze looked at the charming SSS-rank mecha girls beside him and smiled faintly, "Sorry, you're not good enough for me, A-rank girl."

title: Love's Redemption: Her Resounding Comeback
description: I was once a billionaire CEO, but my husband tried to murder me to seize my fortune. Miraculously surviving, I went into hiding and was unexpectedly taken in by an incognito CEO. Now, fully prepared, I'm ready to rebuild my empire and reclaim everything that is rightfully mine.

title: 30 Days to Chill
description: Before dying, 40-year-old Lin Chuxue learns that her husband, Lu Mingzhe, never truly loved her and their son, Lu Xuan, favors his father’s former lover, Su Yun. Reborn into the seventh year of her marriage, Lin Chuxue initiates a forced divorce, which must undergo China's mandatory 30-day cooling-off period. During this time, she joins Professor Wang’s team in Shanghai to tackle advanced brain cancer.

title: A Second Chance at Love
description: Heir to Lingxiao Temple, She is forced into marrying him rumored to be on his deathbed. Neither wants the match, but fate steps in when she unexpectedly saves his life. Unaware they’re each other’s intended, they grow close amid a flurry of comedic misunderstandings before discovering the truth and embracing their happily ever after.

title: The Double Life of My Secret Secretary
description: Her parents forced her into a flash marriage with a stranger who was a CEO, so she fled abroad to escape. After returning home, to avoid her mother's nagging, she disguised herself as a man and became her friend's brother's personal assistant. She then discovered that her boss was the man she had a one-night stand with on her first day back—and he was also her flash-marriage husband whom she had never met!

title: Ex-Husband Wants Me Back
description: Three years into the marriage, she did everything a wife should, but she couldn't make him care. Disheartened, she chose to end their marriage...

title: Love at First Flight
description: Billionaire Luke Knight was mistaken for ground staff while boarding a plane of his own airlines. While on board, he helped head stewardess Melanie Lewis when she was harassed. After landing, Luke agreed to help Melanie by playing her boyfriend, but this led to a misunderstanding by his son Henry. Luke and Melanie worked together to resolve his family trouble and company crisis, but he had to pass a final test to have Melanie's hand in marriage.

title: Bound by Honor
description: Based on the bestselling novel by Cora Reilly! Trapped in an arranged marriage to the cold and dangerously seductive heir of the New York mafia, LUCA, 18yo sheltered mafia princess from Chicago, ARIA must decide if surrendering her body—and maybe her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance at survival.

title: The Filthy Rich CEO Proposed to Me
description: She went on a mismatched blind date with the wrong man. Hoping for a down-to-earth partner for an ordinary life, she never imagined that the single father with a child she ended up marrying would be her dream guy!

title: Veterans Who Refuse to Kneel
description: After leaving the army, Joseph and his fellow veterans start a produce business to build an honest life. When their late comrade's widow and daughter are harassed by an evil manager backed by a powerful tycoon, Joseph steps in only to have their company sabotaged. Cornered and humiliated, the veterans refuse to bow. With an unexpected ally exposing the corruption, they fight back and reclaim their dignity and their future.

title: Power, Lies, and Marriage
description:
Aurora may seem like an ordinary housewife, but in reality, she is the only daughter of the impossibly powerful Redmond family. On their wedding anniversary, she catches her politician husband, Shawn, cheating with her best friend, Tiffany, in his office. She also learns that her late young daughter was denied her life-saving transplant because of them.

After learning the truth, Aurora contacts her family and decides to leave Shawn. She secretly gets him to uniwttingly sign a divorce agreement. Completely unaware of what’s happening, he continues his endless string of betrayals, practically rubbing her face in his affair.

Aurora endures humiliation and anger. She plots her revenge. She exposes her cheating husband in front of the public at a campaign event, revealing his true nature to all of his supporters. She decides to run against him in the gubernatorial election, not only to end his political career, but to usurp it.

title: Signal: Mom Will Avenge You
description: Five years ago, while she and her husband were working late, their daughter was tragically murdered at home. Five years later,  to her astonishment, a long-unused phone accidentally rings. Driven by a mysterious impulse, she answers the call, which connects her to the time just before her daughter's death five years ago. The phone becomes a bridge between different timelines. In her desperate attempts to save her daughter, she repeatedly alters the timeline, triggering a butterfly effect. Through her efforts and the clues she pieces together, she uncovers truths she never knew: years of marital betrayal, the identity and motive of her daughter's murderer, and other emotional entanglements. Ultimately, she chooses to sacrifice her own life to save her daughter's. However, five years later, in another timeline, the daughter, now grown, uses the same phone to connect with her mother from the past, initiating another round of mutual redemption between mother and daughter.

title: My CEO Dad Chasing My Mom Back
description:
"Why are you still alive?" I don't know this crazy woman at all, and she just came up to me and shouted at me!
I suffered a car accident five years ago during pregnancy and was saved by a handsome stranger, who later I married. I've always noticed that my daughter looks very much like him, but because of amnesia, I can't recall the truth. 
Five years later, I now entered a tycoon jewelry company and met this crazy woman. Plus, many other people are saying that I look exactly like the CEO's daughter, the missing heiress! What's my husband and my real identity?

title: San Francisco Cowboy
description: A 21-year-old cowboy goes to San Francisco to find his mother, who abandoned him as a newborn baby. He meets fascinating and funny characters in San Francisco who change his life forever.

title: The Hacker's Revenge Code
description: Lü Shu, the backbone of the company, gets abruptly fired by the CEO's daughter who just returned from abroad, triggering a massive layoff that cripples the company. What follows is a series of unexpected and captivating twists.

title: Not the Bride He Wanted
description: Asher, Layla's mate, betrays her by eloping with her sister, Vivian, who was supposed to marry Lucian, the most dangerous Alpha King in history. To protect her pack, Layla agrees to marry Lucian in her place. Asher still believes Layla is his fiancée. Layla and Lucian, along with Asher and Vivian, hold their wedding ceremonies simultaneously. Just as Layla is about to leave, Asher realizes Vivian tricked him. In a frenzy, he grabs Layla, who's about to leave forever.

title: The Blind Wife's Unseen Trap
description: She was blind, but one day she suddenly regained her sight and discovered her husband cheating with her best friend. They had plotted to kill her for her inheritance. With danger looming, she chose to pretend to still be blind, cleverly outwitting them step by step to uncover the truth.

title: The Movie Star's Daughter in the Dark
description: Years ago, a handsome rising star pursued the plus-sized Best Actress against societal norms, becoming a celebrated couple, but after achieving fame, he shockingly killed his wife and daughter, initially blaming a home invasion. Little did he know, his daughter has returned with a hidden identity, determined to avenge her mother and bring him to justice.

title: My Sister Stole My Man
description: After a one-night stand, the woman’s sister steals her identity. Six years later, she becomes the CEO’s legal advisor, and they grow close. The sister, fearing exposure, tries to sabotage her, but the CEO thwarts each attempt. In the end, the truth is revealed, and the CEO’s family reunites.

title: The Warlord Returns
description: War hero Harrison returns from war to discover his sister has died by her fiancé, Karter's hand. Harrison infiltrates Karter's banquet wearing his worn fatigues, announcing to Karter that his punishment will arrive in 3 days. Eventually, he reveals his true identity as the Director of FBI, and achieves his ultimate revenge.

title: Spoiled by My CEO Husband and Cute Twins
description: Six years ago, the woman had sex with the president by mistake, and one of the children she gave birth to was taken away. Six years later, the woman went to the wrong table during a blind date, and mistakenly thought that the president who was looking for a nanny was her blind date. At the same time, the president's son ran out and hugged the woman's thigh and started calling her mom...?

title: End of the World, Start of My Empire
description: After World War III, Arthur Morgan is reduced to scraping by in the chaos, surviving on scavenged goods while being bullied and robbed by former high school classmates—until a chance discovery of alien technology changes everything. He rescues three women who become his wives and sets his sights on using this power to rise as the King of the Wasteland.

title: CEO, Those Twins Look Just Like you
description: As a single mother raising her twins, she unexpectedly encounters a playboy who disrupts her life. Little does she know, this playboy has a hidden identity as a billionaire. And shockingly, he turns out to be the father of her children...

title: Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King
description: Desperate to save her dying sister, Tessa agrees to auction off her virginity -- only to be claimed by the most dangerous man in the Mafia. Will she ever be able to trust the man who bought her love... or will trusting him cost her everything?

title: Ding! CEO Hubby Online
description: After being set up by her own family, Nora Wood becomes pregnant with Tyler Holt's child, who is later named Bryan. Unfortunately, when Bryan turns five, he is diagnosed with leukemia. In an effort to cover medical expenses, Nora decides to sell the family jade pendant Tyler had given her, triggering a city-wide search for Bryan by the Holt family. Meanwhile, Nora joins Holt Group as Tyler's secretary. As they work closely together, their feelings for each other grow, and their relationship flourishes over time.

title: The Master in Hiding
description: Eight years ago, Finn defeated all 22 martial arts schools in Heatherfield to prove his boxing supreme, but he lost his wife in the aftermath. He vanished to raise his infant daughter as a humble rickshaw puller. When Vanguard Martial Arts School targets him and endangers his child, Finn steps back into the ring, tearing through their ranks to bring his daughter home.

title: Watch Out! She's a Mastermind Heiress
description: After growing up in the countryside, 21-year-old Isabella Patton is sent back to her wealthy birth family. Before long, she becomes acquainted with the smoldering (and much older) Oliver Bates, who begins to relentlessly pursue her, oblivious to the fact that she is his fiancée. Meanwhile, Isabella's cousin Eliza, who was raised by the Patton family in her place, is on a desperate mission to turn the whole family against her for good. Unluckily for Eliza, Isabella is a hotshot genius with unparalleled talent in the medical and tech fields, and is able to outduel Eliza at every turn. As Isabella's unique skills are revealed, she wins the support of her five brothers and parents, becoming the crown jewel of the Patton family while always remaining just out of Oliver's grasp.

title: The Heiress Can't Catch a Break
description: Chloe Vance is abandoned at the altar by her fiancé, Sebastian Carmichael. Her adoptive parents then reveal she isn't theirs and demand back child support. Just as despair sets in, her biological parents—the mysterious richest billionaire Vincent Kingsley and his wife—appear to welcome her into their elite family. Making a stunning comeback as the Kingsley heiress, Chloe puts her adoptive family and scumbag ex in their place. Meanwhile, she and her infant betrothal partner, Spencer Winslow, fake a relationship, only to realize they caught real feelings. Dropping the act, they decide to marry and start a happy life together.

title: 30-Day Marriage After a One-Night Stand
description: As she prepares to embark on a lucrative job in Africa, she unexpectedly crosses paths with the enigmatic CEO of a major corporation. After a misunderstanding leads to a whirlwind marriage to quell public scrutiny, they apply for divorce on the very day they obtain their marriage certificate, agreeing to a cooling-off period before their separation. What starts as a temporary cohabitation soon becomes complicated by his charming advances and the looming conflicts of high society. With a month to navigate their complicated relationship, how will she choose between her heart and her ambitions?

title: The Hart-Breaker
description: Nerdy girl Pearl is determined to catch the eye of her longtime crush, but is clueless on how to do it. But after a shocking encounter with Ethan Hart, the school's biggest bad boy, she makes a deal with him that will finally get her noticed. With his help, Pearl catches the attention of the guy she wants and sparks do fly... but in the wrong direction.

title: Bound by Her Heart
description: Owing her life to the heart donated by her sister, the girl is determined not to waste it. With the support of a billionaire CEO, she seeks vengeance against those who wronged both her and her sister...

title: Nanny to My Hot Bully
description: Abbi is Felix's rival... and nanny. Things take a complicated turn when she moves into his house to care for him and his sister and Felix  and Abbi realize their feelings for each other. Can Abbi hide her feelings for Felix to keep her nannying job?

title: Died Coding, Came Back Cheating
description: A genius programmer dies from an all-nighter building AI. He wakes up in a fantasy cultivation world. No magic talent. No ancient bloodline. Just a weird pendant girl and a brain full of modern science. While others meditate for centuries, he builds flying drones, combat algorithms, and energy weapons. The elites laugh — until he breaks every record and becomes the youngest legend in history.

title: When Forever Fell Apart
description:
For their sixth anniversary, Natalie wants to surprise her husband Ethan, so she goes to the clinic to check on the sperm he stored… only to find out he took it out long ago!
Turns out, he donated to his ex and childhood crush so she could have his baby! And now that woman is back—with the child. Worse, Ethan actually brings them into their home, as if they belonged there.
After being let down again and again, Natalie finally makes up her mind. She’s done. She wants a divorce. She’s walking away. For good.
Will Ethan manage to save their marriage before it's lost forever, or will Natalie disappear before Ethan realizes that he's lost a truly good woman?

title: Evolve to Devour
description: Ryan Summers is transported to the Beastmaster World, where he's stuck as a despised, F-rank Muckhide Serpent. On the brink of death, he activates the Devouring Evolution System. Starting as a Shade Wolf, he devours enemies, evolves into a Creation Dragon, and becomes a force that can shake the world. With humanity fighting a global Beast Horde and powerful invaders, Ryan devours gods, rises to ultimate power, and leads the charge to save the world.

title: Five Years Desert Exile, His New Bride
description: Aria spent five years in a desert oil field, believing Dylan would marry her. Instead, he exiled her to marry Harlow. She returns to stolen credit, a forged scandal that killed her father, and an overdose. She doesn’t vanish. She gathers proof—fake degrees, stolen patents, a forged paternity test, Harlow’s affair—and sends it to the board and the press. Their perfect life collapses. Dylan loses everything; Harlow ends up on the street. Aria rebuilds in Midland—loved, free. She has receipts.

title: Married The Mafioso I Saved
description: Hannah gave up everything for her fiancé, only to be brutally betrayed and abandoned in the States. Desperate to stay, she flash-married Alex, the "street thug" she accidentally saved with a single kiss during his escape. Passion ignites as Alex shields her from her vengeful ex and every threat. As their new life unfolds, Hannah starts to realize Alex might be more than just a street stranger...

title: The Ex-Con Lawyer's Revenge
description: Nora was a rising defense attorney until her fiancé Adrian perjured himself on the stand, framing her and sending her to prison for three years. She emerged to find Adrian with Brooke—the real Bennett heir, who killed her own best friend Emma and stole her song. Nora quietly allied with Julian (the wrongly convicted man's cousin) and Emma's father Frank. Frank retrieved a deleted recording from Brooke's home: Brooke ordering the murder. In court, Nora exposed everything. Brooke got life. Adrian fell. Nora reclaimed her law license, cut ties with all who betrayed her, and began again with Julian.

title: The Vote Queen: My Mayor Ex Can't Have Me
description: Competitiveeating champion Vivian has a special gift: the more she eats, the better luck people close to her get. She devotes all her resources to boost husband Arthur’s mayoral campaign, only to face his betrayal and forced divorce. Vivian breaks away and enters an alliancemarriage with rival candidate Smith. With her supernatural gift, wit and public popularity, she crushes schemes from her exhusband and tycoons, exacts revenge and gains sincere love.

title: Between Us & Our Enemies
description: Felix (the bottom) and Dimitri (the top), agents from opposing factions, have been locked in a deadly game for five years. Despite their professional rivalry, they share an unspoken rule: "missions are missions, but the bed is ours." Beneath the surface, genuine feelings have blossomed. When pressured by their superiors, Felix feigns indifference to protect his lover. A nuclear crisis forces them to pose as a couple on a yacht for an undercover mission, where their staged romance turns real. Upon returning, they resolve all misunderstandings and join forces to eliminate the mastermind behind the scenes, faking their deaths to escape the organization. Shedding their assassin identities, these once lonely and proud individuals find redemption in each other, finally embracing the domestic life they've always dreamed of.

title: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
description: Lisa accidentally sleeps with her CEO ex-husband, Aidan, for the first time. He had neglected her so much that he doesn’t even know her face! Next day, in a comedy of mixed identities, Aidan hires her to be his secretary and starts pursuing her! Will she take him back?

title: The Elf Queen's Revenge
description: Seraphina heard her husband plot to swap their baby with his mistress's child. He would raise the mistress's daughter as the prophesied Warden. Seraphina's own child would be crushed into nothing. She smiled, said nothing, and switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, she stood in the shadows and watched her husband beat his own daughter bloody. She watched him throw her into a viper pit. She watched his mistress brand the girl's face with a permanent scar. They never knew the girl was theirs. All that cruelty meant for Seraphina's child—they poured into their own. On Awakening Day, Seraphina gave her enemies everything they wanted—until she revealed the truth in front of the entire realm. Their ""chosen"" daughter was never theirs. And the girl they destroyed carried their blood.

title: From Heartbreak to Fated Lover
description: For four years, Ava believed Mason Collins loved her. But when his first love returns, he calls Ava nothing but a "pastime." Humiliated and broken, she accepts a contract marriage with the tycoon, Anderson Lauren. But this marriage is more than a deal. Anderson has been searching for Ava for years, and he'll do anything to protect her—even if she doesn't remember him. As buried truths surface and hidden enemies close in, Ava discovers she was never just an orphan.

title: Love on the Edge
description: Caroline Winsor, once a pawn in her mother's quest for luxury, is betrothed to the controlling tycoon Dominic. On the day of their grand wedding, she decides to escape, only to find herself in the thrilling world of underground racing, ruled by the enigmatic Wyatt. Unbeknownst to all, this icy racer harbors a secret identity. What could happen between a fallen heiress and a street racer?

title: To All the Exes I've Loved Before
description: To escape her living hell, she willingly takes her savior's hand and chooses to become the villainess. Behind the glamorous lights, a genius producer from a wealthy family orchestrates the perfect trap, while she puts on a mask to enter the game herself for vengeance. Now, a cruel yet beautiful revenge play begins against the monsters blindly exposing their ugliest desires.

title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy
description: Natalie's conniving grandmother and sister marry her off to a rural farmer, Rhett. He's a single father, looking after a mute daughter, Ellie. Natalie's presence isn't taken kindly, as she is shunned by Ellie and the woman next door. Over time, she learns the woman next door is actually abusing Ellie. She develops a bond with Ellie, which deepens when Ellie speaks up for the first time to save her. But as Natalie starts settling in, new troubles arise. Ellie is bullied at school, and Natalie gets tangled in conflicts involving both her old and new families. She vows to protect the hard-won love and family she's built.

title: A Match Made in Heaven
description:
I flash married a street vendor, but he turned out to be a billionaire CEO!
I am a lost wealthy heiress, betrayed by my boyfriend, and my foster parents even wanted to sell me to an old man. In desperation, I flash married a street vendor!
To my surprise, the vendor is actually a successful and rich CEO. With his support, I will make everyone who wronged me pay!

title: American Sniper: The Kid of Guns
description: After Carl Oliver, The American Sniper and King of Guns, heroically dies saving a little boy named Spencer from a car explosion, his spirit is magically transferred into Spencer's 9 year old body. Now Carl, while inside the body of a 9 year old boy, must save his new family's gun range from unscrupulous relatives, evil rivals, and even deranged killers.

title: I let her have all. They live in regret
description: On her wedding day, Sabine brother Leo spills red wine on her mother's heirloom wedding dress. Her fiancé Marco then pressures her to apologize to Ava. She publicly calls off the engagement, and leaves the Ricci household to study design under Nora, an old acquaintance of her late mother. After Sabine's departure, Leo and Marco finally realize how their years of favoring Ava have hurt her. Plagued by remorse, they set out to find her. Deprived of her sources of support, Ava spirals out of control. She flees to Nora's home and takes her hostage, luring Sabine to come alone. At the critical moment, Marco, Leo and the police officers arrive. Ava is shot dead, and Nora is rescued...

title: The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl
description: After a one-night-stand, Adele Moore becomes pregnant. She wants to keep the child, but her father kicks her out of the house. With nowhere else to go, Adele becomes homeless.  She tries her best to raise her son despite her challenging circumstances. One day, Adele's son, Brad Moore, runs into billionaire Heston Deleon.  By chance, Heston discovers that Brad is his son. He tries to track down Brad, but loses their trail. Through a series of misunderstandings, Adele and Heston become entangled again!

title: Infinite Evolution: From Serpent to Immortal
description: Born a nameless snake, Ethan Yates was destined to be prey. But with the Ultimate Devouring System, he hunted beasts and refined Spiritual Flames to fuel his rise. After winning the Hidden Dragon Trial and devouring the Serpent Queen, Ethan triggered a Limit-Breaking Evolution. He shattered his lowly bloodline to become a Flood Dragon, seizing his path toward the Immortal Realm.

title: Wait, That's My Wife!
description: After years of secretly being the richest heir, Guang plans to reveal his true identity to her girlfriend Shen Liuli, hoping she'll love him for himself, not his wealth. At his best friend Dong’s wedding, he’s shocked to see Shen Liuli as the bride, realizing she chose Dong for his money, believing Chen was just a poor guy. Faced with betrayal from both his friend and his love,  Guang decides to take a stand and seek the ultimate revenge.

title: Kissed by Claw and Fang
description:
"Ivy, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car-- a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private highschool. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Sebasian, the werewolf heir, and Zane, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities: one as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love?  
Ivy later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything."

title: Trapped in the Boss's Embrace
description: Lovestruck, Beatrice Lawson eloped with her college sweetheart Desmond Belmont and has been secretly married to him for ten years. However, when she discovers his affair with a wealthy socialite, Beatrice decides to divorce him and finally stop living in his shadow. As she begins to make a name for herself with a new apartment and new career, she meets the mysterious and attractive Damian Crowley. As the two men fight for her attention, Beatrice wonders if love is worth all the pain and sacrifice, or if she's better off fending for herself.

title: The Bride They Never Expected
description: Celine Samuel, the chairwoman of Samuel Group, is about to marry Harry Chase. When she humbly goes to pick up Harry's mother at the airport, she's mistaken for his mistress—while Harry's glamorous mistress Amy is embraced as the future daughter-in-law. Now, Celine must endure public humiliation from Harry's mother, who has no idea she's insulting the real boss.

title: He Sent Me a Lover
description: Natalie Vance, the daughter of a wealthy tycoon, is forced to marry the powerful Edward Sterling. Because her husband is infertile, she is forced to have sex with Sebastian Reed, a male companion hired by her husband, in order to continue the family line. Initially deeply humiliated, Natalie gradually develops genuine feelings under Sebastian’s gentle protection. The two join forces to collect evidence of the Sterling family’s crimes against the Vance Group. At a charity gala, Natalie publicly exposes her husband’s brutality and conspiracy. She ultimately succeeds in divorcing him and begins a new life with Sebastian, completing her power transformation from a puppet of a wealthy family into an independent woman.

title: The Nurse's Secret Marriage
description: Nurse Aria Browne gets married to billionaire CEO Mason Adams to raise money for her dying mother's operation. Purely contractual, the two never actually see each other during their courthouse ceremony. They meet again three years later - Mason, as the owner of Aria's workplace, and Aria, as the nurse who saved Mason's grandpa's life. They don't recognize each other, but their feelings for each other grow as they spend more time together. Falling for his grandpa's nurse, Mason decides to divorce his wife who, unbeknownst to him, is the very woman he's falling in love with.

title: Mistress Wars
description:
She was a successful businesswoman with a perfect life—until her husband’s mistress, a live-streaming influencer, barged in with the “Anti-Mistress Alliance,” accusing her of being the homewrecker.
Humiliated and enraged, she began to suspect her husband, who denied everything. As her best friend’s suspicious closeness to him came to light, betrayal surrounded her on all sides.
With her husband and his mistresses plotting against her, she decided to fight back. How will this toxic marriage end?

title: Cancel the Wedding, Queen Moves On
description: Maria’s perfect life crumbles when she discovers her fiancé's affair. Determined to take control, she confronts betrayal, finds herself drawn to Alec, her long-lost ex and now a billionaire. As their paths collide, old feelings awaken, and Maria discovers that love can be unexpected, passionate, and impossible to ignore.

title: I Had a Baby without You
description: Five years ago, curvy waitress Scarlett saved Brandon's life and spent one unforgettable night of passion with him before vanishing. Now she's back, slimmed down and unrecognizable, and he's the reclusive CEO who unknowingly fathered her daughter.

title: CEO's Twins Want Mommy Back
description: With a loving hubby and cute stepkids, Cassandra's flash marriage seems too good to be true.  But will her troubled past catch up to her? And why do the kids seem so familiar?

title: The Monster Made Her Queen
description: Gideon chained Cora to an altar and fed her to the Deep King. The monster didn't tear her apart. Soren unlocked her chains, kissed her, and gave her half his heart-stone so she could breathe the sea. She married him. She loved him. Then Gideon returned. He cut out Soren's heart and crushed the stone in front of her. Cora woke in the enemy's camp, poisoned again, stripped of everything—until she felt a kick inside her belly. Soren's child. The one they said could never exist. Now she carries the last of the Deep King's blood. The sea is calling her home. And this time, she's not coming back as a sacrifice. She's coming back as their queen.

title: Breaking the Ice
description: Single mom Caroline dumped her first love Easton Black eight years ago…But she never told him he got her pregnant! Now he’s the hottest hockey star in the league and Caroline's boss! Will Caroline tell him the truth, or is it all too late? Based on Shutout by Jami Davenport!

title: Meet My Brothers
description: Catherine Rowen spent three years as a contract wife, treated like a servant and discarded the moment her divorce papers were signed. Pregnant, humiliated, and threatened by her husband’s mistress, she hits her lowest point, until a helicopter lands, revealing the truth: she is the long-lost daughter of the powerful Lane family, rightful sister of Dominic, Connor, and Liam.

title: How to Kiss a Vampire
description: Eight years after Vincent abandoned her, Ella—now a single mom—is pushed off a rooftop and saved by a mysterious, flying masked man. She wakes up to find Vincent at her side. He denies being the masked man but insists his enemies are targeting her and demands she move in with him for protection. Why is the man who broke her heart now acting like her savior? And why does he seem... not entirely human? Can Ella trust him again—or is he hiding more than just a mask?

title: CEO Queen: A Mother’s Revenge
description: After 15 years of living as a humble orphanage worker, Mary Miller's peaceful life is shattered when a brain hemorrhage leaves her comatose. While her youngest adopted daughter Grace desperately tries to save her life by selling her own blood, her other children Rose and William reveal their true cruel nature. When Mary finally wakes and claims to be Phoenix Group's legendary CEO, she faces brutal mockery and violence. But those who dare abuse the "delusional old woman" are about to learn they've made a terrible mistake—as Mary's vast empire prepares to strike back against all who wronged her family, while rewarding the one daughter who loved her without knowing her true identity.

title: My Stolen Billionaire Life
description: Switched at birth, Allie had no idea who she really was until she fell for Xander Maddox. That's when she gets her DNA results. Now, she's torn between telling Xander who her father really is and risk losing him or keeping a lie from the man she loves.

title: Sisterhood of Lies: Pledge for Revenge
description: After Ashlyn dies in a sorority hazing “accident,” her identical twin sister June takes her place to get revenge on the real killers — Ashlyn’s back-stabbing bestie and her frat-bro boyfriend.

title: The Hitwoman
description: Madeline Archer, assassin, doesn't want bloodshed—but if she stops killing, her little sister dies. When Maddie is forced to take a contract on Hayden Kent, she runs into two problems. One, he's the District Attorney. And two–he was her first and only love. And he wants her back.

title: Bound to the Rebel Wolf
description:
Their families slaughtered each other, and they’re sworn to hate one another… but the pull between them can't be denied.
Maeve, the alpha princess, enters Luperiom determined to survive the kingdom’s brutal war college. What she doesn’t expect is a fated bond with Saxon Blackmoor—the most powerful wolf there… and her enemy.
Now, the one wolf she shouldn’t want might be the only one who can save her.

title: Newly Wed Enemies
description: After her father is destroyed by Alexander Helios’ Ponzi scheme, Flora infiltrates Helios Corp to ruin his family. But when Alexander’s son Apollo unexpectedly marries her, revenge turns complicated as she discovers he may be innocent of his father’s crimes.

title: The Price of Loving You
description: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?

title: Zombie King Rise: Even the Belle Begs Me
description: Fired from Pelagia University after her lifebond beast died, Lydia Quinn summons Lucas King, a Rank FFF little zombie hiding SSS-tier powers. Together, they win the National Mentor Assessment despite sabotage. Now VP at Drayne University, Lydia faces a deadly trap. Surrounded by Bosses at antimagic domain, Lucas removes his Corpse-Suppressing Talisman, unleashing chaos, until Lydia's kiss brings him back.

title: The One I Never Forget
description: Five years ago, a tragedy that claimed the lives of loved ones from both sides forced Sofia​ and Justin​ apart, a separation further complicated by Doris's​ lies, Sofia's miscarriage, and Justin's severe injury. Five years later, Sofia returns to Los Angeles as a renowned journalist, while Justin has become a baseball superstar. Their reunion is fraught with conflict, fueled by misunderstandings (Sofia falsely claims to be married; Justin mistakenly believes Sofia left him for money), obstructions (continued opposition from Doris and schemes by Esther), and danger (Esther's plot to commit murder). Ultimately, Justin uncovers the whole truth about the past, Doris confesses her wrongdoing, and Esther is exposed for her crimes and arrested. Transcending their pain, Sofia and Justin achieve dual fulfillment in their careers (Sofia completes her major report; Justin wins a championship) and in love. Their story highlights how honesty and forgiveness can allow love to be reborn from the ruins of lies and violence.

title: Leaving My Alpha Husband in Ice Cold Regret
description: When Snow discovers her alpha husband cheating, she offers herself as ritual sacrifice to be eternally frozen. And when she leaves, she will finally break their mate-bond, leaving ice cold regret to be his new forever mate! But what will he do to bring her back?

title: OMG, I'm Surrounded by Three Princes
description: Erin, a down-and-out street vendor, is betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, but no one knows that her true identity is the long-lost princess. Just when the three princes find the clues and Erin can return to the royal family, her true princess identity is claimed by her best friend. In the many subsequent dangerous situations, Prince Charles repeatedly protects Erin, causing Erin to develop a different feeling for her "brother" Charles.

title: Daddy Forgot, but Mommy Remembers
description: Nicole loses everything the night she’s framed—her freedom, her child, and the love of her life. Seven years later, she returns as a nanny in the very house that once destroyed her. Ethan, her ex-fiancé, still haunted by the woman he once loved, starts to feel something for the new nanny—without knowing it’s her. Secrets simmer, memories resurface, and Lila, their stolen daughter, is the unexpected thread pulling them back together.  He doesn’t remember her. But his heart never forgets.

title: Betraying My Billionaire Husband
description: When rich heiress Jane Walden's father is imprisoned for fraud, she's left to fight cancer and a secret pregnancy without any money. Wanting to protect her fiance and his new company from her disaster of a life, she stages a fake affair in order to get him to fall out of love with her. But years later, even though he's finally a billionaire, Vincent still hasn't forgotten Jane. How does she break it to Vincent that he has a 7 year-old son named Dylan?

title: The Regent’s Secret Wife
description:
For four years, I raised the foolish son my scumbag duke had with his mistress.
The moment he returned, he humiliated me in front of everyone.
“You're only fit to be my mistress.”
I let out a cold laugh and signaled for my attendants to escort the child into the carriage.
What he didn't know was that four years ago, on the day he forced me to swear before his iron gauntlet, I turned around and married the most powerful man in the entire kingdom.
And now… my king has come to stand behind me.For four years, I raised the foolish son my scumbag duke had with his mistress.
The moment he returned, he humiliated me in front of everyone.
“You're only fit to be my mistress.”
I let out a cold laugh and signaled for my attendants to escort the child into the carriage.
What he didn't know was that four years ago, on the day he forced me to swear before his iron gauntlet, I turned around and married the most powerful man in the entire kingdom.
And now… my king has come to stand behind me.

title: Open Your Eyes, My Billionaire Husband
description: Hailey is cash-strapped and desperate for a way to pay her mother's heafty medical bills. Her family agrees to help her, on the condition she marries the billionaire Samuel Trent, whom is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it wouldn't be long before the infamous Samuel Trent would wake up from his coma and discover he's engaged to a complete stranger.

title: He Made Me Kneel Before the Fake Saintess
description: Once the strongest rope guide of the Sacred Mountain, Evelyn was framed after an avalanche by the beloved Saintess Celeste, who claimed Evelyn cut the rescue rope and left her crippled. Her fiancé, Duke Adrian, believed the lie. For three years, Evelyn knelt on frozen steps to pay for her brother Noah’s medicine and keep the orphanage alive. On the final step, Adrian orders her to kneel and lick Celeste’s boots. Then a black raven arrives with Noah’s death notice. With nothing left to lose, Evelyn tears up the atonement contract and drags the Saintess’s perfect lie into the light.

title: You're My Treasure
description: Five years ago, the blind and paralyzed CEO was abandoned by his family, but she stood by him faithfully. They fell in love, and he gave her half of his jade pendant as a token of their love. However, after a car accident, she suddenly disappeared, and miraculously, the CEO's vision was restored. Since then, he has been searching for her.

title: I Returned, Everyone Else Fell
description: He was once despised as a worthless failure, a man who drove his own family to ruin while chasing the favor of the powerful. Then he died—and woke up reborn, carrying five thousand years of immortal wisdom in his soul. Now, facing his dying mother and bitter sister, he swears to rewrite fate. Watch as the Immortal Sovereign returns to walk among mortals, settling old scores and shaking the world to its core.

title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me
description: The wolfless Lyra, has been captive in the Wolfsbane pack for seven years, during which she was constantly abused by Alpha Roland. During one of her escapes, Lyra has an accidental one-night stand with Alpha Alfred, Moonshadow pack's strongest Alpha, and becomes pregnant with his child. Alpha Alfred rescues Lyra from Alpha Roland and brings her back to his pack. To protect her, Alfred and Lyra form a Fake Luna contract.

title: Spoiling Me, Spoiling You - The Rich Wife's Sweet Game
description: After dying on a night shift, nurse Sophia wakes up as the wife of a top tycoon. But she's immediately accused of being a mistress by the original wife's bitter ex, who even threatens her life. The husband, Spencer, is rich, handsome, and heirless, so Sophia decides to charm him into securing her future. To her surprise, this cold, woman-hating man turns into a loving, doting husband who can't get enough of her.

title: True Heiress Never Lies!
description: Pampered real heiress Ellie is framed and sent to juvenile detention by her family. They believe she lives comfortably, unaware that under the fake daughter's orders, Ellie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she is released, broken inside, but still seen as spoiled. Only when her father beats her and her prosthetic falls off do they realize the truth...

title: My Ex Rejected Me, He Protected Me
description: To save her sick daughter, desperate single mom Elise Chandler spends a fateful night with her drugged benefactor, CEO Nathaniel Reed. But when her greedy family steals the lifesaving money and she discovers she is pregnant, Elise hits rock bottom. Cornered at the hospital by her degenerate gambler ex-husband and terrible parents, Nathaniel swoops in, knocking the trash out with one punch and paying all her bills. Learning the truth, he publicly declares that the baby she is carrying is his! Watch as he fiercely defends her, crushing the scumbags, and keeping the mother and daughter under his wing with endless love, turning a debt of gratitude into a match made in heaven.

title: Fake Queen Bee, I'm the true Heiress!
description: Seo Hae In, MK Group heiress who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hae In hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life. However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Seo Si Eun, the daughter of the Hae In family's maid, arrives at school posing as the MK Group heiress. Si Eun quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hae In finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.

title: We Will Love Again
description: You dumped Noah Preston when he had nothing,  but now he's a billionaire!

title: ReelTalk EP13-Queen Bee Meets Queen Bee
description:
Get ready for a buzzworthy return as the queen bee herself, Daniela Couso, joins the latest episode of ReelTalk with Sarah Moliski! These two legendary villains dish on the reality of bringing their characters to life and the fun side of it all. Daniela also spills the tea on surviving the chaos of high school drama, how she conquered it, and made her way to the Hollywood spotlight! She even dives into fan comments. Some sweet, some downright crazy!
This episode also packs a bonus clip with another villain you love, Michael Vaccaro! Tune in for a candid convo about the power of representation for mature actors and why they absolutely deserve to take the lead in those swoon-worthy romance stories too.

title: The Quarterback's First Love
description: After her quarterback fiancee’s betrayal, cheerleader Maddie’s life unravels. Drawn to Cameron, another football player who feels oddly familiar, she faces new challenges as her ex, the cheer captain, and Cameron's mother plot to tear them apart.

title: Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer Is My Ex-Lover
description: Freya Swann turned her back on her first love, Tristan Blackwater five years ago…But she never told him she had his child! Now he’s returned to the kingdom as a dragon-slaying hero and Freya is his personal servant! Will Freya finally tell Tristan the truth?

title: Love Me, Bite Me
description: For centuries, the most powerful vampires, the Tepes family and the Velda family have remained an alliance which, if broken, could send the world into chaos like never before. The alliance is threatened by a seemingly normal human girl Sammantha Evans, a waitress at Club Dracula owned by the powerful Alarik Tepes. One fateful night on New Years Eve, the world will be changed forever…

title: Addicted to You
description: Audrey's biggest regret? A one-night stand with Floyd, her secret love for eight years. Despite his arranged marriage and his family's troubles, he kept rescuing her. She thought she was just a fling, but he was already head over heels for her...

title: Beast-Taming: All Evolve, I Revert
description: Expelled by the Collins family, illegitimate child Miles Collins has rare beast-taming talent but is too poor to form a pact with even a lowest-tier spirit beast. Humiliated by Ryan Collins and Sophie Grant, he awakens the Ultimate Beastmaster Reversion System. While others evolve, he uses ancestral reversion to turn a green caterpillar into the Void Azure Dragon!

title: ReelTalk EP6-Could Self-Love Be Self Defense?
description: Join host Rachel Bencosme and the fabulous Haley Lohrli for a spirited episode of girl talk and espresso martinis! These two ladies discuss the importance of having a solid support system and the magic of vulnerability. As they mix up their favorite cocktails, they share heartfelt moments and the key ingredients to building your own village. Whether you’re sipping at home or just need a dose of friendship, tune in for a bubbly conversation that celebrates the power of connection, one espresso martini at a time. Cheers to friendship, laughter, and a little liquid courage!

title: ReelTalk EP9- The Reel Happily Ever After
description: In this enchanting episode, join Richard and Jessica Sharrah as they take us on a heartwarming journey through their fairy tale romance. From the moment Richard swept Jessica off her feet on a motorcycle to their happily ever after, their story is nothing short of magical. Our host, Sarah Moliski, puts their love to the test with a whimsical challenge, and even invites their children for a game of 'Who is Most Likely To.' Be sure to stay tuned until the end for a surprise that will add an extra touch of magic to their family story!

title: Pregnant and Married to a Movie Star
description: Pregnant and broke bartender Lacey is offered the role of a lifetime when non-commital movie star Chris Powell asks her to pose as his fiancee. Neither of them knows that the baby she's carrying is actually his.

title: The All-Seeing Eye
description: Struck by a deadly bolt of lightning, he awakens the all‑seeing Immortal Eye—a divine power that defies all logic. He sees through fake antiques, peer into hidden illnesses, and instantly expose every weakness of his enemies. But his greatest secret? A hidden cultivation realm lurking beneath the glittering modern city. Now, ancient immortal arts clash head‑on with cutting‑edge technology—and one man holds the power to rewrite the world’s rules.

title: My Secret Billionaire Husband
description: Farming leads Molly Gordon to a billionaire CEO. She thinks he is just a handsome husband, but his hidden identity shocks everyone. He saves her land, crushes local bullies, and spoils her with unlimited cash. Molly uses his wealth to boost the village through livestreaming. Now, she enjoys true love and a thriving hometown.

title: The Lost Prima Ballerina
description: Amelia Wilson, the richest heiress, was lost on Halloween. The poor waitress Jennifer found and kidnapped Amelia so that her daughter managed to be adopted by Amelia's family and live a rich life. Thirteen years later, Amelia, now a ballet champion, faces bullying from her biological family and the impostor heiress. Eventually, Amelia's family discovers the truth and begs for her forgiveness...

title: The Elite Heir's Ultimate Comeback
description: Hector and Alice have been in love for years, but just as Hector is about to reveal his true identity, a tragic accident leaves him in a coma. Alice’s family, despite their limited resources, contributes what they can to his recovery. As Hector slowly regains consciousness, he can only communicate by pressing a call button. Meanwhile, an antagonist posing as a doctor manipulates the family. In a critical moment, Hector finally speaks, warning the antagonist that with a single phone call, he can bring them to justice.

title: The Eunuch’s Secret Queen
description: Betrayed and brutally tortured to death by the Emperor, the Crown Prince, a powerful general, and the principal graduate in her past life, Rosalind Ashcroft is reborn on the eve of the imperial selection. She allies with head eunuch Lucian Thorne after discovering his fake identity. One by one, she strikes down her enemies: she destroys the new principal graduate Benedict Fairfax, schemes to overthrow the Crown Prince, and turns the Emperor and the general against each other. As they bond through blood and fire, Lucian is revealed to be a former royal. Together, they tear the palace apart, send their foes to hell, and seize the ultimate throne.

title: Never Ever Lie (The Witch Game)
description: Six friends head out on a camping trip to play a game of Never Have I Ever, but between laughter and secrets, they soon realize the forest hides a presence determined to punish every lie.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Spoiling Me, Spoiling You - The Rich Wife's Sweet Game
description: After dying on a night shift, nurse Sophia wakes up as the wife of a top tycoon. But she's immediately accused of being a mistress by the original wife's bitter ex, who even threatens her life. The husband, Spencer, is rich, handsome, and heirless, so Sophia decides to charm him into securing her future. To her surprise, this cold, woman-hating man turns into a loving, doting husband who can't get enough of her.

title: You're My Treasure
description: Five years ago, the blind and paralyzed CEO was abandoned by his family, but she stood by him faithfully. They fell in love, and he gave her half of his jade pendant as a token of their love. However, after a car accident, she suddenly disappeared, and miraculously, the CEO's vision was restored. Since then, he has been searching for her.

title: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
description: Lisa accidentally sleeps with her CEO ex-husband, Aidan, for the first time. He had neglected her so much that he doesn’t even know her face! Next day, in a comedy of mixed identities, Aidan hires her to be his secretary and starts pursuing her! Will she take him back?

title: Taming the Hellion Prince
description: On her wedding day, Adelaide Sterling arrives at the altar — only to find her groom running off with her half-sister. Instantly, she makes a split-second decision — marry Zachary Blackwood, the notorious "Hellion Prince". Known for his wild ways and late nights at the Elysium Theater, Zachary is every noblewoman's nightmare. But Adelaide is no ordinary bride. While others whisper, she sharpens her sword — and her plan. And when enemies close in, it is Adelaide who leads armies, crushes conspiracies, and forces her crownless king to kneel — not in defeat, but in devotion.

title: The Mermaid Queen’s Revenge
description: Serlanty, East Sea mermaid princess, was drained of golden scales by her family and lover. The bastard Winsil stole her credit. She traded the Heart of the Ocean for human form, defeated evil with the Land King and found true love.

title: Reborn: Female CEO at My Feet
description: Reborn on the very day Valerie Stanton breaks off their engagement and humiliates him publicly, Miles Sterling awakens the Goddess Conquest System. He opens lucky chests, crushes Felix Vance and the security guards with ease, and turns Valerie’s attitude around instantly.
