After unlocking a $50 million black card from a chest, he exposes her desperate funding crisis. Valerie begs and fawns over him for a loan, her favor skyrocketing. Dominating the system step by step, Miles rises to the very peak of success!

title: The Secret Between US
description: Tessa and Asher were first loves. Asher left without a word due to family reasons. Three years later, they reunite, but Tessa is now the fiancée of Asher's nephew.

title: Dangerous Situationship
description: Workplace queen Kate Lane and "mysterious hire" Evan Weston start as weekend lovers with one rule: business only, no feelings. But as they join forces to survive corporate warfare, their no-strings arrangement becomes dangerously real. When Evan's hidden identity as the company heir surfaces—along with a formidable rival for Kate's heart—trust shatters. Yet in the ruins, they discover the one truth neither expected: some battles are worth losing, if it means winning each other.

title: My Nephew, The Crown Prince
description: Yvette, orphaned daughter of a fallen general, once married Crown Prince Jeremy and suffered endless humiliation. Reborn on the day of the imperial marriage decree, she refuses to repeat her fate. This time, she chooses the Emperor's injured brother, Prince Yale. Miraculously awakened, Yale gives her respect and protection, and love grows between them, while Jeremy, recalling the past, realizes too late he has lost her forever.

title: Accelerating Love
description: At her wedding, ordinary girl Lillian experiences a heartbreaking betray when she catches her boyfriend cheating with her best friend. In the moment of desperation and defiane, she determined to prove her own worth and impulsively takes the hand of a scruffy mechanic Luca, who stands beside her as it happens. Instead of becoming a burden, their marriage flourishes as they navigate a series of sweet, unexpected moments and overcome challenges together. To Lillian's surprise, Luca is not just a simple mechanic - he is secretly Hamilton, a billionaire CEO and legendary race car driver. What started as a fake marriage turns into genuine love. Watch as the two of them join forces to write a extraordinary rising love story!

title: Fortress Doomsday
description: In the apocalyptic chaos of Fortress Doomsday, protagonist Gage Thorne is reborn with a unique "Rage System"—fueled by vengeance and emotional energy. As mutated beasts, ruthless gangs, and the mysterious Esper Alliance rise, he transforms his humble shelter into an impenetrable stronghold. From Tier-E defenses to nano-enhanced gear, Gage battles Alpha Zombies, Espers, and his own past to uncover the truth behind the Starlight Project and the ABRI conspiracy. Survival is just the beginning—domination is the goal.

title: Shared Senses, Sweet Love
description: To save her mother, Crestmont genius Audrey Hayes joins Vance Group, unexpectedly becoming physically bound to CEO Damon Vance and pregnant with his quintuplets. Though Damon initially thinks she is a gold digger, he falls for her resilience. He protects Audrey from Stella Cole and Lila Quinn's schemes. Ultimately, misunderstandings fade. Audrey's mother recovers and Audrey becomes the cherished wife of the Vance family.

title: The Mute Bride's Revenge
description: After witnessing Reginald murder his wife, Lottie feigned muteness to survive. Years later, she fell for her rescuer Julian, but they were separated by her mother. When her family fell, Lottie sought Julian, only to have her identity stolen by Natalie. To escape Reginald, she married Julian. Pregnant and mistrusted, she fled, later returning disguised as a kidnapper. Their conflict ultimately exposed the truth, allowing them to take down Reginald together.

title: Beyond Us
description: In a future wasteland world, genius AI engineer Clara is devastated when her ex, Marcus, turns her warm companion robots into cold service tools. She quits and takes PWL-000, a Reject Robot slated for destruction. Little does she know, it holds a massive secret.

title: When Fame Meets Love
description: On Harlan's 16th birthday, his mom and stepfather died in a car accident. Due to a series of unfortunate circumstances, he began living with his stepfather's daughter, Eva. Eva was just 22 and became his guardian. As they lived under the same roof, Harlan gradually realized his feelings for Eva at 18. However, before anything could happen, Eva kicked Harlan out of the house. Six years later, the two met again. By this time, Harlan had become a popular star, while Eva was running a coffee shop. Fate brought the two together again.

title: Pregnant by the Serpent King
description: Accidentally transported into a book as a minor character doomed to die, Genny refuses to accept her fate. She's determined to change her story, but she's certainly not planning to give birth to snake babies for a Serpent King!

title: The Bride of the Wolf King
description: Hundreds of years ago, a contest of power and desire caused the Wolf King to lose the woman he loved the most. The Wolf King was in tremendous inconsolable grief and he had sealed up his memory. Then somehow the two met again. The grievances and affairs from the previous life slowly emerged. "And this time, I will kill everyone who obstructs our love. And you shall be my princess, the one and only."

title: Immortal King Reborn: Comeback with My Female CEO
description: The strongest genius of the celestial realm, after being betrayed and killed by a close friend during a treasure hunt, is reborn 500 years in the past. Now, he finds himself imprisoned for his wife's sake. Upon his release, she rejects him and files for divorce. However, his formidable strength soon captures the attention of the business queen of Haicheng, who is drawn to him.

title: See No Lies, Make No Mercy
description: Blinded and thrown off a cliff, Steve survives, merges with the Dragon Orb, and awakens "Dragon's Gaze", a power revealing the true price of everything. He snags a $20M treasure bowl used as a dog dish, pulls top-tier jade, and unearths a piece of the Imperial Seal. After humiliating his ex and bending the underworld to his will, he wins over three stunning women. But when the Nine-Dragon Tripod surfaces, the lethal Lane family comes for him. Armed with X-ray vision, Steve rewrites his fate.

title: My Unborn Baby Called Me Out
description: Rosie Grant died saving the world—and woke up as a fetus in a novel. Her mother? A world-class love fool. Her father? A gold-digging deadbeat. The whole family? Doomed. Rosie panicked. And then her thoughts started leaking out—loud and clear. Her mother heard her. The romance-brain snapped awake. Armed with Rosie's inside intel, the maternal clan united: outsmart the scumbag, crush the scheming mistress. By the time Rosie was born, she and her mother were the most spoiled girls in the Grant family.

title: My Backup Husband is a Tycoon
description: On Fiona's wedding day, both she and her sister Amber are reborn, but Amber seizes the chance to steal Fiona's wealthy groom, Leo Lynch, leaving Fiona to marry the seemingly poor security guard, Noah Porter. Fiona, aware of the Lynch family's deceptive allure, embraces her new path in search of tranquility. Yet, Noah's enigmatic background earns him the respect of powerful business figures. Meanwhile, Amber's dream of a luxurious life crumbles as her husband is unfaithful, leading her to pursue the affluent Porter family, only to find a shocking resemblance between their heir and Noah.

title: Family Is His Only Weakness
description: Wyatt, once known as Hades, the man who whipped the infamous No-Escape Prison into shape, returns to the city to uncover the truth behind his family's murder. Backed by seven formidable sworn sisters from every corner of power and influence, he cuts through criminal empires, crushes old enemies, and protects what's his. As the underworld collapses in his wake, Wyatt moves closer to the truth of his past and the reckoning that awaits.

title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad 2
description: Fay Thompson thought she understood the mafia world -- but the arrival of a scheming rival, a shocking pregnancy, and her lover's arrest will force her to become the Mafia Queen she was always meant to be, or lose Kent Lippert forever.

title: Fated to Find You
description: At 16, Bailey's foster mother sold her eggs on the black market, leaving her infertile. Years later, working as a school janitor, she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and meets the child’s father, a secret billionaire caught in a brutal custody battle. As their unexpected flash marriage blossoms into real love, secrets, betrayals, and a vengeful ex-wife threaten to tear apart their fragile new family.

title: Ms. CEO's Baby Daddy Is the Merchant of Death
description: Connor Reed, the most powerful arms dealer in the world, saves a Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while he is undercover. Four years later, while still hiding, Charlotte shows up... with their child. Now Connor must keep both of them safe... without revealing his true identity.

title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad
description: Fay Alden catches her boyfriend Daniel cheating and breaks up with him, but soon after, Fay meets Daniel's father Kent Lippert, the Mafia King. Kent not only reveals that Fay's real father is Mafia don Lorenzo Alden, but presents Fay with a proposition: marry his son to join the bloodlines, and he'll protect her family from a violent criminal. Fay agrees, and Daniel is all too happy to marry Fay to distract his dad and the mob world from the truth: he's gay. Fay struggles to fit in in the mob world, and can't deny her growing attraction to Daniel's father Kent. Soon, their relationship crosses into a passionate secret BDSM love affair. Don Alden is not who he seems, and is intent on using Fay as a bargaining chip to secure a better alliance with Russian syndicate leader, Ivan Kozlov. Fay and Ivan strike up an unlikely flirtation that erodes her fake engagement to Daniel. Fay's learns all too late that not only are her father and Ivan working together to destroy Kent, but Ivan is an undercover cop hellbent on taking Kent down and taking Fay for himself. Ivan and Don Alden's double cross lands Kent in jail, and after Fay discovers she's pregnant with Kent's baby, she decides she has to do whatever possible to free the father of her unborn child. With Daniel's help, she takes out Don Alden, and pressures Ivan into clearing Kent's name. Fay and Kent are reunited, marry, and live happily ever after.

title: Fall for My Icy Rival
description: Top skaters Arthur and Julian, long-time rivals, are forced to pair skate amid sponsorship woes. Suspecting Julian uses him for singles glory, Arthur remains distrustful despite quiet tender moments. Their agent Lily sabotages Arthur, leaving him injured. Julian abandons the World Championships to care for him. After further misunderstandings, they win the final, Arthur confesses publicly, and their hidden mutual love unfolds amid schemes and commercial pressure.

title: Five Winters for Her, Five Keychains for Me
description: Maya was Ryan's fiancée for five years. Every Valentine's, he flew to Aspen with his first love Hannah. Five years—thirty-seven gifts for Hannah, five cheap keychains for Maya. She decorated their apartment alone; he never once came to see it. Until Hannah's shoes appeared in the hallway and Hannah picked their wedding cake. Maya cancelled the apartment, quit her job, and left the city in under an hour. When he finally chased her down, she said: "You are five years too late."

title: Fated to Find You
description:
Six years ago, orphan Clara spent one night with Nathan, President of Shenghua Group. She became pregnant and gave birth to Emma alone. Six years later, Emma was bitten by a dog and faced costly rehab. Clara joined Shenghua Group as a logistics assistant and reunited with Nathan.

Vanessa, an heiress with a crush on Nathan, humiliated Clara, scalded five-year-old Emma with boiling water, and obstructed her treatment.

Walter, the Sheng family patriarch, discovered his son was infertile. At the hospital, he met injured Emma. A DNA test confirmed she was his lost granddaughter. Clara fought to protect Emma, while Nathan pieced together memories from six years ago.

Desperate, Vanessa kidnapped Emma. Walter rescued her and eliminated Vanessa's influence. Through life-and-death trials, Nathan and Clara confessed their love. Emma recovered, and the family reunited, embarking on a happy future together.

title: Feast of Power
description: Nick, who's secretly the wealthiest man in the world, lives as stay-at-home husband with his wife, Bella. Just as he’s about to reveal his true identity and share his wealth and power with her, he discovers Bella’s betrayal. Nick realizes he had mistaken Bella for his true love. He later finds Elena, a woman who loves him for who he is, not for his wealth or power. Determined, Nick takes back everything he had planned to give Bella and chooses to share it with Elena instead, leaving Bella full of regret.

title: Falling for My Dad's Best Friend
description: Kylie, a bold young woman infatuated with her dad's best friend, Jaxon, tests his limits as she tempts him with her charm. As Jaxon struggles to resist her, the tension between them escalates, leading to an ultimate betrayal that changes everything.

title: Love Beyond Misunderstanding with My Daddy CEO
description: The uncle CEO rescued the girl who was molested by the bad guys. Unexpectedly, the two had sex after being drugged. Not long after, the girl found out that she was pregnant and found the president. However, because the CEO knew that she was singing with him, he mistakenly thought that the girl was a vain and gold-digger... When will the CEO know that his savior was actually this girl?

title: Battlefield to Boudoir: She Rules Them All
description: Claire, daughter of a military family, was invincible on the battlefield. After her death, she finds herself in the body of the wife of Sebastian, CEO of Fowler Corp. To secure her independence, Claire agrees to a one-year marriage contract with him, promising to play the role of his wife in exchange for a house and a job upon divorce. Throughout the year, Claire not only outmaneuvers those who threaten her but also charms Sebastian's siblings. Sebastian gradually becomes captivated by her and embarks on a journey to win her heart.

title: Fated Mate of the Nine-Tailed Fox
description:
Rin, the sole heir of the White Nine-Tailed Fox clan, was kidnapped as a child by the Black Nine-Tailed Fox and raised in darkness.
On her 20th birthday, she plans to escape—once her fox powers finally awaken. But fate has a cruel twist in store: her destined mate is revealed to be Hyun Dong-joo, the cold and powerful leader of the Black Nine-Tailed Fox.
Rin and Hyun Dong-joo resent one another and reject the bond. But just when White Fox leader Baek Do-yoon steps forward and claims Rin as his fated partner, Hyun Dong-joo suddenly declares he will marry her instead.
Who will truly be Rin’s fated mate?

title: Falling for My Gold-Digger Wife
description:
Susan married Cyrus, believing her "tough luck" could balance his "bad luck." But the cold truth is his heart belonged to someone else.
She kept her feelings hidden, focused on paying off her parents' debts, and made the most of the marriage. When Cyrus's dream girl came back, Susan decided to walk away.
To win her back, Cyrus made her his assistant, guarded her fiercely at work, and fought for the marriage she wanted to forget. In the end, love wins out, and so does Susan.

title: Dine, Dash & Destroyed
description: Joyce Pike takes her mother-in-law, Grace, to her husband's fancy restaurant invested by her, only to discover they serve pre-made meals. Seeking justice, she faces humiliation from her husband's mistress. But Joyce is ready to fight back.

title: Phoenix Rising: A Princess's Revenge
description: Princess Yue Changge fought to secure her brother’s claim to the throne by opposing corrupt officials and leading successful campaigns. After her return to court, she was ambushed, and her cousin Fu Qingluan was killed by mistake. Before dying, Fu Qingluan revealed her mistreatment by in-laws and asked Yue Changge to avenge her and care for her daughter. Disguised as her cousin, Yue Changge seeks revenge while uncovering court conspiracies. She reconciles with Yun Chuxu, whom she had once broken off their engagement with, and together they defeat their enemies and find happiness.

title: Found Her, Fall for Her
description:
After saving powerful CEO Elliott, Winnie ends up pregnant and severely injured. Eight months later, she gives birth to a premature baby boy.

Desperate to pay for her son's medical bills, Winnie works around the clock just to survive. All the while, Elliott is searching for the woman who saved his life. He is ready to give her all the love she never knew she needed.

title: From Fat Bride to Chef Queen
description: Top chef Nina Sawyer wakes up in the 1970s—as a village girl dumped by her fiancé Evan. Forced into a "fake marriage" with handsome urbanite Andrew Collins, she expects nothing. But Andrew treats her unexpectedly well. Using her culinary skills, Nina wins over the whole village and builds a food empire. Just when she thinks life couldn't be better, she discovers her "ordinary" husband comes from a world far more powerful than she ever imagined.

title: Falling for My Gold-Digger Wife
description:
Susan married Cyrus, believing her "tough luck" could balance his "bad luck." But the cold truth is his heart belonged to someone else.
She kept her feelings hidden, focused on paying off her parents' debts, and made the most of the marriage. When Cyrus's dream girl came back, Susan decided to walk away.
To win her back, Cyrus made her his assistant, guarded her fiercely at work, and fought for the marriage she wanted to forget. In the end, love wins out, and so does Susan.

title: Acting for Real-He Fell First
description: To change her fate and pay off her debts, young woman Daisy strikes a secret deal with Julian Sterling, an immensely powerful business tycoon. They agree to a one-year contract marriage: Daisy must play the role of the perfect Mrs. Sterling in public and assist him with family and business affairs. As time goes by, they fall in love after entering the marriage by arrangement and eventually stay together for real.

title: The Cost of Betrayal
description: Chasing a better future, she ends a seven-year relationship and leaves Milo to face his mother's cancer and mounting debt alone. What she doesn't realize is that the business simulation game Milo mastered is turning real, along with the vast empire and fortune that come with it. She thought she was shedding dead weight. Instead, she walked away from a kingdom she'll never reach again.

title: Odds and Ends for My CEO Hubby
description: Having caught her fiancé cheating with her best friend, she cancels the wedding. When they meet again, her ex mocks her for being a menial diner owner, and she just calls over her new waiter. To the jerk's shock and dismay, he recognizes this "waiter"! His loser ex's employee and husband is a billionaire CEO!

title: Five Years to Find You
description: Five years ago, Michelle Smith, heiress to the wealthy Smith family, fell for Charles, a humble worker. Their love was challenged by her father, who opposed their relationship due to social differences. He threatened to withhold the bone marrow transplant Michelle needed for her leukemia unless Charles walked away. In a selfless act to save her, Charles agreed to leave. Upon learning the truth, Michelle sets out on a determined journey to reunite with Charles and their daughter.

title: Fake It Till We Make It
description: A once-privileged heiress, now facing financial struggles, steps in for a friend at a blind date with a wealthy second-generation tycoon to cover her mother's mounting medical bills. Aiming to sabotage the date with her unappealing antics, she is stunned when her plans backfire, leading to an unexpected marriage!

title: Betrayed, Then Unstoppable
description: In Husite, Sebastian is untouchable, protected by his wife Victoria, childhood friend Phoebe, and sister Lyla. However, on his twenty-ninth birthday, tragedy strikes when Lyla is brutally assaulted to death. To Sebastian's horror, Victoria takes the stand to defend the criminal, and Phoebe pressures him to sign a letter of forgiveness. Reeling from this double betrayal, Sebastian dials a mysterious number said to solve any problem.

title: Fated With My Fox CEO
description: A thousand years ago, Evangeline sacrificed herself to protect Alexander, the Nine-Tailed Deity, from Archfiend in the celestial realm. Grieving, Alexander facilitated her reincarnation, vowing to reunite with her. In the present, college student Selena is rescued from a car accident by a mysterious Nine-Tailed Deity. Using a mystical coin, she discovers Alexander, now the CEO of Halo Corp. As Alexander searches for the reincarnated Evangeline, their lives become entangled, but altering mortal fate brings divine repercussions...

title: Pregnant by My New Boss
description: On the eve of her engagement, the female lead escapes her terrifying family and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire male lead. The grand hotel where she works is also acquired by him as he pursues her relentlessly. Though she only wants to work hard and prove her own worth, the man’s persistence wears her down. In the end, she not only achieves success at the hotel through her own efforts but is also pampered beyond measure by the man.

title: Forever by Your Side
description: When the daughter called her father to save her collapsed mother, he was too busy taking care of his first love and her child. Unable to accept her mother’s death, the daughter continues to care for her as if she’s still alive, while the mother’s spirit lingers, unable to leave. Will the mother finally find peace, and will her daughter ever find happiness?

title: Fabulous and Fierce at Fifty
description:
Female lead Cassandra Calloway and her sister Samantha Calloway are twins who grew up in a family favoring males over females. During a fire, their father, Arthur Calloway, chose to leave them to burn so he could have a son later. Cassandra was pushed to safety by Samantha in the nick of time, and Samantha was saved by firefighters, but the twins were separated. Years later, Cassandra, adopted by a wealthy family and renamed Cassandra Montgomery, is now a corporate CEO who has spent years searching for Samantha. Meanwhile, Samantha lives in misery, struggling to care for their paralyzed mother and deal with her gambling-addicted awful father.

One day after work, Samantha Calloway catches their two-faced nanny, Nadine Fowler, abusing her mother. She also discovers an illicit affair between Arthur Calloway and Nadine Fowler. Fearing Samantha Calloway would kick him out if his affair with Nadine Fowler to have a son was exposed, and prodded by Nadine Fowler's threats and bribes, they decide to start a fire to burn Samantha Calloway and her mother to death.

Overjoyed at the news of finally finding Samantha, Cassandra Montgomery rushes over, only to find Samantha dying in a hospital bed. Filled with grief and rage, Cassandra Montgomery uncovers the truth. Upon learning that their mother's death and Samantha's coma were caused by their scumbag father and the nanny, she vows revenge against the vicious nanny and her scumbag father.

First, Cassandra Montgomery attends Nadine Fowler and Arthur Calloway's engagement banquet disguised as Samantha. Holding her mother's memorial portrait, she turns Arthur Calloway and Nadine Fowler's engagement party into a funeral. Then, she lures her father, the nanny, and the nanny's brother into a trap at her mansion. Using her immense wealth and brilliant schemes, she tricks the fraudulent nanny into losing her life savings. She then sows discord to ruin the affair between the nanny and her father, ultimately ensuring that all the villains who hurt Samantha and their mother are brought to justice...

title: Rise of the Kung Fu King
description: To win dignity for his people, commoner Clint awakens the Kung Fu Boost System —one day of training gifts him one year's power. Defying all odds, he rises from a nobody to the ultimate backbone of kung fu!

title: Pregnant and Fired
description: After being laid off from a company due to pregnancy, the protagonist regains a key marketing position through personal determination and outside support. Along the way, conflicts and eventual reconciliations with coworkers shape her journey. Ultimately, the company is forced into bankruptcy three months later due to mismanagement.

title: Daddy, Here’s Your Real Wife
description: After a one-night stand, he and she had two adorable babies. One day, the babies discovered that their biological father is a CEO. They brought their mom along to find him, but that's when their mom's twin sister showed up and took her place. When both twins appear at the same time, can those around them tell who is who?

title: Love Amidst Adversity
description: He has been loving the daughter of his enemy, tormenting her yet unable to release her from his heart. However, what he doesn't know is that to protect him, she endures his misunderstandings and remains by his side.

title: Never Cross a Supreme Sorcerer
description: As the most powerful Sorcerer on Earth, billionaire CEO Darian Douglas moves through the world with authority—but beneath the surface is a deep, unresolved pain: the disappearance of his younger sister, Anna, who vanished at age 8 to shield him from her dangerous, untamed magic. Now, 10 years later, Darian finally finds her—at the elite Douglas Academy of Magic. But she's lost her memory and doesn’t recognize him. As Anna becomes the target of betrayal, bullying, and heartbreak, Darian must conceal his identity while punishing those who hurt his little sister.

title: From Trophy Wife to Free Soul
description: Sheena had been a trophy wife for ten years, trapped in a cage disguised as home. When her own daughter Wylla chose another woman over her, she made a decision to get a divorce and leave her cold family. She gave up on her marriage, her husband and even her daughter. Wesley never cared about Sheena until he couldn't find her anywhere. Now he's drowning in regret, chasing a woman who'd never come back.

title: After the Goddess of Fate left, My Ex's Mafia Empire Crumbled
description: Skuld, the youngest Fate goddess, descends to the mortal world for her trial and is forced into marriage with Vincent, a mafia heir. She grants him boundless luck, but he betrays her, sends her to her death, and credits his success to another woman. Reborn, she severs Vincent’s fate thread, leaves his family behind, and becomes the wife of Alessan—a comatose godfather she awakens with her power. As she helps Alessan reclaim his empire, she uncovers the conspiracy that nearly destroyed him and the truth behind Vincent’s crimes. In the final reckoning, she must choose between returning to divinity or staying mortal with the man she loves. She chooses him, cutting away her past forever and rewriting her own destiny.

title: Billionaire Luna: Taming My Alpha Mates
description:
A workaholic transmigrates as Princess Aria, whose F-class mental powers were faked and who was murdered by her male favorite. She binds to a pay‑to‑win system that gives tenfold rebates and unlocks divine artifacts.

Her ambitious sister Elena keeps laying traps: poison, forged evidence, a fleet‑polluting scheme, and a killing array on the altar. The heroine breaks through with money and wit. She saves the silver wolf commander Jace, tames the white tiger war god Bastian, rescues mermaid General Cassian, and outmaneuvers the nine‑tailed fox Malakai.

In the final crisis, she carriers the Tears of the Gods in her body, awakens the SSS‑rank golden bloodline, destroys the Black Current organization, purifies the World Tree, and dissolves the orcs' thousand‑year resentment.

She is crowned queen, enacts new policies to protect orcs, and four loyal companions stand by her side. The villains fall, and the empire enters a new era of peace and prosperity.

title: After I Chose Myself, I Finally Broke Free
description:
I was the one getting married, yet my sister was the one trying on wedding dresses with my groom.
Whenever my sister approved a wedding detail, my fiancé agreed with a smile. My opinion as the bride meant nothing. Every time I objected, they silenced me with the same story: she saved me when I was poisoned as a child. “Everything I do is for you, yet somehow I’m the villain.”
I turned away and accepted my father’s offer to return to the pack, take over as Alpha, and marry a more suitable mate.

title: Dine, Dash & Destroyed
description: Joyce Pike takes her mother-in-law, Grace, to her husband's fancy restaurant invested by her, only to discover they serve pre-made meals. Seeking justice, she faces humiliation from her husband's mistress. But Joyce is ready to fight back.

title: Fake Heiress Stole My Family? I have Mr. CEO!
description: True heiress Juliet gives the Thorn family everything, only to be sold out by her brother. Fate plays its hand: she flash-marries Maxwell Davenport, the CEO who spoils her rotten. Every sweet kiss heals a wound. Every cruel betrayal from the Thorns fuels her fire. By the time they realize Juliet was their only treasure, it's too late.The whole family is on its knees. And she's not looking back.

title: Feast of Power
description: Nick, who's secretly the wealthiest man in the world, lives as stay-at-home husband with his wife, Bella. Just as he’s about to reveal his true identity and share his wealth and power with her, he discovers Bella’s betrayal. Nick realizes he had mistaken Bella for his true love. He later finds Elena, a woman who loves him for who he is, not for his wealth or power. Determined, Nick takes back everything he had planned to give Bella and chooses to share it with Elena instead, leaving Bella full of regret.

title: Rise of the Kung Fu King
description: To win dignity for his people, commoner Clint awakens the Kung Fu Boost System —one day of training gifts him one year's power. Defying all odds, he rises from a nobody to the ultimate backbone of kung fu!

title: Revenge of the Commander's Heiress
description: Gordon James left for a battalion the day after his wedding with Daphne Kirk. Seven years later, Daphne took their son Freddy to Gordon's camp to meet his dad. There she found out he got married to another woman in the camp. Conflicts with his new wife Flora and her mom Jane led to Freddy dying on the trip. Daphne swore to avenge her son with help from her father, Marshal Simon Kirk. Gordon killed Jane to win his powerful father-in-law's favor, only to get killed by Flora who then committed suicide.

title: Level up! From a Stray Dog to the God of Death (updating)
description: Reborn as an F-rank trash dog, he unexpectedly gains Anubis's devour-evolution power! He devours beasts and gems to level up nonstop, crushes villains, protects the heroine, and finally becomes an SSS-rank underworld god to save the world!

title: Die For You, Kill For All
description: A female general watches her husband die taking an arrow meant for her. As she falls from a cliff, she swears: if given another life, she will love him better. Then she wakes up—five years earlier, on the day of their engagement. This time, she marries him without hesitation. Armed with memories of the future, she foils her brother's schemes, dismantles a rival's plots, and mends every rift with her husband and his mother. Together, she helps him rise to the highest office—while earning the empire's highest honor for herself. The swords of the past become the foundation of their happiness.

title: He Never Fell for You
description:
Broke and desperate after a rental scam wiped out her wedding fund, Mi-yeon lets her boyfriend talk her into joining a dating survival show with prize money. The premise seems simple: contestants share a room each night with someone not their partner. But the show throws one brutal twist: Her first love, who broke her heart years ago, is here too!
Between money, love, and the truth of their past, what will she choose?

title: He Fell for the New Me
description: After ending her suffocating seven-year marriage, Eleanor Sullivan starts over with her daughter. Once a math prodigy, she returns to her passion and enters the ALI Math Competition. Despite her ex-husband's doubts and outside criticism, she rises to the top in the preliminaries. With ace lawyer 	Jared Caldwell by her side, she finds her confidence—and a whole new life.

title: Maid of Fate
description: In the early 20th century, wealthy young Mary lost her entire family after her governess Jane plotted to seize her family's fortune and committed murder. Years later, she adopted the name Evelyn and infiltrated the noble castle where Jane resided as a maid to seek revenge. She deliberately drew close to Jane's son Sebastian, and the two gradually fell for each other amid constant entanglements. Along her vengeful journey, Evelyn devised schemes to ruin Jane's reputation. Torn between love and hatred, she framed Sebastian in the end. Eventually, Jane went insane and the castle was burned to the ground. Sebastian returned home with a broken arm, and Evelyn reunited with him with a child in tow, putting an end to their tangled love and hatred.

title: Love, Lost and Found
description: For seven years, Summer and her childhood friend Shawn shared a bond brimming with unspoken affection. After a spontaneous, drunken kiss, Shawn, wary of intimacy, pushed Summer away with his erratic behavior. Disheartened, Summer becomes the object of affection for another childhood friend, Julian, despite Shawn's persistent interference. Just as her relationship with Julian deepens, he mysteriously disappears...

title: My heart is AAA
description: Gayoung, a perfect straight-A student, sweetly chases her first love Jungwoo all the way to college—only to hear that his ideal type is a busty girl, which she definitely isn’t. As she clumsily tries everything to become his "type," a mysterious message pops up, promising to turn her AAA size into an F-cup. A bubbly, heart-fluttering romantic comedy short drama about first love, silly dreams, and learning to love yourself just the way you are.

title: Love, Like the First Snow
description: Trapped on a snowbound train, a drugged Ophelia James shares a wild night with a stranger and gets pregnant. Ten months later, she fakes a marriage with Simon Rhodes, unaware that his brother, Harrison, the feared head of the Rhodes family, is the man from that night. Falsely diagnosed as sterile, Harrison hides his desire, playing the supportive brother-in-law while secretly protecting her. Born in the first snow, their bond becomes a destiny he will defy anything to keep. Once cold and isolated, Ophelia melts his icy heart and becomes his sole obsession.

title: My Legendary Dad Returns
description: Ten years ago, the male lead, a billionaire, killed his ex-wife and her lover after they murdered his eldest daughter. After a decade in prison, he reunites with his younger daughter, only to find her abused by her husband’s family. He takes action, but she resents him. Through struggles and revelations, they reconcile and team up to defeat their enemies.

title: Three Brothers Spoil the Villainess
description: Zoe time-traveled into a novel world as a villainess role. It was a love-hate story. She'd retire but was forced to complete the task of "raising hate points" with a system. Unexpectedly, the system malfunctioned, and her thoughts were heard by her entire family! Then the plot completely went off track. When playing the role of villainess, she not only failed to attract disgust but also became the little princess of her three brothers. The tragic ending of the Millers' bankruptcy was changed, and even Quentin, the cold fiance became clingy...

title: Pride Fell For Me
description: When Tessa Reed reunites with Nathan Vance, she’s the humble contractor, while he stands tall as her arrogant client. It’s just like their college days: she pined for him silently, yet the cold, coveted campus heartthrob only had eyes for his perfect moonlight girl. As Nathan gets closer, Tessa falls for him again, until she hears him mock her as a poor girl he could never love. Heartbroken, Tessa walks away. Panicking, a tearful Nathan chases her into the rain to beg for her heart.

title: Marry Me When the Snow Melts
description: For three years, everyone around them claimed they were the perfect match. It was said so often that even she began to believe it. However, it was later on that she came to realize they never belonged to the same world after all.

title: The General's Last Stand
description: General Astrid Sinclair gave up her sword to save her husband, Chasel Grayson. Three years later, she returns with the cure—only to find him wed to another woman, Roxy Durant. Stripped of her title and dignity, Astrid walks away. But when the new emperor Asher Bellamy reveals his long-hidden devotion, her journey from abandoned wife to sovereign Empress only made her stronger. None of her betrayers will survive.

title: The Crime Lord Who Said "I Do"
description: She sells illegal fireworks. He runs the underworld. When she mows down his assassins with a minigun, he repays her by canceling her arranged marriage—to his own nephew—and claiming her for himself.

title: After the Fall
description: Whitney Stone and Jonsen Grant's five-year romance shatters when Whitney uncovers Jonsen's secret IUI with his dying benefactor, Daisy Lynn, just before their wedding. Heartbroken, Whitney cancels the wedding and dives into her research, while Jonsen, seeking answers, discovers Whitney was his savior six years prior. As he attempts to win her back, Whitney finds new purpose and love in her work.

title: Love Found Me at Fifty
description: Former corporate "Iron Lady" Rachel Adams is ruined by her ex-husband and forced to work as a late-night driver, captivating the heart of ruthless billionaire Alexander Brooks after a freezing night and a simple peppermint—but when he offers to clear her name and crush her enemies, can this romance born in the backseat survive the storms of high society?

title: Accidentally Ever After
description: Thrown out by her stepmother and left to fend for herself, Sharon Stinger never expected salvation to come in the form of Jenton's most influential man, Henry Forbes. She enters a flash marriage with Henry, and what starts as a mere exchange of benefits soon turns into an unexpected battle for survival in high society. Looked down upon by the elite, Sharon proves her worth with intelligence and determination, climbing to the top of the design world. Meanwhile, the powerful Henry finds himself falling helplessly for her.

title: Die For You, Kill For All
description: A female general watches her husband die taking an arrow meant for her. As she falls from a cliff, she swears: if given another life, she will love him better. Then she wakes up—five years earlier, on the day of their engagement. This time, she marries him without hesitation. Armed with memories of the future, she foils her brother's schemes, dismantles a rival's plots, and mends every rift with her husband and his mother. Together, she helps him rise to the highest office—while earning the empire's highest honor for herself. The swords of the past become the foundation of their happiness.

title: A Father's Fangs
description: After twenty years abroad, Reynold Zedler returns to Saltgrave—not only to find his estranged son, Dylan, but to uncover the truth behind his wife's murder. He finds Dylan living in poverty, working as a laborer, while Dylan's pregnant wife, Eva, is terrorized by the city's corrupt elite. As Reynold systematically dismantles the underworld that rules Saltgrave, he must reclaim his hidden power and reveal his true identity to protect the family he just found—before it's too late.

title: The F-Rank Chef Who Feeds Gods
description: In an era where Divine Cores awaken, high schooler Wyatt Mercer awakens the lowest of the low — a Grade-F God of Gastronomy. Mocked and expelled from the academy, he's left with only one mission: save his gravely ill sister, Cora. To survive, he sets up a stall selling stinky tofu. But when a customer's Core unexpectedly strengthens after eating his food, Mercer discovers his secret power — whoever eats his cooking with satisfaction signs a pact, lending him their divine power. From there, Mercer rises through the ranks, and proves that even the weakest god can feed the strongest — and make them kneel as well.

title: My Boss Loves Me Too Much
description: Ella planned to challenge herself by taking a new job after years of managing crises, but her world is turned upside down when her new boss, Christian, drags her in a fake marriage! What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes something far more intense. Every touch, every kiss, draws Ella deeper into his world. But what she doesn’t know is that Christian has been playing a dangerous game all along, determined to make her his forever.

title: I Left to Set You Free
description: Elizabeth is shattered to find her fiancé Alexander, who was declared dead in a car crash five years prior, alive and pretending to have amnesia—all while indulging in a passionate affair with her stepsister Marjorie. She soon reveals the truth: she had long known Alexander faked his death to escape their relationship, having seen his video confession years ago. When Elizabeth shows a priceless ring and claims to be married to Alexander’s powerful uncle, Wall Street tycoon Arthur Carter, everyon

title: Don't You Play Me for a Fool
description: CEO Stella hires Emily, a capable college student, as her baby's nanny. But her mother forces an old family friend, Grace, into the house, claiming friends trump outsiders. Grace abuses her position, frames Emily, and even moves in her thieving family. When Emily is injured and silenced, Stella returns early, uncovers the betrayal, and exposes the truth. Grace is held accountable, and Stella finally makes things right.

title: I Left Him for His Enemy
description: For seven years, Cora Matthews shaped herself into the perfect future Mrs. Shaw. Until the night of her engagement, she overheard the truth behind a half-open door. Her fiance Ethan Shaw didn't love her and even would send her to entertain other men. Ethan chose another woman over her on their engagement party. Then Cora left and turned to Ethan's rival, Lucas Grant, and Lucas was not surprised to see her. You insult me? Then I'll be with your rival to ruin you.

title: When Love Is Unequal
description: Livia Dawson used to have loving parents and a sweet home. She was a little princess. But after she had a younger sister, everything changed. They stopped loving her like they used to. Just because she turned the AC down by one degree for her sister, they locked her up in a fridge. Maybe her death will finally wake them up.

title: Feisty Kitchen Witch
description: A modern culinary competition contestant unexpectedly travels back in time to become a princess. In the royal mansion, she garners attention with her exquisite cooking skills and develops feelings with the prince from misunderstandings. The princess leaves the royal mansion after being framed, and later shines with her culinary talents. Can she overcome others to become the head chef? Meanwhile, another man also has feelings for her, will this affect her relationship with the prince? Stay tuned.

title: Burning Between Us
description: Seven years ago, a chance encounter in Wesley Lowe's hotel room turned Alaya's world upside down. That fateful night led to the birth of twins, but tragedy struck when her father took one child, leaving her with only Tommy. Now, Alaya returns home with Tommy, determined to find her lost child. As fate would have it, she crosses paths with Wesley once more, but neither realizes the other's true identity...

title: Genius Baby with a CEO Daddy
description:
Childhood sweethearts for a decade, yet I was not the bride by his side. In an act of defiance,I took matters into her own hands, sleeping with another guy and accidentally winning over the stranger, who turned out to be the incredibly wealthy billionaire! Overnight, I decided to vanish without a trace... Five years later, I return with a pair of adorable babies, having evaded and concealed myslef, only to be caught by him nonetheless. 
"I swore back then, that if I ever caught you, I'd make sure you'd never leave the bed."

title: The Boss Affair
description: Lucy has a one night stand with a mysterious hottie - who just so happens to be her new boss! When sparks fly at the office will they be able to resist each other?

title: Cinderella's Glass Slipper: The One I’ve Always Loved
description: The woman had a crush on the president since she was young, but she didn't dare to approach him because of her fat body. When she grew up, her appearance changed a lot. As his assistant, she accidentally had a relationship with the president, but she was afraid that he would dislike her, so she didn't dare to reveal her identity. Unexpectedly, someone else took her identity and even wanted to kill her...?

title: Passionate Love
description:
The person who harmed my family, I will make you pay! 
When I was 6, my parents were killed, and my brother became mentally impaired. To take care of my brother, I learned many skills and started investigating our enemy. I became an assistant to her as a therapist and began to cause trouble between her and her husband. Luck was on my side, and I gathered evidence against her. Now, let's see what you'll do!
Meanwhile, I encountered a special man, who is a billionaire CEO. It seems that I'm losing control over my heart this time...

title: Walk Again for Me
description: She was sold into a marriage with a disabled man. But when she tries to help him walk again, she makes a shocking discovery: her "broken" husband is actually Cloud City's secret billionaire. And his paralysis? It's all in his head.

title: Mr. Ford, I'm Your Ex-Wife Now
description: Jasmine was raised to be the perfect Mrs. Ford, but after marrying the cold Marvin Ford, she endured years of neglect. Even her three-year-old son urged her to divorce so he could be with Sadie. Heartbroken, Jasmine signed the papers and left with nothing. Six years later in Finland, she has built a successful career as a diplomatic interpreter. When Marvin returns begging her to come back, Jasmine refuses. She chooses herself and embraces a new life on her own terms.

title: Spring at Fifty
description: Susan Caldwell had a bleak life before 50. The son she sacrificed to raise sold her to that upstart for $100,000 just for money. In her darkest hour, Robert Lockwood stepped up. She mistook him for a regular worker at the site, but he recognized her as his savior who gave him life-saving wontons 20 years ago. To protect her, he married her instantly while posing as a laborer, taking her away from the mess. Later, dressed elegantly at a family banquet, she was humiliated and pushed down by her own son. Suddenly, Robert arrived powerfully as the CEO of Lockwood Group, stunning everyone who bullied her. At 50, her life finally entered its true spring.

title: Off the Ice
description:
Lucas Carter is the charismatic captain of his college hockey team. After a concussion leaves him with temporary amnesia, his life begins to unravel. He forgets his complicated rivalry with transfer student Albert Clay, making him the perfect target for Albert’s carefully constructed lie: Albert claims they have secretly been lovers all along.
As Lucas struggles to separate truth from deception, he still believes he is straight, yet finds himself irresistibly drawn to Albert. Torn between his girlfriend Jessica, his fading memories, and feelings he can no longer deny, Lucas embarks on a journey to uncover who he truly is. Along the way, he is forced to confront his identity, his buried emotions, and the truth behind Albert’s betrayal.

title: Farewell, My Last Boyfriend
description: Faced with just three months to live, the once meek Joanna undergoes a bold transformation. She exposes her colleagues' dark secrets, cuts off her toxic parents, and ditches her cheating fiancé. In a whirlwind of liberation, she finally meets her true love—only to find it's too late...

title: A Princess? No! I'm the Female General!
description: Adela Taylor, a daughter of a noble family, joined the army in her brother's name to secure the family's Duke title. She achieved unparalleled success, but upon returning victorious, her brother stole her glory. She was forced into marriage, and her brother killed her. She unexpectedly was reborn as a princess. Then she started her journey of revenge...

title: Alpha Daddy Make Me Yours
description: Wolfless Omega Lyra has always been called the unwanted runt. But she never thought that during this year's summer, when she moved back into the house of the alpha that she's secretly had a crush on for a long time, Alpha Damon-- he would also be her best friend's dad! At home, she can't hold back her long accumulated desires anymore-- they explode out. She fantasizes about Alpha Damon taking her virginity, dreaming about him, even while she knows that an Alpha like Damon would never fall in love with an omega like her. Moreover, Damon is her dad's best friend! When they finally have a forbidden touch, the truth slowly comes out.... could it be... that they're fated mates?

title: Ditching My Jerk Husband, I Become a Stylish Mama
description: A quietly dedicated homemaker’s life unravels when she inherits a staggering $1 billion fortune, only to discover her husband’s ultimate betrayal: he’s secretly been legally married to another woman for years. As she navigates the emotional wreckage, her grueling IVF journey culminates in motherhood — on what should have been their wedding anniversary. With the fierce support of her confidante Zhao Ying, she dismantles her gilded cage of lies, reclaims her dignity, and rediscovers her identity in a triumphant rebirth. Now armed with wealth and hard-won wisdom, she charts a bold new course — rewriting her destiny on her own terms.

title: The General's Last Stand
description: General Astrid Sinclair gave up her sword to save her husband, Chasel Grayson. Three years later, she returns with the cure—only to find him wed to another woman, Roxy Durant. Stripped of her title and dignity, Astrid walks away. But when the new emperor Asher Bellamy reveals his long-hidden devotion, her journey from abandoned wife to sovereign empress becomes a reckoning none of her betrayers will survive.

title: Love in Silence, Vengeance in Echo
description: Nancy Morgan had it all—wealth, status, the perfect life. But when her boyfriend Hank was left deaf and mute after a terrible accident, she gave everything up. Defying her father, Zack Morgan, she ran away from home, pretended to be muted herself just to stay by Hank’s side. For three long years, she worked odd jobs, scrimped and saved, all to pay for his treatments. Then, the unthinkable happened—Hank recovered. But instead of gratitude, he was ashamed of his past, and ashamed of Nancy playing the "poor mute girl." He started chasing after Yana, a woman who only wanted him for his newfound charm, while pushing Nancy away with cruel words and cold shoulders. Finally, enough was enough. Broken but not defeated, Nancy walked away. She returned to her family, moved abroad, and slowly rebuilt her life. And there, she found something unexpected—real love with Noah Vince, a man who cherished her for who she truly was. No disguises, no sacrifices. Just happiness, the way it was always meant to be.

title: A Father's Fangs
description: After twenty years abroad, Reynold Zedler returns to Saltgrave—not only to find his estranged son, Dylan, but to uncover the truth behind his wife's murder. He finds Dylan living in poverty, working as a laborer, while Dylan's pregnant wife, Eva, is terrorized by the city's corrupt elite. As Reynold systematically dismantles the underworld that rules Saltgrave, he must reclaim his hidden power and reveal his true identity to protect the family he just found—before it's too late.

title: The Prince's First Love
description: Lucas never expected to kiss a prince—least of all in front of the entire school. What began as a feud with Prince Nicholas turned into a forced friendship, and that into something far more complicated. Every glance, every brush of hands, pulls them closer... but Nicholas is torn between his royal duty and his growing feelings for the boy he once called an enemy. Neither dares to speak the truth—until the moment it can’t be hidden.

title: The Gift Bride of a Mafia Don
description:
Raven is handed over by her father as a “gift” to mafia don Lorenzo. When she arrives at his estate, the perpetually coldblooded Lorenzo shows no concern for her, allowing the household staff to bully her freely.
But Raven is no easy target. She cleverly fends off the servants’ repeated acts of malice. Her grit gradually tugs at the heart of the ruthless, murderhardened Lorenzo.
Just as their romance begins to blossom, Lorenzo uncovers that Cassian, Raven’s childhood sweetheart, has been devising plans to take her away. A tense showdown brews between the two men.
At the same time, Trisha, Lorenzo’s longtime unrequited love, comes back to New York. Overcome with jealousy toward Raven, the new woman by Lorenzo’s side, she sets trap after trap to destroy her.
Determined to protect Raven, Lorenzo risks his life and is willing to abandon all his power. It is then that Raven realizes her true feelings. The pair confess their love and officially become lovers.
Cassian, her childhood companion, chooses to step aside silently and offer his blessings, leading to a satisfying happy ending for all.

title: Dear Husband, Delete My Number!
description: Stuck in a loveless marriage with an indifferent husband, Emma Williams' last straw breaks when she discovers him with another woman! So Emma does what any other self-respecting girl would do: she demands a divorce! Except her hot billionaire husband won't sign the papers... not unless she makes a deal with him.

title: My Two-Faced Fox Mate
description: To escape her cheating ex, Ivy moves in with his billionaire brother, William. Lulled by the Fox's innocent, puppy-like devotion, she lowers her guard. But when her ex comes crawling back, William drops the act and bares his fangs. Now cornered in his arms, Ivy realizes this wasn't an accidental rescue. The ruthless CEO had been plotting to steal her all along.

title: Burning Between Us
description: Seven years ago, a chance encounter in Wesley Lowe's hotel room turned Alaya's world upside down. That fateful night led to the birth of twins, but tragedy struck when her father took one child, leaving her with only Tommy. Now, Alaya returns home with Tommy, determined to find her lost child. As fate would have it, she crosses paths with Wesley once more, but neither realizes the other's true identity...

title: Mommy, Let's Kick Out the Impostor
description: After a one-night stand, he left her with an ring, and she became pregnant. Six years later, she returned with her triplets. Just as the three children were about to use the ring as a token to identify their father, the ring was nowhere to be found!

title: My Fiancé Has a First Wife
description: Serena Kensington thought she had it all—a thriving career and true love. But right before her wedding, a strange woman appears. Serena takes her in out of pity, only to discover her new maid, Penelope Bennett, is actually her fiancé Nathan Sterling's first wife. Worse, Nathan only pursued Serena to steal her family's fortune. Faced with Nathan's growing greed, Daisy's severe illness, and Penelope's shifting loyalties, Serena's revenge plan officially begins.

title: Two Penniless CEOs' Flash Marriage
description: She hides her identity as a CEO to go on a blind date, hoping to find an obedient man. He’s the head of a major corporation, but, unwilling to marry a gold digger, he pretends to be poor for the date. They hit it off and get married in a flash. Little do they know, their companies are deeply intertwined, and they come close to discovering each other's true identities multiple times...

title: Daddy, I Got You a Wife
description:
Seven years ago, CEO Isabella Morgan was drugged and set up. In the chaos, she shared one reckless night with Alexander Thompson—a scion of Beijing’s elite who had just left monastic life. She fled at dawn, never knowing she was pregnant. After a car accident, she lost her memory and gave birth prematurely. To protect her reputation, her mother gave the baby away and lied that she had never given birth.

Alexander, who had been searching for Isabella, found the abandoned child and raised him as his son, Leo. Seven years later, Alexander and Leo rescue Isabella from danger. Leo, a gifted hacker with superhuman strength, helps his father save her. Alexander falls in love at first sight. Isabella, needing a husband to silence her company and mother, impulsively marries him.

Alexander and Leo pretend to be poor—a kept husband and a little bodyguard—while secretly being a ruthless CEO and a genius hacker. Isabella has no idea that Alexander is Leo’s biological father and that Leo is her own son. The truth finally comes out when her mother comes to meet her son-in-law and “grandson.”

title: Don't say I do
description: Ava Lin’s Manhattan wedding turns into a nightmare when a voice from three years in the future warns her not to marry Ryan Hall. Her groom has secretly registered a marriage with her best friend, Mia Chen, who is already pregnant with his child. In the original timeline, Ava was framed as unstable, stripped of her career and trust, and forced into psychiatric evaluation. This time, she refuses to break down for their cameras. Guided by her future self, Ava gathers marriage records, recordings, legal proof, and the hidden safeguards left by her parents. As Ryan, Mia, and the powerful Hall family try to silence her and seize control of her inheritance, Ava turns the fake wedding into a public reckoning, exposes their fraud, freezes the Hall Group’s IPO, and finally saves herself from the future that once destroyed her.

title: Doctor Boss Is My Baby Daddy
description: When med intern Molly has a one-night stand with a stranger, she thinks it’s a one-and-done kind of deal. But a month later, she discovers two shocking truths: she’s pregnant with his baby… and the stranger is her new boss, Dr. Graham Weston. As soon as Molly’s secret comes out, so do her rivals, including her jealous family and a figure from Graham's past, each determined to keep her and Graham apart. With pressure mounting from all sides, can they survive the chaos and find love in the process?

title: Daddy Left His Baby to Die
description: Careless father leaves toddler in a hot car unattended. Will her mother be able to find her and save her in time?

title: Daddy December
description: The night before her unwanted wedding, the overly practical Holly throws caution to the wind for her final night of freedom and crosses paths with Nick Grayson: sexy, experienced santa stripper, and her (ex) groom's Best Man. Can Nick and Holly make the Christmas magic last, or will she end up standing alone under the mistletoe?

title: Daddy We're Done
description: For ten years, janitor Maya scrimps and saves while raising her daughter Lily almost entirely on her own—only to discover that her husband, Adrian, is actually a multimillionaire who has lavished all his love and affection on his first love and her son. Completely heartbroken, Maya leaves with Lily. She is later revealed to be the daughter of a fallen war hero, and after reclaiming her true identity, she becomes the long-lost beloved heiress of the powerful Harrington family. When Adrian loses his business, his family, and the wife and daughter he took for granted, he falls to his knees and begs for forgiveness. Lily gives him only one final answer: “Daddy, we’re done.”

title: Daddy's Best Friend
description: Aurelia, a wealthy heiress, is obsessed with her father’s ruthless friend, Elias. Their forbidden romance is torn apart by a framed bigamy scandal during a botched wedding rescue. To save her bankrupt family, Aurelia agrees to marry a powerful politician, planning to end her life afterward. However, the politician selflessly steps aside, allowing the star-crossed lovers to finally unite.

title: DRAMA IN HD
description:
Nia, an ordinary 18-year-old, goes viral overnight after posting a video exposing injustice at her school — only to be maliciously re-edited and mobbed online by a top Beverly Hills influencer dynasty.

As hidden-camera footage, deepfakes and long-buried dirt surface one piece at a time, she discovers that her school, a PR firm and a wealthy family are jointly weaving an enormous campaign of public deception. To protect her family and find the truth, Nia joins forces with Jax, a rich-kid documentary director, to fight back — only to find that everyone is hiding something, herself included.

When the truth can only be told to the world on a live stream, she must decide: stay silent, or bet everything and expose everyone for who they really are.

title: Daddy's Got Girls and Guns
description: The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter is mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly get married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule. Upon hearing about this, Sydney publicly revealed that Peter was her husband, putting everyone to shame.

title: Deadly Pact: Blind Tyrant’s Wild Bride
description: In this werewolf world where bloodline determines everything, Elara, who cannot awaken her avatar, is publicly jilted by her fiancé and cast into the forbidden deathlands as a sacrifice. At the bottom of the abyss within the forbidden zone, she meets Kaelen, a tyrant who was poisoned blind by his clan and exiled here. Kaelen harbors an apocalyptic avatar of terrifying power inside him, constantly teetering on the brink of his body tearing itself apart. Kaelen and Elara forge a blood pact. The two escape from the dire straits together, and Elara’s World Tree avatar gradually awakens, healing Kaelen’s blinded eyes. Side by side, they return to their clans, expose the conspiracy at the Origin Ritual, unleash their absolute power, ultimately abolish the bloodline doctrine, and ascend the throne.

title: Dead to Love
description: Dying of cancer, Serena Vance let her husband cheat. But in the end, she's run over by his mistress and dumped like trash. Reborn, cancer gone, the mistress never appears. Now she's back as design queen, joins Grant Group, and crushes it. No more doormat. Only boss.

title: Dad Never Loved Me
description: Graham Shaw ignores Lily's allergies by spraying perfume. Resentful that Amanda Cole drugged him into a shotgun wedding, he favors Mia, daughter of the one that got away, Victoria Shaw. When Victoria and Mia visit, Mia trips Lily as she carries soup and frames her. Graham jumps to conclusions without knowing the facts and scolds Lily. Mia then steals Lily's toys and takes her room, while Graham blindly forces Lily to give in. Heartbroken, Lily tears up Graham's chance card, leaving him with only two chances.

title: Dirt & Diamonds
description: Jack Lewis is a construction worker. On the day of his girlfriend's graduation, he buys a ring to propose—but she suddenly has a change of heart and gets engaged to his best friend instead. Amara Green, the president of the Green Group, happens to witness the entire scene. Moved by Jack's kindness and genuine heart, she decides to enter into a flash marriage with him.

title: Daddy, Guess Who's Your Kid?
description: Six years ago, Emma was set up and ended up spending the night with Simon and giving birth to quintuplets. Now, she returns with her five kids to take revenge. But when her youngest daughter, Minnie, runs off to find her birth father and ask for a better name, Emma's plan goes awry. When trying to find Minnie, she accidentally becomes Simon's assistant and walks right back into his life.

title: Daddy, You’re Out!
description: Nanette Mosley, the long-lost heiress, fell for Lemuel Knox, but he scorned her as a mere rube. After a drunken one-night stand with Lemuel, Nanette found herself pregnant, yet Glenda Harris took the credit and became Lemuel's fiancée. When Nanette's adopted sister caused a hit-and-run that left Glenda in a coma, Nanette took the fall to save her adoptive father, and Lemuel threw her in prison. Upon her release, Nanette thought she wouldn't cross paths with Lemuel again, but fate had other plans. For Glenda's sake, Lemuel tortured Nanette time and time again. By the time he regretted it, she had long stopped loving him.

title: Golden Cudgel: Rise of the Heir
description: Betrayed by family. Abandoned by his fiancée. Awakening a Mythic Weapon no one has ever seen. Leo Hart was written off as a failure, until the Invincible Weapon System unlocked the Monkey King Bar. Now, every beast he slays brings him closer to unlocking more Mythic Weapons. They thought he was broken. But his rise had only just begun.

title: You Dumped Me, I Got a Princess
description: For three years, he played the meek live-in husband, hiding his true identity. Then Vanessa's first love returned, and she coldly kicked him out. The moment the divorce was signed, Ethan York reclaimed his birthright – the legendary heir of the York dynasty. Now South Province bosses bow, miracle doctors respect him, and the capital's elite answer to him. Vanessa begs on her knees. He walks away. And when he finally finds his match in the capital's most untouchable princess? The whole city watches her weep.

title: Daddy, You Passed! Time for Hugs!
description: Four years ago, ancient dragon Caden saved Selena's life and spent one unforgettable night of passion with her before vanishing. Now, Selena returns with five adorable dragon babies, and Caden, now a powerful CEO, discovers he's their father!

title: Demons Tamed, World Saved
description: She crawled out of Melvin's game. She was ready to end him. Then he unlocked the skill: I am your Daddy. Suddenly, those who wanted him gone now call him "dad". Then he entered Ground Zero, until reality itself started breaking. Now, with demons pouring in, can Melvin's team turn the tide?

title: Daddy, I Got Your Back!
description:
At five, Lily has a rare gift, Golden Eyes that can see through anything. Raised in the mountains with her great-grandfather to protect the sacred Heartline, she longs to find her real parents and see the world.
When Darklanders steal seven priceless national treasures and threaten her homeland, Lily sets off on a mission to recover them and discovers her missing father, Alex, a powerful but blinded billionaire. Together, they enter a high-stakes treasure hunt to save both family and country.

title: I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad
description: Killed by Ethan, Vivienne is reborn five years prior. She chooses Richard, Ethan's father and the clan's strongest Alpha. A fated red thread proves them true mates. Carrying his five pups, she passes the Spirit Stele trial, earns divine blessing, and strips Ethan of his title. Ethan takes forbidden drugs, becomes a monster, and kidnaps her. As she falls into the sea, the Ice Lotus awakens the pups' power, lifting them on a golden lotus. Richard slays Ethan, and they wed amid a moonlit flower sea.

title: Daddy's Done Pretending
description: Retired underworld king Roman is hiding as a rideshare driver. Until the Graysons' cruelty at his daughter's engagement forces him to summon his three powerful sworn brothers—crushing his enemies and revealing his true empire.

title: Marked by My Duke Daddy
description: Caterina thought a proposal to marry the Duke's son, Felton, would save her poor family. But the night before her debut ball, her bed is pillaged by Augustus, who brands her with his crest. Dishonored overnight, Caterina heads to her debut, hoping Felton will claim her love. But her world spirals when she realizes the man who's laid claim to her is the wicked Duke, and her fiancé's father.

title: Daddy, Please Kneel Down
description: She was married by her stepfather to a dying CEO who was comatose. Under her care, the CEO recovered. He discovered she was pregnant and assumed she had betrayed him, so he divorced her. Six years later, she returned to the country with her child and encountered him again, what's going to happen?

title: Awakening the Dragon Within
description: Betrayed by his ex-wife, stripped of everything he owned, and left with a daughter dying of leukemia—Liam Blackwood has hit rock bottom. But just when all hope seems lost, an ancient drake pendant awakens the power within him. Rising from the ashes as the Drake Heir, he heals the incurable with a single touch, and shatters bones with a single step. Now, armed with divine medical skill, unmatched martial prowess, and a burning thirst for vengeance, Liam returns to Everett City—not to beg, but to bury.

title: Knocked Up by My Ex's Alpha Daddy
description: Aria risked her life to enter the brutal War Academy for her boyfriend, only to find him in the arms of another woman. Devastated and betrayed, a moment of reckless anger leads her into a dangerous encounter with Blaze Blackwood—the ruthless Alpha King and her academy's Chief Proctor. Unbeknownst to Aria, Blaze is also her cheating ex's formidable father. After a passionate and accidental night together, Aria is horrified to discover she is pregnant. Trapped in an elite academy where she is mocked as a "Wolfless Omega," Aria must survive deadly trials, jealous rivals, and the terrifying presence of the Alpha King who refuses to let her go. Will she succumb to the powerful pull between them, or will her hidden secrets and their forbidden connection destroy them both?

title: True Heiress: Trading Up My Family
description: The true heiress, Stella, was unloved. On her deathbed, her parents celebrated the fake daughter's birthday. Only her aunt and uncle said goodbye. Reborn, she chooses them. They worry they're powerless, but she'll reclaim everything her father, Edward, stole. At the family party, she challenges him: whoever secures the order becomes head. The loser is erased. He takes the bet. The contract? It goes to her uncle.

title: The Dancer He Destroyed
description: For five years, Nora Dean has danced—all for one promise: to reach the highest honor a dancer can achieve. Only then would she earn the right, in her mother-in-law's eyes, to call herself Adrian Foster's wife. She is almost there. But somewhere between the years of silence and sacrifice, something else has faded. The man who once looked at her like she was the only person in the room now looks past her. The love she fought so hard to prove herself worthy of—Nora is no longer sure it's still there...

title: Pretend to Love, End up Obsessed
description: When lawyer Chloe used her boss as a cover to pretend to confess her love during a blind date, she was overheard by her boss Vincent. After a misunderstanding leading to flash marriage, she married rich. From setting boundaries to gradually getting closer, through high tension flirting and office romance, she managed to flirt the cold-faced boss out of control and also reaped a unique love that was favored and firmly protected.

title: Until My Vengeance Comes
description: To give her daughter Cher Gould a happy childhood, Leah Gould, whose husband was a CEO, had always been low-key. But Cher's classmates thought her family was poor and bullied her.  Fiona Liam's son was Cher's classmate. She used Leah's identity to act in collusion with other parents and teachers to bully Leah and Cher. Fiona didn't realize Leah was the real rich lady until Leah settled scores with them. In the end, Fiona got a taste of her own medicine. And Cher learned how to protect herself and admired her mother more.

title: My Husband Played Dead. I Made It Real.
description:
Everyone thought the charred corpse in the morgue was my husband, Marco. But I knew better. The man faking his tears behind me was Marco; the body was his twin, Fabian.
In my past life, exposing his lie got me locked in a psych ward, while my children froze to death.
Reborn on the very day I had to identify the body, I played along. I signed the death certificate and legally inherited his entire empire. To protect my kids, I walked straight onto the turf of his deadliest rival—the ruthless Don Dominic—and made him an offer he couldn't refuse...

title: Alpha Daddy, Mommy is Dead
description: My daughter can still see me. Everyone else sees only an empty room. Before I died, I told her one thing: "Don't tell Daddy Mommy's dead." The Alpha who once loved me thinks I abandoned our child and disappeared again. He's hunting me across the packs, promising the cruelest revenge. The only problem? I'm already standing beside him... as a ghost. When he finally discovers the body they pulled from the river, will regret come too late?

title: Demons Tamed, World Saved
description: She crawled out of Melvin's game. She was ready to end him. Then he unlocked the skill: I am your Daddy. Suddenly, those who wanted him gone now call him "dad". Then he entered Ground Zero, until reality itself started breaking. Now, with demons pouring in, can Melvin's team turn the tide?

title: Speed and Death
description: Who would guess that an ordinary truck driver is actually the legendary God of Speed—a six-time world champion who vanished six years ago? After his best friend dies on the track, Chad disappears from racing. Years later, he finds his friend’s daughter and sister, only to discover their family race team is on the verge of collapse. To save them, Chad enters a string of deadly races through Death Curve, tunnel ambushes, burning streets, broken bridges, container mazes, and an abandoned airfield. As elite drivers and powerful officials challenge him, the humble trucker finally reveals the truth—they've picked a fight with a living legend. Packed with high-speed action, constant twists, and a fierce love worth risking everything for.

title: Mom, don't sign! Dad is not dead!
description: Pregnant Ava is pushed by her mother-in-law Marlene to terminate her pregnancy after Logan is declared dead. A voice from her unborn child leads her to Logan alive, injured, and trapped under a psychologist's memory manipulation. Together, Ava and Logan expose forged authorizations, stolen benefits, and a military cover-up before fighting their way back to their family.

title: Dave needs to Die!
description: a war is coming.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: DEAR GOD
description: A young man contemplates the purpose of his life through prayer. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: In Love with Dr. Baby Daddy!
description: Fueled by the sting of betrayal from her selfish ex, Jade Lancaster dives headfirst into her surgical residency, determined to prove him wrong. But what she didn't expect was to collide with her resident supervisor in a steaming hot ONS! Introducing Dr. Damon Ford—a renowned surgeon with a ruthless edge and a shocking secret: he's the father of her ex's and Jade's baby daddy!

title: Addicted to You
description: Audrey's biggest regret? A one-night stand with Floyd, her secret love for eight years. Despite his arranged marriage and his family's troubles, he kept rescuing her. She thought she was just a fling, but he was already head over heels for her...

title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.
description: A broke delivery guy, Gavin, is dumped by his girlfriend the day she graduates for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78K. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to mansions, a restaurant empire, and a law firm. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back. She ends up in jail. Gavin walks away with Paige's heart, a fortune, and no regrets.

title: The World's Deadliest Body Guard
description:
Kane Mercer was once the Ledger’s top-ranked killer. Three years ago, he retired, hid his identity in the American Southwest, and became a quiet freight driver for the Firethorn Outfit. When crime boss Victor Crowe massacres Firethorn to control the border routes, Kane is entrusted with protecting Tessa Cross, the leader’s daughter—and is forced back into his old life.

A helicopter ambush fails to kill him. Kane tears through the ambush and declares war on Crowe. Crowe raises Kane’s bounty to $3 million and draws in assassins: Deadeye Logan, the Twin Reapers, Sweet Mary, and Pelosi. As Kane defeats each pursuer, his true identity unravels.

He and Tessa cross the Deadlands, surviving breakdowns, shortages, and attacks. Tessa grows from a helpless fugitive into a capable partner. They fall in love. After escaping the wasteland, they ally with the Free Riders and attack the Viper stronghold. Briffen, the former Ledger number one, kills Elias and takes Tessa and Mara hostage. Kane defeats Briffen, catches Crowe’s fleeing helicopter, and ends the manhunt. Everyone believes Kane died in the explosion—but Tessa waits in the rain until he returns. The story ends with their wedding: from lone killer to a man who chooses family.

title: The One-Night Stand Daddy Is A CEO
description: On my birthday, I received a birthday gift, a cowboy. And this cowboy is a daddy type. Originally thought it was just a one-night stand, I didn't expect the other party to be a billionaire. And this billionaire seems to have fallen in love with me, he insists on marrying me!

title: Mommy Don't Cry, Daddy is Sorry
description: When his wife Sienna dies in a mental hospital, Wayne is fooled by the cunning Alison into taking home the wrong daughter. Little does he know, his wife is still alive, reborn as her ruthless alter-ego Scarlett and determined to reveal Alison's trecherous schemes and enact vengeance in her daughter's name.

title: I Fell in Love with My Beautiful Maid
description: The caretaker aspires to a life in the big city and sees the troubled marriage of a professor as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, she soon discovers that everything is part of a larger conspiracy!

title: Til Death Do Us Bind
description: Your boyfriend let you drown in a poisoned pool for your sister. So you Oath-Bond the groundskeeper who saved your life instead.

title: Late Bloomer
description: The tycoon, in order to be with his lover, asked his handsome and strong driver to seduce his wife, thereby causing her to have an affair, with the aim of having her leave the house with nothing.
