In the end, the boss’s plan was exposed, and both he and his lover faced punishment. The driver also realized the importance of being down-to-earth and returned to the countryside.

title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.
description: Gavin is a broke delivery guy, and his girlfriend has dumped him for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78k. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to power. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back.

title: Badass Driver, Hidden Blade
description: After her parents pass away, Kendra faces a crisis as Lopez Group is surrounded by looming threats. Claude, an elite fighter hiding behind a playboy facade, takes an undercover job but is mistaken for a mere driver. He effortlessly thwarts deadly attacks and exposes a mole planted by the Blain family. Meanwhile, more people show up to relentlessly target them and swallow the Lopez family assets...

title: I Don't Need a Husband
description: On the day my IVF succeeded, I caught my husband with his pregnant mistress — but then I heard a sound from my unborn child, a past life where forgiveness destroyed me. So I gathered evidence, froze his assets, and served divorce papers before he got home. I walked away with his money and zero regrets. Then the vision revealed the truth: the real father is a global tycoon. I smiled. I still don't need him.

title: Bound by Duty
description: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. As the heir to the Chicago mafia, Dante is logical to a fault. The only thing Valentina has in common with him is being a widow. When Dante chooses her as his next wife, it's a business decision made by a man still haunted from losing the love of his life. But Valentina won't repeat the lovelessness of her first marriage. As she struggles with her own desire for her new husband, little does she know -- his heart may have already started beating for her.

title: No More You In My Days
description: Valerie Reed, the true head of Zenith Group, stepped down to become a housewife to support her husband, Calvin Hayes. For seven years, she tirelessly cared for the family and nursed him through a severe illness. Yet, her devotion was met with utter betrayal. At their son Noah Hayes's 100-day celebration, Calvin openly brought home his mistress, Mia Reed, and their illegitimate son, Jackson Hayes. Backed by his parents, he gave Valerie an ultimatum: let Mia move in while remaining a nanny for the Hayes family, or divorce and lose your son.

title: Taming My Bullies 1-3
description: On her first day at Maple Elite Academy, transfer student Emma Parker does the unthinkable — she picks a fight with The Big Four, the untouchable heirs who rule the school. Tyrannical Rowan Calloway wants to break her. Golden-boy August Langford wants to protect her. But behind their masks, nothing is what it seems. The closer they get, the harder they fall — for the girl who was never meant to belong in their world. Enemies… or childhood friends?  When it comes to Rowan and August, the answer is never simple. Who will she choose?

title: Too Late, Mr. CEO
description: After three years of abuse, Sasha divorces her domineering CEO husband and leaves endurance behind. Focused on her career, she rises fast as admirers gather around her. While her ex rages over the child he believes she lost, Sasha becomes a woman completely out of his reach. When he finally swallows his pride to win her back, he learns it may already be too late.

title: My CEO Daddy Found Us!
description: Noname actress Aria Lynch married Shawn Group CEO Charles Shawn for her family but later asked for a divorce after a one-night-stand pregnancy. Six years later, Charles found out Aria's daughter Nina was his own blood and looked all over town for her whereabouts. Charles saved Aria and Nina from getting bullied at a film set but couldn't tell little Nina was the daughter he'd been looking for. At the birthday party Charles's mom organized for Nina, they finally found out Aria was Charles's ex-wife. Charles got down on his knee to propose to a pregnant Aria, this time with twins.

title: Badass Driver, Hidden Blade
description: After her parents pass away, Kendra faces a crisis as Lopez Group is surrounded by looming threats. Claude, an elite fighter hiding behind a playboy facade, takes an undercover job but is mistaken for a mere driver. He effortlessly thwarts deadly attacks and exposes a mole planted by the Blain family. Meanwhile, more people show up to relentlessly target them and swallow the Lopez family assets...

title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart
description: Kristina Cooper's a scholarship student by day, online masked singer by night. She's got the perfect internet boyfriend in Dax – sweet, caring, and supportive – until she finds out he's Daxter, the monsterous thug who's been bullying her at school! Will she forgive Dexter, the damaged, broken boy she once loved, or will their anonymous love end in Dexter's never ending regret as Kristina choses a brighter future without him?

title: My Legendary Daddy
description: Hector Kellow, head of the Hall of Mars, lived peacefully with Kira Laird after repelling invaders. Tragically, after their daughter Sophia's birth, Kira was taken by her family, leaving Hector to raise Sophia alone. Five years later, discovering Kira was forced to engage Ian Nelson, Hector attended Harriet Nelson's birthday party with Sophia. There, he revealed his identity, intimidated the guests, rescued Kira, and struck a blow to the Nelson family. Reunited, they returned to Kellow Village, where Hector repaid villagers with gold. However, a misunderstanding led to conflict with his father Jude, putting family ties at risk...

title: The Prince Is My Kid's Dad?!
description: Lyra, Marquis Hayden's eldest daughter, decides to raise her son alone. When her grandfather is critically ill, she returns home. Facing her stepmother and stepsister's schemes to marry her off to a sumgbag, she chooses to wed the prince! Unexpectedly, he's willing to accept her son as well! But why are the Emperor and Empress holding her son without her knowing?

title: Why I Did It
description: Tired of her boring job and in need of a fresh start, Zoe moves back to the city she grew up in. The plan was to get a new job, meet somebody and bring back a spark in her life. She meets Mr. Gregory on a solo night out in the city and ends up in his bed. Unknowingly to her, that innocent hookup was about to change her life and bring back that spark she was looking for, but not in a good way. She bumps into an old friend, Sophia and they become very close only for Zoe to find out the man she slept with is her friend's husband. Things get more interesting when she finds a journal which belongs to her missing brother Andrew who is a journalist...

title: We Are Twins, Daddy!
description: She got drugged and sold by her bestie to a guy. After escaping, she meets a drugged stranger, and they spend the night. Waking up, she finds out her bestie and ex-fiancé betrayed her. Confronting them, she's hurt and caught in a fire. Luckily saved, she later has twins, but one is taken away...

title: Taming My Bullies 3
description: Rowan and Emma's relationship reaches a new stage, but new challenges lie ahead. Will they finally get their happy ending? Emma and The Big Four's story is coming to its finale. Stay tuned for the ending you've been waiting for.

title: Taming My Bullies 2
description: Once enemies, now lovers, Rowan and Emma face new challenges as a couple: an heiress fiancée who'll stop at nothing to win Rowan over, an overbearing mother obsessed with the status quo, and Emma's own fears that she'll never fit into Rowan's world. Emma used to believe their hard-won love could triumph over their differences... but what if leaving Rowan is the right choice?

title: The Tutor Trap
description: School hockey star Brady asks brainy wallflower Harper to be his chemistry tutor. In exchange, he promises to be her fake boyfriend, teach her how to flirt — and help her land her crush. But what will happen when their contract backfires, and the chemistry becomes more than just on paper?

title: On the Wedding Day
description: On the day of her long-awaited wedding into a wealthy family, a bride receives a shocking text—her husband is having an affair. She and her friends rush to confront the "mistress," but things take a bizarre turn when the woman’s true identity is revealed—she’s her future mother-in-law?!

title: Tell Me Not to Love You
description: Brie is the daughter of a servant who works for Teddy’s family. She grew up living in the household with her mother and developed mutual feelings for the young master, Teddy. Once they came of age, Teddy began pursuing Brie passionately, but Brie feels insecure because of her status as a servant’s daughter. Teddy struggles to convince her to be with him. Brie keeps trying to pull away, but through all their back-and-forth, she eventually admits how she truly feels.

title: Cheat on Me? Then Go Bankrupt
description: For five years, Evelyn Lane poured everything—her wealth, her name, her future—into building Darren Foster's empire. But when he lets his junior, Claire, wear her late grandmother's costume on stage, the betrayal cuts deeper than any wound she's hidden. Evelyn pulls the funding, files for divorce, and sells her shares. Darren thinks she's broken. But he doesn’t know she's been the legendary “God of Opera” all along—or that the biggest stage of all is where she’ll take back what's hers.

title: Kidnapped by the Devil
description: When a ruthless arms dealer kidnaps a bride after her fiancé fails his test of love in a deadly game of Russian roulette, she finds herself torn between her moral principles and her growing attraction to the dangerous man who will stop at nothing to make her his.

title: I Don't Need a Husband
description: Serena Smith’s picture-perfect life shatters when she discovers her husband’s affair with her cousin, Raina. Pushed to the edge by betrayal and humiliation, the pregnant heiress drops the docile facade and unveils her power as the true heiress to the Smith empire. This is not a breakdown. This is a takeover.

title: Teach Me How to Say Goodbye
description: Grace, a high school princess and Colt, her family's groundskeeper, are deeply in love. However, when Colt learns he has only months to live, he decides he'll do anything to push her away -- to help her let him go. Admist the misunderstandings and heartbreaks, will Grace find out the truth in time, or will she lose the only boy she's loved to the cruel fate without having a chance to say goodbye?

title: The Spoiled Miss is a Hidden Big Shot
description: On the day of her grandmother's funeral, she gets kicked out of her home. In reality, she’s the long-lost sixth daughter of a prominent family. When she returns, her adoptive sister makes her life difficult, and she’s pressured to fulfill an engagement with another family. Little does she know, her fiancé is the very person she has already fallen for.

title: Taming the Demon Butlers
description: One fall sends Lily Carter into her favorite dating game, Demon Butler. But she's not the heroine, she's the villainess doomed to die. Her only way out? Tame four dangerous demon butlers. Too bad one of them is already at 97% corruption... and ready to kill her.

title: King of War Tech
description: Wesley Creed, the King of War Tech, hides his identity in order to keep his dead squadmates' research alive, only to be treated like dirt. 3 years later, he's ready to reclaim his identity.

title: Summer Situationship
description: Jules needs to fake a relationship with Noah to pay off her mom’s medical debt. There’s one problem: Jules and Noah hate each other. But when they work together to get revenge on their backstabbing ground of friends, Noah and Jules realize that their feelings for each are totally real. Can Jules ignore her feelings for Noah to save her family?

title: Daddy's Little Matchmaker
description: Six years ago, Taffy Vale spent one unforgettable night with James Carter—only to erase his memory and disappear into the hidden haven of Carshire Peak, where she gave birth to their daughter, Kayla. But when Kayla sneaks away to find a match for her mother, she unwittingly leads James straight back into their lives. And when Kayla calls him, "Daddy," James is struck by a strange sense of déjà vu that refuses to fade.

title: Seduction Cove
description: Seduction Cove is a show designed to test couple's loyalties with hot baddies, cash prizes and insane challenges. After Hayley's cheating ex runs off with her sister, she's reunited with Adam, a man who saved her from a near death experience. Will the reunited soulmates survive Seduction Cove?

title: The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride
description:
For five years, Alexis poured her entire heart into Ryder Kane—the golden boy of the racing world. She thought they were building a future together.
But on the day she planned to propose, she learned the truth: Ryder never saw her as a partner. Just a placeholder. A “practice girlfriend.”
Shattered, Alexis accepts an unexpected proposal from billionaire Everett Hale—and cuts Ryder out of her life for good.
Now Ryder is forced to face the fallout. Will he let her walk away… or will losing her push him into a spiral of obsession, regret, and the fight of his life?

title: Thirty Years of Protection and Betrayal
description: When the apocalypse hits, Alex sacrifices his lifespan to shelter humanity in the bunker for 30 years. Yet, he is betrayed by his adopted daughter Evelyn and the ambitious Diana. They fake footage of a peaceful surface to incite the masses and send Alex to the gallows. Blinded by lies, the people destroy the bunker for a promised oasis, only to walk straight into a deadly trap set by Diana and the Giants. As the Giants begin their massacre, regret washes over the survivors. Will Alex, armed with secret mecha tech, let go of his grudge and save humanity once again?

title: Despised No More: The Dragon's Ascension
description: Shaw Claude, the family outcast, has suffered a decade of humiliation in a graveyard. In his darkest moments, the seemingly frail gravekeeper reveals her true identity and helps him awaken his powers. As Shaw ascends to immortality, the demons arrive. An epic showdown across the realms of mortals, demons, and immortals has now begun!

title: Bitter Burn
description: Based on novel by Sierra Simone... When Isolde Laurence is pressured by her father to kill her own husband, Mark Trevena, she chooses to protect him instead. But when Mark overhears her father's orders, he believes she still intends to murder him. A misunderstanding destroys a whirlwind romance as Mark, a BDSM dom, puts Isolde through a world of pain and punishment, that not even her bodyguard, Tristan Thomas, can save her from. In this heart-breaking conclusion of the Salt Kiss trilogy, what will Mark do when he realizes he's hurt the one's he loved... and how far will he go to get them back?

title: Bound to the Mob Alpha's Baby
description: Cursed by a fateful night, Noah is carrying a pureblood Alpha’s child. Without daily physical contact and aura transfers from its father, the baby will drain his energy to death. Cornered, he relies on his ruthless mob-heir roommate, Cole Mercer—unaware Cole is the baby's actual father. Believing Noah was knocked up by another man, Cole’s possessive fury turns into lethal devotion. To save Noah’s life, Cole abandons his throne, while Noah signs an exile pact to save Cole. Three years later, an amnesiac Cole stumbles into Noah’s seaside shop, where his wolf instincts instantly recognize his secret son.

title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up! 2
description: Ellie Holland is forced to marry bigshot billionaire Wayne Lyons in order to save her father's life. For the hefty price of five million dollars, Ellie sold herself into the Lyons family with the promise of delivering an heir. There's just one catch… Wayne Lyons is in a coma!

title: Baby Bargain with the Devil
description: Alina desperately needs a child with Cade to save her daughter, who needs a cord blood transplant. Misunderstood as a betrayer who once abandoned Cade, she bears the humiliation for her child. The truth, however, is heart-wrenching. As the layers of deception unravel, Cade finally realizes the woman he resented for six years was innocent all along.

title: Bound By Blood, Betrayed by Love
description:
Naomi, princess of the Ashvale Pack, loved Silas despite his status as a hostage ward. Defying her parents, she married him, believing love could end their ancient blood feud. When Silas was mortally wounded during an escape, Naomi drank a witch's lethal poison to save his life.
But her devotion bought only brutal betrayal. On their wedding night, Silas slaughtered her entire pack and took another bride. In this deadly wager, Naomi lost everything. As the poison consumes her from within, she closes her eyes, calmly welcoming the release of death.

title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!
description: You're the replacement bride to a billionaire in a coma, but what happens when he wakes up?

title: Baby, Just Say Yes!
description: Betrayed by her fiance and her own sister, Victoria Branson marries Teddy Lloyd without knowing his real identity – a secret billionaire. Together, they have to stand up against Victoria’s evil family, take back her mother’s company and find their happy ending.

title: Bound by Honor
description: Trapped in an arranged marriage with Luca, the cold and dangerously seductive heir to the New York mafia, Aria, the innocent little princess of the Chicago mafia, must decide whether giving her body—and perhaps her heart—to a man born of violence is her greatest betrayal or her only chance of survival.

title: Buried by Lies
description:
Aria Bellini, the neglected eldest daughter of a mafia family, is systematically silenced by her family to accommodate her sister Bianca’s feigned "sensory overload."
In reality, Bianca is a manipulative liar who frames Aria for abuse and deliberately inflicts severe injuries on her.
As Aria bleeds to death, her parents ignore her cries to comfort Bianca instead.
Following her death, Aria’s ghost watches as Lucian Cavalli—the rival heir who genuinely loved her—stops at nothing to unearth the truth and expose Bianca's elaborate setup.
In the aftermath, Bianca is exiled and ultimately dies by suicide, while her parents descend into madness. Finally, Aria’s soul finds peace.

title: Bye EX, I'm Having Billionaire's Baby!
description: On her engagement day, Claire catches fiancé David with a prostitute. Betrayed and homeless, she drowns her sorrows at a bar—ending up in CEO Lucas Fletcher's bed. When Lucas becomes her hotel's new owner, their fling turns complicated: she's pregnant, he's protective. Then, a bombshell—Claire is actually a wealthy family's long-lost heir, promised to Lucas in an arranged marriage. Fate seals their love, crowned with twins and a fairy-tale ending.

title: Keeping the Cowboy's Baby
description: She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugged cowboy who owns the ranch where she works. Now Penelope is caught between the man who would burn the world down for her and her ex, who wants to see her burn.

title: Reincarnated As the CEO's Wife
description: An overweight female lawyer with a noticeable birthmark has always faced discrimination because of her appearance. One day after work, she witnesses a beautiful CEO's wife being bullied to the point of jumping off a building. Miraculously, her soul transfers into the body of the CEO's wife. When she wakes up again, she takes on her identity, seeking revenge and living an extraordinary life!

title: Bound by Lies, Saved by Love
description: Talia Vale poses as mob boss Victor Vale's daughter but is actually his captive. After her mother's murder, she seeks revenge through his bodyguard, Damien Frost. Secretly undercover, Damien is gathering evidence against Victor. As their alliance turns to love, they unite to defeat Victor, avenge her family, and find mutual salvation.

title: Boss to Bride
description: Tyler Hayden was raised poor, even though his parents were super rich. After college, his girlfriend, Nicky Linden, dumped him to join Sky Corp and teamed up with Felix Clark to go against him. On his first day of work, Tyler helped Mrs. Owen and somehow ended up in a quick marriage with her granddaughter, Maeve Owen, the CEO of Sky Corp. Tyler felt he was not good enough for her and wanted a divorce, but over time, he overcame his insecurities. Later, his dad told him the truth. His family was rich too. But by then, Tyler had already learned that love was not about money.

title: Pretty Baby
description: Rosy Dolores, the city's most sought-after escort, enters a fake engagement with billionaire single father Tad Williams to locate the daughter ripped away from her at birth. Unbeknownst to her, Tad's charming daughter, Lily, is the very child she's been searching for.

title: Bound by Hatred
description: A rebellious daughter wants freedom from the mafia life, but her forced marriage to a hyper-possessive mafia killer stands entirely in her way.

title: War King: My Return Makes the Nation Submit to Me
description: A young warrior, abandoned by his father, witnesses his mother’s tragic death due to a conspiracy. Saved by a mysterious figure, he joins the army and, after ten years of battle, rises to power. Now summoned to the capital, he returns to make those responsible for his mother’s death tremble in fear.

title: Obsessed by My Ex's Boss
description: On the day Beatrice catches her husband of eight years cheating, she quietly hands him divorce papers he signs without realizing — starting a thirty-day countdown to freedom. As she dismantles the Belmont family's schemes one by one, she is pulled into the orbit of Damian Crowley, her ex-husband's most feared cousin and the mysterious head of the NobleQuest Group. Revenge, a slow-burning romance, and a long-buried secret about a fire and her own origins begin to surface.

title: Rising After Losing Everything
description:
At the lowest point in your life, you suddenly discover that you are the heir to a wealthy family! 
You were once a poor migrant worker who accidentally offended your boss and suffered betrayal from your wife. Feeling utterly hopeless, you learn that you have inherited billions from a wealthy family!
With this newfound wealth, you confront your fiancée and those who once mistreated you! At the same time, you reunite with the woman who, at your lowest moment, extended a helping hand and whom you now realize is the one worth guarding for life.

title: Baby Steps to Love
description: Despite being newly married, Nicole Lane suffers a heartbreaking betrayal at her husband's hands, leading to the tragic loss of her child. Unable to cope with the pain, she loses her sanity—only to reunite with Liam Holt five years later. After enduring years of cruelty from her former mother-in-law and mistreatment by the household staff, Nicole regains her memories and vows revenge. With Liam's help, she sets a trap for her ex-husband. As they navigate hardships together, love blossoms between them, and Liam paves the way for their future with a heartfelt proposal.

title: Bitcoin Baby
description: Desperate to be financially stable enough to get their daughter back from foster care, two grifters try to con a lonely entrepreneur out of his Bitcoin fortune but get in deep trouble when they find he is not who he claims to be.

title: Brother, I'm Back!
description:
Four siblings were born into a poor rural family, but they were happy as long as they were together. Everything changed when their parents tragically drowned, causing their already struggling family to collapse completely. The eldest sibling, at just ten years old, was unable to support the younger ones on their own. For their safety, they had to endure the pain of begging others to take care of them, leading to a separation that lasted for twenty years.

Over the years, due to the realities of life, the eldest sibling lost contact with the younger ones. This only deepened the guilt and regret, as they believed they had lost them. Determined to find them, the eldest was shocked when the second sibling returned as the powerful chairwoman of a major corporation.

title: Genius Baby Gets Daddy Back
description: After a medical mishap, the virgin Violet Gray becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire stranger, Carter Watts. To provide for the child, they are forced into a hasty marriage. Carter leaves for a business trip and is away for six years, during which Violet raises their son, Patrick, on her own while working at a five-star hotel. Unexpectedly, the hotel is bought out by a mysterious new owner—Carter himself! However, after six years apart, they no longer recognize each other. By chance, Violet discovers that her charming boss, Carter Watts, is actually her long-lost husband...

title: Timeless Vendetta: General, I Don’t Love You Anymore
description: Noelle Lane, a supermarket owner, unknowingly saves General Sebastian Camden of Devain and discovers a portal linking her store to an ancient era. Using modern resources, she helps him become the legendary God of War and starts a family with him—only to be executed by their own son. Reborn with memories of her tragic fate, Noelle witnesses Sebastian’s betrayal and Jasmine Shaw’s control over their son. Refusing to suffer again, she demolishes her supermarket, destroys the portal, and claims her compensation—ready to live on her own terms.

title: The Billionaire’s Baby Bargain
description: Everything is for sale, but will you pay the ultimate price?

title: Super Godfather: Ex-wife Begging Me to Get Remarried
description: Vincent Rogers was framed by his wife Lauryn Torres on the charge of having an affair with his mother-in-law and was forced to leave with nothing. At his wit's end, he was unexpectedly recognized as Don Watson's grandson and inherited the Eye of Satan, becoming the heir of the Grand Group. With his ability to see through treasures and his business acumen, Vincent made a comeback, trampling on the Torres family, swallowing up the Evans Group, winning the heart of Sabina Strauss, and making a billion-dollar profit in the stone gambling field, thus foiling the Anti-Grand Group's conspiracy. As Don Watson's tests for him were gradually unlocked, Vincent eventually took over the Grand Group, exposed Lauryn's crimes, married his true love Sabina, and reached the peak of power.

title: Love Found Her After the Divorce
description: After a chance encounter reveals her "struggling" husband, Paxon, is actually a billionaire, Sienna's world shatters. When a casual apology is his only offer for gifting jewels to another, she walks away. Now divorced, Paxon expects her to return. But Sienna stuns everyone by entering a marriage contract with a mysterious tycoon.

title: I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy
description: During her first year in high school, Hannah Morrow is losing her virginity to the powerful Jamie St. Clair in their prestigious private school’s library. Jamie breaks up with her in front of the whole school and she loses her scholarship. When the two are reunited their final year, they fake a relationship despite hating each other. But real feelings lay underneath their fake relationship. Will Hannah get back the boy who broke her heart? Or will she lose everything when their fake relationship is exposed?

title: Owned by the Bad Boy Athlete
description: Top swimming star Rowan was drugged and had a one-night stand with Evan, a sports reporter who has a crush on him. Evan fled in a panic but left a borrowed press pass, making Rowan mistake the vain female reporter Lena for the one that night.Lena took the chance to cling to Rowan, yet he sensed something wrong and fixed his eyes on the flustered Evan. A temptation and an out-of-control kiss revealed the truth—it had always been him.Amid scandals, family pressure and public opinions, Evan, the wealthy heir, stepped forward to protect his love. From secret crush to contract marriage, a forbidden love starting with an accident burns wildly under the spotlight of wealth and fame

title: Sit Down, Be Humble
description: Stacy Van Ness, the heiress to the biggest winery in Napa Valley, conceals her identity to be with Pete Davis, just to get brutally dumped. She decides to show the world who she is - the richest heiress in the country...but no one seems to believe her?

title: Breaking the Blood Bond Before Dawn
description:
On my birthday, I showed up right on time at the upscale Blood Banquet Lounge Daniel Cook had reserved, genuinely excited for the night ahead.
By the seventh time a blood servant waiter came over with a polite smile to ask if I was ready to order, my phone finally lit up with an iMessage from Daniel.
“Something urgent came up with the Elders’ Council. Go ahead and order yourself a glass of Blood Plasma. Don’t wait for me.”
A second later, I scrolled straight into a new Instagram post.
From his first love.
Camila Bennett.
A Pureblood Elite.
In the photo, Daniel was seated at a table, casually flipping through the menu. He was even handing a fine silk blood napkin to someone just outside the frame, his attention clearly elsewhere.
The caption read:
“Been asleep in the Old World for so long. Someone was worried I’d come back to New York and starve because I couldn’t read the menu, so he’s treating me to a proper feast.”
Just like that, the entire evening lost its flavor.
I handed the menu, written entirely in archaic Latin I couldn’t even begin to decipher, back to the blood servant waiter.
“I’ll have one of everything from your signature Blood Reserve selection.”
By the time I finished feeding and had the rest packed up to take back to my Underground Manor in Manhattan, my phone was flooded with missed calls.
Dozens of them. All from Daniel.
The last one was a voice message.
“Hey, don’t overthink this. Camila just woke up and isn’t familiar with New York yet. I was only helping her find a suitable coffin for Torpor. Next time. I promise I’ll make it up to you with an even better birthday dinner.”
I didn’t respond.
A relationship that keeps surviving on promises of next time…
was that really something worth waiting for, especially for someone like me, a member of the Vampire Kind with time stretching endlessly ahead?

title: How My Boss Became My Hubby
description: Allison Lang is the personal secretary of Lucas Ager, Forbes 30 under 30 and hot shot CEO of Ager Enterprises. To get her ex-boyfriend Kyle off her back, Allison texts him that she's now dating Lucas Ager, but what happens when a twist of fate happens and the entire company sees her text message?! Will Lucas Ager fire her… or will secrets from their past come to light?

title: Sizzlin' Bacon
description: Jurgen Vanderspek is a senior in high school. He loves to tell anecdotes about his sexual escapades, but he is still a virgin. When, one drunken evening, Cissy ends up in his bed, Jurgen gets much more than he bargained for.

title: Runaway Bride, Baby on Board
description: After being drugged, powerful CEO Eason spends the night with Chloe, unaware of her identity. When they cross paths again, Eason—failing to recognize Chloe—hires her as his secretary. While working for him, Chloe discovers she’s pregnant with his child. Just as she grapples with this revelation, Eason, desperate to save his grandmother, agrees to marry Maura, shattering Chloe’s heart. Refusing to reveal the father’s identity, Chloe deepens the rift between them. But the situation turns even darker when Maura, determined to keep Chloe away from Eason, kills Chloe’s mother and threatens her to stay away.

title: Betrayed by my Mob Lover
description:
BETRAYED BY MY MOB LOVER

A Fan Adaptation inspired by 
Falling for My Exs Mafia Dad

He thought he was untouchable.
And he underestimated the wrong man.

Summary
After being used betrayed and discarded by the man she loved Fay vanished from the world that destroyed her
Everyone thought she was gone for good.
But they were wrong
She was just rebuilding quietly in the shadows
And beside her the one man no one expected
Ivan Kozlov
Feared
Calculated
 Lethal
He did not choose her out of love
He chose her out of vision
Together they rose silently
powerfully and when they returned
they did not come for revenge
They came for control
Now Kent who once was the heartless player is nothing but a forgotten exile

This is not a love story
It is a story of power choices and consequence
It is the story of the woman they thought they broke
and the man who helped her rise*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Baby, Just Say Yes!
description: Betrayed by her fiance and her own sister, Victoria Branson marries Teddy Lloyd without knowing his real identity – a secret billionaire. Together, they have to stand up against Victoria’s evil family, take back her mother’s company and find their happy ending.

title: Baby in the Water
description: A cursed lake. Lost children. Lured by haunting cries, young women are drawn to the water only to discover the spirits they seek can never be saved, and neither can they.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Boy Toy I'm Your Boss
description: Cross Group Chairman Adrian secretly returns to surprise his wife Rebecca, but Vice President Ryan mistakes him for her “boy toy.” Humiliated, beaten, and framed, Adrian endures until he reveals his identity. Ryan is jailed, and the couple reunite, expecting a child.

title: BABYDOLL
description: It was supposed to be a perfect night. but one unexpected moment changed everything. Turns out, even love has bugs.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Bound by Her Heart
description: Owing her life to the heart donated by her sister, the girl is determined not to waste it. With the support of a billionaire CEO, she seeks vengeance against those who wronged both her and her sister...

title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up!
description: You're the replacement bride to a billionaire in a coma, but what happens when he wakes up?

title: Marry Me When the Snow Melts
description: For three years, everyone around them claimed they were the perfect match. It was said so often that even she began to believe it. However, it was later on that she came to realize they never belonged to the same world after all.

title: Go Bold, Dr. Baena!
description: Zeph Baena, scorned by his girlfriend's family for his modest background, goes to great lengths to win their approval. He spends his entire savings—and his grandmother's retirement fund—to buy a dream home in full. But little does he know, the story is about to take an unexpected turn...

title: My Unborn Baby Called Me Out
description: Rosie Grant died saving the world—and woke up as a fetus in a novel. Her mother? A world-class love fool. Her father? A gold-digging deadbeat. The whole family? Doomed. Rosie panicked. And then her thoughts started leaking out—loud and clear. Her mother heard her. The romance-brain snapped awake. Armed with Rosie's inside intel, the maternal clan united: outsmart the scumbag, crush the scheming mistress. By the time Rosie was born, she and her mother were the most spoiled girls in the Grant family.

title: You Are My Heartbeat
description: A strict, abstinent CEO discovers that due to a rare condition, he won’t live past thirty. By chance, he learns that a poor college student is the only one who can heal him. Desperate to survive, he forces her into marriage. Over time, she falls in love with him and sacrifices herself to save his life. Believing she died in the process, he is devastated. But seven years later, fate brings her back into his life—blind and with a child.

title: From Probation to Proposal: Triplets with the CEO
description: Born in a rural area, Bella's mom suffered from Alzheimer's disease. Bella faced workplace bully as she was broke, making it difficult for her to become a regular employee. When her mom was about to forget her, she met George Hawthorne. After having one-night stand with him, she received a notice of becoming a regular employee. She hated herself for selling her body to get this and began avoiding him. However, her entanglement with him became deeper. After learning that Bella was pregnant, he took her home and began pampering his little wife.

title: I Became My Ex-Husband's Boss
description:
Mia died on her third wedding anniversary—abandoned and ignored by her cheating husband until her last breath. But fate gives her a second chance.  
Reborn into the past, she serves her husband divorce papers the moment she wakes up. This time, the queen is playing for keeps.

title: Sweet Baby, Sweeter Love
description: After an unexpected encounter, she gave birth to a son. Six years later, the man from that one-night stand learns the truth and begins searching for the child. In the process, she accidentally crosses paths with him, leading to a series of humorous and contentious interactions. In the end, the son reunites with his paternal family, and they all begin a life filled with happiness and togetherness.

title: Reborn, Ex-Husband Begs Me Back
description: In her past life, Audra Quinn divorced Philip Foster—so she could carry their twins to term. Then she woke up. Reborn. And this time? She's keeping her man. She braced herself for a fight. But Philip had other plans. "You here for my family's money?" he asked, eyes bright. "Then, take it all." "You here for me?" He leaned closer. "Tell me what you like. I'll become it"... Turns out, her ex-husband was never the problem. He was just waiting for her to come back.

title: Ride or Die: Predator's Game
description: Rider Jade Zeller's passionate affair with the domineering CEO Easton Quinn ends with a million-dollar breakup fee. Unexpectedly, he turns out to be the fiancé of her malicious stepsister, and the man pursuing her is his nephew! As enemies close in, Jade transforms into a seductive hunter, turning the tables, while Easton loses control in this forbidden temptation. In this dangerous game of manipulation, who is the true prey?

title: Age of Gods: Bound by Succubi
description: When Ragnarok devastates the Divine Realm, Elysium Island is created to test Chosen Ones from the mortal world, allowing the victors to ascend to godhood. Lucas Sterling joins the trials to become a god but unexpectedly awakens the Demon Lord System instead. Embracing a laid-back approach, he uses the system to outwit the Divine Realm, ultimately conquering both realms.

title: Baby’s Sweet Revenge: Mommy, I found My Dream Daddy！
description: In a world where family ties are tested, Flora, a bright young girl, navigates a turbulent home life. Her father, Shawn, belittles her mother, Winnie, over her looks, while engaging in an affair with his sister-in-law, Mandy. Following Winnie's tragic death, Flora's attempt to thwart Shawn and Mandy's wedding leads to her own demise. Yet, destiny intervenes. Reborn, Flora wields her intelligence to liberate her mother from a toxic marriage.

title: Go Bold, Dr. Baena!
description: Zeph Baena, scorned by his girlfriend's family for his modest background, goes to great lengths to win their approval. He spends his entire savings—and his grandmother's retirement fund—to buy a dream home in full. But little does he know, the story is about to take an unexpected turn...

title: Marry Ex's Boss After Divorce
description: Her virgin was sold by her husband to a stranger, and after giving birth, she was deceived into believing her baby had died. Five years later, her husband divorced her for his mistress. Little did she know, she was actually the heiress to a fortune, and the stranger she had a one-night stand with was a billionaire. Moreover, her child was alive..

title: He Swapped My Wedding For My Sister
description: After five years of sacrificing her career for fiancé Luca, Bianca watches him turn their wedding into a celebration for her manipulative sister. She walks away, takes back her work, and rebuilds her life as acclaimed photographer B-09. When Luca tries to destroy her new career, Bianca fights back with the truth—exposing his fraud, her family’s lies, and proving she was never the shadow behind his success.

title: CEO Husband Genius Baby
description:
Five years ago, we fell in love, but his mother forced me to leave him. Shortly after we broke up, I discovered I was pregnant! 
Initially, I had decided to raise the child on my own, but the child was diagnosed with leukemia and urgently needed a bone marrow donation. Helpless, I sought him out, hoping he could save our child. However, his fiancée continuously interfered, creating numerous obstacles. Will my child survive, and can we get back together?

title: Flash-Married and Utterly Spoiled
description: Her fiancé is snatched by her sister, then she flash-marries a trillionaire and gets showered with love!

title: His Pawn, His Obsession
description: Clara had endured humiliation and silence for ten years in the Bellamy family, pretending to be mute and weak, yet she was still ignored by her mother and humiliated by her step-sister. Everyone liked her step-sister who had a powerful backer. But what if she stole her backer? Mr. Yates was cold and aloof, but he fell for a girl ten years younger than him, willingly becoming a stepping stone for her revenge. Until the wedding was approaching, Clara ran away with money. Mr. Yates crossed thousands of miles to pursue his wife. He pushed Clara against the wall and said, "Our relationship is not up to you!"

title: Love Bombing
description: In Reelshort's first unscripted series, 40 singles swipe on each other in real life in order to find true love. They are taken on a series of date challenges designed to test compatibility, connection, and long-term potential. But those who didn’t match are given a second chance at redemption: if they successfully break up any of our newfound couplings, they receive cold hard cash. Can love survive love bombing?

title: Heir’s Wrath
description: After a decade in prison taking his father’s fall, Desmond Kensington comes home to save his mother—only to be tormented relentlessly by his cruel stepmother Veronica and her illegitimate son Roland. Biding his time in silence, he leverages sharp wit and bold resolve to seize the security division, Metropolis Club and Pinnacle Capital, tightening his grip on the core of the Kensington Group. Hiding his fearsome alias Lord Nonus, he allies with Elena to uncover the truth behind his elder brother’s death, lay bare Veronica’s twisted plots, and settle every past score. From a disgraced prison outcast to a dominant tycoon, he strikes with ruthless force to uproot decay, make all wrongdoers pay, and climb to the pinnacle of power to rule the business world.

title: Trial by blood
description: Driven by jealousy, a woman swaps her newborn baby with her best friends', not knowing that the friend switched them back later. For 18 years, she treats her own daughter like trash, while gushing over her friend’s daughter. When the truth will finally come out, it will break her.

title: My S Rank Beast Mate
description: I reborn the day I picked my beast mate, right after my jealous sister Lyra snatched the B-rank snake Voss I once married in my past life. She framed me to be exiled into deadly wilds, but I saved a wounded white lion no clan dared accept. Everyone mocks him rankless trash, until I bear two S-rank lion cubs. The priest uncovers his hidden S-rank blood, brands me the reborn Sacred Daughter. Lyra's fake saint dream crumbles with weak snake cubs, yet she screams I stole her glory. Who will pay for all her bloody betrayals?

title: Spoiled By The CEO After Rebirth
description: In her past life, she was framed and lost everything by her husband and cousin. It's only on her deathbed that she realizes the billionaire she was once engaged to truly loves her. Reborn two years earlier, she wakes up and sets her sights on marrying the billionaire. This time, she won't allow tragedy to strike again. And this billionaire? He's not a playboy at all. His heart belongs only to her.

title: Vicious
description:
Vicious is inspired by the novel by L.J. Shen.
After Vicious bullies Emilia out of town, he reappears years later with an offer she can’t refuse: A job that could keep her afloat. But Vicious is haunted by a past of abuse, and trusting him could drag Emilia back into the world that once broke her... Can she let herself fall for him?

title: You Might Be Bad, but I'm Worse
description:
Ava is finally discharged from the mental institute after years of treatment, thanks to her therapy dog Luna. She is determined to live a happy, normal life in the suburbs and buy a new house for her new beginning, but her neighbors won't stop harrassing her.
Ava keeps a tight grip over herself with her therapy dog's help, staying calm and collected in the face of constant harassment. Her neighbors won't stop, even threatening to kill Luna! Ava starts to slip, fighting back against her neighbors... After all, with an insanity plea, she can do whatever she wants in revenge...

title: Two Snake, One Mate
description:
"Wren's S-rank white lion shifter abandoned her mid-mission to soothe her sister instead. She almost died. The first thing she did after waking? Filed to swap him out. The only shifter available was a B-rank snake no one wanted—Silas. He came with his twin brother, River. Wren took them both. She didn't know Silas was the one who'd saved her that day. he'd hidden his SSS-rank just so she'd pick him. Now her ex is begging at her door while Silas cooks her dinner and River warms her bed. Then the Bonding Agency calls: Silas has been reassessed. A better match is available. His answer? "
"I choose Wren."

title: After Cancer I Turn into A Badass
description: Evelyn has long been oppressed by her stepsister, misunderstood by her husband, and looked down upon by her family. After being misdiagnosed with terminal cancer, she suddenly comes to her sense and decides to live her final days to the fullest. She turns into a fierce diva, taking revenge on her oblivious husband and her evil stepsister. However, her husband suddenly realizes that he has mistaken someone else for his lifesaver...

title: A Marriage for Debt, A Heart to Get
description: To save her family, Rita Lane enters a one‑month marriage of convenience with the billionaire, Landon Hopkin. She’s just a temporary wife; he’s just fulfilling a deal. But between late‑night conversations, unexpected dangers, and the return of his childhood sweetheart Fiona Foster, lines begin to blur. When the contract expires, will they walk away—or choose a love that was never part of the agreement?

title: A Street Scam Made Me a Martial Legend
description: Barnett Grant, a delivery driver, buys a "fake" martial arts manual from an old beggar, only to awaken real, terrifying power. After accidentally injuring Chloe Reynolds, he marries into her family, a fallen martial clan under siege. When he casually masters the long-lost Chaos Tai Chi Art, everyone mistakes him for a hidden grandmaster. One fight after another, Barnett crushes elite rivals, revives the Reynolds family, and begins to realize he may be a once-in-a-century martial arts genius.

title: After 50,000 Years, I Came Back to Earth
description: After 50,000 years of cultivation, Ethan returned to Earth as a Divine Emperor—only to find that just five years had passed. Using immortal arts to rewind time, he witnessed everything: his wife, broken but unyielding, fighting to save their dying daughter; his mother, frail and forgotten, withering away; and his enemy, circling like a vulture, feeding on their pain. He didn't hesitate. He didn't forgive. One by one, he righted every wrong. And before the city even understood what had happened, Ethan wasn't just a returning cultivator anymore. He was the shadow that ran the city—whether they knew it or not.

title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna
description: Five years ago, Tiffany was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, poisoned, and left for dead while pregnant. She survived, but her newborn daughter vanished without a trace. Desperate to find her, Tiffany takes a job as a nanny at the Silvermoon Pack, never realizing the little princess in her care is her own missing daughter. The girl's father is Asher Sterling—the ruthless, untouchable Alpha who has spent five years searching for the mysterious woman from his one unforgettable night. As Tiffany and Asher are drawn together, old enemies resurface, deadly secrets unravel...

title: As the Road Leads
description: When a tragic accident cuts her father's life short, Aurora Sullivan is determined to follow his legacy onto the open road. But her dream hits a roadblock: a corrupt, sexist boss who'll do anything to stop her, and a mother paralyzed by fear of losing another loved one. Refusing to be sidelined, Aurora builds her own team. Together, they'll battle treacherous highways and ruthless rivals to prove that on the road to a new future, the only thing that matters is who's holding the wheel.

title: All Clear at Last
description: Seven years undercover to repay a mistaken debt, AI prodigy Olivia hides her power to uplift her mediocre husband, only to be betrayed when he moves his mistress and their love child home. This is the final nail in this marriage. She immediately divorces him and flash-marries her nemesis, leaving her ex in deep regret.

title: A Ten-Year Marriage Scam
description: Victoria Sterling, The Wealthiest Woman, hides her identity to marry Julian Lockwood. Trusting him completely, she lets him manage her company. But Julian betrays her, having an affair with his secretary, Jessica Mercer, and fathering an illegitimate child, Leo Lockwood. The conflict erupts when Victoria's daughter, Ella Lockwood, is bullied by Leo at school. Adding insult to injury, the other parents accuse Victoria of being a mistress. When Victoria rushes to the school, the actual mistress, Jessica, arrogantly poses as Julian's wife and incites the parents to attack her. Furious, Victoria summons Julian. At the Anniversary Gala, Julian denies the affair until Victoria presents undeniable proof, publicly humiliating him. The truth is finally exposed, and Julian and Jessica are sent to prison.

title: Mated to the Alpha and His Beta
description: On mating night, Charlie is claimed by the Alpha and his Beta. By morning, she's publicly declared "unsatisfactory" and replaced. But when she discovers she can hear their private mind-link—and their chosen mate can't—the question becomes: if she was never meant for them, why is she the only one who feels the bond?

title: Mated to Two Bad Boy Alphas
description: Bullied for ten years, human girl Lia turns sixteen — and the two most dangerous Alphas in town both claim her as their fated mate. One has secretly protected her for a decade, never daring to come close. The other cuts a deal with werewolf hunters to make her his. A forced mark. Hunters in the dark. Nights she vanishes from her bed — and wakes up covered in blood. As every conspiracy points back to her birth, the truth surfaces: she is the Moon Goddess's lost daughter. On the night of the Blood Moon, war swallows the town, and the man she loves takes the fatal shot meant for her. Grief awakens the goddess within — the battlefield freezes, wolves kneel, and a single command shatters an entire army. She rips him back from death itself. But something else came back with him…

title: The Alpha’s Luna Was Already Dead
description: Three days before Mara is due to give birth, her husband Reid cuts her palm with silver and pushes her off a cliff to lure rogues away from Tessa. When the kidnappers demand ransom, Reid decides Mara staged the attack for attention and tells them to do whatever they want with her. Mara and her unborn pup die in the forest. Three days later, the patrol finds a pregnant body. Reid sends it to the morgue without looking at the photograph. He still thinks Mara is hiding. Her ghost is standing beside him.

title: Betrayed Zora Rules All
description: Zora Laurent unexpectedly arrived in a brand-new interstellar world and activated her exclusive system. With the system's help and her own wisdom, she defused provocations, stabilized the situation, discovered rare energy resources, and gradually took control of the kingdom. Awakening powerful mental abilities, she became the heir to the crown. Facing the vast interstellar opportunities, she resolved to lead the empire to explore the cosmos and create a new legend.

title: Affair at the Art Gallery
description: Abigail and Matthew have the perfect marriage, until she catches him with his assistant! *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Atlanta 10.0
description: Based on a True Story, Atlanta 10.0 is a dramatic, gut-wrenching thriller, crime film that displays some of the many tragic and real events that have taken place in Atlanta. You will never look Atlanta the same after this.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: A World in a Grain
description: The "Turtle Back Stone," renowned as the "World's Premier Stone," has witnessed hundreds of millions of years of Earth's history -- from the ancient Sinian Period, through the explosive diversification of life in the Cambrian, to the age of dinosaurs in the Jurassic and the transformative shifts of the Cretaceous.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Her Son Makes Her a Royal Lady
description: Widowed Elise Stanton, the child bride of the Mercer family, survived by selling vegetables. After an accidental night with Prince Owen Pierce, she gave birth to a son. To protect the baby from thugs, she hid him away. Later, desperate to find the baby and earn a living, she became a wet nurse at the Prince estate. Though she and Owen fell for each other, she kept her distance, fearing he was only playing games.

title: Don't Watch Me Waste Away
description: Believing that Celeste had indirectly caused his sister Gloria’s tragic death in prison, Byron let love curdle into hatred. For five years, he tortured Celeste’s body and soul—until the day he learned she was dead. Only then did regret set in.

title: The Last Ark to Mars
description: Ark CEO Elias Gray disguises as a nobody on the last escape pod, loses his Life Card, and is locked in a thruster tunnel to die by a cruel security chief. Rescued and reinstated, he shields Doctor Evelyn from a harassing overseer and a meteor storm. Posing as her boyfriend to dodge an arranged marriage, he crushes her elite circle with a legendary race record and a gifted speeder, until Mars's most powerful boss kneels to him. Rivals punished, he drives off with Evelyn into the Martian frontier.

title: The Alpha's Dead Luna
description: Aria, a wolf-girl who cannot shift, is won over by Alpha Kane's five years of devotion and risks her life to awaken her bloodline. On the day of her awakening, she gains empathic sense—and immediately perceives Kane's year-long affair with a beta. Heartbroken, Aria fakes her death, plays the betrayal video at their mate ceremony, and delivers her "corpse" to Kane before disappearing forever. She finds her birth family, renames herself Phoenix, and rises from the ashes. When Kane comes begging for forgiveness, she leaves him with only one word: Never.

title: Break My Heart Again
description: In a whirlwind of love and betrayal, Lucie Teague and Felix Young's romance shatters when a cruel misunderstanding tears them apart. Lucie, desperate to protect Felix from danger, sacrifices their love, only to meet him again years later as a billionaire CEO... and her new boss! With secrets and lies between them, Lucie must navigate her new job under Felix's watchful eye and endure the torment of her conniving younger sister Elena, the new girl on Felix's arm, all while hiding the truth that could either reunite them or destroy them forever.

title: They Called My Dragon Gear a Scam
description: Elena has been quietly supplying Lionheart with royal-grade dragon gear, helping them win two championships while charging only a fraction of its value. But when newcomer Vivienne calls her work overpriced, Captain Arthur believes the lie, kicks Elena out, and chooses cheap five-silver gear instead. At the royal dragon race, the fake equipment fails inside the lightning gate, while Elena’s real gear carries the rival Silver Wolf team to a record-breaking win. With the evidence made public, the kingdom learns the real scam was never her price, but their greed and betrayal.

title: Fatal Attraction: A Dark Mafia Romance
description: To avenge her mother, Daisy disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the dangerous mafia boss, Hogan. Despite suspecting Daisy's intentions, Hogan finds himself irresistibly drawn to her deadly charm. Will Daisy manage to walk away unscathed, or will she be entangled in passion with Hogan?

title: My Wife Ran Away Again
description: The Young Marshal claims, 'My wife is a naive country girl, do not bully her!' The socialites she upstaged cry, 'Who is bullying who?' He adds, 'My wife is gentle and knows nothing about medicine or guns!' Her cured patients and dead enemies scream, 'Are you blind, Young Marshal?' 'My wife is perfectly obedient, my word is law!' he boasts heroically—while kneeling on a washboard. The adjutants of the Warlord mansion sigh, 'Please keep some dignity, Young Marshal!'

title: How to Tame a Royal Heart
description: Clara Chavez, the daughter of a wealthy merchant, is reborn on the night of her wedding, where her groom, Cole Kerrigan, humiliates her by marrying his sister-in-law as well. Determined to reject this fate, Clara vows revenge and sets out to reclaim everything she has lost. Along her journey, she forms a profound bond with Prince Adrian, leading to the Kerrigan family's downfall and securing her rightful place in the royal lineage, ultimately finding happiness with Adrian.

title: Mama, Sing Me a Lullaby
description:
Single mother Tracey works hard to raise her twins on her own.  Her youngest son Henry hates his family and considers Logan, his older brother with a heart condition, to be a burden. Logan is hit in a car accident and adopted by a rich man, changing his life forever.
Tracey continued to work odd jobs as a janitor. Both Tracey and Logan never gave up on finding each other, and Logan, now CEO, feels a connection to Tracey the moment they meet again.
Tracey's selfless sacrifice has been wasted on Henry. He finds her embarrassing and is eager to deny knowing her, even actively bullying her.
Finally, at Henry's wedding, just as Henry is about to smash a bottle of wine on Tracey, Logan receives the DNA testing results. The woman on stage being humiliated is his own mother!

title: I Got a Magic Dog and a Handsome Husband
description: Winona, a master carpenter, dies saving her military dog, Dash, and wakes in another world as an overweight village woman everyone despises, who has also claimed the handsome Connor as her husband. His mother and sisters-in-law constantly give her a hard time, but Winona refuses to back down. With incredible strength, masterful carpentry, and Dash's treasure-sensing powers, she builds a fortune, helps the village prosper, and finds lasting love with Connor.

title: Make My Lover Your Concubine? Die!
description: Ted Lewis, Emperor of the Celestial World, shattered the Three Realms’ barriers, returned to the mortal world, and seized Heaven Sect. However, after returning, he found his mother, lover and daughter were humiliated. He stood up for them and punished his ex fiancee. Later, in the stone gambling competition, he turned bricks into jade. Finally, he displayed his supreme immortal aura, defeated the immortals summoned by his brother, and shook the world.

title: The Dragon's Tear, a Royal Betrayal
description: The emperor's most trusted young loyalist — protected by a sacred charter and betrothed to a princess—stood up to a bully and lost his life before his own uncle's eyes. When his body was carried into the throne room, the emperor's fury shook the palace. But the true killer wasn't the bully's father — it was a prince pulling the strings from the shadows.

title: Not His Blood, But His Heart
description: Framed by her boyfriend and sent to prison, Annette Switt is offered a way out: save a tycoon's life with her blood. She seizes the chance, only to return home and discover his betrayal. Heartbroken, she marries the powerful Alexander Fletcher in a swift, convenient arrangement. But when revenge turns to real connection, they join forces to take down those who wronged her—and find an unexpected family along the way.

title: ReelTalk EP 71-Maria and Nate's First Date
description: Maria Barseghian and Nate Flores from Once Upon a Breakup hit the streets of LA for the ultimate foodie date. Maria takes Nate through her go-to spots from trendy coffee shops to smash burger joints, ending with a little friendly competition at the arcade. Great food, real chemistry, and a day that gets a little more intimate with every stop.

title: ReelTalk EP 42-Chris and Cayla Went on a Date!
description: Now introducing, ReelTalk Dates! Join The Quarterback Next Door’s Chris Quartuccio and Cayla Brady as they race through a shopping challenge, share a bite together, unwind with a romantic picnic, and top it all off with a swan boat ride, all in true Los Angeles style.

title: Mama's Girl, Killer Mode
description: Top assassin Riley Bishop retires to protect her mother, Jade Lynch, and seek revenge. Once an heiress, Jade was betrayed and abused for years. Witnessing her mother's suffering, Riley becomes the Shadow Queen of an international team. Discovering Jade's ongoing torment, Riley returns to expose the Douglas family's hypocrisy and reclaim the Lynch Group. Old debts, new scores, she's wiping them clean once and for all!

title: The Alpha's Dead Luna
description:
In the werewolf realm, Aria, a she-wolf unable to shift, is won over by Alpha Kane’s five years of life-risking devotion. She risks her life to complete the Blood Awakening for their mating ceremony, only for her new Empathic Sense to uncover Kane’s year-long betrayal and his public contempt, dismissing her as a useless pet.
Heartbroken, Aria orchestrates an elaborate revenge. She leaks his infidelity footage at the globally live-streamed ceremony, stages her own death as a final blow, and flees to England. There, she reunites with her biological parents, who lost her 26 years prior, and is reborn as Phoenix. She coldly rejects the remorseful Kane’s pursuit, finally breaking free from the shackles of betrayal to embrace her new life.

title: Tears of a Falling Star
description: As children, Star (Estelle Frost) and Ash (Christopher Brooks) are kidnapped by human traffickers. Ash gets his leg broken saving Star before they are separated. Years later, Ash is a powerful CEO named Christopher Brooks. To fulfill his Grandmother's dying wish, he agrees to marry into the Frost family. The greedy Frosts substitute their biological daughter Madeline Frost with their adopted daughter Estelle to marry the cripple. Estelle suffers endless abuse from Christopher's admirer Sabrina Carmichael. Christopher, consumed by his search for Star, turns a blind eye. Just as Estelle realizes Christopher is Ash, Sabrina poisons her, rendering her mute. Sabrina and Madeline then conspire to have Madeline impersonate Star. They ruthlessly torture Estelle, piercing her with silver needles and treating her like a dog. Madeline manipulates Christopher into hating Estelle and eventually hires thugs to assault her. Discovering her diary, Christopher realizes Estelle is Star. He rushes to save her, discovering his leg is healed thanks to Estelle's secret herbal prescription. At the hospital, Estelle unknowingly befriends her biological father, a wealthy tycoon. Madeline discovers the truth, fakes a DNA test to steal Estelle's identity, and plots with the treacherous Kensington family butler to silence them. Estelle breaks her leg protecting Christopher. When Estelle's father uncovers the truth, Madeline puts him in a coma to seize Kensington Group. Her crimes exposed, a deranged Madeline attempts to run over Estelle. Christopher saves her but loses his memory. Finally, Estelle awakens his memories at their wedding, leading to a happy ending.

title: Awakening
description: First step up, dump the dead weight. Leo Landon spent years funding Elena Vance's education. Now she's a top earner, and she kicks him to the curb. But Sasha Sterling, Veridia's ruthless queen of industry, sees the power Leo truly holds. She doesn't ask. She claims him. "I'm going to marry you." And the room falls silent.

title: Bedded and Buffed: Claiming My Shifter Harem
description: In a world ruled by shifters, humans are rare and treated as prizes to be bought and bred. Owen wakes up tied to a bed, purchased like property. Then a System binds to him: sex with woman shifters makes him stronger. Soon Owen isn't anyone's pet. He's a noble, a husband, a conqueror. But as his power rises, so do his enemies. To survive, Owen must bed more beauties, grow his harem, and claim his place at the top of a world that once caged him.

title: GODFORGED: TEN SCRAPS OF IRON
description:
Pyrrhos is the hammer-hand at Hermon's Forge — a nobody they call Emberless, because he can't feel forge fire the way a real smith should. He's spent a thousand nights making the runeblades that kill dragons and hydras across the continent. On Assessment Day, he watches the guild crown his senior brother Deryk for a masterpiece called Firstlight: Pyrrhos's design, his three years of work, his signature scraped off the plans. When he demands his wages and walks, his master upends a sack on the anvil — ten rusted scraps. Then, in the dying furnace behind him, a thread of pure gold flame rises on its own.
Ten scraps is his starting stake. With a girl carrying a broken family sword, a landlord's back room, and a wartime order no one else will fill, he builds a forge out of nothing and starts scraping the paint off the guild's fake runes one blade at a time. But the fire in his hands isn't luck. It answers to a bloodline that traces back to Hephaestus himself, to a father who burned with his workshop rather than surrender the plans for the Godslayer, and to an order of ashes still hunting the seven fragments he scattered. Delphi has a name waiting for him. He'd rather earn one.

title: The Lycan's Savage Luna
description: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.

title: Ward of Hearts
description: Silas is trapped inside a deadly psychiatric hospital instance where every room hides a kill rule and every creature is ranked S-Class for lethality. Just when death seems certain, a Romance Conquest System activates in his mind — turning every monster into a love target and every trap into a dating sim.

title: Craving My British Cowboy
description: The reading of the will leaves Asher Bennet in shock. His inheritance comes with a million strings attached, the worst of all, living under the same roof with the most infuriating man on the planet. Asher is a workaholic who lives in London. He goes from living in a posh penthouse in Chelsea to a farm in the middle of nowhere with bugs and fresh air, and a hot cowboy. Lennon Bowie is all rippling muscles and a six pack. It’s enough to tempt this city boy into living the Texas mantra - save a horse, ride a cowboy.

title: Son, I Am Not a Maid
description: Martha Lewis's husband Robert Sterling is killed in a construction accident. Pregnant, she also loses her daughter Sophie. Fifteen years later, she supports her son Matthew Lewis marrying into her family, the Sterling family, while secretly suffering from black lung disease. Rejected by her son, she runs a bun stall and meets Sophie, now CEO of the Sinclair Group. Matthew Lewis tricks her into selling her house to pay his debts, then deceives her into working as a maid for the Sterling family. Humiliated, she discovers the father-in-law resembles Robert Sterling. Sophie Sinclair uncovers the truth and seeks a reunion. At Lily's birthday gala, Cynthia Sterling insults Martha Lewis. Sophie Sinclair defends her mother, canceling a massive contract. The truth prevails: Robert Sterling had amnesia, and Cynthia Sterling's plot is exposed. As Martha Lewis falls gravely ill, Matthew Lewis repents, and she forgives everyone.

title: Father's Wrath: Escape Before Delivery
description: Evelyn Harrington thought she found true love in Graham Bennett—a simple man who promised forever. But behind his sweet words lay a decade-long deception: he and her best friend, Mia Lawson, had been lovers all along, using Evelyn as nothing more than a surrogate to carry their child. After a tragic fall causes her to lose the baby, Evelyn’s wealthy father reappears, revealing her true identity as the Harrington heiress.

title: Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire
description: Amelia is a hard working Junior in College. In order to pay rent, she needs to find work. Her roommate got her a job at a local bar, but her first night on the job took a dark and twisted turn. Her roomate drugged her and pimped her out to a customer for the night. But at a critical moment in the night, Leo saved Amelia from being trafficked. After a night of passion, Amelia became pregnant with Leo's baby, but Leo thinks she's a gold digger. Where will she go? What will she do?

title: Oops! I’m in Love with My Stepbrother
description: Olivia and Finn are total opposites - she's a studious, artistic good girl, and he's a rebellious party animal straight out of rehab. But when they hook up the night before Olivia's dad marries Finn's mom, they realize they have one thing in common: their obsession with each other. Can Olivia put her feelings for her bad boy stepbrother aside?

title: The Swap Game: Claimed by His Uncle
description: Chloe was tricked by her fiancé into attending a swinger party and accidentally entered the suite of his uncle Victor. After a night of indulgence, she was abandoned and humiliated by her fiancé, then forcibly possessed and imprisoned by Victor, reduced to a mere tool. After becoming pregnant, she suffered retaliation, was sold off, faked her death in a fire, and escaped. Three years later, she makes a glamorous return with her daughter. Victor embarks on a “wife-chasing crematorium,” and eventually the misunderstandings are cleared, culminating in a grand wedding and a happy ending for the family of three.

title: Man to Man
description: Ahead of the 2022 World Cup, Javi and Danny — two gifted right wingers from rival clubs — are both called up to the national team. Both are fighting for Spain’s No. 7 shirt — but on their first night as roommates, they end up having a one-night stand.

title: Carp? I'm Dragon!
description: Jack, an ordinary office worker, time-traveled and became a koi fish. He was laughed at by Mermaids. Luckily, Luna saved him and he got a Devour Evolution System. With the system and good luck, he evolved step by step. He turned from a koi fish into a golden flood dragon. He beat those who challenged him and won the Flood Dragon Queen’s approval. Later, he found the Flood Dragon Queen’s evil plan. Finally, he evolved into a powerful sky dragon. He defeated the Flood Dragon Queen, crossed the Dragon Gate and became a real dragon.

title: Beauty and the Beast Mates
description: After a fatal accident, modern-day veterinarian Harper Davis wakes up as Maeve, a disgraced disciple of the Stormcloud Sect, her Core shattered and her Spirit Power gone. In the Matriarchal World where females reign supreme, she is ridiculed, betrayed, and left for dead. But she has one advantage no one expects: the Underdog System. With its help, Maeve binds four powerful and stunning Beast Mates, a wolf, a wyrm, an elk, and a phoenix, and begins her rise from the ashes.

title: A Hundred Years of You
description: A witch cursed Prince Alexander to sleep for a century. Only a Jones daughter's kiss can break it. Catherine, once bound to Prince Arthur who chose her half-sister, enters Vandros Castle and awakens Alexander through a three-night ritual. His soul had escaped as a bat, guarding her since childhood. They fall in love. Arthur storms their wedding, but Catherine rejects him. Two princes duel on a cliff. She chooses Alexander. Arthur falls to a fiery end. They wed, sealed by blood and heart.

title: A Little Fire Dragon? No More!
description: Transformed into a little fire dragon, I thought I was summoned for a sweet romance, only to be torn apart by a dragon core and fed to a bear. On the brink of death, the most popular girl in the academy saves me with a contract. I evolve by swallowing a toad and chase beasts when they charge at us. When my enemies see my dragon form, they kneel in fear: "Is this really the F-rank worthless dragon I ditched?"

title: After Cutting Ties, the Genius Baby Triumphs for Mom
description: A seven-year-old programming prodigy, known as a legend in the hacking world, claims to be a genius. However, no one in the city knows his true identity. He confesses to his mother that he is indeed this legendary figure, but she doesn’t believe him, thinking he’s just kidding. She insists on taking him to a research institute to enroll in a program, only to run into his biological father—her first love, who has become a pretentious person.

title: The Phantom Pilot
description: After secretly saving a Navy base from attack, Mitch Peterson, a janitor and the son of a disgraced fighter pilot, is thrust into SkyForge, the military's most elite flight program. As he battles ruthless rivals and proves himself to be a once-in-a-generation pilot, Mitch uncovers a conspiracy tied to his father's death and a powerful senator determined to bury the truth.

title: Divorce Me, In the Name of Mercy
description: The billionaire married the daughter of his father's killer not out of love, but to torment her. Even when she fell terminally ill, he showed no mercy...

title: Gang Girl Goes to Boy's School
description: Yeon-Woo, the heir of the organization Sipgangpa, disguises herself as a boy to infiltrate an all-boys school and eliminate the heir of the rival organization Makgangpa. However, as she catches the attention of a handsome trio, romance begins to blossom in her used-to-be noir life. One of the three is apparaently the heir of Makgangpa—will Yeon-Woo be able to complete her mission without falling in love?

title: CEO Daddy Spoils His Wife Sweetly
description: Since childhood, she bore her parents' disapproval due to a birthmark on her face. Unexpectedly, she saved him from being drugged, and miraculously, the birthmark vanished. Grateful, he planned a billion-dollar gift and proposed marriage.

title: King of Gold
description: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave laborer in a gold mine. On the brink of death, he awakens a mysterious "Golden Eye" that allows him to see through anything and uncover hidden treasures. From a powerless nobody to a legendary mining tycoon, William uses his extraordinary vision and intelligence to defeat the elites who once crushed him!

title: The Bodyguard Godfather's Good Girl
description:
Born a mafia princess, Zoe has always been a pawn in her ruthless father’s game. Forced to marry Delon in place of her stepsister, she refuses to become a sacrifice for her family’s ambitions.
Desperate to escape, she sets her sights on Nick, her cold and disciplined bodyguard—unaware that he is secretly the powerful Godfather of the Voss family. As Nick witnesses Zoe’s resilience beneath her pain, an irresistible bond forms between them.
But when Zoe is drugged and sent to the altar, Nick finally reveals his true identity and rescues her. Together, they uncover shocking family secrets, expose a deadly conspiracy, and fight for a future of their own—where love becomes the ultimate act of defiance.

title: Prank Gone Wrong
description: Maya, a studious girl, agrees to help her crush Connor prank Harper. But Connor ties her up with zip ties and covers her in fake blood. Harper, terrified, beats her with a steel chair, breaking 17 bones. Maya survives after three months in ICU but is disfigured. She rejects settlements, testifies in court, and gets Harper jailed and Connor imprisoned. She moves away, rebuilds her life, and studies psychology and law. Connor spirals into madness. Maya moves on, scarred but unbroken.

title: My Heroine
description: On her wedding day, Heather Dow was called to the battlefield in her father's place. Fighting alongside Crown Prince Waylon Fenn, she secured victory and earned the title of General Laurels. But when she returned, she found her husband Josh Hagar marrying a noblewoman for power. Moreover, Josh sent her poor sister off as a concubine. Fueled by betrayal, Heather set out for revenge. While she turned Josh's world upside down, even darker schemes awaited her and Waylon in the shadows.

title: King of Guns
description: Brady, the legendary sharpshooter known as the King of Guns, broke the world record for longest confirmed kill then vanished from the public eye. He hid his identity, working as maintenance at a shooting range. He endures humiliation from the dismissive shooting club captain who's unaware of his true identity. The shooting range is facing a hostile takeover. In order to protect Denise, the owner, and her daughter Sophia, Brady steps up and shows his legendary shooting skills, drawing attention to his mysterious identity...

title: Game to Glory
description: Reborn as a ruthless entrepreneur, making millions a day seems like no big deal. He rakes in life-saving money through the game, but suddenly, his superpowers spill over into real life! What's going on here? Is the world about to crash down because of it?!

title: General, You Got the Wrong Wife
description: In order to protect me, I was forced to separate from the person I loved. Many years later, my father sold me to a ruthless general. But this general had the same last name as the person I loved, and seemed to have the same bracelet as mine, but my bracelet was taken away by the person who bullied me, and he also took my identity...

title: That Beggar is the Grim Reaper
description: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod of death disguised as a beggar, finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must decide between keeping his identity secret, or revealing his true identity, and possibly losing her.
