title: Damn! The Duke Got The Wrong Girl
description: After a passionate night together, Ava is shocked to discover that Edmund is the new CEO of her company—and she’s assigned as his secretary. Forced to keep their night a secret, she struggles to navigate their professional and personal boundaries. Meanwhile, her friend Chloe schemes her way into Edmund’s mansion by claiming to be the mysterious woman from that fateful night. As Chloe seduces Edmund and torments Ava, their schemes only bring Edmund and Ava closer. In a stunning twist, Ava learns she is the true heiress to a luxury hotel empire. With the truth revealed, Edmund and Ava finally claim their happily ever after.

title: OMG, I Got Married in Vegas!
description: Emily and William are set to be married to each other. To avoid being married off to someone they've never met before - they get drunk and marry the first person they meet. Each other!

title: Godforge
description: Transmigrated to a monster-filled world, Adrian Locke escapes sacrifice with a Eldritch Editing System. Creating beasts to gain power, he battles the eldritch gods.

title: Wrong Wedding Room, Right Groom!
description: Wendy Sully and her sister are set for an extraordinary double wedding—her sister to the cold and commanding head of the Foster family, and Wendy to his brother, a celebrated actor. But on the wedding night, somehow, Wendy walks into the wrong room!

title: No More Mr. Wrong Guy
description: Nick Wilson wakes up 12 years in the future, married to his nemesis, father to a daughter he neglects, and a bankrupt CEO despised by all. After exposing the gold-digger who ruined him and reclaiming his stolen empire, he's now a devoted husband and fierce father. With old friends by his side, he rebuilds his business, crushes his enemies, and rewrites his disastrous fate — it's never too late to win at love and life.

title: The Glass Cage
description: On the night before her engagement, Celeste Yarrow is locked inside a rooftop glass greenhouse by Ingrid Sloane, drenched in freezing water while the guests film and laugh. Damien Thorne, the man she spent three years saving, refuses to protect her and even exposes her deepest trauma for Ingrid’s amusement. Everyone thinks Celeste is just a small-town woman clinging to power, but she is the real force behind Yarrow Capital and the projects that made Thorne rise. After shattering the glass cage herself, Celeste cancels the engagement, pulls her investment, releases the evidence, and makes every betrayer pay.

title: CEO Daddy Spoils His Wife Sweetly
description: Since childhood, she bore her parents' disapproval due to a birthmark on her face. Unexpectedly, she saved him from being drugged, and miraculously, the birthmark vanished. Grateful, he planned a billion-dollar gift and proposed marriage.

title: Bugged Love: Spoiling His Wives
description: Fayne Carter wakes up as a despised live-in son-in-law, constantly humiliated by his cheating wife and her lover. Just when he's about to snap, he unlocks a game-changing system: spend on his "wife" and get 10x cash back. But Fayne quickly discovers a loophole—any married woman qualifies. From his mother-in-law to his rival's wife, he starts spoiling them all, stacking millions while turning the tables on everyone who once looked down on him.

title: Wrong Wedding Room, Right Groom!
description: Wendy Sully and her sister are set for an extraordinary double wedding—her sister to the cold and commanding head of the Foster family, and Wendy to his brother, a celebrated actor. But on the wedding night, somehow, Wendy walks into the wrong room!

title: That Good Girl Is a Boss
description:
Chloe Miller, the legendary head of the Red Fan Family, lived an extraordinary life—only to be murdered by her enemy, Damian Pierce.

After her death, she awakens in the body of a timid high school girl, going from a powerful underworld boss to an obedient student overnight. But while everyone sees her new body as an easy target for bullies, it now carries the soul of a queen. Chloe decides it is time to rewrite the rules of the school.

All she wants is to enjoy a peaceful student life while putting the school bullies in their place. Instead, she unexpectedly attracts the attention of a domineering CEO, a charming older man, and the campus heartthrob, all of whom begin pursuing her.

While dealing with school bullying and her increasingly complicated love life, Chloe secretly investigates the truth behind her own assassination. Eventually, she reunites with her loyal subordinate, Victor Stone, and together they uncover Damian’s conspiracy.

title: The Last Gambling God
description:
Legendary gambler Henry Smith is framed by his nemesis and fellow gambler, Lip Orville, and forced into hiding after Lip kills his brother, David. 
On the run and out of options, he’s saved by Sophia and assumes a new identity——Carl, a janitor at an underground casino (a speakeasy officially) in Chicago. But when Lip returns, now allied with the mafia, and the infamous mob boss, Don Bazzini, Carl is dragged back into the dangerous world of gambling. At the same time, Carl/Henry begins plotting his revenge.

title: No More Mr. Wrong Guy
description: Nick Wilson wakes up 12 years in the future, married to his nemesis, father to a daughter he neglects, and a bankrupt CEO despised by all. After exposing the gold-digger who ruined him and reclaiming his stolen empire, he's now a devoted husband and fierce father. With old friends by his side, he rebuilds his business, crushes his enemies, and rewrites his disastrous fate — it's never too late to win at love and life.

title: Taming the Gaming God
description: Lucy Summers offended Vivian Lang and soon found her career on the line. Desperate to land a game endorsement, she set her sights on gaming god Ray Harrington. Posing as a total newbie, she strategically approached him—moving next door to his team's base, and grinding game matches by his side. Vivian tried repeatedly to sabotage her, but Lucy and Ray turned the tables every time. With Ray's coaching, Lucy skyrocketed in skill, crushed Vivian and claimed the endorsement. After Ray led ALG to a world championship, he got down on one knee—and Lucy said yes.

title: Eight Heirs for the Dragon King
description: William publicly rejects Lora for her younger sister Selena, who bore a dragon egg in their previous life. Both reborn, William blames Lora for failing to produce a pureblood dragon heir. His older brother Asher saves and cherishes her. Together, they fight royal schemes—while she carries Asher’s pureblood dragon heir.

title: The Fallen God of Gambling
description: A legendary gambler defeated a rival in a championship tournament, but his wife was killed in a car crash orchestrated by the loser. He fell into alcoholism and was rescued by a woman who brought him to her family's estate, where he worked as a handyman. When a powerful family tried to seize the estate, he repeatedly stepped in to save them, and romance grew between him and the woman. Later, he discovered his wife's death was the rival's doing. To protect the woman and avenge his wife, he challenged the rival to a final showdown. He won, fulfilled his vendetta, and ended up with the woman he loved.

title: My Ex-wife Is a Savage Warrior
description: Zayden, Ivy's ex-husband, has become the ultimate victor in his family's power struggle. Years ago, Ivy left when he hit rock bottom, but now Zayden, still in love, demands she marry him again for revenge. Ivy was once seen as obedient and dull, but is secretly a fierce warrior and has left to join a peacekeeping mission. Now, with a second chance at marriage, Ivy returns stronger and more than ready to face Zayden's challenge. This time, she's not the woman he remembers.

title: A Rose Across the Years
description: Rose married Robert because of an arranged marriage. This man was much older than her and very powerful. He was the Minister of Foreign Business, and she was a sharp lawyer. They were both shining in their career. This young, gorgeous lady married a man who even could be her "uncle". But in the end, she fell in love with this strong and powerful man. This is a story about love after marriage.

title: The Gold-Digging Queen's Guillotine
description: Princess Isabella of Valen has spent years studying medicine and developing a remedy for the plague. She returns to the capital quietly, hoping to offer it as a birthday gift to her father, King Arthur, who is about to remarry. Arthur's fiancée, Margaret, resents the princess for staying away and delaying the wedding. While riding through the capital, Margaret lets her carriage tear through the streets and nearly runs down commoners. Isabella stops her, only to be publicly humiliated and beaten by Margaret and her daughter, who accuse her of being a witch. The corrupt, fawning captain of the city guard helps them. Margaret burns the portrait of Isabella's mother and the precious herbs Isabella needs for her medicine, then orders her tied to a stake and burned alive. Just in time, King Arthur learns the truth and arrives with his guards in a fury.

title: Bugged Love: Spoiling His Wives
description: Fayne Carter wakes up as a despised live-in son-in-law, constantly humiliated by his cheating wife and her lover. Just when he's about to snap, he unlocks a game-changing system: spend on his "wife" and get 10x cash back. But Fayne quickly discovers a loophole—any married woman qualifies. From his mother-in-law to his rival's wife, he starts spoiling them all, stacking millions while turning the tables on everyone who once looked down on him.

title: Extreme Gambling Game
description: Hank comes back from the army, finds he can't fit in, has to find a job as a car wash man, and his life is a mess. At the same time, his daughter was sick, but he did not have any money; he had to rely on the help of other men to save his daughter. Hank was rejected by his wife, abandoned by his life, and humiliated by others. There was a rage in him that wanted to change... when he accidentally acquired the power of perspective.

title: Rise of the Caged King
description:
Once a business elite, Silas is framed for murder by his rival Chase and his own wife Marina. Sentenced to 60 years, Silas endures brutal humiliation from prison bullies until he meets Grayson, a legendary mafia godfather in hiding. Grayson trains him in lethal combat and helps reduce his sentence in exchange for a future favor of revenge.
Meanwhile, young Ella suffers Marina’s abuse while secretly discovering the truth: her mother’s affair and her father’s innocence. 
Three years later, Silas is released. He crashes Marina’s engagement party like a ghost from the past, ready to strike. Armed with a father’s love, he begins his war to reclaim his life and rescue his daughter from hell.

title: From Grave to Glory
description: Poisoned by her husband, she is reborn at the brink of death. This time, she will not be a victim. She will settle every score they own her, unraveling secrets and reclaiming her life in a world of deceit and power struggles.

title: Cheating Death: The Avenging Twin Goes on a Rampage
description: Fifteen years ago, Lydia gave up her billionaire adoption spot to her twin, Diana. Years later, ruthlessly bullied by elites, Lydia attempts suicide and barely survives. Diana returns victorious, only to find her beloved sister fighting for her life in the Intensive Care Unit. Devastated, she seeks vengeance, becoming the bait to personally punish the monsters who pushed Lydia to the edge!

title: Don't Beg When I'm Gone
description: In the 80s, military doctor Colin endures his parents' favoritism toward his adopted brother Justin and his fiancée's betrayal. He breaks the engagement, cuts ties with the Davis family, and prepares to transfer to the capital with Commander Kirk in seven days. Blinded by Justin's lies, his family keeps hurting him — until he leaves for good. By the time they realize the truth, Colin is already gone.

title: Never Marry a Gold-Digging Social Climber
description: Billionaire CEO Victoria Sterling marries barber Garrett Fletcher, but is betrayed by him and the nanny, Stella Moore. Driven by patriarchal sexism, they sell her newborn daughter, fake her death, and swap in the boy, Zachary Fletcher, to gain her trust and steal her fortune. Victoria Sterling endures 23 years of humiliation while secretly guiding her sold daughter to become the richest woman in the country, Morgan Sterling. At the company handover, mother and daughter unite to expose the truth, ruining the four Fletchers. Garrett Fletcher is jailed for money laundering and murder, Stella Moore is sentenced for child trafficking, Zachary Fletcher is arrested for embezzlement, and Mrs. Fletcher suffers a stroke. Mother and daughter finally reunite, and the villains face justice.

title: The Governor's Lucky Charm
description: Ellie has been branded a "jinx" by her village for her eerily accurate predictions, but in truth, she's anything but cursed. When she's taken in by the governor's wife, Irene, after a chance encounter, her presence turns the mansion upside down: flowers bloom, fortunes shift, and lives begin to change, including the governor's.

title: Little Rebels
description: After a tragic car accident, the parents redirected all blood supplies to save the brother, causing her to ultimately languish and die on her hospital bed. Reborn, she finds herself back at the age of ten. Determined not to survive as she did in her previous life, she plans to take revenge, strip the family of everything, and make her mother regret her actions.

title: She Returned as a Mystic
description: Framed at nine by a fake heiress and pushed off a cliff by her own mother, Winter Sinclair survives and is rescued by a mysterious master. Twelve years later, she returns as a metaphysics prodigy, saving tycoons and cracking impossible cases. As her corrupt family schemes against her, each is publicly exposed. While the Sinclairs self-destruct, Winter rises above them, untouchable, unstoppable, and rewriting fate itself.

title: The Prodigy's Rebellion
description: Ethan Smith holds the title of the youngest scientist on Earth. However, contrary to expectations, his life is marred by family conflicts and tragedy. After being reborn, he chooses to distance himself from his family and live for himself. This time, Ethan refuses to be weak. He not only proves his brilliance to his family but also to his deskmate, his school, and ultimately, the entire world—showcasing that he is a genius who will not be underestimated.

title: His Caged Angel
description: At her husband’s promotion party, Layla crosses paths once again with Revis, the mafia don who kept her five years ago and brought her endless nightmares. Determined to protect her hard-won marriage, Layla refuses to have anything to do with the supreme leader of the Hale family. What she does not know, however, is that she has long fallen into the carefully laid trap of Revis’s hunt, with nowhere to run.

title: The Beggar King Returns
description:
Wall Street tycoon Ryan Chase is poisoned and pushed overboard by his fiancée, Mia, during a lavish yacht party. He miraculously survives—but loses his voice, his identity, and everything he once had. Left with nothing, Ryan is rescued by a kind mute woman named Sophia, who brings him back to her family's small restaurant and offers him a job.
Despite constant abuse from Sophia’s spiteful stepmother Diane, Ryan and Sophia grow close and eventually fall in love. When Sophia’s father, James, falls critically ill, Ryan steps up to help the family.
Meanwhile, Mia forges a marriage certificate in an attempt to steal Ryan’s multi-billion-dollar empire. Ryan’s loyal assistant, Thomas, risks everything to protect what’s left.
When Diane discovers Ryan’s true identity and still refuses to help James, Ryan finally reaches out to Thomas—ready to return to the battlefield and take back everything that was his.

title: Fury Unleashed: Your Sister Rises
description: Having become a CEO, she learns that her long-lost twin sister was nearly bullied to death by classmates. She decides to assume her sister's identity and take revenge on the bullying group. Will the bullying gang recognize her true identity? What will their fate be?

title: Being Good Is Tough
description: A newly retired father travels to see his daughter in the city and helps an elderly stranger who has fallen, only to be falsely accused and extorted. Undeterred, he reaches her company and discovers she is a powerful CEO. Outraged by the injustice, her employees rally to defend him. The daughter clears his name, and the two share a heartfelt reunion, cherishing their restored family bond.

title: The Wrong Limo, The Right Groom
description: Gentle Audrey Bennett is forced to marry simpleton Jeremy Vance for a $200,000 bride price, while Asher Montgomery is arranged to wed arrogant heiress Kendra Sterling. On their wedding day, Audrey and Kendra clash at the same hotel in identical dresses. In the chaos, they get into the wrong limos! When the bridal veils are lifted, they realize the mix-up but slowly catch feelings in their accidental pairings. After swapping back, they despise their original lives and file for divorce. In a twist of fate, Audrey reunites with Asher, and Kendra falls for Jeremy, proving true love always wins.

title: Ages Backward, Loves Forward
description: Born in the 1970s, Vivian Hart has a secret that defies nature—she grows younger as time passes. Labeled a freak by the world, she finds her only warmth in her adoptive mother. But everything changes when she falls in love with her childhood sweetheart, Graham Harrington. While the years pull them in opposite directions, their love remains… until fate tears them apart again and again. Vivian Hart leaves for Hong Kong, rising from nothing to become a powerful businesswoman. Meanwhile, Graham Harrington builds an empire of his own, never forgetting the girl he once loved. Separated by time, reunited by destiny, their love spans over half a century—challenging life, death, and society itself. But in the end… is growing old together the only definition of a happy ending?

title: I'm God in the Village, Garbage Outside
description: Fenn entered the game to save his sister but got stuck in the noob village. When demons attacked, he activated the Noob Village Invincibility System and defeated the Demon Lord at level 1. But if he wants to save his sister, he needs to be invincible. This village is his only chance.

title: My Bestie Wants My One-Night Stand CEO
description:
I was mistakenly sent to the bed of a billionaire by my best friend. Afther the steamy night, he was looking for me all over the city. 
However, my best friend betrayed me for his incredible wealth and disguised herself as me.
But when I successfully passed the interview of the company, why did this billionaire boss look so familiar? Could he find out I was the girl from that night...

title: Wrong World, Right Guy
description: One thousand years of training. 81 divine tribulations. One accidental trip back to Earth. Ethan is a divine being in a world of beginners, and he was fine keeping quiet about it. Then someone messed with his family...

title: Wrong Chat, Real Wife
description: Evelyn is a Harvard-trained surgeon quietly married to Boston's most private billionaire, and one wrong Slack message turns her whole department against her. Vanessa, a new intern, posts selfies from the driver's seat of Evelyn's custom G-Wagon, correctly names the interior color, and calls her attending a broke liar desperate for attention. When a florist arrives with roses for Mrs. Sinclair, Vanessa shoves her aside, takes them, and puts her fiancé on speaker to come defend her honor — announcing his name is Nathaniel Sinclair. Genuinely curious who her husband has been all this time, Evelyn simply texts him to pick her up after work. What walks into that lobby is the real CEO, an administration lined up to congratulate the wrong woman, and a man Nathaniel recognizes instantly: his own driver, who's been borrowing his cars, watch, estate and name to pull women in bars. But the unmasking isn't the end. Vanessa has a livestream, a pregnancy, a sob story and millions of viewers ready to believe the rich stole everything from her — and Evelyn has every hour of footage that proves otherwise.

title: The Return of the Lost Heiress
description: Robin is saved by the penniless Ron when she was kidnapped as a child and lost her memories. However, 13 years later, Anna, Robin’s ruthless birth mother, finds her and stops at nothing to snatch her back. Will Robin turn her back on the father who raised her for the riches of her birthright?

title: The Butcher's Unexpected Love Story
description: A rural girl who sells pork unexpectedly meets a secretive billionaire CEO. They have a whirlwind marriage, and their feelings gradually deepen. However, when his first love appears, cracks start to form between them, and billionaire's true identity becomes a ticking time bomb for their marriage.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith: Pretending to Be CEO‘s Penniless Lover
description: I married my penniless husband whom I have loved for many years, but it seems that he found out that I am not an ordinary hotel waiter? He is not an ordinary security guard?!

title: Racing King Rise Again
description: A three‑time world champion racer is thrown off the podium by his own brother's betrayal. His father dies. His dreams shatter. He ends up hiding as a garage mechanic. Then a woman named Anastasia refuses to let him rot in the shadows. She drags him back to the track, stands with him through every crash and curse, until he rises again—and snatches the most brutal victory of his life.

title: Goddess Unbound: Rising After Divorce
description:
The Emperor's daughter, Yun, was betrayed and severely injured. A poor young man, Peng, saved her. To repay him, Yun hid her identity and married Peng, giving birth to their daughter,NiuNiu. While supporting the family, Yun secretly used the Emperor's power to help Peng succeed.
When Yun planned to reveal her true identity, she found Peng cheating and wanting a divorce. Peng's mother humiliated Yun and eventually drove her
and Niu Niu out of the house.At a grand banquet, Yun revealed her identity, exposed Peng's betrayal, punished the traitors, and became the Empress.

title: The Phoenix Within Me
description: The three major sects coveted the power of the Fire Seal and killed her parents. Before their deaths, her father sealed the Fire Seal’s power within her. Severely injured, she was taken back to her sect by her brother. However, she faced constant exclusion from the sect leader and other disciples, making life difficult, though her brother’s protection kept her safe. Years later, a traitor led the three sects in an attack on her sect, aiming to seize the Fire Seal and take control. With the sect on the verge of destruction and her brother nearly killed, she could bear it no longer and unleashed the Fire Seal’s power, turning the tide and saving them all!

title: Tell Me Your Secret, My Bride
description: College student Lian Cabot transmigrates into the illegitimate son of the Duke. His mother was murdered, and he is forced to marry into the Croft family, taking a foolish bride. After the marriage, Lian uses his poetic talent to win over his alluring mother-in-law and beautiful sister-in-law during the day, while at night he trains in martial arts with a mysterious woman. However, it seems that the person he shares his bridal chamber with each night is different.

title: Fighting Legend
description: Five years ago, Alexander dominated the national martial arts circuit, winning ten consecutive championships—until Cyrus, the secret owner of Kunlun Club, framed him, getting his titles stripped and banning him for five years. Five years later, operating under the alias Xander, he endured humiliation to help his wife Isabella reach the championship finals—only to be ruthlessly divorced. With the support of martial arts heiress Lysandra, Xander decided to return to the ring, reclaim everything that was rightfully his, and ultimately crushed the Zhou family's plot to collude with a foreign power and dominate the entire martial arts world—defending his title and becoming a true fighting legend.

title: Her Second Life, Her Rules
description: Betrayed, robbed of her inheritance, and murdered by her cheating boyfriend and his mistress, Nancy gets a second chance at life. Upon rebirth, she stuns everyone by marrying Riverport's richest man, Lincoln, and turning the tables on those who destroyed her. To save her late father's company, Nancy must survive a ruthless six-month business wager. With Lincoln as her ally, she crushes her enemies, reclaims her power, and rewrites her fate.

title: Utterly Spoiled by My Gigolo Husband
description: Rebelling against her father, Jules flees an arranged marriage only to inadvertently entangle herself with a mysterious gigolo, sealing a contract marriage. While she seeks revenge, he silently protects her from the shadows. But when the façade falls away, it reveals him as the powerful leader of a business empire. Transforming from a pawn to a player, Jules reclaims her life, while her supposed "gigolo" husband proclaims her as his sole love and redemption.

title: Back to the Ring: My KO Mom
description: The boxing queen, Tanya Boyle, retires at the peak of her career for love. Unknown to all, Tanya marries Wesley Thomas and devotes herself to looking after the family. Unfortunately, she gets stomach cancer. So, Wesley’s mother introduces a lady to Wesley. Tanya is heartbroken but offers her blessings. After being reborn, Tanya cherishes her health and fights for happiness. But she ends up divorcing Wesley. Then, Tanya rebuilds her life and returns to boxing. At this time, she discovers Wesley’s new girlfriend, Yolanda Lopez, is lying about being the boxing queen. So, Tanya decides to regain her glory. Wesley looks down upon Tanya when fighting her. He even persuades her to quit the game. However, Tanya ignores Wesley and defeats him. Wesley is shocked, and everyone finds out Tanya is the boxing queen. Wesley regrets losing his idol. But Tanya has changed a lot. She only wants to live her life.

title: No Mercy in Her Second Life
description: In her past life, Jennifer mourned a husband who was never dead. After he faked his death, stole his brother's identity, and conspired with his lover to kill Jennifer and her child, she is reborn before the tragedy. This time, she ends the cursed pregnancy herself and rejects a life of false widowhood, choosing instead to marry the powerful regent everyone fears.

title: Christmas with a Prince: Becoming Royal
description: CHRISTMAS WITH A PRINCE: BECOMING ROYAL is an American Christmas romantic drama from director Justin G. Dyck (Anything for Jackson, A Very Country Christmas), starring Nick Hounslow (The Catch, Good Behavior) and Kaitlyn Leeb (Total Recall, Locked Up).

title: Trapped in a Billionaire's Love
description: After a stillbirth, Seraphina Morgan is manipulated into a one-night encounter with Phil Grant, the wealthiest man in Jiggo City. Unexpectedly pregnant, she is taken into Phil's home. As they spend more time together, Phil begins to uncover the truth. Will he continue to treat Seraphina with respect? And how will the heartbroken Seraphina handle this complicated relationship?

title: A Little Whisper
description: Five-year-old Annie, who can understand animals, saved Landon Hawthorne, a wealthy businessman, from suicide. Now she's his whole world and he's her legal cheat-code against every villain fate throws at them. With her innocence and gift, Annie not only survives dangers but also melts his cold heart—a magical tale of mutual healing.

title: My Uncle's Secret Obsession
description: To save her mom, Sylvia Warren's engaged to Ethan Fletcher. Seeing no future, she sets her sights higher—on the true power in the Fletcher empire: his uncle, Sean Fletcher. Her plan is simple: seduce Sean, secure her freedom. But Sylvia doesn't know that she's the girl Sean has been searching for all along. Every "accidental" encounter was his design. Sylvia must discover if the man she targeted as her ladder out is her ultimate trap... or her only salvation.

title: She Rises Where Love Dies
description: Seven months pregnant with her second child, Natalie finds that her husband of ten years had once legally married another woman. The betrayal shatters her world. Determined to leave, she prepares to return to her powerful birth family only to suffer a premature labor. Delayed treatment costs her unborn child's life. With her last hope extinguished, Natalie cuts all emotional ties and is taken back into the elite family she once walked away from.

title: Tormented Girl Got Her Prince Charming
description: Mia's dad used a forged DNA test report to tell a big lie. He took in his illegitimate daughter Natalie, and lied that Mia wasn't her mom's biological daughter. Because of that fake DNA report, Mia's mom bought it and started bullying Mia. Mia became Natalie's blood tank, and they even wanted to take away her kidney. Luckily, Mia met a good man, Brian Frost. This man and his family pampered Mia and loved her. Mia's dark life got sunshine...

title: Animal Whispering Led to My Uncle Team!
description: After burying her mother, Mia is abandoned by her relatives and left to fend for herself. A twist of fate awakens her ability to understand animals, leading her into the world of billionaire Julian Ford, who brings her into his powerful family. With her rare gift and kind heart, Mia helps the Fords overcome crisis after crisis, gradually winning everyone over, including her cold, disabled uncle. The girl no one wanted becomes the family's most treasured miracle.

title: My Hidden Heiress: CEO Daddy's Secret Baby
description:
Six years ago, Clara's life took an unexpected turn when she was found pregnant after an ONS with Ethan and expelled from school. Fast forward to the present, Clara is at the hospital with her daughter, Mandy, for a fever, only to discover Mandy carries the distinctive genetic traits of the influential Thorne family. 
The Thornes are excited about Ethan's daughter. Ethan Thorne's grandfather, particularly thrilled, wastes no time in ordering Ethan to bring Mandy back into the family. Rediscovery, familial bonds, and the pursuit await.

title: Divorced, Devoted & Dominating
description: Jocelyn gave up her tech career for marriage, only to be betrayed and forced to serve her husband's mistress. She divorces him, takes back her patents, and tanks his company overnight. After a flash marriage with her former rival Steven, she returns to the tech world and rises higher than ever, leaving her ex with nothing.

title: The Lawyer in a Fool's Body
description: Noah Collins, a modern judge's assistant, wakes up as the son of the Chief Justice in Astralon—with only 72 hours to live. To survive, he must rely on a mysterious "Codex System" and his "Eye of Judgment" to solve cases, uncover royal secrets, and outwit corrupt officials. With his enigmatic wife Grace Sinclair at his side, every trial becomes a desperate fight for time.

title: Obsessed With My Son’s Bride
description: In her past life, when the legitimate daughter Leah Bates became pregnant, Elara Bates was deceived into becoming her brother-in-law's concubine. Unbeknownst to her, Leah's childbirth marked the end of Elara's life. Given a second chance, Elara carefully orchestrates her rise, first winning over her brother-in-law's influential father to secure her role as Duchess. She then reclaims her rightful place in the Bates family, exacting vengeance on those who wronged her.

title: After One Night, I Became a Mommy of Four
description: Five years ago, Sarah was drugged by her stepsister and unknowingly spent the night with Jackson, CEO of the Ford Group. Abandoned while pregnant, she later gave birth to quadruplets, two of whom were secretly taken from her. Now raising the remaining children alone, Sarah joins the Ford Group for a better life, only to reunite with Jackson. Separated by lies, they grow closer as buried secrets begin to surface.

title: Legally Bound To Love
description:
The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed  by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law.
What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

title: Love You, Loud and Clear
description: She faked a disability and spent her inheritance to save him. His first words after recovery? A confession of love—for another woman. Now she’s marrying his rival.

title: If Loving You is a Sin, then I'll Go to Hell
description: Ellie Jones has been a good girl her whole life, that is until she loses her virginity to bad boy Asher King at her first high school party. The two fall for each other and she gets pregnant. However Ellie's father, the Pastor, and Asher's family, The Red Snakes Gang, wants to keep them apart and take away their baby. Now he has vowed to protect her, no matter the cost.

title: Love Lies and Bloodline
description:
Yveline McKnight is a hardworking and determined young woman, a trait she's had since her teenage years. However, her life takes a sudden turn when her greedy aunt reveals that she was switched at birth. This revelation strains her relationship with her younger sister, Celine, who begins to treat her coldly, leaving deep emotional scars.
Meanwhile, Jaden Harrington is a meticulous right-hand man of Rose Lewis. Known for his unwavering loyalty, he completes every task assigned to him. Jaden is already set to marry Rose’s daughter, Itzel. Even though neither of them has feelings for each other, they have no choice but to proceed for the sake of their secured futures.
But everything changed when Itzel got into an accident and required a blood transfusion. It was then discovered that she was not a true Lewis. As a result, the wedding plans were temporarily put on hold, and Rose sent Jaden on a mission to find her real child.
During his search, Jaden’s path shifted when he met Yveline and fell in love with her at first sight. He decided to focus on getting to know her rather than fulfilling his mission. However, their love will not come easy, as there are many obstacles—one of which is the truth about Yveline’s connection to the Lewis family.

title: Double Life of a Cell Block King
description: Harrison hits rock bottom after a betrayal by his own stepfamily.  He deliberately goes to prison to gather evidence of his stepfamily’s crimes. After his release, a sudden marriage ties his fate to Sophia, and the two are quickly pushed to the margins, facing humiliation, poverty, and open scorn from those in power. As Sophia chases a chance at a new future, Harrison is repeatedly branded as a ex convict—until a single moment inside the Maple Group building signals that everything they believed about him may be wrong.

title: The Alpha Lost His Ugly Luna
description: Willow celebrates a positive pregnancy test until she overhears a monstrous truth: her Alpha husband, Adrian, has never touched her. Every time she trusted him, his Beta took his place behind her blindfold, while Adrian built a lie to brand her unfaithful and crown his mistress Luna. Betrayed, pregnant, and trapped in a pack that calls her wolfless and ugly, Willow plans her escape. But under the full moon, her birthmark vanishes, a legendary white wolf awakens, and the men who used her begin hunting the woman they can no longer recognize.

title: Bully at School, Sugar on Live
description: Daniel is the invisible, bullied equipment assistant for the ice hockey team, a pitiful bottom who only gets attention and care when he becomes a sexy cam boy late at night. He has no idea that his most hated bully, the school's top alpha who despises gays, is the same person who showers him with money every night as his biggest fan. This is a story of enemies turned lovers, where a straight jock is bent out of shape by the boy he swore to hate

title: Farewell to Deep Love
description: She initially gave up the chance to complete the system's task, transferring her husband's cancer cells to herself. Knowing she didn't have long to live, as a mysterious genius scientist, she created a lifelike robot identical to herself, programming it to always obey her husband and protect her daughter. But after she died, her soul ended up inside the robot, only to watch her husband move his mistress into their home, treat her daughter cruelly, and humiliate her in various ways. At that moment, she began to regret her decision. Does she still have a chance to change everything?

title: Countdown to Doomsday
description:
On my way to my hometown to go through the divorce procedures, my husband and I missed the high-speed rail ticket, so we were forced to take the green train. In the previous life, no one knew that the zombie virus was spreading, and all the passengers on the train died. 
Fate made me reborn and returned to an hour before my death. At this time, I clearly realized that at this moment, there was only one way to save the fate of all passengers, that is, to stop the train and let everyone get off in advance!

title: Don't Let Your Son Fall, Hon
description: Diana discovers her husband Victor is having an affair with her best friend Claire. Trapped in a marriage filled with deceit and abuse, she invites Claire’s 19-year-old son Leo to live with her as an act of revenge. But Leo has been secretly in love with Diana for years. What begins as a calculated scheme evolves into a genuine connection, forcing them to navigate threats from a crypto scam, blackmail, and violent confrontations. In the end, they must choose between  destruction and redemption.

title: Fake it Till You Love Me
description: Being betrayed by her fiance, Caroline got drunk and in bed with her billionaire boss Edward...which becomes the biggest headline all over the country!  Caroline has no choice but agree to play Edward's wife. Their fake relationship has to get past Edward's strict grandma, insidious brother...and themselves.

title: The Furious Mom
description:
"I hope my child stays away from disputes and lives a normal life." 
Fifteen years ago, as a top agent, I retired from the field and became a low-key barbecue stall owner. But my simple wish as a mother didn't come true. 
When my daughter was bullied at school, I was furious. How dare anyone bully her under my watch!
The harm inflicted on my daughter, I will make each of you pay for it, one by one...

title: Rise of Power: Dad, Your Son Comes Back
description:
The protagonist, once the son of a wealthy tycoon, is kidnapped by the tycoon's adopted son and separated from his family. He later joins the Hidden Wolf Special Forces, growing up to become their captain, known as the Wolf King. Just as he is about to reunite with his father, the adopted son poisons him in a betrayal. In a desperate escape, he is injured and loses his memory, only to be saved by his sister.
For eighteen years, the tycoon searches for his son, scouring the nation until he finally finds him in Yang City. Just as the butler brings the protagonist to meet his father, unforeseen events occur. The adopted son intervenes once more, threatening the protagonist by putting his sister's life at stake.

title: When the Wolf Fell in Love
description: Hilary is the heroine born into the Royston family, a fallen lineage of White Wolves. As a child, her mother sealed her power and hid her in the Blade tribe, where she grew up suffering humiliation, servitude, and abuse for being seen as “wolf-less.” Though outwardly timid and restrained, she is inwardly resilient, kind, and deeply compassionate, never losing her sense of mercy or duty even in despair. Forced into a substitute marriage, she meets Aldric in the Shadow tribe, and their relationship slowly develops from misunderstanding and distrust into mutual salvation. As her memories return, she learns the truth about her mother’s death and her family’s destruction, while also awakening the power of the White Wolf. In the end, Hilary is no longer the “useless girl” others trampled on, but the heir to the White Wolf King—someone who carries deep pain, yet still chooses to protect the ones she loves.

title: She Let Go, He Lost All
description: After a life of betrayal, Natalie Lawson wakes up on the day her husband Dylan Mercer asks to marry her stepsister Chloe. Instead of fighting, she walks away. She leaves for Myana, a lawless land, to rebuild her late father's empire. There, she finds an unexpected ally—Vincent Hawkins, a powerful commander bound to her family by an old debt. Together, they rise. When Natalie finally stands at the top, Dylan realizes what he lost. But this time, she's not looking back.

title: I Fell in Love with a Serial Killer
description: New actress Alina meets Jake on a movie set. She soon discovers he is the masked serial killer who killed her abusive father and saved her years ago. As bodies pile up around them, she struggles between fear and desperate love.

title: Walker Love Tale
description: When a zombie outbreak hits, Mia saves someone—only to be attacked in return. Just when she’s about to die, Damian, the Zombie King who’s secretly loved her for years, comes to her rescue. Things get even crazier when Damian takes her home and his zombie parents already call her their daughter-in-law. Then Mia learns the cure may lie in Damian’s genes! Now she has one crazy plan: win over the Zombie King, have his baby, and save the world！

title: She Let Go, He Lost All
description: After a life of betrayal, Natalie Lawson wakes up on the day her husband Dylan Mercer asks to marry her stepsister Chloe. Instead of fighting, she walks away. She leaves for Myana, a lawless land, to rebuild her late father's empire. There, she finds an unexpected ally—Vincent Hawkins, a powerful commander bound to her family by an old debt. Together, they rise. When Natalie finally stands at the top, Dylan realizes what he lost. But this time, she's not looking back.

title: My call boy, my loyal CEO！
description:
Zoe is a computer genius, but she mistakenly identified Daniel as her benefactor and married him.
After three years of marriage, Zoe realized that Daniel didn’t love her at all—instead, he had always looked down on her and used her. Framed by Daniel, she was forced out of their joint company with nothing and lost the patents she had already registered. Choosing to divorce, Zoe started over and launched her own business. To protect her patent ownership, Zoe decided to have a child to inherit them. In a hurry, she sought a "cheap and reliable" male escort for the purpose, only to end up with the young and exceptional Noah. Though she never intended to fall in love, Zoe found herself ensnared in the seductive trap of this domineering CEO...

title: Killer Wife, Spoiled Life
description: Reina is a long-lost heiress with a secret: Over the years, she's taken over a mysterious overseas syndicate once controlled by her adoptive father, until he was murdered: The very reason she returns and agrees to a marriage of convenience with Edwin Fletcher. Now she's ready to find the truth, but are the Fletchers entirely innocent?

title: Married to a Rogue Prince
description: Marian Sutton, daughter of the Marquis, is ordered by the emperor to marry Prince Harlan. But when Harlan rescues his cousin Scarlett from drowning, Marian's grandmother insists on a dual marriage. Betrayed and poisoned by Scarlett and Harlan, Marian is given a second chance at life. Reborn on the day of the marriage decree, she boldly rejects Harlan and chooses the notorious Prince Julian, the capital's infamous playboy.

title: Deal & Love
description: After one crazy night, Iris Shaw and Evan Hale secretly marry. To dodge family pressure, they agree to a 30-day fake marriage, but sparks soon fly. Realizing Iris is his childhood savior, Evan vows to win her heart. However, Iris resists falling in love. Desperate, Evan tries to seduce Iris. Just as she yields, a family dinner reveals a shocking truth: they are bitter business rivals! Can their love survive reality?

title: Too Late, Dr. Hall
description: For five years, I stayed by Vincent's side, enduring his coldness and hiding our relationship to protect his image as a single man. He refused to let our child call him "Dad," and in public, we were only coworkers. I kept compromising for our family until I returned home one day and saw another woman leaving his bedroom. Years of hurt finally broke me. Since he cared so much about being single, I decided to let go and walk away.

title: Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant
description:
Everyone's always told Nora to keep her head down and stay silent, but there's one exception — Vince Grant, her husband. As their contract marriage comes to an end after the best year of her life, Nora is faced with returning to her abusive family, who are already plotting to marry her off again.
Always the calm, collected CEO, Vince finds himself desperate for a chance to win Nora over, even though she left him without looking back. He watches Nora shrink back into the shell he spent a year coaxing her out of, and decides enough is enough. Whether it's as the best "ex-husband" the world's ever seen, or Nora's real husband, with no contract between them, he'll protect her with everything he has.

title: Married to a Rogue Prince
description: Marian Sutton, daughter of the Marquis, is ordered by the emperor to marry Prince Harlan. But when Harlan rescues his cousin Scarlett from drowning, Marian's grandmother insists on a dual marriage. Betrayed and poisoned by Scarlett and Harlan, Marian is given a second chance at life. Reborn on the day of the marriage decree, she boldly rejects Harlan and chooses the notorious Prince Julian, the capital's infamous playboy.

title: Too Late, Dr. Hall
description: For five years, I stayed by Vincent's side, enduring his coldness and hiding our relationship to protect his image as a single man. He refused to let our child call him "Dad," and in public, we were only coworkers. I kept compromising for our family until I returned home one day and saw another woman leaving his bedroom. Years of hurt finally broke me. Since he cared so much about being single, I decided to let go and walk away.

title: After Her Last Will
description: Celeste Monroe taught the Bancroft family medicine. Matriarch Bancroft wished for Celeste's visit before dying. Yet, her descendants disrespect Celeste, using Mr. Bancroft to suppress her, unaware that he learned everything from her!

title: Farewell to Old Love
description: Gretchen Spencer walks down the aisle in her white gown—all alone. The only guest? Her mother‑in‑law. The groom never shows. She smiles through the humiliation. Two years later, fate throws her face‑to‑face with the missing husband she never really had.

title: Above All Limits
description: Logan Ward runs a small shop. Unremarkable. Just an ordinary man with an ordinary life. Except the wooden carvings he casually whittles can manifest into towering divine forms. The doodles he tosses in the trash can grant mortals instant ascension. The stray dog he feeds could swallow the sun and moon. Even the loach he boils on a whim could pass for a dragon lord of the four seas. But, he has no idea...

title: Swallow Me Whole
description:
Swallow Me Whole is based on the novel by Gemma James, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish.
I need to know how to blow a guy. Ashton Levine is my best friend's brother and totally off-limits... until one reckless night under a bar table changed everything.  The rules of him being my sex tutor are simple: No kissing. No screwing. No falling in love. But the more I use my body in the name of experimentation, the more I know being friends isn’t enough. Is it too much to want it all with him?

title: The Broken Me Met Him Again
description: Bullied and forced to break up with her first love, she spiraled into pain, ending up in a mental hospital where she gave birth to a daughter. Five years later, struggling to survive with her daughter, the people who once tormented her return. After leaving her, her first love became a renowned lawyer. When they accidentally meet on the street, can they rekindle their lost love?

title: The In-Laws from Hell
description: Housewife Audra Hart is oppressed by her in-laws for having a girl, driven by their mindset of favoring sons over daughters. She endures it for her filial husband, Caleb Hart. However, her tolerance only leads to her mother-in-law showing more favoritism toward the second son, Wyatt Hart, and youngest daughter, Kelsey Hart. Worse still, the mother-in-law bullies Audra Hart's family and urges Caleb Hart to divorce her. Awakened by his mother's endless cruelty, Caleb Hart firmly stands with his wife and daughter, kicking his biased mother out of the house.

title: My Duplicated Husband
description: For five years, Esther has been trapped in an abusive marriage. Her husband, Carl, cheated on her, was physically violent, and indirectly caused the death of their daughter. On their fifth wedding anniversary, during another violent confrontation, Carl dies accidentally. In shock, Esther buries his body in the backyard and goes to sleep. The next morning, Carl appears in front of her again — alive and behaving like the caring, gentle man he once was when they first fell in love. His personality no longer matches the abusive husband she buried. Esther begins to question what is happening. Did Carl somehow return from the dead, or has someone replaced him?

title: Dirty Teacher
description: A high school senior becomes the victim of an elaborate frame-up after learning that her boyfriend is sleeping with their teacher.

title: Martial Gallop Life
description: Gabriel, a boxing legend turned devoted single dad as "Quentin", must resurrect his fierce past when danger threatens his daughter!

title: What Miss Secretary Wanted
description: For five years, a woman was the secret lover of her boss, but he never truly loved her back. Fed up, she decided to leave the jerk she'd loved for so long, yet he was in a total panic...

title: Too Late, Clair Collins
description:
Years ago, Jake Hudson entered the Los Angeles business school on a Collins family scholarship. During a fraternity incident, he was rescued by Clair, the eldest daughter of the Collins family, and developed feelings for her. However, a drugging plot led Jake to mistakenly enter Clair's room. To protect the family's reputation, the elder Collins arranged a contract marriage between the two, while secretly entrusting Jake with investigating a traitor within the corporation.

During the marriage, Clair misunderstood Jake's scheming nature, becoming cold and distant towards him, even allowing others to humiliate him. Jake, however, remained patient, concealing his feelings, protecting Clair while silently contributing to the corporation.

Three years later, Jake, believing he had repaid her debt of gratitude, decided to leave. Only then did Clair realize that Jake was not only not the mastermind behind the poisoning incident but had also made significant contributions to the corporation. Feeling deeply guilty, she began to pursue him. She gradually discovered Jake's resilience and independence, as well as his deep affection for her.

title: Three Brothers Regret After I Left the Family
description: Unable to give up the blood relationship, she chose to return to her biological family, but found that this family was indifferent to her and preferred an adopted daughter who had no blood relationship with her. After being humiliated for a night, she finally woke up and returned to her original family, which had no blood relationship with her but loved her very much...

title: Our Love, Built on Lies
description: Forced to spy on heir Lucien to pay her father’s debts, Elara finds herself trapped in a web of betrayal, lost love, and tragic loss. After the truth of her noble lineage surfaces, she must face a vindictive rival and a complicated past. Amidst power struggles and life-threatening danger, can Lucien’s ultimate sacrifice heal their broken bond?

title: Memory's Return: Love's United Front
description: After barely surviving her family’s attempt to kill and bury her, a powerful female CEO loses her memory and is left with the mind of a young child. Wandering the streets as a beggar, she’s taken in by a seemingly frail but influential CEO. The two enter a whirlwind marriage, only to face constant humiliation from his family. A heated clash with his stepmother unexpectedly restores her memories, but she chooses to keep her true identity hidden...

title: My Firefighter Ex-Husband Burns in Regret
description: Following the tragic death of their daughter Alyssa in a youth center collapse, Hazel seeks justice and revenge on her firefighter husband Jace, who chose to save his ex-lover Candace and her daughter, Kimberly, instead. Consumed by grief and rage, Hazel holds Jace and Candace responsible for Alyssa's death. As she navigates her sorrow, Hazel transforms her pain into a drive for charity, establishing a foundation to help children. Burdened by guilt, Jace tries to make amends for his decisions, leading to his self-imposed exile. Ultimately, Hazel moves on, finds new love, and leaves Jace to face the consequences of his actions.

title: Infatuated with the CEO
description: Emma is too busy caring for her ailing mother to think about love—especially not with August Hughes, the notorious bad boy and heartthrob everyone fears. What she doesn’t know is that August has been waiting for her all along, hoping for a chance to win her heart. As their paths begin to intertwine, will Emma find the courage to trust him, or will she risk losing her chance at true happiness?

title: You Divorced a Genius Heiress
description: When Elle Vanderbilt, the secret tech-genius Dr. Nova, is divorced and dumped by her husband for an imposter, she flash marries handsome stranger Roy Grant - only to discover he's her ex’s biggest rival. Together, Elle and Roy battle her cheating ex and the fake Dr. Nova for the world's biggest tech contract.

title: The Double Life of a Billionaire Heiress
description: After three years of marriage, CEO Wes Sterling is convinced that his wife Kira is a cheating gold-digger. Fed up with Wes’s accusations and mistreatments, Kira finally divorces him and re-embraces her true identity...a billionaire heiress! What will Wes do when he realizes he made the biggest mistake of his life? Will Kira make him pay...or fall for him all over again?

title: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes
description: Leo Striker loves nothing and no one other than his family and his fast rides. That is until Kara Bellini, helpless but resilient, stumbles into his arms. She thinks she escaped from a thug just to fall for another...but Leo turns out to be a BILLIONAIRE?! What else is he hiding beneath his tattoos and leather jacket?

title: Back to My Ex-Husband with Our Twin Geniuses
description: Six years ago, she left after an event that nearly cost her life. Now, returning with her son, she met someone from her past at an auction, yet it appeared she had completely forgotten him...

title: Ex-Husband Roll Out of My Life
description: Trina, a housewife betrayed by her husband and humiliated by her entire family, finally finds the strength to leave a loveless home. Thus begins her countdown to freedom.

title: Secrets and Soulmates
description: A group of sexy singles move in together with one unforgettable goal: uncover their secret soulmate. Each person has a hidden match living alongside them, but finding true love isn't easy when secrets, temptations, and sexy challenges are around every corner. Will our singles recognize true, fated love—or choose the wrong heart?

title: Loving You Again with Memories
description: When she is suddenly kidnapped, he sacrifices himself to save her, and they both tragically fall. But fate intervenes, and she is reborn. In this new life, she vows to focus on three things: revenge, revenge, and more revenge! Determined to protect him and reclaim her family's fortune, she is set on making the villains pay dearly.

title: Operation Christmas Trap
description: Six years ago, Winnie and Logan fell in love and had twin daughters. But after Selina sowed discord between them, a misunderstanding drove the couple apart. Six years later, with a little help from their twin daughters swapping places, the truth comes to light.

title: Miss You After Goodbye
description: To repay a debt of kindness, Neil signs a secret contract with Keira's father stating that he will marry Keira for five years and help her recover from a painful breakup with her first love, Simon. During their contract marriage, Neil is attentive and caring towards Keira, but she never treats him as anything more than Simon's substitute. When the contract comes to an end, Neil discovers Keira's persisting infatuation with Simon and finally decides to divorce her. When Keira sees the divorce agreement and learns from her father of Neil's departure, she is overcome with regret and travels the world searching for Neil, ultimately realizing that the man she lost was truly in love with her. However, it's all too little too late, as Neil has already embarked on a new, promising path and left her behind for good.

title: My Security Guard Dad Holds a Fortune!
description: A content security guard watches his ambitious son build a billion-dollar empire and advises caution. As the son's business collapses, the father steps in to turn the tide. The son is astonished to discover that his father is not just a security guard but the world's richest!

title: The Finall Play
description: Ryan, star quarterback of the Brooks University Falcons, tears his ACL after a game-winning touchdown that secures national championship qualification. Doctors rule him out for the season, leaving only sixty days before the final. As Ryan sinks into despair, Aiden—a cold, highly professional rehab therapist interning on campus—takes over his case. Their intense physical-contact sessions stir unspoken tension. Backup quarterback Cole covets the starting spot and sabotages Aiden’s recovery plan. Ryan and Aiden grow quietly attracted to each other. Rival Victor bribes the media to question their relationship, and the Tigers’ captain targets Ryan’s injured knee. In the national final, Ryan fights through pain and delivers another game-winning touchdown on live television, defeating the Tigers. Afterward, Aiden helps him to the empty rehab room. Ryan hangs his championship medal around Aiden’s neck, and they embrace and kiss.

title: The Ten-Million Dollar Trap
description:
Emma Sinclair, hidden heiress of Sinclair Real Estate, followed her father’s orders to live modestly—used car, budget clothes, treated as a poor student. She trusted her roommate Bella, a vain cheerleader who secretly hacked her phone and drained ten million dollars. When Emma discovered the truth, Bella pushed her off a Dubai hotel rooftop. Jason, the basketball star Emma loved, had already publicly slapped her, calling her a fraud. Emma died abandoned.

Reborn to the day Bella proposed the Dubai trip, Emma plans revenge. She “loses” her phone, replaces it with an old Nokia, and lures Bella into spending over five million dollars on non-refundable luxury items. At payment, Bella is exposed, unable to cover the bill. Jason sells his sneakers and maxes credit cards to help her. Followers desert. Only Ashley apologizes. Then tycoon Victor Sterling reveals Emma as the Sinclair heiress. Bella is arrested for fraud; Jason loses everything. Emma’s revenge makes every betrayer taste the fall.

title: Never Fall Alone
description:
Maddox, a gifted diver haunted by the trauma of a past accident, makes his comeback. On the night of his return, he mistakes Teo, a younger fellow athlete, for someone else and spends the night with him. The next morning, he discovers Teo is none other than his new synchro springboard partner.
What follows is a journey from awkward hostility to budding affection. Tormented by public expectations and lingering trauma, Maddox struggles repeatedly with his feelings. Their rival Tyler secretly films their intimate moments and uses the footage to blackmail them.
In the end, Maddox conquers his inner demons. He and Teo claim the championship at the grand finals. Standing on the winner’s podium, they publicly confirm their relationship, achieving fulfilment both in their sporting careers and their love.

title: The Contract Wife Who Was Once Loved
description:
Three years ago, a car accident left her in a vegetative state. Her childhood sweetheart stayed by her side, caring for her and waiting for her to wake up. However, a scheming woman deceived his mother into signing a marriage contract, forcing him to marry her with the stipulation that they couldn't divorce for a year. Despite the marriage, he continued to devote himself to his true love, his heart belonging only to her.
Consumed by jealousy, the scheming woman kidnapped her rival, switched faces with her through plastic surgery, and burned her vocal cords, rendering her mute. She then threw her into a fire, causing the two women to swap identities. Miraculously surviving, she woke up to find herself mute and suffering from amnesia. Facing abuse and scorn from her unaware lover, she tearfully accepted her new identity.
Can she, with her appearance and memory completely altered, reclaim her true identity and successfully take her revenge?

title: Pregnant By the Billionaire
description: Mia Harper, down on her luck, marries wealthy CEO Carter Prescott as part of a deal. Their fake marriage soon blossoms into real romance, but their love is tested when Carter's ruthless ex, Lily, stops at nothing to win him back. The drama intensifies when Mia discovers she's pregnant with Carter's baby and uncovers the shocking truth that Lily is her long-lost stepsister...

title: Don't Blink, You'll Miss It
description: The Master of Magic, Daniel Angier, went into hiding after losing his brother in a tragic casino heist gone wrong. But after reconnecting with a close friend of his brother’s, Daniel sets out to reclaim the title of the Master of Magic in order to save his childhood orphanage.

title: My Dark Romeo
description: After Romeo Costa ruins Dallas Townsend's reputation at the debutante ball and forces her into a marriage, Dallas makes a new plan: seduce him, break his rule, and get the family she’s always dreamed of. But Romeo is not easy to break. And Dallas isn't the type of girl to give up.

title: Mated to My Sworn Enemy
description: When nine-year-old Samara Brenner, the last heir of the legendary White Wolf bloodline, witnesses her family slaughtered, she escapes and spends the next nine years hiding under a false identity, pretending to be a weak Omega while preparing for revenge. Her plan unravels when she discovers her fated mate is Roman Hartwell, the Alpha she has believed was complicit in her family's massacre. As hatred turns into reluctant trust, Samara uncovers a devastating truth: Roman has spent years searching for her and hunting the real mastermind behind the betrayal. Together, they must expose a conspiracy that reaches deep into their own families, reclaim her pack, and decide whether love is stronger than vengeance.

title: My Son Crossed Me Out for His New Mom
description: At her son’s seventh birthday charity gala, Elena Moore is humiliated on a live broadcast when her little boy crosses out her face in the family photo and declares another woman his real mother. Her powerful husband, Derek Harrington, demands she apologize instead of protecting her. But Elena refuses to break. She announces a divorce and launches an audit into the Harrington Children’s Medical Fund. Soon, she uncovers a chilling “Mom Exit Plan”: staged videos, a fake psychiatric evaluation, and a plan to erase her from her child’s life forever. This time, Elena fights back.

title: My Fated Mate Wasn't Him
description: Ava, a human without a wolf soul, married Alpha Nick because the Moon Goddess declared them one-hundred-percent fated mates, but he spent two years humiliating her and never believing a word she said. When the Silver Moon Temple reveals the compatibility reading was wrong and her true mate is Ryan, the West Coast Alpha, Ava forces the annulment herself, suffering a soul backlash that nearly kills her. In her coma, Nick discovers the bruises and the miscarriage she hid—after he choked her—and finally kneels to admit fault, but it's too late. When Ava's wolf soul awakens, she runs to a cliff's edge, broken beyond reach. Ryan saves her; Nick lets her go. Ava loses her memories of him, leaves, and opens a flower shop in a quiet town, learning who she is without being anyone's Luna. Months later, a familiar voice calls her name—but this time, the choice is hers.

title: Maid for My Nemesis
description: Conscientious class president Emma is keeping a big secret: She's the poorest girl at her wealthy private school. When her rival, uber rich bad boy Lucas Bennett gets her fired from the part time job that's paying her father's medical bills, he makes it up to her — by hiring her to be his personal maid! Lucas agrees to keep their arrangement a secret... as long as Emma caters to his every need.

title: Mommy, I Got You A Date
description: Liam and Annie were a young couple until Annie was nearly assaulted. In the process of saving her, Liam severely injured the attacker, resulting in his imprisonment. The wealthy Holland family head revealed Liam as their heir, forcing Annie to leave him by promising to save him if she agreed, hiding her pregnancy and pretending to love money. Six years later, Annie is a janitor, and Liam is the Holland heir. Despite his resentment, Liam still loves Annie and repeatedly saves her, but she avoids him, fearing for their son Henry's safety and feeling guilty for the past. Liam decides to win her back by focusing on Henry, believing that with Henry, Annie will return. He carefully plans to remove the obstacles that separated them.

title: Mommy, You Always Win
description: They threw her out, pregnant and penniless. Eight years later, Maggie returns as a billionaire tech genius with twin prodigies and a secret: she already owns the company her family stole from her. Now she'll make her enemies beg as she proves that moms can have it all—and revenge is sweetest when it's served by a girlboss.

title: My Two Mates Never Loved Me
description: I’m Evelyn. In my past life, Alpha Caden and Beta Zane only used me as a bet toy for their beloved Sera, then threw me to wild wolves to die. Reborn, I stripped off all their gifts and fled barefoot in snow. The so-called perfect Sera turned out to be Asher, a male warrior in disguise. He sacrificed his lifespan to save me. When I fell for him, Caden and Zane begged hard for my forgiveness. But Asher died young. Can I avenge him and break free from the two cruel Alphas?

title: Mafia Mamma's Hot Lover
description: Betrayed housewife Maria’s life is upended when she unexpectedly inherits a vast mafia empire at her grandfather’s funeral, transforming from a dismissed “middle-aged housewife” into the “Godmother” of the St. Clair crime family. As she navigates her new role—seeking peace in a world of violence—she rekindles a forbidden love with Richard, her childhood crush and the family’s trusted advisor. But Richard is secretly the long-lost heir of their greatest rival, torn between blood and loyalty. Forced to publicly oppose each other while secretly allying, they must survive assassinations, family treachery, and their own hearts to expose the true mastermind behind the conflict, end the bloody feud, and claim both power and love.

title: Mommy's Little Savior
description:
Five years ago, Elena Hartwell broke up with her college boyfriend Killian Thorne to protect him from her ruthless uncle Victor—making him believe she was a gold-digger. Heartbroken, Killian returned to his family's trillion-dollar empire, while Elena was framed by Victor and imprisoned, where she gave birth to their daughter Luna.

Now, brave 4-year-old Luna tracks down Killian at his corporate headquarters, shocking everyone by calling him "Daddy." After a DNA test confirms the truth, Killian learns of Elena's wrongful conviction and the sacrifices she made. With his power and resources, he sets out to free Elena, protect Luna from Victor's schemes, and win back the woman he never stopped loving.

title: My Name Is Not Maya
description: Maya Bennett’s life disappears overnight. Her coworkers don’t recognize her, her records are gone, and another woman is already living under her name. Searching for answers leads her to SECOND LIFE, a mysterious organization tied to vanished identities and stolen lives. But the deeper she digs, the more terrifying the truth becomes: what if Maya Bennett’s life was never hers to begin with?

title: My Ex Is My Boss
description: Gavin Wright spent three years funding his girlfriend Mandy Parker. On their wedding day, Mandy, now at the elite Sewell Group, tests him by demanding a massive bride price and publicly insulting him. Fed up, Gavin Wright cancels the wedding. Little does she know, he is the Sewell Group CEO's long-lost child. The next day, Mandy is shocked to find he is now the Sewell Group's general manager, her direct boss.

title: My Mate is a Vampire
description: A werewolf cursed to never shift. A vampire with dark secrets. Kaiya and Talon are supposed to be mortal enemies, but what will the two do when the impossible happens and... they form a mate bond?!

title: My Master My Slave
description:
Five years ago, Morris was the young master who vanished; Ivan the manservant left behind. Now, Ivan is a billionaire CEO, while Morris is so desperate he trades his nude photos to his former servant for his sister’s medical fees. This deal deepens the thorn of abandonment in Ivan’s heart. He humiliates Morris with money, yet can’t help falling for him, mistaking revenge for a game he’s already lost.

After an accident, Morris fakes amnesia to prolong their twisted entanglement. Ivan, seizing the chance, crafts a bigger lie: he tells the “amnesiac” Morris they are engaged lovers. Thus begins an engagement full of hidden agendas—one pretends to forget, the other pretends to possess. But on their wedding day, Ivan’s stepmother Irene exposes both deceptions. As the lies unravel, the truth of that rainy abandonment, the desperation behind the photos, and the love buried under revenge are laid bare. Two liars, one overdue “I love you.”

title: My Immortal Love
description: After being fired and betrayed on her birthday, Lana’s life takes a supernatural turn when she becomes the first person in 2,000 years to see Augustus—a cursed, invisible Roman immortal. Believing Lana is his destined "miracle," Augustus begs her to help break his eternal curse. There's just one deadly catch: to set him free, she must kill him. As they grow closer and undeniable sparks fly, Lana is torn between her deepening love and the cruel fate demanding his sacrifice. Can they defeat the ancient gods and break the curse without losing each other, or is their romance doomed?

title: Marry Me, Mr. White
description: Rachel finds herself without a groom on her wedding day, only to realize that her soon-to-be husband is in bed with her own cousin! Refusing to become the laughing stock of town, Rachel decides to continue on with the wedding, there's just one little thing she needs to do… find a new groom!

title: My Sisters Made Me Rich
description: Nolan Hayes is a delivery guy humiliated by his cheating girlfriend and a rich rival. Then he finds a mysterious bracelet that unlocks crazy powers—including glimpses of the future. Suddenly, nine powerful, stunning women show up, claiming to be his "adoptive sisters." They help him turn the tables on everyone who wronged him, fight back against the elites, and rise from rock bottom to become absolutely unstoppable. Expect payback, romance, and non-stop twists.

title: My Demon Harem Runs This Endgame
description: I'm Luke, dropped into a wraith apocalypse. While others cower, I see only irresistible succubi. I steal a kiss from the Scarlet Bride, turn Wraith Queen Carmine into my pampered loli, and seduce the Gloom Weaver Empress into my wife. Scarlet & Ivory Twin Wraiths, the Gloom Lion Sovereign, even SSS-level wraiths, all fall to me. Apocalypse? Wraiths? I am the true chaos, the ultimate threat.

title: My Ex Is My Boss
description: Gavin Wright spent three years funding his girlfriend Mandy Parker. On their wedding day, Mandy, now at the elite Sewell Group, tests him by demanding a massive bride price and publicly insulting him. Fed up, Gavin Wright cancels the wedding. Little does she know, he is the Sewell Group CEO's long-lost child. The next day, Mandy is shocked to find he is now the Sewell Group's Mr. Wright, her direct boss.

title: My Ex Dumped Me... So I Become His Stepmom
description: Blessed with rare fertility, Sylvia Sims was destined to marry Hugh, the adopted heir of Marquis Ethan McCarthy. Yet on their wedding day, Hugh demanded to take a concubine alongside her. Refusing to share her husband, Sylvia boldly called off the marriage—and instead wed the Marquis himself. Enraged, Hugh schemed to ruin them, only to be stripped of his title in disgrace. Meanwhile, Sylvia joyfully conceived the Marquis's own heir, securing a legacy of love and power.

title: Mr. Moore, My Heart Won't Be Tamed
description: Betrayed by her husband, Mason Kane, Nancy Larson is determined to take her life back. She'll claw her way from the wreckage of her marriage to the top of the business world. But when Frank Moore—a powerful man from her past and one unforgettable night—reappears, he threatens to disrupt everything. Is he her greatest ally, or the one who will burn her new empire to the ground?

title: My Rented Girlfriend Rules Me
description: Lucas Harrington has two problems: too much money, and too many women chasing it. Desperate to dodge yet another arranged marriage, he drops a bombshell: $100,000 a day to rent a girlfriend for New Year's. Enter Joanna Collins—ice queen, self-made millionaire, and the last person who needs the cash. She signs the contract anyway. Over drinks and family dinners, something shifts. Lucas, spoiled heir who's never washed a dish in his life, finds himself in an apron, chopping vegetables. By the time the fireworks fade, he's not just in love—he's trained. Loyal dog, willing slave, whatever she wants.

title: Mom, Love Me Again
description: She was framed to death, and he misrecognized their daughter. Given another life, she is going to protect her love ones, and punish the bad!

title: Marry Me, In the Name of No Mercy
description: Amelia Sutton wakes up as the disposable character in the novel she read. Forced by her infertile husband, Carey Abbott, to bear a child to secure his title, Amelia makes a daring choice: she picks the future Emperor—the blind musician, Ansel Sinclair. Using her knowledge of the story, she turns from a pawn into the player, becoming the obsession of the man destined to be a tyrant.

title: Taming My Mafia Master
description:
After catching her boyfriend of seven years cheating, ordinary office worker Chloe has a one-night stand with Aiden, a dangerously charming mafia boss. A man who has never slept with the same woman twice—and who has never believed in love—breaks his own rules for the first time because of her.

A contract relationship binds them together. Knowing she will fall for him, Chloe secretly changes their one-year agreement to just three months. Meanwhile, Aiden becomes increasingly addicted to her, yet refuses to admit his feelings because of a betrayal in his past.

As a rival provocateur, the contract’s expiration date, and a new suitor push them to the edge, Aiden—the man who has always controlled everything—finally realizes the truth: he is the one with the most to lose.v

title: My Sister Stole My Man
description: After a one-night stand, the woman’s sister steals her identity. Six years later, she becomes the CEO’s legal advisor, and they grow close. The sister, fearing exposure, tries to sabotage her, but the CEO thwarts each attempt. In the end, the truth is revealed, and the CEO’s family reunites.

title: My Sister Stole My Man
description:
Tonia is a twin who has been bullied all her life by her twin sister– Steph. Who always manages to ruin everything Tonia has. Even to the extent of destroying Tonia's engagement.
Tonia's best friend is back in town, richer, more handsome and well connected. The tides are now in Tonia's favor. A love story is also blossoming.
Would Steph and Jaden succeed in destroying the blooming love between Tonia and Michael, would Michael be able to protect Tonia, and would he be able to serve Steph a cold plate of revenge.
The path to Michael's and Tonia's path to happily ever after is filled with dark twists and turns, would they fight for their love and survive?

title: Nero: Made Men
description: Based on the novel by Sarah Brianne. Elle's life is turned upside down when Nero, the untouchable bad boy, swoops in to save her from her school bully. One smile from him makes every girl swoon, Elle couldn't believe he wants her.  Gazing into his eyes, she wonders if this notorious bad boy could be trusted... How was she to know that she was just a part of Nero's mission, as the heir to a Mafia Empire?  As for Nero, he has somehow fallen head over heels for this girl who has no idea the danger she was in.

title: Sisters in Vengeance
description: Ivy was the real heiress of the Hayes family who was lost. After 18 years, she returned to the Hayes family. Everyone thought she would compete with Audrey, the fake daughter of the Hayes family. But unexpectedly, the first thing she did when she came home was to cling to Audrey. During their interaction, Audrey was moved by Ivy's sincerity, and the two sisters jointly tormented the villain and harvested sweet love.

title: My Pocket-Sized Mama
description: Mary Fowler, who has dwarfism and stands only four feet tall, kindheartedly adopted an abandoned baby girl, Mia. Over the next 18 years, Mary tirelessly raised Mia, who eventually got accepted into a top university. However, when the Mayor's son, Frankie Miller, tries to force Mia into marriage, Mary is severely injured while protecting her. Just in time, Mia's biological father, Robert Pierce, CEO of Pierce Corporation, steps in to claim his daughter and punish the evildoers. At Mia's grand college celebration party, she faces bullying from classmates, but Mary stands fiercely by her side. Ultimately, the truth prevails, the villains face justice, and mother and daughter happily reunite—proving that a mother's love isn't measured in height, but in the size of her heart.

title: Mom Is Never Coming Back
