description: Young Olivia Davis witnesses her mother, Julia Hayes, get killed by Vanessa Price, a woman obsessed with Olivia's father, Arthur Davis. When Olivia desperately seeks help, Vanessa fakes an illness to stop her. With Arthur absent, Julia dies in despair. Later, in the Evans estate living room, Olivia accuses Vanessa but is scolded by her father. Forced to live with her mother's killer, Olivia endures Vanessa's framing and Arthur's misplaced blame. Biding her time, she secretly teams up with Aunt Fiona to gather evidence. At Vanessa's birthday party, Olivia publicly exposes the truth, finally opening Arthur's eyes. Unhinged, Vanessa kidnaps Olivia, planning to kill her in front of Julia's memorial portrait. Arthur sacrifices himself to take the fatal blow for his daughter, leading to Vanessa's accidental death. Ultimately, while paying respects to her parents, Olivia steps into a new life, forever changed.

title: Marry My Love, Not My Fiancé
description: Pearl Harper, the only daughter of a global business tycoon, suffered a severe body change after saving Mason Black. Yet her fiancé, Mason, faked his death and stole his older brother's identity to marry someone else. Upon learning this, Pearl decides to restore her beauty and crashes Mason's wedding to expose his crimes. Who says you have to marry your fiancé?

title: Mom, Love Me Again
description: She was framed to death, and he misrecognized their daughter. Given another life, she is going to protect her love ones, and punish the bad!

title: Mom, We're Dumping Dad This Time
description: Vivian Kensington, a billionaire heiress, hid her identity to marry Silas Sterling and prove their true love. For years, she worked multiple jobs to fund his acting dreams. Just as she planned to reveal her wealth to boost his debut, Silas abandoned her with a divorce and an NDA. Devastated, Vivian suffered a car crash and fell into a 5-year coma. Their young daughter, Mia Sterling, stepped up to care for her, surviving by scavenging and being raised on neighborhood charity. Five years later, Mia hopefully approaches Silas, now a superstar, only to be cruelly humiliated by him and his vain mother, Agatha Sterling. As Vivian finally wakes up and sees Silas's true colors, she vows to strike back and protect her daughter.

title: My Family Wants Me Dead
description: As the CEO of Sterling Group, Vivian Sterling had it all. Kind and unsuspecting, she even took in her pregnant cousin. But her joyful pregnancy became a nightmare. Her husband, Nolan Vance, coveted the Sterling Group's wealth and conspired with her cousin, Chloe Mercer. Behind her innocent facade, Chloe deeply envied Vivian. The pair controlled Vivian's life, sent Arthur Sterling away, and bribed a doctor to delay her labor. Vivian died in agonizing pain, discovering their affair in her final moments. Miraculously reborn, Vivian vows to rewrite her fate. Feigning ignorance, she plots her escape from Nolan, Chloe, and Mrs. Sterling. Along the way, she uncovers their schemes, realizes her mother's elegance is a lie, and discovers her adopted brother Arthur's hidden agenda...

title: Mom's Support Money
description: When Rose Hayes dies of terminal cancer, her son Gary Hayes and his wife Chloe Hayes hide her death to keep scamming monthly support money from Sarah Hayes and Arthur Hayes. Claiming Mom is just visiting her folks, they fake videos, bury her ashes in the family plot, and lie that it's neighbor Gus Carter's dead dog. When Sarah and Arthur return for Mom's fiftieth birthday, a fresh grave makes them suspicious. With Mayor Bennett's help, they uncover the truth. Furious, they reclaim the remaining 2.21 million in support money and kick the unfilial couple out. Mom's dying will brings all their sins to light.

title: My Mother-in-Law, My Mom
description: Diana Sterling's mother-in-law Shirley Sterling needs heart surgery. However, her son Arthur Sterling, the only capable lead surgeon, abandons her for his first love Chloe Dalton, causing his mother's death. Heartbroken Diana begs Arthur to see his mother one last time but is turned away. Arthur stays with Chloe, ignoring the final arrangements. Following her dying wish, Diana buries Shirley in the Sunflower Field, deciding not to erect a headstone or hold a funeral. Surprisingly, Chloe wants the plot, so she and Arthur dig up the grave, and Arthur scattered the ashes. Diana explodes, exposing the truth at a fake funeral Arthur hosts for his reputation, and asks for a divorce. As Arthur orders her to walk away with nothing, lawyer Gavin Pierce presents the will: Shirley left everything to Diana. Diana reclaims the house and car Arthur bought for Chloe and kicks her out. She uses surveillance footage to expose Chloe's deceit to Arthur and sends Chloe's thieving mother to prison. A remorseful Arthur agrees to walk away with nothing. Chloe attempts a murder-suicide with poison but only kills herself, leaving Arthur severely crippled. Three years later, Diana and Gavin Pierce are a couple. They bump into Arthur, now a town doctor in Shirley's hometown. Diana calmly says goodbye, triggering Arthur's old illness, and he dies hallucinating.

title: Mom, Forgive Me Again
description: Marian Wilson, a resilient single mother, strives to raise her daughter Grace and stepdaughter Melly after her partner passed away. As she juggles cleaning jobs and scrap sales to make ends meet, Grace abandons her sister on purpose just because she's a well-behaved girl. Years later, desperate to marry into wealth, Grace chooses to hide her identity and claims to be an orphan. But secrets have a way of surfacing. Now she's going to beg her mom for forgiveness.

title: Mom's Second Baby Before My Exam
description: On the day of her grad school entrance exam, 22-year-old Emma Miller is dragged away by her father, Richard Miller, who claims her mother is gravely ill. At the hospital, Emma discovers her mother, Helen, isn't sick but is giving birth. Driven by patriarchal tradition, Richard forces Emma to quit school to care for her new brother. Devastated, Emma runs away. Six years later, as Emma gets engaged to Oliver Wright, her parents show up with her brother, Toby Miller. They make unreasonable demands, even causing a pregnant Emma to miscarry. Ultimately, with her mother-in-law's support, Emma and Oliver heal their rift and find happiness.

title: Mom, I'm Here for You
description: The female CEO Eleanor has tried to find her birth mother for 20 years and finally got some news. Unexpectedly, a human trafficker Victor wanted to scam Eleanor for her money. So they let Janet replace her real mother who was imprisoned and abused. Because of birthmark inconsistency and memory deviation, Eleanor started doubting the fake mother. She found out about their trap and finally saved her real mom. And those bad people also got punished...

title: My Family Has My Back
description: After moving from the sticks to the city, Stella endures endless abuse from her in-laws. During the Mid-Autumn Festival dinner, she finally snaps, leaving the Thorne family with her daughter, Gemma. Learning of her plight, her mother takes her in. Coincidentally, Stella's brother, Roman Mercer, just moved to town as the General Manager of Stratos Corporation. When Stella's demand for a divorce sparks a fierce dispute, Roman steps in to confront the Thorne family. Ultimately, the in-laws pay the price, and Stella successfully divorces Garrett Thorne.

title: Spoiled by the CEO During Pregnancy
description: Born in a family that favors boys over girls, the money I earned from working as a part-time student was stolen by my mother. And she used it to buy a video game for my younger brother! When I was desperate, the CEO's assistant found me and proposed - if the CEO fell in love with me, I would have money to go to college! I decided to take the chance. Just one night, I got pregnant, and the CEO actually spent a lot of money and loved to spoil me!

title: Puck Me Baby One More Time
description: Lila Cobb once saved Alexander Vaughn, the hottest hockey player. One night of passion between them left her unexpectedly pregnant. Eight months later, Lila was cast out of her family and gave birth to a premature baby boy. Struggling to pay the hospital bills, she worked herself to the bone. Meanwhile, Alexander has been searching for Lila all along, determined to give her and their child all the love he has. But will he be able to find them before it’s too late?

title: Forced to Marry My Enemy
description: Sean Carter gave up his powerful family name to live as an ordinary DoD civilian analyst, hoping his wife Morgan Hayes loved him for who he was. But when he caught Evan Brooks assaulting her, Morgan protected Evan’s military future by giving false testimony and sending Sean into three years of punishment in Alaska. The day Sean returns, Morgan brings him straight to her wedding with Evan, humiliating him in front of everyone who thinks he is powerless. But Sean has one secret left: he is the son of General William Carter. When the truth comes out, Morgan and Evan finally learn that the man they destroyed is the one who can bring them down.

title: Miss Me When I'm Gone
description: For three hundred years, Shane held Demon-Suppressing Pass, keeping the demon race at bay and the Eastern Union safe. But peace bred doubt. With demons unseen for generations, the court and the people branded him a fraud and cast him out. The moment he left, the demons returned. As the Eastern Union fell into chaos, Shane had already turned his back, crossing into the Ascendant Kingdom, where a new war awaited, and a deadlier legend was about to begin.

title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone
description: After losing my parents, I move in with my godmother, Aunt Sandra. I live under her roof with her two sons-the Miller brothers-surrounded by love and care. I think I’ll end up with one of them. But everything changes when the maid’s daughter, Lola, moves in. The Miller brother I love most breaks my heart into pieces. After I leave, they lose their minds trying to find me.

title: Marry Me, Mr. White
description: Rachel finds herself without a groom on her wedding day, only to realize that her soon-to-be husband is in bed with her own cousin! Refusing to become the laughing stock of town, Rachel decides to continue on with the wedding, there's just one little thing she needs to do… find a new groom!

title: In Love With My Classmate's Mom
description: Eddie is reborn on the very day before he was supposed to confess his love to the most popular girl in school. Everyone is waiting for his big move, but with the help of a mysterious system, Eddie shocks them all by confessing to her mom, Whitney! From that moment on, his bold pursuit of love turns the whole campus upside down.

title: My Security Guard Dad Holds a Fortune!
description: A content security guard watches his ambitious son build a billion-dollar empire and advises caution. As the son's business collapses, the father steps in to turn the tide. The son is astonished to discover that his father is not just a security guard but the world's richest!

title: Not My Clan, Not My Problem
description: Audrey Harrington, the adopted daughter of the Harrington Estate, is betrayed and murdered by the trueborn child, Stella Harrington, and the rest of House Harrington. Reborn, Audrey vows revenge. Calculating her every move, she reclaims the steward's power only to strategically let it go, plunging House Harrington into financial ruin. She then exposes Stella Harrington's schemes, completely humiliating her. Meanwhile, she allies with His Highness Rowan Lancaster to uncover the dark secrets of House Harrington. Ultimately, Audrey exposes their crimes, leading to the family's exile. Free from their grasp, she finds her happily ever after with Rowan Lancaster.

title: The Scent That Made Him Mine
description: Their love was sealed with a kiss in the perfumery, but a family conspiracy turned it into a curse. She “betrayed” him to settle debts; he “died” in a crash. Five years later, she’s a down-and-out job seeker, while he’s the dashing heir of a conglomerate. When a perfume bottle shatters, the familiar scent unravels secrets — the locked room, the staged betrayal. Who’s pulling the strings? Click to witness the electrifying showdown between love and revenge!

title: Tame Me, My Lord
description: To save her mother, Rose enters a binding master-servant contract with noble heir Harry—unaware she's the idealized first love he's secretly yearned for years. Tangled in a whirlwind of mutual obsession and jealous torment, they navigate a labyrinth of misunderstandings before confessing their passion, only to be torn apart by their clashing worlds. In a climactic twist, Harry storms Rose's wedding ceremony as she's poised to marry another. Defying societal chains, Rose embraces her true desires, culminating in a kiss that rewrites their destiny.

title: Hey Mommy! Time for a New Daddy!
description: Reborn as a five-year-old, Talia only wants to protect her mother. But her charm and secret talents soon win over powerful elders and silence the doubters. With a tycoon father, an even richer stepfather, and a future billionaire husband, she grows up as the family's darling, proving that even the smallest star can shine the brightest.

title: I Became My Ex's Stepmom
description: After she finds that her boyfriend, Marco, cheated on her with Jessica, Gretchen Hayes marries Lorenzo Sterling, the billionaire CEO she just met. But her revenge takes a shocking turn when her ex becomes her stepson. In a world of luxury and lies, Gretchen must outsmart her enemies and claim her power — and maybe find real love along the way.

title: Her Billionaire Father Spoils Her Rotten
description:
Genius hacker Abby was the Governor's adoptive daughter, enduring years of abuse to help him seize power. Yet, right before her 18th birthday, her adoptive father sells her to a lecherous businessman for $5 million. 
In despair, she uses DNA matching to find her biological father—America's top tycoon, Dominic Mancini. Back in the lap of luxury, Abby not only inherits trillions but also has three elite adopted brothers, each a titan in his own right, to protect her. 
At her grand coming-of-age ceremony, Abby makes a magnificent return as the sole heir, publicly unmasking her adoptive family's cruelty and making those who once bullied her pay dearly. 
Reborn from the ashes, she will begin her brilliant life at the pinnacle of power.

title: Slay, Madam
description: Two girls were kidnapped and rescued by a kind cleaner who raised them. One of them, Marianne, got her rich family back at 15—but she saw her past as shame. To erase the witnesses, she poisoned and tried to run down Stephanie. The cleaner pushed Stephanie aside and died. Then Marianne hit her again. But Stephanie survived. She turned out to be the lost heir of a billion‑dollar empire. Five years later, she's back—not as a victim, but as a predator.

title: The Omega's Command
description: He is the only Omega in the entire military camp, crushing every Alpha with perfect scores just to join the legendary team Raven and stand beside his idol, Ares Thorn. But on the day he earns his place, the man waiting for him is not Ares. It is Logan Frost, an ace sniper and the legal husband assigned to him by the matching system, kneeling before him with roses in his hands. Before Ethan can refuse, Ares steps out from behind Logan, grips Ethan's chin in front of everyone, and says, "He is mine." His idol claims him. His husband proposes. On the same day. As the countdown to his forced match closes in and enemy fire surrounds them, Ethan realizes he never wanted only to stand beside Ares. He wants far more than that. He does not want to become anyone's Omega. He wants to become Raven.

title: A Mother’s Wait: Mom, Dad, I'm Back
description:
Fifteen years ago, Elijah Morton was separated from his mother Sabrina Lester at a fair and adopted by General Hale Gibson. After Gibson became the King, he appointed Elijah Duke of South and ordered him to build a palace in his hometown while seeking his parents. Staying at Lord Gideon Quain's estate, Elijah repeatedly missed recognizing Sabrina, who worked there as a servant. When Sabrina's house was seized for palace construction, her nephew Wyatt Morton attempted to force her out. Elijah intervened, confirming their mother-son bond through a keepsake.
Wyatt later kidnapped Elijah to curry favor with Gideon, who panicked upon discovering this and freed Elijah by revealing his status. Sabrina and her husband Alfred Morton sought help from Elijah's fiancée Camille Elwood. Camille's stepfamily framed her for theft, leading her father Larry Elwood to sentence her to marry Chester Quain. Elijah rescued Camille and punished the conspirators.
At Sabrina's estranged father Paul Lester's 70th birthday, Sabrina presented Elijah's expensive wine in plain packaging. Her jealous sisters denounced it as fake, prompting Paul to disown her. Elijah arrived with officials bearing lavish gifts, exposing the family's hypocrisy. He departed with his parents as Paul regretted his cruelty.

title: In Bed with Your Lies
description: Sara is forced to marry Noah Dempsey, the blind heir to a struggling family, in place of her stepsister Cathy. As Sara gets to know Noah, she falls in love with him, only to discover that he not only has perfectly good eyesight but also leads a significant property conglomerate. Ultimately, Noah realizes that Sara is the dream girl he's been searching for all along.

title: I Ditched Him for His Rival
description: Esther Jennings discovers her fiancé, Channing, is cheating with her stepsister, Ember, and worse, she's pregnant. Heartbroken, Esther seeks revenge by marrying the ruthless Carl Shepherd, the infamous "Devil of Riverton." In exchange for his power, she agrees to be his wife, but they vow to keep things strictly business. As Esther fights back against her betrayers, the line between pretense and real feelings blurs, and love grows in the ashes of revenge.

title: In This Life, I Choose You
description: In her past life, Mara Jones believed Evan Jacquet was her savior, so she devoted herself to him, giving him everything she could—only to be betrayed and murdered in the end. After being reborn, she wastes no time and calls her former arranged fiancé, Charles Xander, determined to change her fate. This time, she proposes to him with an irresistible deal.

title: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me S2
description: After the mysterious death of Madame Delacroix, Emily finds herself framed by her envious employers, Vivian and Dominic, who conspire to have her name removed from the will and to see her imprisoned for the crime. Detective Ramirez enters the fray, determined to uncover the truth, only to discover that Madame Delacroix died of natural causes and that Emily had nothing to do with her death. As the investigation unfolds, Dominic’s past comes back to haunt him when Detective Rodriguez begins probing into the suspicious circumstances surrounding Raphael’s disappearance, leading Dominic to go into hiding. Vindicated, Emily unexpectedly inherits Madame Delacroix’s vast wealth. Honoring a pact made with the late matriarch, she embarks on a quest to find her estranged son, Jamal. When she finally locates him, she offers him a position at the manor as a help, but Jamal initially refuses due to his pride, despite his impoverished state. He however changes his mind after hearing about the generous compensation on the table...

title: I Think My Wife Wants To Kill Me
description: When Emily, a young and unassuming secretary, is drawn into the twisted schemes of her billionaire boss Dominic, her quiet life is turned upside down. Dominic arrives at Emily's doorstep with a gunshot wound, claiming his wife Vivian tried to kill him. Desperate, he begs Emily to go undercover as a maid in his lavish penthouse to spy on Vivian, whom he suspects is cheating and plotting against him. Torn between her loyalty to Dominic and her growing unease about the situation, Emily reluctantly agrees, only to find herself plunged into a tangled web of lies, betrayal, and deadly secrets. As she begins uncovering the truth, Emily discovers Dominic's wound was self-inflicted as part of a twisted plot to frame Vivian and gain full control of the family's vast fortune. But Vivian is no helpless victim - she's a cunning and ruthless schemer in her own right, determined to protect her own interests and expose Dominic's deception. The two engage in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, each trying to outmaneuver the other while keeping their own illicit activities hidden. Caught in the middle, Emily must decide whether to expose Dominic's sinister plan or continue playing along, all while navigating her own conflicted feelings for her deeply flawed and manipulative boss. The situation spirals out of control, leading to a violent and deadly confrontation that leaves everyone's true motives and loyalties in question. Events take another tragic turn when Lady Martha is found dead in her bedroom in their family home. A detective is brought in to solve the case, and Emily is framed as the killer.

title: I Quit Deliveries, I'm Going to Be a Kingpin
description: Deliveryman Cameron gets cuckolded and humiliated by his girlfriend Chloe, then faces endless rejection on blind dates. Suddenly, CEO Valerie, Pinnacle Group heiress Madeline, and Empress of the Underworld Roxanne Vance all propose to him with luxury cars and mansions. It turns out Cameron is the long-lost son of The Apex Sovereign, leader of the Apex Group empire. When his brother Damian Hayes plots to kill Cameron's adoptive mother for the inheritance, Cameron walks away from the trillion-dollar fortune. Instead, he uses The Apex Medallion to strike back, bringing Damian to justice and finally reuniting with his birth mother.

title: It's too late. I'm dying
description: Lillian faked an affair to push Jonathan away, hiding a cancer diagnosis and the truth behind her sacrifice. A year later, Jonathan humiliates her in front of millions while Ashley keeps twisting every clue against her. As Lillian's illness can no longer be hidden, Jonathan learns the truth too late and must spend the rest of her borrowed time proving love without demanding forgiveness.

title: In This Life, I'm Trying To Save The Boss
description:
One day, the only heir of a wealthy family was murdered in his office. The victim was Ki Seungho, the president of DA Entertainment. And the suspect was his secretary, Lee Yeonwoo. The world didn't believe in her innocence, and Yeonwoo was ultimately sentenced to death.
“If only I had one more chance.”
Perhaps her desperate wish just before her death had been heard. When Yeonwoo opened her eyes again, it was a month before the incident took place. As if to warn her of the fate to come, a chilling red line remained on her neck, like a tattoo.
So Yeonwoo made a decision. This time, she would save the president and save herself. But this time, Seungho began to pay attention to her.

title: He Can Hear His Wife’s Inner Voice
description:
Adrian, trillion-dollar CEO of Sterling Group, enters a marriage of convenience with Elowen, a noble-born heiress. After the wedding, he gains a strange ability: he can hear every inner thought of his new wife.

Outwardly, she is a gentle socialite. But she is actually Elara, Elowen's twin sister. When her elder sister was injured, Elara was brought back from a welfare institute to take her place. To her, this marriage is just a deal—she wants to collect the money and run.

Amused by her wild inner monologues, Adrian glimpses her true self: a spirited, loyal girl haunted by inferiority. He falls for her. Though he has seen through the fake marriage, he protects her in secret—buying the fireworks studio she longed for and helping her chase her dream.

While Elowen keeps acting the perfect heiress, she grows entangled in the lies. Before she knows it, genuine love blooms. Yet she fears everything will crumble once her true identity is revealed. As rivals stir trouble and the twin-sister truth draws near, this marriage built on secrets faces a severe test.

When the lie comes out, their cross-class romance must stand against family schemes and past traumas—a spicy, funny sweet-romance billionaire drama.

title: I Devour All Evil Spirits
description: The Ancient God Prison has failed. Eternal night falls, and monsters born of human despair ravage the world. After witnessing his parents' murder, Cole Mitchell's fierce hatred gets him chosen as the new Chief, granting him the power to capture beasts and steal their abilities. To avenge them and hunt down killer 004, he joins the Nightpyre Bureau, fighting fire with fire in a ruthless quest to devour all anomalies.

title: My Taxi Driver Ex Is a Billionaire
description:
Ryan, the only son of the wealthy Winchester family, was willing to work as a taxi driver for five years for love, only to be repaid with betrayal by his wife Bella. In order to attach herself to Ethan, a rich young master, Bella coldly chose not to see Ryan’s grandmother one last time when the grandmother was critically ill after a car accident. The grandmother died with resentment, and before passing, mistakenly took the kind attending physician Ella for her granddaughter-in-law and entrusted the family heirloom ring to her.

Bella’s heartlessness completely woke Ryan up, and he chose to return to the family to inherit the position of president. At the grandmother’s funeral, Bella and Ethan made a high-profile appearance to compete for a ten-billion-dollar investment. When they saw clearly that the new president in the seat of honor was none other than Ryan, whom they had humiliated in every possible way, the two were instantly thunderstruck. Later, still unaware of Ryan’s true identity, they continued to humiliate him in every possible way. In the end, when Bella, filled with fantasy, tried to marry into the wealthy Winchester family, Ryan exposed her in public. After learning Ryan’s identity, Bella regretted it endlessly.

title: I Calm the Beast Tides With Spirit‑Words
description: Though blind, Lyra has an incredible gift: she can understand the language of spirit beasts. Then she starts bonding with adorable spirit pets and gathers a group of steadfast companions. Using her kindness and wit, she calms the beast tides!

title: He's Done Being Nice
description: "I'm Jason Hayes, and today, I am reborn. In my past life, I was weak. In this one, I choose to be the villain." From a humble waiter to the king of the underworld, Jason fights back against every bully and outmaneuvers the most powerful figures, including the father-in-law of a crime lord. His ironclad rule: touch what's mine, and you won't survive. Only when he stops stepping aside does Jason learn a brutal truth: the world makes way for those who refuse to move.

title: See It, Own It, Rule It
description: Ethan Drake, an overworked intern, awakens a supernatural power: x-ray vision. Overnight, his life transforms from mundane to legendary. A stunning CEO becomes his personal secretary, his long-admired campus crush falls for him, and a billionaire heiress stays faithfully by his side. When the most powerful family in the state names him their sole heir, Ethan's rise is complete—from corporate nobody to unrivaled master of treasure and desire.

title: Knight in Shining Suit
description:
After being diagnosed with terminal brain cancer, Ryder Van Woodsen brutally dumps the love of his life, Astrid Marie, so that she could find someone else to spend it with. Years later, 
not expecting to have lived as long as he has but still struggling with cancerous symptoms: he fatefully runs into Astrid again. She’s distressed and had been told her fiance cheated 
on her with her step-sister mere minutes prior running into him again. But the catch is, she doesn’t recognize him, and this time: Ryder has something to offer to her - without her 
knowing who he really is; the man who broke her heart into a million pieces, and never told her why.

title: The Wife I Despised Is My First Love?!
description: Lily, a blind girl, found her boyfriend Brian cheated on her. She accidentally slept with the richest man, Albert Morgan. After becoming pregnant, Brian forced her to demand money from Albert. Under Albert's grandmother's pressure, Albert married Lily. After marriage, Albert despised Lily while searching for his childhood savior, unaware that the true savior was his hated wife. When Lily regained her sight, another woman Gloria appeared. Gloria pretended to be Albert's childhood savior, and bullied Lily...

title: He's Done Being Nice
description: "I'm Jason Hayes, and today, I am reborn. In my past life, I was weak. In this one, I choose to be the villain." From a humble waiter to the king of the underworld, Jason fights back against every bully and outmaneuvers the most powerful figures, including the father-in-law of a crime lord. His ironclad rule: touch what's mine, and you won't survive. Only when he stops stepping aside does Jason learn a brutal truth: the world makes way for those who refuse to move.

title: Exiled to an Island, I Built an Empire
description: Exiled to a remote island with his family, nobleman Fabian turns his misfortune into an opportunity. Armed with modern knowledge, he transforms the barren island into a thriving settlement by creating fresh water, producing premium salt, developing fishing industries, and building wealth through trade and manufacturing. After forging weapons and gathering loyal followers, Fabian defends his new home against pirate Redbeard and begins his rise from disgraced exile to ruler of the seas.

title: Fake It Till You Make It
description: To get back at her cheating ex, Nancy boldly claims that the elusive big shot, Ethan, is her boyfriend, and overhears the lie. To her shock, Ethan not only plays along but also marries her to lift his ailing grandmother's spirits. They agree to part ways once she recovers, but as they live together, sparks fly, and Ethan discovers Nancy is the miracle doctor he's been searching for. What began as a lie turns into fate.

title: The Dumb Billionaire Heiress In Love Part II
description: Antonio inadvertently shoots Isabella, she is in a coma, and wakes up six months later on her bed, but she has lost her memory. Stella is now impersonating Isabella, and she is secretly stealing the family fortune under Isabella's name. Isabella eventually reaches out to an imprisoned Antonio, and Antonio points her in the direction of Detective Gonzalez because he could be a possible ally. After her conversation with Detective Gonzalez, Isabella finds out that she was never in a coma...

title: She is Mine
description: Eric Gibson has always been possessive. He is used to getting his way, so when his father marries Jenna Black, a mysteriously stunning woman with a shady past, he is captivated. What starts as admiration spirals into a dark obsession. Eric tries every charm up his sleeve to make Jenna his, but when she refuses his advances, he vows to try every other way to make her his. He manipulates situations to isolate her, planting a seed of doubt in his father thus shaking their marriage up. Eric’s love for Jenna slowly turns more deadly...

title: The Ice Hockey Star Regrets Deeply
description: I gave my virginity to save my drugged stepbrother. He married me because I was pregnant... then killed me on our wedding night. When I woke up, I was back to the night everything began. This time, I sent his beloved woman to his bed, gave up my inheritance, and fell for the man who truly loved me. But just when I stopped loving him, my stepbrother uncovered the truth. “I was wrong… Please marry me.” I smiled. “Too late. The woman who died in that fire will never love you again.”

title: The Devil in Disguise
description: When the evil cultivator Evan was cultivating with some ladies in the Immortal Realm, he fell into the mortal world and was transported to the body of a timid man with the same name. The original owner was imprisoned by his paranoid and spoiled fiancee, not allowed to leave the bedroom, and suffered humiliation. His two sisters-in-law also despised him for lacking masculinity, causing him great suffering. On the night when Evan was possessed by the evil cultivator, his spoiled fiancee came. This once timid fiance suddenly became a badass...

title: Served Time, Now I'm His Mrs. Right
description: Forced to be a “lucky bride” to wake comatose billionaire Zander Morris, Elara Switt is discarded after their one night. Years later, she returns as a nanny—only to discover her twin son being raised by her stepsister, Nelly, who now plays the doting mother and wife. Using her medical skills and relentless determination, Elara infiltrates the house, fighting to reclaim her child, expose her web of lies, and make every betrayer pay.

title: Lost In It
description: Grassroots singer Matt Lipsey lost his sight three years ago after saving his girlfriend, Sapphire Steele, from a fire. Deceived by Sapphire and his sister Ruth, he was coerced into becoming a stand-in singer for Neal Arnold, who promised to help him launch his career but ultimately betrayed him. Tragically, Matt died due to their betrayal. Reborn, Matt resolves not to be exploited again, embarking on a path of vengeance while rising to stardom.

title: The Waiter I Married is a Big Shot
description:
On the day before the wedding, I caught my fiance cheating on me. On the wedding day, I showed up, fully dressed up as a bride, but not to marry him! Instead, I flash-married a waiter! 
I am a young female CEO with a great career, how dare my fiance have been cheating on me all the time? To make him regret, I flash-married a waiter, and decided to revenge on him!
Little did I know, the man I married is a billionaire CEO! After becoming contract lovers, he kept supporting my career, and we inevitably developed feelings for each other...What should I do?

title: His Hidden Identity
description: He, a hidden tycoon controlling the national economy, marries her in secret to boost her confidence, but she divorces him before he reveals his identity...

title: The Mafia Don’s Virgin Wife
description:
Mia’s life is picture-perfect on the outside: a cooking-and-cleaning housewife. On the inside, she’s a surgeon with extreme OCD. Two years of marriage to Jimmy, and she’s still untouched—he finds her boring, stiff, and way too “proper.” Threatened with divorce to learn “bedroom skills,” Mia grabs a check and heads to a secret club, desperate for a teacher to save her marriage. She’s forced into a sexy outfit, blindfolded, and challenged to paint on her own body—a test in breaking free from her OCD shell.
Upstairs, Mafia don Nick finishes handling a traitor. In the glass elevator, he spots blindfolded Mia on stage and can’t look away. As the doors close, a spotlight drops toward her. Nick reacts instinctively, smashing through the doors, saving her, and whisking her away. And so begins a twisted, passionate game of training, desire, and forbidden romance.

title: Buried in His Lies
description: After her husband David Jones dies unexpectedly, Gina Clark finds herself fighting on all fronts: Sylvia, the pregnant mistress, demands a share of the inheritance; David's greedy family closes in; and even her own daughter, Eva, grows distant. But Gina has two powerful weapons—the gold David secretly converted, and a recording that could ruin everyone.

title: Becoming a Superstar Starts with Breakup
description: After kneeling to his ex-wife for 99 days, he is reborn with a determination to become a superstar. Facing numerous challenges and opportunities, he competes in "The Voice," writes songs live on stage, and showcases his talent at a prestigious family banquet. Along the way, his complex relationships with his ex-wife, friends, and rivals add emotional depth and tension to his journey toward stardom.

title: The Wife I Despised Is My First Love?!
description: Lily, a blind girl, found her boyfriend Brian cheated on her. She accidentally slept with the richest man, Albert Morgan. After becoming pregnant, Brian forced her to demand money from Albert. Under Albert's grandmother's pressure, Albert married Lily. After marriage, Albert despised Lily while searching for his childhood savior, unaware that the true savior was his hated wife. When Lily regained her sight, another woman Gloria appeared. Gloria pretended to be Albert's childhood savior, and bullied Lily...

title: Done Being A Fool: I Touch, I Rise
description: After ten years of being a fool, a wild night awakens Felix's Crimson Flame. Now he gets a power-up from any girl he touches, and he absorbs spiritual energy from demon corpses. He's finally strong enough to seek revenge and claim what's his. Still, with great power comes great responsibility. The clock is ticking.

title: The Alpha King and His Virgin Bride
description: The Alpha King Killian Storm is cursed to not live past age thirty. Only finding his true fated mate can break the curse, but what happens when his fated mate is a human? Humans cannot mate with Alphas. If he mates with her, she dies, but if he doesn't... he dies.

title: Stop Acting Dumb, My Billionaire Hubby
description: The father married his daughter to a silly president for money. After the president regained his memory, he found that the murderer of his parents was her father! He vented his anger on her...

title: I Seduced My Husband’s Adoptive Father
description: My husband drowned me while I was pregnant, calling me nothing more than a gold-digging maid. When I opened my eyes, I was back before the nightmare began. This time, I refused to become his mistress. Instead, I climbed into the bed of the one man he could never defeat—his billionaire adoptive father. “You're mine now,” Marcus said. I thought I was only using him for revenge... until the day my ex knelt before us in tears, and I realized I'd fallen for the only man who had ever truly protected me.

title: Don't Mess with My Sister
description:
She, a gentle and timid illegitimate daughter of a wealthy man, suffers abuse from her husband's family after marriage. When the wealthy man unexpectedly dies, she is the sole heir to his fortune. Her husband hires someone to kill her to seize the inheritance, but the hired woman looks exactly like her. After a struggle, they both pass out and their identities are mistaken.
The straightforward and tough hired woman, at the request of others, helps her reclaim the fortune. They soon discover that they are actually twin sisters. Together, they set out to uncover the truth about their parents' deaths and seek revenge on her husband's family.

title: Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire
description: Small-town girl Emily moves to the city to collect a debt from her ex, Kevin, hoping to pay off her mother’s medical bills. But she discovers Kevin is now a sugar baby living off of wealthy woman, Rose, and together they humiliate her. Just as Emily hits rock bottom, she stumbles across Lucas. Through an unexpected misunderstanding, Emily becomes the contract wife of a CEO.

title: My Past Life is a Divine King
description: A high school loser just remembered he used to rule the universe. There's one problem: he's currently powerless, broke, and every time he tries to cast a spell, people film him for acting like a weirdo. But when he starts hot-wiring modern tech—using a smartwatch to track his "mana," buying herbs on the Internet for forbidden pills—he realizes the ancient way might just need a modern upgrade.

title: The Fallen God & His Mute Muse
description: Levi Tran, an immortal, is reborn to escape a massive debt. He awakens in a gambler's body, only to find his mute wife's voice stolen. Now, will he be able to give the woman her voice back with his mortal body?

title: Kill Me? I Have Too Many Identities to Kill
description: Just as Julian was about to die, he awakened the Background Editing System. If you want a new identity, just edit it. Duke Silas wanted to kill me? I'd edit my identity to be the Crown Prince! The Flora Sect misunderstood me? I'd edit my identity to be their Saintess's crush. No matter how many tricks you have, my new identities could deal with everything. I'm always the winner!

title: Bride of Vengeance
description: Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings. The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.

title: Simmering Love
description: She is the true heiress as well as an adopted daughter in two families. But her biological parents favor the adopted daughter, her foster mother constantly challenges her, and even her own little brother sees her as an enemy. Bound by a marriage contract, she weds the business mogul Jamie. Luckily, there's one man who stands as her protector, shielding her from the storm.

title: Rise of the Heiress with X-Ray Vision
description: The orphan Nina's family raised became the man who drove her to the edge. He took her home, her fortune, and almost her life. But X-ray Vision has given her a second chance. Now she sees the truth, the treasure, and the path to justice. And she's walking it on her own.

title: Titanic Love After Rebirth
description: She died in the year he loved her most. With a billion-dollar fortune, he threw it all away, choosing to follow her in death. When she opens her eyes again, she’s back to the years when she despised him. With a bitter smile, he says, “Want a divorce? Over my dead body.”

title: Bride of Vengeance
description: Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings. The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.

title: Poison in the Honey
description: Betrayed by the very father who doted on her, Nora Graham discovers his affection was a cruel lie to elevate her half-sister. After his ultimate betrayal leads to her family's ruin, death grants her a second chance. Reborn with hardened resolve, Nora returns to the glittering, cutthroat world of the Graham mansion. No longer the naive heiress, she plays the part of the dutiful daughter while quietly dismantling the conspiracy from within.

title: Love That Saved Me
description: Marina Sinclair is unloved by her family. Framed by her sister and thrown into jail, she's shamed by her father, cursed by her mother, and blamed by her brother. After cutting ties for good, she unexpectedly becomes the cherished obsession of Damien Yates, the untouchable "Golden Scion" of the city. Only then does she realize: Damien has always been the light in her darkest days — silently guarding, healing, and loving her. To him, she's always been exclusive.

title: I'm Really Not an Immortal
description: "I shouldn't have ever saved you and brought you up this mountain!" My teacher scolded me for ruining his precious ingredients to make the divine medicine, but later was surprised at the outcome, that I successfully made it out! I am an orphan, study divine skilled with my teacher, and now come down the mountain to gain experiences. On the first day, I meet a girl, and saved her fatehr's life. Little did I know, they are my lost family, and little did they know, I'm a powerful figure with strong ability!

title: Reborn to Marry the Infertile Emperor
description: In her past life, Gloria was married off to the ruthless crown prince by decree, only to be killed after three childless years. Given a second chance, Gloria decides to wed the infertile emperor instead. Now, she's pregnant. Guess who's the true phoenix?

title: Titanic Love After Rebirth
description: She died in the year he loved her most. With a billion-dollar fortune, he threw it all away, choosing to follow her in death. When she opens her eyes again, she’s back to the years when she despised him. With a bitter smile, he says, “Want a divorce? Over my dead body.”

title: One Night Stand... To Forever
description: Forensic expert Vivian Smith, shamed for her job, accidentally sleeps with tycoon Ethan Parker—her ex’s uncle. A contractual marriage sparks chaos: their "stench solidarity" masks lethal secrets. As family feuds, conspiracies, and desire collide, they fight prejudice and lies, healing each other’s wounds. Can love survive autopsy tables and boardrooms?

title: Stop Reading My Mind, Villain Heirs
description: Gigi, a modern girl, is transported into a cultivation novel and rescued by Joshua Quinn, who can somehow hear her inner thoughts. Knowing the future, she realizes the five Quinn brothers, feared as future villains, are all destined for tragic deaths. Determined to change their fate, Gigi helps them escape one disaster after another and becomes the family's most treasured member. Together, they battle the scheming Bell family and the Demon Lord to rewrite destiny and save the cultivation world.

title: She Writes Her Own Crown
description: Rosalind Lawson died betrayed by her husband, William Sloan. Reborn as the true heir of Prince Jason, she returns with a healer’s hands and a vengeful heart. Now, with Commander Damian Shaw at her side, she will reclaim her title, her fortune, and her future—no matter the cost.

title: He Loved Her Sister First
description: Sadie has always been a good girl, but she falls for Ethan, her sister's rival. To please him, they indulge in many secret, scandalous encounters. After a passionate camping trip, Sadie discovers the shocking truth: Ethan's love was a revenge scheme against her sister. Sadie is heartbroken and makes the painful decision to walk away.

title: Knocked Up by the Wolf Duke
description: Shivon has spent her life dreaming of escaping her cruel family and earning a place at the Royal Academy. But after one reckless night with the mysterious Duke Alaric Blackmoor, she discovers she’s carrying the one thing everyone believed impossible—his child. Alaric was thought incapable of producing an heir, because a wolf can only conceive with his fated mate. Now, as Shivon’s family tries to sell her to the ruthless Lord Greyfang, Alaric will stop at nothing to find the woman who may be his one true mate—and protect the impossible heir growing inside her.

title: KO, The MVP Heiress is Back
description: Reborn after her family’s betrayal, Claire refuses to sacrifice herself for Violet again. With Adrian’s support, she exposes Violet’s schemes and pursues her esports dream. Despite her brothers’ remorse, Claire chooses freedom and a new life.

title: Salt Kiss
description: Based on the novel by Sierra Simone. Ex-soldier Tristan becomes bodyguard to his uncle-in-law, a magnetic billionaire who runs an exclusive sex club. Despite his best efforts to stay professional, Tristan's drawn to his boss’s dominance, breaking down his defenses until he finally submits. Under Mark’s seduction, Tristan is pulled into a world of pain and pleasure he never imagined. But his lust for Mark unravels when he’s sent to retrieve Mark’s fiancée… and falls for her too.

title: The Poker King Returns
description: Karter, the legendary Poker King lost everything when he reported Aaron for money laundering 3 years ago. He was rescued by Elena, the daughter of a small casino's owner. When Aaron returns to put Elena and the casino in danger, Karter gives up his disguise as a humble waiter, and reveals his true identity.

title: Kill Me I'll Take the Throne
description: Aurelius had just transmigrated into the eldest prince of the Great Hua Dynasty, who had been guarding the frontier for five years, when he received an imperial decree ordering his execution. "What? I command six hundred thousand troops, and you want me dead?" Aurelius fought his way back to the capital, slew the treacherous rebels, and seized the throne—only to discover at the very last moment that it was all a trial orchestrated by Emperor Zenith himself.

title: Five Keys, One Hidden King
description: Grayson, hidden ruler of the Five Nation Syndicate, poses as a gardener. His wife Vanessa leaves him for being poor and falls for Ivan — his most dangerous subordinate plotting to seize the vault. Grayson infiltrates his own summit, proving his identity through golden keys and escalating confrontations. Outgunned, he flees with waitress Sarah and discovers she, not Vanessa, once saved his life. He turns Ivan's heist into a trap, ambushes the traitors in the vault, and crowns Sarah as queen.

title: Don’t Provoke Him，He’s the King of L.A
description:
After losing his eldest son Ethan to murder, billionaire Kane Morgan retreated from the spotlight and became a ride-hail driver to quietly watch over his younger son Liam.

At a welcome party, Liam is humiliated by Damian—and discovers his late brother's fiancée is having an affair with him. Then Liam is kidnapped and learns Ethan was tortured to death by Damian.

Just as Damian sets up a cruel game to torment Liam, Kane smashes through the door. His old subordinate Victor arrives and bows in submission. The kidnappers realize the taxi driver was a top-tier capital magnate all along.

Kane declares revenge, returns to Vertex Capital, and launches an all-out assault on the O'Hara empire. Victor punishes his own son Taylor. Vanessa's repentance is too late.

After these trials, Liam reconciles with his father. Together they run the conglomerate. Liam and Aurora fall deeply in love. The O'Hara Group collapses completely.

title: Kitty Kills
description: While investigating the brutal murder of her parents, a young woman is kidnapped, raped, and left for dead. On All Hallows Eve, she comes back dressed as a blood-thirsty pussycat keen on taking the souls of the men who destroyed her world.

title: Knock
description: What would you do if you heard a strange sound while gaming? Would you investigate?*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: The Knockout King
description: Jax Carter, the bastard son of a disgraced housekeeper and a fight gym patriarch, secretly trains under three outlaw coaches. When he's entered into The Crucible, an elite, once-in-a-generation MMA proving ground, he must carry the weight of betrayal, shame, and thousands of pounds of hidden resistance training. As rivals rise and family tries to crush him, Jax must prove once and for all: he wasn’t born to break... he was built to fight.

title: KEMBALINYA SANG EKSEKUTOR
description:
After the shocking car explosion that seemingly killed Har Deniro, his once power full empire falls into the hands of Rina, his former assistant with a deep rooted vendetta. consumed by resentment, Rina torments Lana, Har's gentle wife, as she consulidates her newfound power.
Unbeknownst to all, Har survives the blast. concealing his true identity, hi witnesses his wife's suffering and the treachery of his closest allies, including the wavering loyalty of Reno.  As har unravels the conspiracy that destroyed his life, he is forced into a psychological duel with Rina one that exposes long buried secrets tying Lana,Rina,and Rina' father (Toni) together.

the story bulids toward a devastating climax: will Har exact merciless revenge, or will her 
chooise forgiveness to end a legacy of hatred that has consumed them all?*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man
description: Cain Hunter, heir to the almighty Godfather, is back! He'll fight past mind-controlling schemers and threats haunting the shadows, whatever it takes to pass the ten trials his grandfather has set for him. But what if it all comes at a cost? What if it means losing the love of his life, Annalise?

title: W・KING
description: Reborn with a chance at retribution, Sun vows revenge—but the threads of fate binding him to Liu Che refuse to sever. Amidst ruthless power struggles and shadowy conspiracies, they manipulate each other even as they burn with irresistible attraction. In a tempest of love and hatred, they rage against destiny’s grip, only to find themselves inexorably drawn back to the bond they cannot escape...

title: You Kicked the Wrong Woman
description: After ten years abroad, Eleanor Vance returns home and happens to save a kid from her son’s fiancée, Tara Reed. Beaten, disfigured, and robbed of her most treasured heirloom, Eleanor hides her scars—and her true power. Playing the meek mother-in-law, she gathers evidence of Tara’s corruption and cruelty. At the family banquet, just as Tara celebrates her upcoming wedding to William Shawn, Eleanor reveals herself as the new CEO of Shawn Group. One by one, she tears down the liar’s empire.

title: The Lucky Koi Girl
description: Born poor, Sansa Miller tends to her sick mother and disabled father. As a living lucky charm, she brings bullies karmic payback and rewards kindness, inspiring good. She forgives cruel neighbors, making them repent. She befriends a vendor who once stole her stall. Then a crisis hits. And her estranged grandpa finally sees her pure heart. Filled with regret, he makes amends and reunites the family.

title: Back to the Ring: My KO Mom
description: The boxing queen, Tanya Boyle, retires at the peak of her career for love. Unknown to all, Tanya marries Wesley Thomas and devotes herself to looking after the family. Unfortunately, she gets stomach cancer. So, Wesley’s mother introduces a lady to Wesley. Tanya is heartbroken but offers her blessings. After being reborn, Tanya cherishes her health and fights for happiness. But she ends up divorcing Wesley. Then, Tanya rebuilds her life and returns to boxing. At this time, she discovers Wesley’s new girlfriend, Yolanda Lopez, is lying about being the boxing queen. So, Tanya decides to regain her glory. Wesley looks down upon Tanya when fighting her. He even persuades her to quit the game. However, Tanya ignores Wesley and defeats him. Wesley is shocked, and everyone finds out Tanya is the boxing queen. Wesley regrets losing his idol. But Tanya has changed a lot. She only wants to live her life.

title: I Liked Our Breakup Post
description: After ten years with her childhood love Adrian, Evelyn is repeatedly blamed and humiliated because of Sienna's schemes. Adrian keeps threatening to break up with her through posts saying "100 likes and we’re done." This time, Evelyn gives the post its 100th like and leaves for Stanford. When Adrian finally sees the truth and begs for another chance, Evelyn has already chosen her own future.

title: Little Cupid's Knock: Love Marked by Fate
description: Five years ago, they had a one-night stand at a hotel and ended up having four children. Now, five years later, she returns with her four kids. Meanwhile, he, marked by her all those years ago, has been searching for her. Fate has brought them back together.

title: The Cursed Alpha's Mate
description:
The Cursed Alpha’s Mate is based on the novel by Cricket Colson, published by Tapas Entertainment and Radish.
Shay Santos is finally ready to lose her virginity, but when she tries to surprise her boyfriend, she finds him cheating on her instead! Heartbroken, she goes out with her BFF and vows to sleep with the first guy who approaches her… Who happens to be powerful Alpha Mal Haywood. Their attraction is instant, animal, and for a human and a werewolf… Forbidden. But that’s not the only problem: Mal’s been cursed, and if doesn’t mark Shay as his mate and impregnate her with his pup, he’ll die!

title: I Can Summon Monkey King?!
description: Dante time-traveled to the Soul Control World. After three years of continuous failure, the school beauty left him. However, she didn't know that although Dante couldn't connect with the common Soul Galaxy, he could connect with the Mythical Soul Galaxy! He could bind with the Monkey King, Nezha, and God Erlang!

title: Awakened As King
description: In a world where every adult awakens a profession, their profession decides their fate. But time-traveler Allen Stuart is reborn into privilege. His father, a top mythic human powerhouse, made him heir to one of eight great cities. As others fought to change their fates, Allen awakens something the world has never seen before: King!

title: I Became the CEO's Most Beloved
description: Erin Vance’s 18th wedding anniversary turns into a nightmare when she discovers her husband Derek cheating with her best friend Sofia. Betrayed and abandoned, Erin is forced to start over with nothing. With help from Gavin Bower, she enters the “Miss Intercontinental” contest and rises from a housewife to a champion through her talent and determination. Defeating Sofia and exposing her scandals, Erin rebuilds her life. Gavin, secretly the president of K Group, supports her while letting her prove herself. After overcoming betrayal and danger, Erin regains her dignity and begins a new chapter with Gavin.

title: Fate Beneath Your Tender Torture
description: By day, Caroline is an icy corporate executive; by night, she masks up in leather and slips into an underground club, hunting the man responsible for her miscarriage. There, a mysterious younger aristocrat draws out desires she’s long buried— only to reappear days later as a new “intern” at her company. Is he an ally… or her next threat?

title: Tenth Wedding, New Groom
description: Abandoned at her tenth wedding—and insultingly replaced by a K-9 dog—Brigid Hayes marries powerful billionaire Marco Romano on the spot. Ignorant of her new status, her toxic ex-fiancé and his scheming assistant physically attack and frame her. Marco swiftly retaliates, uncovering their official corruption and bringing them to complete public and legal ruin. As her tormentors crumble, Brigid discovers Marco's devotion stems from a deep, shared past.

title: After I Took Back My Love
description: After a painful rebirth, Eleanor, once a devoted wife and mother, finds her family's affection reserved for Lydia, her husband William's true love. Betrayed by William's bigamy and her children's cruelty, she abandons them, secretly applying to Harvard. As she builds a new life in science, William and the children, now suffering under Lydia's abuse, realize their loss. They beg for forgiveness, but Eleanor, hardened by their betrayal, coldly rejects them. Choosing her own path, she leaves them behind to embrace a future of independence and self-worth.

title: Stableboy
description:
Openly gay city kid Evan Brooks is sent to a Midwest ranch with one condition: compete on the high school rodeo team or lose his dream of culinary school in Paris.
His biggest obstacle? Team captain Colt Maddox — the straight, golden-boy cowboy whose shot at going pro depends on winning State.
After Evan is forced to be Colt's stableboy, their rivalry turns into something neither of them expected. In a town where being gay is more dangerous than bull riding, falling in love could cost them everything.

title: The Queen Bee Strikes Back
description: Bella, heir to the wealthy Walton family, is tired of being surrounded by calculating rich kids. She falls for Marc, a plus-size guy who seems to love her for who she is, hiding her identity and even helping him get recruited to Harvard’s football team. But betrayal hits hard, Bella discovers Marc has been cheating on her with her classmate - and bully - Jessie, who constantly mocks Bella’s body. Even worse, Marc has stolen her identity, claiming he is the Walton heir to win clout and rise to the top of Western High’s social scene. Bella dumps him, has a stunning glow-up, and embraces her curves. When they mock her college future… could Bella’s next move leave them speechless?

title: The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back
description: In a previous life, heiress Emily was a genius in the hacker field. In a global competition, fake heiress Olivia accuses Emily of plagiarism, which totally destroys her reputation. Her family believes these false accusations and kicks Emily out of the house. In the end, she’s killed by fake heiress Olivia. In her second life, not only does Emily cut off her ties with her blind to the truth family, but she also gives Fake Heiress Olivia who was falsely accusing her of plagiarism a slap in the face.

title: Step Aside, I'm the King of Capital
description: For six years abroad, Cassius builds the world’s top financial empire, the Enros Group, under the name “Mr. S,” even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend Isabella, she dumps him, chasing wealth and claiming only the mysterious Mr. S is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor lands Cassius in a sudden marriage to Freya, the beautiful CEO of Mirror Media. At Isabella’s inauguration party, she tries to kick Cassius out again and again, never guessing who he really is—until Cassius finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.

title: I'm Done Being a Yes-Man
description: Enzo is the mysterious heir to the Quinn Corporation. He comes from a prominent family and has an extraordinary talent for football. He is infatuated with the daughter of his family's chauffeur, Stella Hall. One night, Stella gets into an accident from drunk driving, but she convinces Enzo to take the blame for her. Worried that her secret will eventually get out, Stella scams Enzo out of all his savings and hires a killer to murder Enzo. However, just as Enzo is about to die, a mysterious power sends him one month back into the past. Now that Enzo knows Stella's real personality, he's no longer in love with her. Enzo resolves to leave behind his "simp" image and make sure Stella gets what she deserves.

title: Ace! The Golf King's Reconquest
description:
"Lion" was once the Grand Slam champion that ruled the world of golf. Devastated by the loss of his wife, he disappears to take care of their baby daughter at the peak of his career, leaving behind his insurmountable legacy. 
Hiding away as a gardener, "Lion" pulls weeds and mows the lawn at a golf club to make a living. Desperate to give his daughter a better life and pay for her tuition, "Lion" steps back on the golf course to reclaim his former glory! The roar of the mighty "Lion" will be heard around the world!

title: Her Desired Alphas
description: Marabella's dark powers made her the target of her pack after she accidentally killed Kyan's father. No one understands her except for Jonah, her boyfriend and the future Alpha. When the Moon Goddess pairs her with Kyan instead, her only hope shatters, Will this mate bond turn out to be a blessing, or another curse?

title: Poolboy
description: When high school swim team captain Aidan Crew loses his essential after-school job due to his rich bully Will Harrison standing up for him to his boss, he has no idea how he's going to pay his mother's substantial medical bills and rebuild his college fund, until Will offers Aidan a humiliating, but lucrative job as his pool boy. Aidan reluctantly takes the gig and the two start to fall for one another, but they must navigate the hatred between their families and vicious school bullies, while protecting the secret of Aidan's pool boy gig and the feelings building between them.

title: Awakened As King
description: In a world where every adult awakens a profession, their profession decides their fate. But time-traveler Allen Stuart is reborn into privilege. His father, a top mythic human powerhouse, made him heir to one of eight great cities. As others fought to change their fates, Allen awakens something the world has never seen before: King!

title: DILFS
description: After moving to a new city, events out of Jordan’s control force her and her daughter to stay with three sexy single dads: Mason, who is gruff and bristly with a tragic past; Landon, the bad boy charmer; and Eli, your ice king boss. But after a night of passion with all three of them, Jordan finds herself pregnant. Which DILF is the father?

title: 90 Seconds: The Knock
description: Left home alone, Chloe and Rowan think it's just another quiet night. But one knock at the door changes everything...all in 90 seconds. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Water Broke, Heart Broke
description: Nine months pregnant, Kyra's water broke, and her husband took her hospital bag for another woman. He locked her in, cut the phone, sealed the door, and watched her bleed through a camera. He said she was "making a scene." She lost everything that night, except the will to stand. What he stole wasn't just a bag. It was her last reason to forgive. Now she wants no apology. Only the truth, the divorce, and a life he can never touch again.

title: The Dark Knight's Secret Vow
description: An adaptation of Double life of my billionaire husband. To save her mother, Lady Natalie must marry the kingdoms most despised man: The Dark Knight. She believes she is bound to a traitor, but he is secretly a powerful heir plotting his revenge, and their marriage is the final piece of his dangerous game. When she discovers she is just a pawn, will she become his queen or his downfall?*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: LION KING
description: Introducing Chinese customary lion dance culture and folk lion dance competitions.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: My Scar, His Debt to Pay
description: Rachel and Ethan were trapped in a war zone. While trying to save Ethan, Rachel was left with a disfiguring scar on her face. They fell in love and got married, but there was only one evacuation spot. Rachel gave it to the injured Ethan, and Ethan promised he would come back for her—unaware that Rachel later discovered she was pregnant. Six years later, Rachel returns to the country to save her daughter, Sophie, only to find that Ethan had already married the hospital director’s daughter and started a new family after his return. To protect his reputation and status, Ethan even slandered Rachel and Sophie. At this critical moment, Rachel’s long-lost father finds her and reveals that she is actually the daughter of the chairman of the Harrington Medical Group. In the end, the scumbag doctor loses everything and suffers the consequences of his own actions, while Rachel goes on to live a happy life with her daughter.

title: Her Final Bet
description: Scarlett Spades, a seemingly ordinary housewife, is secretly the last heir of the murdered Gambling King, forced into hiding since her family was wiped out. When her devoted husband is framed by a rigged casino and driven to the edge, Scarlett is dragged back into the underworld she swore to abandon. Playing the naïve "lucky girl", she seduces cheaters into arrogance and destroys them with impossible wins—until her revenge awakens the true mastermind behind her parents' deaths, and one final bet demands blood, love, even her life...

title: Double Life of My Military Man
description: When a small-town doctor unexpectedly crosses paths with a sexy, mysterious soldier, sparks fly. But as their relationship blooms, both are forced to keep the real reasons for their whirlwind romance and the truth behind their identities a secret. He's a special forces ace and secret billionaire. She's a special ops agent undercover. Both operatives have a single mission--to investigate and ultimately eliminate one another.  Will they risk sacrificing everything for loyalty or love?

title: Never Underestimate Girl Math
description: Zosha is a poor orphan who gets bullied by all the rich Ivy League kids for working on a farm. But Zosha's about to beat them all at the one thing they least expect: math.

title: The Lost Prince Strikes Back
description: In the year 4026, planet K-28 invades Earth, pushing humanity to the brink of extinction. Prince Zayne Voss of Earth crashes his fighter jet into the enemy's core space station, sacrificing himself for victory. He falls into a coma and is rescued by his girlfriend, Lia, who didn't know his royal identity. Zayne awakens at the exact moment Lia is being humiliated. He reclaims his status as Prince to punish everyone who wronged Lia and her family. Then Zayne formally proposes to Lia. They hold a wedding. Despite facing insults from Lia's relatives, Zayne stands up for his bride.

title: A Duke's Daughter Strikes Back
description: I am the eldest daughter of the Duke of Anjou. Six years ago, I eloped to a farmstead with Julian, a penniless knight. I cut the umbilical cord with my own hands and gave birth to our daughter, trading everything for the vow he sealed with a copper ring. When we met again, he had been ennobled as a count. With his arm around the waist of his widowed sister-in-law, Cecilia, he kicked away the hand I stretched out, begging him to save our daughter. "Drag this madwoman and that little bastard out. Beat them to death." Poisoned blood spilled across the carpet as Adele and I closed our eyes, dying with hatred in our hearts. When I opened them again, I had returned to the day he received his title. I sold the farmstead and went back to my father, kneeling before him to admit my mistake. Rumors spread through every street of the royal capital. That night, his captain of the guard set fire to the empty farmstead. What he did not know was this: the moment he sent men to silence me, the crimes of bigamy and murdering his wife had already been sealed in the Church's records.

title: Never Look Back
description: After saving Zach's life, Malese Accola marries him, only to suffer four years of neglect. Zach's heart belongs to his childhood sweetheart, Kayla, who torments Malese with impunity. Kayla steals her work, then causes her miscarriage, and Zach enables it all. Devastated, Malese divorces him and flees abroad to chase her art dreams. Her absence finally opens Zach's eyes to his true love and Kayla's venom. He chases her across the globe, but she won't look back. Meanwhile, powerful CEO Joseph Cohan, Malese's secret admirer, gives her the love she deserves...

title: My Enemy Alpha
description: When you're forced to wed the dark and dangerous Alpha Ronan — your mortal enemy — you're sure you'll kill each other before you make it to the altar. But when a common enemy threatens to destroy your pack, will you accept that you are fated to one another? Or reap deadly consequences?

title: The Duke's Daughter Strikes Back
description: Beatrice Ashcroft, daughter of a duke, was betrayed by her husband Jasper — who faked his own death and left her to rot. She died with nothing but hatred in her heart. Then she opened her eyes. Back to the day before it all began. This time, she knows every lie, every scheme, every face behind the masks. And she knows exactly how to destroy them all. But revenge is a lonely road — until she meets Nicholas, a mysterious commander with secrets of his own. He is not what he seems. He is the emperor, traveling in disguise. And he is about to become her most powerful weapon...

title: Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage
description:
Iris and Benjamin were once the ultimate power couple—total relationship goals for everyone, and loaded to boot. They went from college sweethearts straight to tying the knot, and he even gave her a kidney to save her life, swearing he’d love her forever. But by their third year of marriage? Benjamin was hooking up with his mistress out in the open, no shame at all.

Crushed and done with his nonsense, Iris set a "15-day countdown" and quietly planned her divorce and escape. But his pathetic lies and the mistress’s bold-faced disrespect pushed her over the edge—she lost the baby. Completely broken, she finally took off, all by herself.

Benjamin had no clue how much he’d hurt her until she was gone. That’s when his brutal "redemption tour" started—you know, when someone messes up bad and then begs for forgiveness, but it’s already too late. He offered a reward worldwide to find her, but Iris outsmarted him at every turn. His career and reputation? Gone in a flash.

Even after he dumped the mistress, got on his knees to beg for mercy, and took a knife for Iris (ending up seriously hurt), he couldn’t melt her cold heart. In the end, he just had to watch—lonely and full of regret—as she built a new, happy life. And that’s when he finally got it: "Belated love ain’t worth squat"—affection that shows up too late? It’s totally useless.

title: Succession: Beauty and the Billionaire
description: Grace Esther's life falls apart when her mother kicks her out after discovering she's not her real daughter, and her boyfriend also leaves her for her step-sister. Fortunately, an old family friend takes her in. There, she meets his attractive CEO grandson, Aden, who gives her a job as his assistant, and they soon develop a romantic connection. What she doesn't know is that her real father has finally heard about her and is desperate to find her...

title: Ms. Detective and Mr. Thief
description: After 15 years, sparks fly when Isabel and Ari reunite and become passionate lovers. She's a police detective trying to make her career by catching a mysterious master thief. As Ari helps her investigation and their affair gets steamier, will she realize that her lover is the criminal she's hunting?

title: Back to Reckoning
description: After ten years in prison for avenging his foster parents, Victor Warren returns to find the Titan Group still ruling the city—and now they're targeting his sister. Armed with skills forged behind bars and a burning need for justice, Victor wages a one-man war to dismantle the empire and unearth the dark secrets buried a decade ago.

title: I Took It All Back
description: During seven years of marriage to Ethan Grant, Vivian Whitmore has endured endless neglect as her husband openly favors his "dream girl", Angela. On their child's full-month celebration, Vivian reaches her breaking point. She announces divorce before all the guests, reveals the baby isn't Ethan's, and pulls her investments—plunging the Grant empire into chaos. The truth exposed and her revenge served, Vivian walks away with her child, leaving Ethan drowning in regret he can never undo.

title: The Next ReelStar
description: The Next ReelStar is a reality competition series where men representing states across the country compete for a breakout lead role at ReelShort, with fans having the power to decide the winner. Under the mentorship of judges Jesse Morales and Nicole Mattox, contestants join Team Jesse or Team Nicole, each striving to develop their star quality. Through a series of high-stakes challenges, they’ll showcase their talent to impress a powerhouse panel of vertical industry professionals. For the first time in a vertical unscripted series, fans will have the power to vote in the finale, deciding which finalist is crowned The Next ReelStar.

title: Forced to Marry the CEO I Saved
description: Lawrence descends the mountains to find his childhood friend, the "chubby girl." After rescuing Yvette from an assassination attempt, he is forced into a sudden marriage. Posing as a security guard, he protects the Feng family and confronts villains like Mr. K and the Evil God. Discovering that the Evil God is the one who killed his father and burned the orphanage, Lawrence awakens his family’s blade technique to exact revenge, ultimately confirming that Yvette is indeed his long-lost "chubby girl."

title: What?! You're in My Body!
description: In a freak accident, undercover agent Lena Shane and gang leader Ryan Wayne switch bodies. She is forced to play the ruthless gangster in his body, while he secretly uses her body to go undercover. From hating each other's guts to cracking a case together, they uncover a drug conspiracy and the truth behind his father’s death. Meanwhile, a sweet romance develops between them.

title: Hook, Line & Sinker
description: Cesar knows Jane is bait that's sent to ruin him, yet he steps into her trap anyway. He teaches her seduction and control, only to fall first. They never say "I love you," only "We're accomplices." She came for revenge, and he made it an obsession. In a game of desire and deception, the trap snaps shut on them both. Tuition for his lesson? Her lifetime.

title: The Prank That Broke Us
description: High school star student Eleanor Vance has been best friends with Leo Carter for 16 years, until he knocks her out and ties her to a goalpost as a “prank” to impress the popular girl Savannah. Humiliated in front of the whole school, Ellie transfers to California without a word. There, she finds real friends, academic success, and a caring new boyfriend. Meanwhile, Leo loses his mind with regret, but Ellie has learned that some betrayals can never be forgiven.

title: ReelTalk EP 77-Love Whisper
description:
Four breakout stars from ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series come together for an intimate Pride Month special short video, sharing their most genuine crush confessions through cinematic monologues inspired by real emotions, memories, and love stories.
Set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, Crush Confessions captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.

title: My One-Night Lover Is My Contract Husband
description: My parents set me up with a contract marriage, and I heard my “future husband” is a total disaster. To escape, I ended up spending the night with a male model. Turns out, he’s actually my husband…

title: Tailor Wife & Her Protective Boss
description: Reincarnated back to 1995, Wendy marries the aloof Charles Gould, heir to the Gould Garment Factory, to avoid a tragic fate orchestrated by her cousin Rachel. Unbeknownst to her, Charles has secretly loved her for years. Their relationship humorously transitions from a contractual agreement to a genuine commitment. As Wendy starts her own clothing business, Charles quietly supports her ambitions. Together, they navigate family conflicts and corporate rivalries, ultimately leading GGF to a successful IPO and crafting their own tale of romance and entrepreneurial success.

title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village
description: In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.

title: Danger & Desire
