description: Elite operative Henry is assigned as the personal bodyguard to Paige, a cold-blooded CEO at the center of corporate warfare. As assassination attempts and boardroom traps collide, Henry’s battlefield instincts and business savvy become her strongest shield. What begins as protection turns into an alliance, as the two join forces to dismantle a powerful enemy plotting their downfall.

title: Little Lucky Dragon: Nova
description: A three-and-a-half-year-old girl was forced to tell fortunes on a city overpass to earn money for her abusive uncle and aunt, who beat her mercilessly and nearly sold her to human traffickers. At the critical moment, her young uncle—a professional race car driver—swooped in to rescue her. From that moment on, her four extraordinarily accomplished uncles launched a full-scale campaign to pamper their niece and exact revenge. The youngest uncle vowed to make the villains "pay tenfold"; the third uncle, a triple-crown-winning actor, began leveraging his massive fanbase to expose their crimes; the second uncle, a scientific genius, plotted to make their lives "a living hell"; while the eldest uncle, a ruthless tycoon, threatened to ship them off to Africa to mine coal. When the girl finally returned home, her grandfather wept joyful tears, her grandmother miraculously recovered from a chronic illness, her cousins beamed with pride, and her enigmatic clan-leader father proceeded to spoil her beyond imagination.

title: Rising After Divorce
description:
Facing my troublesome family members again and again, I can't take it anymore!  Many years ago, I had a one-night stand with a woman who disappeared after giving birth to our child. I hide my identity as the Dragon Master, making a living as a taxi driver and raising my daughter alone, yet people look down on me.
Now, I've reunited with a woman who seems to be that one-night stand of mine. This time, I will reveal my true identity and reclaim everything that belongs to me!

title: NO NO YES
description: It's time for a change.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: The Queen is No Longer Silent
description: For six years, Ivy Grant hid behind the name Ivy West, pouring her trust fund into her husband Noah’s hotel empire while enduring his neglect, his mother Margaret’s cruelty, and the return of his first love, Vivian. When Ivy is publicly humiliated at a livestreamed banquet and later loses an unborn child, she finally stops staying silent. Returning as the true Grant heiress, she exposes the West family’s debts, Vivian’s schemes, and the poison hidden behind years of “family” humiliation. With her son Mason beside her and the Grant family behind her, Ivy reclaims her identity, destroys the people who stole her body, her child, and her name, and becomes the only protagonist of her own ending.

title: Her Name Is Not Pawn
description: Grace Lawson is a rising star at Breeze Air—brilliant, respected, and utterly alone. Starved for love after a lifetime of neglect, she falls hard for David Collins's whirlwind romance. Yet his passion isn't for her. It's for her connections, her status, and her usefulness. Today, they're getting married.

title: My One-Night Stand Made an Heir?
description: Seven years after a chaotic one-night stand, Thea's son, Sean, accidentally reunites with his biological father, a man with a powerful diviner lineage, Everett. A DNA test exposes everything, pulling the powerful Hopper family into a frantic search for their lost heir. Thea becomes Everett's assistant. Sparks fly, misunderstandings explode, and love nearly collapses until the truth forces them all back together.

title: Daddy, She’s Not Nanny, She’s Our Mommy!
description: Abigail Thorne was set up by her sister and forced to marry Roderic Graham. On their wedding night, Abigail accidentally crippled her husband and was expelled from that family. Five years later, she is back—a miracle doctor with five clever children. Roderic Graham, the man who rejected her, is irresistibly drawn to her and her children, unaware that they are the family he has been searching for.

title: Loving You in the Wrong Name
description: After a childhood accident separated Christian Douglas and Lily Rivers, he spent 20 years looking for her. Which is also why he relentlessly trashes his in-name-only wife, Joyce. But just as he pushes her to the edge, he discovers she is actually his long-lost love!

title: One Night Stand
description: In the heart of a bustling city, we meet Emily, a dedicated and hardworking office assistant striving for a better life. When a passionate one-night stand with her charismatic boss, Richard, leads to an unexpected pregnancy, her world takes an unexpected turn...

title: The IT King's One-Night Stand
description: Joining Jaslynn's company as a top tech expert after their one-night stand, Yevander helps her win a corporate battle!

title: The Nanny: A Crow in Swan's Feathers
description: Busy CEO Chloe Mitchell hires nanny Peggy Barnes for her daughter Ruby, unaware that Peggy and her husband David Foster are having an affair. The cruel pair abuse Ruby and plot to frame Chloe so she will leave with nothing. Chloe fights back with hidden cameras, exposing their crimes at her mother-in-law's birthday gala. Ultimately, David, Peggy, and cousin Frank Miller are jailed for kidnapping and abuse. Chloe then quits her job to help Ruby heal from Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.

title: I Married a Secret Billionaire
description: After catching her boyfriend cheating with his boss, Sydney is devastated. Drunk and heartbroken, she accidentally runs into Evan, Riverton's richest man, outside a bar. The two had briefly met in prison six months earlier. On impulse, Sydney proposes a flash marriage, and Evan surprisingly agrees. After the wedding, her life suddenly turns around, leaving her cheating ex furious, while Sydney slowly discovers her new husband is far more powerful than she ever imagined.

title: Mom, I Don't Want This Nanny
description: Busy CEO Vivian Hayes hires nanny Brenda Tucker to care for Mia, who has autism. Brenda feigns kindness but abuses Mia and steals, conspiring with her husband Gary Tucker and son Dustin Clark, Vivian's assistant, to steal Vivian's wealth. Vivian exposes them with hidden cameras. Desperate, the Tuckers resort to kidnapping Mia for a 10 million dollar ransom. To save Mia, Vivian is forced to kneel and wipe their shoes. The police arrive and arrest the criminals. Vivian realizes family matters most and resigns to care for Mia.

title: Awakened: The Nanny's Son Regrets
description: In her past life, Audrey Kensington suffered complete family ruin caused by her husband Tristan Vance and homewrecker Nadia Mercer. Tristan even threatened her with organ trafficking, causing her to die of sheer anger. Reborn, Audrey vows revenge. She revokes their privileges and gifts, crushes the scumbag and bi*ch, exposes their affair, saves her family's fate, and ensures the villains are brought to justice.

title: Under One Lane
description: Ethan and Caden are fierce rivals on their college swim team—until a family reunion unexpectedly turns them into stepbrothers with no blood relation. Forced to share a bedroom during swim season, their constant clashes slowly become undeniable attraction, while Caden's secret feelings finally begin to surface. Just as they admit what they feel for each other, Noah, the team's jealous vice-captain, secretly records them kissing and frames Ethan with banned supplements, threatening his scholarship and place at Nationals. Facing scandal, family pressure, injury, and their athletic careers, Ethan and Caden must stop trying to protect each other alone and learn to fight side by side. At the national championship, they win together—and finally choose to openly claim both their love and their future as professional swimmers.

title: I'm Really Not an Immortal
description:
"I shouldn't have ever saved you and brought you up this mountain!" My teacher scolded me for ruining his precious ingredients to make the divine medicine, but later was surprised at the outcome, that I successfully made it out!
I am an orphan, study divine skilled with my teacher, and now come down the mountain to gain experiences. On the first day, I meet a girl, and saved her fatehr's life. Little did I know, they are my lost family, and little did they know, I'm a powerful figure with strong ability!

title: His One and Only Love
description: Lyla grows up feeling different from others and struggles with a sense of inferiority. Forced by her family to work and earn money, she faces abuse at every turn. On her 22nd birthday, Lyla wishes for true love. While working a part-time job, she saves Leo, a handsome and gentle president, and unexpectedly becomes pregnant. Leo takes her in and cares for her tenderly, and over time, their love blossoms. However, as they uncover the mystery of Lyla's past, they find themselves entangled in a web of conspiracy and evil. How will Lyla defend their love? What kind of ending awaits her and Leo under the care of the Goddess of Fate?

title: I Spent $2.90 on My Husband’s Card and Got Pinned to the Ground
description: On her fifth wedding anniversary, Evelyn Hart is thrown to the ground and accused of stealing after using her husband’s shared card for a subway ride. Behind the accusation is her husband Aiden, his ambitious assistant Sophia, and a scheme designed to strip Evelyn of money, dignity, and power. But Evelyn is not the helpless wife they imagined; as the lies unravel, she takes back her name, protects the people they abandoned, and rebuilds her life beyond his love and his approval.

title: Honey, We Are In a Novel
description: After a publisher twists a writer's novel, turning its villain into a victim, a gas explosion sends her family into the story itself. Now wealthy but doomed to lose everything in three years, they must rewrite their fate before the plot destroys them.

title: Dance Until the End
description: Martina, a farm-raised dancer, uses an engagement contract to secure her spot in the prestigious Bianchi Tango company, but Julian—a handsome assassin—interrupts her plans and forces her to help him. He is a dangerous obstacle, until Matina discovers he might actually give her everything she has ever wanted. Just as she finally gives in to her feelings, he walks away... But when they face death together, they realize that life is too short to waste true love.

title: Help! My Hot Boss Has My Nudes!
description: He’s her Hot Boss. She’s his employee. But when she sends him a pic of her boobs by mistake, desire, scandal, and secrets turn the office–and her heart–upside down.

title: Abandoned Dragon, Ascendant Queen
description: As a child, Elian was condemned by her father Marcus for being a magicless waste; her mother Selene burned her life force to save her and cast her off a cliff, where she was adopted by Kaelen. Twenty years later, she awakened the Golden Dragon bloodline, returned home to find her mother, exposed the truth, stripped Leora of power, exiled Marcus, and became Queen of Ashridge. Leora made a deal with dark sorcerer Morgaine, sparking war and taking Kaelen hostage. Elian awakened Dragon God power, defeated the dark magic, saved her parents, and was ultimately crowned Sovereign of the continent.

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: Despite societal pressures to marry, Lizzie Bennet, second eldest of the Bennet sisters, has her heart set on spinsterhood. But when her father falls gravely ill, Lizzie is unexpectedly thrust into the classist world of courtship in order to save her family from destitution. After a fateful encounter with the broody, mysterious millionaire, Mr. Darcy, Lizzie’s forced to choose between denying her feelings for the sake of her family or allowing herself to fall recklessly in love.

title: That Makes Two of Us
description: Four years ago, at the wedding arranged by their families, Max, the scion of the conglomerate, was absent, leaving the down-and-out socialite Alice as the nominal Mrs. M. Four years later, Alice has transformed into a well-known divorce case investigator, while Max returns home as the chairman of the M Group and entrusts her with handling his divorce case—neither recognizing the other. The meddling of a scheming colleague and the conspiracy of a cousin pile up one misunderstanding after another. When the truth comes to light, the two, who once passed each other by, finally come together after resolving their knots.

title: His Carefully Planned Sin
description: After losing her mother as a child, Lillian is taken in by the powerful James family following her father's sudden death. A single night with Sam James, the family’s second son, seems like a mistake until she realizes it was carefully orchestrated. As his obsessive pursuit closes in, the truth behind her adoption and her buried past begins to unravel, leaving Lillian trapped between desire, deception, and a fate she never chose.

title: Falling for the Thorned Rose
description: Abandoned and left with nothing, Emily sets her grandmother’s house on fire and runs straight into Sawyer Lewis, the bloodied heir of a powerful family. He takes her in, planning to use her to overturn a ruthless power game. But Emily refuses to be anyone's pawn. As she strikes back and breaks every rule, Sawyer finds himself falling for the very chaos he tried to control. Together, they burn their enemies down and save each other in the process.

title: No More Nice Girl
description: Thea, the Reed family's heiress, discovers her fiancé, Henry, has been letting his friend Lynn eavesdrop on their private moments. Henry accuses her of overreacting. After pressure from his parents, Thea gives him one last chance. But Henry, along with his friends, continues to humiliate her. When he learns Thea has secretly married the most influential man in the city and realizes he's just a pawn in the Grants' game, he's shattered.

title: Playing Innocent, Winning His Heart
description: Betrayed by her stepsister and forced into a sham marriage, Sophie decides on a bold revenge: seduce her stepsister's uncle—the ruthless tycoon Alfred Hart. But what starts as a calculated move turns into something far deeper. Not only does he spoil her relentlessly, but he also uncovers a shocking truth: Sophie is the long-lost heiress to an overseas empire.

title: Trapped in the Book, Married to My Enemy
description: After being transported into a book, Claire finds herself framed into marrying Sean—the man originally meant for her sister. Adaptable by nature, she channels her energy into securing wealth, knowing money is the true source of power. But on their wedding night, Sean drops a bombshell: he has an incurable disease. What follows is a marriage of convenience between a gold‑digger and a reckless noble, where Claire masterfully transforms the young lord from a playboy into the perfect "henpecked" husband.

title: Taming the Ice Prince
description: Elliot has been in love with Fredric since high school, a love that has spanned five years. Due to an arranged marriage between their families, she is moving in with him, tasked to bear his child. However, Fredric suspects that Elliot might be a spy sent by his stepmother and makes life difficult for her at every turn. But the truth is, Elliot has been his silent supporter through his most vulnerable moments. When she left, he finally realized his love for her.

title: Checkmate, My Hubby
description: Avery Daigle, a notorious tomcat, faces pressure from his parents to settle down and marry. His single demand for a bride? Obedience. Hazel Arnold fits the bill and seems like a good match. However, Avery's world is turned upside down when he witnesses her exacting revenge with her own hands...

title: Don't Cry When I Move On
description: The hidden CEO is heartbroken when his girlfriend rejects his proposal for his impostor, but he will make her regret!

title: The Spy Who Married Me
description: Two modern best friends wake up in a rival kingdom as royal sisters sent into political marriages and secretly planted as spies. One weds the stoic war prince, and the other marries his charming, scheming brother. Both princes suspect betrayal. But the "elite spy" is a clueless bookworm, and the "naive girl" is a master strategist. As traps backfire and schemes unravel, suspicion turns into a sweet battle of wits and love.

title: Nothing Can Hide from Me
description: Tyler Clerk, an Uber driver, has to works his ass off to pay for rent and his sister's treatment. After a one-night stand gifts him X-ray eyes, every rough stone he scans spills jade—and secrets. With Chaya's help, he's become an antiques appraiser and earned enough money to cover his sister's medical expenses.

title: The Way You Smile at Me
description: Betrayed by her boyfriend Aaron, Mia Wood impulsively accepts a proposal from Lucas Moore—her ex's boss. Their marriage begins as a contract for revenge, but Lucas's unwavering devotion slowly mends Mia's broken heart. What she doesn't know is that this "coincidental" union is the result of Lucas's years-long secret affection. As their pretend relationship deepens into real connection, past lies and Aaron's desperation threaten to shatter their fragile beginning.

title: You Are My World
description: Abandoned at birth and raised by a mute father figure, Sara knows only gratitude and loyalty. But after a clash with a privileged boy turns dangerous, she saves him from drowning and vanishes in the river, leaving her devoted father to grieve the daughter he risked everything for.

title: A Tangle of Love
description: In a romance-themed observation show, several participants undergo a series of interactions and conflicts filled with love, misunderstandings, and power struggles. In the end, one couple rises to overwhelming popularity, and true love prevails as they happily end up together.

title: Daddy, We're Getting You a Wife
description: Serena Morris enters a whirlwind marriage with the enigmatic Lucas Reed, stepping into the role of stepmother to his two children. However, she soon uncovers a startling truth: Lucas's children are, in fact, her own, lost to her five years ago. As the past unravels, long-buried secrets come to light...

title: Son in Law's Revenge
description: After being mistreated by his wife’s family for years, Leo discovers that he is the heir to a vast fortune. Now it’s time — for revenge!

title: Silent Star, Shining Scars
description: Joyce Shaw, a gifted girl from the countryside, enters Juhama University with big dreams, only to be framed for crimes she didn't commit. Expelled and blacklisted, she works in the shadows for five years. Her world changes when Liam Rute, a powerful heir, saves her, seeing the star she truly is. When her past is brutally exposed and her mother falls ill, Joyce decides to fight back. With Liam by her side, she's ready to reclaim her name, her future, and her stolen spotlight.

title: I Divorced on Delivery Day
description: Heiress Joy Quinn hides her identity and cuts ties with her family to marry broke boyfriend Ryan Zimmer. But just as she's about to give birth, betrayal strikes. With the baby in the wrong position, Joy checks into a private hospital. But Ryan's best friend Yasmine accuses her of faking it for luxury. Manipulated, Ryan tries to move Joy to a cheaper clinic, sparking explosive drama. Just then, Joy's father, billionaire Raymond Quinn, arrives bearing lavish gifts. But Ryan and Yasmine mock him, refusing to believe his identity. As three elite CEOs show up honor Quinn, the truth is revealed. But it's already too late. Joy loses the baby and demands a divorce. Desperate, Ryan spreads lies online, accusing Joy and her father of murdering the child. The internet turns vicious. Raymond strikes back with evidence, and calls the police. In the end, Ryan and Yasmine are convicted and sentenced.

title: When the Fallen Prince Met the Unbroken Woman
description: Vanessa Lewis, a merchant's daughter married into the prestigious but hypocritical Hayes family. After a life spent giving everything—only to be betrayed, discarded, and left to die—she awakens reborn on the day her household is exiled. This time, armed with foresight and her hidden wealth, she refuses to play the victim. As the Hayes family struggles on the bitter road to exile, Vanessa turns the tables, exposing their greed and arrogance while securing her own survival.

title: Taking Back Love, Rising Above
description: To fulfill a debt of gratitude, Flora married into the Milo family, only to be betrayed and humiliated by her husband, Harrison Milo. So she orchestrates her own death and rebuilds her life . Five years later, Harrison uncovers the truth and will burn everything down to get her back—but he’s too late. She’s already moved on, and her new life has no room for his regret.

title: My Husband Betrayed Me, My Life Became Mine
description: Josephine helped build the Walker Group from the ground up, sacrificing her health and fertility for her husband, Cameron. When the company goes public, she discovers his affair with his secretary, Ivy, who is now pregnant. After one final betrayal, Josephine files for divorce. As Ivy plots to steal the company, Josephine strikes back, reclaims her empire, and rebuilds her life with Finn, the man who loved her all along.

title: Ding! CEO Hubby Online
description: After being set up by her own family, Nora Wood becomes pregnant with Tyler Holt's child, who is later named Bryan. Unfortunately, when Bryan turns five, he is diagnosed with leukemia. In an effort to cover medical expenses, Nora decides to sell the family jade pendant Tyler had given her, triggering a city-wide search for Bryan by the Holt family. Meanwhile, Nora joins Holt Group as Tyler's secretary. As they work closely together, their feelings for each other grow, and their relationship flourishes over time.

title: Oops! Falling for My Wild Heiress
description: The day Alina Archer realizes she's transmigrated into the body of a wealthy character in a book, she visits an upscale club that night and takes a model named Oliver Nolan back to her home. To her surprise, he’s not only incredibly handsome but also skilled in various areas. He teaches her the ways of business and saves her from crises multiple times. As their bond deepens, Oliver decides to propose when her family pressures her to marry soon. It’s at this moment that she discovers he’s actually the richest man on Earth.

title: Yielding to Her Charm
description: Nina Yeats, battling a debilitating illness, becomes entangled with a monster, Jack Xavier, while trying to fulfill her late mother's last wish. Exploiting her vulnerabilities, Jack seems inescapable, yet Nina refuses to yield. As the icy facade of this devilish figure begins to crack, Jack finds himself unexpectedly bending to Nina's will. Nina discovers that Jack is not as fearsome as he seems, and slowly, she finds herself drawn to him.

title: The Funeral That Made a Boss
description: Five years ago, Damian Cross woke up in a shallow grave. His wife sold him out. His parents were dead. His sister was gone. He was the only one who walked away. Now he's back. One man. Three syndicates. One mission: tear them all down. He starts from the bottom and rises fast. Too fast. Because the higher he climbs, the closer he gets to the truth. The people who destroyed his family? Just pawns. The real monster has been watching him the whole time. This isn't revenge anymore. This is war.

title: Only For You
description: Keira West is coerced into marrying Clyde Irving, with her mother's well-being held as leverage. Neglected by her husband, Keira finds herself entangled with his uncle, William, the true power behind the family. But as their forbidden relationship deepens, can she build a future with this man, or will their love bury them alive?

title: Oops, Roomie, You Picked the Wrong Girl!
description: Aurora Lee wakes up reborn on her first day of college, memories intact of being betrayed and murdered by her best friend, Phoebe Bowen. This time, the real heiress hides her identity while Phoebe—the imposter—invites everyone on a luxurious overseas trip, secretly plotting to steal Aurora's fortune again. As Aurora plays along with Phoebe's deception, she maneuvers to unmask the truth in a deadly game of revenge where everyone is a pawn, and no one leaves unchanged.

title: Oops, You Fired the Wrong Woman
description: Lena, a rich heiress, entered the Sutton Group as Eric's fiancée, with hiding her true identity. It was a childhood arranged marriage. Lena appeared to be addicted to gaming and neglecting her duties, but actually, she used business resources and connections of her family to clear all obstacles for Eric, helping his company go public, and elevating him to be a business tycoon. However, Eric was unaware of this. He blindly trusted his scheming assistant Sophie, and ignored Lena's care and kind reminders...

title: Out of Prison, Into War
description: Edward walks free on early release, only to be dragged into a street clash when a minor traffic incident turns into a $50,000 extortion scheme. He stays behind to handle it and effortlessly drops Helena and her crew. When reinforcements arrive and they threaten his sister-in-law, Edward unleashes his full strength, crushing them alone. As the dust settles, a powerful business leader recognizes him, hinting that his past is anything but ordinary.

title: Oops, Roomie, You Picked the Wrong Girl!
description: Aurora Lee wakes up reborn on her first day of college, memories intact of being betrayed and murdered by her best friend, Auria Bowen. This time, the real heiress hides her identity while Auria—the imposter—invites everyone on a fancy overseas trip, secretly plotting to steal Aurora's fortune again. As Aurora plays along with Auria's deception, she maneuvers to unmask the truth in a deadly game of revenge where everyone is a pawn, and no one leaves unchanged.

title: Awakening: Football's Last Hope
description: Valerius football seemed doomed — until his comeback! Zale Cole, a once-promising football talent, squandered his past life, but given a second chance, he's back to sixteen with every football star's unique skill! Now, Zale's about to change the game. But can he really defy the odds and lead Valerius football to unprecedented glory?

title: Game of Blood
description:
"Street thief Irma is one execution swing from death when Crown
Prince Lukian, dying from a curse only black blood can ease, buys
her life as his blood source. His touch heals him without pain or
blade, which is a resonance no one can explain. Her trust shatters
when she learns he let her best friend die feeding the same ritual,
then shatters again when she uncovers his icy fiancée Rina's
secret: decades spent killing black-blooded women, including
Irma's mother, to fuel stolen immortality. When Irma exposes her,
Rina strikes first, framing her for murder and seizing the crown."

title: Fool Me Once
description: Dossey Hope, intellectually disabled since childhood, was deceived by her parents into taking the fall for her sister and went to prison, where she secretly learned martial arts. Upon her release, her parents attempted to commit her to a mental hospital. At that moment, Nathan Gannon, heir to the wealthiest family in the Capital, suddenly proposes marriage.

title: Fool Me Once
description: Dossey Hope, intellectually disabled since childhood, was deceived by her parents into taking the fall for her sister and went to prison, where she secretly learned martial arts. Upon her release, her parents attempted to commit her to a mental hospital. At that moment, Nathan Gannon, heir to the wealthiest family in the Capital, suddenly proposes marriage.

title: Mom, I Owe You A Fortune
description: Reborn as a tycoon with regret, Frederick returns to his parents' divorce day to side with his wronged mother, vowing to rewrite their destiny with wealth and power.

title: She Bows for No One
description: Isabella gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But when he's promoted to Alpha's General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Isabella is the lost wolf princess — destined to be Alpha Queen — and he'll regret letting her go.

title: To Heal or to Burn
description:
On the day she’s supposed to become a bride, Jennifer is thrown from a thousand-meter magic tower by the man she once saved. Her crime? Healing the blind duke whose heart belonged to another woman.
But death gives her a second chance.
When Jennifer awakens in the past, she refuses to save him again—even as the kingdom’s most powerful families beg for her healing blood. Instead, she makes a shocking wager before the entire royal court: while the duke’s beloved struggles to cure blindness, Jennifer will attempt the impossible—reviving a man whose soul is already dead.
Ten days. One sacred blood pact. And only one woman will walk away from the capital alive.

title: Love lost on Ice
description:
Hockey star Kaelen proposes on ice. Jealous Isolde drives into Lia—Kaelen is gravely injured saving her. Lia donates a kidney to save him, but Isolde fakes a cruel farewell letter and forces her away.

Awakened, Kaelen believes Lia abandoned him. Heartbroken, Lia is diagnosed with leukemia and leaves for Switzerland.

Five years later, Lia returns as a chauffeur, drowning in debt. Kaelen, now a superstar, mistakes her for a gold-digger and hires her as his humiliated personal assistant. She silently endures his hatred and Isolde's abuse—until she throws herself in front of a car to protect him. The doctor reveals the truth: Lia was his kidney donor all along.

Isolde is arrested. Kaelen declares Lia his fiancée. A year later, she escapes from the Swiss hospital to his rink—and they kiss on the ice, vowing to spend every remaining moment together.

title: Fiancée's Betrayal, Dante's Inferno
description: Dante Bosch returns home after 3 years in the Marine Raiders on a top secret mission, only to discover not only is his fiancée Lilith pregnant with his brother Virgil's baby, but Virgil has also spent all his money. To add insult to injury, his parents take Virgil's side. After suffering betrayals and humiliations, Dante exposes Virgil's lies with a video at his wedding.

title: No One Choose Me
description: When Veya and the hypocritical woman who brazenly interfered in her marriage were both poisoned, her husband and five-year-old son unhesitatingly gave the only antidote to the mistress. Reborn with the memory of her desperate and tragic death, Veya decided to sever this rotten marriage and launch a ruthless counterattack against the usurper and her betraying family.

title: My Long-Lost Son Turns Out to Be a CEO
description:
The mother sells fish for a living and supports her two sons. However, because of the scars on her arms, she is considered as having an infectious disease and lives a difficult life. Because the younger son has allergies since childhood and gets more care from his mother, the older son is jealous. During a quarrel with his younger brother, he accidentally causes his younger brother to fall down the mountain and disappear.
The mother always thinks that her younger son is not dead. She searchs for her son for years. Eighteen years later, the younger son who is rescued and becomes the heir of a big Group. He always wants to find his mother. However, due to the demolition of the old house, the lost son misses the opportunity to find his mother. But the eldest son abandons his mother and refuses to recognize her because he wants to marry a rich family.
In the process of searching for her son, she experiences various humiliations and grievances, can she finally recognize him?"

title: Blood Moon Roommates
description:
Noah Gray, a commoner, earns a full scholarship to St. Cassian Academy, an elite school for nobles. On his first night, he discovers his roommate Damian Blackwood's secret: the cold wolf prince chains himself every bloodmoon to suppress his lycanthropy. Noah's blood can calm him. Secrets bind them, and affection blooms.

The academy hides dark schemes. It selects sacrifices for a deadly ritual on bloodmoon nights. When Noah faces trial, Damian takes the mark for him. During the ritual, Noah awakens as the last heir of the extinct demon-hunter clan.

The headmaster, Damian's uncle, murdered Noah's parents. He arranged their room for twenty years to use them as keys to unseal a demon. To protect Noah, Damian leaps into the abyss.

Noah forms a sacred covenant. Their love becomes the permanent seal. The demon is banished. At dawn, Damian kneels and kisses Noah's palm.

title: Cinderella's Vengeance Clock
description:
Nick Drake and Nathan Drake risked their lives to save Sasha Grey, who then agrees to a mysterious old man's terms to become a maid for Harold Godwin and his son for six years.

During this time, Sasha endures Harold's indifference and his ex-wife Naya Smith's schemes, quietly waiting for the agreement to end.

When Naya returns, Harold's favoritism and Tim's betrayal leave Sasha utterly disheartened. 

As the six years conclude, she leaves decisively and reunites with the awakened Nick.

Only after losing her does Harold realize his love for her, but it's too late.

When the truth is revealed, Harold is gravely injured protecting Sasha, who ultimately chooses Nick over him.

This is a story of sacrifice, betrayal, and redemption, where love and hate intertwine as everyone seeks their own place in the world.

title: Pampered by My Ex-husband's Billionaire Friend
description: A stunning and talented heiress finally divorces her husband, who has been absent for four years. Pressured by her grandmother to have a child to inherit the family company, she is introduced to a man she thinks is just handsome and fit. But to her surprise, he turns out to be a billionaire CEO who has secretly loved her for years!

title: Love Me, Don't Own Me
description: A rebellious heiress burns her arranged engagement to chase freedom in 2000s Harbor Town, until her escape is shattered by the city’s most powerful man: her ex-fiancé’s mysterious uncle, who spent three years as her secret obsession.

title: If Someone Treated Me Gently
description:
I just started my career as a singer, and my boyfriend betrayed me and drugged me! I ran away, bumped into a hot guy, and ended up having a one-night stand with him! Little did I know, he is a billionaire CEO.
After that, during the lowest period of my life, I discover myself pregnant! And in a condition that I didn’t realize, I met the baby’s father again, and he offered me a home! When will I know he is the man I hooked up with? Will he be my redemption?

title: Loop of the Doomed Bride
description: On her wedding night, she wakes up in a death trap, tied to a bed, framed for adultery, and executed by the Madam. Reborn, she returns to this fatal start again! To survive, she cuts the ropes, knocks out the fake lover, and tells the Madam. But she just buries her alive. The third time, she finds her husband murdered and is executed as the killer... Caught in an infinite loop where every path leads to death, how will she survive?

title: God of Snow
description:
In a world where the sun has long vanished and eternal winter reigns, fire is condemned as the greatest forbidden power.

The all-seeing Snow God rules the frozen world through colossal Snow Dragons, relentless guardians that patrol the skies, hunting down every trace of warmth and anyone guilty of the ancient sin known as fire.

When young Lyra is struck by a deadly frost sickness, her father, Aldric, Lord of Winterfall, makes an impossible choice. Defying the Snow God's absolute law, he enters the forbidden ruins of an ancient civilization and awakens a forgotten flame. The fire saves Lyra's life—but at a devastating cost. As the Snow Dragons descend upon Winterfall, Aldric sacrifices himself so his daughter can escape.

His final act awakens something far greater than anyone could have imagined.

The Snow God has sensed the return of fire.

An endless storm of Snow Dragons descends upon the city, reducing Winterfall to ice and ruin.

Far away, a young noble named Kael, heir to the Darkhold, witnesses the destruction. Haunted since childhood by mysterious dreams of fire, he begins searching for the truth behind the world's greatest taboo. The deeper he investigates, the more he realizes that history itself may have been rewritten.

Perhaps fire was never the true enemy.

As Lyra grows older, she discovers that she is no ordinary survivor—she is the only person chosen by the fire itself.

And now, the Snow God has turned its gaze toward her.

Together, Lyra and Kael embark on a journey across the frozen world, pursued by the ruthless Ravok, the Snow God, and its relentless Snow Dragons. Their path leads them toward the legendary Hollow Sea, where long-buried secrets may finally be revealed.

As the truth begins to emerge, Lyra realizes that what the Snow God fears most may not be fire itself—but humanity's ability to reclaim warmth, hope, and freedom.

The battle between a god determined to preserve absolute order and the people destined to change the world has only just begun.

title: No More Looking Back
description: She originally pretended to be deaf and mute for the male lead, but ended up being despised by him. When her true identity is revealed, how will she handle this imbalanced love, and will she be able to start a new life?

title: Borrowed Face to Love You
description:
On the tenth anniversary of their marriage, Vivian is blindsided when her beloved husband of ten years, Vincent, suddenly asks for a divorce. What she doesn't know is that Vincent has been diagnosed with terminal cancer and has only 90 days left to live. Unable to bear the thought of making Vivian watch him die, he cruelly hides the truth, undergoes facial reconstruction, and returns to her life as a complete stranger.
With only ninety days remaining, Vincent is determined to fulfill a promise that only he knows. But just as Vivian finally opens her heart to love once again, they are forced to face the cruelest goodbye of all.

title: Bloodbound to You
description:
Sonny, heir to a lineage of vampire hunters, accidentally awakens Victor—the Blood Lord
imprisoned for 300 years—during a sacred sealing ritual on Holy Mountain. As family
betrayal, past-life memories, and a conspiracy surrounding the "Holy Blood" unfold one by
one, two men who were born to be mortal enemies fall in love again and join forces to
overthrow a hunting order that has endured for three centuries.

title: Pregnant by My Ex's Dad
description: After Lucia's selfish boyfriend ends things because he doesn’t believe in her, she vows to prove him wrong. Determined to be the best surgical resident, she throws herself into work— and under her resident supervisor, Dr. Sawyer Campbell: ruthless renowned surgeon, surprise baby daddy, and worst of all… her ex’s dad.

title: Parental Love 1993
description: In the 1990s, a railway worker accidentally saved a city girl, and the fate of the two people intersected from then on. She was betrayed by her ex-boyfriend and her biological mother's preferred boys over girls. Only the love and care of the worker and his son illuminated her life like a light. He was brave, kind, and responsible. He raised the son of his ex-girlfriend who had a heart disease, and took care of the city girl meticulously. After many hardships and twists and turns, the two of them finally got together, but at this time, something unexpected happened again. The generous death of a woman who liked him, and the return of his ex-girlfriend made their lives uneasy. In the end, they made a decision...

title: Fool No More: X-Ray Vision
description: Beaten into a fool after a failed courtship, Dylan is saved by a gorgeous woman. She never hides her own body while bathing or sleeping, and slowly falls for the fool Dylan. Suddenly, Dylan hits his head and receives the Astral Hermit legacy! Cured of his foolishness, he awakens X-Ray Vision and other magical powers, like medical skills. Mastering all skills, he kicks off a legendary life! He met a rich heiress and a hot doctor. Will he entangle with these women?

title: To My Romeo, with Love
description: Penny and Mason are childhood best friends who’ve quietly fallen in love. But after spending their first night together, Penny is diagnosed with cancer—and makes the agonizing choice to push Mason away to protect him from the pain of losing her.

title: My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me
description: Audrey hides her identity as a CEO to protect Cornell's pride, working behind the scenes to help him secure a major hotel project and climb to the top as the hotel's CEO. As she helps him make his way up the ladder, his first love, Cecilia, returns, putting a strain on their relationship . Meanwhile, Audrey faces relentless pressure from those around her, including Cornell, which pushing her to consider a divorce. After enduring countless humiliations, she finally recognizes her worth and the price of dedicating herself to the wrong person. With her confidence restored, Audrey eventually chooses divorce and fight to reclaim her place as the CEO.

title: QB! Look what you made me do!
description: To cover her grandmother's sky-high medical costs, Nadia crashes a wedding as a faux mistress, escaping in rugby star Benjamin's jersey and unleashing a viral scandal over his inadvertent "cross-dressing" photo. Bound by a forced contractual marriage, she becomes a pawn for idol Paris, tasked with stealing Benjamin's playbook—a betrayal that plunges her into a moral quagmire. As misunderstandings spiral and kidnappings ensue, Benjamin's life-threatening injuries shatter Nadia's loyalty to Paris. Yet when her hero sacrifices himself again to save her, crippling guilt drives her to vanish. With past secrets and present dangers colliding, can love survive the wreckage of their star-crossed pact?

title: The Virgin Camp Counselor
description: When Chloe's first day of camp, her nemesis Morgan reveals that she's a virgin to all of the other counselors, and the guys at camp compete to see who takes Chloe's V-Card. But when she's saved by bad boy counselor Asher, she meets the first person who gets her to let her guard down. Can Chloe and Asher's relationship a summer of crazy campers, wild bonfires, and a hoard of counselors who want to tear their relationship apart?

title: Captured and Bound By My CEO
description: When Lydia West is kidnapped by her rival and forced to marry him for a year to save her dad, she’s sure she’ll hate him forever. But as the truth behind his actions emerges, Lydia is forced to question everything and everyone she thought she knew. Caught between loyalty to her family and her growing feelings for a man she’s supposed to hate, Lydia must decide whether she can resist falling for her captor or let duty tear them apart.

title: Charmed to Meet You, Too
description: After finally connecting with the mystery neighbor she’s been “charming” through her Crocs Jibbitz ™ charms, hopeless romantic Lexi is crushed when Tyler never calls—unaware he lost her number by accident. While Tyler launches a viral online search to find her again, Lexi escapes to a tropical wedding and sparks an unexpected connection with another charming stranger, unknowingly carrying the same heart-shaped Jibbitz ™ charm that could reunite her with the guy fate keeps pulling her back toward. ​

title: Go Easy On Me, Boss.
description:
She was betrayed at the altar. Now, a WARRIOR GODDESS is out for revenge... and love.

After a brutal public humiliation, Li Mengqi's life is over. But it's just the beginning when a legendary female warrior takes over her body! Her mission: settle the score and go back. Her problem: the irresistibly charming Young Master Gu.

Thrown into a world of danger and passion, she discovers that love is the greatest battle of all. Will she choose to return to her power, or stay for his heart?*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Her Secret Crusader
description: The city is under attack by supervillains and needs their hero – The Crusader. Lyndon is hiding his hero identity to live a normal life. But when the Mayor’s beautiful daughter Nadia seeks out his help, can Lyndon outsmart his evil family to become The Crusader again and save Nadia’s life?

title: You Fired the Backbone of Detroit
description: Hank Walker, mechanic by day and genius auto engineer by night, is fired under new management. Betrayed, Hank is offered a dream job from rival company Mach 15. Will Hank get to build the supercar of his dreams? Or will interference from rivals old and new cost him everything?

title: Now You Know Who I Am
description: Elena is chair of the Cooper Group. She handed the company over to her husband, Dalton. Elena returns to board of directors after a 5-year absence, but no one at the company recognizes her anymore. Elena is met with a workplace full of gossip, bullying, and rumors. Many speculate that "Dalton's wife" is some old hag. Flora, Dalton's secretary, has repeatedly, unsuccessfully tried to seduce him. One day, Flora sees Dalton and Elena sharing affection, and believes Elena to be his mistress. Then, she finds out Elana is pregnant. Wanting to be Dalton's mistress herself, Flora sets her sights on tormenting Elena, and forcing her out of the picture.

title: My Wolf Roommate is a Fool
description: Beneath New York City, a secret werewolf society exists alongside the human world. At the request of a close friend, pureblood Alpha Marcus Vance fabricates a $50,000 debt to force young illustrator Felix Carter to stay by his side—supposedly for his own “protection.”Cold, obsessively clean, and seemingly immune to desire, Marcus soon finds his defenses crumbling under the pressures of living together...

title: What Doesn't Break Me
description: Raised in rural poverty, Taylor gets into MIT, but her father and older brother rip up the acceptance letter and sell her to an old rich man for cash. With help from her mom and little sister, Taylor escapes—but loses all contact with them. Seven years later, Taylor is the richest person in the world. She returns home in glory—only to find her mom beaten and her sister sold by her brother. Fueled by rage, Taylor shows up at the welcome banquet held for the world’s top CEO—her brother, now her employee, doesn’t recognize her and calls her a whore in front of everyone. Can Taylor prove who she is, find her sister, and bring justice to those who crushed her? And when the truth comes out—what punishment awaits those who looked down upon Taylor?

title: The Call Boy I Met in Paris
description: Sophie met Justin seven years ago, but she doesn't remember who he is. As fate would have it, they reunite seven years later after a one night stand. She mistakens him for a callboy and asks him to fake marry her, but little does she know... he's a billionaire!

title: The Ghost of You and I
description: Lieutenant Ryan Cross is fighting on the front lines, but he doesn't tell his wife, Alice, for fear of worrying her. Tragically, Ryan is killed in action while trying to save his comrades. However, his lingering regrets cause him to transform into a ghost and return to his wife’s side. Back home, Alice, who thinks Ryan is just hiding from her, is convinced he's been cheating! Pissed, Alice decides to get back at Ryan by marrying another man. On the day of the wedding, Alice’s bridal car passes Ryan’s funeral procession.

title: Golden Feather: Temptation Game
description: At the Golden Feather Academy, after being rejected, Queen Celine offers her playboy stepbrother Leo a night with her if he can seduce and destroy the boy who refused her—the president's son, Logic. But when Leo's fake pursuit turns real, Celine loses control of Leo forever...

title: Three Brothers Spoil Me
description: Nancy, the long-lost Lancaster heiress, battles betrayal from her boyfriend Alan and his mistress Mia, who try to steal her place. When will Nancy establish her true identity and gain acceptance from those around her?

title: Love & Blood
description: When Sophia sets out to find her missing twin sister, Tina, the trail leads her to The Red Veil, an elite vampire nightclub ruled by the ruthless Von Drák family. As she digs deeper into its dark, seductive world, Sophia discovers a chilling prophecy, a forbidden romance, and a supernatural war that could consume them all.

title: Guarding Her Body, Claiming Her Heart
description: Her life was a fairytale lie until she caught her fiancé in bed with her own brother. When an attempt on her life shatters her last illusions, she is thrown together with the only man she can trust: her new bodyguard, Derek. He’s cold, aloof, and frustratingly professional - yet a single look from his piercing eyes is enough to make her burn. Can she truly trust the man sworn to protect her when everyone else has betrayed her?

title: The Lady Boss CEO is My Daughter
description: After Matilda's only daughter, Elodie, is rescued from her kidnapper by local police - she is turned over to foster care and never to be seen again. Matilda and her son, Carson, never stopped searching for her -  spending every last penny on posters and PI invesitgations till they starved. Then, after twenty long years of desperate attempts to get Elodie back, she returns. Except, now she's Billionaire CEO Miss Atkins and her company is going to destroy the very home she grew up in - and the only remaining clue that could bring the family back together again.

title: Money, Robots, and a Happy 4th of July
description: The Iron Marine, Toby Stark, returns home after saving the country only to be brutally dumped by his ex who as no clue he's the richest guy on Earth! How will Tobias slap back at her?

title: When Love Comes Too Late
description: A car accident leaves Winnie's daughter on the brink of death. Her doctor husband, Aaron, chooses to save his first love Monica's child instead, leading to the death of his own daughter. Winnie seeks justice for her lost child, only to face relentless interference from Monica and distrust from her husband.

title: Alpha's Regret
description: Lila's fated mate, the rival alpha, rejected her. Now, he's back, wanting her and a second chance. But can she trust him...especially when she's hiding their son?

title: Dwarf Hoop God
description: NBA Hoop God Kim dies in a crash, his soul awakening in Colin's body, a 5'5" teen mocked as a dwarf. Then he shatters the Thunder team's vertical record. Jealous captain Max maliciously injures Colin's brother, Brent, sparking Colin's revenge. Facing Supreme Limitless and their CBA stars, Colin rallies from a 32-point deficit. A 45-second rampage and 1.8-second clutch dunk crush the dirty plays, proving height means nothing and pure skill rules all in basketball.

title: Undercover Heiress
description: Selina Murphy, a wealthy heiress, goes undercover as an intern at her fiancé's company—only to cross paths with Grace, a cunning opportunist from the wrong side of the tracks. Grace brazenly steals Selina's identity and, with the help of their coworkers, relentlessly bullies the "new girl." But Grace picked the wrong target this time. The real heiress is about to fight back.

title: Spoiled by the Devil
description: While foraging in the countryside, Emily is suddenly taken to the capital by her brother's sworn enemy, John. Everyone assumes the ruthless, powerful man will make her life a living hell, but to their shock, John spoils Emily beyond imagination, turning the "poor victim" into the most envied girl in the city.

title: Sister Pact, Love's Contract
description: To save their orphanage, sisters Nora and Vivian Collins sign a contract to become the Johnson family's "professional daughters-in-law." Tough, martial arts expert Nora is assigned to tame the playboy heir, Colton. Meanwhile, Vivian is ordered to heal the reclusive, Graham. It's a business deal: fix the brothers, get the cash. But when their mission is nearly complete and the sisters prepare to leave, Colton and Graham realize that they've fallen for their wives.

title: His Secret Heiress
description: Bonnie was born into wealth and privilege, but thanks to Isabel’s schemes, she married the wrong man, suffering disfigurement, betrayal, and the ruin of her family. Reborn, she quietly sets her sights on the seemingly lowly adopted son of the Nail family. Only she knows that this boy, now overlooked, is destined for greatness. Power, wealth, and influence await him.

title: Pregnant and Pampered by the CEO
description: Robin Wilner, the wealthiest man in Kingfell, suffers from the Affliction syndrome and discovers that Grace Dawson is his only remedy. To protect her unborn child, Grace marries Robin but faces challenges from her toxic family. As more secrets of the past surface, something more challenging is awaiting.

title: Payout & Payback
description: Eight months pregnant, Allison Grant lands a $5 million bonus. Joking, she's fired; she gets a vicious slap instead of support. Worse yet: her mother-in-law is drugging her to force a miscarriage, while her husband cheats and plots to steal her fortune. Raging, Allison vows revenge. With her best friend and business partner, she plans a brilliant counterattack, making the traitors pay dearly.

title: Possessed by the Alpha No Escape
description: Ten days married, and her husband dumps her. She's hunted in the woods. Until she saves a wild, memory-less man and marries him. But he's actually the murderous Wolf King who woke up one hundred year ago. And her? She's the sealed Supreme Duke of Hell. When her ex and his mistress humiliate her, their bloodlines awaken. Extreme revenge. Forbidden desire. Together they crush every traitor and make them crawl at their feet.

title: Paper Marriage
description: For five years of marriage, I gave up my career and left everything behind to follow my brigadier general husband—only to end up living as an illegal resident on the base. He gave my military dependent slot to the girl we sponsored, and even had the lock on our home changed for her. Heartbroken, I left in the dead of night and started over in a new city. Seven years later, at a military arts festival, we crossed paths again. He was full of regret, but I was already standing next to another man. This time, I didn't look back.

title: My Alpha Forced Me to Lose Our Pup
description: Aria once loved Damon Hayes as the boy who saved her. Then he became Alpha, let Vivienne Sutton mark him, and forced wolfsbane down Aria's throat to erase their pup. Worse, he dragged her bleeding to Crescent Hall so Vivienne could call her a mate-thief before every Alpha. Damon thought Aria was still the packless stray he used to feed. He was wrong. Hollow Ridge had searched twenty years for its lost daughter, and her father arrived just in time. Once Aria finally rejects Damon, the Alpha who threw her away starts losing everything.

title: Debt of a Masked Night
description: After her father’s business goes bankrupt, Skylar Stone is forced to work as Lucas Ford’s maid as collateral. But just when she thinks things can’t get worse, an unexpected pregnancy shatters her world. Lucas, convinced of her betrayal, demands she get an abortion, leaving her devastated. Heartbreak forces her to leave her homeland, but six years later, she returns—with her child and a story far from over.

title: Pay to Win: Apocalypse Reset
description: Reborn on the apocalypse day, Albert drops a billion and unlocks god mode. While others fight to survive, he steamrolls the world.

title: Don't Mess with a Prep School Princess
description:
Sierra Lane thought she was getting her life back when she was finally released from juvie after taking the fall for her boyfriend, Jake. Instead, she’s met with a shocking truth: she’s the long-lost Lancaster Heiress, heir to one of the biggest fortunes in the country.

Armed with a new identity and eager to reclaim her place at Hawthorne Prep, Sierra returns to school, ready to share the news. But instead of a warm welcome, she finds that Jake has moved on with her ex-best friend, Fallon. Even worse, Fallon has already been telling everyone that she and the heiress are best friends, making Sierra’s arrival a direct threat to Fallon's reign as queen bee of the school.

As Sierra battles relentless gossip, sabotage, and an entire school that wants her sent back to juvie, she’ll have to prove she’s exactly who she says she is before Fallon destroys her reputation for good.

title: Promise in Paper, Folded Vow
description: Ex-special forces Caleb hides his identity to fulfill a promise, joining Twitty Group as a guard to protect Abby and the "Aegis Paper." As its rivial, Kendall Group, sends assassins, Caleb uses his unmatched combat skills to defeat them. But when he digs deeper, foreign threats emerge...

title: My Telepathic Pup Made Me Luna
description: Maeve is a defective Omega with no Wolf Spirit, a slum scavenger who once trusted her toxic friend Faye, swallowed wolfsbane, lost her unborn child, and died in flames set by Knox’s noble first love, Blair. Reborn on the night Alpha King Knox seeks her as the cure to his dark curse, Maeve hears the fierce little voice of her unborn telepathic pup and finally makes the smart choice: accept the Moonstones, the black card, and her place inside the Pack House. With her pup warning her of every trap, Maeve trains, wins the Queen Mother’s heart, exposes Faye and Blair, proves her child is pureblood, and rises from rejected Omega to Luna Queen.

title: Trapped in Professor's Playroom
description: Lena, a dedicated and bookish student, is cruelly dumped by her boyfriend Ryan, who mocks her as a boring, unattractive nerd. Heartbroken and humiliated, she drowns her sorrows at a bar, where she meets the charming and handsome Adrian. One impulsive night leads to a passionate encounter. To Lena's shock, she later discovers that Adrian is none other than Ryan's father. What began as a moment of reckless escape becomes the start of an impossible entanglement that will turn all their lives upside down.

title: From Puppet Bride to Alpha Queen
description:
Ever since my Omega sister saved me from wolfsbane poisoning, she used that life debt to control every detail of my existence—including my wedding.
She picked the flowers, designed the theme, and even tried on wedding dresses with my groom while he smiled in delight. Every time I voiced my outrage, they weaponized the past to silence me: "She saved your life! Why are you always acting like the villain?"
If they want the wedding so badly, they can keep each other.
I discarded my ring and returned to my royal pack, took my throne as Alpha Queen.

title: The Mafia Boss Happens to Be My Sex Partner
description:
Fiona Shaw's life of luxury shattered when her family's empire collapsed, leaving her burdened with a crushing $500 million debt. To save what's left of her family, she agrees to a cold-hearted bargain: a marriage of convenience to Henry Sterling, the second son of a powerful business dynasty.  

But behind the glamour of high society lies a painful truth. Henry is gay, deeply in love with his male secretary, Louis, and indifferent to Fiona. He married for one reason alone—to produce an heir under his mother Elizabeth's pressure, secure the family fortune, and defeat his rival half-brother, Jeff.  

Now, trapped in a loveless marriage and yearning for freedom, Fiona finds herself drawn into a dangerous affair… with a man whose secrets are even deadlier than her own.

title: Past love, Present promise
description: Jane, a single mother, gave birth to her son after a car accident. Seven years later, she reunites with her first love David, but the old pains still burn between them. In the darkness, young intern Tony lights up Jane like a flame—only to discover he is David’s cousin! Jane is forced to choose between the two brothers…

title: Puppy Love
description: Puppy Love is a fresh dating show where contestants go on a playdate with dogs for a chance to fall in love with their owners.

title: My Secret Alpha is My Lucky Puppy
description: The talented painter's daughter was forced by her biased and despicable father to become a ghostwriter for her illegitimate younger sister, reduced to a cleaning worker in a gallery, and even sold as a commodity at an underground auction. She was unexpectedly forcibly possessed by a mysterious tycoon and contracted for a flash marriage. What she didn't know was that this perfect husband who helped her fiercely revenge on her despicable father was not only the feared Alpha werewolf of the city, the "stray puppy" she saved ten years ago, but also the top bidder who had spent millions of dollars over the years to avidly collect all her paintings.

title: The MVP's Plus Size Love
description: In a tale of transformation and revenge, bullied high schooler Alexandra reinvents herself as "Lexi" with the help of childhood friend Dan, returning to expose her tormentors, reclaim her dignity, and find true love.

title: Pu Drénpa
description:
In the high mountains, beyond what most eyes can see, there are monks who do not control the cloud they invite them. This 90-second short captures a forgotten ritual, a silent dance between human energy and the breath of the sky.
A moment of mystical beauty, calm power, and sacred simplicity. Written and directed by Roger Delmont.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Purpose
description:
This short film was born from a simple idea: to create a story larger than its means. Though written by a human, the film was brought to life entirely through the use of artificial intelligence, from imagery to narration. By harnessing AI tools, the project transcended the traditional limits of budget and location, proving that meaningful storytelling is no longer confined by circumstance. This experiment is not about replacing the human voice, but amplifying it.

PURPOSE invites viewers into a visual parable set against the unforgiving desert, a landscape that serves as a metaphor for the hardest seasons of life. Through subtext and intimate narration, the film explores the weight we carry, the unseen voices that depend on our journey, and the hope that persists even when answers remain beyond the horizon. This short film transforms the desertscape into a mirror of our existence, offering not resolution but reflection, a reminder that beyond hardship lies not triumph, but purpose.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Super Triplets Help Mom Rule the Palace
description: Time-traveled into the ancient Cold Palace, Catherine gave birth to triplets. She got the Super Mom System. And she had to become the Empress to survive. Fortunately, her three kids had extraordinary talents. The eldest had innate divine power, the second could turn stone into gold, and the youngest had the ability to see a thousand miles and hear a thousand miles away. Her kids' father, Emperor Aaron, believed she was scheming and using her children to climb the ranks, but he gradually fell for her. Finally, Catherine became the Empress.

title: Crippled Prince's Love
description: Reborn and pregnant, Julia Monroe hides two secrets. To survive, she makes a deal with crippled Prince Adrian: she'll fix his legs, he'll protect her “bastard” twins. But as they unite against a common enemy, a greater secret emerges—the man she's healing holds the key to their true parentage.

title: Time-Traveled Emperor No More a Puppet
description: A modern man is reborn as a puppet emperor destined for a brutal death—starved in a dungeon, then torn apart by horses. But this time, he's not playing by the old rules. With a hidden "King's System" awakening, he starts a ruthless war against the power-hungry empress dowager. He crushes eunuchs, tames the harem, humiliates scholars, defeats foreign invaders, and expands the empire. From broken pawn to the greatest conqueror the world has ever seen.

title: ReelTalk EP 80-BroTalk: Pool Party
description: BroTalk is BACK! The Big Four from Taming My Bullies are taking over the pool. Cam Porras is hosting a pool party with friends (Travis Owens and Grant Garcia) when a mysterious lifeguard (Luke Dodge) crashes the fun and starts enforcing strange beach rules. Plus, stick around as the cast answers the burning questions fans have been buzzing about.

title: Trapped with the Cruel Prince
description: Journee, a modern forensic examiner, suddenly wakes up as the Seventh Princess Consort of the Solarian Kingdom. Her husband, Prince Liam, is rumored to be ruthless and cursed. With only the Dimensional Nexus System to guide her, she must raise his intimacy and clear his long-buried wrongful case to return home. She focuses on the mission, but Liam's growing attention may turn her carefully planned escape into something far more dangerous.

title: The Cripple Prince's Lucky Star
description: Once a heavenly spirit of fortune, Ivory is reborn as a princess, only to be cast aside by her own father. Saved by a disgraced prince, she uses her gift to turn misfortune into blessing, heal the wounded, and uncover her true identity. When a false "blessed girl" steals her name, Ivory must rise again, defying fate to reclaim her destiny and the love that was meant to be hers.

title: The Devil's Power Couple
description: Cast out years ago, Bonnie returns with a secret identity and a plan for revenge. As the mysterious "Satan," she seizes control of the Jones family, while her assistant Jacob turns out to be the powerful "Lucifer." Together, they crush their enemies and uncover a hidden conspiracy.

title: Once Upon A Breakup
description: After being abandoned on her birthday by her college boyfriend, Mia impulsively proposes to Carson, the charming but dangerous leader of the Moretti crime family. Though their relationship begins as a rash escape, it quickly turns into something real. But Mia’s ex refuses to let go. Obsessed, jealous, and spiraling out of control, he’ll stop at nothing to win her back, even if it means destroying the new life Mia’s trying to build with Carson. However, Mia isn’t looking back. She's thriving with Carson by her side and ready to show Aiden exactly what he threw away.

title: Tempted by My Step Son
description: After his mother’s death, billionaire heir Vincent became reckless, cold, and impossible to control. But everything snaps when his father Arthur brings home a mysterious woman who looks exactly like Vincent’s late mother — and even gives her his mother’s priceless jewels. Convinced Evelyn is a manipulative gold digger, Vincent sets out to expose her. But inside an abandoned greenhouse wrapped in vines, he uncovers her darkest secret… and a dangerous attraction neither of them can resist.

title: Gossip Plan
description: He is a billionaire, and she is an unknown actress. One accident made them swap bodies. They have to play each other's roles to avoid being discovered. Living each other's lives, solving each other's problems, and even seeing each other's bodies, they start to fall in love.

title: Win Their Hearts, Forge Your Fate
description: In a world spiraling into chaos, Baz Lee, a man in his fifties, discovers a system that reverses his aging by marrying multiple women. To navigate these turbulent times, he forms an unlikely alliance with Yasmine Lynch, a wounded female general. Disguised as a man, Yasmine joins Baz as they infiltrate a military camp, embarking on an epic journey from humble farmer to powerful warlord.

title: Campus Saga: Superpower Teen
description: The football captain humiliates me and has nude photos taken of me at school. At my lowest moment, I inherit my late father’s powerful conglomerate and a ring that activates five superpowers. I shed my weakness and turn my pain into revenge.

title: Sleep With A CEO After Fiancé's Betrayal
description: On my wedding day, my fiancé told me my sister was pregnant with his child. For the sake of family honor, I had to break off the engagement. That night, I had a one-night stand with a stranger. I thought he was just a cowboy, but little did I know, he was a possessive billionaire.

title: My Crippled Mate is the Alpha King
description: On the eve of her wedding, Cordelia Carter is framed by her stepmother and stepsister, drugged, and left to be ruined by wild wolves. Instead, she spends one night with Damian, the feared Duke of Broken Spine Fortress, accidentally breaking the seal on his hidden power. The next day, betrayed by her fiancé and cast out by her father, Cordelia is forced into a blood-contract marriage with Damian to save her sick brother. When her family later tries to destroy her wolf soul, Damian returns in full power to save her. Together, they take revenge, expose every conspiracy, and find love in the ruins.

title: Till Payday Do Us Part
description: After saving billionaire Jacob's nephew, Nina unexpectedly ends up married to Jacob himself. While dealing with a spoiled nephew who refuses to respect her and parents eager to cash in on her new status, Nina has no problem putting everyone in their place. She treats the marriage as a temporary arrangement and plans to leave with a generous divorce settlement. But as Jacob falls harder and harder for his outspoken wife, walking away becomes far more complicated than either of them expected.

title: My CEO Amnesia Puppy
description: James Bennett suffered amnesia after a car accident, retaining only 5-year-old memories. His passionate pursuit of Claire Reynolds shifted to hesitation after regaining memories. Claire, Ascend Corp's president, battled the Cooper family. James' ex-lover Vanessa Cooper sabotaged their marriage & hired thugs to harm Claire, landing jailed. Despite turmoil—misunderstandings, a rushed wedding & pregnancy—they reconciled & began anew.

title: A Promise to Keep
description: I am a ritual bride, I make a living by helping men who die young carry on their bloodline. I've already completed the rites for 107 such men, each case earning me three hundred silver coins. By tradition, I must perform the wedding ceremony with the deceased, then complete the rituals in a prepared bridal chamber. On this day, I took on my 108th job, my 108th "husband." Only this time, it seems to be a bit different from the past.

title: 10-Point Trap
description: Ethan Reed's parents always favored his sister, Iris. Every time he took an exam, her score was exactly ten points higher—and whenever he missed one, hers mysteriously tanked. Suspicious but silent, Ethan decided to expose the lie. He studied in secret, aiming for 741 on the finals. That would force Iris to score 751—the maximum possible score. His family, desperate to protect the scam, locked him at home and tried to destroy his admission papers. But Ethan fought back, broke free, and rewrote his own future at a top university.

title: The Emperor Is a Pawn
description: Sara, a workaholic from a cutthroat tech giant, wakes up in an imperial palace with nothing but a goofy, scatterbrained "system" by her side. But she's not here for love or loyalty, she's here to climb. Treating palace intrigue like office politics, Sara turns every superior into a stepping stone. Even the emperor? Just another tool for her next promotion.

title: The Devil Wears Desire
description: A woman with only three months left to live is caught in a dangerously seductive web. There’s the billionaire playboy who kept her as a secret lover but now brings his fiancée around, an ex-boyfriend back in her life with no memory of their painful history, and a mafia boss who sees his late wife in her, harboring a twisted desire to keep her close by any means. As lies and secrets blur the lines between love and obsession, what choice will she make?

title: Waking Up From a Deep Sleep
description: Three years ago, a car crash left Madeline Hayes in a vegetative state. Her darling cared for her, but he cheated and abused her, unaware she was semi-conscious. When Stella Brooks looted Madeline Hayes's room and beat Mia Thorne, Madeline Hayes woke up and struck Stella Brooks with a bat. A dispute ensued between Victor Thorne and Stella Brooks. Stella Brooks killed Victor Thorne and then herself. Madeline Hayes and Mia Thorne lived happily ever after.

title: The Eternal Protector and His Fragile Fiancée
description:
An immortal was tricked before his death into marrying a foolish granddaughter of a powerful family. Initially, he planned to ignore her, but he soon discovered that her unique bloodline was essential to his cultivation. Reluctantly, he decided to secretly protect her. The female lead was once infamous as the "madwoman" of her family, known for her violent and unpredictable personality, as well as her unfathomable skills in poison. However, when faced with her savior, she chose to hide her true self, pretending to be an obedient and gentle girl by his side.

Yet, her younger sister, driven by greed for the family fortune, relentlessly bullied and oppressed her. Forced into a corner, the female lead had no choice but to transform into a ruthless figure in the shadows, hiding her true nature from her savior as she navigated the challenges and dangers that surrounded them.

title: Someone Loved is Never Lost
description: For seven years, Christmas meant grief––until Raphael Stone sees a face he thought he'd never see again. Lucy, his beloved wife, is alive, but she can't move or talk anymore. Worse, she doesn't seem to remember him at all. Will true love triumph over pain and misfortune?

title: 10-Point Trap
description: Ethan Reed's parents always favored his sister, Iris. Every time he took an exam, her score was exactly ten points higher—and whenever he missed one, hers mysteriously tanked. Suspicious but silent, Ethan decided to expose the lie. He studied in secret, aiming for 741 on the finals. That would force Iris to score 751—the maximum possible score. His family, desperate to protect the scam, locked him at home and tried to destroy his admission papers. But Ethan fought back, broke free, and rewrote his own future at a top university.

title: A Promise to Keep
description: I am a ritual bride, I make a living by helping men who die young carry on their bloodline. I've already completed the rites for 107 such men, each case earning me three hundred silver coins. By tradition, I must perform the wedding ceremony with the deceased, then complete the rituals in a prepared bridal chamber. On this day, I took on my 108th job, my 108th "husband." Only this time, it seems to be a bit different from the past.

title: The Alpha's Secret Pup
description: Blind Ayla is "sold" by her fiancé to Ronan, the Wolf King of the North. After one night of passion, she is framed by a witch and exiled from the wolf territory. She struggles to survive alone with the Wolf King's child. A year later, her daughter Lumi unexpectedly reunites with Ronan. Facing the witch's pursuit, her fiancé's betrayal, and Ronan's probing, Ayla hides her true identity and secretly plots her revenge. Meanwhile, as Ronan investigates the truth, he gradually realizes he has long been caught in an emotional vortex for Ayla—and willingly becomes the weapon of her vengeance. Curses intertwine with true love, setting off a bittersweet romance that defies race and destiny.

title: Oops, I Leveled Up the Apocalypse
description: Reborn as a post-apocalyptic underling, Finn binds the "Wife Pampering System" and chooses three women everyone despises: a paralyzed S-rank, a mutant, and a dying clone. Laughter turns to shock as Finn's serum awakens their powers, telekinesis, super strength, and instant teleportation. Together, they crush enemies, but Colonel Zeller's missile strikes and city-wide hunt threaten to wipe them out. Survival just became war.

title: Snack in a Plant Trap
description: Arrogant genius falls into a jungle where every plant-woman and vine-guy wants a bite. He came to save the world. Now he's just running.

title: Oops, My General Hubby Can Hear My Thoughts
description: When science whiz Sydney Long unexpectedly dies, she wakes up in the past as the bride of the infamous villain General Jake! Planning to stay under the radar, she aims to play nice, earn money, and step aside for Jake's true love, the "ninth wife". But on their wedding night, Jake hears her thoughts: "Isn't he the General Jake with the ninth wife scandal?" Confused, Jake wonders, "Father has only eight wives—who's the ninth?"

title: The Paw Prince
description: A cursed prince, unaware that he transforms into a dog, becomes the target of an evil princess who schemes to marry him while trying to rid the kingdom of the dog, not realizing her kindhearted twin secretly loves the very creature he becomes.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Sleep With A CEO After Fiancé's Betrayal
description: On my wedding day, my fiancé told me my sister was pregnant with his child. For the sake of family honor, I had to break off the engagement. That night, I had a one-night stand with a stranger. I thought he was just a cowboy, but little did I know, he was a possessive billionaire.

title: Swapped Brides, Swapped Fates
description: Murdered by her sister Serena, Grace Thorne awakens on her wedding day to the Quinn family. Armed with memories of betrayal, she sees the truth: her charming husband Mason is hollow, her sister is venomous, and her new family is greedy. This time, Grace plays a different game. She'll reclaim her power, expose the conspiracy that destroyed her bloodline, and make every traitor pay. But as her vengeance unfolds, the secrets of her frail husband, Cyrus Quinn, may change everything.

title: Trapped by the Hunter
description: My scholar husband Edmund sold me for 300 bucks to hunter Rowan, a cruel fate every village woman feared. I waited for brutal mistreatment, but he brought wild flowers, stewed chicken and swore to give me time. My greedy in-laws sneaked in at night, beat me and stole his rare white pheasants, ruining Edmund’s exam future. Broken-handed, drunk and drowning, he begged for forgiveness at our grand wedding. Yet I held Rowan’s hand—this contracted wife finally earned a real, warm marriage of my own.

title: Entangled with My Ex's Brother
description: In a past life, Beatrice was utterly betrayed. After being reborn, she publicly exposes her fiancé's hypocrisy and turns to collaborate with the wildest member of the Sterling family. "Shall we cooperate, Sebastian Sterling?" she proposes, only to be unexpectedly outmaneuvered. "I want to be your devoted ally!" From then on, the lofty heir of the Sterling family bows only to her...

title: JEJAK BOS
description:
ciige/Reno Elmontana adalah pebisnis kaya dari China. ia datang ke Batam, Indonesia. untuk membangun kerajaan Bisnis baru. ia mendapati dirinya terjebak di tengah sabotase,pengkhianatan dan perbedaan budaya yang nyaris menjatuhkannya.
