namun lewat pertemuan tak terduga dengan Har Deniro. pria lokal yang lihai membaur dan mampu menguasai strategi branding, Ciige menemukan sekutu yang mampu mengubah arah pertarungan bersama, merekabukan hanya melawan musuh yang bermain dari balik bayangan, tapi juga menulis ulang aturan permainan bisnis di kota itu, dengan kepercayaan dan visi sebagai senjata utama.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Not Daddy Anymore, Just Alpha
description:
Seven years ago, Fallon, the sole heir of the Northfall Kingdom, eloped for love, renouncing her throne. She hid her identity with Kellan, her savior, becoming a scorned "stray mate" among the Emberfang wolf pack.

For seven years, she endured humiliation. Yet Kellan spent his days with his late brother’s widow Briar to seize power, letting the pack treat her and her five-year-old son Knox like servants and bastards. Publicly rejected on her son’s birthday and brutally beaten, Fallon’s heart died.

She stopped holding back, awakened her royal blood power, and fled back to Northfall with Knox. When her father, the Alpha King, passed the crown to them, Kellan and the pack realized whom they had wronged. Kellan was forced to mark Briar, then stabbed by her; both died. The declining Emberfang pack begged for mercy but was refused. Fallon and Knox ascended, completing a sharp rise from disdained mate to supreme queen.

title: Jackpot Love
description: He thought money would buy happiness and a new bride.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: A Zombie Girl’s Journey Home
description: When the apocalypse descended, Anya, a girl with severe social anxiety, deliberately infected herself to escape both survival and socializing. Unexpectedly, she retained her human consciousness and became a “freak zombie” with absolutely no combat power. She shouldered her backpack and embarked on a southbound road trip in search of her family. Along the way, her innate kindness led her to save survivors time and again. She met Zane, a cold and ruthless human killing machine; Leon, a fellow zombie male lead with overwhelming combat prowess; and Mia, a mad virologist. She also adopted an apocalypse-level adorable zombie dog. To find her family and uncover the truth behind the virus, the three people and one dog formed a quirky wasteland team, beginning a trope-defying, laugh-out-loud healing journey through the apocalypse.

title: Judgment from Beyond
description: The Taoist priest and the police officer, he has two identities, both quirky and thrilling. He possesses the strongest martial arts and Taoist magic. His favorite thing to do is to punish bad guys!

title: A Joke Destroyed My Child
description: Author Hayley's husband Ryan plays an annual April Fools' "dare" game with his childhood sweetheart Summer. This year he tricks Hayley into signing an annulment, then marries Summer. Hayley loses her baby in a miscarriage while Ryan abandons her; she takes her copyrights, goes independent, and her career soars. Ryan repents and confesses publicly; his company collapses and Summer goes insane. In the end: on another April Fools' Day, Summer attacks with a knife, Ryan says "this time I lost," and Summer breaks down crying.

title: I'm a Witch, But I Just Want to Farm
description: To escape relentless pursuit by her enemies, the century-old witch Elara assumes a new identity and takes refuge in the impoverished, lawless town of Windvale, where she is sheltered by the honorable knight Aldric. As Elara secretly uses her magic to improve the townspeople’s lives, affection blossoms between them. When her enemies arrive and expose her true identity, Elara and Aldric fight side by side to defeat them. Together, they lead Windvale into a new era of prosperity and marry with the townspeople’s blessing. Yet the Magic Council, which once watched from the shadows, now appears to have set its sights on this newly revived land…

title: The Judge
description: Haunted by his brother’s murder, elite soldier Lucas Hayes infiltrates The Lockwood Family to protect his sister-in-law, Cynthia Sinclair. Fighting corporate sabotage, poisoning, and dark forces after a secret energy formula, Lucas resolves multiple crises. What begins as hostility slowly turns to quiet devotion as Lucas faces down danger after danger. When he unleashes his global connections to turn the tide, his fearsome true identity—The Judge—is laid bare. In a final, explosive reckoning, he crushes the conspiracy, avenges his brother, and vows to protect Cynthia forever.

title: Did You Just Poison Me, Wife?
description: Daniel transmigrates into the body of a degenerate gambler, only to wake up and realize his own wife has just poisoned him. Salvation arrives in the form of the "Daily Intelligence System", which grants him crucial foresight each day. Seizing this second chance, Daniel completely reforms, and leverages modern knowledge to introduce advanced firearms, single-handedly turning the tide of battle and earning a noble title. Yet, his greatest challenge comes not from war, but from a rift in time itself, threatening to separate him from the wife he has grown to cherish.

title: I Am Not Just a Wife
description: After six years of marriage, Wendy discovers her husband is still in love with his first love and that even their daughter has drifted away from her. She files for divorce and returns to medicine, reemerging as the brilliant prodigy known as "Su." As Wendy rises, her ex-husband realizes too late that she was the one he loved all along. With the support of Milo, Wendy builds a new life on her own terms.

title: The Seduction of Jac Frost
description:
Twenty-five years after being left at a New York City hospital as a brand new infant, Jacqueline Frost has defied the odds and is now thriving as a young woman. She might not have a lot of friends, or any family, but she has a job she excels at and she’s finally going to get her big break. Cherry picked by her supervisor to present her ideas to the CEO of Vaughan Professional Consulting, she is excited to finally get a chance to play with the big boys.
Wilder Vaughn is the CEO of a consulting firm which helps repair the images of screwed up celebrities, athletes and politicians and frankly anyone else who will spend money to make their problems go away with some decent PR tweaking. When one of his directors tells him over and over about the brilliant woman named Jacqueline in his department, he finally agrees to let her pitch to him on a major client. He wished he’d agreed sooner.
Jacqueline Frost walks into his office and he immediately knows she’s special. One shake of her hand and the CEO, who also happens to be a prince to the queen of all the Southern Realm fae-folk, finally finds his mate after years of searching for her. The problem? She doesn’t know she’s fae.
When Rafferty Vaughn is called to an emergency meeting in his twin brother’s office where he lords over humans like some kind of prick with a superiority complex, he is immediately jealous of the fact his twin found his mate first. Then she walks in and when he introduces himself, a single touch of her hand reveals she is his mate too.
The fates are playing an irritating game. The brothers need to decide quickly what their next moves are. They haven’t gotten along since they were teenagers and haven’t shared a meal in peace let alone a mate. Will they try to force one or the other to sever the bond to allow one brother to have their mate to themselves or will they work together? 
To complicate matters all the more Jacqueline is the missing princess to the king of the Northern Realm, Jack Frost. Since the king has blamed the Vaughn family all along for the loss of his daughter, the twins are fighting an uphill battle against a woman who thinks they are crazy and a king who wants his daughter to go home with him instead of staying in the human world or with spoiled princes who can’t agree on anything.
Jacqueline is freaking out. When her biological family come out of the woodwork, she finds her father is the Jack Frost, her mother apparently suffered some kind of mental break when she was kidnapped as an infant moments after her birth, and she has two siblings who don’t seem to like her very much, despite what they claim. Her boss and his brother are calling her mate. She’d give anything to just let things go back to the way they were. So what does she do?
She insists on working with the client she was pitching for and ends up following the troubled skier to a small idyllic town in Colorado to help him fix his image. She doesn’t expect, however, that her two new mates, her entire biological family and the twins’ families to follow her. 
What ensues is a comedic, romantic, free-for-all where Jacqueline dodges every attempt at everyone trying to seduce her to their side. The seduction of Jac Frost has begun and it’s every man for himself, until someone starts causing trouble and Jacqueline’s life might be on the line. Then it’s a show of solidarity between a group of people who never wanted to work together but they’ll do anything to keep their princess safe. They’re going to have to figure out how to make it all work or they may lose her forever.

title: A Doctor Wife's Revenge
description:
After years of devotedly caring for her family, she was met with relentless ingratitude from her husband and son—who even brazenly vowed to form a "real family" with a glamorous actress. Heartbroken by their betrayal, fate intervened when she saved the life of an influential industry titan during a medical emergency. As a skilled doctor, she earned both his admiration and steadfast support, emboldening her to divorce her toxic marriage.
Guided by the mogul’s mentorship, she reclaimed her identity and blossomed into her own spotlight: excelling in her medical career, radiating confidence, and crafting a life of purpose. Meanwhile, the delusional father-son duo, who’d believed their fantasy would thrive, soon drowned in regret—one desperately chasing redemption as a son, the other pleading for a second chance as a husband, both left to mourn the irreplaceable woman they’d taken for granted.

title: My Janitor Dad Is a Legend
description: He hid his identity for 20 years to raise his son. When his vain future daughter-in-law called off the wedding, she had no idea she’d just awakened a hidden king.

title: The Judge
description: Haunted by his brother’s murder, elite soldier Lucas Hayes infiltrates The Lockwood Family to protect his sister-in-law, Cynthia Sinclair. Fighting corporate sabotage, poisoning, and dark forces after a secret energy formula, Lucas resolves multiple crises. What begins as hostility slowly turns to quiet devotion as Lucas faces down danger after danger. When he unleashes his global connections to turn the tide, his fearsome true identity—The Judge—is laid bare. In a final, explosive reckoning, he crushes the conspiracy, avenges his brother, and vows to protect Cynthia forever.

title: Bad Son-in-Law, Go to Jail
description: Eleanor bought a big villa for her daughter-in-law Diana. One day, she excitedly brought her old best friend Marian, who is also Diana's mother, to visit the villa. But they were stopped outside by a strange woman. Who was she? Before the two old friends could figure it out, the woman pointed at Eleanor's nose and scolded her as a thief...

title: More Than Just His Sister
description: Business mogul Eliza Reed returns home with plans to rescue her husband Julian's faltering company, only to discover his suspicious closeness with his secretary, Quinny. Julian insists Quinny is just like a sister to him, yet she possesses Eliza's personal belongings and her late mother's heirloom. Confronted with her husband's favoritism and betrayal, Eliza awakens to the truth and finally decides to divorce him.

title: Mother's Justice
description: After three years in a coma, Vivian wakes to find her life stolen. Her husband Zane and the maid's daughter, Claire, have seized her company, erased her identity, and tormented her daughter, Lily. Stripped of everything, Vivian must play a dangerous game. Using her wits and hidden allies, she exposes the betrayal, unveils the deception, and fights to reclaim her empire, her name, and her child's future.

title: Till Jail Do Us Part
description: After $5 million is stolen from a powerful criminal organization and their husbands—the gang’s leaders—are arrested, four feuding wives are forced to work together to recover the money before it’s too late, discovering just how far they’re willing to go to protect their families—and who they truly are beneath it all.

title: Age 8, Justice Straight
description: Tucker, a seasoned detective in his past life, is reborn in ancient times as an eight-year-old low-ranking official. When the Righteous Magistrate System awakens, he quickly solves a kidnapping case, outwits corrupt gentry, and defeats bandits. Using the system's rewards, he gains martial arts skills and wisdom. Watch as he uses his newfound powers to serve the people, punish evil, and leave his mark on history!

title: My Boss Gave Me a Junk Boat, Now I'm Rich
description: Fisk uses ocean-current data and an old Ship's Log to predict the route of a massive bluefin tuna migration worth millions. When he demands 7 years of unpaid wages from Dylan who rules the dock, he is mocked, blacklisted, and given only a derelict boat, the Old Seagull. Refusing to quit, Fisk restores the vessel and risks everything on one voyage. Against all odds, he lands a fortune in bluefin tuna and proves his doubters wrong in a stunning comeback.

title: Rose in Chains
description: Hate has chained their fates together, love is the only key. Mafia Boss Liam swore to destroy the man that killed his father, even keeping his daughter Rose captive. Torn between his thirst for revenge and obsessive fascination with the fallen heiress, Liam finds himself just as much a prisoner to Rose. When the bloody truth behind their past is finally revealed, they realize they were never meant for devastating hatred, but instead love.

title: Kiss Me 99 Times a Day
description: Alice Breslin, desperate to ditch a sleazy guy, impulsively kisses CEO Anson Vega. The next thing she knows, he whisks her away and they get married on the spot. After their whirlwind wedding, they slowly start developing feelings for each other as they spend their days together. In a dramatic twist, Anson unexpectedly discovers that the genius "Sam" he's been searching for all along is actually Alice.

title: Marrying A Millionaire with My Baby
description: The framed CEO had sex with the woman, but the person who framed him arranged a scumbag man to lie that he had sex with the woman in order to escape the blame. After the woman gave birth to quadruplets, she was told that only one child survived. Many years later, the scumbag man got a promotion and got the woman's house, so he kicked the woman out of the house. At this time, the woman and the CEO reunited...

title: Fake Scar, Real Jerk, True Regret
description: Sienna, the daughter of the world's richest man, attended university while hiding her identity. Accidentally, she got disfigured in a fire to save her boyfriend Chris. Before the graduation ceremony, she always wore a fake scar sticker. Chris also acted like a good man. Just when she thought Chris had withstood her test and was ready to offer him a high-paying job, Chris mistakenly believed Iris to be the daughter of the richest man at the graduation ceremony and humiliated Sienna in every way...

title: Cyberking Reclaims His Throne
description: Max Lennox is the world's number one hacker, CYBERKING. Just when he's about to uncover the Pentagon's secrets and expose them to the world, he gets betrayed by his girlfriend, who shoves him off the roof! He miraculously survives, but loses all his memories... except for his genius hacking skills. He gets saved by a kind-hearted programmer, Suki Ruskin. Together, they try to get Max's memory back, hoping to figure out who did this to him. Will he ultimately reclaim his throne as The CYBERKING?

title: I Sent My Son's Fiancée to Jail
description: On the eve of my son's engagement, I fly to Jefferton and buy the largest villa as a gift for my future daughter-in-law. By chance, I run into a woman bidding for the same mansion, only to discover she is my son's fiancée. Worse still, I uncover her secret: she cheated on my son, is pregnant with another man's child, and plans to pass it off as his. She flaunts her powerful backer, never realizing the man she's bragging about… is me.

title: Uncle William, Please Say I Do!
description: After Alaina saves powerful businessman William from a near-fatal car accident, he gives her a promise. Months later, William finds her at his nephew Jason's engagement party—only to discover she's Jason’s fiancée. Though he hides his feelings, William gifts her a family heirloom. When Jason betrays her, Alaina breaks off the engagement. With her grandmother's Alzheimer’s worsening and a wedding wish unfulfilled, Alaina asks William to marry her in a secret one-year contract. William sees this as his chance to win her heart, and as he protects her, Alaina also starts to fall for him.

title: Hello, Let's Get Married
description: Married moments after meeting for the first time, new couple Maya Moore and Ethan Armstrong attempt to make their spontaneous marriage work despite interference from their enemies and Maya’s mysterious past.

title: Too Late, My Rejected Mate
description: Selene, the noble Lycan Princess, loved the East Coast Alpha Caleb for eighteen years, only to be betrayed, drained of her blood, and brutally murdered by him and his Omega lover, Elara, in her past life. Miraculously reborn on the night of the Blood Moon Altar, Selene refuses to make the same mistake. Instead of Caleb, she chooses Kael, an Alpha bound by a dark witch's curse. Forced to endure Caleb's arrogant humiliations and cruelties under the temporary effects of a secrecy potion, Selene patiently bides her time. With Kael ultimately breaking his curse to become an unmatched ancient Lycan, will Selene successfully rewrite her tragic fate, expose the traitors, and claim her throne as the ultimate Lycan Queen?

title: Rejected Alpha, Risen King
description:
Adrian, the Silver‑Moon Alpha, spent twenty years in seclusion. After awakening under the Blood Moon, he descends to Raven’s Port to honor his betrothal, only to be humiliated by Scarlett.
He demonstrates his power in Raven’s Port and is recruited as a consultant by the Supernatural Affairs Bureau. After moving into the manor, he learns from the Lunar‑Crown Mirror that he is the reincarnated vessel of Valerius, the Speaker of the Blood Moon Council.
The Blood Moon Council creates a Lily clone intended to detonate and destroy the city. Instead, the replica sacrifices itself to protect the city and reveals Lily’s whereabouts.
Adrian awakens demigod power, at the cost of having only three years left to live. He then flies to Europe with Scarlett and the others to rescue Lily and confront Valerius head‑on.

title: Rejected, Got a New Husband
description: Rejected by her whole family, Rebecca uses a system to be reborn. Then she gets a bold proposal from her ex's rival, Xavier Kingsley. Strangely, Xavier knows all her habits and always defends her against her toxic past. She assumes she is just a substitute for him, but turns out, she is his true love!

title: ME AND JAMES DEAN
description: Me and James Dean represents a young man's relationship with the world around him. After suffering from a near-death experience after an accidental overdose, Chase embarks on a cross-country road trip back to his hometown. Accompanied by the spirit of James Dean, Chase confronts his shortcomings, reconciles relationships with his family, and makes peace with his life before he passes away. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Pampered by My Silver Fox Uncle
description: On her coming-of-age day, Princess Lia Torres of the Phoen Dynasty finds her soul transported into the body of an 8-year-old girl in the modern world. This girl, deprived of love by an imposter daughter, met a tragic end through neglect. Fueled by indignation, Lia takes on a new life with a disrespected father who is scorned by all.

title: The Adjuster
description: After his sister dies due to losing health coverage, Matteo Leone, a broken man, takes justice into his own hands by killing the insurance company CEO. But he isn't just out for revenge, he has a bigger goal: Expose corrupt health insurance companies for preying on their most vulnerable customers. Matteo stays one step ahead of the police, leaving a trail of clues to send his message, soon becoming a hero to the people the evil CEO's thought they could silence.

title: Tao's Magical Journey
description: Tao is an anxious college student whose life is split between the chaotic anxiety of her classroom and the magnificent, magical world she enters every time she falls asleep, where she is Princess Tao, the confident leader of three elemental Warrior Princesses. Though she begins the journey overwhelmed and confused by her royal duty, a crisis forces her to discover that the intense, over-the-top feelings she experiences in her real life are the source of her magical strength. With her eyes glowing pink, she commands the power of the Earth, only to be violently ripped back to her boring reality the moment her magic peaks. The series follows Tao as she learns how to integrate her warrior leader persona into her real life, harnessing her anxiety to protect her fantasy kingdom and ultimately, to gain the courage she needs to survive her own.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Bound to My Heiress
description: In her previous life, Stella mistook Isaac for her savior and, out of gratitude, agreed to marry him. Unbeknownst to her, the true hero, Adrian, had lost his memory due to an accident and ended up as her bodyguard, silently protecting her. It wasn't until her final moments that Stella realized the truth: Isaac's heart belonged to her stepsister, Ivy. This ruthless pair not only wove a web of lies but also meticulously plotted against her. Stella passed away with a heart full of resentment. However, fate granted her a second chance...

title: Peace Out, I'm Marrying Someone Else
description: Oliver Logan is the wealthiest man in the world, but even his vast fortune can't hold onto Chloe Stone. Confident in Oliver's love, Chloe brazenly uses his money to support her lover. Once Oliver sees her true colors, he finally awakens to the truth. Now, he's going to tell them he's marrying someone else and ensure they lose everything!

title: Xue Bao's Magical Journey
description: The kitten Xuebao accompanied her owner to the Forbidden City for a visit. After getting separated from her owner, she accidentally stumbled into a parallel world dominated by cats (a complete feline imperial court with a Cat Emperor, Cat Empress Dowager, Cat Harem, and Cat Concubines),where all the intrigues, rivalries, and power struggles of a royal court were in full swing.In this world, though each cat held a distinct status, none could resist their inherently silly and adorable feline nature, viewing everything through their unique perspectives.Gradually adapting to this world, Xuebao longed only to return to. To survive, she had to abide by the rules of this realm and seek a way back to the normal world within the Cat Palace.After some investigation, Xuebao discovered that obtaining the golden collar held by the Cat Empress Dowager was the key to reconnecting with the real world. But to get it, she had to become the Cat Empress.After navigating the initial chaos, Xuebao began strategizing step by step, starting as a Cat Concubine to establish her footing in the harem, gradually rising in rank to get closer to the Empress Dowager and fulfill her plan to return home.Along the way, she faced the unpredictable schemes and hidden daggers of the feline court, but also shared laughter and companionship with fellow cats, encountering strange and wondrous tales from all corners ofthe Cat Dynasty. Through these tumultuous adventures, Xuebao learned a new perspective from Emperor Dundun that cats must be free and independent.She began to shed her ingrained belief in being cared for as a pet, instead learning to help others, awaken her inner independence,and gain fresh insights into life and selfworth.In the end, just as Xuebao was about to return to the real world, the Cat Palace faced unprecedented calamity and crisis.Torn between resuming her old life or staying to help the cats who had aided her and avert disaster, what choice will Xuebao make?*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: I, The Contracted Djinn
description: Eli Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Eli freedom– but on one condition: Eli must marry his granddaughter, Christine Parrish, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Eli transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Eli starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. Then, when Christine's old flame reenters the picture, Eli's heart is completely shattered. Now, Eli is faced with a tough decision– should he stay by Christine's side once the final wish is granted, or is it time to for him to divorce Christine and finally live his own life?

title: Vengeance & Grace: Millionaire's Cherished Wife
description: Betrayal, miscarriage, and death. Now reborn, Gwen Miller marries the nation's wealthiest man, Caspian Guillot. With newfound strength and determination, she now wants blood.

title: True Heiress Takes High School
description:
Lila Lawson, the daughter of the Murphy family's maid, used her connections to her advantage, posing as the real heiress. Meanwhile, the real heiress, Macie Murphy, faced disgrace when she was accused of cheating, and no one believed that Lila had framed her.
Humiliation. Bankruptcy. Death.
Now reborn, Macie is back in high school.

title: Reborn: To Tear Off Her Mask
description: In the 1980s, Milo secretly admired the factory director's daughter, Hailey. He even risked everything to save her from losing her virginity, only to be falsely accused of assault, ruining his life. Now, reborn on that fateful day of final reckoning, Milo seeks justice. This time, who else will regret crossing him?

title: Peace Out, I'm Marrying Someone Else
description: Oliver Logan is the wealthiest man in the world, but even his vast fortune can't hold onto Chloe Stone. Confident in Oliver's love, Chloe brazenly uses his money to support her lover. Once Oliver sees her true colors, he finally awakens to the truth. Now, he's going to tell them he's marrying someone else and ensure they lose everything!

title: Hey General, Your Disabled Husband’s Running Away
description: Rosia Monroe, the fierce General of Zhenri, finds herself in a scandalous predicament after her body is inhabited for three years by a transmigrator. Upon regaining control, she discovers her reputation tarnished as a lovestruck fool, and her husband disillusioned. Determined to restore her honor, Rosia confronts villains and rekindles her love. Finally, she picks up her spear to defend her country in the battlefield.

title: The Double Life of My Deliveryman Husband
description: Verna Collins came to the city to visit her daughter Sheryl Vance, who had just given birth to a baby. However, she met Ivy Wright, who was posing as a beggar to find an ideal wife for her wealthy father Emerson Wright. Ivy was charmed by Verna's kindness and arranged a blind date between Verna and Emerson. Emerson, thinking Verna was a fraud, pretended to be a delivery man. But to his surprise, Verna didn't care. Emerson was captivated by Verna's kindness and gentleness and quickly married her. However, at this time, Verna discovered that Sheryl had been deceiving her by using excuses not to let her see her grandson. Sheryl even hired an actor to pretend to be her at her grandson's party. Verna angrily confronted Sheryl, but the latter accused her of being a fraud. Just as Verna was being beaten by her in-laws, Emerson, who had been attending the party incognito, stepped in to stop them. The Dylan family, unaware of Emerson's identity, learned from Sheryl that Emerson was just a delivery man and insulted him. At this moment, the vice president of the Wright Group was invited to the party and was shocked to see Emerson. He immediately stopped the Dylan family from insulting him. But at Emerson's hint, he didn't reveal Emerson's identity. As a result, the Dylan family lost the cooperation with the Wright Group that was within their grasp, but blamed Verna, thinking she had deliberately embarrassed. Verna was heartbroken after seeing through Sheryl's true colors. To cheer her up, Emerson took her to a real estate agency and said he would buy her a house. Of course, to maintain his poor image, he bought a second-hand house. But they happened to run into Sheryl, who was there with Natalie to buy a house...

title: Silent Divorce, Loud Regrets
description: A car accident gave Moxie aphasia, yet her husband, eager to please his secret lover, proposed a fake divorce. Moxie finally wakes up. He wants a divorce? He's going to get one. But guess who will be regretting it?

title: The CEO's Most Wanted
description: She was his perfect trophy wife, until his betrayal set her free. Now, Saylor Bell has built an empire from the skills she learned decorating his home and hosting his parties. She's a self-made millionaire with the world at her feet, and her ex-husband, Remi Webb, is desperate to win her back. But he's too late—the most powerful man in town, Jai Nash, is already on one knee, ready to make the woman Remi discarded his queen.

title: The True Heiress’s Revenge
description: Amelia Glyn, heiress to the Glyn Group, enters university posing as a commoner—only to be targeted by the bully, Vivian Lowe, who steals her admission spot. But when Amelia's true identity is revealed and an explosive secret about her father’s illegitimate daughter is uncovered, a fierce battle over family name and fortune erupts.

title: Genius Babies Saves the Day!
description: In the final of the Global Super Brain Showdown, Team Ofror was on the brink of defeat. Just when all hope seemed lost, an unexpected hero emerged—8-year-old Leland Griffin. He solved impossible Rubik's cubes, detected microscopic differences in water, and assembled a star chart with pinpoint accuracy. Against all odds, he led his team to a stunning victory. Turned out, in his body was the soul of Harvey Bowers, the greatest scientist on earth!

title: 24 Hours to Save Her
description: Howard was once the Undefeated Boxing King. However, during a crucial match, he was drugged by his opponent, leading to a devastating loss. In the violent aftermath, he tragically lost his beloved daughter. His wife left him, and he was expelled from the boxing association. He had to scrape by as a food delivery man. Then he met a single mom Nancy and her daughter Mia, and they got along well. Later, a rich man wanted Mia's kidney for his own daughter, but Howard saved Mia...

title: Contract Wife Is a Drama Queen
description: Adrian, unhappy with his family's arranged marriage plans, hires Chloe, a spirited pig butcher, to be his contract bride. Chloe accepts the role for financial gain, skillfully navigating challenges and adversaries. As they grow closer, hidden truths about Adrian's past and Chloe's true identity emerge. Amidst the revelations, they find themselves falling in love, their destinies intertwined by fate.

title: Bound to My Heiress
description: In her previous life, Stella mistook Isaac for her savior and, out of gratitude, agreed to marry him. Unbeknownst to her, the true hero, Adrian, had lost his memory due to an accident and ended up as her bodyguard, silently protecting her. It wasn't until her final moments that Stella realized the truth: Isaac's heart belonged to her stepsister, Ivy. This ruthless pair not only wove a web of lies but also meticulously plotted against her. Stella passed away with a heart full of resentment. However, fate granted her a second chance...

title: Clinging to My Alpha Mom
description: Wendy, heir to a martial arts clan, is betrayed by her own family, left with amnesia, and written off as a fool. However, everything changes after a daring rescue. Posing as a mother to her rescuer, Minny, she teams up with Theo, a "cripple" hiding a deadly agenda. Together, they take down their enemies, reclaim the martial arts studio, and shatter every lie until the final truth reunites them as a real family.

title: His Immortal Majesty
description: A being older than gods awakens once every fifty years—for ten years of fun. He rules the Divine Court, with four lieutenants holding power over war, wealth, beauty, and fame. Before his last sleep, a family head playfully promised him a granddaughter. Now he's back. That family has betrayed him. The granddaughter tears up the engagement. They have no idea who they just crossed.

title: When a Morden Girl Fell Into the Prince’s Harem
description: When actress Zoe Sanchez is transported to ancient times, she becomes a concubine to Prince Alfred. Trapped in his treacherous harem, she must outsmart rivals and win the Prince's heart using her modern wit. From unwanted servant to undeniable favorite—her most dangerous role begins now.

title: 3 Months Left, The Heiress Strikes Back
description: Diagnosed with terminal cancer and given three months to live, she starts taking revenge on those who hurt her. Then, a call from the doctor reveals it was a misdiagnosis!

title: My Plumber Boyfriend Is a Hidden Heir
description: Evan appears to be a plumber who left school to support his ailing father, but in reality, his father is a wealthy tycoon. During a repair job, he meets Serena, a school beauty, and after learning she's been disowned by her family, he offers her shelter. Then, the two decide to pretend to be a couple to handle their respective issues. Meanwhile, Tyler, who has feelings for Serena, retaliates by targeting Evan and undermining Serena's family business. It's not until Evan's supposedly ill parents reveal themselves that Tyler and Serena's father realize their mistake. Ultimately, Evan and Serena achieve both love and career success.

title: A Tangle of Love
description: In a romance-themed observation show, several participants undergo a series of interactions and conflicts filled with love, misunderstandings, and power struggles. In the end, one couple rises to overwhelming popularity, and true love prevails as they happily end up together.

title: Great-Grandma is the Supreme Cultivator
description: Leonard Poe, descendant of Veronica Poe, falls for Ivory Sowle—unwittingly making an enemy of her jealous admirer, Frank Lawson, who ruins his career and forces him into delivery work. Witnessing her three powerful adopted heirs abuse their power to oppress her own great-grandson, Veronica decides to reshuffle Great Arkland's elite families, overthrow the corrupt order, and raise the kind-hearted Leonard to power.

title: The Forsaken's Revenge
description: Ethan, young master of the Summers family, awakens a unique martial soul, only to be scorned as the weakest of its kind, facing constant humiliation. Unwilling to succumb to fate, Ethan sets out on a solitary journey, overcoming numerous trials and unlocking the true potential of his devouring martial soul.

title: Return to Claim Her
description: The billionaire Adrian died in an accidental fire. His wife Helen tried hard to keep his family fortune. Adrian's family didn't want a woman to take charge. Helen did not care about the gossip of relatives. But one day, Adrian's younger brother Nathan came back at his brother's funeral, holding Adrian's will in his hand. Nathan claimed that his brother had left everything to him and he was the true heir of the Vaughn family. But what surprised Helen even more was that Nathan looked exactly like Adrian... Is he really her husband's brother?

title: Your Majesty, I Am Loyal to You
description: Aaronian time-travels to a dynasty and becomes a small‑town magistrate. He accidentally gets caught in a deadly power struggle between an empress and her corrupt ministers. To stay alive, he fights back with modern tricks—crushing conspiracies one by one. Now, he and the empress join forces to save the empire and bring peace.

title: Marry My Fake Brother After Rebirth
description: She's the adopted daughter of a billionaire family, yet she bears her brother's child. She always thought he just wanted to possess her, but after their adoptive mother's murder, she realizes her brother truly loves her. Upon rebirth, she decides to be with her brother and not repeat past mistakes.

title: The Heiress's Regret: Spoiled by Her Three Brothers
description: Once the beloved little princess of her family, she turned her back on them for the sake of her boyfriend, willing to sacrifice everything for love. But when he reveals his true colors after securing a massive investment, he tries to cast her aside for the wealthy daughter of a powerful businessman. Just as she faces humiliation from her ex and his family, her three brothers swoop in to reclaim her. They embark on a journey of revenge against the ex, showering her with love and support, while she also finds a high-quality fiancé along the way.

title: Ten Years of Wrong Love
description: Jesse was wrongfully imprisoned for ten years. Upon release, he discovered that the real culprits were his own wife and daughter, who even caused his mother's death. Disheartened, Jesse decided to divorce and leave town. In Tont City, he rebuilt his life, becoming a senior engineer and falling in love with Lizzie. Returning to his hometown with newfound success, Jesse is determined to bring those responsible to justice.

title: The Unbound: A Mortal's Path to Godhood
description: In the South Empire, females rule everything, while males' status is low. Aaron made a living selling pork. He often faced humiliation from some powerful girls. The whole society looked down on men, forbidding them from practicing martial arts. Aaron still dreamed of fighting on the battlefield and defending the country. He practiced martial arts behind his mom's back. Then he participated in the Martial Arts Contest, gradually uncovering his own background. Actually, he was the Queen's son...

title: Billionaire Twins Fall in Love with Me
description: Eight years before, the twin heirs fell in love with you at the same time. But fate did them badly, that one died and one suffered amnesia. Eight years later, you encountered the one who don't remember you on a blind date, and he quickly fell for you again. This time, will true love find its way?

title: Surrender, My Stepson
description: When Evelyn Hewitt, a general from hundreds of years ago, wakes up as modern-day heiress and stepmom to rebellious Killian Foster, she brings battlefield tactics to household wars. Armed with pressure points and a fierce spirit, she must tame her spoiled stepson, navigate a marriage of convenience with CEO Stephen Foster—who shares the face of her lost love—and conquer high society’s doubts. This time, her empire is the Foster family.

title: Rejected to Renowned: The Chef Queen Comes Back
description: She is a gifted young chef but overlooked by her family due to being a girl. Undeterred, she becomes a renowned chef through self-learning and secret mentorship. After leaving home, she is mentored by a culinary master and rises to the top. Returning to help her family in crisis, she is rejected by her relatives for being a woman. To prove her worth, she holds a grand feast, only to face challenges and provocations from foreign rivals, leading to a battle for honor that will determine her fate, her family’s legacy, and the country’s pride.

title: The Melon Seller Is the King
description: Bentley, the true power behind Apex Constructions, hides his identity to raise his son right, posing as a night-market fruit vendor while sending Sam to learn the hard way on a construction site. But when a ruthless bully, Hunter, the spoiled son of Bentley's own subordinate, targets Sam, steals his girlfriend, and crushes him at every turn, Bentley steps in. His secret is revealed, yet the bully still dares to strike until Hunter's father arrives, and the truth finally hits home.

title: Dad Was a Street King
description: Once the formidable underground king of the Northeast Provinces, Linden Holt has traded his notorious past for a quiet life as a butcher. But when the young thugs demand protection money, his loyal lieutenant, Dominic Walden, arrives just in time with a team of bodyguards to send a clear message. Linden confides that his retirement was meant to provide a stable life for his son, Felix. However, a sudden call reveals that Felix has landed in hot water. Will the retired kingpin be forced to re-enter the fray and reclaim his throne to protect his family?

title: The 'Puppet' Emperor & His Clever Strategist
description: Julia Cullen has spent over a decade serving in the court, living her life for others. It wasn't until she was deeply hurt that she realized true love comes from those who accept her as who she's and support her journey to become her best self.

title: The Wife's Secret
description: He deeply loves his family, works hard every day, and even sells blood to earn money. However, he unexpectedly discovers his wife behaving strangely recently. Is she cheating on him, or has their love already faded?

title: The Ugly Heiress's Try
description: A wealthy heiress realized at her parents' funeral that her trusted husband and best friend conspired against her. In her anger and despair, she loses a child. Just when she thinks all is lost, a billionaire CEO extends a hand to rescue her. Three years later, she returns with a new identity and a stunning appearance, ready to make the unfaithful couple pay for their betrayal.

title: Queen of the Court
description: After abandoning her career as a tennis star, Lily Pearson dedicated her life to helping her boyfriend Adam's tennis career. But after helping him win his own Grand Slam...the fame changed Adam for the worse.  Adam's not only involved with a younger tennis star Mia Sparks, but he wants Lily to coach her as well. Will Lily accept this betrayal and love a cheating man she no longer recognizes, or will she have the courage to leave, and salvage her potential from all those years ago?

title: Queen Never Cry
description: 7 years ago, Nicole leaves her family fortune behind for her husband Ethan. She thought she's the happiest wife and mother -- until Ethan and her best friend Elaine sent her to jail and took her daughter away. Now seeing their true color, Nicole decides to regain her heiress status, take back her daughter and show everyone what a real queen looks like.

title: Queenpins- My Enemy, My Wife
description: New York's two deadliest queenpins, Vera Marchetti and Bianca Conti, have been rivals for twenty years and lovers in secret. When Bianca is exposed as a fake heiress, stripped of her name, and thrown to the enemies she made for her family, Vera flies home to claim the only person allowed to kill her. Together they turn a blood debt into a power play, crush the Contis, and make the underworld watch its most dangerous enemies become wives.

title: Queen of Letting Go
description: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.

title: Queen Mom Rules
description: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift called fake, and she's even banned from the table!

title: Queen of Letting Go
description: After June and her parents die in a freak accident, she finally sees her family's true colors. Reborn alongside them, she decides to stop playing by anyone else's rules, focusing only on winning over the enemy who mourned her death in her past life. She ignores business crises, lets her sister steal her fiancé, and even applauds her grandparents when they hand the family empire to a cousin. Chaos erupts as the family scrambles, begging her to take control again.

title: The Exiled Alpha Queen
description: Alpha Holden married Ella by following a witch's prophecy regarding fated mates. After they wed, Ella works tirelessly to help him manage the pack. However, Holden mistakenly believes she only married him for the title of Luna, leading him to deeply resent her. He maintains an ambiguous relationship with his childhood sweetheart Ivy, whose manipulations cause him to repeatedly misunderstand his wife. Just as Ella discovers she is pregnant, she catches Holden kissing Ivy and overhears him saying he wants to get rid of her unborn child. Utterly heartbroken, she divorces him to protect her baby and leaves the pack. Meanwhile, she discovers her true identity as a wolf princess.

title: Queen's Gambit
description: She stepped back to support her husband's rise, then he cheated, his mistress attacked, and her daughter nearly died. Now this queen is done playing nice. She's freezing his power, exposing their crimes, and taking back everything—one ruthless move at a time.

title: The Mob Boss’s Plus-Size Queen
description:
Thrown into the freezing rain by her mobster husband for being "fat and worthless," Hannah is left with nothing. Desperate for shelter, she accepts a midnight emergency call to nanny for a traumatized toddler.

She arrives at a breathtaking estate, only to discover her new employer is Don Lucian Moretti—New York’s most feared mafia kingpin. While her ex replaced her with a cruel social climber, the legendary boss offers her respect, a million-dollar life, and a unyielding protection.

When her ex begs on his knees, it’s too late. The rejected wife is now the Mafia Queen.

title: The Snow Queen
description:
Born with the mystical Water Pearl, Eileen spent her childhood abused by her own family.
They sacrificed her to the abyss. That was the moment her ultimate ice magic awakened.
Eileen tamed a deadly dragon, returned to save her younger brother, and made everyone who betrayed her pay.
Inside the royal palace, she exposed the queen’s conspiracy. Beneath the sea, she rescued her mother and defeated the monsters threatening the kingdom.
In the end, Eileen rose as the Queen of the Seas.

title: Four Wolves, One Queen
description: Elowen, a "Wolfless" outcast, is betrayed and sent to the palace as a breeding candidate for four fierce princes. In a desperate fight for survival, she awakens the legendary "Silver Wolf" bloodline. Her power not only tames the princes' madness but also allows her to expose conspiracies and overthrow a tyrannical king. Ultimately, she is crowned the Alpha Queen by all four princes, rising from nothing to hold supreme power.

title: The Wolfless Alpha Queen
description: Thirteen years ago, a traitorous scheme tore the Bloodwolf Clan apart. The true-born princess, still just a child, was cast out in the wild, losing all memory of who she really was. At nineteen, she awakens the overpowering Progenitor's Power. Returning home, she finds her Mother tortured, her father paralyzed, and the traitors colluding with the enemy to destroy the clan from the inside. Will the true-born princess be able to reclaim her throne and save her people?

title: From Omega's Prey to Luna Queen
description: Betrayed by her fated mate Noah and bullied for years by Omega Olivia, Emma Carter fled the Silver Moon Pack. Ten years later, she returns as Luna Queen, mated to Alpha King Liam. At the pack reunion, she publicly rejects Noah. Trapped in a toxic bond, Noah and Olivia reap what they sowed, while Emma builds a peaceful new family. A stirring tale of escaping toxic bonds, healing, and earning true respect.

title: Mafia Queen's Fake Bride
description: FBI Agent Parker is assigned a covert mission: go undercover as the heiress to a mafia family and become the bride at a gangster wedding. But before she walks down the aisle, the groom is a no-show—and in his place stands his older sister, Thea: the old flame Parker coldly killed on an undercover assignment three years ago.

title: The Lycan Queen Rose to Slay
description: Female wolves are killed at birth. Bianca, a rare white wolf, survives disguised as a boy for eighteen years. When exposed, her uncle Krown invades and kills her father. She sacrifices her wolf spirit, but Krown massacres her people anyway. Rescued by her divine grandfather and nine elemental uncles, she trains for three years, then enters the Alpha King tournament with female warriors. She defeats Krown, reveals females are inherently stronger, claims the crown, and abolishes the killing law.

title: Wolfless? Bow to the Queen!
description: Sarah has no wolf power and is looked down on by everyone in her clan. Her fiancé dumps her publicly at the engagement party and shames her with another woman. When she’s hopeless, she meets Liam, a secret werewolf trapped by a silver collar. They make a marriage deal to take back her family’s power. They fight her greedy uncle, cruel stepmother and evil nobles, and find out who killed her parents. Sarah wakes the rare White Wolf power, while Liam reveals he’s the true Wolf King. They destroy the dark magic plot, end unfair blood rules, and rule the werewolf world side by side with everlasting love.

title: His Mafia Queen
description: Massimo Livoti is the most dangerous mafioso in the country… and he’s your bitter enemy. When you accidentally sleep with him, you’re shocked that it turns into an unwanted marriage. Forced into enemy territory, you don’t know who you can trust. With everything you love under threat, will you step up and take your place by Massimo's side?

title: Queen Mother of the West
description:
The peerless beauty looks back on her life in the holy land, and her deeds attract demons and ghosts.
The last generation of female emperor-the Queen Mother of the West was born.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: I AM THE LUNA QUEEN
description:
The moment the Alpha King pins me onto the bed, I slap him.

"You’re my wife." He growls dangerously.

"The wife you refused to touch for three years? I'm not that pathetic woman."

I'm not, for real. I went to sleep a college girl, and woke up a Queen. 

Servants said the King hates his Queen, so his mistress rules the palace—but that was before me.

title: The Exiled Dragon Queen
description:
Abandoned over a cliff by her birth father right after birth, Renata is taken in and raised by the Black Dragon King. Twenty years later, she awakens the power of the Primordial Dragon Soul and returns to the Red Dragon Tribe. There she finds her birth mother reduced to slavery, her aunt who has seized power on the throne, and her arrogant fake‑princess half‑sister.

When the Blue Dragon forces invade, the tribespeople push Renata to sacrifice herself. Instead, she crushes the enemy in three moves, and the overwhelming aura of her Primordial Dragon Soul forces everyone present to kneel before her. Her remorseful birth father begs to acknowledge her, only to be coldly rejected. Her aunt and half‑sister stage a counterattack by allying with dark forces, yet they are utterly defeated. In the end, the Goddess of Flame descends to bestow her blessing. Renata is crowned the Supreme Dragon Queen, bringing an end to the thousand‑year‑long conflicts among dragon clans.

title: Siren's Pact: My Pirate Queen
description: Princess Genevieve is drugged and betrayed by her fiancé Lord Sterling on their wedding eve. He forges her abdication and sells her to privateer Captain Blackwood. Rescued by Captain Maeve Vance, Genevieve adapts to pirate life and the two fall into a forbidden romance. When their enemies corner them, Maeve is gravely wounded. Desperate, Genevieve makes a soul contract with sea witch Ursula—gaining storm and siren powers at the cost of her humanity. Growing colder, she builds the Pirate Coalition with Maeve, but the dark pact erodes her soul. With Lady Catherine's help, they expose Sterling's crimes and defeat him and Blackwood. As Genevieve freezes into salt, Maeve's true love kiss breaks the curse. They found a dual-queen empire spanning land and sea.

title: The Wolfless Queen
description: Selene Ward shattered her wolf soul at ten to save Tristan, Dark Moon's future Alpha. For eight years, she endured being called "wolfless," clinging to his promise that she would be his Luna. At his coronation, he held her down while his new girlfriend cut her hair with silver scissors, then rejected their mate bond before a thousand witnesses. Selene accepted his rejection, severed her pack bond, and walked away—with her father, Dark Moon's head warrior, beside her. No one knew that losing Tristan would awaken her dormant bloodline. At Apex Royal Academy, she meets Ryker Thorne, a "useless playboy" hiding the power of a pureblood Lycan king, and discovers a mate bond ten thousand times stronger than the one she lost. Selene rises from outcast to legendary commander as Dark Moon crumbles without her. The wolfless girl never returns. The White Wolf Queen takes her place.

title: The Wolf Queen Strikes Back
description: Diana, the Wolf Queen, grew tired of war and bloodshed. She disguised herself as a simple healer in the woods. To give her daughter Katherine a normal life, she sent her to the Conroy pack. Little did she know, it was a living nightmare. The Conroy pack treated Katherine like a worthless slave—humiliated, abused, beaten, and nearly raped, simply because she had no power. When Diana discovered the truth, her motherly fury was unleashed. As the dark secrets of the Conroy pack’s betrayal of Lord Julius Redblood came to light, it was no longer possible to hide. The Wolf Queen had to strike back, defeat her enemies, and reclaim her crown.

title: The Alpha Queen Returns
description: Jessica, the Wolf Queen, grew tired of war and bloodshed, so she disguised herself as a plain healer in the woods. To ensure a normal, happy life for her daughter, she sent her to the Russo pack. Little did she know, she had sent her daughter into a living nightmare. Her daughter was treated like a slave—humiliated, abused, beaten, and nearly raped, simply because she had no fame or power. Realizing her mistake, Jessica resolved to save her daughter and make those who mistreated her pay. Meanwhile, she discovered that the Russo pack had betrayed their country and collaborated with Lord Kilian Darkmoom. Finally, Jessica defeated them and restored peace to the wolf world once more.

title: The Return of the Voltage Queen
description: Aurora Hale was born an S-Class heiress — until the man she loved locked a poisoned collar around her neck, drained her power for seven years, then watched her family die and left her nailed to a wall. But death isn't the end. Aurora wakes up the night before the collar ever goes on, and this time she'll expose his lies. She'll tear off his mask, reclaim her crown, and rise as the Voltage Queen, while everyone who betrayed her watches their world burn.

title: The Return of My Drama Queen
description: On the eve of her execution, Marie Antoinette looks back on her life and wishes for a second chance. As the guillotine comes down, she wakes up in the modern day reality of failed actress Antonia Lavigne Fontaine, where she has another shot at righting the wrongs of the past and finding a love that endures through time…if the villains that haunt her don’t kill her first.

title: I Quit: Now the Queen Begs Me Back
description: A thousand years guarding the Abyss Hold, one man stood against the demon horde — Leo Carter. He has done everything for the Queen, Elena Valen. But how did she repay him? She stripped him of his rank. Cast out like a commoner, he was betrayed.

title: The Queen's Revenge
description: Twenty-four years after Ethan Holt abandoned her, Ava Stone returns with power, capital, and one impossible demand: she wants his son, Noah, as her fiance. Their engagement becomes the blade that opens old crimes inside the Holt Group, from stolen trust funds to a deadly family cover-up. Ava came back for revenge, but she leaves with justice and a man who chooses freedom with her.

title: Bow to Your Queen, My Lord Duke
description: Milana devoted everything to support her husband Nasus, only to be betrayed, poisoned, falsely reported dead and buried alive by him and her adoptive sister Aethios. Rescued by the king and her childhood friend Taric, she discovers she is the long‑lost princess Natalie. Half a year later, she returns as a princess. Using her wits and evidence, she sets her enemies against one another. In the end, she reveals her true identity, brings the culprits to justice, and finds her happy ending with Taric.

title: I Quit: Now the Queen Begs Me Back
description: A thousand years guarding the Abyss Hold, one man stood against the demon horde — Leo Carter. He has done everything for the Queen, Elena Valen. But how did she repay him? She stripped him of his rank. Cast out like a commoner, he was betrayed.

title: The True Queen
description: Elven princess Elune became mortal for love of Prince Leon, helped him unify, but pregnant she was framed by jealous cousin Sylvia, Returning home, she became Elven Queen and came back. Leon coveted the crown that only she could wear. She exposed him, became true queen, and exiled Sylvia to a monster's death.

title: The Slap Queen No One Hurts My Baby Girl
description: Regina, the formidable, iron-fisted matriarch of the Jiang family, strikes fear into everyone in City A. Three years ago, she went overseas to develop a life-saving cure for her daughter Lily's rare illness. Yet when she returned with the finished medicine, her family had fallen apart. Regina's gold-digging husband Victor colluded with housekeeper Harper and her daughter Yvonne to seize control of the household. They usurped Regina's place as mistress of the house, then joined forces with Lily's fiancé Felix to reduce her to a servant. Lily endured daily abuse until she was driven insane. Heartbroken and enraged, Regina rescues her daughter. She vows to reclaim her status, attend the grand banquet, and make every wrongdoer pay dearly.

title: The Visionary Queen
description: Broke medical student Audrey unexpectedly awakens God-tier X-Ray Vision. After saving a dying billionaire heir, she uses her superpower to uncover hidden treasures and dominate the stock market, transforming into the richest woman. Pursued by elite bachelors, she handles them all with grace. Who says girls are meant to be weak? Watch Audrey rise as a badass queen!

title: F-Rank’s Mecha Queen
description: The school's only F-rank walked up to the mecha that terrified S-ranks. The mecha girl sneered, 'Do you deserve to look at me?' Kieran Blackwood smirked, 'Be my girlfriend, Seraphina.' Her arrogance instantly shattered. Late at night, his door was kicked open. The mecha girl glared with fiery red eyes. 'Explain!' she demanded dangerously. 'Why did you flirt and run!?'

title: The True Queen Returns
description: Carly Tubert dropped out of high school to support her boyfriend, Jacob Celis, and spent seven years building the Rosewood Group into a global empire while secretly funding his education and career. Returning to propose, she finds Jacob dumping her publicly for another. After meeting Wendel Group CEO Clement, Carly reveals her billionaire status, ready to watch Jacob regret his decision.

title: Country Gal to Hotel Queen
description: Country gal Eleanor Rhee rises to become a five-star hotel manager, dazzling the fashion world with her design talent and exposing impostors with her intricate schemes. Mob boss and CEO Wyatt Porter transforms into a master at discerning deception. When the truth about the jade pendant is revealed, the wedding turns into a face-slapping scene. But the best is yet to come.

title: Dear Husband, I Quit
description:
A man as high as the sky, Choi Hyunseo, the heir to Miwoo Group, extends a scouting offer to Tae-yeon, a low-ranking employee in the PR team. Tae-yeon, struggling with her mother’s hospital bills and facing the need to take on part-time work once the company closes, cautiously asked what it was about.
“It’s a job of becoming the mother of my soon-to-be-born child, my wife.”
It was a job that involved enjoying the benefits of being a part of Miwoo Group while becoming Choi Hyunseo’s wife. Raising another woman’s child... Tae-yeon was left speechless in front of this huge proposal. It was no surprise she was shocked—if it weren’t the man she had secretly loved for years, she might not have been as surprised.

title: From Plus-Size Girl to Campus Queen
description: Sloane, Westbridge University’s adored It Girl, wakes in the 220-pound body of Riley, the classmate who stole her face, wealthy family, and fiancé through a permanent soul swap. Riley expects Sloane to become the school’s favorite joke. Instead, Sloane discovers that Riley’s body is healthy and complete, while her own “perfect” body was starved, cut open, and mutilated to make her marriageable. Two months later, classmates rig a livestreamed ceremony to humiliate her. As hundreds laugh and wait for the 220-pound girl to appear, the doors swing open. Sloane enters in a red dress, and the entire auditorium falls silent.

title: The Human Queen of the Lycan King
description: Five years ago, human Nicole accidentally entered Lycan King Calvin Hall's territory and became bound to him before fleeing. Years later, she returns with her sick son Paul and unknowingly becomes Calvin's family doctor, only to discover he is the man from her past. As Paul's hidden Lycan blood awakens, enemies brand him a cursed child and seek his death. Calvin protects his mate and son, exposes the conspiracy, and proves Paul's royal heritage, finally reuniting his destined family.

title: Fate's Redo: I Quit Loving You
description: On her birthday, Claire faced a double blow: her boyfriend of four years, Ethan secretly got married to his long-time crush, Natalie. After being abandoned by Ethan, Claire was involved in a car accident. At the brink of life and death, she traded her emotional ties for a chance at rebirth, losing the ability to love in the process. In her new life, she decided to let go of her infatuation with Ethan completely, accepted a family-arranged marriage, and married the playboy Lucas, embarking on a new chapter of her life.

title: Fallen Princess to Queen
description:
Cecilia, Crown Princess of Etheria, rescues a disfigured “deserter” named Amos from a death pit and makes him her personal guard. Three years later, King Helios of Nord storms her capital—and reveals he is Amos. Having used her to steal every military secret, he destroys her kingdom, burns her ancestral tombs, and enslaves her. To buy time for her brother Edmund to strike Nord’s rear, Cecilia endures public humiliation, torture, and repeated abuse, until she takes a fake-death potion left by Edmund and escapes.

Edmund captures Nord’s capital, trades Helios’s mother for Cecilia’s “corpse,” and secretly revives her. Years later, Edmund dies, naming Cecilia regent for his young son. Helios, learning she is alive, begs for reconciliation, then threatens to massacre civilians when refused. Cecilia declares war and leads the army herself. After three years, she stands before Nord’s capital, shoots Helios twice but spares his life, then orders the assault. That night, Helios dons his old disguise mask and burns himself alive in the palace.

Cecilia annexes Nord, abolishes slavery, standardizes weights and measures, establishes a people’s council, and unites both kingdoms into a new realm—Eternal. She never marries, devoting her life to her people. Upon her death, she is honored as the “Mother of the Eternal Realm.” Her bronze statue still stands in the capital square, gazing into the distance, a silent witness to the peace she won with blood and sacrifice.

title: An Ex-Con Mother's Quest
description: Elaine Norman, whose hidden identity was the Master Healer, was coerced by her father into marrying Matthew Stone after serving time in prison for a crime she took the blame for her father, with her twin sons held as leverage. When she tragically discovered her youngest son had died, Elaine stumbled upon an identical birthmark on Matthew's son during her mourning...

title: The Wolf King’s Runaway Queen
description: Framed by her father's concubine, Clara Cole is rescued by the Wolf King, Adrian Shaw. After one fateful night, she is exiled for her family's crimes and secretly gives birth to their son Oliver—who can speak to animals. Five years later, Clara returns to find a cure for her son, only to cross paths with Adrian, neither recognizing the other. When Oliver is accused of being a monster, Adrian steps forward to claim his family, exposing the long-buried truth. Through revenge plots, wolf clan conflicts, and a fox demon's schemes, they stand together against all odds. Clara soon conceives twins, and the family finally finds lasting happiness.

title: Fear Not, Mommy: Quade Strikes
description: Audrey Sterling's half-sister, Melody Sterling, commits manslaughter. Forced by her father, stepmother, and Melody to take the fall, Audrey flees. During her escape in the mountains, she sleeps with Vincent Vance, who was injured and slipped an aphrodisiac. Vincent leaves a jade pendant behind. Audrey is caught again by the Sterling family and drops the pendant, which Melody picks up to impersonate her. Ten months later, Audrey gives birth to quadruplets. Melody snatches and abandons the babies, then frames Audrey for murdering them, sending her to prison for five years. Upon release, Audrey is sold to the underground club by Melody's thugs. Hacker Deuce discovers Audrey is in danger and sends the highly skilled Ace to rescue her. Ace finds Vincent, claims him as his father, and urges him to save Audrey. Vincent questions Melody, mentioning that the woman from years ago had a flower-shaped birthmark. He demands to check both Audrey and Melody. Audrey has the birthmark, but Melody had already tattooed an identical one on herself. Just as Vincent thinks he misunderstood Melody, Ace mentions he did a paternity test. Ace's Master, Zane Lockhart, arrives with the results. The results show Ace isn't Vincent's biological son, as a city hospital was bribed to fake the test. Ace insists the test is fake. Then, Audrey's ex-boyfriend, Lionel Yates, steps in to claim Ace is his son. Vincent is suspicious but forced to believe it. Because of this, Vincent gives Melody the cold shoulder. To win him back, Melody plans to buy a painting at an auction as a gift for his Nana's birthday banquet. Later, Melody reappears and poisons Audrey and the children, using the antidote to blackmail Vincent into marrying her. Vincent and Audrey play along, exposing Melody's crimes at the engagement ceremony. Melody brings up saving Vincent years ago, but Gabriel Hayes arrives with evidence proving Audrey is the true savior. Finally, Melody is taken away by the police.

title: Fold or Die: Gamble Queen Rises
description: Journalist James got betrayed by Travis and was killed by Dominic while investigating an underground casino. Three years later, his daughter Hailey becomes a master of gambling skill. To save her gambling addict aunt and track down the killer, she sneaks into her enemy's underground casino...

title: The Serpent Queen's Rebirth
description: Reborn as a serpent outcast, Aurelia is sent to a frozen wasteland as a sacrifice. After a mysterious encounter, she returns with a shocking secret that turns the entire kingdom upside down.

title: Forbidden: Entangled Love
description: My boyfriend cheated on me with his good brother, so I seduced their friend—a CEO. Now, in the face of my ex's betrayal and obsession, the male mistress's jealousy and murder attempt, and the CEO's fiancée's schemes, what should I do next?

title: Rejected Queen
description:
In a society ruled by werewolf clans, Elara Cole is publicly rejected by her fated mate and becomes the laughingstock of her pack. But everything changes when she unexpectedly awakens the rare bloodline of the White Wolf King.

As her true identity and power begin to emerge, those who once looked down on her, factions hungry for her strength, and long-buried conspiracies all start closing in. Surrounded by manipulation, betrayal, and deadly threats, Elara must reclaim the identity and power that were always hers—and rise as the true queen she was meant to be.

title: Holy Crap?! My Sperm Donor is a Billionaire
description: When Emily Winter's "marriage" is exposed as a fraud—with her husband Weston Hewitt already wed to her housekeeper's daughter, Tanya—her world collapses. Refusing to be a victim, Emily visits the nation's top university to select the perfect candidate to father her heir and secure her family's legacy. But her calculated plan takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with Jason Lewis, a brilliant student with a secret identity: the heir to the mighty Lewis Group.

title: Reborn Bride: Saving the Crown Prince
description: In her past life, Lydia was betrayed and left with nothing. Given a second chance, she refuses to marry the same man and repeat her fate. Instead, Lydia chooses to marry the dying Crown Prince, a decision that has the entire city anticipating her downfall. But what if the "sickly" prince isn't so sickly after all?

title: The Return of My Drama Queen
description: On the eve of her execution, Marie Antoinette looks back on her life and wishes for a second chance. As the guillotine comes down, she wakes up in the modern day reality of failed actress Antonia Lavigne Fontaine, where she has another shot at righting the wrongs of the past and finding a love that endures through time…if the villains that haunt her don’t kill her first.

title: Oops! I Slept My Rival's Billionaire Dad
description: Lily Cole gets publicly humiliated by her secret crush of ten years and his new girlfriend. After drowning her sorrows in alcohol, she accidentally ends up in the room of an older man, William Wilson, mistaking him for a male escort. A month later, she finds herself unexpectedly pregnant. Just as she's panicking about the surprise pregnancy, the guy shows up with a billion-dollar dowry, ready to marry her. Not wanting to become anyone's stepmom, Lily tries to escape, only to find out that the old guy is not just a billionaire but also her nemesis's father! While others lean on their fathers, Lily's got her rival's dad on her side!

title: What Came Out of My Antique Lamp
description: In a cyberpunk world, brilliant scientist Livia is betrayed by her boyfriend, who steals her research. Heartbroken, she drinks alone—until an antique lamp in her home starts spitting out strange objects. She pours water into it, but it never fills. Unknown to her, the lamp connects to Edonia, a dying magical world. There, elf bishop Marcus is about to sacrifice himself to save his people from drought and war. A flood of fresh water erupts from the lamp. The elves hail Livia as their Lamp God. Through the lamp, Livia and Marcus exchange supplies and comfort. She sends water, food, and futuristic weapons; he helps her heal and face her world. They fall in love. But Livia knows the legend: Marcus is fated to die young. She vows to rewrite fate and save him—as his foretold death approaches.

title: To Shield My Family, I Became A God
description: Ethan Hayes gets a second chance at life after a tragic past. Reborn with mystical powers, he is determined to rewrite his destiny. Now, he must use his newfound abilities to protect his family from deadly threats, settle scores from his previous life, and face a shadowy organization lurking in the city's underworld.

title: Reborn Bride: Saving the Crown Prince
description: In her past life, Lydia was betrayed and left with nothing. Given a second chance, she refuses to marry the same man and repeat her fate. Instead, Lydia chooses to marry the dying Crown Prince, a decision that has the entire city anticipating her downfall. But what if the "sickly" prince isn't so sickly after all?

title: The 101st Time I Let Go
description:
Sammy and Shane were childhood sweethearts, but a devastating fire left Shane under the mistaken belief that Sammy had deliberately failed to save him. This misunderstanding festered, turning Shane's love into a lingering resentment. Over three tumultuous years of marriage, Shane has filed for divorce 100 times, each time met by Sammy's pleas for forgiveness.

When Shane files for divorce for the 101st time, Sammy's heart finally shatters. Resolved to let go of this unrequited love, she makes the bold decision to walk away and accepts the mysterious marriage proposal of a stranger.

title: We Met Long Before the Wedding
description: At 8, Samuel meets Sage, a girl who heals his heart and his legs at a sanatorium. Sixteen years later, as the head of the Grant family, Samuel vows to find her. But after years of searching, she's nowhere to be found until the Smith family's second daughter, forced into marriage, unexpectedly enters his life. A journey of lost love, unexpected marriage, and a touch of humor awaits.

title: Reborn to Swap Fates
description: Jealous of Mitch Harmon for his luxurious life, Javier Harmon attacked Mitch with a knife, and the cousins both died. But when they opened their eyes, they were back on the fateful wedding night in 1977 that had set their lives on diverging paths! With memories of his last life, Javier married Patsy Reeves, the adopted girl, instead of switching brides with Mitch. He thought he could steal Mitch's future—but only sank deeper into misery. Meanwhile, Mitch built a life richer in love, purpose, and success than before with Margie.

title: Before I Was Born, I Planned Revenge
description: In her past life, Ellie was shamed as a bastard by her biased father and ultimately murdered by his beloved mistress. After death, she learns her world was a novel, and she was only a disposable character. Reborn in her mother's womb, Ellie plots from before birth. Using foresight and cunning, she wins the trust of the head of the Grant family, exposes a poisoning scheme, and drives her enemies out, securing justice and a future for herself and her mother.

title: One Night Stand... To Forever
description: Forensic expert Vivian Smith, shamed for her job, accidentally sleeps with tycoon Ethan Parker—her ex’s uncle. A contractual marriage sparks chaos: their "stench solidarity" masks lethal secrets. As family feuds, conspiracies, and desire collide, they fight prejudice and lies, healing each other’s wounds. Can love survive autopsy tables and boardrooms?

title: ReelTalk EP20-Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer is My Ex-Lover Premiere Screening
description:
Sparks flew at ReelShort’s first-ever exclusive screening of Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer is My Ex-Lover. Follow stars Seth Edeen and Nicole Mattox as they reignite their chemistry in the latest sizzling ReelShort show. From the big screen to the Q&A and fan meet and greet, this star-studded night was on fire.
Fans, cast, crew, and surprise ReelShort stars showed up for a night full of laughs, dragon slaying, and maybe even a little drama. Watch closely, you might just spot a few familiar faces in the crowd. Don’t miss this behind the scenes look at the hottest premiere of the season!

title: Forever Your Prisoner
description: Reporter Nina successfully gains the trust of crime lord Leon Mann and takes him down. Three months later, Nina encounters Leon again at a TV network's gala, only to find he has transformed into Chase Kane, with a spotless reputation. Through investigation, Nina confirms that Chase is indeed Leon and suspects he seeks revenge. As she navigates this elaborate deception, Nina feels dwarfed by the cunning Leon, but with no other choice, she must risk everything for a desperate counterattack.

title: The Go-Between Girl
description: Having nothing left to teach his mentee, Victor Hale sent Rhea Kirk, a Go Prodigy, to the Myst Go Club owned by Alaric Drayke. There, she cracked the Ultimate Puzzle and defeated the ruthless Go King. Yet, as the dust settled, hidden secrets began to surface, Rhea and Alaric decided to participate in the Grand Go Game and find the truth of the past!

title: My Path to Darkness
description: A genius pianist has an accident during a performance and wakes up in a novel she read, becoming the despised secondary female character. Using her knowledge of the story, she realizes she's never been favored in her family and strives to change her fate by confronting a deceitful man and gaining the favor of a key male figure, altering her original life path.

title: Fate Reborn: Switched to True Love
description:
In her past life, Samantha married Iain, a penniless man who later rose to wealth and success, while her sister Nina married military officer Evan and went mad after Evan died shortly after their wedding. Blinded by jealousy, Nina killed Samantha and was killed in return.
Now, the sisters are reborn.
This time, Nina plots to steal Iain. But she doesn’t know that Samantha also remembers everything. This time, she's already saved Evan's life and is on her way to an even better future.

title: I Divorced My Husband for The Chancellor
description: Gloria risked her life to save her husband, Felix. But the remedy requires two doses, taken three years apart, for a complete cure. Felix has already taken one, while the other could save the poisoned Prime Minister. Meanwhile, under the guise of "virtue", Felix pressures Gloria to step down as his legal wife and make way for the Kingsfall Princess. Now with the remedy in her hands, will she still give it to her husband or simply divorce him?

title: The Pretender Emperor
description: Klem Shaw, an actor from modern times, wakes up as the stand-in of the missing Emperor of Argentea, controlled by the ruthless Empress Dowager. Trapped in a palace of lies, he must outwit the Empress and cunning concubines while playing the deadliest role of his life. Using his modern savvy and acting chops, he turns from a puppet into a player.

title: Reborn to Ruin You, My DEAR Hubby
description:
Stella, the forgotten wife, was left in the countryside while her husband, Joshua, brought his sister-in-law to the city, claiming it was to avoid gossip. He wrote Stella sweet letters every month, but gave all his military pay to his sister-in-law.
During a famine, while Joshua's sister-in-law and her children dined on meat buns in his city mansion, Stella and her child starved to death.
But death wasn't the end. Stella is reborn, and this time, she's not playing the obedient wife.
