title: Little Princess Came Back Radiant
description: Camille gained 120 pounds, saving her fiancé Astor, only to discover he faked his death to marry his sister-in-law Tina. After a stunning transformation, she returns with a powerful new ally: Charles Lester, the CEO who worships her. Together, they crash Astor's wedding, unveiling Camille's true identity as the hidden daughter of the "Godfather." Now, it's time for payback—and a billion-dollar "wedding gift" they'll never forget.

title: CEO, That Intern is Actually Your Wife
description:
My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! 
My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married...
As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

title: Love Was Never Part of the Mission
description: Lia's dream to follow her father's footsteps as a police officer was cruelly shattered when the ruthless crime lord, Caleb, wiped out her family. Surviving the massacre, Lia assumes a new identity as the private tutor of Caleb's child, all for her perfect revenge. However, when she discovers what is in the hidden room of Caleb's house, her world shatters again.

title: She Used My Husband's Sperm
description: Cora’s husband helps his dead best friend’s widow get pregnant, then defends her at every turn, calling it kindness while his own marriage collapses. When his loyalty turns violent and costs Cora her unborn child, she stops begging and starts collecting proof. Armed with Sienna’s recorded confession, Cora forces a brutal divorce, walks away with what she is owed, and watches the woman who stole her husband trap the Vance family in the scandal they created.

title: She's Not Homeless, She's Healer Goddess!
description: Everyone accuses Trixie of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Lysander Armstrong! (And win his heart too)

title: So close, yet so far the stolen princess
description: On the day of her birth, Princess Olivia of the Magic Empire was swapped by her ambitious aunt Sirena, who branded her with a dark magic seal to suppress her powers, leaving her a powerless "lowly bastard." For eight years, she was beaten and tortured by her false mother, bullied mercilessly by the false princess Julianna, and even forced to kneel and eat from a dog bowl at the royal banquet—while her real mother, the Queen, and her brother, the Crown Prince, remained unaware, though they were so close. On the eve of the Bloodstone Ceremony, which would decide the fate of the empire, Sirena cut open her chest to extract her pure blood. Dying, the 8-year-old girl, desperate to keep her promise to her brother that she "must come," broke her own fingers to free herself from chains, walked barefoot across molten rock, and pushed open the palace doors covered in blood. As she was dragged away, her collar tore, and her 11-year-old brother instantly recognized the Stardust mark on her chest—the truth was revealed. Her mother awakened in fury, and the divine pure blood returned in glory. The true heir reclaimed the throne, and the villains faced judgment.

title: SSS: Rise of the Beastmistress
description: Serena Sterling transmigrates into a novel as the doomed fifth princess, a mere cannon fodder fated to die in the first chapter. To defy fate, she saves the future Archfiend, Cassius. Hiding her power, she levels up and tames tiger Magnus and phoenix Valerian. Rising to a Tier-10 tamer with three SSS beasts, she crushes plots, defeats villains, and embraces darkness to rule, turning Gloryhold into Shadowhold.

title: She Is Where the Stars End
description: Arina is about to marry the love of her life, Nathan, but runs away at the wedding after learning just a minute prior that she has a terminal illness. She goes far away to Switzerland to seek treatment. Four years later, as Arina prepares to undergo euthanasia, she learns that Nathan has come to Switzerland and decides to see him one last time. However, Nathan arrives to meet her accompanied by his pregnant wife.

title: Spicy Sister
description: As a child, Victoria nearly died in the freezing streets. It was Arthur Hope who saved her and adopted her. Years later, she reinvented herself abroad as Phoenix. But her world is shattered when she receives the heartbreaking news of Arthur's passing. Determined to pay her respects, she returns home, only to be confronted by spiteful uncles and ungrateful siblings. Finally, Victoria decides it's time to end this charade once and for all.

title: My First Night Shift Saved the City
description: Ten grand a night. Too bad the museum is full of ancient trouble. On Shawn's first shift, he meets restless artifacts and a broken Octo-Arm Asura. He restores the statue. He feels the power. And somewhere across the city, a disaster vanishes before it really begins. They'll call him a myth, and he's just getting started.

title: My Boss Is My Secret Husband
description: To save her grandfather, jewelry designer Elena enters a fake marriage with a stranger, CEO Cedric. Two years later, she joins his company as his assistant, but they don't recognize each other, sparking a sweet comedy of "my boss is my husband." Facing schemes from a jealous colleague, Elena and Cedric clash and connect in the workplace. As misunderstandings and plots unravel, they are shocked to discover their legal spouse is their destined true love.

title: Sisters Have Crush On The Same Man
description: Rosa and Emma are sisters, living their fantasy life in a castle their father had inherited, Rosa is engaged to Edward Douglas. As a result of an unfortunate accident, Rosa fell into a coma, but the marriage was not called off, and Rosa's name was replaced by Emma. Times goes on, the couple find themselves in difficult situations, and Rosa comes back to life after six months. When she opens her eyes, the growing tension urges Emma to confess the truth to Rosa...

title: Skyward Ambitions
description: After seven years abroad, Adrian York returns as the Chairman of Aetheris Consortium, a global financial titan. His plan? To help his girlfriend, Nina Sterling, secure a job at Langford Group. But Nina, blinded by ambition and greed, betrays him to pursue the elusive Chairman. Heartbroken yet resolute, Adrian meets Claire Langford—and they marry swiftly. At a high-profile signing gala, Claire shocks everyone, revealing that Adrian is not just a business partner... he’s her husband.

title: My Sister's Husband
description: Synopsis:Fresh off her divorce, Ava travels to Hawaii for a getaway with her brother-in-law Jack, and the pair cross moral boundaries through a series of lingering temptations. When their secret comes to light, a marriage crumbles and the two sisters suffer a bitter falling-out. Burdened by guilt, both women grow and heal separately over their long estrangement. Ultimately, they bridge the rift between them, rebuild their sisterly bond despite the scars, and find true redemption.

title: My Secret Husband is My Boss
description: Kate married a stranger in order to secure her inheritance without ever seeing him. She returns two years later get a divorce, not knowing that her hot billionaire boss and crush Jack Townsend is her secret husband.

title: He Chose My Sister, So I Chose His King
description: Emma spent years protecting Ethan, a supposedly mute werewolf, only to hear him speak when he chose to save her sister from a deadly fire. Reborn on the day their father bought the twin wolf guards, Emma refuses to repeat her mistake. She gives both brothers to Sophia, enters the family empire, and builds the power she was once denied. But when betrayal turns into kidnapping and murder, Emma fakes her death and joins forces with Mason Astor, the ruthless Alpha King and her family’s greatest rival. This time, the abandoned heiress won’t beg to be chosen—she’ll destroy everyone who chose against her.

title: My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor
description: Leia, struggling with infertility, is caught slacking off at work by her boss, Alec, while browsing a sperm donor website. Mortified by the encounter, she tries to move on. After carefully selecting a donor at the sperm bank, fate takes an unexpected turn—she ends up choosing Alec’s donation without realizing it. When will Leia discover that the child she’s carrying is actually Alec’s?

title: She's Out of His Mind
description: Childhood and high school crush vibes, college awkwardness, and the kind of comedy that makes you say "same." Watch every episode of "She's Out of His Mind" -- and keep your eyes open for actors Jennifer Siebel Newsom and Amanda Noret from TV's "Veronica Mars."*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: My Worst Boss Is My Online Crush
description: She can't stand her boss, and he'd rather tease her than tell her how he feels. When he's sent away to turn around a failing restaurant, he insists she come along. What she doesn't know? Her biggest workplace rival is also the man she's fallen for online.

title: Sweet Temptation
description: Based on the novel by bestselling author Cora Reilly. 21 year old Giulia Rizzo suddenly finds herself engaged to the ruthless crimelord Cassio Moretti against her will. Rumor has it he's responsible for the bloody, untimely death of his wife, whom Giulia is not only replacing as a wife, but as the mother of their two young children. Will rebellious Giulia manage to make a life for herself alongside Cassio, or will his refusal to let her into his heart create yet another broken marriage?

title: Faking It with My Ex's Best Friend
description: Clara fakes amnesia to test her boyfriend—only to catch him cheating and watch him toss her aside for his best friend, Ethan. Big mistake. For the ultimate payback, Clara starts fake-dating Ethan to drive her ex insane with jealousy. But what happens when Ethan’s fake kisses start to feel dangerously real?

title: The School for Bad Boys: S*x Lessons
description: Leo is devastated to find out his new roommate at reformatory school is his arch nemesis, Tyler. But when the highly inexperienced Leo falls for the Headmaster's daughter, Tyler offers to give him "sex lessons." The more Leo and Tyler lose themselves in these lessons, the harder it becomes the deny their feelings for each other. But getting caught doesn't just mean expulsion, it means prison. And Leo and Tyler can't decide if being together is worth the risk.

title: Empress of Shadows
description: In her first life, Serena had no tricks—and lost everything. The man she loved threw her into a dungeon and killed her. Now reborn, she plays the longest game. Ten years to learn seduction, run a business, build an army. No more broken heart. This time, she'll steal the prince's soul, take the throne, and wear the crown.

title: My Sassy Wife
description: Wild heiress Yuki Ford marries into the Moores to flip their scheme—only to find Jason Moore faking illness to escape her. But when her counter-move traps him instead, their battle turns explosive… and one kiss could ruin everything.

title: His Secret Heiress
description: Bonnie was born into wealth and privilege, but thanks to Isabel’s schemes, she married the wrong man, suffering disfigurement, betrayal, and the ruin of her family. Reborn, she quietly sets her sights on the seemingly lowly adopted son of the Nail family. Only she knows that this boy, now overlooked, is destined for greatness. Power, wealth, and influence await him.

title: Oliver! She Is My Sister
description: Sensible Olivia Sinclair and Oliver Sterling, CEO of Sterling Group, are happily married. Their peace shatters when Olivia's half-sister Chloe Sinclair and mother Valerie Sinclair stay with the Sterling family. Seemingly sweet, Chloe secretly covets Oliver and is jealous of Olivia, plotting to steal her life. One night, Chloe drugs Olivia to seduce Oliver but is bluntly rejected. Believing she is better looking and more vibrant than Olivia, Chloe refuses to give up and escalates her schemes.

title: His Silent Possession
description:
Seraphina, a once-wealthy heiress fallen on hard times, signs a humiliating contract to settle her family’s crippling debts. By a cruel twist of fate, she discovers the cold-blooded kingpin behind the underground loan ring is none other than Elias—her refined, restrained literature professor from university.
By day, he is an upright, erudite scholar; by night, a ruthless devil who traps and dominates her. The two become entangled in an immoral, charged power dynamic rooted in her debt repayment. As old family vendettas erupt into violent bloodshed, their twisted game of control takes an unexpected turn. Lines between victor and vanquished blur, and neither can tell where manipulation ends and genuine longing begins.

title: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle
description: There was a time when Nina believed her happiest moment would be walking down the aisle with Evan, her college sweetheart. But betrayal shattered that dream, teaching her that true love and forever were rare illusions. After their divorce, she vowed never to give her heart away again. Then Damon—Evan’s youngest uncle—stormed into her life, refusing to let her run. She tries to keep her distance, not wanting ties with her ex’s family, but Damon’s relentless pursuit leaves her breathless.

title: Virginity Pact
description: After Quinn gives herself a makeover to get back at her neighbor and bully Cam, she becomes the subject of a schoolwide bet for her virginity. With every guy (and even some of the girls) chasing after Quinn, but how far will she go until she realizes the one guy sabotaging her every attempt is the only one who actually wants her?

title: Love as Bright as the Stars
description: Avery Sinclair is the neglected eldest daughter of the Sinclair family. Her stepmother, Evelyn Sinclair, and sister, Peyton Sinclair, steal her medical papers and take credit for saving Carter Vance in Stonehaven. Having lost her memories, Avery returned home to seek her mother's belongings and unexpectedly reunites with Carter. However, Carter has mistaken Peyton for his savior and is engaged to her. By saving Carter's uncle, Vincent Carmichael, with her genuine medical skills, Avery slowly unravels her true identity: she isn't a biological Sinclair, but the daughter of Celine Monroe and the head of the Rockwell family. Ultimately, Avery reclaims her Sinclair Corporation shares, Peyton's fraud is exposed, and Carter realizes his true feelings, bringing the two of them together.

title: He's Not A Spare Son
description: Dustin Curran felt like a spare son. He was sent to his grandfather in the countryside right after his birth, while his parents raised his adopted brother by their side.  When he returned home after his grandfather passed away, he was immediately cast into the Clearwind Sect, where he improved his cultivation. One day, his parents suddenly showed up and demended him to wed Linda Collins, who was terminally ill. But Dustin is no longer the spare son they dismissed. They begged him to leave the sect, only to regret it.

title: The Don's Obsession
description: Mixed-race college student Elias is cornered by loan sharks after his father flees the country with millions. Then Lucius Vance, the iron-fisted don of the Vance family, descends. He forces Elias to sign a contract—not as an assistant, but as his personal plaything. He shoots through the hand of anyone who covets Elias, and shatters his will in a dark wine cellar. Elias never fully surrenders. On a yacht under enemy fire, he makes a run for a lifeboat—but it was a game all along. Lucius catches him in the rain. Enraged by his defiance, he binds Elias's wrists to the bed with his own belt. With absolute power and a branding mark, Lucius declares one thing: this forbidden contract has no escape. Not anymore.

title: I Am Bro, Escort, or Boyfriend?
description: He, driven by unspeakable hardships to venture into the business world, encountered two extraordinary women who would become the most radiant beacons in his life's journey.

title: Ashes for My Sister's Destiny
description: When Juniper and her sister Odette were born, an astrologer predicted that Juniper’s success would one day drive Odette to her death. Their parents believe every word. For eighteen years, Juniper is punished for being smarter, working harder, and shining too brightly. On the day of the SAT, they take away her admission ticket and lock her inside a freezing industrial freezer, convinced her sacrifice will save Odette. But outside that locked door, Odette is begging for her sister to be released. As the cold closes in, Juniper realizes the prophecy was never the only thing threatening to destroy their family.

title: Bad Sister
description: A student at a Catholic school has suspicions when one of the nuns begins acting creepily towards her brother. But she can't tell anyone, because who would believe that a woman of God would do such a thing?

title: My Daughter's Pets Are SSS-Rank Beasts?!
description: A loser live-in son-in-law makes an epic comeback with his daughter! Abandoned in the mountains five years ago, Gareth awakened the God-Tier System in despair, raising wild animals into SSS-Rank beasts to protect his daughter. Now, he returns with his epic beasts to avenge his family, just as his runaway wife suddenly reappears. Watch this fierce dad command beasts to protect his loved ones and shake the world!

title: He's Not A Spare Son
description: Dustin Curran felt like a spare son. He was sent to his grandfather in the countryside right after his birth, while his parents raised his adopted brother by their side.  When he returned home after his grandfather passed away, he was immediately cast into the Clearwind Sect, where he improved his cultivation. One day, his parents suddenly showed up and demended him to wed Linda Collins, who was terminally ill. But Dustin is no longer the spare son they dismissed. They begged him to leave the sect, only to regret it.

title: A Fortune Reclaimed
description: Snubbed and looked down on by his in-laws this New Year’s, Adrian Cross hides a earth-shaking secret: he is none other than the powerful chairman of the elite Wonston Group!

title: The Wastrel & The Assassin
description: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone.  But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?

title: Fated to the Feral Lion
description: Reborn on the Empire’s Matching Day, S-Class Guide Veda refuses to repeat her tragic fate. In her past life, she sacrificed five years of her power for Dane, only to be abandoned to die for another woman. This time, she rejects their 90% match and chooses Ryker, the Empire’s feared SSS-Class commander with a perfect 100% bond. As their legendary connection awakens, Veda exposes Dane and Vera’s betrayal while helping Ryker conquer his madness. When Dane remembers his past life, it’s already too late. Bound forever, Veda and Ryker rewrite destiny, and find the love they were always meant to share.

title: The Alpha's Obsession
description: At an elite lycan academy, poor Omega Ryan fight against the upper class for a scholarship - the fund for his mother's treatment. Alpha king Kael becomes obsessed, branding him with a forbidden "A4's Red Moon mark"—while gentle heir of Vance family, Silas silently guards him. Ryan refuses to be a kept pet. Awakening the rare "Silver Moon Bloodline," he crushes the old order. After Kael takes a fatal wound saving him, Ryan shields him in return, and the two evolve into soul-bonded mates. Under the full moon, their eternal mark rewrites the fate of all wolfkind.

title: You Took My S-Rank Talent, I Got a System
description: Charles awakened the system after being stripped of his talent by his foster father. His foster dad's son Ryan got his S-Rank talent. Charles was remarkable in contracting an S-Rank Spirit Beast and clearing the trial in the Hunter Tower. He defeated Ryan. By obtaining rare resources, Charles improved his own ability and his beast's growth. To find his parents, he entered another world...

title: Your Husband Is Mine
description: Driven to despair after losing both her husband and baby, Vivienne only lives for one thing - REVENGE! But simple murder doesn't torture enough. Why not steal her husband and make her watch!

title: Love Betrayed
description: She sacrificed everything—her family, her fortune, her identity—to marry the man she loved, helping him rise from nothing to build a business empire, trusting his promise: "You will be my one and only, forever." However, that promise shatters when his mother's bestie returns from abroad, insisting on moving in as his "personal maid". As she infiltrates their lives, their love begins to crumble from within...

title: Second Marriage Bliss
description:
To escape the marriage arranged by my parents, I secretly got married. I thought everything would settle down, but my husband cheated on me after the wedding!
Before getting a divorce, I had a one-night stand with a man. I thought it was nothing serious, but the man got attached to me! As I kept dealing with him, I discovered he was the man my parents had arranged for me to marry years ago! What should I do?

title: My Hockey Rival Under Me
description:
Axel is a ghost, a Russian operative buried deep inside the underground fighting circuit, sent to infiltrate the empire of Dante, the most feared mafia don on the continent. His ticket in? A brutal cage match where he publicly defies the don, then holds back the killing blow. The bait works. Dante brings him home.
But the mansion is a cage of its own. When Axel gets caught cracking the don's safe, his only alibi is a forged love letter, a lie that accidentally ignites Dante's twisted obsession. When assassins strike, Axel sees his moment. He steps in front of the bullet meant for Dante. Bleeds for him. Nearly dies for him.
The reward? The don's absolute trust, and an S-level pass to every secret in the empire. Now Axel is inside the heart of the beast. But the deeper he goes, the blurrier the line becomes between mission and something far more dangerous.
He came to betray him. He didn't plan to fall for him.

title: Baby Trapped by the Billionaire
description: When Katie's younger sister's cancer worsens, she finds herself signing a contract to give birth to a mysterious billionaire's heir. However, when proving their relationship to the CEO's grandpa turns out to be more difficult than expected, Katie and Mr. Brandt find themselves growing closer to one another, despite the contract's one and only rule: no falling in love.

title: The Sister She Has Never Seen
description:
Fay never thought her perfect wedding day would be ruined by a stranger calling herself “family.”  
Just as she is about to marry into the powerful Smith vampire family, a woman she has never met before walks in—**Ramona**, carrying a baby and a storm of secrets. Fay’s world shatters as long‑buried lies surface: the sister she was never allowed to know, the past her parents hid, and a truth that could tear two vampire bloodlines apart.  
Ramona is not just some lost relative—she is a witch, marked by forbidden magic and hunted by those who fear what she can do. Drawn into the supernatural chaos is **Ethan**, a member of the Smith family, whose growing bond with Ramona turns an already fragile alliance into a dangerous, tangled fate.  
As spells are cast and tempers ignite, sisters who were strangers must decide: stay divided by old wounds, or stand together against the darkness tying their families to blood, curses, and destiny. Between arranged marriages, ancient grudges, and a mate bond that refuses to be denied, Fay’s wedding becomes the beginning of a much bigger story.  
THE SISTER SHE HAS NEVER SEEN** — an anime fantasy drama of family, magic, and second chances.  
She lost her sister once. She won’t lose her again.

title: Chained to My Prison Guard
description: When Scarlett Jameson is put in prison for a crime she didn’t commit, she ends up on the radar of sexy prison guard, Jack Rayne. He taunts and tortures her with sexual delights but does he have a darker motive for chaining himself to her?

title: Sis, I Prepared a Billionaire Husband for You
description: She turned down an acceptance letter from an Ivy League university for her boyfriend, choosing instead to stay at the company as a janitor. But to her shock, her boyfriend proposed to the company's heiress. Devastated and heartbroken, her life takes an unexpected turn when her long-lost twin sister, the powerful figure behind a vast conglomerate, finds her and asks her to take her place for the purpose of handling business affairs, and entering into a marriage with a CEO......

title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO
description: After Sam's ex cheats on her and steals her money, Calladan Vandalay marries her at first sight. But he doesn't tell her that he's secretly the richest billionaire in the country. What will Sam do when she finds out? And can they keep their true identities a secret from the preying family and friends in Sam's life?

title: They Bet I'd Cry, I Bet They'd Fall
description: Aria hides her identity as the sole heiress of America's richest family and enters college disguised as a scholarship student to evaluate her arranged fiancé. Instead, she becomes the target of a cruel dating game where wealthy students compete to break girls' hearts for money. She plays along until the night they publicly dump and humiliate her. Just when everyone expects tears, Aria ends the game with a single phone call. Their fortunes, reputations, and futures begin collapsing one by one. But the revenge she prepared is far from over.

title: The Scent That Found Me
description: Five years ago, perfumer Vera was drugged by her father, her formula stolen by Rosalind, and she was framed for plagiarism. Pregnant, she gave birth to twins—only to be told they died, given a bloodstained cloth, and thrown out. Five years later, a little girl named Luna runs into her flower shop calling her “Mom.” Luna’s father, Carter, proposes a contract marriage. Vera notices the twins share her amber-gold eyes and jasmine allergy. Digging deeper, she uncovers the truth: Rosalind faked the twins’ deaths and stole them. Carter is actually Lawson Lane, CEO of Apex Group. Together they expose Rosalind, reclaim the children, and Vera wins an international perfume competition. She takes back her formulas, her children, and her love. Carter proposes. On their wedding day, Vera learns she’s pregnant again—this time, she’ll keep her baby.

title: That Beggar Wants Out
description: Stan Shaw, a skilled master of medicine and martial arts, disguises himself as a beggar to escape a marriage contract with the Miller family. Contrary to his plan, they insist on the marriage. Yet the one they want him to marry isn't necessarily the one he thought.

title: The Cut That Freed Me
description: When Bridget’s childhood best friend, Trevor, pins her down on stage so the campus Queen Bee can chop off her waist-length hair for a cruel "prank," eighteen years of loyalty vanish in a single snip. Refusing to be a punchline, Bridget instantly withdraws from university, walks away from their toxic bond, and takes control of her own destiny. While Trevor’s life spirals out of control, Bridget rebuilds herself from the ashes, trading a humiliating public joke for a near-perfect SAT score and a triumphant path to Columbia University.

title: Taste of the Wild
description: Emma, heir to a deep‑mountain tribe, rescues a amnesiac CEO—Charles—who’s fallen off a cliff after being hunted. She keeps him alive in the wilds; he introduces her to the big‑city jungle. What starts as a sweet‑and‑wild fling soon explodes into family conspiracies, a psycho ex‑girlfriend, and a genetic curse that won’t quit. From crashing galas to corporate comebacks, they fight back at every turn. In the end, she doesn’t just land her man—she becomes the bridge and shield between her tribe and the modern world. Think savage girl × loyal wolf CEO—equal parts steamy and badass.

title: The Sister They Hated
description:
When Scarlett was eighteen, her parents were brutally murdered for helping bring down a drug cartel. To protect her younger siblings, Scarlett let the world believe she was the villain — playing the disgrace of the family while she spent years quietly hunting the killers down, until she finally destroyed them all.

Ten years later, Scarlett is dying of a terminal illness — despised by the very siblings she sacrificed everything for. Now powerful and successful, they decide to use a memory-extraction machine to broadcast Scarlett's every memory to the world, determined to expose her crimes and put her on trial. But the deeper they dig, the more they realize Scarlett was never the person they thought she was…

title: The Woman Starts The War
description: When nurse Cindy gets caught in a deadly mafia shootout, ruthless crime boss Allan D'Angelo saves her life by declaring she's his fiancée. Now she's a prisoner in his world - living in his mansion, wearing his ring, and playing a role that could get her killed.

title: The road not taken
description: This is a female-oriented revenge short drama with a rebirth & counterattack theme. With her past-life memories, the heroine Chloe is reborn. She avoids the marriage-robbing trap set by her sister Lily, gives up the false shortcut of becoming a mafia godmother, and chooses to accept the upright wealthy businessman Jayce who is in financial crisis. Relying on her experience in managing underground industries from her previous life, she helps Jayce turn the tables and reach the top. In the end, the evildoers get what they deserve, and Chloe becomes the ultimate ruler of both the legal and underworld worlds on the East Coast.

title: The One that Got Away
description: Anna left her old life and old love behind when she married Mason and became a stay-at-home mom. Neglected, unsatisfied and undervalued in her 10-year marriage, Anna starts to reminisce about her passion-filled relationship with her rockstar ex-boyfriend, Adrian Jones. When the charismatic and dangerous Adrian reappears in her mundane life, Anna is forced to face her deepest desires…and choose between her past and present.

title: That Beggar Wants Out
description: Stan Shaw, a skilled master of medicine and martial arts, disguises himself as a beggar to escape a marriage contract with the Miller family. Contrary to his plan, they insist on the marriage. Yet the one they want him to marry isn't necessarily the one he thought.

title: The Little Witch
description: Freya is kidnapped by a coven of witches, hidden away in a tower like Rapunzel, waiting for the day her magic awakens. The evil witche's plan is thwarted when a brave witch hunter saves Freya and runs away with her. Now Freya must navigate a modern world that she's never lived in before, and learn the true meaning of love and sacrifice.

title: The Art of Letting Go
description:
When Olivia signs up for a life-saving surgery that will erase every memory - including the man who broke her heart - she's finally ready to walk away from her painful marriage.
But with 14 days left on the clock, her cold, distant husband realizes too late what he's about to lose.

title: The Return of the Lost Striker
description: When André Brandão, son of famous NFL quarterback Thiago Brandão and former beauty queen Cristina, disappears in a devastating fire, the psychotic fan Dinho sees an opportunity to swap André for his own son, Vitor. Twelve years later, the two boys meet at soccer tryouts, where André surpasses Vitor. The Brandão family, unaware that André is their long-lost son, relentlessly attack him. They subject him to physical and mental torture, encouraged by their adopted son. Until they discover the shocking truth—André is the one they were looking for. The Brandão family then do everything to beg for forgiveness while Vitor and Dinho plot revenge.

title: Too Late to Love Me—So He Went Back in Time
description:
Sharon, an ordinary art student, publicly confessed her love to wealthy young master Ryan at his birthday party, only to be humiliated ruthlessly. Her years of humble devotion turned into a laughingstock, leaving her heartbroken and determined to start a new life. On the night she planned to move out, a man who looked exactly like Ryan blocked her way.

He was Ryan from three years in the future, traveling back filled with remorse. In his past life, he lost Sharon, watched her art school admission spot be stolen by Ryan’s younger sister Lena, her talent buried, and she was eventually driven to commit suicide.

Having returned to make amends, he revealed the truth to Sharon and guarded her as she pursued her art dream. The arrogant present-day Ryan and scheming Lena kept sabotaging her at every turn. Future Ryan foiled their plots time and again and exposed their true colors. In the end, Sharon rediscovered her talent, rose to the pinnacle of the art world, and gradually opened her heart to this belated love that crossed time and space.

title: The Man I Was Meant to Forget
description:
He was the love of my life. Now, he's my sister's husband. 
Maya has loved Carter for ten years. Until the day she learned he had married her sister. She left and vanished for three years.
Now she's back. And the first thing he does is grab her wrist and call her like she's still the girl who loved him. But the ring on his finger tells a different story.

title: To Love, To Loathe, To Return
description: On her wedding day, Evelyn is shockingly replaced by her best friend and accused of murder by her fiancé, leading to her wrongful death. Now reborn, her first mission is to gather evidence while continuing to attend the wedding as the bride. Only this time, she launches a counterattack instead. The wedding is now a public apology event for the deceitful couple.

title: Spoiled by My Fiancé's Uncle
description: Out of revenge for her fiancé's betrayal with her best friend, she gets close to her fiancé's uncle, only to unexpectedly become involved with him. Not only does he offer his help when she faces difficulties, but he also supports her in secret. As their relationship deepens, they face a series of misunderstandings and challenges. Will they be able to recognize their true feelings for each other?

title: The Daughter They Cast Out
description: Aurora Ashworth built her family’s empire from nothing. Then at a celebration banquet, her parents announced she wasn’t their biological daughter — their real daughter was Juliana. Stripped of everything, Aurora returns to the impoverished Rust Belt with nothing but her business genius. Starting with a single grilled skewer food truck, she rallies the neighborhood, builds a thriving community enterprise, and turns poverty into power. Juliana, desperate to steal Aurora’s engagement and destroy her new life, launches ruthless attacks — stock shorts, supply cuts, demolition plots. Nathaniel stands by Aurora, publicly rejecting his arranged marriage to Juliana. When Frank risks his life to expose Juliana’s bribery, she kidnaps Luna in a final trap — but the scheme collapses, and she’s arrested. The family corporation goes bankrupt. The Rust Belt rises as a new business hub. Aurora gets engaged to Nathaniel and leads an entire neighborhood out of poverty, building a future entirely on her own terms.

title: The Wedding That Wasn't
description: Edward Henderson hid his wealth to win the heart of Irene Lawson, a simple, kind woman who loved him for who he was—or so he thought. On their wedding day, he planned to reveal everything. But Irene's best friend Nancy had other ideas. Poisoned by whispers of "testing his love," Irene turned the wedding into a gauntlet of absurd demands. Edward begged, reasoned, pleaded—but his bride-to-be only listened to her friend. He looked at the woman he loved, saw someone he didn't recognize, and made a choice: "The wedding is off."

title: The Last Fight
description: Don left the army and returned home. He just wanted to be with his parents and help run their small business. But then a local thug tried to skip out on the bill, and everything went wrong.

title: Twist of time
description: Ethan Arturo receives an unexpected guest, Kyle Crisanto, on the day of his father’s burial. He ends up in a bar after his mother confirms that Kyle is his step-brother. When Kyle joins him at the bar, he notices that Ethan is attracted to a certain waitress, Nathalie Andrés. Kyle urges him to talk to her, but when Ethan does so, Nathalie humiliates him. To save his crumbling pride, Ethan strikes a bet with Kyle: he'd get Nathalie in his bed before the week runs out.But things soon take a different turn.In the course of the bet, Ethan and Nathalie fall in love with each other. Well, until she finds out about the bet by an anonymous tip and calls off the relationship.A few weeks goes by and she still can’t let go of her feelings for Ethan. She’s advised by her best friend Kristine Malic, to have some sort of closure so she’d be able to move on. Nathalie heeds her advise and asks for one last night with Ethan...

title: Awakend: Martial God Beggar
description: Years ago, a family known for their qigong mastery was wiped out. Before her death, the matriarch warned her child never to use their skills again. Years later, during a martial arts competition to choose a bride, a young lady from another family is about to lose to a foreign opponent. At a critical moment, the child shatters a jade pendant, regaining strength to protect their beloved.

title: Take the Lottery Ticket, I Just Want Grandma!
description: Eleanor Crawford unexpectedly won 300 million dollars in the lottery. She planned to split it among her sons, but they only abused her when she stayed with them. Only her grandson Leo quietly cared for her, even confronting his parents to defend Grandma. Heartbroken by her ungrateful sons, Eleanor gave up on them. Before passing away, she gave the winning ticket to Leo. Disgusted by his parents, he kept it a secret. Ultimately, Leo chose not to claim the 300 million dollars, donating it all to charity instead.

title: Let the Past Rest
description: Claire, divorced and broke, becomes caregiver for Poppy, a traumatized girl. She wins Poppy's trust and marries Adrian Mercer to secure custody. Her ex-husband Daniel harasses her, but Adrian defends her. Claire and Adrian grow close, and she learns Poppy is Adrian's adopted niece. They have a child and legally adopt Poppy. Daniel loses everything. Claire finds true family and love.

title: Rise of the Trash-Tier Pilot
description: Jake Carter, an academy outcast branded as a "deserter's son," endures daily ridicule while struggling in the shadow of his father's tarnished legacy. Written off by his peers as a hopeless rookie, Jake harbors a secret: he is the only one capable of awakening Corona Prime, a forbidden, legendary mech that has remained sealed for decades. When a cataclysmic Class-5 Titan erupts from beneath the earth, crushing the dome base's defenses and obliterating all active units, humanity is left without hope. As panic spreads and the base stands on the brink of total annihilation, Jake races toward the hangar, determined to face the monster alone.

title: Virtuous Wife Supports My Ambitions
description:
I come from a poor background and had to give up attending the best university to take care of my seriously ill mother. Fortunately, my girlfriend never left me. She believed in me and encouraged me: “You are the most outstanding person I have ever met, and nothing can compare to you!”
Finally, I got an excellent job opportunity and reluctantly left home to work in the city. My boss’s daughter fell in love with me, but I only love my wife back home.
Years later, I became a CEO. Just as I was planning to return home to reunite with my wife and mother, an accident caused me to lose my memory! When I woke up, two women claimed to be my love—one dressed in luxury, the other in rags. Who should I believe?

title: True Love at Twilight
description: Widow Susan Vance raised Audrey Vance, only to be kicked out for being a country bumpkin. On her way home, she saved an amnesic Benjamin Sterling. They survived by selling wild herbs. Six years later, Benjamin Sterling suffered kidney failure after protecting Susan Vance. She secretly donated her kidney to save him. Deeply moved, Benjamin Sterling brings Susan Vance into his wealthy family to give her happiness.

title: The Wedding That Wasn't
description: Edward Henderson hid his wealth to win the heart of Irene Lawson, a simple, kind woman who loved him for who he was—or so he thought. On their wedding day, he planned to reveal everything. But Irene's best friend Nancy had other ideas. Poisoned by whispers of "testing his love," Irene turned the wedding into a gauntlet of absurd demands. Edward begged, reasoned, pleaded—but his bride-to-be only listened to her friend. He looked at the woman he loved, saw someone he didn't recognize, and made a choice: "The wedding is off."

title: The Heart That Lost Its Way
description: My husband said I was too conservative. He said he felt no physical desire for me. The very next day, he sent me to a Perfect Wife Training Program. He said I needed to “free my nature” and learn how to serve a man. I was stripped naked and put on display. “A wife who doesn’t know how to please her husband?” “Your husband paid a fortune to send you here. We’ll make sure he gets his money’s worth.” On the day they announced my “final inspection,” my husband watched as I performed for different men. He completely lost control. I licked the scars on my own body and smiled sweetly. “Honey, thanks to your careful guidance, I’ve finally become a qualified wife.” “The men I served were in heaven.” “Do you like me now?” He pulled me into his arms and broke down, sobbing.

title: The One that Got Away
description: Anna left her old life and old love behind when she married Mason and became a stay-at-home mom. Neglected, unsatisfied and undervalued in her 10-year marriage, Anna starts to reminisce about her passion-filled relationship with her rockstar ex-boyfriend, Adrian Jones. When the charismatic and dangerous Adrian reappears in her mundane life, Anna is forced to face her deepest desires…and choose between her past and present.

title: The Truth About Me
description: Lars (Bryant Sands) tries to expose the shallowness of his classmates by interviewing Chrissy (Ellie Gerber), the most popular girl in his high school. But he realizes there is more depth to her than he expected. Chrissy herself is drawn to the moody but intelligent Lars. As the chemistry between them becomes too obvious to ignore, they do what any normal teenager would: they fight it.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Marry to Top Star at 40s
description:
The female lead divorces her husband after enduring his domestic abuse, alcoholism, and infidelity. She quits her job as a high school teacher and becomes an obscure, little-known talent manager. During this time, her ex-husband continues to tear her down, while the relentless demands of her work leave her overwhelmed and exhausted. As if that weren’t enough, the top superstar she manages, Lucas, constantly gives her a hard time—teasing her every day and creating work out of thin air just to torment her. How did her life become so dark?
But—what?! Lucas was once her student?
And Lucas says he likes her?
No, impossible. Absolutely impossible!

title: The Other Guest in the Room
description:
The Final Check-in
The argument started like any other, late night frustration, a dropped call, and a simple denial from Liam. But for Sophie, the quiet sound of a laugh right before the line went dead was the undeniable crack in his carefully constructed lie. Now, every subsequent text exchange, every denial, every placating word, only escalates her suspicion that Liam isn't just cheating, he's concealing a truth far more dangerous. Trapped in a digital echo chamber of their history, Sophie desperately pushes for proof, unaware that her ultimatum, If you're alone, prove it, will unleash a torrent of evidence and chilling confessions that reveal Liam is not just with another person, but that the stakes of his secrecy extend far beyond a shattered relationship. The conversation that follows will turn an argument about trust into a frantic race for survival, all unfolding in the unforgiving, public glare of their private chat history.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Too Late to Love You
description: Camila is an aerial dance enthusiast who discovers that her boyfriend, Andrés, has been cheating on her. She tries to use dance as a way to forget him, but she must confront the memories they shared. She'll have to come to terms with the idea that the truth she needed to know hasn't arrived too late.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Reset: Taming the Tyrant
description: Lillian transmigrates into the doomed consort as tyrant Felix orders her family's execution. Using a reset system, she alters their fate by rewinding time. Felix, aware of the loops, suspects witchcraft but plays along. As Felix falls for Lillian, they shift from enemies to lovers, combining her reset ability and their wits to defeat the rebels together.

title: Late but True Love
description: Gemma Sully was set up by her stepsister for a one-night stand with a stranger. Even her fiancé called off their engagement. Desperate to help her critically ill mother, Gemma begged her father, who cruelly suggested she spend a night with an old man. Enraged, she impulsively married a stranger who promised to cover her mother's medical expenses. Initially, she believed she married an ordinary man with good looks, but he turned out to be a powerful figure from a prestigious family.

title: One-Night Stand With the Right Man
description: Grace Shaw, drugged while saving a man overseas, has a one-night stand with a stranger, Nathan Fenton. Back home, Nathan returns to break off an engagement. But he didn't know his fiancée was Grace. To reclaim her family's company, Grace forces him to stay engaged. Neither knows the other's true identity. Secrets and missed chances keep them apart until the truth surfaces, the past is revealed, and love finds its way back.

title: Attack Speed x10: Rise to the Top
description: When the game Aethelgard launches globally, players from every nation race to seize resources and dominate the game. Quinn Flynn awakens a god-tier talent at launch — Tenfold Attack Speed. His unmatched DPS lets him farm mobs and slay bosses at a fast speed no one can match. He secures top-tier resources, leads the Atherian region to the top of the server rankings, and monopolizes the global in-game economy. His rise catches the attention of a hot guild leader. He's the super hero in the game.

title: Don't Mess with That Beggar
description: Winnie, the beautiful heiress of the Shaw family, finds the boy she once helped, now a beggar. In a shocking twist, she kneels and proposes to Timothy on the street. Impressed by her loyalty, he agrees to marry her and returns to the Shaw family with her. But her family is furious, demanding she either leave him or leave the family. Timothy warns that if they force them out, they will regret it.

title: Carter Reed
description: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. Emma killed a mafia prince to save her best friend, and now the city wants her dead.  There’s only one place left to turn: Carter Reed - the most feared man in the city and the man her dying brother trusted with her life.   Carter promised to protect her from monsters, even from himself.  But the more time she spends under his protection, the more Emma realizes she’s falling for a monster. And the more Carter wants the one woman he swore to never touch.  Will they give in, or will their enemies catch them first?

title: Caged by His Twisted Love
description: Nora Harrison thought she killed mafia boss Luca Moretti. But he survives and resurfaces as a billionaire investor, trapping her in his world and forces Nora into a dangerous game: become his woman or lose everything she loves.

title: Reborn to Love Mr. Right
description: Arianna dies a tragic death on the day of her graduation, while Derek, the driver's son, takes all the spotlight on stage. She gave him everything—her car, her credit card, even her father’s company—only to be used and discarded. While he spoiled Ivy like a princess, he treated Arianna like a servant. Only in death does she realize that Hayden, the billionaire’s heir - had been waiting for her all along. Now, fate gives her a second chance to make things right.

title: Return of the Reaper
description: Isaac Kane is a single father with a dark secret: he was once the most feared killer on the planet. After making a vow to his dying wife to never kill again, he now spends his days as a down-on-his-luck single father. But when his daughter is kidnapped by a major crime family, he must break his vow... and kill his way through the Russian Mafia, while re-taking his place as a near-mythic killer that haunts the nightmares of the wicked.

title: Reborn to Marry a Beggar Prince
description: Reborn after her family was slaughtered by her treacherous husband, she crushed her wedding crown, divorced the marquis, and took a homeless fool as her new groom. The city mocked her blindness. But that “beggar” was secretly the crown prince, waiting for the perfect moment to reveal himself.

title: Reborn, Not Yours
description: Eight years of agony. Endless betrayals. Then a second chance. Madeline Hayes awakens at the start of her nightmare, and she's not the same naive girl anymore. She cuts off her so-called uncle, trashes his precious first love, and gets her revenge cold and clean. But when she turns to leave for good, the man who once broke her now clings to her, red-eyed, begging her to stay.

title: Reborn from Hell, Dragon's Wrath
description: Logan Collins, heir to a wealthy family, was framed by his first love and sent to prison. While incarcerated, his family was tragically killed, and their assets were seized by his ex-girlfriend Jenna Grant's family. The only surviving relative is his young aunt. Fortunately, during his time behind bars, Logan mastered extraordinary skills—antiques, appraisal, gambling, medicine, and even cultivation. Upon release, he emerges invincible. Watch as Logan protects his only remaining family and navigates the urban jungle with swift justice!

title: Ride or Die: Predator's Game
description: Rider Jade Zeller's passionate affair with the domineering CEO Easton Quinn ends with a million-dollar breakup fee. Unexpectedly, he turns out to be the fiancé of her malicious stepsister, and the man pursuing her is his nephew! As enemies close in, Jade transforms into a seductive hunter, turning the tables, while Easton loses control in this forbidden temptation. In this dangerous game of manipulation, who is the true prey?

title: Return of the Heir
description: Marcus Hale gifts his girlfriend his prized patent, securing her an award from the Zenith Group. But at the ceremony, she turns on him and orders his legs broken to impress a richer man. As the beatdown starts, Zenith's CEO freezes. She recognizes the bloodied young man. He's her son, who lost years ago. Now, hell will break loose.

title: Reborn for My Mr. Right
description: I died once because I trusted the wrong man. Never again. At the auction that destroyed me last time, I humiliate my rival, buy a "worthless" mega-project for billions, and suddenly—a dark, powerful stranger offers me eighty billion like it's nothing. He says he's loved me for two lifetimes. I say: prove it.

title: Reborn, Rise and Revenge
description: Angela Davis was trapped into marrying into a wealthy family, only to face jealousy from Amy Miller and be falsely accused of murder, leading to her tragic death. Reborn, Angela is determined to get revenge. Start by leaving this man behind! At first, Jason Brown dismisses her, but gradually finds himself somehow drawn to her. Will Angela's quest for justice and independence lead to unexpected love?

title: Reborn, Not Yours
description: Eight years of agony. Endless betrayals. Then a second chance. Madeline Hayes awakens at the start of her nightmare, and she's not the same naive girl anymore. She cuts off her so-called uncle, trashes his precious first love, and gets her revenge cold and clean. But when she turns to leave for good, the man who once broke her now clings to her, red-eyed, begging her to stay.

title: Reborn for You
description: After being reborn in 1984, Luke sees his pregnant wife Rachel and swears to change his ways. Determined to give his wife and unborn son the life they deserve, he starts from nothing, picking up scraps to earn a living. With every step, he works not only to build a future but also to win back Rachel's trust and love.

title: Reborn From Betrayal to Reign
description: In her past life, Seraphina Sterling forsook her royal duty for Lucius Hawthorne, only to die painfully by his betrayal and poison. Reborn amid blood, she comes back with glorious military victories, exposes every conspiracy, and leaves the guilty drowning in regret. Beyond love and hate, she claims ultimate power and rules as empress.

title: Reborn to Make My Three Brothers Cry
description: In my previous life, as the real heiress, I was framed by the fake one and her three brothers. In the end, I was poisoned and married to a dead person. After rebirth, I used the information from my previous life to send the fake heiress and her three brothers to prison. I will rise to the top step by step and become the chairman of my Group!

title: Reborn for Love
description:
"How dare you still say words like going home together!" I couldn't believe that the man I love so deeply has betrayed me! I killed him with my own hands,  and I was framed and killed by my sister.
But I'm given a second chance. Reborn back to when everything hasn't surfaced, this time, I'm going to take the initiative! Those who has ruined me in my past life, I will make them pay.

title: Reborn from Hell, Dragon's Wrath
description: Logan Collins, heir to a wealthy family, was framed by his first love and sent to prison. While incarcerated, his family was tragically killed, and their assets were seized by his ex-girlfriend Jenna Grant's family. The only surviving relative is his young aunt. Fortunately, during his time behind bars, Logan mastered extraordinary skills—antiques, appraisal, gambling, medicine, and even cultivation. Upon release, he emerges invincible. Watch as Logan protects his only remaining family and navigates the urban jungle with swift justice!

title: Beast-Taming: All Evolve, I Revert
description: Expelled by the Collins family, illegitimate child Miles Collins has rare beast-taming talent but is too poor to form a pact with even a lowest-tier spirit beast. Humiliated by Ryan Collins and Sophie Grant, he awakens the Ultimate Beastmaster Reversion System. While others evolve, he uses ancestral reversion to turn a green caterpillar into the Void Azure Dragon!

title: Reborn: I'm the Devourer
description: Betrayed, drained, and slain by the Crown Princess in his past life, now, Cillian is reborn — and seizes the Crown Princess's Nether Power. Dismissed as a broken prince, he secretly wields the Omni Cauldron. Fifteen acupoints unlocked. Divine Seed condensed. His enemies fall before they understand. This life, he doesn't seek revenge — he seeks ashes. The dynasty will burn. The throne awaits. And beyond it, his true destiny.

title: Return After Ten Years
description: Successful Madeline Hawthorne invests $1 billion in Virtue Creek to fulfill Grandfather Hawthorne's dying wish. Returning for his 10th memorial, she faces emotional blackmail from her aunt, uncle, and cousin, who try to force her into marriage for a hefty bride price. When Madeline Hawthorne's true identity is exposed, her family and the Town Supervisor greedily demand more. Even a student she sponsored joins the ungrateful wretches, plotting to traffic her to Myanmar. Ultimately, evil gets its due, and they all pay the price!

title: The Wolves’ Regret for Their Rabbit
description:
Freya, a female rabbit beastkin, was adopted by Lady Hughes, her mother’s best friend, after her parents passed away. She grew up and attended school alongside Landon and Marcel, the twin wolf beastkin brothers of the Hughes household. The twins were popular celebrities at the beastkin academy. Leveraging her rabbit-type healing powers, Freya tirelessly helped them resolve all kinds of troubles, fully believing she would marry one of the two brothers someday.
Everything fell apart the moment Charlotte, a fox beastkin, appeared. Charlotte schemed relentlessly to frame Freya and drive her away. She successfully manipulated the wolf twins into misunderstanding Freya, creating a rift between them. Tormented and wronged, Freya drifted apart from the brothers. Overcome with despair, she resolved to transfer schools and wed Grayson, the young heir of a lion beastkin clan.
Only after Freya left did the Hughes twins wake up to the truth, see Charlotte the fox beastkin’s true colors clearly, and drown in remorse. Yet it was far too late. Freya was already with Grayson, had completely let go of the past, and was preparing for their wedding.

title: The Pauper Shifter I Married By Force Is The Real Heir
description: Reborn on my 18th engagement day, I watched my jealous sister grab the fake wealthy serpent heir. I chose the ragged handsome merman Orion, the real hidden Kensington heir. At the gala, I exposed the serpent’s swamp monster disguise and his brutal abuse of Lily. After Tristan attacked us, Orion’s family paid me off to leave. I fled overseas—until a giant iridescent mermaid tail cut through the sea toward my cruise ship.

title: Wrong Sperm Buyer, Right Marriage
description: When Alfred Lane answers a "surrogate wanted" ad to pay for his mother's medical bills, he never imagines he'll walk away married to Claire Sloane, the legendary ice queen CEO in Saltwick. Their contract is simple: he gets paid, she gets an heir. But Alfred's hidden combat skills and mysterious past turn the tables on judgmental relatives and jealous ex. As Claire sees the real man behind the facade, their fake marriage starts to feel dangerously real.

title: Iron Ark: Rebirth
description: Seven days before the catastrophic flood, Serena Hale is reborn. Using her severance pay, she buys a discarded steel tank, gives up a respectable life, and frantically hoards supplies—turning the tank into Noah's Ark and humiliating her sneering ex-coworker Celine Shaw. When disaster strikes, she coldly watches Celine and the others fall, driving off looters and her vicious former landlord Victor Kane again and again. Surviving brutal cold through sheer ruthlessness, she uncovers the coordinates to Dawnhaven Base, sails there, hides her supplies, blends in as a refugee—and rises to claim her place in the new world.

title: Wrong Heir, Right Throne
description: A nobody delivery driver, Wyatt Fletcher, suddenly discovers he is the long-lost heir to the Winslow family — the owners of Starlight Media, a struggling live-streaming empire. Surrounded by scheming rivals like Vaughn Sterling and betrayal within the company, he must rise from the bottom, take control of the failing group, and outplay everyone who once looked down on him. No longer an errand boy, he becomes the boss — and he’s ready to rewrite the rules of the industry.

title: Iron Ark: Rebirth
description: Seven days before the catastrophic flood, Serena Hale is reborn. Using her severance pay, she buys a discarded steel tank, gives up a respectable life, and frantically hoards supplies—turning the tank into Noah's Ark and humiliating her sneering ex-coworker Celine Shaw. When disaster strikes, she coldly watches Celine and the others fall, driving off looters and her vicious former landlord Victor Kane again and again. Surviving brutal cold through sheer ruthlessness, she uncovers the coordinates to Dawnhaven Base, sails there, hides her supplies, blends in as a refugee—and rises to claim her place in the new world.

title: Born to Bring Luck I Married My Ex’s Rival
description: Nora Quinn was born lucky—for everyone but herself. Paid to marry into the Hale family, she turned their bankruptcy into billions. Their thanks? Her husband called her a jinx and handed her $500,000 to disappear. So she walked out and married his biggest rival that same afternoon. Now watch the Hales burn.

title: Wrong Sperm Buyer, Right Marriage
description: When Alfred Lane answers a "surrogate wanted" ad to pay for his mother's medical bills, he never imagines he'll walk away married to Claire Sloane, the legendary ice queen CEO in Saltwick. Their contract is simple: he gets paid, she gets an heir. But Alfred's hidden combat skills and mysterious past turn the tables on judgmental relatives and jealous ex. As Claire sees the real man behind the facade, their fake marriage starts to feel dangerously real.

title: Born at Sea, Born for Revenge
description: Nadia Mercer never saw death coming from the people she loved most. Betrayed by her husband Brandon and her best friend Marnie, she was drugged, locked inside a shipping container, and cast into the open sea—pregnant and left to die. But a kick from within changed everything. Fighting for two, she endured the impossible. Now Nadia is back. She walks into Brandon and Marnie's wedding—not to congratulate them, but to destroy them!

title: King Of Mars：From Red Dust He Rises
description:
Max, a Martian prince born with extraordinary powers, witnesses his mother being poisoned and his throne usurped by his uncle Silas. Cast into the wilderness and left to die, Max survives and sets out on a path of vengeance and rescue.
He joins forces with a team of mercenaries and, amid the brutal arenas of Mars, awakens his power of “Reversal.” Step by step, he exposes Silas’s conspiracy and ultimately returns to the palace to reclaim the throne and secure the future of Mars.

title: Mocked No More, Emperor Returns
description: Celestial Emperor Abe Marshall awakens in his final, broken avatar as a lowly live-in husband. But this is no helpless pawn. With his power, he deals with the scheming in-laws, hateful cousins, and finally rids himself of his hateful wife. They thought they owned him. They were dead wrong.

title: The Househusband's Hustle
description: Modern office worker Finn Morgan accidentally transmigrates into the body of the Stanley family's deadbeat son-in-law, who was an abusive gambler plotting to steal the family's fortune. Now, with a math Ph.D. and expertise in medicine, Finn reforms to protect his wife, Elena. But it looks like this is a lot of work.

title: Our Marry-Go-Round
description: A rich young lady and a wealthy CEO cross paths while fleeing from their arranged marriages. They agree to a contract marriage, each hiding their true identities. As they navigate this arrangement, caring for one another, love gradually begins to blossom.

title: Simp Reborn: Win Over Her Mom
description: Adrian Mercer transmigrates into a female-oriented fiction novel. Using the God-tier Favor System, he defies fate to become a laid-back villain in this hilarious tale.

title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
description: Sebastian Klein is a loser and an ex-con. No girl in her right mind would marry him... until you!

title: The Billionaire's Virgin Surrogate
description: What happens when a student surrogate proposes to her client that they should conceive the baby the natural way?  Desperate to save her father, Harper agrees to carry a baby for Will Trenton— a single, mouthwateringly hot billionaire. As their worlds collide and the boundaries blur, Harper finds herself irresistibly drawn to Will. But beneath the surface, a question remain: Is Will feeling the same?

title: Forced to Marry, Forced to Rule
description: After his past life was ruined by women, Charles Gray only wants to stay away from them and cultivate in peace. But his system has other plans: marry or die. So he kidnaps a holy maiden, charms an ancient empress, and somehow ends up with a harem he never asked for. Along the way, he unlocks insane powers, a hundredfold return cheat, and a divine body that makes him irresistible. The catch? Every new wife might just drain him dry. He says he's not a playboy, but the system says otherwise.

title: Daisy Tucker and Mr. NYC
description: After a flash marriage, country girl Daisy finds herself married to her new boss, Hamilton Smith, owner of Smith Media. But misunderstandings and plots by Hamilton's evil VP, Bianca, threaten to destroy their relationship before they can confess that they really love each other.

title: How to Break a DILF
description: Sophie was just an intern. Until a leaked text exposed her fantasies about her boss. Humiliated, heartbroken, and still hopelessly in love. She tries to move on, but when danger strikes, Jesse’s the one who saves her. Now they're living under one roof.  Late-night glances turn into dirty secrets. She’s his best friend’s daughter. He’s the man she can’t stop wanting. Temptation was never part of the plan.

title: Snatched a Billionaire to be My Husband
description: What happens when you fall in love with your ex's uncle?!

title: Wrong
description: Based on the novel by Jana Aston. Sophie Tisdale has a foolproof plan to lose her virginity before senior year ends...until someone informs her that her partner-to-be has a bet on whether he can film taking her v-card. That someone being Luke, her gorgeous coffee shop regular....slash her new pelvic examiner. How wrong is it to have a thing for your campus gynecologist...and why doesn't Sophie really seem to care?

title: Your Love Broke My Heart
description: Seraph was a princess cherished by her family her entire life, until her sister was murdered. When her husband and best friend helped the killer escape justice, she was forced to grow up overnight.

title: Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance
description: Facing family pressure to quit college and marry, Clarisse's world changes when she meets Austin, the CEO of Lloyd Group after helping his grandmother after a scam. Learning about her financial struggles, he offers her money in exchange for a fake marriage to fulfill his grandmother's wish. They form an unexpected alliance, while Austin keep his true identity a secret from her.

title: Dear My Cruel Brothers
description: After my parents died, I was raised by Aunt Sandra, my mother's best friend,  and cherished by her two sons, the Miller brothers. I believed I would one day marry one of them. But when maid's daughter, Lola, arrived, everything changed. The Miller brothers cruelly broke my heart. Only after I left did they realize what they had lost and desperately search for me.

title: The Real Mrs. Morris
description: Alone on a Business Trip for a Year (28 episodes) follows Catherine Morris, CEO of Morris Group and top scientist. After a year of research in Seattle, she discovers her husband Evan betrayed their DINK agreement—he has a baby with mistress Megan, who seizes her Beverly Hills mansion and pretends to be Ms. Morris. Catherine is blocked, humiliated, framed for mental illness and fired. Saved by her brother Chris, she learns Evan’s wealth and status come from her, with her patents under his name. Villains are punished: Megan jailed for fraud, Evan for assault and bigamy. Catherine recovers, presents groundbreaking research, and becomes a Nobel candidate, shining as herself, not just the chairman’s sister.

title: Kiss Me One Last Time
description: Adeline Rhodes is diagnosed with stage four kidney cancer and has months to live. Her husband, Blake Rhodes, seems preoccupied with her half-sister Rebecca, whom she constantly has to donate blood to. Blake mistakes Adeline for a calculating gold-digger, and she thinks he’s never loved her. All of this changes when Blake finds out Adeline’s dying, but it might be too late for him to tell her that it was her that he loved all this time.

title: America's Favorite Ex-Husband
description: An aspiring writer’s life is turned upside down when he rescues an up-and-coming Hollywood starlet.  Ten years later, Daniel’s the house husband to America’s Sweetheart, ignored and invisible to the paparazzi and his own family.  When a megastar old flame comes back to seduce his wife, Daniel’s life reaches a new level of hell and he realizes he must do the unthinkable: divorce America’s Sweetheart!  By the time his famous wife realizes what she’s lost, it may be too late to win him back.

title: Mancini’s Forbidden Bride
description: Pregnant. Widowed. Dragged into the Mancini mafia. Ava never expected her late husband to be the hidden heir—nor to crave his ruthless brother. Ice-cold don Luca vows to shield her, but every touch ignites a forbidden fire. Rival gangs close in, her birth family plots betrayal, and the dynasty teeters on war. How long before Luca shatters every rule to claim the woman worth killing for?

title: Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King
description: Vanessa Peters is in for a surprise when she goes to sell her eggs to pay off her boyfriend's debt... and ends up pregnant due to a clinical error. She decides to keep the child after finding out her boyfriend is cheating on her, but begins to fear her decision when she finds out that the father is no other than Marcello Lavigne, a ruthless, murderous Mafia King. After saving her life from thugs who try to attack her for having mafia money, Marcello moves Vanessa to his mansion against her will. As he continuously proves his commitment to keeping her safe from criminals, bullies, and his mafia family, Vanessa begins to develop feelings for him despite his player behavior and his murderous capacity. Will she accept Marcello as the father to her child, and accept his offer to become queen of the Mafia empire?

title: Straight A Pregnancy
description: After a one-night stand with Ben, the hottest guy on campus, Kelsey realizes she's pregnant...and decides to keep the baby. But will Ben stick around - or will he stay a flirty fratboy forever?

title: Untouchable Until Her
description: Nina Hart is a struggling intern desperate to pay for her grandmother's surgery. Xavier Scott is Kingsrow's most powerful tycoon, a man who can't stand anyone's touch. One drunken mistake changes everything when Nina becomes the only woman he can touch, and a month later, a pregnancy ties them together for good. Xavier shields her from every hurt and even makes her his wife. Nina thinks he only wants an heir, never realizing the one he truly can't let go is her.

title: The Rise of the Ugly Luna
description:
Lyric, an Alpha’s scarred and wolf-less daughter, was betrayed by her mate and exiled after a one-night stand with a powerful stranger. Five years in the human world cured her face and awakened a forbidden gift: she is a "Siphon," able to absorb any disease.
Forced back by family debt, Lyric enters a contract marriage with the ruthless King Jaris—only to realize he was her one-night stranger. Misled by his scheming "wife" Marta into believing Lyric betrayed him, Jaris is cruel by day, yet so obsessed with her body that he drugs her by night for secret intimacy, leaving Lyric believing it’s all a vivid dream.
But the secrets run deeper: Lyric’s presumed-dead twins are alive, stolen by Marta to claim the throne. And from the shadows, Jaris’s exiled brother Caden is returning with a blood-drinking army to burn it all down.

title: Double Souls Under the Moon
description: Leah was the soft, obedient heir everyone thought they could break. But when she is nearly drowned, Vera, the dangerous soul sealed inside her body, finally awakens. Betrayed by family, framed by a fake daughter, and abandoned by her mate, Leah has lost almost everything. Now Vera is back to expose every lie, punish every traitor, and reclaim the throne they were both born to rule.

title: Love You Until I Forget You
description: Grace, a bankrupt heiress, didn't want to burden Marcus. So she lied about having an abortion to make Marcus leave. Seven years later, a little cripple girl kept meeting Marcus by fate to raise her mother's medical expenses. Marcus initially thought this kid was without parental education, but he never expected she was actually his daughter with Grace. After learning the truth, Marcus desperately wanted to reunite with Grace and his daughter, but fate was not on his side. Grace was dying and was forgetting him...

title: The Mute Luna and Her Cursed Word
description: Elara is the Moon's Voice—whatever she speaks becomes real. To save the world, she swore silence for ten years. Her husband Roman believed Vanessa's lies that Elara betrayed him. He cut off her hand, blinded her eyes, slaughtered her entire family—all to force her blessing. When her seven-year-old sister's head rolled to her feet, Elara finally screamed her first words in a decade. But she didn't speak a blessing. She spoke a curse: “The Lycan King's reign is rotten. The world will break.” Roman's kingdom crumbled. Frostmoon crushed him. Vanessa's heir was exposed as a bastard. Roman burned his own hall to let Elara escape. Ten years later, a new Lycan King united all packs—a strong age built without any Moon's Voice at all.

title: Revengeful Return of the Ugly Beauty
description: Not long after marriage, her husband had an affair with one of her students, and the two caused her, eight months pregnant, to fall into the sea. After plastic surgery, she transformed into a stunning goddess, returned, and embarked on a journey of revenge.

title: True Luna
description: When Emma Parker turns 18, she discovers her fated mate is Logan Carter, the alpha of her pack. But that happiness is short-lived when Logan rejects her for another she-wolf. Soon after, Emma learns that she is no ordinary wolf, and that many dangerous people are after her. Alpha Logan rejected Emma, so why is he willing to risk it all to keep Emma safe?

title: True Luna：On My Terms
description:
Chris, a low-level Omega werewolf, is brutally murdered during her pregnancy by her mate Alex and former friend Janet.
Reborn one year prior to their bonding ceremony, she decisively rejects the scumbag in public and severs their bond, triggering her hidden bloodline 		as the "True Luna" (Mother of all Werewolves).
Guided by a mysterious vision, she must find her true love within a month to fully awaken and survive. Taken in by Leon, the powerful Alpha of the 	Fire Moon Pack, Chris faces  continuous  framing  by  the villains.  
Ultimately,  through  numerous trials, she and Leon firmly choose each other, leading to her complete awakening.They cast the evil duo into the 	dungeon and live happily ever after.

title: You Fired A Genius Surgeon
description: After Dr. Adrian Marksman, the most renowned surgeon in the country, gets dismissed by his boss's son, he joins forces with Dr. Vivian Hart, the brilliant and ambitious head of a rival hospital. This move drives his former hospital into financial ruin, and when Preston realizes he has let go of the wrong doctor, it's already too late...

title: The Gourmet CEO Turns out to Be My Baby's Dad
description: Betrayed by her family, Skylar is forced into a compromising situation with a sleazy-looking director in exchange for her grandmother's medical bills. However, she unexpectedly has a one-night stand with Maxwell, CEO of Klein Group, instead, leading to an unplanned pregnancy. Sent abroad, Skyhlar returns six years later with her son and opens a restaurant. Fate eventually brings her and Maxwell back... Will he recognize Skylar as the unforgettable woman from that fateful night?

title: The True Crown Luna
description: The True Crown Luna is a thrilling werewolf academy revenge drama. Fiona, the true heir struggling with her powers, has her royal medallion stolen by the ambitious Dana on her way to Full Moon Academy. Dana usurps Fiona's identity, bullying the school and trying to claim Fiona’s fated mate, Crown Alpha Marcus. Forced into the role of a janitor, Fiona endures the cruelty while secretly mastering her abilities. As the Full Moon Ceremony nears, Fiona unleashes her true Moon Goddess powers. Alongside Marcus, she exposes the imposter, reclaims her throne, and forces the entire pack to bow down to their true Queen!

title: Sugar Daddy's Sweet Pursuit
description: I was born with a birthmark on my face, which made me disliked by my biological parents. I was bullied since I was a child. When I grew up, I accidentally saved the billionaire CEO who was drugged, and the birthmark on my face miraculously disappeared. The mysterious CEO therefore prepared a gift worth hundreds of billions, wanting to marry me...

title: Burn the House Down
description: Nick Caldwell, 30, chased 20-year-old Cecilia Voss hard. She fell for him, only to get betrayed. Cecilia was nothing more than his backup option. Crushed, she came back swinging. Took him for everything, built herself back up, found a guy who actually cared. She lit her own fire.

title: My Purr-fect God
description:
Framed, dumped, and expelled at his own summoning ceremony, Evan Vance is left with nothing but a Rank F Shadow Cat until the Divine Tamer System awakens.
What everyone calls trash evolves into a god-tier Devour Beast, crushing City-Destroyers and overwhelming even the legendary Void Devourer.
Meanwhile, the so-called genius Iris Moore has no idea that the man she abandoned has already stepped beyond destruction… and is on his way to becoming a god.

title: Caught! The Ruthless Alpha's Runaway Luna
description: Betrayed by her boyfriend. Hunted down by her father. Forced to mate with a ruthless Alpha King. Cora thought her life was over until she escaped and accidentally marked a dangerous, magnetic stranger. Left with no choice, she accepted a fake mating proposal from that stranger, totally unaware that her "contract mate" is the very Alpha King she’s desperately trying to escape...

title: Revengeful Return of the Ugly Beauty
description: Not long after marriage, her husband had an affair with one of her students, and the two caused her, eight months pregnant, to fall into the sea. After plastic surgery, she transformed into a stunning goddess, returned, and embarked on a journey of revenge.

title: Audrey in Full Bloom
description: Harvard MBA Audrey Lorenzo Bloom is on her way to shatter barriers as powerful conglomerate BloomCo’s first female and non-white CEO.  She’s been preparing for years, even using an alias as a Latina cleaning lady to learn the inner workings of the company.
