Now on the eve of the banquet introducing her, Audrey discovers her fiancé thinks she’s an illegal alien and plans to defraud and deport her, the senior executives are plotting a coup to put her white cousin in charge, and her bitterest enemy since childhood, Ryder Marlow, might not be her enemy after all…

title: Love at First Shot
description: Stella Langford's college shuts down. She has to transfer to another college, but ends up living with Nathaniel Hawthorne, CEO of Hawthorne Group. They are forced into a contract marriage. Bullied by socialite Vicky Swing, Stella fights back with her sharp wits and shooting skills. But when her true identity and a buried past begin to surface, Nathaniel realizes the girl he married on paper is the one he's been destined to protect all along.

title: The Eunuch's Gambit
description: Jeremy, a fortune teller from the 21st century, is transported to ancient times and becomes a fake eunuch. Initially planning to stay under the radar, his life changes when he's caught by the princess while pretending to serve her. Forced into a relationship, Jeremy wins the princess's heart. Using his strategic genius, he rises through the ranks in the palace, eventually becoming the first-ever "Lord of Leisure."

title: Brother, Your Buddy Seduced Me
description: Angelina is exiled abroad for five years after falling for her adopted brother, Nick. Upon returning, she meets his buddy Tristan—a dangerous jerk she knows she must avoid. She never expects to fall into a secret affair with him, completely unaware that this forbidden love game is his long-planned seduction.

title: The Power of Love: A Disabled Tycoon's Heart
description: The female protagonist marries her boyfriend to inherit the family business, only to discover on her wedding day that she has stomach cancer and is immediately abandoned by her boyfriend! To get back at the scoundrel, she quickly marries a blind man, only to find out after the marriage that he is not blind at all, but the wealthiest person in the city. The female lead and her husband join forces to confront the scoundrel and the unfaithful woman, regain their family fortune, and after learning of the misdiagnosis, they live happily ever after.

title: Never Promise Forever
description: To fulfill a thousand-year vow, the Goddess Selena created a magical puppet to withstand the cruelty of her reincarnated lover, Seth. When the puppet finally shatters, Seth is consumed by a gut-wrenching realization of the truth. Selena, however, has already found a soulmate in Christian, leaving the three of them trapped in a whirlpool of obsession and fate. After surviving life-or-death trials, Selena lets go of her fixation on the past. She then uncovers Christian's own heart-wrenching secret spanning cycles of reincarnation.

title: Careful, You're Dangerous
description: Abandoned as a child, Sylvia is taken in by Yale and raised like a princess, but she mistakes his care for love. Years later, after being sent abroad by the Shepherd family, she returns to find them trapped in a scheme. To repay Yale, she becomes Theo's secret lover, unaware that he has loved her quietly for years. Through his unwavering devotion, Sylvia finally learns what true love really is.

title: Rewritten Vows
description: Aurora Quinn loved Oscar Russel, but he and his sister Luna betrayed her. After death, she learns Oscar’s brother, Lucian, was her true protector. Reborn, she returns to the moment Sir Russel asks her to choose a husband and picks Lucian. Oscar keeps scheming but at the wedding Lucian exposes him onstage. In the end, Sir Russel revives and expels Oscar, while Aurora and Lucian start anew.

title: Seduced by My Proud Fiance
description: On the day the Stone family's second daughter is to be married, the long-dead eldest daughter returns, now inhabited by Ellie, a thousand-year-old immortal. Sent to repay a love debt, Ellie is bound to Sebastian, a cold and powerful heir who resents her across lifetimes. As she restores the fallen Stone clan and earns his love, Ellie finally breaks her love trial only to give up immortality to save him.

title: A Father's Redemption
description: In his past life, Austin ignored his own daughter for a widow named Anna, raising Anna's two sons. But when he got old and ill, Anna and her sons refused to pay his medical bills. So he died in pain. After rebirth, he wouldn't be a stepfather again. He rejected ungrateful Anna, and decided to earn more money to raise his own daughter well. In the end, he also got a nice wife Daisy...

title: Reborn to Fly
description: Rae's dream was to be a pilot. But when she found out that she was pregnant, she married her boyfriend and settled down as a housewife. Seven years later, while on her husband's flight, Rae discovered his secret: he had been keeping a mistress for years. Adding to the horror was the plane crashing in a thunderstorm; it seemed that certain death awaited them... Until she found herself going back in time with her memories intact. Now, Rae must make new choices to rewrite her future... before it's too late!

title: Power Never Felt So Sweet
description: Julia, Mystic Grandmaster, failed her ascension and was reborn as a rich heiress sharing her name. Betrayed by her adoptive father and a scheming fake heiress, she turned their tricks against them. Forced to help restore her power, Noah, the Hale heir, started falling for Julia. Together, they navigated schemes, danger, and mutual love.

title: Lured to Ruin
description: Blinded in a crash, Zoe Reed learns her husband Arthur Crawford is having an affair with the maid, Monica Walsh. Even their adopted daughter, Mia, is actually their illegitimate daughter. Zoe regained her sight long ago but plays blind to gather evidence. She secretly reclaims her father's assets and traps Arthur in massive debt. Eventually, Arthur and Monica are utterly ruined, leaving Mia in deep regret. Amidst her revenge, Zoe falls for a delivery guy, Dominic Lancaster—who is secretly a CEO—and starts a new life.

title: Velvet, Blood & Power
description:
Twelve years ago, Lila watched her sister Mira get murdered—a gold hairpin through her throat, ordered by a general’s mistress. Today, Lila is that general’s top mistress, a dancer whose beauty hides a blade. She sleeps beside her family’s destroyer, Julian Ashford, waiting for the perfect kill. But on the brink of revenge, she discovers the impossible: Mira loved this man. Now Lila is trapped between hatred, truth, and a taboo desire she never expected. With the wife, the mistresses, spies, and rebels all circling, this blood‑soaked game of seduction and vengeance will leave no one unscathed.

Please note that Episodes 54 and 55 of this series were AI-generated.

title: Vengeance in the Veil
description: The rich heiress Isabelle stole Natalie's fiance on her wedding. Natalie's father was too mad and fainted. Isabelle demanded that nobody go to treat Natalie's father. Natalie decided to take revenge. She went to seduce Isabelle's father Dominic. Dominic knew what Natalie was up to, but he still couldn't resist this young girl. He fell in love with her and married her. Natalie became Isabelle's stepmom and would take everything from Isabelle.

title: virtual lover
description: On the eve of a global short playwriting competition, a struggling playwright unexpectedly receives assistance from a mysterious AI. This mysterious AI not only provides inspiration but also simulates a perfect "AI lover" as the protagonist. Through this collaboration, they create a viral hit short play. However, as the protagonist delves deeper into the story, he discovers that he has developed complex feelings for the AI, which seems to have transcended its programming and possessed "emotions." The play explores the boundaries between humans and technology, virtuality and reality, and creativity and emotion in the age of AI.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: VEIL
description: 2 Friends get stuck on the side of the road as they look for help the stumble upon a mysterious box that leads them into each others mind and they have to find their way back to each other. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Surrounded by Heirs
description: After years of separation from your family, you finally decided to return home as the heiress. How dare these people question your identity at the party that your Billionaire father threw to welcome your comeback?! You married a man, keeping your wealthy heiress identity a secret, but turned out to be bullied by his family and cheated by him. You decided to bear them no more and return to your own family. But, you found out that someone has been impersonating you! Luckily, three handsome men are here to support you. Is your meant-to-be prince one of them? And how will you take revenge, with your own ability and strength?

title: The Alpha's Virgin Captive
description: Evelyn never meant to save the ruthless alpha, Dominic—but now she’s his mate. She’s wolfless and already chosen Harrison, but Dominic doesn’t take no for an answer. He kidnaps her, claiming her as his. She tries to run, but the more she resists, the hotter the desire burns between them. What terrifies her most? The way she’s slowly starting to crave him... more than anything.

title: A Vegas Happily Ever After
description: She’s a stripper trying to escape her past and survive. He’s the billionaire who never forgot her. She never thought she’d see him again after high school—until he walks into her club and proposes. Now she must hide their marriage from everyone who could destroy them both… and find out if he truly loves her, or just loves owning her.

title: Broken Vows, Healing Love
description: After three years of marriage to Edward Lowe, Serena Tate discovers his obsession with her sister-in-law, Miranda Sharpe, and his manipulative ways. Disillusioned, Serena divorces Edward, reclaims her assets, and revives her career in traditional medicine. Throughout her journey, Larry Sims stands by her side, helping to expose Miranda's plot to sabotage Serena. Eventually, Serena and Larry marry in a whirlwind romance, and Serena's cancer drug "New Life" achieves great success. Edward realizes his mistake, but his regret comes too late.

title: Driven by Love
description:
Harper is an orphan from the slums, with no degree and no connections. She takes a job as a live-in nanny for Liam, a former race car champion left paralyzed and broken after a career-ending crash.
One is a man who's given up on life. The other is a woman who's never had a chance to live. Through sheer grit and stubborn kindness, Harper pulls Liam back from the edge. And when her world comes crashing down, Liam becomes the shield she never had.
When danger closes in, Harper fakes a betrayal to protect him, and the two part ways in heartbreak. A year later, she resurfaces as the CEO of her own bakery empire. This time, when they meet, they stand as equals—no longer employer and employee, but rivals and soulmates.
From the slums to the top. From opposites to partners. This is a story of two people who saved each other, and loved each other, against all odds.

title: Love My Wives, Grow Strong
description: Arthur Reed, a modern man, travels back in time as a poor scholar with a system that rewards him for spoiling his wives. He marries twins, defeats bullies and bandits, and gets engaged to Duchess Sibly. In the capital, he saves the Empress Dowager, foils foreign plots, and helps the Empress defeat the regent. He then rejects power and retires peacefully with his wives.

title: Island Survival
description: He found himself stranded on a deserted island with two alluring women. With survival skills in his hands, he gradually won over the beautiful women who initially looked down on him.

title: The Funeral That Made a Boss
description: Five years ago, Damian Cross woke up in a shallow grave. His wife sold him out. His parents were dead. His sister was gone. He was the only one who walked away. Now he's back. One man. Three syndicates. One mission: tear them all down. He starts from the bottom and rises fast. Too fast. Because the higher he climbs, the closer he gets to the truth. The people who destroyed his family? Just pawns. The real monster has been watching him the whole time. This isn't revenge anymore. This is war.

title: Love My Wives, Grow Strong
description: Arthur Reed, a modern man, travels back in time as a poor scholar with a system that rewards him for spoiling his wives. He marries twins, defeats bullies and bandits, and gets engaged to Duchess Sibly. In the capital, he saves the Empress Dowager, foils foreign plots, and helps the Empress defeat the regent. He then rejects power and retires peacefully with his wives.

title: Love On Ice
description: On the night of her engagement, Charlotte discovers her fiancé William cheating with her best friend. Just as her world collapses, rising hockey star Ryan unexpectedly steps into her life and becomes the only person willing to protect her.But their connection soon pulls them into something far more dangerous than heartbreak. After Ryan is brutally injured during a suspicious game, Charlotte uncovers a web of power, money, and manipulation tied to her family fortune.

title: Saved My Life, No More Love
description: For seven years, Coralie loved Malachi with no title, no ring, no place in his world. Then his first love returned—and he proposed. Not for love. For a prenup that would pour his fortune into another woman's hands. That night, her grandmother's last wish shattered, and so did Coralie's patience. She left New York with nothing but dignity. When he finally learned what love looked like, she had already stopped needing his.

title: Mafia Boss Never Loved Me
description: I married mafia heir Vance at twenty and cared for his trauma for five years. He loathed my touch, burned my birthday gift, and let his beloved Iris wander his private study I was banned from. After he was drugged and hurt me cruelly, I begged the godfather for a divorce. When I packed bags and fled to the seaside to grab freedom, Vance broke down without me. He finally spilled his bloody childhood secret and composed a song only for me. Yet he signed divorce papers, gifting me freedom. Will we meet again after I leave everything behind?

title: My Gorgeous Wife is an Ex-Convict
description: Brielle is wrongfully accused of killing her fiancé's sister. Her fiancé refuses to believe her, and sends her to rot in prison. Three years later, after her release, Brielle works to prove her innocence. A mysterious and handsome stranger, Jay, lends her a helping hand... But there may be more to him than what meets the eye.

title: She Chose the Devil Over You
description:
Seraphina, Heaven’s mightiest seraph, defeated Hell at the cost of her blood and wings, only to be falsely charged with glory theft. The scheming angel Celeste framed her with an innocent disguise, while Aurelian, her lover, delivered the cruelest betrayal. He denied her sacrifices before all angels, severed her wings, and stripped her of all honors.
Heaven exiled her to Hell on a supposed redemptive suicide mission, yet secretly rewrote the battle summons into a marriage contract. Demon King Malachi gladly accepted the unmatched warrior as his bride. After Celeste ruined her last love token, Seraphina severed her bond with Aurelian and abandoned Heaven.
As the demon king’s bride, she will reclaim what she lost. Celeste’s lies will be uncovered, Aurelian will regret his choice, and Heaven will learn its error: it broke her wings, but Hell granted her a throne.

title: Never Forgive, I'm His Now
description: Nina Morris sacrificed everything to save her husband Gabriel, only to be left barren and betrayed by his affair with his sister-in-law Chloe. Desperate, she accepts a deal with Gabriel's rival, Victor Harrington. Their marriage is meant to be revenge, but Victor offers her something her husband never did: respect. As Nina rises from the ashes, Gabriel's regret and Chloe's jealousy ignite. But the ultimate shock awaits: the boy she rescued years ago is now the man she married.

title: Do Me Over
description: Sarah Loren is a widow with a teenage son, Ethan Cole is a big shot CEO who wants to acquire her company. He is arrogant, brilliant, and unnecessarily good looking, and he'll stop at nothing to get what he wants, and what he wants… is Sarah's heart.

title: Love by Confinement
description: Ava was sent to prison by Liam for causing the death of his friend. After being released, Ava was tortured by Liam and her love for him was tested to its limits, yet little did she know, Liam also endured incredible agony. In the end, the couple let go of their grievances and started a new life together.

title: Never Forgive, I'm His Now
description: Nina Morris sacrificed everything to save her husband Gabriel, only to be left barren and betrayed by his affair with his sister-in-law Chloe. Desperate, she accepts a deal with Gabriel's rival, Victor Harrington. Their marriage is meant to be revenge, but Victor offers her something her husband never did: respect. As Nina rises from the ashes, Gabriel's regret and Chloe's jealousy ignite. But the ultimate shock awaits: the boy she rescued years ago is now the man she married.

title: Trap Love
description: To stop her father's fourth wealthy marriage, Sloane Vance set her sights on Garrison Grant. She staged chance meetings and even snuck into his room. Yet after Garrison fell for her, she left out of sheer boredom. Four years later, she returned. He trapped her at the airport, eyes red, demanding if she'd enjoyed playing hide-and-seek with him.

title: Love Arrives Six Years Late
description: Bound by a six-year contract, Aurora endured endless abuse for her child and loved ones. Trapped in a cold fake relationship, she suffered humiliation and torture at the hands of Damian's scheming first love. Once the deal ended, she broke free. Ruthless regrets, hidden truths, and two powerful men stood before her. The villainess got her bloody end, while the cold ex-lover fell into lifelong remorse. Aurora abandoned her painful past, embraced true love and a bright new future.

title: A Love That Couldn't Survive
description: "The year my father’s affair drove my mother to her death, I hated him to the core. To appease me, he personally sent Victor Young, the man I had loved for ten years, to my bed. After one night together, I fell completely in love with him. Three months into the relationship, under his persuasion, I forgave my father. Four months in, the news of my pregnancy broke. From then on, I became the most pampered pregnant woman in Beverly Hills. Every time I went for a prenatal checkup, they were always waiting in the hospital hallway. Everyone said I was treated like a princess by both my husband and my father. But on the day of the major ultrasound, neither of them showed up. “We have an important project to discuss,” my father said gently, stroking my hair. Victor Young softly rubbed my pregnant belly. “Once we’re done, I’ll bring back gifts for you and the baby.” I smiled and watched them leave, but just before the checkup, I received an anonymous video. In the video, my father was wearing a groom’s suit, standing beside Morgana Ashford—the woman who had driven my mother to death. Next to her was their illegitimate daughter, visibly pregnant, in a wedding dress, holding Victor Young’s arm. “Double happiness!” someone cheered in the video, raising a glass. “Congratulations to Mr. Hunter for finding true love, and congratulations to Mr. Young for finding such a perfect match!” At the end of the video, my father’s voice drifted in lightly. “Your fake marriage agreement with Emily doesn’t count. When the baby is born, it will be illegitimate.” Victor chuckled softly. “Emily has everything, and Isabella grew up as an illegitimate child. I can’t bear to let her child suffer the same fate.” I bit my lip and held back my tears as I left the hospital, but my phone suddenly vibrated. A sterilization certificate popped up on the screen, along with a line of text: “As long as you’re willing, the child in your womb will be the only heir of my life.”"

title: Love Beyond the Canvas
description: Art world mogul Jeremy Finch concealed his identity to pave the way for his fiancée Crystal Klein's career. However, she used sexy painting with the wandering artist Collin Dupont to hold an art exhibition. Jeremy went to the scene and wrecked it completely. When Crystal arrived, she chose to trash Jeremy rather than blame Collin. Jeremy finally realized that she never cared about him. He finally decided to give up on this relationship.

title: For Her, He Never Moved On
description: Bailee was betrothed to the wealthy Dante from a young age. However, Dante had no love for her and left for overseas studies on their wedding night for three years. Seeking revenge, Bailee took a lover, a man she believed to be insignificant. But when Dante returned, she planned to end her affair. Meanwhile, Bailee learned that the marshal of the country had returned from abroad exactly three years ago. Could the marshal be the lover she has been supporting all along?

title: Ivy & Thorn: Ivy Never Fades
description: In their past lives, Ivy and Daisy were both at the orphanage, waiting to be chosen by prospective parents. Daisy opted for a wealthy family, while Ivy joined a humble cleaner's household. Yet, Patrick Vance, the heir of the affluent family, was drawn to Ivy's independence. Consumed by jealousy, Daisy killed Ivy and then took her own life at their wedding. Reborn on the day of the selection, Daisy decides against the wealthy path, hoping to replicate Ivy's fate. However, she soon discovers that the cleaner's family is far from the paradise she imagined...

title: Ivy & Thorn: Ivy Never Fades
description: In their past lives, Ivy and Daisy were both at the orphanage, waiting to be chosen by prospective parents. Daisy opted for a wealthy family, while Ivy joined a humble cleaner's household. Yet, Patrick Vance, the heir of the affluent family, was drawn to Ivy's independence. Consumed by jealousy, Daisy killed Ivy and then took her own life at their wedding. Reborn on the day of the selection, Daisy decides against the wealthy path, hoping to replicate Ivy's fate. However, she soon discovers that the cleaner's family is far from the paradise she imagined...

title: The Emperor’s Doomed Obsession
description:
In her previous life, Natalie Simpson, born a nobleman's daughter and the wife of General Eden Richter, was betrayed and murdered by her sister Winona Simpson and the general himself, meeting a tragic end.
Reborn into a new life, she vowed revenge and seduced the King to wield him as her weapon. Yet she soon realized her miscalculation because the King had fallen far more deeply than she'd anticipated. To her shock, he resolved to crown her queen against all odds!

title: One Night to Forever Love
description: After being betrayed by her ex-husband, she decides to celebrate her newfound single life with a night of drinking at a bar. There, she unexpectedly encounters him, and their chemistry leads to a passionate encounter. Believing he is just a wealthy heir, she has no idea that he is actually her ex-husband's uncle—and the most mysterious tycoon in the city. As secrets unravel, will their connection survive the truth?

title: Never Stopped Loving You
description: Elara Raven's daughter was declared dead. Her lover abandoned her. Now, six years later as a music diva, a little stranger's song on a competition stage reminds her of the very song she wrote for her daughter. Her child is alive. The fight to reclaim the life stolen from her begins now.

title: The Seventh Death of the Devil
description:
She killed him six times. Each time, he forgot her. Each time, she fell in love again.

Now, on the seventh, she's a ruined heiress sold at auction—and he buys her. The magnetic pull is instant. Their bodies remember what their minds don't.

But when she finally plunges the knife into his heart, he doesn't die. He awakens with golden eyes. He is the devil she made a deal with. Every death was his ascension.

Devastated, she flees. He tears out his own godhood—five centuries of power—to become mortal, just to find her. Endures a hundred lashes until his back is shredded. For one chance to hold her without hurting her.

True nirvana isn't emptiness. It's surrender to love.

title: Love Beyond the Canvas
description: Art world mogul Jeremy Finch concealed his identity to pave the way for his fiancée Crystal Klein's career. However, she used sexy painting with the wandering artist Collin Dupont to hold an art exhibition. Jeremy went to the scene and wrecked it completely. When Crystal arrived, she chose to trash Jeremy rather than blame Collin. Jeremy finally realized that she never cared about him. He finally decided to give up on this relationship.

title: Orc love
description:
Brian and Logan were twin Wolf Beastkin that my cousin Isabella and I rescued from the Underground Beast Trade.
Back then, the two of us stood there staring at those filthy little wolf pups, and without even needing to say much, we each decided to adopt one.
I took Brian. Isabella took Logan.
Thirteen years passed in the blink of an eye.
All that time, I believed that even if Brian didn’t like me, he would at least feel grateful that I had saved his life.
That illusion shattered the day I accidentally overheard him talking to some other Beastkin.
Someone asked, “Emma’s been really good to you. Why are you always so cold to her?”
Brian let out a short, dismissive laugh. “Who asked her to be good to me?”
“You’ve got it good and don’t even realize it.”
“Good? Then I guess I should thank Emma properly. If she hadn’t taken me first, I’d be the one with Isabella right now.”
Another voice chimed in, “I mean, makes sense. Compared to Isabella, the head cheerleader, Emma’s just… nothing special.”
A dull ache spread through my chest.
In that moment, every feeling I had held onto for Brian over the years quietly disappeared.

title: White Wolf Rising
description:
Aria, a young she-wolf of the North, fails to shift during her awakening ceremony and is branded wolfless. Her fiancé Kael breaks their engagement in public and chooses Lyra as his new Luna candidate, while the council moves to exile Aria from the pack.
Determined to prove herself, Aria claims her right to a Trial, only to be hunted through the snow by Lyra’s men. On the edge of death, her hidden white wolf bloodline finally awakens.
Saved by an exiled hunter, Aria enters White Fang Academy under a new name and starts again from the lowest rank. Through humiliation, schemes, and brutal battles, she rises as the academy’s darkest horse. At the Alpha Trial, she defeats Lyra and Kael, choosing not to become a Luna, but the White Wolf Queen who will reclaim the North.

title: We Never Said We Went Bankrupt!
description:
The York family, the most powerful, wealthy family in the nation, is rumored to have gone bankrupt. Even though the rumors aren't true, word spreads, and the Yorks watch as their allied families turn on them. The Wilson and Meyer families turn from trusted kin into violent, abusive monsters, hell-bent on destroying the Yorks. At back-to-back events, a wedding and a 70th birthday party, the Yorks face a deluge of abuse and humiliation from the Wilsons and Meyers, respectively, putting the survival of their family name to the ultimate test.
Can the Yorks overcome the doubters, abusers, and haters? Will they clear their name, and reestablish their rightful standing as the most powerful family in all the land?

title: Where the Stars Went
description:
Stella Hart loved Ashton Voss without a shred of dignity. Heir to a century-old Old Money jewelry empire, he blamed her for a fire seven years ago — convinced she'd ignored his cries to save a stranger instead. For three years he punished her for it: one hundred divorce letters, and one hundred times she came crawling back to sign them away.
The hundred-and-first, she didn't.
Not after he forced allergic Stella to drink in front of his friends. Not after her stepsister shattered her dead mother's locket on the floor. Not after his slap broke the hearing aid she'd worn since her father's fists stole her hearing at nineteen.
In a blood-red dress, she signed — and walked into the arms of Ethan Morrow, the Silicon Valley titan who'd quietly funded her late mother's cancer research for years. 
Ashton realized what he'd thrown away far too late. He begged. He drank. He tried to burn her name down so no one else could have her.
But you don't get to break a woman who's already walked away — you just get to watch her shine somewhere you can't reach.
He spent three years calling her nothing. Now he'll spend a lifetime wondering where his star went.

title: When Wife Won't Forgive
description: On their 25th wedding anniversary, Anne discovers her bestselling author husband, Jonathan, has been having an affair. Anne is fed up and wants to get a divorce. Jonathan thinks he's going to become the CEO of the publishing company, so he immediately kicks Anne to the curb. Utterly heartbroken, Anne decides she won't forgive Jonathan again. She resumes her position as Chairwoman of an elite publishing company, and removes Jonathan from his position. Jonathan finally realizes that Anne who played housewife for 25 years was actually a wealthy heiress.

title: When Love Walked Away
description: Adrian leaves his own daughter Esther in a car while he hangs out with his childhood sweetheart, Stacy and her son Lucas. Under the hot summer sun, the car overheats and shuts down. The A/C stops working and Esther starts to overheat. She's at risk of heatstroke and almost faints. Esther dials Adrian's phone to ask for help. Without listening to her, Adrian hangs up. Just before Esther's tablet runs out of battery, she calls her mother. She begs her mom to save her. However, before Esther can tell Claire her location, the tablet dies. Claire starts to desperately search for her daughter. Will Claire be able to successfully find and save her daughter before the unthinkable happens?

title: Who Knew My Hubby Was A Secret CEO?
description: After a heated family argument involving her sister and brother-in-law, Talia marries Ethan on a whim, unaware he's actually a powerful CEO keeping his identity under wraps. As the newlyweds navigate family drama and close calls that threaten to expose the truth, they grow closer. In the end, Ethan reveals who he truly is and proposes for real. This time, with love at the center. Talia says yes, and they finally get the happy ending they never expected.

title: In Bed with My Brother-in-Law
description: Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes, saves Bella, and they unite to defend their mafia throne.

title: Who's Laughing Now, My Ex?
description: For seven years, Elle Gold secretly helped Joe Judd build DK Corp into a successful company. On their wedding day, pregnant and ready to reveal the truth, she is humiliated by Joe. In an attempt to please his first love, Sue Cole, Joe allows Sue to steal Elle’s spotlight by wearing a wedding dress. Elle endures their cruelty time and again, only to discover that Joe and Sue are having an affair. Worse, Joe believes Sue’s lie that she’s the founder of DK Corp. Devastated, Elle demands a divorce. With Carl Irwin’s help, she plans her revenge. At the signing banquet, she exposes her true identity, pulls her investments, and watches as Joe crumbles in regret.

title: Who's Laughing Now, My Ex?
description: For seven years, Elle Gold secretly helped Joe Judd build DK Corp into a successful company. On their wedding day, pregnant and ready to reveal the truth, she is humiliated by Joe. In an attempt to please his first love, Sue Cole, Joe allows Sue to steal Elle’s spotlight by wearing a wedding dress. Elle endures their cruelty time and again, only to discover that Joe and Sue are having an affair. Worse, Joe believes Sue’s lie that she’s the founder of DK Corp. Devastated, Elle demands a divorce. With Carl Irwin’s help, she plans her revenge. At the signing banquet, she exposes her true identity, pulls her investments, and watches as Joe crumbles in regret.

title: Who's Playing Whom?
description: Maya Nolan, once an abducted heiress, is now the world's top hacker and head of an assassin organization. But she's back for revenge. She infiltrates the Kane household under false pretenses, only to engage in cat and mouse game with her nemesis, the DarkNet Lord, Sebastian. In this crafted vendetta, who will be the ultimate mastermind?

title: Wrong Woman to Betray
description: Abandoned on her wedding night, noblewoman Vera is divorced after her husband returns from war with a mistress and child. Refusing to be discarded, she reinvents herself, using her rare medical talent to cure the Prince Regent and earn power of her own. As court enemies close in, Vera rises from betrayed wife to a woman capable of changing the empire's fate.

title: When We Parted, the World Went Still
description: When Mason sees his wife, Helena, and Wayne making out in the car, he is furious. After being framed by Wayne again and again and betrayed by his wife over and over, Mason is so disappointed that he agrees to divorce. Not until Helena finds out that everything Wayne said is a lie, does she realize how wrong she is. She wants to win Mason back, but Mason has married another girl and moved on.

title: The Wolf King Bowed for Me
description: Evelyn is the sole Alpha heir of the Silvermoon Pack, but a poison secretly administered to her since childhood has kept her wolf spirit from fully awakening. In her past life, she trusted Adrian, surrendered her wealth and power to him, and was ultimately betrayed and killed by Adrian and Serena. Only in her final moments did she learn that Lucien, the Lycan Crown Prince, was the man who truly loved her. Given a second chance by the Moon Goddess, Evelyn returns ten years into the past and refuses to remain powerless. She takes back her resources and birthright, exposes the impostors who betrayed her, and, with Lucien's help, removes the poison suppressing her wolf spirit. As her legendary White Wolf bloodline awakens and her enemies fall one by one, Evelyn discovers that Lucien is not only the hidden Lycan Crown Prince—he is also her fated mate.

title: Where My Love Went Wrong
description: Once a star diplomat, Winnie gave up everything for love, only to be rejected by her marshal husband, Leo, and their son. Determined to start over, she returns to the diplomatic world as the mysterious "Miss Wan," dazzling allies and rivals alike. When Leo finally regrets letting her go, it's already too late. Betrayals are exposed, war looms, and love turns to ashes. As Leo falls on the battlefield, Winnie walks forward. She's stronger, wiser, and ready to face the world on her own terms.

title: Twin Mafia Kings' Runaway Wife
description: Genesis has spent seven years hiding from her Irish mob husband Kiefer and his twin Tadhg. When Tadhg spots her in California, she flees, but Kiefer captures her. During the confrontation, she reveals that Kiefer’s sister Aoife and her friend Laoise pushed her down stairs, causing a miscarriage—while she was pregnant with twins. One twin, Roan, died; the other, Egan, survived and was hidden from Kiefer. Kiefer, shocked, kills a guard who helped cover up the abuse. Genesis escapes but is tracked down with Egan. Kiefer, Tadhg, and his father Lorcan all pursue her, and over time, she forms a polyamorous relationship with the three men. They move to a new estate, and Genesis learns her biological father is Russian mob boss Nazar Sokolov. After Laoise’s rescue attempt and a final confrontation, Genesis kills her enemies and reconciles with her family, ending with new children and a restored bond. Based on Tempting the Mafia Twins by Tatienne Richard on MyFiction.

title: Sweet Wild Bride of Mine
description: Eliza Spencer, self-made billionaire, survives a murder attempt and wakes with amnesia. Rescued by Justin Patton, a handsome stranger in a wheelchair- she marries him unaware he's also a billionaire faking his disability. When her memory returns, she keeps her identity a secret to reclaim her company from her greedy family and protect Justin from his vicious half-brother and step-mother.

title: The Wife He Gave Away
description: Five years married, and he kicked me out for his "amnesiac" sister. After I miscarried, he said, "Let's get divorced, just pretend, to keep her calm." So I signed the real papers, blocked him. Her fake amnesia got exposed, she ended up in a psych ward. He faked cancer, then a car crash. Years later, I'm on Forbes, my sister's insane, my mother lives on the $200 a month I give her, and the man who threw me away is just someone I don't even bother to name anymore. They tried to destroy me, now I'm out of their reach.

title: My Safe Word Was Revenge
description: Caleb Shaw calls BDSM a cure for his dead marriage, then chains his wife Mara to a tree for his mistress. When Mara says the safe word, he leaves with the key. By sunrise, Nina’s hired men find her. But Caleb never knew what Mara buried for this marriage. She was not just his wife. She was the woman who once owned the West Side docks. Now the collar, the blood, and the betrayal will drag every Shaw secret into the light.

title: We Will Love Again
description: You dumped Noah Preston when he had nothing,  but now he's a billionaire!

title: Between Two Worlds: A Bride for a Bun
description: Stranded in a famine-ravaged era, Conrad Hayes unlocks the Two-Way Gate System—a bridge between eras powered by marital bliss. His first wife, the ailing Joyce Bennett, is bought with a single steamed bun. Soon, he rescues her sister Sherry and shelters the poor girl, Renee. Using the Gate to trade across time, Conrad amasses wealth and influence, but danger follows every move.

title: Hiring My Sweet Wife
description:
Chloe Shaw had never worked a day in her life, until her parents cut her off and gave her three months to survive on her own.
Desperate, she took a high-paying job: marrying her best friend's wealthy uncle.
It was supposed to be an easy deal, until she realized her new husband had been in love with her all along.

title: The Princess Who Walked Away
description: Qianrin borders are under attack. Gretta Ely, heartbroken by Crown Prince Hades Maverick's intention to wed someone else, requests a diplomatic marriage decree. Hesitated, the emperor still appoints her as Princess of Qianrin. She will marry in seven days. Meanwhile, the crown prince, unaware of her decision, remains confident that his childhood sweetheart would never leave him.

title: New World, Old Rules?
description: Axel blows into the wild. System fires up. Guns, fire, and modern tricks crush the Stone Age. One gunshot silences a tribe. He exposes the priest, builds a fortress, tears up beasts, and rules them all.

title: The Wife He Threw Away Came Back on Top
description: Her husband cheated. Her son betrayed her. Then the billionaire she saved left his entire empire to her. Now Avery is back on top, and everyone who wronged her is about to regret it.

title: The Wife Who Burned
description: Betrayed and framed, Katniss Frost returns under a new identity with her son. With vengeance in her heart and a mission to save her critically ill daughter, she decides to confront her ex-husband, Garrick Unwin. But this time, he's the one who's going to burn.

title: The Widow Who Stole the Marquis's Heart
description: Widowed Jean becomes a wet nurse at the Wilson Estate to support her family, only to reunite with Rory Wilson, the nobleman she once shared a brief romance with. Hiding her past, she claims the child she brings is her late husband's son. Rory senses something familiar and begins uncovering the truth. As Jean faces schemes within the estate, Rory realizes she is the woman he never forgot. When the secret is revealed, they overcome their separation and reunite as a family.

title: The Wolf King Bows to Me
description: Heiress Erin is betrayed by her fiancé on the eve of their engagement, just as her family falls into crisis. In her darkest moment, Luca, the bodyguard who has always protected her, becomes the only person she can rely on. As the conspiracy unfolds, Erin fights to reclaim everything that was taken from her—unaware that Luca is actually the long-lost Wolf King who vanished three years ago.

title: Two Worlds Apart
description: In a world divided by wealth and privilege, two baby girls are unknowingly switched at birth, each raised in the life intended for the other. On one side is Isabella, a spirited young woman who grows up with every luxury imaginable, unaware that her family’s vast fortune is not rightfully hers. Raised by her wealthy “father,” Mr. Donovan, and groomed to embody poise and elegance, Isabella is engaged to Adrian, a charming, ambitious man who seems to complete her picture-perfect life. On the other side is Elena, raised in poverty by her loving yet struggling “father,” Mr. Martinez. A grounded and hardworking young woman, Elena works as a janitor in Donovan Industries, the very company owned by her real family. Despite her modest circumstances, Elena carries an innate sense of sophistication and resilience that draws people to her.Their worlds collide when Elena crosses paths with Adrian, Isabella’s fiancé. A chance encounter sparks a connection between them, challenging Adrian’s loyalty and drawing him toward the quiet strength and authenticity that Elena possesses. As the secrets begin to unravel, Adrian’s feelings lead him to discover the truth behind Isabella and Elena’s past...

title: Between Two Worlds: A Bride for a Bun
description: Stranded in a famine-ravaged era, Conrad Hayes unlocks the Two-Way Gate System—a bridge between eras powered by marital bliss. His first wife, the ailing Joyce Bennett, is bought with a single steamed bun. Soon, he rescues her sister Sherry and shelters the poor girl, Renee. Using the Gate to trade across time, Conrad amasses wealth and influence, but danger follows every move.

title: His Ex-Wife Is Now Empress
description: Nearly forty, Juniper works herself ragged to pay for her daughter's medical care. Then she catches her husband of 18 years shopping for fine silks with another woman, his mother, and a teenage boy. Heartbroken, she leaves and carries her sick daughter through the rain to seek help. A disguised emperor saves her daughter's life, and soon a marriage contract makes Juniper Empress. What begins as a marriage of convenience turns into true love when the cold emperor falls for her.

title: You Woke the Wrong Dad
description: Once feared as the "Ruthless Dragon," Yale Cooper left his violent past to protect his wife and daughter, living quietly for 18 years. When his daughter Nina is bullied and humiliated at school, she hides the truth to avoid trouble. But when the aggressor brings trouble to Yale's repair shop, his buried past resurfaces. The Ruthless Dragon awakens. After settling the matter, Yale moves his shop next to Nina's university, vowing to protect his family and live a life of redemption.

title: The Weak Scholar Who Would Rule
description: Forced to abandon his martial path for a scholarly life, Sean was betrayed by his fiancée, Luna. Her harsh words, "My husband must be a general, not a weak scholar!" ignite a fire in him. With his dignity shattered, Sean vows revenge. Leaving the scholar's life behind, he rises from the ashes to conquer the land and reclaim his destiny as a legendary general. No one can stop the man who's destined to rule.

title: The Walls Between Us
description: Deceived by her first love, Winter believes her husband, Simon, married her for money and turns her back on both him and their daughter. She never realizes Simon has been secretly supporting her, while the man she trusts is stealing his research and her fortune. When the truth comes out, Simon leaves, their daughter chooses another mother, and Winter is left with nothing but regret.

title: Not Now, Wifey
description: She wants a good life for her daughter; he wants to cure his mom. They agree to get married to help each other. But then, another rich girl falls for him because he saved her...

title: Two Mafia Kings Want Me
description: I ran from my arranged wedding after catching my fiancé in bed with another woman. That same night, I lost my virginity to a stranger—only to discover he was my fiancé all along. When I became pregnant, he looked me in the eye and said, “Get rid of the baby.” I walked away for good... until his powerful rival offered me a new life. Now two mafia heirs are fighting for me, but only one deserves my heart. The problem? The man who broke me refuses to let me go.

title: Two Wives, Two Divorces
description: I married into the Harper family together with my best friend. Me to the the older brother, the fire captain, and her the younger brother, a famous surgeon. On our wedding anniversary, I found myself trapped, locked in a room by my husband's first love. Then, chaos erupted upstairs. Flames tore through the house. Seven months pregnant, I was alone, trapped, with no one coming to save me. Smoke choked me, searing my lungs, making every breath a struggle. Trembling, I dialed my husband, praying for help. His voice, impatient and cold, cut through the panic: "Stop making a scene. False alarms are a crime! Megan’s cat is in danger too! I gotta go save an actual life!" In the end, it was my best friend, Leah, who smashed open the door and saved me. Leah, frantic, called her husband, begging him to come over and treat me. But only icy indifference came from the other end. "Megan's cat injured its tail. As a doctor, I have a responsibility to treat it. Leah, can't you two be more gracious? Stop making a fuss over us doing our jobs and have some respect for yourselves." That day, I lost my child. Watching the doctor carry out what had been my baby, fully formed, I felt my soul shatter. "Leah, I want a divorce." Leah hugged me tightly. "If you get a divorce, I'll leave too. Those two pieces of human garbage aren't worth a drop of our tears.” That night, the Harper brothers received the divorce agreements, and panic set in.

title: Hated to Mate
description: He wrapped around me and threw me into the abyss. Now I'm back, 100lbs lighter and armed with a "love point" system. The snake wants my blood. The wolf wants my heart. But that serpent? He just locked the door, and his scales are trembling.

title: Undercover Prison King
description: When ex-soldier Troy Poe inherits a corrupt private prison, he decides to go in undercover as an inmate to expose those responsible. But when the head guard, a man who he trusted, turns out to be the leader of the crime ring , Troy must find a way to convince the officials that he is not a prisoner, but in fact, the owner of the prison... or break out. All the while, he must protect those in danger, including a weak old prisoner whose sentence has been falsely extended, and a beautiful doctor who's caught in the crossfire.  Will Troy find a way to escape? Or will he become just another casualty of his own prison?

title: Ma Was Wrong
description: Sisters Caroline and Isabella Foster are abused by their stepdad, Robert Sterling, while their mother, Diane Sullivan, remains oblivious. To pay his lover's debt, Robert attempts to sell Isabella. Caroline is hospitalized trying to save her. Later, Caroline witnesses a fleeing Isabella get critically injured in a car crash. Robert intercepts all of Caroline's desperate calls to Diane. Isabella tragically dies, leaving Caroline utterly disillusioned with her mother. Discovering Robert's affair, Caroline teams up with Simon Gallagher to expose him. Robert is brought to justice, and a remorseful Diane reconciles with Caroline.

title: XL Stands for Xtra Love
description: Ellie wants to be a world famous model, but no one'll give a chubby girl a chance. She has a one-night stand with fashion company CEO Eason, raising their son Lucas alone. Hoping to land a job as a model, she answers HALE Group's casting call only to discover that the boss interviewing is her baby daddy, Eason Hale himself!

title: The X-Ray Maverick
description: Returning from the army, Ethan Ford is betrayed by his fiancée and loses everything. However, a mysterious system grants him X-ray vision and ultimate martial arts. Mastering high-stakes gambling and antique appraisal, Ethan rises to the top. Surrounded by beautiful women, he begins his legendary journey!

title: From XL to Extra Love
description: Kate Harris, once an overlooked, plus-size dreamer, lands a job at Reynolds Group and meets the CEO of her fantasies—the effortlessly charming Lucas Reynolds. But her fairytale crashes when she’s framed for plagiarism by the jealous office queen Chloe, and Lucas, deceived by appearances, fires her on the spot. Crushed but not defeated, Kate takes a dangerous weight-loss drug and reemerges with a new identity and a stunning transformation. Back at Reynolds Group as a rising star designer, she begins to dismantle Chloe’s web of lies, all while catching Lucas’s attention once more. What Lucas doesn’t know is that the captivating woman he’s falling for is the same girl who once gave him hope during his darkest childhood days — the sweet, chubby Kate. As secrets unravel and the misunderstandings fade, Kate and Lucas inch closer to a second chance at love. But just when it seems like their story might get its fairy-tale ending… the drug fails, the weight returns...

title: Careful, He's Got X-Ray Eyes!
description: Labeled a tea boy, apprentice Jed Simon is kicked to the curb by his wife. Little do they know, he suddenly gains X-ray eyes! Determined to play no more nice, Jed starts gambling stone and cutting more and more imperial green! Look who's rising to the top now?

title: My X-Ray Eyes Rule the City
description: Leo Banks got a special physique and X-ray eyes. After leaving his sect, he runs into his fiancée and tries to save her, only to be mistaken for a creep. To prove himself, Leo now has to dominate the city and live a carefree life.

title: You Can't Stop My Super X-Ray Vision
description: After his girlfriend dumps him, Michael, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant global influencer bullies, all while winning the heart of his high school's most popular girl.

title: Dear X
description: Ji-Yeon, the wanna-be among the theater majors at school, dreams of a bright future after being cast in a famous director's work. However, her life shatters when her best friend Yu-Mi spreads a deepfake video of Ji-Yeon having intercourse with Professor Park, and on top of that, has an affair with Ji-Yeon's boyfriend Geon-Woo. Determined for revenge, Ji-Yeon teams up with teaching assistant Su-Ho, who exposed Yu-Mi's true identity to her.

title: How to Tame a Silver Fox
description: Harper Reeves is just trying to finish up her senior year of Yale without being a completely friendless loser. However, when her party's suddenly crashed by her dad's best friend and mysterious business partner, Chris Collins, she realizes she'd much rather have been busted by the cops. Chris, always in over-protective mode, gets on Harper's nerves, until she realizes he needs to go. Together with her best friend Maria, she brainstorms Operation Seduction, planning to get Chris to fall in love with her so her dad will kick him out himself. But every time Chris saves Harper from trouble, she gets closer to realizing she may have feelings for him after all.

title: The Unexpected Divine Doctor
description: Medical student James Madden accidentally gains X-ray vision. After being framed, he uses his new powers to exact swift revenge on his enemies. He then saves a billionaire's daughter, outshines top medical experts, and strikes it rich by finding rare antiques and playing the stock market.

title: Saved by the Sexy Cowboy
description: Ava is on the run from her abusive ex, who will stop at nothing to get her back. But then she encounters a sexy cowboy who saves her and teaches her how a woman is supposed to be loved. Can Ava learn to love again or will her abusive ex catch her before she has the chance?

title: Fix You
description: Based on the novel by Christine Bell. Olivia Beckett’s perfect life is unraveling—her family’s broke, college is slipping away, and her high school sweetheart has turned violent. Enter Sebastian “Bash” McDaniels, a rising boxer working nights at a bar to escape his past. When he rescues Olivia from her ex, their connection sparks, but as danger closes in, Bash must choose between his dreams and saving the girl who could break him.

title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION
description: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.

title: My Ex is in the Navy SEALs
description: Six years ago, Regina chose to break up with her boyfriend Julian to avoid hindering his promising military career due to her overwhelming debt. Six years later, they reunite in a foreign land, Julian is now a commanding officer, while Regina is a single mother. Their chemistry reignites, but their bonding faces uncertainties of their class differences and pressure from people around them. This time, will they find their way back to love again?

title: Freed by the Sexy Farmer
description: After her once-wealthy family loses everything, virgin heiress Lily Holt is sold to Mason Black, the notoriously cruel heir of the Black family fortune. Terrified of his violent reputation, Lily runs away from Mason the night of their fake marriage and crashes into Cal Foster, a sweet, sexy farmer who falls for her at first sight. However, when Cal discovers the man Lily’s running from is his landlord and long-time rival, he risks his life and livelihood to protect her.

title: I'm the Dragon King & Legendary Healer
description: A legendary figure has disguised himself as a beggar and is now wandering the streets. The eldest daughter of a prominent financial ruler has been afflicted with a mysterious illness. Despite a substantial reward offered by her father, no expert has been able to cure her. One day, the ruler's second daughter happens to pass by a reward notice and encounters the beggar with a tattered bowl. She drops some change into his bowl, and the beggar, recognizing her kindness, offers to fulfill one of her wishes. He then accompanies her to her family home. The ruler is skeptical that a beggar could cure his critically ill daughter, but the beggar calmly performs his exceptional skills and, indeed...

title: Marrying My Ex's Boss
description: Orphaned Sylvia gives up her dream of jewelry design to pay for her sick sister’s surgery. Framed for cheating with CEO Leo by her boyfriend Alan and his enemies, Leo is forced into a fake marriage with her to protect his company’s reputation. Yet as they grow close, he discovers her talent and kind heart. When the truth is exposed, Sylvia leaves—but Leo gives up his throne to win her back. Together they defeat the conspirators, and when the contract ends, Leo proposes with true love.

title: X-Ray Vision: The One-Eyed Outcast
description: Branded a worthless outcast, Oliver awakens his one-eyed X-ray vision! His power brings him lots of surprises and a great fortune! Now his family are drowning in regrets!

title: My Step-Brother is My Ex?!
description: Four years ago, a misunderstanding ripped Hannah Hart and Dean Dumont apart. Hannah vowed she would never see Dean again... until her father unexpectedly remarried Dean’s mother. Now Dean and Hannah are stepsiblings… but neither of them know it!

title: Now I'm Your CEO Ex-Husband
description: For seven years, Sam endured being treated as a useless husband by his wife, Winnie, and her family. His sacrifices went unnoticed, and even his birthday was forgotten. Tired of being taken for granted, Sam walks away and reveals his true identity, the CEO of Zenith Group. As he rebuilds his life and reclaims his dignity, Winnie and her family are forced to face a painful truth: they never appreciated the man who had quietly given them everything.

title: The Unexpected Divine Doctor
description: Medical student James Madden accidentally gains X-ray vision. After being framed, he uses his new powers to exact swift revenge on his enemies. He then saves a billionaire's daughter, outshines top medical experts, and strikes it rich by finding rare antiques and playing the stock market.

title: Let’s Get Married, Mr. CEO
description:
Three years after their last encounter, Eva Frost's first words to Timothy Moore are: "Let's Get Married, Mr. CEO"...
Betrayed by the boyfriend she had bankrolled for years, who deceived her out of their marital home, Eva decides to move forward and blurts out the unexpected. To her surprise, Timothy clings to her at the marriage office, declaring, "I never said I wouldn't agree".

title: ReelTalk EP 86-What's In The Box Challenge with Katelyn and Joel
description: Katelyn Rose and Joel Erdmann from My X-Ray Vision Sees Right Through You take on the What's in the Box challenge. With nothing but their sense of touch, the two must identify a series of mystery items hidden inside the box. From creepy textures to bizarre objects, will they trust their instincts and guess correctly or completely miss the mark?

title: Nurse by Day, Hero by Night
description: Nathan, an ordinary male nurse, discovers he has the rare Sun-Forged Physique and is chosen by a martial master. With x-ray vision and overwhelming strength, his life flips overnight. He rises fast, making money, turning heads, and crushing anyone who stands in his way. In the end, he crushes the ultimate boss and becomes one of the richest and most powerful men alive.

title: The Fox CEO's Sweet Trap
description: Born with a heart defect, Aria grows up in mountain seclusion, saving a fox from tribulation. A decade later, the fox becomes tycoon Matthew Goode to find her. Fleeing the pressure of an arranged marriage, Aria coincidentally interviews at Goode Group. Seizing the chance, Matthew initiates a calculated pursuit, and Aria unwittingly walks straight into his trap.

title: My Kids Ruin My Ex's Fancy Life
description:
Brynna’s fiancé, Sterling, crashes their wedding with his wealthy mistress, Celina. In front of everyone, they set fire to the wedding dress designs she spent months creating and viciously humiliate her elderly mother. Enraged by their cruelty, her mother suffers a fatal heart attack and dies on the spot. Overnight, Brynna loses her fiancé, her career, and the only family she has left. Heartbroken, she leaves the country.
Five years later, Brynna makes a stunning return to the fashion world with her daughter, Mia, and her mysterious “contract husband,” Kane. At a major fashion exhibition, Sterling claims Mia is his daughter. He and Celina publicly slap Brynna and try to snatch the child from her.
Just when Brynna is about to lose everything again, Kane steps forward to protect them and reveals his true identity.He is one of Europe’s most powerful financial tycoons. In front of the entire crowd, he declares Brynna his legal wife and Mia his biological daughter. Sterling’s exhibition privileges are immediately revoked.Everyone thinks Brynna has finally turned the tables.But the real revenge has only just begun.
And when the dust finally settles, what will become of the contract marriage that has lasted five years?

title: Sweet Destiny with You
description: To escape the marriage her mother forced upon her, Nicole Smith boldly sleeps with a stranger and runs away from home with a baby bump. Five years later, she's a devoted single mom to her son, Danny Smith. Just as their life struggles, Marcus Jansen steps into her life, determined to win her heart. Yet, his childhood sweetheart, Zoey Reeves, seethes with jealousy and keeps causing trouble. Little do they know, Marcus is the father of Nicole's son, and her true identity holds even more surprises...

title: REBORN 2008: X-RAY VISION
description: Ethan Hayes travels back to the millennium with X-Ray vision. He finds Philip's artifact and Emperor Kane's porcelain. With Grace, he fights smugglers to retrieve lost treasures.

title: The Crown
description: Emmaline Castro, the renowned COO and backbone of the Castro enterprises, one of the largest pharmaceutical conglomerates in America. Ruthless in her approach to business and unrelenting in her pursuit for success, Emmeline hits an unanticipated upturn in her career aspirations when her sickly father, Gerard Castro, informs her that he intends to name her irresponsible and nonchalant brother JONAS, as Heir to Castro Enterprises. Emmaline is livid at the absurd proclamation, but her father is resolute and his decision is set in stone. Desperate to change his mind, Emmeline informs her father that she will land the Anderson account, a billion-dollar partnership that will not just boost the company's net worth, but also, its reputation.In a stroke of fortune, Emmaline manages to land a meeting with the anonymous benefactor behind the Anderson account, Mr. X. But it turns out to be no stroke of luck. The meeting was orchestrated by Mr. X himself after he read her proposal. Upon their meeting, Emmaline realizes that Mr. X is a man she humiliated years ago for being poor and wretched. Will Emmaline swallow her pride and consent? Will she be able to beat her devilishly deceptive and cunning brother to the prize? Will she be able to deny the romantic connection forging between her and Mr. X?

title: With X-Ray Eyes, Desire Ignites
description: Mocked her classmates, Jessie Stark gains x-ray vision suddenly and can spot priceless antiques, predict stocks, and even see illnesses. From hustling in backstreet markets to dominating high-society auctions, Jessie turns her gift into a fortune—all while dodging rivals, outsmarting bullies, and untangling a web of secrets involving Gordon Graham, Leo Lawson, and a mysterious tycoon who knows more about her power than she does.

title: Fate Rekindled at the Hotel
description: Right before her engagement, Cecilia escapes a cheating fiancé and a greedy family, only to find herself unexpectedly pregnant after a chance encounter with Springfield's heir, Chris. Determined to build a new life, she starts over at a luxury resort, but she finds that Chris has just bought it. She wants independence. He wants her. In the battle between ambition and love, Cecilia finds both.

title: I Seduced the Wrong Man
description: With no way out, Vera sets her sights on Yael Brown, a top-tier powerbroker known for his coldness and ruthlessness. Yael sees through her intentions from the start, but chooses to indulge her, drawn in despite himself. What begins as a calculated game slowly turns into an emotional entanglement, pulling the untouchable man down from his pedestal and binding him to her fate.

title: The Vampire Next Door
description: Introverted Cameron, is desperately in love with his high school crush Diane. But his romantic pursuit is halted when Victoria, a female vampire moves in next door. Cameron soon discovers he's in the middle of a life-and-death adventure.

title: Reborn as His Deadly Temptation
description: Betrayed and murdered in her past life after being used to bear the Crown Prince's heir, Erin is reborn with vengeance in her heart. Disguised as a palace maid, she infiltrates the Eastern Palace to destroy those who wronged her. As she carefully sets her trap, Crown Prince Spencer falls into an obsession she never intended. Keeping him just out of reach, Erin turns desire into a weapon, each step closer to him drawing her nearer to revenge.

title: The Princess of My Phobia
description: Reborn with memories of her past life, Caroline sets her sights on the Crown Prince before fate can slip away again. She plans to take his bloodline, disappear, and raise the child alone. Six years later, she returns to the capital in search of her son, only to collide with the very man she abandoned. What she never expected was that the once-invincible Crown Prince had developed a fear of women… and has been searching for her ever since.

title: The Fallen God & His Mute Muse
description: Levi Tran, an immortal, is reborn to escape a massive debt. He awakens in a gambler's body, only to find his mute wife's voice stolen. Now, will he be able to give the woman her voice back with his mortal body?

title: The Mafia Wife's Sweet Obsession
description:
She is a ruthless mafia queen and the legendary underground doctor, Dr. X.
He is a business genius who has spent years pretending to be crippled, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.
When both are betrayed at the altar, they marry each other on the spot.
She hides her identity. He hides his feelings. What begins as a marriage of convenience soon turns into a dangerous game of secrets, lies, and irresistible attraction.
But when her true identity is exposed, can they survive the enemies closing in—and each other?

title: Queen of Seeing Through Lies
description: Dumped for her poor background, Sabrina Shaw is struck by lightning, awakening x-ray vision via her grandma's bracelet. She dives into the high-stakes jade gambling world, uncovering rare treasures one after another, outwits her enemies, and seizes control of Bennett Jewelry and the Jade Association. Her legendary comeback culminates when she unveils the mythical Imperial Green at the grand Jade Expo.

title: Christmas Mix up
description: When Alejandro (Claudio de la Torre), a groom left at the altar, escapes to a remote estate to mend his broken heart, his life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Clara (Francis Rodríguez), the messy, sarcastic, and surprisingly vibrant caretaker. What begins as a chaotic clash turns into a Christmas entanglement filled with humor, jealousy, misunderstandings, and revelations that force them both to discover that love’s miracles happen where least expected.

title: In Love with My Ex's Uncle
description: Betrayed by her fiancé, Annabelle breaks off the engagement and marries her ex's uncle—the heir of a powerful family, Nathaniel Frost, who is terminally ill. What follows is a dangerous game of revenge, desire, and legacy, where every move could destroy them all.

title: Too Late, Mr. CEO
description: After three years of abuse, Sasha divorces her domineering CEO husband and leaves endurance behind. Focused on her career, she rises fast as admirers gather around her. While her ex rages over the child he believes she lost, Sasha becomes a woman completely out of his reach. When he finally swallows his pride to win her back, he learns it may already be too late.

title: Unveiling Her Secret Identities
description: Legendary Miss X is reborn after a plane crash as Penny Xander, an adopted and abandoned village girl. To fulfill her last wishes, she returns to the Xander family and is arranged to marry the disabled son of the Hank family, Boris. However, Boris is not entirely disabled; he remains the heir and is secretly searching for her...

title: I'm Not Your Ex Anymore
description: At a friend's birthday dinner, I come face-to-face with my successful ex, who arrives with his new girlfriend. Sitting across from me, he coolly dismisses our past as "ancient history." Our friends keep teasing us, making the reunion even more awkward. Under his gaze, I stand and smile faintly. "Yeah, it's been a long time. We haven't spoken in ages, and whatever we had is long gone."

title: Exiled to Emperor
description: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.

title: The Boy with Golden Eyes
description: In his previous life, Keith attempted to assassinate his enemy to avenge his parents, but was instead killed by his subordinates, dying with regret. Upon opening his eyes, he finds himself reborn at the age of ten and unexpectedly awakens the 'Golden Eyes' — an ability to see through the essence, value, and truth of all things. Now, it's his chance for revenge.

title: Sleeping with a Hot CEO
description: Sophie's boyfriend cheated on her with her half-sister, which broke her heart. Accidentally, she slept with a rich and hot CEO, Tyler Grant. Tyler liked her and pursued her, Sophie couldn't resist this man's charm. As time went, they loved each other deeply and had a lovely child...

title: Sweet Destiny with You
description: To escape the marriage her mother forced upon her, Nicole Smith boldly sleeps with a stranger and runs away from home with a baby bump. Five years later, she's a devoted single mom to her son, Danny Smith. Just as their life struggles, Marcus Jansen steps into her life, determined to win her heart. Yet, his childhood sweetheart, Zoey Reeves, seethes with jealousy and keeps causing trouble. Little do they know, Marcus is the father of Nicole's son, and her true identity holds even more surprises...

title: Goodbye, My General Husband
description: Falsely accused of treason, Stacey Lonoff was put behind bars by her husband, General Gordie Patzer. To avenge his childhood sweetheart Ciara Rede, Gordie tortured the pregnant Stacey to death, having no idea the true traitor was Ciara herself. But fate gave Stacey a second chance. When she opened her eyes again, she found herself back to the fateful day a month ago when everything began to unravel! In this life, she swore to protect her country and make Gordie and Ciara pay!

title: No More Nice Girl
description: Thea, the Reed family's heiress, discovers her fiancé, Henry, has been letting his friend Lynn eavesdrop on their private moments. Henry accuses her of overreacting. After pressure from his parents, Thea gives him one last chance. But Henry, along with his friends, continues to humiliate her. When he learns Thea has secretly married the most influential man in the city and realizes he's just a pawn in the Grants' game, he's shattered.

title: Now I'm Your CEO Ex-Husband
description: For seven years, Sam endured being treated as a useless husband by his wife, Winnie, and her family. His sacrifices went unnoticed, and even his birthday was forgotten. Tired of being taken for granted, Sam walks away and reveals his true identity, the CEO of Zenith Group. As he rebuilds his life and reclaims his dignity, Winnie and her family are forced to face a painful truth: they never appreciated the man who had quietly given them everything.

title: Husband and Kids Chose Her Over Me
description: Housewife Sarah knew her husband Lucas was arrested for participating in prostitution. She hurriedly went there, but her husband even blamed her for being too slow. Because he didn't want his first love to get sunburnt. Sarah decided to divorce Lucas. But her two children, whom she had raised with deep love, sided with the mistress Grace. Sarah decided to go abroad and leave this family. After Sarah left, Grace revealed her true colors. The children began to miss their mom, but Sarah would never turn back.

title: Schemes of the Heart: Mr. Hart's Game
description: Framed and betrayed by her own family, Maya Lane loses everything. Given a second chance, she returns with a single goal: vengeance. Navigating the cutthroat worlds of high society and entertainment, she forms an unlikely alliance with media mogul, Liam Hart. Together, they will expose the lies of her Keira and scheming father Gordon, turning their gilded world upside down. Betrayal runs in the family, but so does her will to survive and conquer.

title: My Husband Is Hard to Mess With
description: He was running from a lie that wanted him dead. She offered a truth that could save him. To survive, he built a new lie—one that trapped them both. Now, the walls are closing in, and the love that was built on deception will be tested by a fire of betrayal and a dangerous enemy who started it all. How far would you go to protect a secret that could destroy the one you love?

title: You Are My Destiny
description: Logan was blind and abandoned—until Giselle saved him, and they fell in love. She sacrificed everything for him, even giving him her corneas. But just as he regained his sight, she was gone. What he didn’t know was that she was pregnant—and fate made her his wife. Five years later, Logan returns as the Hale heir, unaware that his wife and their ailing daughter are the very ones he’s been searching for. When the truth finally comes out, will he win them back—or has he already lost them forever?

title: You Are the Only One
description: Ten years ago, Edward and Doreen were just classmates. Ten years later, the boy became a double Oscar-winning actor, while the girl became a reporter. They met again on Valentine's Day and got married on the spot. After that, Edward began his long journey of pursuing his wife after marriage.

title: You Are Not My Mom
description: Genevieve Bancroft murders her twin sister, Josephine Bancroft, stealing her identity as CEO and caring for Josephine's daughter, Gwendolyn Vance, who was blinded in a car crash. Once her vision returns, Gwendolyn fakes blindness to secretly gather evidence. Aided by Nicholas Mercer and Alexander Hayes, she exposes the truth at the shareholders' meeting, finally seeing Genevieve brought to justice and avenging her mother.

title: Dear Professor, You Are My Baby Daddy
description:
Med student Cora never expected to get pregnant—let alone with the baby of Damon Hawkins, the city’s most eligible billionaire bachelor... and her new visiting professor.
She planned to keep the child a secret, but Damon kept pushing past her walls—until he dropped to one knee and asked her to marry him.
What Cora thought would be a fleeting romance turned into a whirlwind of unexpected tenderness and indulgent love.
But the closer they grow, the more dangerous secrets begin to surface. As betrayal and hidden bloodlines come to light, Cora must face the ultimate question—
Can she truly find happiness... and reunite with the family she never knew she had?

title: Daddy I'm Your Lucky Star!
description:
Lila is five when her uncle Harold and aunt Karen abandon her. Jonathan, a kind billionaire, finds her and takes her home. He adopts her, and from that day, the house feels brighter. Lila brings luck and warmth. Noah, Jonathan’s son, has not spoken for a long time; with Lila by his side, he finally finds his voice. At an auction, she helps Jonathan win a hidden treasure chest. She even “talks” with the family dog and follows the hint to help Noah find his missing violin.
When danger rises, Lila “forces” Harold and the schemer Vivienne to tell the truth. The lies fall apart. She helps the family get out of harm’s way, exposes the schemes, and leaves Harold, Karen, and Vivienne with nowhere to hide.

title: Swimming My Way Back to You
description: Hazel has been in love with Marcus for eight years and spent three of them as his secret lover. Just when she thought she had finally won his heart, she overhears Marcus confessing that the only person he’s ever truly loved is his first love, Zoe. Heartbroken, Hazel decides it’s time to break things off with him—only to find out she’s pregnant...

title: No More You In My Days
description: Valerie Reed, the true head of Zenith Group, stepped down to become a housewife to support her husband, Calvin Hayes. For seven years, she tirelessly cared for the family and nursed him through a severe illness. Yet, her devotion was met with utter betrayal. At their son Noah Hayes's 100-day celebration, Calvin openly brought home his mistress, Mia Reed, and their illegitimate son, Jackson Hayes. Backed by his parents, he gave Valerie an ultimatum: let Mia move in while remaining a nanny for the Hayes family, or divorce and lose your son.

title: Goodbye, My Yesterday
description: In her first life, Sherry trapped Ethan into marriage only to find herself abandoned, miserable, and dying with regret. Now, she wakes up forty years earlier, on the very day she gave up her college dreams to marry him. This time, she tears up the form, takes control of her destiny, and sets out to live the life she was meant for.

title: Cry Your Eyes Out by My Tomb
description: The billionaire seeks wild revenge on his beloved who left him years ago, unaware she secretly bore his child. Now, as her life slips away, his heart aches with regret...

title: My Black Python Wants My Eggs
description: At Cascadia Reptile Research Institute, Noah Hayes is assigned to Avery, the largest and most bad-tempered white python in the facility. Avery refuses food, scares away every snake Noah cares for, bites only him, and keeps wrapping around him like a jealous lover. Noah thinks the snake hates him, until a breeding-season check reveals the ridiculous truth: Avery has been courting him all along. When Avery starts leaving “gifts,” guarding him from other snakes, and appearing in Noah’s dreams as a beautiful silver-haired man, Noah realizes his troublesome white snake may want far more than care. He wants Noah.

title: My Kidney for Your First Love?!
description: In her previous life, Vivian sacrificed everything for love but died tragically because of the scumbag Gavin and homewrecker Claire. Reborn on her wedding day, when Gavin publicly humiliated her, Vivian exposed his evil intention to seize her family fortune in front of everyone and revealed her own identity as the head of the Cloud Group. Gavin was enraged, but the man Ian he had insulted turned out to be a big shot. Vivian and Ian joined forces to drive their enemies away and got together.

title: My Kidney for Your First Love?!
description: In her previous life, Vivian sacrificed everything for love but died tragically because of the scumbag Gavin and homewrecker Claire. Reborn on her wedding day, when Gavin publicly humiliated her, Vivian exposed his evil intention to seize her family fortune in front of everyone and revealed her own identity as the head of the Cloud Group. Gavin was enraged, but the man Ian he had insulted turned out to be a big shot. Vivian and Ian joined forces to drive their enemies away and got together.

title: Can't Say I Love You
description:
"After four years of secret love and six years of marriage, you repay me with this?"
