During our six years of marriage, I worked tirelessly at home like a servant. Yet my husband wanted to drive me away because of his first love's return！ Unable to endure it any longer, I chose to divorce him. 
When we meet again, I’m already a confident businesswoman negotiating at the table, and also a returned heiress, and he is no longer worthy to stand by my side.

title: Let Me Stay By Your Side
description: You and your sister are orphans and grow up together with your brother who is your neighbor. One day, returning home together, the brother picked up a pack of cigarettes out of curiosity. While all three were inside, a fire broke out, and your sister and the brother were rescued, while you were left behind. Many years later, you grew up to become a successful CEO, while your sister became a worn-out housewife to the neighbor's brother. Initially wanting revenge on your sister, you discover her enduring domestic abuse while pregnant, which deeply makes you hurt too. When your sister faces a life-threatening situation, you face a crucial decision: whether or not to save her.

title: New Year with My Pretty Boss
description:
To escape the pressure of marriage, Vonny accidentally crosses paths with Jay, a young man from the countryside hiding his true family background and they decide to enter into a fake relationship.
Jay has no idea that Vonny is actually the Executive Director of his company until he is reassigned as her assistant. As their families begin to meddle, Jay's true identity is slowly revealed and the story really starts to heat up.

title: Sky-High Payback See Ya
description: The traffic controller Harrison is framed for misconduct by his wife and best friend—reborn, he unravels their conspiracy!

title: The Alpha King Is My Baby’s Daddy!
description:
Layla Hale, a fallen heiress, scrapes by working at a small‑town bakery with her twin sons, who can shift into wolf cubs. She endures harassment from her lecherous boss and constant hunger, until her best friend signs her up for the Voss Group Jewelry Competition. She returns to New York and wins the championship through her own talent.
Yet barely after lifting the trophy, she is framed by her malicious adopted sister Maggie, who had wronged her in the past. Layla is forced down onto a chair at City Hall and made to take Maggie’s place in marrying the notorious CEO of Voss Group — a man rumored to be hideously ugly, brutal and perverse.
When the door swings open, however, the man who steps forward is none other than the one who marked her five years ago — the biological father of her two wolf‑cub sons. What she does not know is that the man she has spent five years running from has spent those same five years searching for her.
— Fled with my kids for five years, only for my toxic sister to force‑marry me to the Wolf King CEO — who happens to be my boys’ real father.

title: Will You Be My Ex?
description: Two polar opposites, Chris and Joey, fall madly in love despite their contrasting backgrounds. But fate intervenes, forcing them apart. Years later, they reunite and rekindle old feelings. Can they make it work this time?

title: My Lycan Lord
description:
Abandoned by her family, Eva is reborn on the day of the bloodline trial. In her past life, her stepsister Vivian framed her, and she died in a vampire castle as a pawn. This time, she sees through her family’s fake love and the vampires’ schemes, choosing wounded werewolf Alistair—secretly the supreme Lycan King. Poisoned by the Ice-Fire Divine Poison and betrayed by his closest subordinate, he hides as a lowly wolf slave.

Vivian steals the vampire marriage contract and torments Eva, while her cold parents treat her as a bargaining chip. Even cast out and mocked by nobles, Eva stands by Alistair. At the Blood Moon Ceremony, Vivian forces her barefoot across silver thorns and sacred fire to kill her. Alistair arrives with his wolf legion, reveals his true identity, and avenges every insult.

Together they uncover the vampire Progenitor’s plot to seize the Blackstone Divine Essence inside Eva. Eva enters the Void Sacred Spring alone, endures heavenly thunder as a mortal, absorbs the forbidden essence, and cures Alistair. They defeat the Progenitor, overthrow the old order, and punish all traitors. Eva ascends the twin thrones as Wolf Queen beside her Lycan King, bound by eternal love.

title: I Am Bloody Mary
description: Mare and her fiancé Nick may not have much money, but they have love. As a foster kid with no family of her own, Mare dreams of a wedding with Nick’s family by their side, but Nick is secretive about his estranged relatives. Then, unexpectedly, his mother arrives, warmly inviting Mare into the wealthy and mysterious Thornwood family. She even offers to host the wedding at their grand estate. But the morning of the ceremony, a horrifying discovery shatters Mare's dream, and she realizes she’s not walking into a happy-ever-after, but into a nightmare twisted by the Thornwood family’s dark history--one that might end up killing her.

title: Mommy by Day, CEO's Wife by Night
description: After her divorce, Jessica lived alone, raising her son Kimi, but faced difficulties resolving his household registration issues. To solve this problem, Jessica chose to marry Ryan, CEO of the RG Group. After the marriage, Ryan accidentally discovered that Kimi might be his biological son, prompting him to launch a thorough investigation. Lucian attempted to claim Kimi's identity for illegal benefits fraudulently. Through Ryan's efforts, the truth was ultimately revealed, and Lucian received legal punishment. They finally reunited happily and have a new chapter of their lives together.

title: The Abyssal Tyrant’s Baby Calls Me Mommy
description:
To survive falling into the hands of Kael, a ruthless Siren king who eats liars, Elena lies—claiming to be his long-lost fiancée. Surprising everyone, Kael’s five-year-old son, Lucian, instantly accepts her as "Mommy." Forced to navigate a dangerous ocean realm, Elena uses her wits and fake romance to stay alive alongside the lethal Siren and his child.
However, when ancient enemies attack and threaten their lives, Elena risks everything to protect them, unlocking a shocking truth: she isn't an impostor. Five years ago, she was Kael’s true mate, who sacrificed her memory to save him during a catastrophic rift explosion. With their memories restored and enemies defeated, Kael leaves the underwater throne behind to reunite with Elena on land, finally completing their family.

title: Swimming My Way Back to You
description: Hazel has been in love with Marcus for eight years and spent three of them as his secret lover. Just when she thought she had finally won his heart, she overhears Marcus confessing that the only person he’s ever truly loved is his first love, Zoe. Heartbroken, Hazel decides it’s time to break things off with him—only to find out she’s pregnant...

title: Divorce Me, In the Name of Mercy
description: The billionaire married the daughter of his father's killer not out of love, but to torment her. Even when she fell terminally ill, he showed no mercy...

title: Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King
description: Exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.

title: Zeus Came Back for His True Love
description:
Cora chose a penniless beggar over the wealthy old merchant her family tried to force her to marry. What she never knew was that her new husband was Zeus—the all-powerful King of the Gods.
When Frost Giants invade Mount Olympus, Zeus is forced to leave her behind. For seven long years, Cora raises their gifted twins alone while suffering relentless abuse from her cruel family.
But when Cora and her children are branded as demons and sentenced to death, Zeus finally returns in a storm of thunder. As his true identity is revealed, everyone who humiliated his family will face the wrath of a god.

title: The Daughter of Zeus
description: After witnessing her mother's murder at the hands of gods, Aria believes one thing: gods are heartless. One day she kills a mysterious golden lamb to feed her starving family—unaware that it's a sacred creature of Olympus. She comes face-to-face with her mother's killer, the Immortal Champion of Olympus - Kairos, who brings her back to Olympus to face justice. Through her journey, she learns of her real identity, the strength that she holds, and the heartbreaking truth behind Kairos' violent history. Together, they face danger, overcome trauma, and learn to accept their Fates that bind them together for eternity.

title: They Fed Me to the Zombies, Not Knowing I Was Their Power
description: Her family threw Nova to the zombies, calling her a useless waste. They didn't know their powers all came from her. Within five hundred meters of Nova, they were heroes. Without her, they were nothing. Left to die, Nova's ability awakened. She took back everything she gave. Now her family stands defenseless in a sea of zombies, watching Nova walk through the horde untouched.She made all zombies kneel. They wanted a sacrifice. However. it was late.

title: Revenge Is a Size Zero
description:
Emma, the wife of the founder of a Paris‑based fashion brand, endured long‑term humiliation and betrayal from her husband Maxime, her best friend Camille and her sister‑in‑law Valerie because of her weight. She was even pushed off a terrace and locked in a cold storage room to die. On the brink of death, she was rescued by her biological grandfather Henri, who had been searching for her for years. She learned that she was the sole heir to the Villard fashion empire.

With the companionship of her childhood sweetheart Lorenzo, Emma rebuilt herself over seven months. She made a glamorous comeback under the identity of Adele Villard and carefully laid out schemes to take revenge on those who had betrayed her. In the end, she exposed their crimes, took over the empire, and embarked on a brand‑new life.

title: Zero Sum
description: Ethan paid an advance of 8,000 bucks for a reception fee to secure a 100 million order. But when he went to the finance department for reimbursement, he was informed only 1,000 bucks could be reimbursed according to the group's regulations. Feeling aggrieved, Ethan went to the chairman to seek justice, only to find that even his 100 million order had been snatched away. He was so mad and went to the client to split the meal expenses. At this point, his fate started changing...

title: Date with the Zombie King
description: Agent Zoe is betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister during a zombie apocalypse, but is unexpectedly saved by the zombie king Ethan on the brink of death. To complete a secret mission, she approaches Ethan to uncover the truth behind the virus, only to discover their fated connection. From using each other to falling deeply in love, they join forces to seek revenge, expose the conspiracy, and end the apocalypse.

title: Zombie Cruise
description: A couple on a peaceful cruise must battle a horde of zombies aboard the ship, steering it away from civilization to prevent a catastrophic outbreak.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: I Swallowed the Zerg Overmind's Egg
description:
In the underground arenas of a wasteland metropolis, Ryker, an F-rank underdog, risks his life in brutal bare-knuckle fights to save his sister, Lena, from a fatal genetic disease.

Driven to the brink, he swallows an ominous Insect King egg offered by the Black Market King, unleashing a terrifying power within himself. Armed with this monstrous ability, Ryker defies class prejudice and claws his way up the ranks, only to find himself steadily mutating into something inhuman.

As the dark truth comes to light, he discovers that his sister's illness and his parents' deaths are tied to a sinister imperial conspiracy disguised as human-insect hybridization. With war and a relentless swarm engulfing the city, can Ryker—on the verge of complete metamorphosis—cling to his fading humanity and save the only family he has left?

title: The Frozen Lycan King Claims His Bride
description: Isabella thought she had found her fated mate, but her beloved bodyguard Holden ruthlessly betrays her for her manipulative stepsister. Brutally abused and abandoned, she is forced by her greedy father to marry Ronan, the Frozen Lycan King—a comatose ruler trapped in an ice coffin. Expecting a life of cold despair, Isabella accepts her dark fate, only to accidentally awaken the fearsome king from his icy slumber. With an ancient contract surfacing and a terrifying new power awakening, how will Isabella survive the deadly conspiracies surrounding her?

title: Stand Aside, the Billionaire Is Here
description: After six years abroad, Zacarías Montiel builds the world's largest financial empire—the Centurion Group—under the alias "Mr. Z," even helping the current president rise to power. When he quietly returns home to propose to his girlfriend, Isabela, she leaves him to pursue wealth, claiming that only the mysterious Mr. Z is good enough for her. Meanwhile, a small favor leads Zacarías into a sudden marriage with Fernanda Salazar, the beautiful CEO of Prisma Media. At Isabela's housewarming party, she repeatedly tries to kick Zacarías out—unaware of his true identity—until he finally decides to reclaim everything he once gave her.

title: Blitzed by My Rival's Obsession
description: Sunny star quarterback Seth hides a love-starved heart behind his perfect facade. When violent ex-linebacker "Mad Dog" Matthew transfers into his team and becomes his forced roommate, their explosive fights bleed into charged, unbearable tension. Seth falls hard, until he spots his rival Ethan's birthday carved into Matthew’s necklace, convinced he's just a stand-in...

title: Frozen by the Man She Loved
description: Chloe freezes to death after giving her last food to the husband and son she thinks are trapped in a deadly blizzard. But as her soul leaves the storage room, she sees the truth: there was no disaster, only a cruel punishment staged by her husband, brother, son, and the fake heiress they all protected. While they feast upstairs and call her a liar, Chloe's body becomes the evidence that exposes every betrayal and drags the whole family into ruin.

title: Wrath of Zeus's Son 2: Secret Protection from the Janitor
description: Leon Vance, Son of Zeus, disappeared in the disaster 10 years ago. His daughter Beryl blames him for her mom's death —— a wound that time has only deepened. Now back as janitor, he hides his power to protect his little girl, and endures her cold stares and mockery. But when Lord of Abyss descends once more, the world is stunned to discover that the coward janitor is their almighty savior.

title: After the 330-Pound Fat Wolf Left, the Alpha Went Crazy with Regret
description: Nia is a 300-pound Omega mocked by the entire pack as a disgusting fat wolf. When Alpha Zayne chooses her as his Luna, she believes she has finally been loved. She poisons herself, bleeds for him, tears her own fur to keep him warm, and carries his child. Then she overhears the truth: Zayne only used her as a womb and plans to kill her after the baby is born. Betrayed, abused, and forced through unbearable trials, Nia awakens as a legendary White Wolf. Now she returns under a new name, not for love, but to save the child Zayne killed. The Alpha finally falls in love with her beauty, but the woman who once loved him has already died.

title: You Drive Me Crazy
description: 6 years ago, car restorer Yasmin was drugged and had a passionate encounter with a handsome homeless guy she thought she’d never see again — only to discover she was carrying his child. Now, fighting to save her 5-year-old son, she takes a job as secretary to Tristen Mars, former race car driver and CEO of Mars Motor Group. Little does she know this billionaire is the father of her little boy!  As old sparks reignite and hidden truths come dangerously close to the surface, Yasmin and Tristen fall for each other while still unaware that they’re the very strangers they’ve spent years longing to find.

title: Superboy vs. Alien
description: Commander Z, the most powerful superhero in the world, hid his identity to live the life of a normal teenager. But as people around him take his kindness for weakness, he is done hiding in the shadows.

title: The Zombie Queen's Guardian
description: Once the chief researcher of the Ark Lab, Miles now leads the Starlight Coexistence Zone, a sanctuary where humans and harmless undead live side by side. But his greatest challenge isn't politics or war. It's raising his daughter, Elara: the Zombie Queen. Infected but not lost, Elara commands the very forces that terrify humanity. As enemies from the Three Zones close in and the Ark's dark legacy resurfaces, Miles must protect the one girl who could either save the world, or end it.

title: Accidentally Fell for the Zombie Queen
description: While searching for a cure during a zombie apocalypse, Easton meets Ellie, unaware that she is the feared Zombie Queen. When he discovers that his blood can suppress her infection and restore her humanity, the two grow close and fall in love. After learning the truth, Easton chooses to help rather than fear her. Together, they uncover the key to a vaccine that ends the outbreak, saving humanity and finding happiness with each other.

title: The Devil's Plus-Size Bride
description: Commoner Elena makes a pact with the Abyss demon Damon so her officer boyfriend Arthur can rise through the ranks, paying the price with a 200-pound weight gain. Arthur heartlessly abandons her for the noblewoman Victoria, who pushes Elena from a raised platform. Near death, Damon saves her and gives her a key to the endless Abyss Vault—spending gold lifts her curse. Elena transforms into a breathtaking beauty and returns as the capital's richest woman, crushing her ex, her rivals, and arrogant nobles with ruthless precision.

title: Infinite Zombie Coins: Buying Out the Apocalypse
description: Scammed out of 70K by his cheating ex as the zombie apocalypse hits, Felix awakens a spending system with infinite Zombie Coins. Armed with unlimited wealth, he dominates the apocalypse.

title: Heartless Frost, Dr. Z's Awakening
description: Dr. Rowan Lawson spent a decade crafting a miracle cure for Dawn Summers, only to watch her gift the triumph — and her heart — to another man. When her new lover deliberately destroyed the serum to force him out, and Dawn stood by in silent approval, Rowan's devotion finally froze over. He vanished from her world and returned as the medical world's most formidable and elusive legend: Dr. Z.

title: He Went Crazy After My Fake Betrayal
description: Three years ago, Madeline bore the scorn of the whole city and played the role of a heartless gold‑digger. When Vincent lay dying in the ICU, she pretended to throw herself into the arms of his half‑brother Niccolo. Everyone believed she had abandoned the dying heir for money. No one knew this betrayal was a deadly lie. To save Vincent, Madeline secretly donated one of her kidneys to him and left. Three years later, Madeline works at a five‑star hotel, where she crosses paths with Vincent. He has survived and reclaimed his powerful family empire, but he is consumed by bitter hatred. Vincent torments Madeline with sharp words and deliberate provocations...

title: Love Bites: My Girlfriend Is a Zombie CEO
description: After a zombie outbreak, Zachary Auden awakens the True Love System and is forced to date gorgeous zombie CEO, Caroline Stark. But that's not the only problem. Between fighting off zombie hordes and dodging dirty schemes from rival survivors, he still has a world to save.

title: ReelTalk EP 67-Backstage: Pucked in the Friend Zone
description: Seth Edeen returns to the ice in this exciting episode of ReelTalk Backstage. Follow along as he takes us inside his new show Pucked in the Friend Zone, showing how he prepares for game day and what it really takes to suit up for hockey. His co-stars also dish on why hockey players are so irresistible and share behind the scenes tea from set. Catch all the action now!

title: Patient Zero's First Day of Work
description: Sarah Palin, Patient Zero in the mental hospital, takes a job at OmniMed after recovering. When her tormentor, Morgan Hunter, turns workplace bullying into a vicious campaign, Sarah fights back. But Sarah is thrown back to the mental hospital...

title: Horror Descends: My Zombies Are Unbeatable
description: Elian Voss doesn't run from the apocalypse. He builds an army. He unlocks the Terror Zombie Synthesis System. Unbeatable nightmares like Samara and Freddy Krueger serve him alone. He exposes the Shadow Court, claims the Map of Creation, and rises as the Nether Lord.

title: Freeze! Runaway Groom
description: To pay for her father's medical bills, Ivy is forced to marry Byron, a wealthy heir, instead of her stepsister. But on their wedding day, Byron doesn't show up, leaving Ivy humiliated in front of all their family and friends. After they finally marry, they set three rules—agreeing they won't fall in love with each other. Eventually, Byron tells Ivy that the agreement is ridiculous because he's already fallen in love with her. He asks her if she loves him back. So, will Ivy reciprocate his feelings?

title: Crazy For Her
description: Five years ago,  Lucas tore through Jane's boundaries. She drugged him, slipped away into the dark. Fate throws her right back into his path, and she's soon plotting another escape right under his nose. This whole time, she's the catch. The trap was set the first moment they locked eyes.

title: One Lady, Five Beastmates, Zero Affinity?
description: Mission count: 100. Destination: Blue Star. Actual arrival: zombie world. Now, Cara is the Duchess's daughter, and she has five beastmates who can't stand her. But still, only she can stop them from going feral. Now the system wants her to win them over. No pressure.

title: The Sunblood Girl Frozen to Death
description: Elara Weir was born with Sunblood, but in her powerful family, she was never treated like a daughter. She was made into a scapegoat: whenever her gifted brother Kaylan failed, Elara paid the price. On the night before the Solar Crown Trial, their mother locks her inside the Moonfrost Chamber, a forbidden room that can freeze Sunblood magic from the inside out. Kaylan begs, their father arrives too late, and Elara dies betrayed by the family she tried to survive. But the scapegoat ritual does not end with death, and her next life may finally set her free.

title: Nepo Zombie: My Relatives Run Every Dungeon
description: A ten‑year‑old boy falls into a zombie world and discovers his secret weapon: nepotism. The S‑class Head Nurse is his aunt. The Red‑Clad Woman, Bronze Coffin Bride, and Nether King are all family. With his undead relatives backing him up, dungeons are just family gatherings. He ends up king of two worlds. Who needs fighting when you have family?

title: Betrayed Zora Rules All
description: Zora Laurent unexpectedly arrived in a brand-new interstellar world and activated her exclusive system. With the system's help and her own wisdom, she defused provocations, stabilized the situation, discovered rare energy resources, and gradually took control of the kingdom. Awakening powerful mental abilities, she became the heir to the crown. Facing the vast interstellar opportunities, she resolved to lead the empire to explore the cosmos and create a new legend.

title: After I Cheated 99 Times, My Husband Went Crazy with Regret
description: Stella, a former sex worker rescued from the streets by billionaire heir Victor, endures three years of hell in his gilded mansion—framed for 99 affairs, gaslit by his childhood friend Chloe, abused by his family, and abandoned by her own son. Each time she cries for help, Victor turns away. But when she finally signs the divorce papers without a fight, the truth begins to surface: she never cheated. The 99 men were Chloe's planted traps. Now free and armed with evidence, Stella must decide if she can ever forgive the man who broke her 99 times—or if some wounds are too deep for redemption.

title: My Freeze. Their Tears. No Forgiveness
description: Sophie grew up in an orphanage and was adopted by the wealthy Johnson family at the age of six. She spent twelve happy years under the love of her three elder brothers and adoptive parents. However, when her adoptive parents' biological daughter, Camille, returned, Sophie fell from being the cherished gem to a misunderstood and hurt outsider. Camille maneuvered step by step, constantly framing Sophie, while the family chose to listen selectively, and the repeated coldness and hurt left her disheartened. Sophie decided to become the first volunteer for her elder brother's 'Sleep Project,' which had been planned for five years, repaying her adoptive parents’ kindness through a life experiment. On her eighteenth birthday, she severed all ties with her family, entered the sleep chamber alone, and donated her corneas to her blind second brother. When she awoke after thirty years of slumber, her family had grown old, but she could no longer remember them—leaving only that misplaced familial affection, etched as an eternal regret through the river of time.

title: Freeze! My Wanted Lover
description: A cop goes undercover to take down a notorious mob boss but faces a dilemma when she falls for her target, especially since he's the main suspect in her father's murder.

title: My Rise To Power After She Left
description: Betrayed by his wife, Yvonne, and left with nothing, Lennox Hayes suddenly inherits ancient powers that change his destiny. When Amelia Langford—heiress to the powerful Langford family of Grimwood—reveals their long-lost engagement, Lennox must navigate a dangerous new world of cultivation and conspiracy. From the streets of Riverain to the heights of Grimwood's elite, he'll prove that even the most broken can rise to rule.

title: She Didn't Bring Roses She Brought a Proposal
description: On her mother's birthday, Chloe visits a funeral home and encounters Julian, a man who has just lost his own mother. At that moment, Julian is adrift, much like Chloe was after her own loss. Moved by his plight, Chloe steps in when Julian is belittled by his fiancée's family and impulsively proposes marriage to rescue him from humiliation. Yet, when Chloe later plans to divorce, she discovers that Julian has taken their relationship seriously and is actually a brilliant and ambitious scholar.

title: The Billionaire Boxer Fell for the Plus-Size Heiress
description: A year ago, plus-size Gemma was bullied until scarred stranger Cole saved her. After a glow-up, she returns as a top physical therapist—secretly the Vance Media heiress—and reunites with Cole, now an isolated boxer. Facing Triss and Sinna’s schemes, she fights back with brains and money, while Cole buys the club to protect her. At the gala, both reveal their billionaire-heir identities, crush their enemies, and kiss above the city.

title: Disciple Overload: From Zero to Empresses
description: Transported to a cultivation world, Evan Yates is a broke, wounded sect leader with a game-breaking edge: take in a Destined Prodigy as a disciple, and his system returns everything 10,000x. When the Dark Heaven Sect rises to plunge the world into chaos and his disciples' deadly pasts come knocking, Evan leads his girls into battle. One lesson for all: mess with his disciples, and you face their master.

title: Oops, I Snagged That Fox's Heart
description: Natalia has been betrayed and pushed off a cliff by her uncle's family three times! Each time, she's saved by Kieran, a nine-tailed fox, and then killed by him. This time, she impulsively kisses Kieran, hoping to change her fate. But she accidentally consumes his core and inherits his powers. Now it's her chance to turn things around.

title: The Betrayal Game
description: After being betrayed and murdered by her boyfriend, Samuel, and his lover Jessica, Nina wakes up before it all happens. Determined to rewrite her fate, she secretly records their affair and plots her revenge. When Samuel tries to scam her again, Nina walks straight into his trap to spring her own. At a tense family gathering, she reveals the proof of their lies, exposing their affair and fraud for everyone to see. This time, it's not Nina who's ruined, it's them.

title: Bridezilla, Never Provoke The Billionaire Mother
description: On the male lead’s wedding day, his mother (the female lead), who’s been abroad, comes to attend the ceremony—but the bride-to-be (the female villain) mistakenly accuses the male lead of cheating. The villain, along with her family and bridesmaids, bullies the female lead. When the male lead arrives, the truth comes out: the villains realize she’s his mother. To get her son to call off the wedding, the female lead reveals the villain’s true, malicious motives for marrying him. With the female lead holding power that could bankrupt them with a single call, the villain is betrayed by her family and friends one after another. Finally, her own infidelity is exposed publicly. The male lead sees through her, cancels the wedding, and the villain ends up being brought to justice and losing everything.

title: Pregnant with My Nemesis’ Brother’s Baby
description: Naomi James's boyfriend pushed her from the rooftop after getting involved with Jenny Walker, a billionaire's sister. Getting reborn, Naomi decided to approach Matthew Walker, Jenny's rich but sickly brother. Matthew was predicted to never have children and possibly dying young, but none of that stopped Naomi from marrying him. Shortly after getting married, Naomi found out she was pregnant!

title: Pampered by My Ex-husband
description: CEO Mr. Hall is hailed as the perfect husband until Cici returns with a child and blows up his spotless image. When he tries to win her back, she shuts him down cold: the child is hers, and he's the one she walked away from. Only after meeting two pint-sized versions of himself does he realize the truth. Chasing his ex? He'll have to get in line.

title: The Freezer's Tiny Kingdom
description: Harrison accidentally discovered a miniature kingdom inside the freezer of his ancestral home. The simple tools he casually used had ten-thousand-fold effects in that tiny world. So Harrison shuttled back and forth between the freezer and the real world, using modern technology to help the miniature kingdom overcome crisis after crisis—bringing enormous shock to that little world.

title: Frozen Frontier: Sarah's Costco Crossing
description: 1846, nineteen-year-old pioneer Sarah Whitlock is trapped in a Rocky Mountain blizzard—her father dying of gangrene, her siblings starving. Chasing a rat across ice, she falls into a crevasse and wakes up behind a modern Costco. Mistaken for a costumed employee, she starts smuggling rotisserie chickens, vitamins, and antibiotics back through time to save her family—while accidentally becoming America's most viral TikTok star. But her wagon train is turning against her, and one door won't stay secret forever.

title: The Lazy Immortal's Nightmare
description: All Damon Hayes wanted was to stay hidden in his new cultivation world, quietly enduring his humble job as a night soil collector. That plan was shattered the day he awakened the Intelligent Cultivation System. Instead of a godly tool for ascension, it became his personal guide to hell—stealing from a Demonic Sect Elder, offending the Demonic Saintess, and painting a target on his back for every powerful being in the realm. Now, as a forbidden technique descends upon him and the Saintess sharpens her blade, Damon has just one question for the system: “Was keeping a low profile really that hard?!”

title: Billionaire's Unexpected Bliss
description: Medical student Chloe accidentally saves a billionaire, Alaric Lawson, resulting in an unexpected pregnancy. He finds her and insists on marriage, showering her with devotion. But navigating his wealthy family brings jealousy, schemes, and a long-lost uncle. Can their contract marriage blossom into true love against all odds?

title: Frozen Heart, Burning Desire
description: To save her vegetative brother, Serena had to marry the Morgan family's heir, Nathan. However, on their engagement day, she learned that her fiance had been having an affair with his secretary. They even made a plan to make her die. In a desperate counterattack, Serena entangled herself with Alan, the half brother and mortal enemy of Nathan. She seduced Alan step by step, hoping to change a fiance. Alan, the cold-faced gentleman helped her many times. Has he already got into her love trap?

title: 封神之战之纣王重生（The Battle of Gods: The Rebirth of King Zhou）
description: The Battle of Gods: The Rebirth of King Zhou，How the reincarnated King Zhou and Daji rekindle their romance, and how they confront the Way of Heaven.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Fall For the Wrong Heir
description: When Mason Linwood, a college student, is betrayed by his girlfriend Hedy, his life seems over—until campus queen, Jocelyne Switt, reappears, secretly carrying his twins. To secure a future, they enter a fake marriage, unaware that Mason is the lost heir to the billion-dollar Linwood empire. As threats close in, their pretend relationship becomes the only shield against a world of greed and lies.

title: I Crowned My Useless Dad
description: Mina Shaw, is reborn as the daughter of Prince Henry—a man hellbent on revenge. She can read minds, turn anything to gold, and her inner thoughts are broadcast to everyone around her! Now, she must navigate a chaotic court, tame her vengeful father, outwit a cunning crown prince, and win over a grumpy emperor—all while accidentally melting hearts and turning the royal world upside down.

title: The Bride Hides a Crown No One Sees
description: Forced to marry into Wildmare, Princess Yetta expects a brute husband and a life of hardship. But the "worthless" stones are pure jade, the "broken" carts hide endless herds, and her rugged husband, Alistair Belmont, is no tribesman—he is the Emperor of the mighty Daurevia Empire. As her sister flaunts a royal wedding, Yetta steps into a gilded cage of secrets, where every lie unravels a truth more dazzling than the last.

title: A Wife's Revenge
description: Lillian hides her true identity as the chairwoman of a listed company, living as an ordinary sales rep. But when she discovers her husband Milo's betrayal and his plan with his mistress, Whitney, to steal her fortune, her world collapses. Broken but not defeated, Lillian awakens. With quiet precision and the power she once hid, she exposes Milo's schemes, protects her daughter, and makes him choke on the consequences of his own greed.

title: Mistaken Love for Hatred
description:
Your father suddenly passed away, and life fell into unprecedented hardship. 
In this difficult moment, your only choice was to work as a housekeeper for the person who caused your family's downfall. You endured humiliation, yet deep inside, a flame of revenge burned. You successfully drove a wedge between him and his brother, turning them against each other. However, during this process, you started to lose yourself in his brother's protection of you. His deep affection made you feel guilty, and you began to doubt whether your revenge plan was right...

title: The Hidden Tycoon’s Wife
description: She plans to tell her husbandabout her pregnancy but finds him with the pregnant  At her mother-in-law’s birthday banquet, she is humiliated and decides to divorce. Her brother steps in, bringing her home and arranging for her to host a business event, where she encounters them again. She tries to embarrass him, but fails. The  family believes he is the boy's mistress, making her life difficult, until it’s revealed that she is the family’s eldest daughter.He finally realizes his mistake, but it’s too late to fix their relationship.

title: Boss Mom: A Lazy Daydream
description: When Vivian's fiancé, Ethan, disappeared without a trace, her world was turned upside down. For five relentless years, she and their children embarked on an unwavering quest, fueled by love and hope. Just as she was on the brink of despair, a chance encounter reunites them. But the reunion takes a bewildering turn: Ethan insists he's never met her, never been in love, and certainly never fathered a child...

title: Mr. Jackson, Your Bride Is Running Away
description: Cathy is devastated to learn that Paxon, the father of her child, allegedly wants nothing to do with her or their baby. Heartbroken, Cathy thought she had lost the baby and left. Years later, fate brings them back together, but misunderstandings only deepen between them. Can they unravel the past and find their way back to each other?

title: Geez! I Have a Dinosaur Park!
description: Replaced by the true heir Justin, the adopted son Caleb is given an empty zoo by the Sterling family. He accidentally activates the Jurassic System, hatches a Triceratops, and goes viral with the help of streamer Kira. When the Sterling family tries to seize the property, Caleb drives them away with a T-Rex and later thwarts a poacher attack. Unlocking more dinosaurs like the Diplodocus, he partners with the Caldwell Group to expand, eventually buying out the Sterling Group to build the world's first Jurassic Dinosaur Park.

title: Plus-Size Girl Travels Back to Become a Tycoon
description:
That day, I caught him cheating on me in the lab, and when I confronted him, he shoved me. The chemicals exploded, and the next thing I know, I’ve woken up in another world as an unloved, overweight woman with two starving kids to take care of. 
With no other choice, I decide to make money and get out with my kids. But my scheming younger sister keeps framing me, and the cold, distant husband I wanted to divorce turns out to be the emperor’s son! Just when I think it’s all over, he starts showing up more and more... Can we really make things work?

title: Reborn as a Fish
description: Neil Ford, a corporate CEO and avid angler, meets a tragic end at the hands of his wife Vivian and her lover Jensen during a fishing trip. Cast into the lake, he transforms into a fish and awakens to a Shock-to-Evolve system. While Vivian schemes to swiftly claim Neil's inheritance, she faces resistance from his parents. Now, with the lives of Neil's parents on the line, he has to farm points and protect his family.

title: Loving You in the Wrong Body
description: Architecture student Melany Ryder made a deal with the CEO, Noah Aiken, to save her ailing mother. While Noah appears to be a gentle, wheelchair-bound man, his soul actually belongs to Liam Aiken, his nephew from the future. In this life, he vows to protect her. As Melany begins to sense his secret love, the mistaken identities and emotional dilemmas confuse her. The truth, family conspiracies, hateful young Liam, can they deal with them all?

title: The Ocean's Gaze
description: Henry, a salvager in the dangerous Mynara Sea, is swept away by a storm and gains the legendary Trident of the Sea King, unlocking a supernatural power to see treasure locations. With his newfound abilities, he navigates the treacherous waters, forms alliances with loyal Milo and merchant heiress Sophia, and rises to become the wealthiest and most powerful King of the Sea, determined to conquer the world’s oceans.

title: Reborn to Swap Fates
description: Jealous of Mitch Harmon for his luxurious life, Javier Harmon attacked Mitch with a knife, and the cousins both died. But when they opened their eyes, they were back on the fateful wedding night in 1977 that had set their lives on diverging paths! With memories of his last life, Javier married Patsy Reeves, the adopted girl, instead of switching brides with Mitch. He thought he could steal Mitch's future—but only sank deeper into misery. Meanwhile, Mitch built a life richer in love, purpose, and success than before with Margie.

title: My Rise To Power After She Left
description: Betrayed by his wife, Yvonne, and left with nothing, Lennox Hayes suddenly inherits ancient powers that change his destiny. When Amelia Langford—heiress to the powerful Langford family of Grimwood—reveals their long-lost engagement, Lennox must navigate a dangerous new world of cultivation and conspiracy. From the streets of Riverain to the heights of Grimwood's elite, he'll prove that even the most broken can rise to rule.

title: Hacked by Fate
description: Shawn gave Joyce Lynn and Lynn Tech his genius. They gave him a dismissal letter in return. With the help of Rachel, the investor, Shawn turns his exile into a revolution. Now, the woman who wronged him watches as the empire she built is dismantled, line by line of code.

title: Frosty CEO, Sizzling Baby Bump Romance
description: Once the Lord of Martial Peace, now a humble security guard—Nicodemus walks the shadows and finds the daughter of the man who once saved his life!

title: Her Caged Bird
description: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Clara's car breaks down in the mountains. There, she meets Terry, a poor college student working part-time as a mechanic. She takes him in, not knowing he's the long-lost heir to a powerful family. Their fragile romance collapses under the weight of his secret, and Terry walks away, unaware that Clara is pregnant. Years later, he returns with power and wealth, and their love story begins again.

title: Stitched by His Love
description: Isabel Gould's parents died when she was a kid, so she had to live with her brother and sister-in-law. But her brother was a gambler and her sister-in-law always mistreated her. Adam Shelby, also titled Duke Shelby, was a strong general. People admired him and called him War God. He and Isabel had a one-night stand, and then Isabel got pregnant before marriage. This was a shameful thing in her empire. Her sister-in-law meant to sell her to an old man to get money. Adam saved her in time...

title: The Frozen Apocalypse: I Hoarded Billions in Supplies
description: Temperatures plummeted overnight, plunging humanity into the extreme cold of The New Ice Age. In his previous life, Jace Hayes struggled through the apocalypse before freezing and starving to death. Reborn a month before the disaster, he hoards supplies, builds an apocalypse bunker, and awakens his abilities early. When the Frozen Apocalypse arrives, Jace is lounging in an apocalypse bunker, enjoying a personal paradise!

title: CEO's Flash-Marriage Frenzy
description: Betrayed by her boyfriend and bestie, the girl ended up flash-marrying a roadside vendor. Who would've thought the vendor turned out to be a rich and handsome CEO!?

title: Lost Heiress of Kingston High
description: Katie Walker is the janitor’s adopted kid — bullied, humiliated, a nobody. Then the golden Maddox brothers show up looking for their long lost heiress sister: Katie! But the school’s queen bee steals her place. Now it’s Katie’s turn to level up, take back her crown, and make them all regret underestimating her.

title: The Great and Powerful Genie
description: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.

title: The Bride of the Dragon God
description:
Pureblood sorceress Grace forces her mute half-sister Liya to marry the Dragon God Naz in her place. After forming a blood bond with Naz, Liya is hunted by Grace's assassins. She falls from a cliff, finds refuge in a monastery, and secretly gives birth to dragon twins. She hides for seven years.

Grace discovers Liya alive, abducts her family, and tortures her. Naz senses the shattered blood bond, transforms into a black dragon, and saves them.

In Dragonflame City, Grace accuses Liya of polluting the royal bloodline. But the Dragon Blood Stone proves the twins carry true royal blood. Grace is sentenced to death.

The seven tribes demand Liya undergo trials in the Valley of Dragon's Rest. Accompanied by Naz and her children, Liya braves poison swamps, molten lava, illusions, and Soul Fire. Her unbreakable heart earns the ancient Dragon Gods' approval. A golden mark appears on her forehead—she ascends as the one true Dragon Queen.

title: The football captain insists on drinking my breast milk
description: A broke single mother, Emma, sells her breast milk to Locke, the werewolf football captain, for one million dollars. He drinks it before games to suppress his berserk wolf bloodline. As their transaction deepens, Locke protects her from her abusive ex and jealous rivals. Emma moves into his estate, where nightly feedings blur the line between deal and desire. Locke tears up the contract, giving her freedom—but she chooses to stay. They become a family, bound not by money, but by love.

title: The Crown of the Abyss: The Mute Bride of Atlantis
description: Lilith, daughter of a siren, sacrificed her voice at thirteen to save her three pirate foster brothers from the sea monster Kraken, becoming mute. After five years of waiting, she is betrayed and humiliated by the brothers—now obsessed with the ship's prostitute Lucy—on her coming-of-age day. Broken-hearted, she tosses her bridal garland to Kai, the Crown Prince of Atlantis disguised as a poor sailor, and seals a blood contract with him. When she cries "I regret it," her vow breaks and her siren voice returns. Kai marries her with all his devotion, abolishes the death contract, and rewrites maritime law. During Kraken's rampage, Lilith sounds the sacred horn and sings the Siren Song to calm the deep—then ascends the throne of the sea with Kai, while her three remorseful brothers are condemned to keep the lighthouse lamp for life.

title: The Alpha King Sold Me to the War God
description: Sold at auction and cast aside by the Alpha who bought her, Omega Elena is handed off to his vanished uncle—the Lycan King and War God, Finn—only to discover that her five children were his all along, and that the man she thought had betrayed her has loved and protected her from the very start.

title: The Father's Sin
description:
My husband left our five-year-old twins to die, all because they dared upset his precious first love.

The men from the "behavior correction camp" burst into our home and dragged our sobbing girls away. 

Their tiny hands clung to the car door, crying and screaming for their daddy.

Kathleen and I found them the next day. My girls, lifeless and bruised. Their breaths stilled forever.

Meanwhile, my husband was on Instagram, celebrating the pregnancy of his beloved.

title: The Ice Man
description:
After being forced to stay on campus during winter break, Eric Tully and his fellow college classmates find themselves trapped by one of the worst blizzards in recorded history. With the campus completely cut off from the outside world, the students soon realize they are not alone.

A mysterious stranger wearing a mask made entirely of ice has begun stalking the frozen campus, picking them off one by one. As the body count rises, Eric and the remaining students desperately search for a way to survive the night while trying to uncover the identity of the masked killer known only as The Ice Man.

But when the survivors begin uncovering clues connecting the murders to a dark secret some of them have been hiding, it becomes clear that the killings may not be random. The Ice Man knows what they did, and he intends to make them pay.

With the blizzard showing no signs of stopping and escape becoming impossible, Eric and his friends must confront the truth about their shared past before The Ice Man hunts them all down. To survive, they will have to determine who among them is truly his target—and why.

title: The Girl He Lost in the Flames
description: Samantha's childhood friend Logan betrays her, giving her VIP ticket to her idol's final concert to another girl, Sierra. Samantha cuts him off, switches to NYU, and rebuilds her life. Logan keeps harassing her, while Sierra vandalizes her home and spreads lies. Samantha refuses to forgive Logan, despite his pleas. She grows close to Ethan, a fellow fan who helps her stop Logan's harassment. Logan attacks Ethan in jealousy. Samantha chooses Ethan, finally finding love and peace with her mother by her side.

title: The Luna Who Broke the Bond
description: On Evelyn’s wedding night, she finds her Alpha husband Lucian in bed with Celeste, her best friend. While he calls her a gold-digger, her phone lights up: her mother is dead. Minutes later, Evelyn miscarries his child, and Lucian walks away to a party. Branded a liar and trapped by the Moon Bond, she is forced to serve the woman who stole her life. But a Luna mark never bleeds without reason. At the elders’ banquet, Evelyn’s silver wound reveals the truth: Lucian abandoned his pregnant Luna. Now she will break the bond, bury his lies, and take the pack he thought owned her.

title: The Return of the Abyss King
description: The Abyss King, Caleb, forsakes his throne and divine power to return to the mortal realm, desperate to rescue his daughter from a deadly pact. Stripped of his strength, he must navigate treacherous conspiracies while forging unbreakable bonds with the noble heiress Victoria and other beautiful allies. Amidst hidden schemes and looming abyssal threats, how will the fallen king fight alongside his loves to reclaim his destiny?

title: The Daughter They Left in the Cold
description: When Juniper and her sister Odette were born, an astrologer predicted that Juniper’s success would one day drive Odette to her death. Their parents believe every word. For eighteen years, Juniper is punished for being smarter, working harder, and shining too brightly. On the day of the SAT, they take away her admission ticket and lock her inside a freezing industrial freezer, convinced her sacrifice will save Odette. But outside that locked door, Odette is begging for her sister to be released. As the cold closes in, Juniper realizes the prophecy was never the only thing threatening to destroy their family.

title: The Lost Son Returns as the Duke
description: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?

title: The Oath and the Orphan
description: In a time of chaos, a single mistake bound two men in hatred. Victor, a ruthless assassin, stole his enemy's daughter and raised her as "Orphan". Douglas, an honorable inspector, took Victor's son and named him "Drifter". Raised on opposite sides of a bitter feud, destiny reunites them as adults—and Drifter falls helplessly in love with Orphan, the woman he was born to hunt. But as the truth unravels, they must choose: will the sins of their fathers destroy their future, or can their love rewrite a legacy of vengeance?

title: The Silver Serpent's Bride
description: Raised on her Grandma's one unbreakable rule, stay away from serpents, she never expects to save a heavily wounded man in the forest. Little does she know, the man she's saved is the feared Silver Serpent King, Silvan. He's made up his mind and has marked her as his. On Bella's wedding day, he crashes the ceremony and declares her his in front of everyone. Desperate to escape this possessive monster, Bella decides to run away with her childhood sweetheart. But to her shock, the man she trusts most betrays her and offers her up as a sacrifice. Betrayed, hunted, and on the edge of death, the man she once feared most becomes the only one left protecting her.

title: The Return of the Wraith King
description: Caleb is the discarded son of a declining house—weak, overlooked, and written off by all. But when his sister Elara faces death, he reveals a terrifying truth: he is the reincarnation of the Wraith King, the most powerful being in the Caelian Empire. As the traitorous Graves family and the ancient Fiendkin rise to shatter the centuries-old seal, Caleb must unite the rival Wraithmaster clans, command legendary spirits like the Twin Reapers, and ascend to the legendary Abyssal Sovereign realm...

title: The Rebel and the Scholar
description: Maya Hayes is a straight-A student with one goal: study hard, escape her violent father, and never look back. But when she stumbles into a tattoo parlor — fleeing a beating — she comes face-to-face with Oakridge High's resident rebel, Jude Sinclair. Soon, the well-behaved scholar and the rich kid with a broken past are thrown together as desk mates. Late nights turn into shared secrets. Insults give way to understanding. Bit by bit, they begin to see through each other's armor — and find something real underneath. Together, they make a pact: break free, fight back, and burn down everything that tries to keep them down.

title: Offered to the triplet Alpha
description: Xanthea Plath, an illegitimate child of the Alpha of Virgo pack, was an omega and omegas weren't allowed to dream, yet she never stopped dreaming. She wanted to be a doctor just like her mother but the luna of the pack, her stepmother would break her physically and mentally and stop at nothing to crush all her dreams. Xanthea had still found a way though all the abuse her steps put her through. But one day her world came crashing down right before her entrance in a medical college when she found out that she was being offered as a bride to the ruthless triplet alphas also known as the demon lords of the Infernal pack of the underworld. Xanthea had heard the horrifying stories of several suitors who had come before her, all of whom had met a gruesome end.

title: The Rebel and the Scholar
description: Maya Hayes is a straight-A student with one goal: study hard, escape her violent father, and never look back. But when she stumbles into a tattoo parlor — fleeing a beating — she comes face-to-face with Oakridge High's resident rebel, Jude Sinclair. Soon, the well-behaved scholar and the rich kid with a broken past are thrown together as desk mates. Late nights turn into shared secrets. Insults give way to understanding. Bit by bit, they begin to see through each other's armor — and find something real underneath. Together, they make a pact: break free, fight back, and burn down everything that tries to keep them down.

title: The Return of the Wraith King
description: Caleb is the discarded son of a declining house—weak, overlooked, and written off by all. But when his sister Elara faces death, he reveals a terrifying truth: he is the reincarnation of the Wraith King, the most powerful being in the Caelian Empire. As the traitorous Graves family and the ancient Fiendkin rise to shatter the centuries-old seal, Caleb must unite the rival Wraithmaster clans, command legendary spirits like the Twin Reapers, and ascend to the legendary Abyssal Sovereign realm...

title: The Lady and the General
description: Reborn as her Grandmother by a sickbed, she escapes an arranged marriage and falls for General Hayes. Using her modern wits, she helps him conquer all odds to live happily ever after.

title: The Wrong Room, The Right Love
description: He married the wrong bride—but found the right love. After a wedding-night mix-up tears her engagement apart, Alexander Hawthorne chases Amelia Stirling across the country. When pregnancy, an old flame, and jealous rivals strike, he never leaves her side.

title: The Bride Meant for the Real War God
description: Victor Blackwood is Valoria's God of War — a legend who bleeds for a kingdom that doesn't even know his name. Taking advantage of that, his younger brother steals every ounce of his glory. Now the emperor issues a decree: the kingdom's most beloved princess, Aurora — Victor's childhood love — shall marry the false hero. His brother. But Aurora knows the truth. Every beat of her heart has always belonged to the real God of War...

title: The Old Chef They Fired
description: After a decade of loyalty, Chef Thomas Dawson is humiliated and fired by his greedy boss and a slick "tech-first" manager. Cast aside like garbage, Dawson sets up a humble roadside stall in the alley across from his former restaurant. Armed with nothing but his decades-old master broth and unwavering integrity, he does what he does best — cooking with his heart. Word spreads. The line grows. Soon, his simple stall becomes a destination — a place where real flavor speaks for itself. Meanwhile, his former employer ends up losing it all...

title: The Curse of the Midas Touch
description: In her past life, the female lead saved a homeless man — actually the Wine God in disguise. He gave her a goblet. Drinking from it gave her the Midas Touch, but each use cost her life force. Used as a pawn by a powerhungry prince, she was exploited and ultimately killed by her jealous sister. With her last breath, she turned her sister's family to gold — and died. After her death, the Wine God revealed she was his daughter. He reversed time and gave her a second chance. This time, her sister stole the goblet first, gaining the Midas Touch herself. The prince still chased power, and the curse remained: the sister's body decayed, greed consumed the family and the court, and all were destroyed by their own desires. The female lead watched from the shadows — and let them destroy themselves.

title: The Sterile Heir and the Beast
description: Over a century ago, Celeste Monroe sealed her memories in Empyrean Estate, guarded by her servant Joan Karlin and pet dog Alex. Time passed, and the Karlin family became the wealthiest in the south. Yet its current head, Liam, is sterile. Now, Celeste returns to retrieve her memories, only to learn Joan has passed away. Alex, revered by the Karlin family as a divine beast, is dying.

title: The Return of the Supreme One
description:
At the academy’s grand Midwinter Banquet, Arthur is publicly stripped of his title, humiliated by the wife he spent five years protecting, and replaced by her returning first love.​
To everyone else, he is nothing more than a useless man living off Silverleaf Academy. No one knows the truth—that Arthur once sealed away his godlike power to save the continent, and the academy itself has only survived because of him.​
So when his wife throws him out with nothing left to lose, Arthur finally ends the contract that bound him to humanity.​
And the moment he walks away, the entire kingdom begins to collapse.
And the moment he walks away, the entire kingdom begins to collapse.

title: The Fury and the Warden
description: After three years of wrongful imprisonment, Claire Hayes emerges from the Eternal Penitentiary as the Fury of the Midnight Ward. On the day of her release, she pins the cold, untouchable Warden — Vincent Vance — against a water cell wall and kisses him. Not out of love, but survival. He holds the key to her future. Together, the Fury and the Warden will burn every enemy who ever wronged her. And along the way, the cold man who never bends... discovers that for her, he will break all his own rules.

title: The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good
description: Pampered real alpha princess Evie is framed and sent to the ruthless Werewolf Military Academy by her own family. They believe she is living comfortably, completely unaware that under the fake alpha princess's orders, Evie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she returns, broken inside, yet her family still views her as a spoiled brat. It is only when her father strikes her and her prosthetic limb falls off that they finally realize the horrifying truth...

title: The Stand In
description:
Emma was abandoned by her biological parents. To save her adoptive mother, she spent two years as the substitute lover of Chris, a ruthless CEO. She groveled in the dust, while her twin sister Mia basked in all the glory — a renowned designer, the eldest daughter of the Foster family, and engaged to a ridiculously wealthy fiancé who worshipped the ground she walked on.

Emma thought she would forever remain Mia's shadow — until Mia "accidentally" died. She believed her miserable fate would finally come to an end. But to her shock, the man she had loved for years kicked her aside without hesitation for a "resurrected" Mia.

The moment her heart died, she turned around and joined a rival company. At the design competition, she made a stunning finale appearance wearing a custom haute couture gown of her own creation — forcing everyone who had ever trampled on her to kneel and watch her coronation.

title: Accidentally His: The Dragon King Won't Let Go
description: On a Blood Moon night, a drunken human girl steps into a cabin where the Dragon King lies in heat. After a steamy night with him, her belly suddenly swells, terrifying her into fleeing and leaving the loyal Dragon King to believe she has abandoned him. Days later, fate brings them together again, only for him to discover that she remembers nothing about him! But wait... is she secretly raising a child with horns all by herself?

title: Abandoned by the Duke, I'm the Divine Seraph
description:
After defeating Pope Pari in a contest of strength, Percy wins his approval—but declines the papacy to search for his origins. Guided by the Pope, he arrives in Crow Territory, rescues his sister, and reaches the Cohen family, only to find them under siege by the Ross family.

His mother reveals the truth of his birth and urges him to flee. Moved, Percy defeats the invaders Brienne and Fiona, and encounters Mia of the Outflow Church, who has been searching for him.

Brienne and Fiona are rescued and transformed by the fallen mage Cru. Fiona evolves into an evil dragon. Percy is defeated and nearly killed. Mia saves him at the cost of her own life. Percy awakens the Sun God's blessing, heals Mia, transforms into a seraph, and slays Fiona.

Cru flees. Percy returns Mia to the Church, refuses the papacy again, and chooses to hunt down Cru.

title: The Father's Sin
description: My husband sent our five-year-old twins to hell, all because they dared to upset his precious first love. The men from the "behavior correction camp" burst into our home and dragged our sobbing girls away. Their tiny hands clung to the car door, crying and screaming for their daddy. Kathleen and I found them the next day. My girls, lifeless and bruised. Their breaths stilled forever. Meanwhile, my husband was on Instagram, celebrating the pregnancy of his beloved.

title: The CEO
description:
Lucas, once a poor boy raised by his single mother, endured harsh treatment from his wealthy classmates because of his humble background while they were in school. Despite the odds, he grows up determined and becomes a successful CEO of his own thriving company. Ironically, some of his former classmates who once bullied him now work for his company, unaware of his identity because he keeps his life private. Lucas is about to make his first official appearance at the company headquarters, which has everyone excited.
On the day of Lucas's arrival, Anna, the only classmate who was ever kind to him, comes to apply for a job at the company. She has no idea Lucas is the CEO, and she doesn’t recognize him as the boy she once helped. However, her job application process turns ugly when the same group of people who bullied Lucas in the past, now his employees, humiliate her. Witnessing this cruelty, Lucas steps in. He decides to hire her directly as his personal assistant, and starts spending time with her, hoping to reveal his true identity gradually.
As their connection grows, jealousy brews among other female employees who are drawn to Lucas’s charm and power, including the daughter of Lucas's influential mentor, Daphne, who is set on becoming part of his life. Amid the rivalry and challenges, Lucas and Anna rediscover each other and begin a budding romance that surprises everyone, reminding Lucas of the simple kindness he cherished in his past.

title: The Return of the Racing God
description: Kyle, once hailed as the "God of Street Racing," was devastated by a racing accident six years ago that left his best friend Hans comatose, and he sank into despair, becoming a delivery driver.When Cole from Team Beta had their team's track seized by Bob and others from Team Alpha, he turned to Kyle for help. Driving a dilapidated pickup truck, Kyle repeatedly overtook Alpha's top racers with his incredible driving skills, triggering a series of racing conflicts. To compete for control of the track, Beta and Alpha agreed to a three-track showdown. Rookie Danson suffered a disastrous defeat and fell into the sea due to his arrogance. Determined to save the team, Kyle resolved to put on his racing suit again. As the competition progressed, Kyle discovered that the accident six years ago was not an accident, but a carefully plotted conspiracy by Antonio, the boss of GT Group, to seize power. After Hans woke up, Kyle teamed up with Cole, Danson, and Hans to form the "Flame" team. Driving old modified cars, they engaged in a final showdown with Team Alpha on dangerous tracks such as Universal Studios. Their goal was not only to win the race, but also to expose Antonio's true colors,achieving self-redemption and justice.

title: The Last Ace
description: twenty‑year‑ago, top gambler Alexander was framed by Calvin, losing everything and turned into a puppet. His daughter Ivy, abandoned back then, grows up with extraordinary gambling gifts. She heads to Las Vegas, gambles at the enemy’s casino, reunites with her birth mother and half‑brother. After deadly showdowns including a face‑off against her controlled father, Ivy kills the villain, settles old scores and rises as the new gambling god.

title: The Lost Heir
description: Arthur, eldest son of the Lancaster family, lost his memory as a child while trying to save his younger brother. He was taken in by a farmer and renamed Johnny. He dedicated everything to supporting his foster sister, Chloe, through school — even taking a brutal beating from thugs to protect her. But driven by her desire to climb into high society, Chloe repeatedly framed Johnny. But when Johnny unexpectedly regained his mental clarity, he uncovered every scheme one by one, and finally reclaimed the life that was always meant to be his.

title: The Dagger in the Palace
description: Years ago, a favored imperial concubine, protected by the emperor’s love, committed heinous acts and falsely accused a loyal family of treason, leading to their extermination. The sole survivor, the loyalist’s daughter, later enters the palace as the general’s daughter to compete for the queen's position. She carefully orchestrates her encounters with the emperor, gaining his affection and eventually securing her place as his concubine. When she finally avenges her family and plunges a dagger into her enemy’s heart, the concubine reveals there was someone else pulling the strings all along.

title: The Real Heiress in the Shadows
description: Damien admired Renee. Used as a stand-in by Damien for three years, Sylvia didn't know she was Renee's long-lost sister. Renee got Sylvia back and started fighting for her, guiding Sylvia to success and true love.

title: The Father's Sin
description:
My husband left our five-year-old twins to die, all because they dared upset his precious first love.

The men from the "behavior correction camp" burst into our home and dragged our sobbing girls away. 

Their tiny hands clung to the car door, crying and screaming for their daddy.

Kathleen and I found them the next day. My girls, lifeless and bruised. Their breaths stilled forever.

Meanwhile, my husband was on Instagram, celebrating the pregnancy of his beloved.

title: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Sextuplets
description: Bullied university student Elena saves her mysterious professor, Lucien, from a deadly poison. Their fateful encounter leaves Elena pregnant with sextuplets—six baby dragons! Just as her abusive family and cruel classmates attempt to burn her alive for carrying "monsters," Lucien descends as a Black-and-Gold Dragon King to claim her as his Queen. However, Elena's rare ability to bear dragon heirs makes her the ultimate prize for the wicked Frost Dragon, Kael. Caught in a deadly war, can Elena awaken her true power and protect her family?

title: The Beast I Bought Broke the Rules
description: Buying an illegal spirit beast for the Grand Exam unlocks a primal reversion system? Watch Lucas Thorne crush elites, battle the Cult of the Primordial Beast, uncover his past, and become a top Beastmaster!

title: The Princess, the Abyss, and the Beasts Who Love Her
description: Once a princess of the Azure Empire, Aurelia is betrayed by her sister Seraphina, thrown into the Fallen Abyss, and left for dead. But instead of perishing, she awakens a primal bloodline and discovers a rare gift for taming even the most ferocious beasts. From a proud cat demon to a fragile rabbit spirit and a dangerously beautiful fox—all fall under her command. And then there's Darius, the cold and merciless Infernal Sovereign, whose dark connection to Aurelia runs deeper than anyone imagines...

title: The Heir Game
description: Twenty years ago, Victoria Stone murdered her fiancé Charles in a candlelit bedroom, stole the golden heir ring, and seized control of the Stone empire as his ruthless "widow." For two decades, she has ruled with beauty, cunning, and a razor-sharp PR machine, treating her three daughters as pawns and turning every scandal into ratings gold for the family's reality TV show.

title: The Green Lie and the Red Truth
description: Lily, a ten-year-old girl, has been labeled a liar since birth by her mother, who relies on a so-called lie-detection bracelet. Whenever Lily speaks the truth—whether she’s hungry, hurt, or innocent—the bracelet flashes red and shocks her brutally. Meanwhile, her twin sister Ruby wears a fake bracelet that glows green nonstop, even as she frames Lily for theft and destruction. Blinded by pseudoscience and favoritism, Mom locks Lily away, ignores her agony, and showers love on Ruby. On New Year’s Eve, Lily suffers a ruptured appendix, begging for help as the bracelet blares red; Mom calls it a tantrum, locks her alone, and goes to watch fireworks. Lily dies in agony, writing her last truth in a diary before her body goes cold. Three days later, Mom discovers the corpse, the diary, and the bracelet’s cruel secret: it only detects fear and pain, not lies. Ruby’s “honest” green bracelet is just a worthless toy. Wearing the bloodstained bracelet herself, Mom is shocked repeatedly as red lights expose her own lies. Consumed by guilt, she goes mad, tortures herself, and later attacks the scheming Ruby, who is hit by a truck and crippled. Dad loses everything and dies in despair. In the end, Mom passes away clutching Lily’s diary, while Lily’s spirit breaks free from the bracelet’s nightmare, floating to eternal peace—no more pain, no more lies, only freedom.

title: The Mafia's Stolen Bride
description: Sabrina wakes from a crash to find her husband cheating with her best friend. To steal her $5 billion trust, he "gives" her to his Mafia uncle, Silas. She fakes amnesia and uses Silas's power to destroy them both—exposing fake pregnancy, stealing deals, sending her husband to prison. When she tries to leave, Silas corners her: "You took ten years to reach me. Now you want to run?" He waited in the shadows for a decade—and finally turns her from a bargaining chip into his bride.

title: The Heirless Alpha's Miracle Omega
description: Ethan, the cursed Alpha of Silver Moon, needs a Luna who can survive bearing his heir. Hope, a poor outland Omega, enters the mate selection to save her pack — and accidentally awakens ancient wolf power. Forced into a bond, Ethan rejects her at first. But when Hope risks her life for him, hate turns into obsession. Now they must break the Luna curse before their mate bond kills her.

title: The Rise of the Beast Monarch
description: Abandoned by his fiancée and exiled by his sect, Adrian Vale awakens the Abyssal Serpent, a spirit beast mocked by all as worthless. Bound by blood, they evolve and rise, becoming a terror the world has never seen. In the final battle, Adrian merges with the serpent, ascending as the Dragon Emperor to shatter the old order and forge a world where all beings stand as equals.

title: The Ugly Girl Turned Pretty
description: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops begging to be chosen, she starts glowing up and catches everyone’s eye, including the boy who destroyed her. But Tessa has already chosen Adrian, the masked outcast everyone calls scarred and pathetic. By the time Chase wants her back, Adrian’s secret is out: he was never weak. He was the richest, most dangerous boy in the room.

title: Imposter War God: The Return of the Dragon General
description: An ordinary office worker is approached by a beautiful warrior, who asks him to impersonate a fallen commander because they look identical. As he steps into this dangerous role, he must navigate those who want to expose him and those who wish to exploit his newfound identity. He soon realizes that pretending to be the commander comes with immense risks and costs.

title: Rejecting My Five Female Mates
description: Orphaned Caine spent ten years protecting his foster father Alpha's five daughters, believing they were his destined mates. However, the arrival of Seth, a manipulative rogue wolf, shatters his world. Blinded by Seth's deceit, the five sisters turn against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and stripping away his honor and sacred armor to appease the rogue. Pushed to the brink of despair by the family he once loved, Caine faces a turning point at his Ascension Ceremony. Will the powerful warrior continue to endure their cruel betrayal, or will he sever their fated bonds to claim a greater destiny?

title: My Boss Is My Secret Online Dom
description:
Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe.
But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her.
By day, they clash at the hospital.
By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.”
Enemies in real life. Addicted online.

title: My Nude Chat Partner Is My Boss
description: To pay her mother's medical bills, Luna becomes a masked nude cam host and falls for Mr. Grayson, the private patron who saves her. After graduation, she becomes CEO Will Grayson's assistant, unaware that her strict boss and her online lover are the same man.

title: My Alpha, My Forbidden Fate
description: Rejected by her partner, Selena feel hopeless and discouraged, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for her!

title: My Fiancé Got My Sister Pregnant, But My Sister Is a Dog
description: At her wedding, Chloe’s fiancé Carter publicly dumps her, claiming he loves her sister Leona and that Leona is pregnant with his child. There’s just one problem: Leona is Chloe’s golden retriever. A fake sister, a fake father, forged DNA tests, AI voice recordings, and a staged pregnancy all crash into one ridiculous lie. But Chloe is no helpless bride. She is the only daughter of the city’s most feared underworld king. When the real Leona is beaten and the real father arrives, the wedding turns into a trial, and everyone who tried to steal Chloe’s life learns what it means to anger the wrong family.

title: My Tyrant Dad Can Hear My Thoughts
description: After entering a novel, five-year-old Joanna becomes a doomed princess destined to die under her tyrant father, Emperor Evan. The twist? He can hear her inner thoughts. At first, he ignores her warnings, but as her predictions come true, he starts following her "advice," promoting her mother, naming her heir, and changing the empire. Together, without realizing it, father and daughter rewrite fate, turning a doomed kingdom into a thriving empire.

title: My Fiancé, My Bodyguard
description: Finn, a battle-hardened soldier, wants peace but is forced back into action after a routine security check exposes his secret identity. Engaged to Josephine, the Sinclair family's daughter, he quickly realizes she's surrounded by danger. Using his skills to protect her, Finn is soon entangled in a larger conspiracy. With quick thinking and relentless determination, he overcomes each threat, turning the tables and emerging victorious.

title: My Ex Is an Alpha, My Future Is a King
description:
Once the Moon Goddess, Roxy sealed her power and gave up her throne to marry Alpha Ethan. She saved his pack but suffered a permanent wound—only to have her sacrifice claimed by Valerie. For seven years, Ethan turned a blind eye. Their son Leo saw Valerie as his real mother, while Roxy and her daughter Aurora were neglected and humiliated.

Finally losing hope, Roxy broke the mate bond and left. She reunited with Asher, the Ancient Wolf King who had waited seven years for her return—and discovered her throne was still untouched.

When the Centennial Trials began, Roxy returned to the arena. No longer the "wolfless weakling," she awakened her divine power, reclaimed her crown, and took back every honor that was always hers.

title: My Boss, My Wolfish Lover
description: Emily Smith only wanted to survive another brutal week under Alexander Blackwood, the ruthless CEO of Obsidian and the most powerful Alpha in North America. But when her cat sends a wildly suggestive GIF from her phone, Alexander takes it as the signal he has been waiting for. Their office tension explodes during a business trip to Alaska, where Emily’s Omega instincts are triggered and Alexander protects her from a hostile wolf pack. Terrified of becoming his possession, Emily flees back to her family farm in Ohio, leaving him only $5.50 as “payment.” Furious, obsessed, and half-feral, Alexander tracks her across three states, wins over her family, crushes every rival, and drags their bond back into the heart of Manhattan. In the end, Emily may still dream of being an independent Wall Street woman, but the hungry wolf she works for has already chosen her as his mate.

title: My Husband, My Hunter
description: Transmigrated into a noble lady, Evelyn Shaw—once a special forces queen—now leads a double life. By day, she's the frail fiancée of Prince Adrian Lancaster. By night, she's the legendary leader of the Blackwind Bandits, Evie, fighting for justice. But when Adrian grows suspicious of his "delicate" fiancée, the hunt begins.
