Can Evelyn keep her mask on, or will the prince uncover the bandit hiding in his own home?

title: My Revenge, My Phoenix
description: After failing her heavenly trial, Queenie Cole awakens in the body of a disgraced noble daughter and vows revenge. As she crushes her enemies and sheds her hidden identities one by one, she grows close to a mysterious tycoon, only to realize he's the powerful clan lord she once used and abandoned. Now, she must reclaim both her power and the man she left behind.

title: My Father, My Hero
description: After falling into the water and losing his memory, Warren Davis, a once-powerful chairman, unknowingly becomes a porter at the very hotel he founded. He endures humiliation from his employees - and even his own son, as they treat him as nothing more than lowly servant, until he remembers who he is.

title: My CEO Wife
description: Aaron Chapman, the Undefeated Overlord, emerges from five years of seclusion in the Celestial Mountains to fulfill his engagement to Faye Lewis. Keeping his true identity a secret, Aaron faces Faye's rejection due to his apparent lack of status

title: My Secret Lover Is My Brother
description: Betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister, Claire, heiress to the Grayson family, needs a baby to secure her inheritance. She asks her best friend to find a reliable sperm donor. However, her adoptive brother Ethan, who has secretly loved her for years, finds out. He returns from abroad, secretly replaces the man Olivia arranged, and becomes Claire's mysterious date...

title: My Maid Stole My Fiancé, But I Stole Back My Fate
description: In her past life, Jennifer Nolan was betrayed by her maid Bridget and fiancé Michael, whose scheme destroyed her family and left her with nothing. After a tragic fall into a frozen lake, she awakens and returns to the day of her engagement. This time, she exposes Bridget's secret and lets the two traitors choose each other. While Michael mistakes her actions for heartbreak, Jennifer, the once-famous lady of the capital, has returned to reclaim her honor and make them answer for their betrayal.

title: My Delivery Girl, My Destiny
description: Amelia Brooks, a college student delivering food to make ends meet, accidentally walks into the world of Rodney Payne — the billionaire. After a drugged night, she’s dismissed as a paid woman… until Rodney finds out she carries the Payne heir. Bullied, betrayed, and belittled, Amelia fights to survive with her baby. But when Rodney realizes the truth, he draws a line: "She's under my protection. Anyone who touches her answers to me."

title: My Reborn Fiancé Begs for My Love
description: I'm Elena, reborn the day I drowned. Last life, I dragged Nathaniel into disability and was forced to be his brother’s substitute bride. This time I swam hard to save Rosa, and Nathaniel dumped our engagement first. Yet he still accused me of copying Rosa, who’s actually copying my style. Later I found Julian also reborn—he’s loved me for years. Nathaniel chased me crazily to make up his sins. But when I’m about to marry Julian, Rosa breaks their engagement and reveals a shocking truth that crushes Nathaniel completely.

title: My Fiancé, My Bodyguard
description: Finn, a battle-hardened soldier, wants peace but is forced back into action after a routine security check exposes his secret identity. Engaged to Josephine, the Sinclair family's daughter, he quickly realizes she's surrounded by danger. Using his skills to protect her, Finn is soon entangled in a larger conspiracy. With quick thinking and relentless determination, he overcomes each threat, turning the tables and emerging victorious.

title: My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit
description: Seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.

title: My Daughter-in-Law, My Shield
description: She expected a sweet daughter-in-law, but got a tattooed woman four years older than her son. Yet when her cruel ex-husband returns, Valerie Stone fiercely protects her. Soon, an unlikely bond proves family isn't always about blood.

title: My Daughter, My Killer
description: After being murdered by the daughter he raised, the billionaire Richard Sutton learns a devastating truth: she was never his real child. Reborn in 2005, he vows to reclaim his empire, expose the ruthless Lauren Sutton, and find his true daughter Jocelyn Hayes—now a struggling intern within his own company. This time, Richard must outsmart the impostor who stole his life… before she takes everything from him again.

title: My Husband, My Killer
description: Determined to bear a child for her husband, Kyle Baker, Lauren Horton undergoes a risky heart surgery. Little does she know, Kyle is having an affair with intern Grace. During her surgery, Grace makes a critical mistake, but Kyle abandons Lauren on the operating table and leaves with Grace. But soon, he's going to regret it.

title: CLAIMED BY MY ALPHA STEPBROTHER
description: Tess is the only wolf in her pack who hasn't shifted — and if she doesn't figure it out by next week, she's out for good. Her only hope is Jaxon: her Alpha's son, her step-brother, her enemy. But the moment he's close, everything changes — her wolf stirs closer than ever, and the hatred she's clung to starts feeling like a lie. There's just one problem: pack law says a future Alpha can never take a wolfless mate.

title: My Husband, My Startup
description: Flora time-traveled into a novel world and became a vicious fake heiress, also the villainess. Flora faced her husband's bankruptcy just after getting married into the wealthy family. Everyone was waiting to see Flora dump her husband and run away. However, Flora had the novel script. She chose to accompany him to make a comeback. The cold and aloof tycoon became the richest man. Flora panicked, "Mr. Tycoon, I only want your company's shares!"

title: My Contract Wife Is My First Love
description: Eleanor Byrd was hopelessly in love with Declan Laurent, despite the fact that there was another woman in his life. Eventually, she married him, hoping he would love her back. Declan, however, harbored resentment towards Eleanor, as he could not marry his beloved Claire Byrd. Misreading Eleanor's love, Declan frequently retaliates against her, not realizing that Eleanor was, in fact, his first love.

title: My Mother-in-Law Wants My House
description: Sydney, secretly the heiress of Lawrence Group, marries Jackson Johnson and buys a house with her own money. But three months into her pregnancy, her mother-in-law, Gloria, moves in, claiming Sydney's home for her son, Jordan. What begins as a battle over family greed and entitlement turns into a war for Sydney's dignity. Justice may be delayed, but it's never denied.

title: Between My Ex and My Stepson
description: Vivian Hartley lands in the ER with a sex toy stuck inside her, and the doctor between her knees is Nathan Reed, the ex she dumped eight weeks ago. Her hotel is three weeks from liquidation, so she agrees to marry billionaire Richard Vale for the bailout. But Richard's son Cameron keeps calling her "Mother" while daring her to choose him instead. Nathan still knows every weak spot. Cameron turns every hotel test into temptation. With the relaunch closing in, Vivian must keep the Hartley alive while both men refuse to let her go.

title: T-Boning my F1 Rival
description: Ryder and Enzo, F1 rivals for fourteen years, one from the slums, one a billionaire heir. Enzo whispers "I love you" during CPR; Ryder wakes convinced it was sabotage. Handcuffs, saunas, and blindfold drills force them close as Ryder battles desire. Enzo risks his life against a violent rival and quietly pays Ryder's mother's surgery. They confess at the track where it began. In the final race, Enzo pushes Ryder to victory with his own car and crashes. In the wreckage, Ryder says "I love you."

title: My Rich Sis Got My Back
description: She endured workplace bullying and harassment until one day when her badass twin sister finally found her back.

title: My Dumb Hubby is a Multi-Billionaire
description: Everyone makes fun of her because her husband is a "knucklehead", but they have no idea it is all just a show he's been putting on!

title: I Accidentally Sexted My Enemy
description: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?

title: I Chose The Playboy Eel To Abandon My Shark Lover
description: I’m Seraphina, ocean princess. In my last life, I loved shark lord Kael, yet he held me down while his lover Lira stabbed my heart with venom crystal. Reborn on my mate-picking day, I shocked everyone by choosing Rhys, the playful dragon eel playboy. Kael seethed, ignored me when assassins poisoned me, and knelt begging me to ditch Rhys later. But Lira’s fake fragility hides deadly malice—she just pushed me into deadly undertow. Can Rhys reach me before I drown?

title: My Cyber Beau, My CEO
description: A young graduate applied for a job as a fashion designer, but the CEO thought she was a marriage candidate his mother sent him. The CEO was thus really picky and mean to her, and they didn't get along. But what he didn't know was that she was actually his online girlfriend...

title: My Wife's Boy Toy Killed My Dad
description: Eight years of grinding got Callum a home, a wife, a daughter. One livestream lover took it all. Callum's wife Vanessa tipped half a million to her favorite streamer, and then helped him run down Callum's father in a hit-and-run. She framed Callum for domestic abuse, stolen his identity to take out loans, and watched the internet crucify him. Now Callum has a new name, a new fortune, and one mission—to throw his cheating wife and her secret lover into jail.

title: Trapped in My Enemy's Embrace
description: Mavis Addams's only wish is to marry her parents' enemy. Life as their daughter has been tough, filled with her family's relentless humiliation and torture, but to her surprise, she finds herself enjoying the role of the enemy's wife. In the meantime, her heart starts to melt for the one guy she shouldn't. Will her plan work out, or is she better off on her own?

title: My fated Alpha: Rejected and Reclaimed
description: Sophia suffered domestic abuse at the hands of her father, Antony, since a very young age. As an adult, Sophia encountered a paranoid and abusive partner, Gordon, who eventually pushed her off a cliff. Miraculously, Sophia survived and was rescued by Alpha Bernard, who had recently lost his partner. After being rescued, Sophia decided to move forward despite the doubts and pushbacks. Antony and Gordern, in an attempt to cover up their crimes, had since been planning to take Sophie out. Fate intertwined, Sophia and Bernard became partners. With Bernard's love and encouragement, Sophia not only overcame her inner fears, but also discovered her powerful abilities as the white wolf. With Bernard's assistance, she defeated Antony and Gordern, and ultimately became the queen.

title: The Alpha's Broken Mate
description: My entire family forced me to take the blame for my adopted sister, and my Alpha told me, "Seven years will pass in no time". While I was in prison for her, losing the child in my womb, my Alpha mate was holding her in his arms and saying, "I love you". After I was released, I severed our soul bond with my own hands and left for the war zone. Later, filled with regret, he clutched my boots and cried, "My Luna". I touched my heavily pregnant belly and said, "Sorry, but I'm already carrying your older brother's child".

title: Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival
description: My fiancé traded me away. Now I'm the CEO's wife — cry about it.

title: Call Me By His Name
description:
At his mate’s inheritance ceremony, his husband and his twin switch
bodies. The ruthless Alpha he feared is gone—replaced by a man with the
same face, but a soul that loves him far too gently. Caught between two
brothers and one chaotic bond, the real question is no longer who gets
the body back—but who truly owns his heart.

title: The Cat Spills.The Whole Mansion Spoils Me
description: Lana possesses a special gift—she can understand the inner thoughts of cats. To avoid being treated as an outcast, she has always kept this ability hidden. To save up for her study-abroad expenses, she takes a job as a live-in nanny for the wealthy Frank family on the West Coast. On her very first day, she discovers that the family patriarch's Ragdoll cat,Noble, has been diagnosed with terminal kidney failure and is scheduled for euthanasia. Hearing the cat's inner voice, Lana learns that Noble has been refusing food because someone has been feeding it poisoned cat food. She risks everything to expose the truth.The mastermind behind the scheme is Sylvia, a candidate for an arranged marriage with Frank. After being exposed, Sylvia escapes but continues to target Lana at every turn. Relying on an intelligence network of cats from across the city, Lana overcomes one crisis after another. She rises from a humble nanny to a highly sought-after figure in high society, and the aloof billionaire Frank finds himself deeply in love with her.However, their class differences meet fierce opposition from Frank's aunt, Vivian. A wave of pressure and even kidnapping forces Lana to leave quietly. Frank, unwilling to lose her, willingly gives up his inheritance to win her back. Together, the two join forces to dismantle a dark pet-industry trafficking ring. Sylvia attempts to expose Lana's supernatural gift in a final scheme, but the cats gather evidence to foil her plan once more.In the end, the family finally accepts their relationship. With Noble serving as the ring bearer, Frank proposes to Lana, and the two are united in a wedding that bridges the gap between classes—a truly happy ending.

title: The Barren Alpha Knocked Me Up with Twins
description: Kaelen, the strongest Alpha of his werewolf clan, struggles with fertility. His grandfather arranges a marriage with the Chris family to secure an heir. Chris, mistreated at home, flees and works at a bar, where she is drugged and has a one-night stand with Kaelen, resulting in pregnancy. Kaelen's assistant discovers the pregnancy and informs him. When Chris returns home to borrow money from her stepmother, she is mocked, but Kaelen arrives to rescue her, takes her to the hospital, and insists she keep the baby, promising to protect her.Kaelen punishes the bullies' families. Chris gives birth, and the family lives happily ever after.

title: Loved Me Most, Betrayed Me Worst
description: Princess Venessa lived a sheltered life—until her sister was murdered. Stripped of her innocence in a single night, she must confront a devastating betrayal: her husband and best friend just helped the killer escape justice. The pampered princess is gone. Now she's coming for every last one of them, to take back the justice they owe her sister.

title: Don't Call Me Aunt
description: A notorious heir returns to seize his family empire — only to find his first love married to his uncle.

title: The Alpha Rejected Me, But the Dragon King Claimed Me
description: On her wedding day, Selene was framed, rejected by the Alpha King, stripped of her crest, and exiled by her own mother. Everyone believed the cursed silver-eyed girl had disappeared forever. Fifteen years later, she returns as the Empress of the Sacred Dominion, ruling the continent’s richest crystal mines from a dragonbone throne. But when her adopted son brings home the daughter of the woman who stole her life, Selene refuses to forgive. Old enemies gather, buried lies surface, and one by one, those who betrayed her discover that the girl they destroyed has become the queen they must fear.

title: The Cold CEO Who Spoiled Me Online
description: I lied about my age and ghosted my clingy online boyfriend half a year ago. Staying at my best friend’s house for break, I froze—her cold, CEO older brother Rhys was exactly the man I dumped online. He recognized me just by my voice and kept testing me nonstop. Later at a bar, he chugged eight drinks to shield me from a creep guy who drugged me. Trapped in his car, he recited every fake detail I told him online, staring at me: “Did you ever regret leaving me?”

title: You Never Saw Me
description: On the night before her eighteenth birthday, Mara Scott is searched in public, stripped of her ID, and locked inside an abandoned gym by the boy she once loved. They think they’re silencing her—but Mara has already lived this night once before. In her previous life, she tried to stop them from attending a party, only to be framed for a horrific crime, murdered, and forced to watch her parents die in a fire. Reborn with a second chance, Mara says nothing. Instead, she secretly records everything and lets the night unfold. This time, when the sun rises, the truth will be impossible to bury—and everyone who betrayed her will face the consequences.

title: Beg Me to Stay
description: For five years, Seraphina Sangreal has kept Grand Duke Alistair Ravenscroft alive with her own blood—and his realm standing—while remaining his secret mistress. When a political marriage shatters her last hope, she walks away with a secret. As betrayal and buried royal blood come to light, Alistair realizes too late that he may have lost far more than the woman who loved him so deeply.

title: Hold Me in the Dark
description: The new intern, Isla, never imagined that the cold and demanding CEO Christian — who shoved her relentlessly on the tennis court during the day — was the same person who broadened her view to unknown territories at night in an exclusive BDSM club. But when the mask comes off and secretive identities assimilate into reality, is this a game she can stay afloat… or submerge deep within the shadows of desire seeking unexpected redemption?  Produced by：Vantage Entertainment

title: Forgive Me, Forget Me Not
description: Lottie is forced to give up on the man she loves in order to save his life. Year later, she runs into him again and he's a bigshot lawyer with billions at his disposal. But not only that, he has a cold hard vendetta against her... for stabbing him.

title: Love Me Two Times
description: Emma and Liam shared a magical night together that ended abruptly when Liam left the next morning without a explanation. Six months later, they get reunited at Emma's sister's wedding where Liam is the best man. As their unsolved feelings come rushing back, Emma decides to fake date Liam for the weekend to get her ex to leave her alone.

title: So What? Your Dad Loves me
description: On the night of Iris's twentieth birthday, Luke drugged her and cheated on her. With the door signs mixed up, Iris mistakenly ended up having sex with the mafia boss Ethan. Upon their reunion, Iris is shocked to discover that Ethan is actually Luke's father. Luke, who had been cheating on her with his cousin Mia, teams up with her to bully and frame Iris, pushing her to the brink. Ethan falls for Iris at first sight and fiercely shields her, standing up against Luke and his grandfather Andy's mafia forces to avenge her and heal her wounds. Luke's true parentage is exposed, and he defects to his biological father Victor, repeatedly attempting to harm the two of them. In the end, Ethan clears away every obstacle and, with Iris, who has endured so much, they finally come together.

title: The Frat King Who Made me Shine
description: Can an invisible, unknown college freshman rise from the overlooked edge of the cheerleading squad to become the brightest star on campus? And can her first love with the most popular fraternity president at school survive jealousy, bullying, betrayal, and the brutal social hierarchy of college life?

title: My Wolf Rejected Me, So I Chose the Scarred Fox
description: After thirteen years of loving the wolf she rescued from the black market, Emma overhears Brian admit he has always wished he belonged to her beautiful cousin. Crushed by a lifetime of being mocked for her looks and never chosen by anyone, Emma dissolves their bond, leaves him her home, and starts over as a university lecturer in Miami. There, she meets Finn, a scarred fox Beastkin abandoned after escaping a trafficking ring. As Emma gives Finn the kindness she once begged for, he gives her something Brian never could: fierce devotion and the courage to see her own worth. When Brian returns begging for another chance, Emma must choose between the love that wounded her and the one that finally feels like home.

title: Divorce Me One Last Time
description: Hallie Bildner, a successful NYC CEO engaged to a billionaire politician, is shocked to learn that her high school sweetheart never signed their divorce papers. Determined to settle the past, she returns to her hometown, only to find her ex hiding two big secrets: the true reason he broke her heart and that his 7-year-old daughter is actually hers. As old feelings reignite, Hallie faces a choice between the life she built and the one she left behind.

title: THE DON LET ME BURN
description:
"No one helps her. Let her burn."
My husband said those words while I was trapped inside a burning car—with a steel bar through my chest. Then my phone somehow connected to him... four years in the past. The boy who once begged me to marry him watched me die while the man he became refused to save me. He thinks I'm lying. He doesn't know I'm carrying his baby... or that this is the last time he'll ever hear my voice.

title: My Husband Gifted Me His Rival
description: For three years, Elena endured a marriage where every affair ended the same way—her husband handed her another man as compensation. When his pregnant mistress demanded a wedding, he expected another fake divorce and another obedient return. Instead, Elena accepted the young man he chose, signed the papers, and walked away for good. By the time Damian uncovered the truth behind the betrayal that destroyed their marriage, she was already standing at another altar. This time, the bride never looked back.

title: Call Me By Your Heart
description:
Seven years ago, Emma was pregnant with Michael’s child, but Rebecca, who secretly loved him, discovered the truth. To protect her child and Michael’s career, Emma teamed up with an actor to deceive him and left. Rebecca then stole Emma’s child, used him to win Michael’s trust, and married him.
Seven years later, Michael, now a rising baseball star, meets Emma, who is working as a cleaner. He coerces her into becoming his assistant, and old feelings resurface. Emma suspects Michael’s son, Jerry, may be her lost child. At a signing event, Michael announces his divorce from Rebecca and confesses his love for Emma. Enraged, Rebecca accuses Emma, but Jerry is soon diagnosed with leukemia. Emma offers to be tested as a bone marrow match, and confirms Jerry is her son. The family is finally reunited.

title: The Dragon Chose Me
description: The ancient dragon fell into slumber protecting humanity. A prophecy promised a new Dragon Lord, marked by a dragon sign, would awaken it. The world forgot—only a wandering bard still searched. William, a magic-less stable hand, lost everything to Baron Charlie. Then an accident awakened a dragon egg, and his hidden power. Now he must survive trials, claim the dragon, defy nobles, and rescue the girl he loves. The lost king rises.

title: My Vampire Husband Wants to Bite Me Every Night
description: The witch Aurora, who has visions of the future, has been exploited by her father to make money since childhood. One day, she accidentally discovers the secret of an influential figure and becomes the target of a manhunt. While fleeing, she meets the Vampire Howard. To her surprise, she foresees a future in which she marries him…

title: She Framed Me, I Went Live
description: In her past life, she was framed by her so-called "best friend" — the entire school believed she was the mistress of a professor, with fake intimate photos and explicit chat records as "irrefutable evidence." She couldn't defend herself until the moment she died, when she finally learned the truth: it was all a scheme by the fake friend and the predatory professor, designed to destroy her reputation and cost her a graduate school recommendation. Reborn, she chose revenge — by streaming everything live online, exposing her former friend's true colors to the world.

title: Fate Led Me to You
description: To escape her family's plan to marry her off, Lynn Shaw seeks help from Caleb, the CEO of Langdon Group, who happens to be passing by. Moved by her plight, Caleb rescues her and enrolls her in a private school under his company. Despite facing discrimination and bullying at school and being forced by her mother to work part-time, Lynn's path crosses with Caleb's once more. As they spend more time together, their relationship blossoms into a mutual affection.

title: Love Me, Hate Me
description: Daphne thought losing him was the only way to keep him safe, so she walked away and married another man. Five years later, the man she once loved returns, but he's colder than ever, determined to make her pay the price for breaking his heart..

title: The Night He Claimed Me
description: After a tragic loss leaves Clara Blunt's parents deceased and her brother seriously ill, she struggles with financial hardship. While working part-time, she unexpectedly reconnects with Alden Damon, her secret crush of eight years. They share a night of passion, but as old family conflicts arise, Alden is forced to send Clara away. Unbeknownst to her, Alden has been deeply in love with her all along.

title: Scandalous
description: When young and fiery Edie is forced to work for and spy on her father’s ruthless rival Trent Rexroth, their hatred sparks into a forbidden desire - an age gap love that could ruin them both.

title: Love Me or I Die
description:
Lauretha Thomas, a young woman struggling to find a job after months of rejection, is left feeling hopeless and frustrated. With mounting pressure from her family’s financial crisis and the weight of her own failure, Lauretha decides to escape her problems for a while. She reluctantly agrees to join her best friend, Pamela, at an exclusive, posh nightclub—far beyond her usual standards of living. Hoping for a brief distraction, she drowns her sorrows in a bottle of wine, trying to numb the anxiety that’s been eating away at her.
But what should have been a quiet night out takes a dramatic turn when she accidentally spills wine all over the shirt of Jayden McClarke, a powerful and ruthless CEO known for his cold, calculating demeanor. His icy glare makes it clear that he’s not one to tolerate mistakes, but before Lauretha can apologize or even gather herself, he grabs her arm in a tight, controlling grip. In a moment of frustration, Lauretha reacts instinctively and slaps him across the face, stunning everyone around them into silence.
The room falls into a tense hush as Jayden, momentarily taken aback, locks eyes with her. But before things can escalate further, Pamela rushes to apologize on her friend’s behalf, trying to defuse the situation. Lauretha, humiliated and overwhelmed, pulls away from her grip and quickly exits the club with Pamela, retreating from the chaos she’s just caused.

title: They Banished Me as a Monster, Now I'm the Strongest Witcher
description:
His mother was brutally murdered, and his fiancée and brother conspired to frame him, throwing him into the deadly Mist Demon Forest to die. Igor’s name should have vanished forever.

Five years later, he returns under a new identity: Oleg, a Level 9 Demon Hunter. Behind his golden mask lies an all-seeing eye that sees through every lie, while a holy sword waits at his side.

When he finally reveals his true identity, the brother who once betrayed him is left crawling at his feet. One by one, everyone who wronged him is forced to pay the price.

They thought they had thrown away a helpless pawn. They were wrong. Now, he is back to settle every score and become the coldest judge in Bloodraven Castle.

title: Fate Won't Stop Me
description:
In a world where choices can reshape destinies, two sisters awaken to a mysterious system that demands a life-altering decision: choose between a billion dollars or their own mother. In their past lives, Hannah's younger sister, Ingrid, chose the billion and entered a life of luxury, only to face a downfall. While Hannah chose family and thrived through her own hard work. Consumed by envy, Ingrid killed her sister.

Now reborn to the day of their choices, Ingrid chooses family instead, while Hannah reluctantly takes the billion. But as Ingrid basks in her supposed victory, Hannah smiles. After all, who knows if her sister just picked hell?

title: Heal Me, Annie
description: Annie, a warm-hearted nurse from an orphanage, always faces life with optimism, lighting up the lives of everyone around her. But despite her kindness, she can't seem to reach Wade, a man hardened by his tough past in Cantana's slums. Silent and closed off, Wade believes he's destined for misery until Annie enters his life, bringing him from darkness into the light.

title: Two Mafia Bosses Begging Me For Love
description: I ran from my arranged wedding after catching my fiancé in bed with another woman. That same night, I lost my virginity to a stranger—only to discover he was my fiancé all along. When I became pregnant, he looked me in the eye and said, “Get rid of the baby.” I walked away for good... until his powerful rival offered me a new life. Now two mafia heirs are fighting for me, but only one deserves my heart. The problem? The man who broke me refuses to let me go.

title: Let Me Taste Your Husband
description: Olivia is the daughter of a wealthy family who didn’t live a good life growing up. After she graduated from college, her step mother forces her to marry the bastard son of another wealthy family so Olivia’s step sister won’t have to, because Andrew Wright, the said bastard son, does not have the best reputation. Little does Olivia know, her life is about to take a turn, because Andrew Wright isn’t just a bastard son...

title: My Husband Auctioned Me Off
description: Ava Hart once used her family fortune and connections to build Ethan Black’s empire, only to be betrayed on their wedding anniversary when he drugs her, steals her assets, and sends her to the underground Black Rose auction as revenge for humiliating his lover, Serena. Bound onstage and priced piece by piece before powerful criminals, Ava secretly activates the emergency chip hidden in her wedding ring, unlocking the Hart family’s protection clause and a $20 billion trust. When Adrian Cross, the man she once left behind, storms the island to save her, Ava refuses to simply escape. She buys out the entire auction, gathers every record, destroys Ethan’s company, dismantles the Black Rose exchange, and sends both Ethan and Serena to prison. Years later, Ava stands as a powerful investor in her own right, no longer anyone’s wife, prize, or property.

title: The Wife Isn't Me!
description: For 30 years, Sharon Tingey believed she was Caleb Poole's partner, only to discover his secret marriage to another. Viewed merely as a "maid" by the Pooles, Sharon takes her inheritance and begins anew, using her embroidery talents and a fresh bond with Franklin Russell to transform her life.

title: Don't Make Me Come Out
description: Chance lived a quiet life, keeping to the streets and caring only for his family's safety. But when danger strikes his daughter, he can no longer stay in the shadows. Once celebrated, now forgotten, he rises again, not for fame, but for love. Old friends heed the call, past glories quietly resurface, and with skill and heart, he protects those dear to him, guarding a fragile peace in a turbulent world.

title: My Merman Husband Is a Deep-Sea Tyrant
description: A crippled human girl trades her cruel, ungrateful merman for a shy "Defective" sea creature — only to discover her sweet new companion is the fearsome hidden king of deep‑sea sirens. Fierce jealousy, ocean‑shaking battles, and a fated love spanning thirteen years unfold in this dark‑sweet merman romance.

title: KPI: Love Me or Die
description: Branded a ruthless capitalist in her past life, she was locked in a frozen tower and left to die, saved only by her timid assistant. Reborn one month before the apocalypse, she liquidates fortunes, buries her betrayers in debt, and builds a mountain cold-storage fortress. When the world freezes, she thrives in luxury while enemies beg in the snow, now "laid off" by the end of the world. And her once-quiet assistant? He becomes her deadliest weapon.

title: The Alpha Forgot Me, So I Let Him Go
description:
I am Wren, an Omega.
My Alpha mate, Kade, lost his memory after falling from a cliff. He fell in love with the nurse who saved him and completely forgot me.
After being reborn, I stopped trying to awaken his memories.
I watched him burn my silver wolf hunting knife, smash the moonstone wall engraved with our names, and place the wolf-fang necklace he had once carved for me around her neck.
When she faked a fall into the water, he shoved me under.
When the kidnappers sank us into the lake and forced him to choose one of us, he chose her to live.
I sank beneath the surface, and the mate mark on the side of my neck split open.
Kade, the life-saving debt from my past life and my letting go in this one are both fully repaid.
Let’s never meet again.

title: His Daughter Chose Me
description: At sixteen, Sofia’s adoptive mother sold her eggs on the black market, stealing her chance to ever become a mother. Years later, Sofia is just a school custodian—until she saves a little girl from a kidnapping and catches the attention of her mysterious billionaire father. Desperate to protect his daughter from a vicious custody battle, he offers Sofia an unexpected deal: marry him. What starts as a fake marriage soon turns into a love neither of them can resist. But his ruthless ex-wife, buried secrets, and deadly betrayals threaten to tear their new family apart. Sofia has already lost her chance at motherhood. Will she lose the family she finally found?

title: Mafia Boss Takes High School
description: When a High Level Mafioso finds himself in the body of a bullied high schooler, he uses it as a second chance at finishing high school. But will his street smarts help him to fulfill his dream of going to college, or will a group of bullies drive him to drop out again?

title: Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell
description: Given a second chance at life, orphan sisters Ivy and Poppy return to the day of their adoption. Remembering her tragic past, Poppy maliciously chooses the impoverished Jones family, believing playing the "poor girl" is the secret to winning the wealthy Lockwood heir's heart. Forced into the toxic Lockwood household, Ivy refuses to be a victim again. While Poppy relies on deception and manipulation to steal the life she covets, Ivy focuses on true independence, standing up to her bullies, and forging her own path. Reborn, I Gifted Her My Hell is a gripping tale of resilience, self-reliance, and breaking toxic cycles.

title: Her Hidden Blade
description: In the kingdom of Aethelgard, where men bow and women rule, Princess Valerie, the ruthless Goddess of War, seeks revenge. To humiliate the enemy who once bested her on the battlefield, she takes the legendary Valdorian Warlord as her consort. But the seemingly submissive man at her side is not who he claims to be. He is Caspian Vale, the twin brother of her enemy, and a Blood Proxy forced since childhood to bear every wound, every poison, every agony meant for his sibling. Chained by a dark blood pact, Caspian hides behind his brother's name, waiting for the one thing that can set him free: the mythical Icebloom. But what begins as a game of deception slowly turns into something neither expected...

title: Her Last Laugh
description:
Eleanor Sterling is the true controller of the Sterling Family Trust. Her husband, Alexander Vance, teams up with her best friend Sophia Bennett to fake amnesia, tricking her into signing divorce papers in a bid to seize her entire fortune. Having seen through their scheme long before, Eleanor completes the legal divestment of all high‑value assets prior to the divorce, leaving Vance Group as an empty shell saddled with $1.1 billion in environmental liabilities.

On the very day after the divorce when Alexander and Sophia take over the company, the EPA issues an indefinite shutdown order together with massive fines. The pair fall from grace overnight. Alexander tries to sell off assets to pay the debts, only to find all his real‑estate holdings frozen. Sophia steals his remaining cash and flees to Harrison Sweet, a ruthless Wall Street tycoon, only to be cast aside by him. Consumed by despair, the two turn on each other. After being imprisoned, Alexander stages a jailbreak. He eventually takes Eleanor hostage on a rooftop but is subdued, and later dies from a gastric perforation. Eleanor reclaims her mother’s inheritance and founds Sterling Group. She redevelops the polluted Brooklyn site into a green creative district, closing the chapter on her revenge while achieving personal reinvention and embracing her authentic self.

title: Her Last Wish
description: The Serpent Ivy White was saved by a scholar from the Bellamy family a thousand years ago, but her skin was removed as a pledge, granting every member of the Bellamy family the right to make three wishes to her. However, when it came to William Bellamy, he did not wish for wealth and fame, but only for Ivy to be his wife. On the day Ivy gave birth to their son, he burned her alive in order to seize her Core. Yet, Ivy had been waiting for this day as well...

title: Her Father’s Secret, My Sentence
description: Ten years after her best friend Blythe dies by suicide following an assault, Tamsin Rowe is condemned by the whole town as the woman who protected the attacker. Hated, isolated, and dying, Tamsin has spent years refusing to reveal the name everyone demands. Then Imogen, once her closest friend, returns as the country’s richest woman and drags Tamsin onto a public Memory Trial. The device was made for death-row criminals, and every extracted memory will be broadcast to the world. As the trial begins, Tamsin begs Imogen to stop. Some truths, once exposed, can never be buried again.

title: He Gave Her My Luna Mark
description: On their anniversary night, Serena Vale comes to renew her mating bond, only to find a rescued Omega wrapped in her Alpha’s coat and wearing her Luna mark. Instead of apologizing, Adrian Cross freezes Serena’s Luna rights so Nora won’t be punished. In front of the pack, Serena loses her place as wife, Luna, and future queen. But she does not beg. At the Moon Court, Serena reveals the secret that breaks him: she is carrying his heir, but the child will never belong to him. If Adrian can give her place to another woman, Serena can take away his bloodline.

title: Her Turn to Fall
description: Miles devoted his life to molding Wendy into a business queen, only to be betrayed and killed. Meanwhile, Wendy believed she could have had a perfect life with the charming Jack instead. Given a second chance at life, Miles decides to dump Wendy and court someone else. But Wendy is also reborn, convinced her rise to power has nothing to do with Miles. But as life resets, she finds a different reality: Miles no longer revolves around her, and he has a new love. And Jack turns out to be a scumbag.

title: The Hobo Goddess and Her Billion-Dollar Contract
description: Everyone accuses Faye of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Adam Stone! (And win his heart too)

title: Spend on Her, Get 10,000X Back in the Apocalypse
description: After his girlfriend sells him out to a death game, James unlocks a system that turns every coin spent on female monsters into ten thousand—and with it, he conquers monstrous bosses, crushes the elite, and seizes total dominion over the end of the world.

title: The Mob Boss Demands Her Perfect Genes
description: Elite doc Christine catches mafia boss Damon's eye—her eggs are top-tier, and he wants his heir. She hates his guts: same mob that drove her mom to suicide. She rushes a wedding to escape, but Damon crashes the ceremony and snatches her. Locked in his penthouse, he comes at her hard every night; she fights back twice as hard. But slowly she sees past the ice—when someone drugs her, Damon burns it all down to save her. That twisted, obsessed devotion cracks her open. Christine drops the grudge. They end up together, damaged but locked in.

title: Her Turn to Fall
description: Miles devoted his life to molding Wendy into a business queen, only to be betrayed and killed. Meanwhile, Wendy believed she could have had a perfect life with the charming Jack instead. Given a second chance at life, Miles decides to dump Wendy and court someone else. But Wendy is also reborn, convinced her rise to power has nothing to do with Miles. But as life resets, she finds a different reality: Miles no longer revolves around her, and he has a new love. And Jack turns out to be a scumbag.

title: Her Turn to Burn
description: Charlotte helped her "best friend," Jasmine, over and over again and even died saving her. Reborn, she’s done playing the martyr. This time, she’ll stand back and watch as Jasmine and her psycho boyfriend sink into the hell they made.

title: The Heiress and Her Bodyguard
description: In the wake of her father's brutal murder, Emma becomes a target when she digs into the truth. Caught in the crosshairs, a mysterious bodyguard named Liam steps in to save her. Emma, blind but razor-sharp, senses Liam's connection to her father's death. An explosive conspiracy is unfolding, and time is running out...

title: Her Turn to Win
description: After eighteen years away, Sara returns to the powerful Graham family, only to be framed by her scheming adoptive sister and dismissed as a country bumpkin. But beneath her humble facade hides a world-class violinist, a luxury jewelry designer, and a gifted healer. When her ex-fiancé Jonathan discovers the truth, he realizes the woman he cast aside was the one he was destined to love all along.

title: I Watched Them Love Her
description: Tessa is pushed off a building by her adopted sister Chloe. She wakes up at fifteen, reliving her life. This time, she refuses to fight for her family's love. Chloe manipulates everyone, framing Tessa for cheating. Tessa calmly proves Chloe's guilt using surveillance footage. Chloe is expelled. Tessa earns straight A's and a Yale scholarship. Her family apologizes, but she remains distant. She leaves for Yale alone, determined to live for herself.

title: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees
description: Cain Hunter is a broken man after his wife betrays him and ruins him financially. Just as all hope is lost, Cain is suddenly brought to the mysterious Don Ludwig, who makes him an offer: pass his tests, and Cain will succeed him as the new Godfather of Bourne Syndicate.

title: Her Whisper in the Dark
description: In a psychiatric hospital, Raff Hess, the most dangerous patient, finally passes his 144th mental evaluation and is released. However, unbeknownst to everyone, his condition remains unchanged—his late fiancée, Freya Kim, still whispers vengeance in his ear. Four years after Freya's murder, Raff is now free and ready to set his meticulously planned revenge into motion against her four killers.

title: Hooked Her Ex’s Forbidden Brother
description: The day her relationship ended, she hit the bar looking for a rebound. Instead, she landed her ex‑boyfriend's younger cousin – the untouchable ice prince of the elite circle, and the only person her ex is terrified of. Her ex loses his mind.

title: Her Rise To Fame
description: For years her music was stolen to lift her adoptive sister to stardom. When she blows the audience away on a talent show, the A-list judge tearing her down is actually her own birth mother, who has no idea she’s favoring the wrong girl.

title: I Loved Her, I Lost Her
description: Zane asked to divorce Sherry because his first love Bella came back. But he didn't know his wife was a hidden heiress. Her real name is Lilian. After divorce, Sherry took back everything she gave to Zane. Without Sherry's secret support and help, Zane's company and business were hard to maintain. He regretted it, but his wife would never come back.

title: Her Majesty and Her Demons: Tame or Die (updating)
description: After an accidental death, office worker Rachel transmigrates into an otome game as Lilith Crane, the villainess destined to be killed by her four demon butlers. With F-ranked demon-taming power and all butlers’ Darkness Levels at peak, she must reverse her fatal fate: save the psychotic snake demon, win over the cute lop-eared rabbit, tame the ferocious hellhound, and outwit the scheming succubus. Amid noble power struggles and imperial spy conspiracies, she fights to claim her inheritance and survive!

title: Brothers in Arms
description: After their fellow veteran's apparent death, hard-bitten Nick Gallo and two other brothers-in-arms join forces in Las Vegas to protect the man’s wife and daughter from a savage local mob. Nick starts falling in love with the family, but his relationship is thrown into chaos after a shocking return.

title: The CEO and Her Daughter's Secret Father
description: Connor Reed, the world's most powerful arms dealer, saves Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while undercover. Four years later, still in hiding, Charlotte shows up... with his son. Now Connor must protect them both... without revealing his true identity.

title: He Pretended to Get Bullied Only for Her
description:
The boy I loved had been bullied at school. I took countless hits and endured endless pain to protect him. I was even preparing to transfer with him.
But one day, I suddenly heard him say, "She’s always hanging around me. It’s so annoying."
A guy replied, "If you’re sick of her, why not just tell her? Why pretend you’re being bullied? She doesn’t seem like she’d keep pestering you."
"Lily gets upset every time she sees me. She only feels safe when I hold her hand. I’m doing all this for Lily. Ivy just has to suffer a little longer. She’ll get through it."
So that was it. Everything was for the new student from a poor family. My pain meant nothing.
But he did not know I was the Winchester family’s sole heir.
I turned around and made a call. "Mom, which elite school did you mention before? I’m going alone."

title: My Sister Is the Warlord Queen
description: Abandoned by their parents, the Blackwood sisters, Catherine and Grace, grew up with only each other to rely on. As adults, both built successful lives. But at Grace’s engagement party, Catherine shows up straight from an undercover mission, still dressed as a janitor, and becomes the target of ridicule from Grace's in-laws and former classmates. When her sister is betrayed and humiliated by her fiancé, Catherine reveals her true identity as the Warlord Queen, and makes everyone regret underestimating them.

title: Heiress Crash Lands on Her Husband
description: In a marathon of trumping identities, Lily must own her cheating ex, his mistress, their moms, her new royal suitor, the women after her true love, and finally, the dominant mother-in-law! Can Lily win them all?

title: Love Found Her After She Died
description: Murdered by her family, billionaire Kay Fuller is reborn as a nobody actress, Karina. She once paid $30 million for a sham marriage to Wilbur. Devastated by her death, Wilbur discovers Karina's true identity and vows to win her back. As Karina, she destroys scumbags, takes down her enemies, and rises to stardom. Clearing up past misunderstandings, Wilbur and Kay finally confess their love.

title: Steal Her Heart on Ice
description:
U.S. figure skater Camila walks off the World Championship ice with silver — defeated by her ruthless arch-rival Sophia.
Backstage, she runs into Scarlett: her long-time secret crush, the retired legendary champion. And she stumbles straight into the scene: Sophia cheating with Scarlett's husband.
To yank the woman she loves away from the cheating scumbag, Camila gives Scarlett an ultimatum:
Be my exclusive full-time coach. Or I leak the affair proof to the whole world.
Trapped to save her public reputation, Scarlett has no choice but to agree...

title: His Partner, Her Revenge
description: Ava Russell on the eve of her arranged marriage, is drugged by her fiancé Nico Moretti and has her hair brutally shaved off by his comrade Scarlett. Refusing to swallow this humiliation, Ava secretly contacts Damian Costello, the powerful heir of the Costello family who has secretly loved her for twelve years. On the wedding day, when Nico tries to sneak Ava into his family through a shabby, hidden ceremony and Scarlett publicly strips off her wig to mock her, Damian arrives with a magnificent fleet to marry Ava in style. With the help of Damian and the Commission, Nico and Scarlett are stripped of their power and arrested for violating family laws, while Ava finally finds her true protector and happiness.

title: The Rabbit Bride Who Rejected Her Alpha King
description: I‘m Elowen, the only rabbit shifter with purifying blood, destined to be Alpha King Kael’s Luna. But on our bonding altar, he brought his pregnant snake mistress, ordering me to raise their child as their servant. I revoked our bond and offered myself to any shifter willing to claim me. Everyone feared Kael—until cursed, discarded Prince Rowan stepped forward. I chose him, my pure blood suppressing his deadly curse. The old prophecy shifted to us. Kael lost all power and begged me back, while his serpent lover sank into dark corruption. Can Rowan and I stop the feral beast tide sweeping the realm?

title: Back to Her Heart
description: James Witt wakes up 10 years later: his body was hijacked by an imposter who divorced his soulmate, Jocelyn. Now back in control but facing two ruthless rivals, James must fight tooth and nail to redeem his past and win back his family.

title: Do Not Disturb: Lady Boss in Disguise!
description: To become the heiress of her family hotel chain, Violet Trenton goes undercover as a cleaning lady and takes out the troublemakers one by one. Will she succeed and save the hotel? And is her sexy new COO Kasey Johnson just a powerful ally, or something more?

title: Reborn for the Lycan King
description: Reborn after her stepsister’s deadly betrayal, Diana shoots an arrow to choose her mate. It lands on Alexander, the hidden Lycan King. But with Ivy still plotting and her bond with Alex unclear, Diana must fight to change her fate—before it’s too late.

title: The Deaf Heiress's Secret
description: A deaf heiress regains her hearing just in time to discover the people closest to her plotting against her. Keeping her recovery a secret, she plays a dangerous game of deception against those who believe her disability makes her weak. As she investigates suspicious events from her past, she must carefully navigate a web of betrayal while pretending not to hear the conspiracies unfolding around her in order to bring those who wronged her to justice.

title: Under Her Heels
description:
Elena, a disgraced jewelry heiress betrayed by her family, finds solace in Lucien, a mysterious, injured violinist she rescues from the rain. To regain a sense of control, she binds him with a Master-Servant Contract, treating him as her submissive pet.
However, as Elena’s company is besieged by the ruthless Vere family, Lucien secretly manipulates the shadows to protect her. The power dynamic shatters when Elena discovers Lucien is actually the lost heir of the Vere empire. To save him from his tyrannical brother, she cruelly banishes him, breaking their contract.
This rejection awakens the beast. Lucien sheds his submissive disguise, returning as a dominant tycoon with an army of loyalists. He is no longer the pet on a leash, but the master of the game, ready to burn down the world to claim his Queen.
Core Themes: Hidden Identity, BDSM Power Play, Corporate Revenge, and Redemption.

title: Reborn to Rule the Sky with My Dragon
description:
Briar gave everything to her elite dragon flight and her fiancé, Silas. Her reward? Betrayal. They mocked her unawakened dragon as a useless runt, stripped her of her rank, and left her to die.
But death didn't take.
Reborn back to a few days ago, Briar turns her back on her toxic ex. While they laugh at her "weak" dragon, Briar is ready to unleash a mythical power unseen for centuries. When the skies clash, Silas will realize too late: they didn't just discard a useless teammate—they threw away the goddess of victory.

title: The Divorced Wife is a Genius Surgeon
description: 8 months pregnant, Alyssa is abandoned by her husband for his mistress and their lovechild Lilly. Little do they know, Alyssa is actually Jane Davenport M.D.--heiress to the Davenport fortune, and the only heart surgeon in the world that can save Lilly.

title: Stop! That Homeless Man Is an American Hero!
description: Ethan escorts his fallen comrade's ashes back home. On the way, he gets stopped by the local Sheriff who accuses Ethan of being a homeless vagrant. Ethan gets dragged in for questioning at the police station. They humiliate and torture him, but Ethan endures because he must protect his friend's ashes.  But then, the sheriff goes too far. He desecrates the ashes! Just when things are about to take a turn for the worse, Ethan's old army subordinate– now the Director of the FBI– appears! Will Ethan's true identity as an American hero finally be revealed?

title: After Her Seventh Heartbreak, I Took Mom Back to Heaven
description: I am Cupid, the god of love. To pass my final trial, I reincarnated as a human baby into Elaine's womb. Yet even before birth, I heard my father Arthur promise his mistress Chloe: "Once she gives birth, I'll lay it all out for her.

title: My Secret Lover Is His Brother
description: To forgive Piper's family debt, she's promised to marry one of the Bellfort brothers. Will she choose the star lacrosse player Drew? Or the handsome loner Noah? How can she decide when she has a connection with both?

title: Alpha Heiress Reclaims Her Pack
description: After three years of secret Alpha training, Aria Sterling returns to find her mother enslaved, her birthright stolen, and an impostor family ruling her pack. To reclaim the Sterling throne, she must break a silver curse, expose a forged bloodline, and reveal that the mighty Aether Guild answers to her.

title: Miss Her After She Left
description: Iris gave her heart and virginity to Caspian, only to overhear his cruel laughter with friends about her family. She walked away, unknowingly leaving a lasting mark on Caspian's heart. Ten years later, Caspian finds himself still in love with Iris. He's desperate to trap her with marriage. But what awaits him in this long-awaited union?

title: Never Reject A Wolf Princess
description: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty—only to be betrayed and rejected by her mate. But she’s not one to stay broken for long. When she unexpectedly bonds with a new mate hiding his own secrets, Lia is thrust into a world of power, deception, and second chances. Now, she’s done following the rules. It’s time to reclaim her throne—and make everyone who doubted her regret it!

title: After Divorce, My Ex-Wife Became a Billionaire
description: Claire, secretly the heir to a vast fortune, hides her true identity to marry Milo out of love. Living in Los Angeles, she quietly uses her wealth and influence to smooth out the obstacles on Milo's path to building his startup. Just as Milo is on the brink of success, Claire discovers he's been unfaithful. Confronted, Milo admits he's fallen out of love, speaks harshly to her, dismisses all she's done for him, and pressures her into a divorce. Heartbroken and deeply disappointed, Claire decides to reclaim her position as a billionaire heiress. She withdraws all her support, and lets Milo face the consequences of his actions, making him regret everything he's done.

title: Seduce My Sister's Man to Revenge
description: Betrayed by her stepfamily and banished by her father, Blair Langley returns to take back what's hers. Seeing her stepsister with her fiancé, Christian Sterling, she realizes her perfect chance for revenge has arrived.

title: Backstage Romance with the Popstar
description: Rockstar Dexter Hayes thinks he found his next hit when he dumps his loyal assistant Casey for rising star Scarlett Hart. What he doesn’t know is that Casey is living a double life as Echo, the mysterious super-producer who built his career and secretly owns his label. As the truth unravels, can Dexter and Casey can find their way back to the music, and to each other?

title: Final Skill: Win Her Heart
description: An ordinary guy, Max, gets a system that grants him all sorts of skills. Just as he's about to win the ultimate prize, one bad review from Rita resets everything. Desperate to fix his rating, he goes all out to win her over!

title: Betrayed Alpha Queen Rises from the Ashes
description: Nessa, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Blaze Ashclaw. But Blaze mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Nessa cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Blaze to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?

title: Lady Boss Takes on Vegas Bullies!
description: Jane goes undercover as a janitor to investigate allegations of employee abuse. But when she is forced to reveal her true identity to protect her loyal workers, no one believes her, and now, someone has stolen her identity as executive of the casino! What can she do as a meager janitor?

title: His Decoy Wife
description: Evelyn Shaw believed Adrian Grant loved her. To the world, he was the devoted husband who kissed her at galas and called her his only weakness. But after years of kidnappings, scars, and a lost child, Evelyn discovers the truth: Adrian built their marriage to make her a decoy wife, a public target meant to keep his real love, Maya Cole, safe. When she uncovers his diary, hidden money transfers, and the lies behind every “rescue,” Evelyn uses Maya’s arrogance to secure Adrian’s signature, files for divorce, erases her trail, and disappears. By the time Adrian realizes what he destroyed, Evelyn has already chosen herself.

title: His Curse, My Destiny
description:
Luna, a mixed‑blood Beta, is used as a scapegoat by her family. She is offered up in place of her arrogant older sister Selena to Kael, the Shadow Lord, who is rumored to be terrifying‑looking and whose partners never survive more than three years.
In the grand hall of the Shadow Citadel, she witnesses the tyrant writhing in agony as dark crimson curse runes devour his body. By chance, her touch causes the curse marks to crack and fade — she is the living antidote he has sought for three hundred years.
Against her will, he pins her upon his throne and hurls her onto the carpet, forcing her to endure both agony and pleasure. Three days later, he personally sends her into the Moonlit Trials, forcing her to stand before the entire nobility with her low‑status mixed‑blood heritage.
When her sister publicly smashes her tournament insignia and sneers that it is a counterfeit, the mysterious supreme lord in his silvery‑white mask steps out from the crowd. His deep voice rumbles: “A token bestowed by my own hand, and you dare call it counterfeit?”

title: His Only Cure
description: Naomi Chapman was tormented as a poison tester for 10 long years, till her stepmom got her back to get married on her daughter's behalf. Naomi became the antidote for her husband Samuel Hunt, Highvale's most revered general. She found love at her new home and learned to stand up for herself.

title: His Caged Love
description:
Bankrupt heiress Isolde signs a three-year mistress contract with Savien Thorne, heir to the Thorn Group, just to cover her mother’s life-saving medical bills.
The second the contract ends, she’s ready to walk away for good.
Until she finds out she’s pregnant.
His arranged fiancée learns the secret, and torments her at every turn.
Worse — she’s never been anything but a double for the other woman.
She moves out and cuts all ties.
But he’s not letting her get away.

title: His Love: My Best Friend
description: Clara Rossi thought she had the perfect life with her childhood sweetheart, Marco, until he betrays her by sleeping with her best friend, Sofia, and forcing Clara to surrender her Princeton scholarship using a private video. Desperate to escape his control and abuse, Clara secretly applies to Yale, but when a leaked video and false accusations spiral out of control, she fake-drowns her car to start over in New Haven. Years later, Marco uncovers the truth and desperately seeks her forgiveness, while Sofia faces prison for her schemes. Will Clara ever look back, or will she leave her painful past behind forever?

title: Rejected Luna is His Fated Mate
description: On her wedding day, Nova is publicly abandoned when her fiancé, Cole, recognizes Elara as his fated mate. Meanwhile, Alpha King Ronan is also left at the altar by Elara. The next day, Ronan arrives at Nova’s door with 108 chests of betrothal gifts and asks her to marry him. United by betrayal, Nova accepts his proposal and begins a new life as the Luna of the Draven royal family. As Cole desperately tries to win her back and Elara repeatedly schemes against her, Nova gradually discovers that Ronan did not choose her on impulse—he has secretly loved her for twenty years.

title: His Power, My Revenge
description: As the abandoned daughter of the Sutton family, Savannah's stepmom set her up and wanted to send her to a man's bed. By chance, she had a one-night stand with Nolan. Savannah was attracted to Nolan's power and influence, and secretly seduced him. She wanted to marry Nolan to strike back the Suttons, but she didn't know that Nolan was the man she had sex with that night. Nolan became interested in her and gradually fell in love with her, and was willing to be used by her. Savannah knew the cause of her birth mother's death and brought the bad guys to justice. She also became a  a popular actress in the showbiz.

title: Carrying His Triplets, Becoming His Wifey
description: Daisy works in a warehouse to pay for her tuition, but her father steals her money. Financially desperate, gets another job at a strip club to make ends meet. There, she has a one-night stand with Marcus, a billionaire. Soon after, Daisy discovers that she is pregnant with triplets.

title: His Brother's Wife
description: In a marriage marked by neglect, Regina is sidelined by her husband, Marlon. Three years in, Marlon is diagnosed with a terminal illness with only ten months to live. Suddenly, his mistress arrives with his only child, confident of securing her place. Just as she believes victory is hers, Regina returns with a surprise — an heir from a fateful night with Marlon's brother, Jared. As Regina prepares to reclaim her position as the lady of the Stanton family, the true father of her child opens her door up at night...

title: His to Protect
description: Returning from abroad, Evelyn Carrington witnesses her family being massacred. The killer is the Lawson family's eldest daughter, a self-proclaimed transmigrator determined to wipe out all Carrington women. Seeking revenge, Evelyn schemes to get close to Marshal Peyton Bennett. However, Peyton Bennett recognizes her as his childhood savior and willingly lets her use him. Ultimately, Evelyn exposes the transmigrator, gets her revenge, and finds true love with Peyton Bennett.

title: The mob boss spoils his pregnant wife
description: Damon Blackwood, the ruthless mafia don who has never touched a woman at thirty, mistakes innocent college student Lily for an escort during a rainstorm. After one brutal night, he casts her out with a priceless watch. One month later, Lily discovers she is pregnant with twins—but her drug-addicted brother's debts force her parents to sell her to a dealer. Seven months later, she collapses in Damon's own bar, and the Patek Philippe on her wrist reveals the truth: she is the virgin he destroyed. When Damon learns his own heirs are dying inside her, the beast becomes a prisoner of love. He brings her to his estate, quits whiskey and cigars, buys out entire department stores, and crashes through windows to protect her from bullies. From a blood-soaked underworld to a sunlit chapel, this is the story of a soulless killer who learns to kneel, and a broken girl who learns she is worth more than diamonds.

title: His Miserable Mate
description:
Desperate. That’s the only word to describe Caroline’s life.
Orphaned and struggling to survive, she hides behind the name Evelyn, dancing in the shadows of a strip club just to make it through another night. But her world is turned upside down when she meets Elliot — a mysterious man whose eyes seem to recognize her soul.
One fateful night, Caroline is kidnapped and dragged into a hidden world she never knew existed — a kingdom ruled by werewolves, haunted by vampires, and bound by witchcraft. There, she learns an unbelievable truth: she isn’t human at all, but a hybrid of werewolf, vampire, and witch… and Elliot is her fated mate.
Yet destiny is cruel. Elliot is possessed by a dark sorcerer, turning love into battle and desire into danger. Caroline must confront her past, embrace her powers, and risk everything to save him — even if it means facing the monsters within herself.
Along the way, she uncovers her lost siblings and the secret of her royal bloodline, proving that broken souls can still rise from their scars.
HIS MISERABLE MATE — a romantic dark anime fantasy filled with love, destiny, and redemption.
Because sometimes the one who destroys you… is the one you’re meant to save.

title: Crowned in His Claws
description: Exiled half-beast prince Cassian storms back from the dead, slaughters his father, and seizes the throne in a bloodbath. His first prey, Vera, the ice-cold former queen. The woman who crushed their love for a crown, married his father, and cast him into the beast pit to rot. Consumed by rage, the ruthless new king forces his stepmother into his bed as his personal captive and swears to kill Lucian, Vera's royal son with the dead king. Then a bombshell drops. His so-called half-brother shares his rare, exclusive beast blood. Vera has hidden the truth of Lucian's identity.

title: Dying After Ten Years for His Sin
description: Default

title: Monster in His Eyes
description: Based on the book MONSTER IN HIS EYES by J.M. Darhower! Karissa Reed, 19, is trapped by her controlling mother and abusive ex, Tommy, but her world shifts when Naz Conti, a dangerous ex-con mafia boss, rescues her. Drawn to his danger, she challenges him to let her be his, with every kiss and daring move, risking everything for desire, curiosity, and forbidden love. Can she survive his world, and dare to love the man everyone warns her to fear?

title: From His Prank to a CEO's Arms
description: Nancy expects a proposal on her thirtieth birthday. Her childhood sweetheart Max delivers public humiliation instead. She cuts him off and marries Liam, a man she barely knows. Max dismisses it as spite—until a birthday banquet brings both families together and a revelation shatters his smug certainty.

title: No Longer His
description: Lyra Vane once loved Alpha Silas enough to give him eight years, her loyalty, and her future crown. But when the noble Elara claims to be his destined mate, Silas turns Lyra into a nameless human prisoner, destroys her face, and leaves her bleeding for another woman’s lies. Lyra buys her own death, escapes as Zoe Miller, and rebuilds a dangerous new life in Grayiron Town. When Silas discovers the truth, his regret becomes obsession. But the woman he finds is no longer his Lyra. She is free, scarred, and done begging to be loved.

title: Now His Secret Is My Weapon
description:
After a failed overdose, housewife Sophia wakes up in her husband Matthew’s body—and he’s stuck in hers.
She fights his battles at work, destroys his mistress Christy, and turns his career around. He suffers her monster‑in‑law Janet and the cruel weight of domestic life. But when cheating accusations and secrets ignite a full‑blown crisis, they realize swapping bodies might be the least of their problems. Will they ever get back to themselves—or is this curse their new reality? The countdown is on.

Please note that Episodes 51 of this series were AI-generated.

title: The Luna He Lost on His Wedding Day
description: Celine loves Crown Prince Adrian, only to discover that he married her to protect her stepsister, Vanessa. After enduring his repeated betrayal and cruelty, Celine exchanges their engagement on the wedding day and marries Rowan, the disabled former heir. With Rowan's respect and protection, their marriage of convenience gradually becomes real love. Meanwhile, Adrian finally discovers that Celine—not Vanessa—was the woman who saved his life, and desperately tries to win her back. As the truth about the Moonheart Stone, Vanessa's lies, and the Ashford family's betrayal is exposed, Celine refuses to return to her old life and chooses Rowan once and for all.

title: Coaching His Heart
description: After a one-night stand, Kate and Tom are separated by a misunderstanding. They reunite one month later when Kate becomes the assistant coach of a men's hockey team and Tom joins as their new captain. Forced to work in close proximity, sparks of their unresolved passion begin to reignite. Only this time, Kate must hide a big secret to keep her job—she's pregnant with Tom's child - a revelation that could change everything.

title: Reborn to Build an Empire
description: Reborn in a fallen kingdom, Gavin Thorne is captured with a group of female refugees. Then he awakens a nation-building system: the more people he saves, the more powerful his rewards. With his fierce female army by his side, he'll turn a wasteland into an empire.

title: Firefighter Husband Burned His Daughter, Driven to Desperate Regret
description: A firefighter sets his own home ablaze for his mistress’s drill, trapping his three-year-old daughter inside. The mother watches via security cam, but he dismisses her pleas, calls the child illegitimate, and prioritizes the assessment. As flames consume the nursery, the daughter’s ghost emerges—still apologizing for being “bad.” Only when charred remains, a melted necklace, and final recordings surface does he break down. But forgiveness never comes. The daughter’s last words: “Daddy didn’t love me.” He is arrested; she fades into ash, finally free.

title: From His Tutor to His Darling
description: As a boy, Joseph hated studying until his mother brought Jane to be his little “housekeeper.” Her patience and warmth changed him completely, and he secretly vowed to marry her one day. Years later, Joseph has become one of the world’s most powerful tycoons, and the first thing he does with his success is return to the countryside to make Jane his wife.

title: I Was His Secret. Now I’m His Regret.
description: Holding onto Ethan's marriage promise, Cynthia was his secret lover for five years. But when pregnant Kelly returned, he dumped her. Cynthia joined Reese Group, cutting ties. Ethan's late regret failed to win her back. While he and Kelly faced retribution, Cynthia found true love with Jerome.

title: After all this time
description:
A secret lover becomes a wife after an unexpected pregnancy, but is their marriage truly just for show? When past love resurfaces, is it too late to fix everything?
For five years, Grace and Andrew’s relationship has been nothing more than a casual fling—he craves her body, while she dreams of his love. But when an unexpected pregnancy forces Andrew to marry her, a simple mistake turns into an inescapable bond. As their connection deepens, secrets from their college days resurface, revealing that their tangled fate may have been sealed all along.

title: The Cursed Alpha and His Virgin Groom
description:
Cursed by the Moon Goddess, Alpha werewolf Arthur Griffin has only one way to survive: before his 30th birthday, he must find the one person bearing the Moon Mark—the legendary Pure Vessel—and complete their fated bond. Otherwise, he will die.
For years, Arthur has searched every corner of the country, but his quest has led nowhere. Convinced that his destined mate must be a woman, he never once questioned the prophecy.
Everything changes after a tragic car accident brings an unexpected young man into his life.
The moment Arthur discovers the hidden Moon Mark on the young man's waist, he realizes the shocking truth—
The fated mate he has spent ten years searching for... is a man.
Desperate to break his curse and stay alive, Arthur will stop at nothing to keep the young man by his side.
But what begins as a relationship built on obsession, possession, and resistance gradually transforms into a love neither of them can escape—a love that was written by fate from the very beginning.

title: A Penny for His Revenge
description: Charlie was abandoned by his wealthy family as a baby, left for dead in a fire. 25 years later, his family comes looking for him. Finally, he'll get to have a real family! As a smart genius, he helps the family business grow by billions. But when it comes time to pass out the bonuses, his fake brother gets millions, but they only hand him a penny. Is this what his family truly thinks about him? When will he stand up and take back what truly belongs to him?

title: I Was His Secret. Now I’m His Regret.
description: Holding onto Ethan's marriage promise, Cynthia was his secret lover for five years. But when pregnant Kelly returned, he dumped her. Cynthia joined Reese Group, cutting ties. Ethan's late regret failed to win her back. While he and Kelly faced retribution, Cynthia found true love with Jerome.

title: What? His First Love Is Me?
description: Janet saved Ethan Sullivan from a car accident, who was the CEO of Sullivan Group. Unexpectedly, when Ethan woke up, he lost part of his memory. He insisted Janet was his girlfriend. For money, Janet didn't deny it. As they spent time together, she was moved by Ethan's kindness and love. She truly fell in love with him, but his mom hated her. In the end, Janet was a rich family's long-lost heiress, and they got together happily...

title: Pregnant by His Alpha Brother
description: Sloane was a fake mate assigned to heir Royce. For three years, he never marked her, spiked her drinks with suppressants, and humiliated her in public. His brother Kael, whose Thorne blood Sloane recognized at a ceremony, returned and proposed a deal: “Three months, he never pleased you once. I need one night.” One true bite shattered the fake bond. Sloane carried Kael's pup. Royce killed Magnus for the seat, kidnapped seven-months-pregnant Sloane, and confessed to everything—recorded live by the ring she wore. Royce was caged for life. Kael knelt before the pack and asked Sloane to be his Luna.

title: Phantom of His Heart
description: At eighteen, May witnessed her childhood love Alvin take a bullet for her and vanish into the sea during a cruise ship abduction. To uncover the truth, she agrees to marry into the wealthy Grant family. On the eve of her wedding, she encounters a motorcycle mechanic with altered memories, Miles — who is, in fact, the presumed-dead heir of the Suttons, Alvin.

title: Mafia Boss & His White Rose
description: Evelyn Harrington's sister Lily is critically ill, with the life-saving experimental treatment controlled exclusively by mafia boss Victor Volkov. Evelyn seeks him out to purchase the medication, but unable to afford the exorbitant price, Evelyn offers herself as payment, and Victor accepts with harsh conditions that she endures for her sister's sake.

title: Find You: The Emperor's Lost Heir
description:
Emperor Sebastian has spent years searching for his beloved Sylvia and their son, Elliot, to no avail. He is completely unaware that his beloved and his child have been enslaved and tormented by his subordinates, at one of his own estates.

Sebastian follows a trail of clues that lead him to the estate where they’re being held. Piece by piece, he uncovers evidence of his partner and son’s whereabouts. Just as things reach a dangerous climax for his beloved, Sebastian arrives in time to save both her and their child—and delivers justice to the villains responsible.

title: Rustblade Witcher
description: Abandoned as a baby by his father because of his strange appearance, Rex was raised by an Immortal into the ultimate monster hunter. Years later, his search for kin leads him to the Radiant Knights. His mother instantly recognizes him, but his commander father rejects him, despising his hunter status. When the Templar Order crushed the Radiant Knights in a surprise attack, leaving his mother dying. Rex’s sister reveals the truth of his heritage—prompting him to step in and turn the tide.

title: World's Strongest Loser!
description: Tim Harper is secretly Titan, but at school he's a bullied new kid. His powers keep nearly slipping out, and Sarah suspects his double life. Their bond grows through a talent show and a scholarship contest run by billionaire Blackwell, secretly Tim's mentor. Confessing his secret costs Tim his powers. Mayor Hunter and Jax frame him at a gala, and a blast nearly kills everyone. Powerless, Tim risks his life anyway, regains his powers, and flies off with Sarah as the villains are arrested.

title: The Dragon's Return:  Reclaiming My Throne
description:
On the Dragon Continent, bloodline is everything. Pure dragon blood grants shifting forms and magic resistance. Those who can't shift are called Exiles — treated as slaves.

Kaelen, firstborn of the Red Dragon House, was born unable to shift. On the eve of his coming-of-age, his three brothers cut his tendons, stripped his inheritance, and took his fiancée. His father branded him a slave and exiled him to the Silent Deadfire Volcano.

In the volcano's depths, disaster became blessing. The dragon blood within him awakened the ancient Progenitor Dragon God's inheritance. Over ten years, his severed bones regenerated, and he mastered world-destroying Dragon Tongue magic.

Ten years later, holy war breaks out. The Red Dragon House faces extinction. Kaelen returns as a cold dragon hunter—identity hidden. One crisis after another forces his enemies to kneel. His former fiancée regrets everything. In the end, before the entire continent, he reveals his true form: the Progenitor Dragon, reclaiming his throne.

title: My Hidden Dragon Awakened
description:
