To save his dying daughter, he knelt in the rain begging his ex-wife, only to be pushed into the mud.

Left for dead, he was run over by a luxury car—but at that very moment, his royal dragon blood awakened!

With golden eyes and giant wings, he became the last living dragon on earth.

To escape an arranged marriage, the cold female CEO offered him a contract marriage and saved his daughter.

He hid his identity as her assistant, mocked by his ex-wife as a worthless toy boy.

Until the night of the elite gala—

The city's richest tycoons and the war general knelt before him, shouting: "Welcome back, Your Highness!"

His ex-wife spat blood in pure regret.

But when the enemies who slaughtered his clan thirty years ago kidnapped his daughter, they crossed the line.

Touch the dragon's scale, and prepare to die!

No more hiding—his wings blocked the sky, bringing down divine wrath in the storm to crush them all.

He saved his child, conquered the cold CEO's heart, and claimed his throne as the only king of this world!

title: Living His Life, Knowing His Wife
description: After his twin brother's sudden passing, he assumes his identity to uncover the truth. But he had no idea his brother had a stunning wife...

title: The Betrayed Demi-God Reclaims Everything
description:
After three years of fighting on the northern front, legendary dragon rider Kalen Gerard returns home, ready to marry the woman he has loved for years. Instead, he finds his castle occupied, his fiancée pregnant with another man's child, and his family legacy stolen by a shameless usurper.
Branded a worthless nobody, Kalen is ordered to give up his title, his home, and even raise his fiancée's illegitimate child. But no one knows the truth—he is the kingdom's greatest war hero, the man who slew the Black Dragon and saved humanity.

title: My Wedding Was Supposed to Be His Funeral
description: For three years, enslaved Brielle has entered Alpha Gideon's room in darkness, wearing Odessa's scent and taking her place in his bed. Gideon knows the deception yet refuses Brielle a name, protection, or freedom, while Odessa threatens her young sister and plans to marry Brielle to a brutal man. Desperate to escape, Brielle volunteers for a soul bond with Evander, Gideon's cursed elder brother, an Alpha heir expected to die within months. What begins as a pact of survival changes when Brielle's wolf calms Evander's dying spirit and her stubborn care gives him a reason to fight. As Gideon uncovers the truth and Odessa tightens her control, Brielle must decide whether she is still someone else's substitute or finally the author of her own fate. This time, she chooses.

title: His Golden Touch on My Body
description: Orphan Elara is forced to serve as wedding assistant for her cousin Vivienne and blind mafia heir Dante. Years ago, Dante was blinded by his uncle Salvatore’s curse after saving young Elara in a bloodbath, creating a soul bond. Whenever Dante longs for or touches her, a scorching golden mark appears on Elara’s skin—visible only to her. From forbidden tension to mutual rescue, Elara uses their soul link to save Dante. At last, his bare hands touch the marks, breaking the curse, restoring his sight and power. They destroy Salvatore’s plot; Vivienne and Margaret fall. Elara rises from lowly orphan to underworld queen, standing beside Dante.

title: Locked Out of His Heart
description: Five months pregnant, Penny Bennett miscarries after her husband, Cameron, locks her in a lily-filled room to please his pregnant first love, Melanie. But he forgot Penny's severely allergic to lilies. Realizing she never had Cameron's heart, Penny leaves. When Cameron gets the divorce papers, he finally panics.

title: The Janitor Billionaire & His Swapped Bride
description: After Nora's stepsister Bianca steals her AI-matched partner, Nora is forced to marry a janitor and becomes the laughingstock of her family. Little does she know that the janitor is the billionaire behind the AI matchmaking system, using their marriage to test her true feelings...

title: Fated to His Brother's Alpha
description: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha, and older brother's best friend, Dalton. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.

title: The Billionaire Janitor Is Back!
description: Billionaire magnate Jack retired to spend time with his family. He was once CEO of the world's biggest defense contractor, but he's not just a school janitor. His son throws him out of their house to make space for his new baby. Jack saves a young woman from danger. She's so impressed by his heroics she sets him up with her mother Emma, the icy cold headmistress. They start a contract marriage. The school dean keeps trying to overthrow Emma, Jack swooping in to save her from his schemes, even saving the school from bankruptcy!  Right when Emma is facing unprecedented challenges, about to be removed from the school board, he steps in with billions of dollars to save her from humiliation. His true identity is finally revealed - he's the richest man in the world!

title: He Called His Wife a Vase
description: Cara Osborne comes to marry in a little boat. Nicole's yacht takes her berth and demands she kneel. Dario calls her a vase. She marries in and plays the part. He still chooses Nicole. Only brother Luca treats her like a person. When they come for her boat, she makes one call. The dock locks. Allies run. Accounts freeze. Dario kneels and begs to spoil her. The hand she takes is Luca's. She keeps the papers. She takes the late spoiling. He learns she was already his wife, and never his.

title: My husband pretended to be his identical twin brother
description:
It was the fifth year of my marriage to Ethan when his private jet crashed.
 
His twin brother Elias brought me a charred wedding ring, his voice deep and somber. “Sister-in-law… my brother is gone.”
 
I was overwhelmed with inconsolable grief, on the verge of ending my own life countless times to follow him. Yet I eventually discovered a horrifying truth: the person who perished in the crash was not him at all.
 
Wiping the tears from my eyes, I turned around and gave my answer firmly.
 
“I will marry Owen in ten days.”

title: His Nighttime Obsession
description: Overnight, heiress Lydia lost it all. Her family is bankrupt, her father is clinging to life, and ruthless loan sharks are hunting her sister down. Pushed to the absolute brink, she grasps at her only lifeline—a deal with Rian, the ruthless second son of the Dynasty family. Rian let her seduce his older brother, Leo. For Lydia, it’s a calculated game of survival. For Rian, she’s just another pawn on his chessboard. But the seemingly perfect "golden boy" Leo hides a sinister secret behind his charm. Meanwhile, Rian—the very devil who threw her to the wolves—unexpectedly shows her a dangerous, intoxicating tenderness. What starts as a cold-blooded game of revenge spirals into an inescapable trap of the heart. Dancing on the edge of a blade, their masks finally slip, only to realize that in the darkest abyss, they are each other's only salvation.

title: Her Kidney, His Regret
description: Eight years after giving her son a kidney, Helen Miller is broke and has two months to live. She visits him, only to be disowned. Meanwhile, Cole Group's chairman, Andrew Cole, is searching for his long-lost wife...

title: His Athlete Boyfriend
description:
At Oak Valley High, soccer star Damian and football captain Zane are bitter rivals. A surprise kiss during training ignites Zane's relentless pursuit—he's had a crush on Damian for years. But when Damian finds a slip marked "D.K." in Zane's ring box, he assumes Zane is chasing Daisy, the cheer captain.

Their tension simmers: teasing, a princess carry, flowers by the sea, hiding from each other. A genuine kiss in drama class and Zane shielding him in an alley slowly break Damian's walls. At the school dance, a misunderstanding forces Damian to flee by graduating early.

Everything comes to a head at the championship game. Zane climbs into the stands, confesses publicly—and reveals D.K. stands for Damian himself. Their love finally comes true.

title: Came For The Money, Stayed For Him
description:
"To save his terminally ill younger brother, impoverished basketball prodigy Anderson accidentally wanders into the private testing lab of wealthy heir Campbell. Forced to sign an exclusive, high-value contract, he finds himself trapped in a series of bizarre physical compatibility tests.

Convinced he's completely straight, Anderson is repeatedly betrayed by his own body's honest reactions, believing he's fallen into an attraction he never asked for. What he doesn't know is that Campbell, who originally intended nothing more than to tame and control him, is gradually losing control himself. Captivated by Anderson's untamed spirit and fierce resistance, the hunter slowly becomes the one being conquered."

title: Married Him, Then Left Him for Dead
description:
Sebastian promised to protect Joanna forever. On their wedding day, his foster daughter Chloe killed Joanna's mother with her car. Instead of seeking justice, Sebastian threatened Joanna, covered up the crime, and chose Chloe again and again.
When Chloe destroyed her family, took her unborn child, and exposed their twisted secret, Joanna stopped begging for love. Armed with evidence and a powerful lawyer, she dragged them into court.
This time, someone would finally pay the price.

title: I Left Him a Letter, Not a Goodbye
description: Framed for destroying his family, Grace endures five years as a servant in her own husband's home—despised, replaced, punished for refusing to lie. No one knows she's dying, and carrying his child. By the time James reads her letter, it's too late.

title: I Raised Him. He Let Me Drown.
description: After ten years of devotion, Evelyn is betrayed by Lucian, the holy white dragon she saved and raised, when he rescues her charming sister Vivian from a deadly flood and leaves Evelyn to die. Reborn on the day she first found two dragon hatchlings, Evelyn refuses to be anyone’s sacrifice again. But Lucian remembers the past too, and Vivian is determined to steal every blessing meant for her sister. As academy dreams, stolen grace, and ancient dragon secrets collide, Evelyn discovers the truth of her bloodline: she is not a powerless human girl, but the Abyss Dragon Queen.

title: He Left Me at the Altar, So I Married the Man Above Him
description: To escape an arranged marriage, Maddie Hawthorne hides her beauty behind fake freckles and falls for Benjamin Sullivan, the only man who claims to love her for who she is. But on their wedding day, Benjamin abandons her at the altar for his first love, certain Maddie will never leave him. He is wrong. With the guests still laughing at the “unwanted bride,” Maddie wipes away her disguise and accepts the marriage alliance she once fought to avoid: Sebastian Whitlock, heir to the most powerful family in Kingsport. As Benjamin scrambles to win back the woman he never truly knew, Maddie steps into a marriage that could give her everything she was once too afraid to claim.

title: Baby, Please Don't Marry Him
description: To secure her boyfriend’s future, Gloria pretends to be superficial and breaks up with him. Seven years later, she's forced into an arranged marriage, only to find her fiancé's uncle is her now-successful ex. As old feelings resurface and misunderstandings unravel, the two are drawn back together for a second chance at love.

title: Runaway Bride Fell For Him
description: Forced to take her stepsister's place and marry Tristan Lynn, the notoriously cruel and supposedly impotent Mr. Lynn, Maya Harper flees her wedding—only to accidentally jump right into Tristan's car. Unaware he is the very groom she is running from, she begs him for help. The aloof Tristan plays along and takes her home. A year later, Tristan looks at an exhausted Maya in bed and smirks, "Still think I am impotent?"

title: My Fiancé Betrayed Me, So I Bankrupted Him
description: Minutes before her engagement, Manhattan's richest heiress catches her fiancé in bed with the scholarship student she personally sponsored. He humiliates her in front of the entire city, believing love has finally defeated money. Instead of begging, Sera unleashes the contracts that built his empire. Frozen assets, federal investigations, and billion-dollar lawsuits turn his dream into a nightmare. But when he realizes the woman he betrayed was the only reason he ever stood at the top, it is already too late.

title: Reborn to Make Him Fall
description: An ancient princess is murdered on her wedding day and reincarnates into the body of a modern woman. In her new life, she isn't interested in her CEO husband's affection and asks for a divorce, which grabs his attention. It's then that he realizes his wife is nothing like he imagined, and he begins to be drawn to her step by step, ultimately falling deeply in love with her.

title: Fleeing The Future I Saw With Him
description:
At a superpower‑fueled academy where strength reigns supreme, ordinary girl Sophie unexpectedly awakens the extremely rare ability of Future Sight. Yet the very first vision she sees of the future shows her locked in a passionate kiss with Damien, the campus’s cold‑hearted, sharp‑tongued student council president!

Convinced this could never happen, Sophie is determined to keep her distance from him. But fate plays a cruel joke on her: that very same night, her mother remarries‑‑and Damien suddenly becomes her stepbrother. As the embrace and shared bed from her prophecy start coming true one after another, misunderstandings and romantic tension between them keep building amid their cohabitation and school life.

title: Good For Him
description: Ava Dickson, beautiful, calculative and some might say cold, fought to win the heart of Adam Hart. Using her father's influence and money, she helps Adam build one of the biggest Shipping companies in the world. Ava's only request to Adam is that he remain faithful and committed to her even though she knows his heart once belonged to Ella Madden. Ella still waits for Adam to come back to her, and she takes her chance when the opportunity presents itself.Adam believes that he can and will only love Ella, even if Ava's father managed to convince him to marry his daughter. But a chance meeting with Ella reignites old feelings and soon, a romance ensues. They try hard to keep their secret relationship from Ava. Their once beautiful romance produced a child which Adam kept hidden from Ava successfully.Things spiral out of control when Ava finally learns the truth. Will Ava turn the other cheek and forgive Adam for his temporal weakness accepting his other family, or will Adam finally leave Ava and be with the love of his life. The twists and turns of this drama series ask, what if the bad guy wins? Will there be a happily ever after? I guess we have to stay tuned to find out.

title: Marked by Him I Became the Dragon Clan's Forbidden Toy
description: Heroine Stella, betrayed on her crowning night, hosts dragon prince Silas's soul in her heart. From enemies to symbiosis, she embraces dragonhood, escapes to Ash Mountains with elf prince Logan, and battles Grant's void-army. Completing a blood ritual, she becomes a dragon knight, unites three races, defeats the void god, reunites with family, and evolves from avenger to guardian.

title: My Billionaire Husband Left Me for Him？
description: Joyce wants to divorce her husband Henry because he can't get hard, but Henry won't let her leave their sexless marriage. His inheritance is at stake, as his parents demand an heir before deciding whether to give their business and fortune to him or his brother. Henry is convinced Joyce married him for money, not love. Joyce is determined to prove him wrong, but then her mother is diagnosed with cancer, and they desperately need money...

title: Infertile CEO? She Can Give Him Triplets
description: The wealthy Thorne family publicly recruits a wife for their heir to break their family curse of being infertile. Daisy from Luck Village takes the job for money and signs a marriage contract with the reluctant CEO, Harvey Thorne. Evolving from bickering rivals to genuine lovers, they defeat business plots and expose the truth behind the curse. Ultimately falling in love, Daisy safely delivers triplets, securing their happy ending.

title: A Ruler in Disguise
description: Marcus, a warlord who controls America’s economy and weapons, attends his brother Reed’s wedding. Mistaken for a delivery worker because of his mission uniform, he is looked down upon by the fiancée and her family. As a result, Marcus tries to set Reed up with the famous 'Three Goddesses of America,' but no one would believe him and they humiliate him. Reed defends him, so the fiancée’s family turns on Reed — she publicly dumps him to marry her ex instead, who has secretly been bankrupting Reed's business. Enraged, Marcus strikes back and humiliates them all. Only then do they learn his true identity—and regret it too late.

title: Seven Sins! I claimed them all!
description:
Cast out by the angels as worthless — no virtue, no power, no mother — Bastian is thrown into the Void to die.
But the pendant his demon queen mother left him just awakened. Down in the abyss, the Seven Deadly Sins have waited fifteen years for their lost prince.
The angels should have killed him when they had the chance. He's coming home — and he's bringing all seven Sins with him.

title: First Daughter:Forbidden Duty
description: After her father, the President, is assassinated, Nova becomes a target of dangerous political enemies. When her father’s best friend and former special forces officer Grant Steele is sent to protect her as her personal bodyguard, Nova immediately distrusts him, seeing him as a hypocrite just like her deceased father. When she uncovers his dark BDSM secrets, she decides to use it against him, trying to seduce him to prove her point. But the more she pushes him, the more she finds herself drawn to his strength and vulnerability. As the two grow closer, their bond deepens, and the lines between manipulation and love blur while they fight to survive against the conspirators who will stop at nothing to destroy her.

title: Claimed by the Deep
description: Researcher Lia mistakes a deadly Siren, Xavier, for a lonely merman and teaches him courtship songs and dances. He accepts her as his mate. When she flees, he kidnaps her, believing she betrayed him twice. She learns they met as children—he saved her, she forgot. He wants to keep her forever. She discovers she's pregnant. He lets her go. She captures him to force him to stay. Their pup is born. They marry. Xavier, once alone, finally has a family.

title: I Called the Police This Time
description:
This is a satisfying revenge short drama with a rebirth theme, set in a wealthy family feud. The story opens with full-throttle conflict: heroine Lindsay, having been reborn, is only three days postpartum after a cesarean section when her ex-husband Cole breaks into the maternity center ward at midnight with his mistress Natalie. Joined by bribed staff, they attempt to forcibly take her child away.
Unlike her weak and submissive self in the previous life, Lindsay now holds clear logic and a tough attitude. She stays sharp-witted throughout the ward confrontation, pressing forward with consecutive questions and forcing her opponents into a corner. She exposes the mistress's hypocritical "innocent" disguise on the spot, calls out the maternity center supervisor's biased favoritism, and confronts the powerful oppression of her wealthy ex-husband head-on. Every word strikes hard, with non-stop satisfying plot twists, perfectly shaping a contrasting heroine who is "physically weak but has an unbreakable spirit". It tells a revenge story of the heroine turning the tables against the odds, protecting her child and taking down the unfaithful man and his mistress.

title: Pregnant by My Tough Daddy CEO
description: After losing the money to cover her mother's medical expenses to her brother, the female lead gets bullied for being broke, but is saved by the male lead. She finds a part time job at a bar, and bumps into the male lead again, who decides to help out with the medical expenses. The female lead is pregnent with twins after a one-night-stand with the male lead. She ends up moving into his house and becomes everyone's favorite.

title: Homeless Billionaire Baby Daddy
description: Daisy and Alex share a one night stand and part ways on one fateful night -- which leaves Daisy pregnant. Alex is on his way to her when he gets into a car accident and loses his memory. 5 years later, Daisy runs into a homeless Alex, and her daughter Poppy insists he's her father. When will Daisy realize this homeless man is her baby daddy? Will the family of three work together to take revenge against scheming villains?

title: Bite the Exorcist Heir
description: Lian Vier has spent his life hiding at Sanctum Academy as a harmless mixed-blood student, while in truth he is the last pure-blood male incubus under a kill-on-sight order. When a loss of control throws him into the arms of Lance Silverwood, the exorcist heir born to destroy him, blackmail, black-market hunters, and an abyss ritual close in. Lance chooses to feed him, bind himself to him, and fight beside him; when the buried truth about the demon purge is exposed, Lian stops being prey and becomes the one who judges the hunters.

title: Creation Itself Is Love
description:
Mia Langford, a talented but financially struggling art student, never expected her quiet life to collide with power, desire, and betrayal. A single reckless moment in class—an impulsive gaze and a forbidden sketch—draws the attention of her professor, Wesley Winslow, a brilliant yet dangerous man whose presence alters the trajectory of her world.
Before Mia can understand the shift, her manipulative stepmother arranges a sudden engagement between her and Wesley’s entitled son, Darius—an alliance designed entirely for wealth and influence.
But everything changes on a fateful night when, drugged and blindfolded, Mia ends up in Wesley’s arms instead of her fiancé’s. What should have been a mistake becomes an irreversible entanglement—emotionally, physically, and morally.
As their forbidden bond deepens, Mia becomes trapped between two powerful men—one who seeks to possess her and one who risks everything to protect her. Darius, driven by jealousy, control, and entitlement, escalates his obsession. He forces Mia into humiliation, threatens her reputation, and captures evidence meant to destroy her future, using blackmail and emotional warfare to keep her under his control.
Meanwhile, Mia fights for dignity in a world determined to shame and silence her. Rumors spread on campus, classmates turn against her, and her image becomes a weapon used to dismantle the life she worked so hard to build.
Wesley becomes her only refuge—but also her biggest contradiction: the man she should run from, and the only one she wants. Their connection grows from forbidden desire to something dangerously close to love—forcing both to confront their fears, ethics, and the power structures binding them.
In a world where everything—her body, her name, her future—is being claimed by others, Mia must decide whether to surrender…or fight for her identity, her freedom, and her own voice.

title: Betrayed by My Wife, I Return for Revenge
description:
Sean, sole heir to the Kelton Group, hid his identity for love. He became a stay-at-home husband and helped his wife Vivian rise. On the night she became Vice-President, she and her male best friend Lucas framed Sean for Lucas’s drunk-driving hit-and-run. He served a year in prison. Vivian never visited—she moved in with Lucas and let their son Jason call Lucas “dad.”

Released, Sean gave her one last chance. He returned home and caught them in bed. Vivian slapped him, called him a jobless deadbeat ex-con, and even Jason humiliated him. He signed the divorce and returned to the Kelton Group.

His billionaire father Winston backed him, assigning childhood friend Mia—president of Nossa Group—to assist him. At the Nossa welcome banquet, Vivian and Lucas mistook Sean for a beggar, smashed his Patek Philippe, and ordered guards to drag him out. Mia revealed his true identity: heir and chairman of the Kelton Group. Lucas and Vivian turned on each other, were dragged out, and stripped of everything. With Mia by his side, Sean reclaimed his power and completed his revenge.

title: My Ex-Wife The Mafia Princess
description:
Vera and her husband Lucas once survived a life-or-death fire together. Yet years later, in their contractual marriage, Lucas—plagued by selective amnesia—failed to recognize that his wife was the "white moonlight" he’d never forgotten. Instead, he treated her with cold indifference and even pressed her for a divorce.
Vera tried to reveal her true identity to Lucas, only to be sabotaged by her romantic rival. She narrowly escaped death in a car crash, but was rescued just in time by Victor, a powerful mafia boss—who soon realized Vera was his long-lost biological sister. Overnight, Vera—still suffering from memory loss—transformed into a globally dazzling mafia heiress.
Meanwhile, Lucas, who’d seemed cold and heartless on the surface, began to act with "tsundere" reluctance: he couldn’t help but go to great lengths to win her back, embarking on an arduous, bittersweet journey to chase his wife. The two navigated countless predicaments—from a wealthy tycoon vying for Vera’s affection, to a two-faced rival scheming against her, and even a seemingly kind man setting traps for them—before finally clearing up their misunderstandings and committing to each other. Just as they found their way back to one another, however, the haunting doubt of "unexpectedly becoming a father" (to a child he didn’t initially recognize as his own) came crashing back…

title: My Dear Daughter, Love Me Once More
description: The male lead only has eyes for his first love and won’t even let Aria, his own daughter with his wife/the female lead, call him “Dad.” Aria waits all day for him on her birthday, only to witness him propose to his ex. At the school talent show, the mistress and her daughter bully Aria, and the husband helps them. To steal Aria’s summer camp spot, he feeds her a strawberry cake, knowing she’s allergic—she nearly dies. That’s when the female lead decides to divorce him and finally reveals her secret: she’s the daughter of a duke. She uses her true identity to fight for justice for her daughter. In the end, even when he kneels and begs Aria for forgiveness, she never calls him “Dad” again.

title: Mom, I will protect you this time
description: Ava is reborn on the day of her parents' divorce hearing, determined not to drag her powerful CEO mother into ruin again. She pretends to choose her gambling father while secretly exposing her illness, Lily's manipulation, and the family's boardroom schemes. This time, her mother refuses to sacrifice either her daughter or herself.

title: Goodbye, My CEO
description: James Knight is your boss. Sexy, rich, and totally off limits. Dating him might destroy your career, but loving him will certainly break your heart. Because what’s worse than knowing you want something, besides knowing you can never have it?

title: Silicon God Strikes Back
description: Leon is a genius engineer who has a special knack for creating computer chips. His life was perfect – great job, loving wife – until one day, his family doctor informs him that his wife has stage four cancer! Leon does everything he can to save her, but soon realizes that his wife isn't who he thought she was. He decides to change his entire life. He's ready to prove that his talents can dominate the tech world.

title: I'm Actually the Last Cultivator
description: Quentin, a prodigy already at the Tribulation Stage, was unmatched in the world. To keep him humble, his master tricked him into believing he was mortal and sent him down the mountain. Unaware of his true strength, he accidentally saves Eliana, and they join forces. Facing danger and hardship together, he gradually learns that true cultivation lies in refining heart and character. Ultimately, he realizes his power has long made him invincible, but his duty is to protect the people.

title: The Billionaire Heiress's Double Life
description: After three years of marriage, CEO Wes Sterling is convinced his wife Kira is a gold-digging cheater. Tired of Wes's accusations and mistreatment, Kira finally divorces him and reclaims her true identity... a billionaire heiress! What will Wes do when he realizes he's made the biggest mistake of his life? Will Kira make him pay... or fall for him again?

title: Rejected By The Alpha, Claimed By His Brother
description: My Alpha husband just woke from a five-year coma... and I'm pregnant with his brother's baby. He still calls me his mate, still believes I spent five years waiting for him. He doesn't know he rejected me, broke our bond, and lost me forever. Now the only thing more dangerous than my secret marriage is the child growing inside me. What happens when he finally learns whose Luna I really am?

title: Smile and Endure? Not This Time
description: On his wedding night, Adrian wakes up and finds that his bride's in his cousin's bed. Humiliated. Mocked. But Adrian's not the fool they remember. He's armed with a system that turns black sheep into legends—poetry, martial arts, medicine, business. He masters it all overnight. His secret weapon? Claire Collins. The noble lady who was forced to marry him. Except she's lived this life before—and this time, she chose him.

title: I See the Death Countdown
description: Death chooses Leo and gives him the power to see it coming — a red number hangs over anyone with three days or less to live, counting down what they have left. He brushes it off, until a stranger with a zero over his head is killed in the street right in front of him. Then he boards a flight and finds a zero over every passenger on board. This plane is going down. He fights to stop the takeoff and the other passengers throw him off; only Anna believes him and walks off with him. The plane crashes. He was right about all of it.

title: At the Mercy of My Vampire Ex
description: Three years ago, she pushed her husband into the rain, making him hate her enough to survive. Three years later, she escapes into the Underground Blood City, only to find its ruler is him—the man she "killed" is now a vampire godfather. He traps her by his side, punishing her with hatred, binding her with a blood oath, until he discovers the truth: she never betrayed him. She left to save his life.

title: The Scent of My Fated Luna
description: A half-witch, half-werewolf teen forced to hide her true identity struggles to survive a high school divided by magic and fangs—while resisting her fated mate, the future Alpha who doesn’t remember their childhood bond, and battling the jealous rival willing to destroy her to claim him.

title: I'm Done Hearing Your Voice
description: In Ian's last life, Kyle used his inner voices to manipulate his family and ultimately kill him. Reborn, Ian is abandoning his toxic family for revenge! Hearing Kyle's manipulative voice, Ian laughs. No one can hurt him this time!

title: The Unwilling Heir to an Immortal
description: When security guard Ethan Mercer saves a drugged heiress, Elena Hawthorne, she marries him. But the Hawthorne family sees him as nothing but a kept man who married up for money. Ethan doesn't fight back, but as crisis after crisis strikes the Hawthorne family, Ethan begins to unlock abilities he never knew he had. And somewhere along the way, the woman who married him out of gratitude falls for him for real.

title: Forbidden Bond: Claimed by Three Vampire Heirs
description: To win equal inheritance rights for Omegas, a hidden pureblood heir must survive a year teaching at Evernight Academy without revealing his sex—until three powerful Alpha heirs discover his secret, mark him, and defy the vampire world to protect him.

title: Taming the Monster, One Last Time
description: She almost saved him, but a glitch killed her. Eleven years later, she's reborn into a new body—only to find her failure turned him into the empire's most feared villain. Now she has to seduce the monster she created.

title: Lunar Companion
description: Drugged, Cynthia spends a night with Marcus Chase. Unaware he's a business heir, she flees. Reuniting at work, Marcus poses as an assistant, pursuing her—but she avoids him over rumors he's gay. Colleague Leah schemes against her, trapping them in cold storage and framing her. When Cynthia gets pregnant, Marcus faces rejection. Truth reveals: the rumor was Marcus's friend Ryan's lie; Leah jailed. Marcus wins Cynthia, exposing corruption.

title: I Got Married without You
description: Martina blindly gave her heart to Andrés for three whole years, only for him to leave her like she was nothing. At his wedding to someone else, he shows up to tell her that... Was she everything to him all along?

title: Love Found Her After the Divorce
description: After a chance encounter reveals her "struggling" husband, Paxon, is actually a billionaire, Sienna's world shatters. When a casual apology is his only offer for gifting jewels to another, she walks away. Now divorced, Paxon expects her to return. But Sienna stuns everyone by entering a marriage contract with a mysterious tycoon.

title: This Time, I Won't Marry You
description: Julian's wife Vicky cheated on him with his friend Harry, and then they murdered him. Now he's reborn, seven days before his wedding. Instead of stopping the wedding, Julian makes sure the cheaters marry each other and he marries another girl, Rachel, Harry's abandoned fiancée. Julian and Rachel make the cheaters drown in debt with a cursed land deal and loans they'll never repay. In the end, justice is served cold.

title: The Serpent Lord Wraps Her Close
description: To save her mother, whose body is turning into snake scales, Leah sells herself and is fatefully bound to Sean, the Serpent Lord, bearing nine serpent eggs. While Sean protects her, he is forced into a heavenly trial and leaves her behind. Alone, Leah returns home, only to be framed as a demon and nearly killed by her village. Sean returns in time to save her and discovers she is the daughter of his long-lost benefactor.

title: Maybe this time
description: If you could relive your life,  would you choose differently?   Dumped by her husband and lost in a midlife crisis, 45-year-old housewife Meredith Blair wakes up in her 20-year-old body after a mysterious encounter. Now living undercover as her daughter’s new roommate “Red” ,  she reigniting her long abandoned music dream and unexpectedly falling for Harry, a charming young musician who just might change everything.   But how long can she keep her secret… and what happens when the truth comes out?

title: The Serpent Lord Wraps Her Close
description: To save her mother, whose body is turning into snake scales, Leah sells herself and is fatefully bound to Sean, the Serpent Lord, bearing nine serpent eggs. While Sean protects her, he is forced into a heavenly trial and leaves her behind. Alone, Leah returns home, only to be framed as a demon and nearly killed by her village. Sean returns in time to save her and discovers she is the daughter of his long-lost benefactor.

title: He Marked the Cheer Captain
description: Josie spent three years hidden by Alpha Deck Volan at all-wolf Redhaven. Plus-size, her wolf will not stand; they call her wolfless. Pulse Night he promised to mark her, then bit flyer Paige and called Josie the girl next door. She goes to Moonridge to wake her wolf. Gold wolf, same body. She returns and takes the captain jacket. Deck wants a true mark. Too late. Cade never lifted her, refuses a fake mark. She wins, keeps the coat for who stands in the rain with the girl they said had no wolf.

title: He Didn't Say He Loved Me Until I Left
description: After five years of devoted love, Harper discovers her boyfriend’s proposal is just a cruel bet among him, his friend and scheming female companion. Heartbroken, she calls off the wedding and leaves Chicago for Austin to start a brand-new career. While her ex sinks into bankruptcy and misfortune due to arrogance and bad choices, Harper climbs up the career ladder through her outstanding professionalism and builds a wonderful life on her own. Regretful and down-and-out, her ex begs for reconciliation repeatedly, yet Harper has long walked out of the past. This is an inspiring story about cutting off toxic love and thriving independently.

title: He Loved the Wrong Brother
description:
Jasper Hawthorne was a powerful heir to a luxury fragrance empire.
After a devastating accident, he lost his eyesight and everything he once had.
When the world abandoned him, Kieran Moren stayed.
For two years, Kieran became his eyes, his support, and the only person who brought him back to life.
In the darkness, Jasper learned to love the man who saved him.
But when Jasper finally regained his sight, he made the cruelest mistake.
Killian Moren, his half-brother, stole Kieran’s identity and claimed the two years of devotion as his own.
Unable to see the truth, Jasper chose the wrong person.
He lost the only man who truly loved him.
And by the time he discovered the truth, it was already too late.

title: The Alpha King's True Heiress
description: Sold to a drug lord by her foster father, Aurora leaps from a tower and is reborn. She exposes the Harrisons' abuse, then her sealed wolf awakens, revealing her as Alpha King Vincent's long-lost daughter. Vincent brings Aurora home to a noble academy where she crushes every challenger. Three adopted brothers discover they are all her destined mates. At her coronation, Aurora exposes the Harrisons' crimes and Vincent banishes them. All three brothers declare love, leaving her choice open.

title: He Begged, She Left
description: Maeve Astor, the time-traveling Princess Imperial of Zhouland, spends a decade transforming her husband, Alex Roy, from a penniless guy into a business tycoon. She even donates her kidney to him. Yet, during his sister's engagement party, Alex brazenly arrives with his mistress and their love child. Maeve finally awakens and secretly initiates a financial reckoning. She leaves behind three explosive documents that will bring her betrayers to their graves.

title: He Loved Her Sister First
description: Sadie has always been a good girl, but she falls for Ethan, her sister's rival. To please him, they indulge in many secret, scandalous encounters. After a passionate camping trip, Sadie discovers the shocking truth: Ethan's love was a revenge scheme against her sister. Sadie is heartbroken and makes the painful decision to walk away.

title: The Wife He Buried
description: Elena Miller spent three years in a coma — a coma she earned saving her fiancé Liam's life. She woke up to find a woman named Vanessa wearing her clothes, raising children everyone called hers, and living in every space she'd left behind. Worse, Liam and her brother James were secretly keeping her legs paralyzed to make sure she could never leave. When Elena discovered the truth and tried to fight back, her own brother whipped her ninety-nine times in a locked cellar — then walked away without looking back. So Elena stopped fighting them. She started planning. With the help of a long-estranged aunt, she rehabilitated her legs in secret, faked her own death, and vanished. In a quiet mountain town, she found a life that was finally hers — and a man who never once asked her to be grateful for being loved.

title: The Billion-Dollar Heir's Six-Year Secret Bride
description: Ethan Voss, heir to the ultra‑wealthy Voss conglomerate, fell in love with Clara, an ordinary girl, under a concealed identity. He was left comatose after a car accident and vanished for six years. Clara held fast on her own, gave birth to their daughter, and scraped by on odd‑job work. Upon regaining consciousness, Ethan made behind‑the‑scenes arrangements to make amends to his beloved. He threw a lavish top‑tier wedding to humiliate his snobbish relatives, finally revealed his true identity, and walked hand‑in‑hand with Clara toward a happy ending.

title: He's the Rulebreaker
description: Trapped in a nightmare apartment with a fake roommate, a toxic "girlfriend," and a parrot that knows too much—one guy can see the deadly loophole in every rule.

title: The Bride He Betrayed
description: On the night of her dream wedding, Silicon Valley heiress Avery Stone learns her new husband, Ethan Vale, slept with another woman “to practice” and is leaving their bridal suite to legally marry her. When Ethan uses a secret intimate video to trap Avery in their billion-dollar merger marriage, she stops crying and starts planning. His mistress tries to expose Avery online, but Avery flips the trap, turning Ethan’s own verified account into a global scandal. As his empire collapses, obsession, pregnancy, blackmail, and revenge spiral into a deadly final confrontation, while Avery fights to reclaim her name, power, and heart.

title: Fake Witch Claimed by Two Heirs
description:
I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence.I'm a fraud who snuck into the most elite magic academy in existence. Everyone here wields real power — vampires, werewolves, dragon clan, witches — while I survive on street performer tricks and sleight of hand. If I'm exposed, what awaits me is worse than death. But I had to come: my sister died here. The academy called it an "accident." I know better — her killer is somewhere on these grounds.
I kept my head down, stayed invisible. It wasn't enough. The blood heir, the wolf clan's little prince… the most powerful men in this academy are closing in on me one by one, marking me, declaring in front of everyone: "You're mine." Are they falling for me — or have they already uncovered my secret?

title: He Paid for One Night, Then Wanted Forever
description:
Struggling to make ends meet, Haley strikes a one-night deal with Julian, heir to a powerful wealthy family, at a nightclub to fund her gravely ill mother’s treatment. She is convinced they will part ways forever after that night, only to find herself repeatedly drawn into his world.

At a high-profile auction, Julian pays an astronomical sum to claim her. It soon emerges that he has been secretly laying the groundwork for years to track down and dismantle a human trafficking syndicate. Her childhood sweetheart Ryan, who comes across as gentle and refined on the surface, is secretly the ruthless kingpin of the criminal ring — and so the fateful entanglement of the three begins to unfold.

When gunfire erupts, Haley takes the fatal bullet meant for Julian. As she wakes up to his long-overdue confession, she is left to wonder: should she trust in fate’s design, or is this nothing but fate’s cruel joke? Spanning five years of unspoken affection, this secret love will finally find its answer amid high-society conspiracies and life-and-death trials.

title: The Housewife He Threw Away Is a Billionaire
description: Aria Vale spent three years pretending to be the perfect housewife for Damon Crawford, the man who thought he built his Wall Street empire alone. Then he brought home a mistress and demanded an open marriage. Aria smiled and said yes. One call later, New York’s richest men were at her feet, ruthless Kade Ashford claimed her in public, and every hidden Vale dollar vanished from Damon’s company. By the time he learned his “boring wife” was the heiress funding him, bankruptcy, divorce, and lifelong regret were already waiting.

title: The Lost Heiress
description: Mia grew up in the slums, raised by her grandmother Mrs. Gray. After her grandmother died, she worked as a design intern, resilient and never complaining. Meanwhile, Olivia, the Winston family's fakedaughter,waspamperedandarrogant—seeminglykindbutdeeply jealous and manipulative. When the Winston patriarch needed blood, they discovered Olivia wasn't their biological daughter. Mia, from the slums, was the real Winston heiress. Broughthome,Miafacedcoldrejection:herparentsdespisedher background, her brother remained distant, and Olivia constantly framed her—stealingaccusations,destroyingherdesigns,public humiliation—even plotting with her birth parents to drive Mia out. Mia initially endured, but Olivia's escalating attacks and her family's indifference awakened her. She stopped compromising, established herself in Winston Group's design department, and investigated the baby-switch truth. She met Lucas, a talented lawyer drawn to her resilience. He helped her, providedevidence,anddefendedherwhenframed.Mia'sdesignswon recognition, securing her position. She fought back, exposed Olivia's evil deeds, and uncovered the truth: Olivia's birth parents bribed the Winston servant to switch the babies for a better life. Olivia was expelled. Her birth parents and the servant faced punishment. Mia reclaimed her inheritance, earned her family's recognition, found love with Lucas, and became the Winston Group's core heir—transforming from slum girl to elite heiress.

title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir
description: Vince buried his past with Dante, the mob heir who vanished five years ago. When Dante returns, he's still reckless, still devastating, still determined to win Vince back. But Leo, the fragile younger brother Vince saved, wants him too. Caught between two brothers, Vince must decide if the man who broke him once is worth the risk again.

title: The Last Gray Helmet
description: Ethan Kane was a broke mechanic from a border colony — a low-grade citizen, conscripted into the Gray Helmet Suicide Squad and sent to die as cannon fodder for the Swarm. Everyone assumed the bugs ate him years ago. They were wrong. Every impossible battle that "nobody soldier" fought was quietly written into the Alliance's military textbooks — under a name no one knew: the Unnamed Marshal of the 9th Expeditionary Force. Ten years later, Ethan comes home to find his wife scavenging scrap to survive, his crippled father spat on, his daughter branded the child of a deserter — humiliated by the mayor, the syndicate, and the very son who sold them out. He came back for one thing: to make every last one of them understand who they buried. And when the Swarm follows him home, the town will learn the deserter they mocked was the only guardian they ever had.

title: The Mystic Healer Who Rules the Realm
description: Cora Montgomery, heiress of a mystic arts family, dies in the modern world — and wakes up in ancient Valoria as Valerie Blackwood, the unwanted daughter of a powerful merchant clan. On her first day in this new life, her own father buries her alive as a sacrifice to secure the family's fortune. But lightning strikes the grave. She claws her way out. Armed with the Five Mystic Arts, Valerie dismantles her enemies one by one. And to survive the political storm, she makes a deal: a six-month marriage of convenience with the cold, guarded Crown Prince Callum. But what begins as a contract becomes something neither expected...

title: The Heiress They Couldn't Break
description:
Stella Shaw, once Newport's top socialite, was pushed down stairs by her half-sister Molly seven years ago—leaving her with a cane and a shattered ballet dream. Now her father forces her into a marriage with the opportunistic Simon.

Seemingly compliant, Stella has quietly laid her plans. Her security consultant "Cole" is actually Adrian Waverly, heir to the Waverly Group, lying low at her side. Her private investigator Sage is Evelyn, the daughter raised by her aunt Victoria.

On her wedding day, Stella exposes Simon and Molly's betrayal, refuses to sign, and calls off the engagement.

Then she discovers the "mother" in the hospital is a stand-in. The truth behind her real mother Vivian's disappearance surfaces. Stella strikes a deal with Victoria—and at The Aster Gala, she stages her ultimate counterattack: Evelyn reveals her identity, returning the Shaw Harbor Group to Stella. Adrian proposes under his true name. Stella accepts the ring—then flies alone to Capital City to continue searching for her mother.

title: Don't Toy with My Heart, Mr. Billionaire
description: Adult toy designer Holly is forced to sign a contract marriage with arms dealer Derek after her company’s cash flow collapses. What begins as a simple exchange of interests spirals out of control as they move in together and face escalating crises. Derek is cold, dominant, and in total control, yet he begins to waver in the face of Holly’s resilience and kindness. Holly appears soft on the surface, but she grows stronger with every scheme, betrayal, and wound, learning to fight back. Caught between desire and genuine emotion, they move from using each other to saving each other, confirming their feelings through danger and misunderstanding, and ultimately breaking the contract to choose real love.

title: The Outcast and Her Beasts
description:
When the academy’s outcasts are forced to choose the familiars no one wants, Faye ends up with a useless bear that can’t even cast a basic spell. But the moment a noble girl steals the beast from her, Faye realizes the impossible—both of them remember a past life buried beneath an endless winter curse.
Now, surrounded by enemies, mocked for her bloodline, and bonded to an abandoned fox everyone calls defective, Faye has only one rule left: survive long enough to uncover why her former companion came back… and what terrifying secret the so-called “worthless” beasts are hiding.

title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life
description:
Delaney is the youngest daughter most beloved by the Dragon God, but she falls in love with a human named Dylan. As a test, the Dragon God seals Delaney’s divine powers for three years.
During those three years, Delaney, a female CEO, helps Dylan’s company grow into a household-name corporation. To protect Dylan’s pride, she supports him quietly from behind the scenes. In the third year of their marriage, Delaney gives birth to a dragon egg that needs to be hatched, but Dylan becomes involved with Daphne, his secretary who is secretly his mistress.
At an auction, Delaney crosses paths with Daphne and the two clash. The dragon egg, on the verge of hatching, becomes the target of Daphne’s jealous rage…

title: Married to the Homeless Merman: He is the King of the Ocean
description: Caelon, the hidden king of the ocean, disguises himself as a homeless merman while investigating a traitor. After kind-hearted Mia is betrayed by her fiancé and humiliated by her stepsister, Caelon impulsively marries her, hoping to protect her while keeping his royal identity secret. As they return to Mia’s hometown for the wedding, romance grows, but Caelon’s true power and status become harder to hide.

title: The Betrayed Mother is the Divine Heiress
description:
Lena — heir to the divine legacy of Athena.
A nurturing, gentle mother figure, easily moved by compassion, yet beneath her warmth lies a sharp, commanding presence. Once the High Strategos of the fabled Order of Aegis, she vanished from power after a devastating fire twenty-five years ago—when she risked her life to save seven infants and raised them as her own.
For decades, Lena kept her true identity hidden. But on her fiftieth birthday, the seven sons she sacrificed everything for are swayed by their birth families, turning against her and branding her a trafficker. Betrayed and heartbroken, Lena awakens her long-buried power. No longer willing to endure in silence, she rises to reclaim control, expose the truth, and remind the world—and her sons—why she was once feared as a leader destined to command.

title: The Heiress's Game
description: Elena, the sole heir of the Sterling family, is betrayed by her fiancé and biological sister on the eve of her wedding—her fortune seized and her life ended tragically in a mental institution. Reborn from the ashes, she returns to the week before her fate unfolded, shattering her engagement and striking back with bold precision. Seeking revenge, she strikes a deal with Marcus, CEO of the rival Vance Corporation, agreeing to become his contractual fiancée in exchange for 3% of the company's core equity. United in mutual benefit, they team up to settle old scores and uncover buried secrets, rising to the pinnacle of elite power—only to find themselves drawn into an even deeper, more dangerous game of high-stakes political maneuvering at the top.

title: The Heirs' Love Game
description:
To save her struggling company, Yerin joins a popular dating show. Things become complicated when she reconnects with her ex-fiancé and a close childhood friend.
What begins as a strategic decision gradually turns into something more personal, leaving her feelings increasingly uncertain.
Amid a tense succession battle, can Yerin protect both her company and her heart?

title: Forced to Bear the Dragon’s Heir
description:
A thousand years ago, dragons saved the elves from orcs—but demanded a virgin princess for every new Dragon King. Lora, the elven king’s illegitimate daughter, is blackmailed by her stepmother into taking Princess Bella’s place as the dragon bride. But Prince Draven isn’t the tyrant of legend. He offers a deal: give him an heir, and he’ll free her mother and grant her freedom.

Day by day, Draven falls for Lora’s gentle heart. She opens to him and willingly carries his child. Then the orcs return, and Draven is gravely wounded. Bella arrives, playing the “true princess,” poisoning Draven’s trust in Lora. Heartsick and misunderstood, Lora walks away—only to be kidnapped by orcs as leverage. Draven risks everything to save her, drives back the orcs, and exposes Bella’s schemes. In the end, the bastard bride becomes the Dragon King’s one true queen.

title: The Heiress They Called a Fraud
description: Winter returns to seek her birth family, only to be mistaken for a fraud and rejected by her brother. By fate, she is welcomed by the powerful Fowler family, who give her the love she never had. Mocked as a village girl with no status, Winter proves herself through her medical genius and rises to fame as Kingsport's young miracle doctor. When the truth reveals she is the Ford family's missing daughter, their regret comes too late. She has already found where she belongs.

title: Stitches of Regret: The Mistaken Heartbeat
description:
Why do two people who definitely love each other hurt each other so much?
Erik, driven by a misguided desire for Evelyn's happiness, resorts to hurting her in an attempt to force a divorce. Unable to comprehend the sudden rejection, Evelyn endures increasing pain with each cruel action from Erik. Exhausted and broken, Evelyn reluctantly agrees to the divorce, her spirit shattered. But just as she begins to rebuild her life, Erik returns, consumed by regret and longing for reconciliation.

title: He Pulled a Prank on Me and Lost Everything
description: When her childhood best friend Leo ties her to the school goalpost as a prank to impress another girl, Eleanor Vance transfers to a California high school to start over. As she heals, excels academically, and finds new love, Leo spirals into regret—but some betrayals can never be undone.

title: She Swapped the Wrong Baby
description: On the same day, two best friends gave birth. Ellen, drowning in poverty, secretly swapped her newborn with her billionaire best friend’s baby, desperate to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she never expected: her friend saw everything and silently switched the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Ellen’s scheme is finally about to pay off, the truth explodes in her face: the daughter she’s tormented and belittled all along… is her own blood.

title: She Returned as Empress
description: After her boyfriend stages a car accident to kill her, modern woman Skye awakens in another world as Zoe, the new empress of the Kingdom of Legumid. Surrounded by deadly court intrigue, including a powerful minister who looks exactly like her betrayer, and an emperor feared as a tyrant, Zoe uses wit and courage to survive. Fighting for her life and the throne, she earns the emperor's unwavering devotion, and together they defy fate to escape a tragic destiny.

title: She Was Never Dirty
description: She secretly married the richest family's son. He believed she was kidnapped and "ruined," so he froze her out—while letting another woman and her child take her place. On the day his sister and that woman teamed up to make her leave, she dropped the act. Revealed her true power as the head of a global empire. Declassified her undercover rescue files for the world to see. When his family came crawling back, she crashed their stock price and watched the other woman's child shatter their precious white jade floor on their knees.

title: She Shook the Battlefield
description: In the Republican era, prodigy Josephine sought glory as "Greatest Under Heaven" — until her quest cost her father's life. Sealing her power, she hid in Sebastian's grain shop. When gangsters attacked, his creed— "a true warrior protects" —reawakened her strength. As traitor Marshal Cyrus struck, his son Charles took the bullet for her, exposing the plot. Reborn, Josephine united Azure City, crushed the invaders, and marched north with Sebastian — warrior no more, but guardian.

title: She Fled Hell Only to Marry Fate
description: CEO Elaine Langley finds her husband Kevin Hayes gifted her villa to mistress Fiona Monroe. Elaine exacts revenge on the betrayers.

title: She Shall Reap the Divine
description: Autumn Hall, after being betrayed by Daisy Wood, faces the destruction of her family. Consumed by overwhelming resentment, she awakens the Demon Lord Azure within her. Joining forces with Abyss and Fiume, she seeks revenge. As the gods lay siege, they use dreams to mount a counterattack, reuniting the Three Demon Lords and plunging the divine realm into chaos.

title: She Ruled the Wilderness
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, Major Sevyn finds herself inhabiting the body of a notorious villainess who shares her name — one known for colluding with a scoundrel and tormenting her own children. Banished and facing scarce resources, Sevyn possesses a hidden space filled with abundant supplies. With her husband and children hating her, she decides reshape her reputation!

title: She Owns Me Tonight
description: Framed by her fiancé Justin and stepsister Kelly, Vivian Lee becomes the nation's most hated woman. But little do they know—her delivery-girl life was just a disguise. Now she’s back, ready to reveal she's the true heiress of the Lees. From livestream takedowns and family showdowns, to training the timid Ryan Shaw into a formidable heir, Vivian plays a ruthless game of power and payback.

title: She Blocked the Cure for Her Own Child
description: Natalie Collins is racing against time to save a critically ill child, Leo, who needs an urgent $60,000 surgery. But when she goes to the bank to raise her withdrawal limit, she meets Fiona, a rigid and arrogant teller who demands the impossible: "Prove this card is yours. Prove you are you." Natalie swallows her anger for Leo's sake, jumping through every absurd hoop. Just as approval finally comes through, her phone lights up with a photo—Leo and his mother, smiling together. And the woman in the photo is none other than Fiona... Turns out the woman blocking the surgery is the mother of the child she's trying to save.

title: She Played the Long Game
description: After 30 years of a childfree marriage, Sarah's life implodes when her husband James’s illegitimate son storms in demanding an inheritance. Betrayal turns to shock when Sarah reveals her own secret, 25-year-old twins. As Sarah strikes back with precision, James and his mistress scheme blindly. Fake paternity tests, hidden debts, and a wedding turned bloodbath expose every lie. No one walks away clean.

title: She Played Obedient, He Paid in Blood
description: Cindy Sutton seems the perfect submissive companion to Winston Scott—but secretly, she is executing a careful revenge. When Winston’s fiancée, Chloe Ashwood, returns, a dangerous game unfolds involving power, betrayal, and transplanted hearts. Everyone is playing to control others while falling into someone else’s trap.

title: The Lawyer She Slept With
description: Her stepmother sold her off for a dowry—but sent her to the wrong address. She ended up in a drugged lawyer's bed, fled in anger, and never looked back. Nine months later, she walks into his firm for a divorce lawyer. He's been searching for her ever since.

title: Awakened, She Rises as the Frost
description:
At six, Callista watched her aunt burn for teaching magic. The city-state of Os forbids any woman from practicing sorcery—punishable by fire.

For fifteen years, she hid her femininity, disguised as a man, and scraped by at the Academy of Magic. When the Flame Clan massacres her family, Callista falls off a cliff—and awakens her ancient frost bloodline.

She returns with thunderous fury: slays the clan lord, repels a dragon army, and publicly reveals herself as a woman. She stands before the Council of Elders and demands the abolition of the discriminatory edicts.

Later, she travels to the Wind City-State under a false identity, meets Prince Silas, and falls in love. Together, they unite two realms and forge a new order where magic belongs to all—regardless of gender.

title: She is still typing...
description:
A message from your dead ex. A fiancée with too many secrets. And a best friend who knows the truth. Every text message brings Daniel closer to the story they tried to erase.

When Daniel starts receiving messages from his ex-girlfriend, Emily - months after her supposed death -his world begins to unravel. Each text exposes another layer of deception drawing him into a web of lies involving his fiancée Lisa and his best friend Jason. Told entirely through Daniels phone screen 'She is still typing...' is a gripping digital thriller about love betrayal and the messages we were never meant to read.

Daniel thought he knew the people closest to him. He thought he understood love, loyalty, and the boundaries of friendship, until messages from Emily, his ex-girlfriend, begin appearing on his phone months after her supposed death. Each notification draws him deeper into a world he cannot trust, where every photo, every voicemail, and every text may hold a secret, a warning, or a lie.

As Daniel navigates these digital breadcrumbs, he begins to question everything he thought he knew about those around him. His fiancee, Lisa, seems perfect on the surface, but the texts suggest a hidden agenda. His best friend, Jason, appears to be a confidant, yet he may be hiding truths that could shatter everything. Daniel finds himself caught between love, obsession, and betrayal, unable to know whom to trust, and terrified that every interaction could have deadly consequences.

Told entirely through Daniels phone screen, She Is Still Typing offers a fresh and immersive storytelling experience. Viewers live the story as Daniel does, scrolling through messages, examining photos, replaying videos, and piecing together the secrets hidden in plain sight. With every message, the tension builds. Every image raises new questions. Every call could change what he believes is real.

How much can he trust the woman he loves. How far would his best friend go to protect or deceive him? And what truth is Emily trying to reveal before it is too late? 'She Is Still Typing' is a gripping psychological thriller about love, betrayal, obsession, and the messages we were never meant to see, an intimate, suspenseful, and emotionally charged journey told through the most personal lens of all, the phone in your hand...

Are you ready for an immersive experience...? Because she is... Typing...

*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: She Was More Than the Woman in Uniform
description: Sophia helped her husband Eric rise from an employee to General Manager of an airline. Sophia trusted Eric and would hand over her company to Eric. But Eric couldn't wait to use Sophia's airline Platinum VIP card to please his secret mistress, Donna. Later, Donna met Sophia who was inspecting the plane undercover. Sophia recognized her own VIP card, and knew her husband cheated on her with Donna. Donna, in order to show off, insulted Sophia badly. Eric sided with his mistress and asked Sophia to apologize.

title: Champion, She is Not the One
description: Anya, an intern journalist, unexpectedly met Michael, the most popular star athlete, while filling in for her good friend Nancy. After that night, Anya was worried about the potential consequences and decided to keep it a secret. However, Michael mistook Nancy for Anya, which led to a series of misunderstandings and challenges...

title: When She Stopped Chasing His Love
description:
Camellia was born with a gift for piano, but after losing hearing in one ear, her family gave up on her.
To keep chasing music, she accepted Dylan’s help—and became the stand-in for the woman he truly loved: her sister, Malory.
Three years later, Malory returns. Camellia finally sees the truth and decides to leave.
But when she walks away, a mysterious music producer sees her talent.
And Dylan begins to realize… he lost the wrong woman.

title: The Empire She Saw Coming
description: When Nina's father falls gravely ill, she's desperate for money until her family jade pendant unlocks a supernatural gift: the ability to see hidden truths and buried value. With her all-seeing vision, she wins the lottery, strikes gold, dominates the stock market, and uncovers priceless treasures. After saving Wade, head of the Yates Group, she steps into the business world, outmaneuvering rivals and building a powerful empire from the ground up.

title: Ex Left for Gold, She Married the Throne
description: Sixteen years ago, Eleanor Fletcher's husband faked his own death and abandoned her — all for wealth and status. Left alone to carry the Blackwood family, she did the unthinkable: she married the family's adoptee, Silas, giving the household a new future. Sixteen years later, Silas has risen to become the most powerful minister in the court. Together, he and Eleanor share a deep and unbreakable bond — until the past comes crashing back. Caleb — the husband who supposedly died — returns with another woman and her children, demanding his birthright. But he has no idea what he's walking into...

title: After the Divorce, She Takes It All
description: Deeply in love with her husband, Dane, Veronica gave him everything and became a housewife. In return, she was cheated on and brutally murdered by the love of her life. Now reborn back to a year ago, she chooses to return to the legal world and use her future vision for revenge. This time, she sees Dane for who he truly is: a good-for-nothing cheat.

title: Dumped? She's Upgrading!
description: After two years at war, Andrew Garrison returns—not to his wife Lesley, but to his sister-in-law Evelyn. Unbeknownst to the Garrison family, Lesley is no helpless wife: she's the student of a renowned healer. While Andrew and Evelyn indulge in their affair, Lesley quietly revives the "deceased" heir Edward and seizes control of the household. In a mansion filled with lies and betrayal, she turns from the scorned woman into the master player.

title: Beauty & Billions: She Strikes Back
description: A top CEO from 2026 dies — and wakes up in 1993 as Ivory Dawson, a disfigured woman betrayed by her cheating husband and a ruthless homewrecker. Stripped of her dowry and thrown out to die, she refuses to stay down. A modern smartphone can change everything. Toxic mother-in-law, brainwashed son, and a scumbag husband, she's fighting them all back.

title: Sheriff Johnson VS The Hive Mind
description: Sheriff Johnson's journey to prove himself. He's sent by President to beat hive mind and enter a squad. But the squad leader is very arrogant and never listens to Johnson. Johnson is very smart and experienced. In the end, he finished his mission to save humanity.

title: Not Your Ordinary Heiress—She’s a Goddess
description: Originally Urania, a celestial goddess, Seraphina is thrust into the modern world as a Morrow heiress after a failed breakthrough. To reclaim her divine status, she must complete the unfinished business of her mortal counterpart. Upon returning to the Morrow family, she is enraged to find her parents being humiliated and swiftly takes a stand, showing no mercy.

title: The Test She Failed
description: Lucas Hayes and his wife Chloe go for a routine checkup. The results come back: advanced liver cancer. But Chloe misreads the report — she believes Lucas is the one dying, not her. While Lucas scrambles to raise the $50,000 surgery fee, Chloe refuses the hospital's arranged liver donor and lends the $50,000 to her younger brother to get a car. "Lucas doesn't deserve to spend that much", she tells herself. Then Lucas places her real diagnosis in her hands. But the money, the one thing that could have saved her, is already gone...

title: My Wives Are She-Demons
description: Chris, a male model, got dropped into a world of demons. His gig? Posing for the demons. His side hustle? Collecting she-demon wives. Then he's thrown into a national survival game. There, he meets the enemy, and she is one of his.

title: The Husband She Took for Granted
description: A gifted scientist gave up his career to be a stay-at-home husband and dad for his baby, only to find out his wife had an abortion to save her business partner. He finally files for divorce, and returns to science. His wife who's taken him for granted now regrets it all.

title: The Lies She Believed
description: Jessica is duped by an online scam, dreaming of quick riches. She sends her husband's $500,000 savings to fraudsters, ignoring police warnings. Believing she's wealthy, she divorces and sells their house, even mocking anti-fraud experts. But when the scammers disappear, Jessica realizes her greed has shattered her family.

title: Claimed by the Alpha I Hate
description: All her life, Daisy Storm never knew what was wrong with her. Why couldn't she shift? Why didn't she have a wolf? Even though she was hated by her entire pack, Daisy thought at least she had her mate, the Alpha... until he cheats on her and breaks their mate bond on her eighteenth birthday, making her biggest bully into the new Luna. She ran away from home in tears, but just six months later her mother mysteriously dies, and she's ordered to return by the new Alpha in charge - the one she blames for her mom's death - Nolan Fenrir. She swears that she'll never forgive him for all he's done, and yet... Daisy feels this unnatural pull to Alpha Nolan, and despite his harsh surface somehow he feels the same. She can't have ANOTHER mate bond, could she? With the man she hates the most?!

title: Shanghai Sherlock
description: Two Watsons, one Sherlock

title: Into the Abyss: She Collected Monsters
description: Betrayed by her boyfriend and best friend, Ruby falls into an infinite flow of instances and awakens as a Siren. With her deadly allure, she doesn't just escape. She claims four instance bosses for herself. As darkness consumes the world, Ruby and her four kings stand against the chaos.

title: Spoiled by My CEO Husband
description: A waitress loses her money to her addict mother and faces eviction. She takes a club job, where she meets a cold CEO she once admired. When he's drugged, she helps him, but he mistakes her for a prostitute and leaves. A month later, she's pregnant. His family—who thought he'd never have kids—is overjoyed and vows to pamper her.

title: The Obsession of a Billionaire
description: To settle her father's debt, Evelyn Collins signs a three-year contract with wealthy heir Alfred Prescott—becoming his hidden lover. When the deal ends, she plans to leave with dignity, only to realize she’s already fallen for him. But the return of Cecilia Bennett, the woman Alfred once loved, shatters everything Evelyn thought she knew. She wasn't the mistress. She was the stand-in. Pregnant and ready to disappear for good, Alfred finally breaks. "Who said you were the stand-in? She was."

title: Snatched a Feisty Heiress
description: She quietly marries into a top family, only to be mocked as a trophy wife. On their wedding night, she's left alone, so she buys a city landmark. As her husband ignores her, she takes control when a family crisis hits and exposes a conspiracy. With a snap, she flips the boardroom and dominates the racetrack. When old secrets resurface, everyone realizes that she's not just a gold digger. She's the queen back for revenge.

title: Rules Broken! She Hacked Back!
description: Reality shatters, the supernatural descends, and a deadly "Horror Tales" game engulfs the world. Ex-detective Maria Taylor wakes up seventeen, trapped in a death game where breaking the wrong rule means annihilation. While others crawl to survive, she hunts the cracks in the system. When the world cowers, she strikes back. One girl against the abyss, outsmarting death itself.

title: Mr Hills' Adorable Wife
description: Valerie is rejected by her family for being born with a birthmark on her face but Andrew Hills, a hot billionaire, falls in love with her when the two share a moment of passion at a hot spring. He goes on the hunt to find her but in a twist of events, he accidentally hits her with his car and causes her to lose her memory before he discovers who she is. He takes in Valerie while not knowing she's the one he's looking for.

title: Ashes and Thorns
description: After their fates are reset, two sisters embark on completely different life journeys. Letting go of past pains, the younger sister chooses to stand side by side with a duke misunderstood by the whole world. Step by step, she uncovers the truth of manipulated destinies with courage and wisdom, breaking the invisible chains that trap countless people. In the end, everyone breaks free from prearranged lives and learns to take responsibility for their own choices.

title: Sleep with Me, Mortal!
description: In search of the "masculine energy" she needs to balance her magical power, naive witch Astrid Hall leaves her all-female coven for a co-ed private school where sparks fly between her and blind but devastatingly handsome Nate Woodford. When she discovers the curse that robs him of his sight, they make a deal: if she cures him and returns his vision, he'll do anything she asks. But Astrid is in for the culture shock of her life when she learns "sleeping together" doesn't quite mean what she thought it did!

title: They Pushed Me to Be Empress
description: Natalie Summers was a doctor of traditional medicine—until she woke up as the most useless princess in the realm. She wanted a quiet life. Instead, she found her fiancé tangled up with her scheming half-sister. She tried to coast. The world forced her to become the top scholar. She thought about keeping a handsome companion. He turned out to be a spy. She looked for a powerful patron to lean on. Instead, she ended up tricked into marriage with a prince who answered to no one. She tried to do nothing. Fate made her an empress.

title: Rise of the Hidden Heiress
description: Valerie looks like a nobody, but she's the secret daughter of crime lord Arthur Morgan. To save her mother, she's thrown into the underworld, a pawn in a deadly game. But she survives. Feeding intel to the police, she orchestrates a bloody trap, watching the syndicate destroy itself. When the smoke clears, she walks away from the bloodshed, aces her exams, and rewrites her destiny.

title: Love in the Ashes of us
description: Nina and Easton have been in love for ten years. She stands by him through everything, from his days as an unknown student to becoming a billionaire. But just as Easton reaches the height of his success, Nina catches him getting too close with his business partner, Candice. With Candice stirring the pot, Nina finally gives up on him completely. One day, the three of them board the same flight. Mid-air, the plane experiences a sudden emergency. During the crash landing, Easton chooses to protect Candice—leaving Nina, who is pregnant with twins, in critical danger...

title: I Leashed A CEO!
description: A drunken woman walking her dog late at night was led by the dog to a tycoon’s private car. Chasing the car, her clothes got caught and torn by the door. The two had an intimate SM encounter in the car, fully photographed by paparazzi and making gossip headlines. To calm public anger, the tycoon lied that the woman was his fiancée and searched for her using a dog leash as a clue. His stepsister faked her identity after seeing the news. The woman knew the man that night was the tycoon but dared not tell anyone, nor did she know her sister’s impersonation. She later became his personal bodyguard via an interview, and affection grew between them. Yet the stepsister kept sabotaging their relationship, causing constant conflicts. Will this scandal - triggered farce reveal the truth? Will the two lovers finally get together?

title: Billionaire CEO's Secret Obsession
description: Dr. Leah Anderson's life is turned upside down when she falls for the hot, seductive billionaire, Ryan Carter, whose obsession makes him a dangerous lover. Their passionate romance takes a dark turn as men in Leah's life begin to mysteriously disappear, and now she must face Ryan's chilling secrets, and confront her love for him.

title: Mafia's Desire for the Wet Nurse
description:
Elena is drugged by her stepfather and, at a masked ball, has a night with Vincent—a powerful heir who can't touch any woman due to childhood trauma. She gives birth to Leo, but Frank sends the baby to an orphanage. Vincent recognizes his tie at the scene, adopts Leo, and brings him home.
Desperate to reclaim her child, Elena applies as a wet nurse at Cunningham Manor, reuniting with Vincent—neither recognizes the other. Leo only drinks Elena's milk. Vincent discovers Elena is the only woman he can touch without repulsion, and gradually falls for her.
Frank's schemes and Lina's sabotage are repeatedly thwarted by Vincent. Elena learns her child has been "adopted" by the Clintons, but discovers the child isn't hers—the orphanage director was deceiving her. Vincent produces the tie: Leo is her son, and Vincent is the masked man from that night.
Vincent confronts his father Charles, exposing the abuse that drove his mother to suicide. Charles concedes, accepting Elena. The family of three reunites in a grand wedding.

title: Claimed by the Prince：the Forbidden Wet Nurse
description: Clara, a young widow, shares one night with a stranger in the castle rose garden—not knowing he’s Crown Prince Gabriel. Pregnant, she leaves her baby and a golden ring on the castle steps to save him from a tyrant.
