She becomes a wet nurse at the castle, nursing the little prince who refuses all others—without knowing he’s her son, and the cold prince is her one-night stranger. When the truth surfaces, Gabriel crowns her queen.

title: We Ditched the Plot and Got Rich
description: Two best friends, both worn down by the grind of corporate life, were unexpectedly transported into a cheesy romance novel, becoming the book's foolish female side characters — wealthy heiresses who were obsessing over worthless men. The two hit it off instantly, ditching the original characters' idiotic behavior. They decided to use their fortune to live easy, kick the scumbag to the curb, crush the scheming rivals, enjoy their wealth in peace, find true love, and end up as sisters-in-law — completely rewriting their miserable fate into a story of two women who won without breaking a sweat.

title: We're Your Parents
description: A college freshman comes home for her family's legendary Thanksgiving feast and starts to suspect there's something very wrong with her parents.

title: CEO's Irresistible Wet Nurse
description: Tammy is a single mom who needs money to look for her son. Desperate for work, Tammy takes a a wet nurse job in a powerful manor, never guessing the cold,  intimidating master is the father of her son. Nor that her touch alone breaks his years-long trauma with women. What he doesn't know is that he's about to hire her.

title: Thirsty for the Wet Nurse
description: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.

title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King
description:
Falsely condemned to bear only lowly mongrels, Moonwolf she‑wolf Aurora is viciously harmed by her husband and clan leader Tristan. Reborn on the day of the political marriage, she hears the hateful prophecy again and watches Tristan wed her sister to produce a noble Silverwolf.
On a full‑moon night, Aurora slips into Moonillusion Bar and surrenders herself to the trapped, heat‑stricken ancient wolf god Fenrir for a child. Their fiery night frees Fenrir from his thousand‑year bonds. He shocks everyone by claiming the pregnant Aurora as his bride.
She delivers a supreme wolf king. Her powerful bloodline erases every disgrace. The traitor and her scheming sister kneel in defeat. Aurora changes her fate and gains unmatched glory.

title: From Ashes, We Rise
description: Karol Sowle was born into a rural family. At 18, she married Joseph Lee, a young intellectual, and followed him to the city. However, Joseph's family scorned her humble origins and subjected her to constant mistreatment. Unable to endure it any longer, Karol left and met Theo Lipsey, a disabled veteran. With Theo's support, Karol pursued education, honed her sewing skills, and eventually founded her own clothing factory. Meanwhile, under her devoted care, Theo's legs gradually healed.

title: Models vs. Werewolves
description: Five young models go to an Airbnb in the woods for a full moon that comes once every five hundred years. What starts off as the perfect girl's trip quickly becomes a nightmare as a pack of ancient werewolves are awoken by the new moon.

title: Three Days Before the Wedding, I Walked
description: Olivia’s fiancé Marcus repeatedly prioritizes her cousin Gemma—skipping their trip, forgetting her allergies, and giving Gemma her wedding dress. After he abandons her again for Gemma, Olivia cancels the wedding, travels to the World Cup with supportive friends, and moves out. When Marcus finally realizes his mistakes, it’s too late. Olivia chooses freedom and self-worth over a one-sided relationship, leaving him and his enabling family behind.

title: I Gain New Superpowers Every Week
description: College student Luke Hayes gains a new superpower weekly. His first, a life countdown, helps him save Ashley Sinclair from suicide. Luke uses his shifting powers to crush the mastermind, winning both success and love.

title: The Day We Got Married
description: Caroline has just picked up her engagement ring that she ordered a few weeks ago. She wants to show the ring to Matthew, her fiancé, at Matthew's apartment. When she arrives at Matthew's apartment, she discovers Matthew having sex with her stepsister, Alexis. Caroline is furious and quickly leaves Matthew's apartment, but accidentally gets hit by a speeding motorcycle. At that moment, Jack, who is overseeing his company's apartment, sees Caroline and immediately saves her. The next day, Alexis and Matthew visit Caroline at the hospital, but Caroline, feeling very sad, asks for the engagement to be called off. While at the hospital, Caroline sees a man attempting to steal the wallet of an elderly patient. Caroline helps the elderly woman. While escorting the woman back to her room, Caroline receives a call from her late mother's company lawyer, informing her that her stepmother plans to transfer ownership of her mother's Rosewood company to Caroline's greedy stepmother, Joana. Upon entering the woman's room, Caroline discovers Jack, the woman's grandson, who has just arrived, and the woman, named Nancy, is seen scolding Jack, who is also unmarried. Jack appears disheveled as he had just returned from inspecting his company, leading Caroline to assume he is poor.A few days later, Caroline meets Jack at a cafe and asks him to marry her. Eventually, the company falls into Caroline's hands, and she struggles to restore her mother's company to its former financial glory, which has suffered a decline.Throughout their journey, Caroline discovers that Jack is the heir to the famous Stone family. However, the conflict is not over as her stepmother, Joana, tries to sabotage their marriage. In the end, Caroline and Jack overcome all obstacles and begin a new, happy life together.

title: I Proposed to a Stranger at My Wedding  Season 1
description:
Hidden-heir billionaire Adrian Sinclair learns his mother has arranged a marriage for him. Desperate, he disguises himself as a hotel security guard to escape. That same day, orphan Elena Hayes is publicly jilted by her fiancé Blake. Furious, she spontaneously proposes to the stranger in uniform. They elope in a hasty marriage.

Elena believes she married a penniless freeloader. Secretly, Adrian buys malls, protects her career, and punishes her ex—all while hiding his identity. As secrets unravel, they face workplace sabotage, a scheming mother-in-law, a fake fiancée Vanessa, and Blake's obsessive pursuit. Through every hardship, their bond grows genuine.

Everything comes crashing down when Lady Sinclair arrives.

title: Shall Steel Wield Arcane Power?
description: The invincible warrior Arthur, who possesses the power to kill gods with bare hands, followed his master's orders to marry the declining Norman family, and married the seriously ill young lady Rosalind. Faced with the contempt of his family and the difficulties of various villains, Arthur, who was regarded as a "magical waste", used absolute physical violence to crush all magic laws. Not only did he cure his beloved wife and help her awaken her top talents, but he also defeated strong enemies such as the Imperial Magic Knights along the way. Finally, the supreme god descended and publicly knelt before Arthur, revealing his identity as the "uncrowned king". Arthur climbed to the top of the empire with his beloved wife.

title: Until We Find Each Other
description: Five years ago, Evelyn Lynch, the daughter of a powerful pharmaceutical tycoon, fell in love with Charles, a factory mechanic. When her inherited leukemia relapsed, her father used her life as leverage, forcing Charles to leave, or he would deny her the transplant that could save her. Faced with an impossible choice, Charles sacrificed his love and disappeared just to keep Evelyn alive.

title: Alpha Stole Me At My Wedding
description:
Evelyn watched her mother die by a werewolf's claws as a child. She believed her boyfriend Riley saved her that night—and prepared to marry him.

Then she discovers her boss Kaelen is the man from her erotic dreams—and he's a powerful werewolf Alpha who claims she's his destined Mate.

On her wedding day, Kaelen exposes Riley's affair with Evelyn's stepsister, then snatches the bride himself. Evelyn resents his intrusion, but as they grow closer, she witnesses his true wolf form—and her hatred for werewolves erupts.

The final showdown reveals everything: the boy who saved her from Victor's claws fifteen years ago was Kaelen. Her crescent birthmark marks his bloodline. Their bond was sown long before she knew his name.

All enemies fall. Misunderstandings shatter. Kaelen crowns Evelyn as his Luna—the one and only.

title: After My Fake Death, He Went Mad with Regret
description: My childhood friend promised to marry me—then proposed to my adopted sister. The most powerful man on the West Coast suddenly swept in and married me. For five years, he was the perfect husband. Until I heard the truth: he only married me to keep me from blocking my adopted sister's happiness. So I changed my name, faked my death, and set up a video to expose everything. But after I died, he went mad with regret.

title: Replaced My Guardian with a Werewolf
description: Elora, a low-tier mage, is mistreated by her Guardian Drake, a crippled dragon who resents her. She files to replace him and adopts Griffin, a feral werewolf no one wanted. Griffin is devoted and protective. Drake grows jealous and confesses his twisted love, but Elora rejects him. She severs their bond. Drake is later abandoned by his wealthy admirer and ends up in a shelter. Elora and Griffin build a loving life together. He is everything Drake never was—gentle, loyal, and hers.

title: The Flames We Buried
description: Ten years of devotion, one marriage of convenience, and a betrayal that left her for dead. Now she’s back with no memory, a new man, and a secret that will make her former husband beg—but some wounds burn too deep to forgive.

title: How We Met
description: A sheltered young loser goes on the worst blind date ever when he and his date must cover up the accidental murder of a crooked cop.

title: Weak in Sight, Keeper in Secret
description: Ten years ago, Lucas witnessed his father's murder by Greyson. He feigned weakness and secretly inherited the Sky Curtain's power. After winning a tournament to reopen the case, he exposed Greyson's treason—only to find the real mastermind was Elder Valentino, a thousand-year-old Rift clan spy. Valentino framed Lucas and threw him into the Abyss prison. Just when the enemy thought it was over—deep in the prison, silver light began to crack through the dark.

title: Jilted at the Altar, I Wed My Archnemesis
description: On Eric Lowe's wedding day, his bride Joy Lynn ran away with his younger brother Ryan. So he did the only logical thing—he called his childhood rival Emma Shaw and asked her to marry him on the spot. Locked in a marriage of convenience, the two gradually revealed their true feelings for each other. But when Joy tried to crawl back and Ryan's schemes came to light, Eric realized the woman he'd been fighting with his whole life might just be the one he couldn't live without.

title: ReelTalk EP 43-We Recreated Iconic ReelShort Looks!
description: Our fashionistas are back! In this episode, host Sarah Moliski teams up with stars Sarah Noelle and Maria Barseghian to tackle a style challenge inspired by some of our favorite ReelShort scenarios. With SHEIN’s different styles, they’ll put together outfits for every situation. On-screen or off. Who will slay the looks and who will improvise? Tune in to find out!

title: If Only You Were Mine
description: In the small college town of Cedarbrook, we find Brandon, a brilliant but introverted 19-year-old undergraduate student. He's your stereotypical nerd, the guy who's there for everyone but often overlooked. His best friend, Sarah, is the complete opposite—a lively and outgoing young woman. Unbeknownst to everyone, including Sarah, Brandon carries a deep and secret crush on her. As the story unfolds, we witness their unbreakable friendship. They navigate the challenges of college life together, with Brandon providing constant support, often putting Sarah's needs before his own. Unfortunately, their friendship is tested when Sarah finds herself in a toxic and abusive relationship with her boyfriend, Mark. Brandon's pleas for Sarah to leave Mark go unheard, as she's blinded by her love for him. Despite the heartache, he remains steadfast by her side, vowing to protect her. When a final, violent altercation between Sarah and Mark lands her in the hospital, Brandon is the only one there to care for her...

title: Fatal Wedding
description: Christine catches her fiancé Jack cheating with his childhood sweetheart. In her past life, she revealed the other woman’s HIV diagnosis—so Jack livestreamed her rape and torture, then had her murdered. Now fate gives her a second chance. Standing outside that same door, listening to the filthy sounds inside, she tears up the report and walks away. This time, she won’t save anyone......

title: Boss, We Found Your Dream Girl!
description: A childhood accident erases her memories of him, but they unexpectedly reunite under a misunderstanding. He resolves to help his childhood sweetheart recover her lost memories. Meanwhile, she discovers her boyfriend cheating with her best friend, who she learns is also her half-sister...

title: After I Remarried, My Wolf Men Brothers Went Mad
description:
Brianna, the frail werewolf princess, was raised under the protection of two elite guardians—Jaren and Colin—who swore to marry no one but her. But as she came of age, the two men made a reckless bet, using a low‑status she‑wolf named Zoe to test Brianna's feelings.

Zoe, jealous and scheming, laced Brianna's birthday cake with peanut butter—knowing her deadly allergy. While Brianna choked and collapsed, Jaren and Colin, blinded by pride, believed she was faking it. They imprisoned her, smashed her jewels, and crushed her devotion.

Heartbroken, Brianna fled to the vampire fortress, recalling a childhood engagement pact with Marcus, the Vampire Monarch—who had loved her for fifteen years despite the blood feud between their races. Marcus healed her, read her memories, and vowed revenge.

He sent wedding invitations to Jaren, Colin, and Zoe. As they presented lavish gifts, Marcus called for his bride—and Brianna walked down the aisle. The three betrayers froze in shock. The woman they had wronged was now another man's queen.

title: CEO, That Intern is Actually Your Wife
description:
My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! 
My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married...
As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

title: 5-Year-Old Cultivator: Not Weak
description: Five-year-old Nova has reached Energy Refining Level 30,000—invincible, yet stuck. Tired of her endless appetite, Master Calvin tricks her into leaving to find Jalen. Believing she is just a weak cultivator, the invincible Nova clings to Jalen, a top fighter in Rivergard, sparkling hilarious adventures.

title: Ashes of Vengeance: The Wedding Reborn
description: Evelyn, burned alive in her wedding gown by husband Edward and best friend Iris—who stole her fortune and her parents' lives—is reborn at Edward's proposal. This time, eyes wide open, she turns their trap against them. With bridal veils, spices, letters, and curses, she delivers each torment until they burn in their own regrets.

title: Reborn Before the Impostor’s Wedding
description: In her past life, Iris, the true heir of the Pierce family, had her identity, designs, and fiancé stolen by Vivienne, the fake heiress. She was burned alive in a bridal workshop. Reborn on the day of Vivienne’s wedding, Iris refuses to be the bridesmaid. She steps onto the red carpet wearing her mother’s legacy gown and proclaims to the whole world: I am the real Pierce daughter.

title: The Second-Chance Heiress
description: Stella Drew got a second chance after her "perfect" marriage to Zaid Webb ended in treachery. Back at the altar of decision, she doesn't just walk away from her toxic childhood sweetheart—she runs into the arms of the truly better man, leaving Zaid to choke on his shock and regret.

title: I Went for Money, Found Love
description:
Fox House sells fox spirits with all kinds of powers. Rowan Mitchell is the only odd one out, using his power only to make people rich and refusing love deals. After being dumped, Melody Bell crosses paths with him, convinced love never lasts, and only money won't betray her. 
Will love ignite between them?

title: The Phoenix Was Never Weak
description: After being murdered by Elara in her past life, Aelia is reborn at the sacred beast contract ceremony. This time, Elara rushes to claim the obsidian dragon, believing it was the source of Aelia’s former glory, while Aelia calmly chooses the wounded, half-dead phoenix everyone mocks. But Aelia knows the truth: the dragon Draven is a parasite that feeds on its contractor’s magic, while the phoenix is far more powerful than it appears. As Elara is drained by the beast she stole, Aelia heals the broken phoenix, earns his trust, and discovers his true identity as Ignis, an ancient immortal phoenix. When Draven and Elara try to steal Aelia’s magic and fate again, Ignis awakens in full fire and proves that the phoenix was never weak.

title: Beauty and the Western Beast's Summer Lease
description: Down on her luck, Southern belle Bella gets sold into a frontier whorehouse by the very man who was supposed to marry her. She barely escapes with her life and ends up stumbling onto the ranch of Cole — a brooding, rough-around-the-edges millionaire who hasn't spoken to anyone in years. To keep herself alive and help Cole hold on to custody of his autistic daughter, they strike a bargain: a marriage of convenience. He's the beast, she's the delicate flower, and together they have to fake being head over heels — until the heat between them makes it impossible to keep pretending. Two broken people, one wild ride, and a whole lot of enemies to crush along the way.

title: The Wedding Crasher: Contract Love
description: Hired to ruin a wedding, Nora Scott is offered a deal by the billionaire, Asher Parker: a one-year contractual marriage for a life-changing sum. Unknowingly, she's the spitting image of his fiancée, heiress Cathy Sinclair. This is no coincidence—it's part of a scheme by Cathy's stepsister, Nydia Sinclair, to steal the family fortune. Asher, who only wanted a convenient wife to thwart his family's plans, finds himself drawn to the enigmatic woman wearing his lover's face.

title: Married To A Stranger
description:
Lily Henderson, an ambitious but financially struggling woman breaks up with her overly possessive and abusive boyfriend a day before an all-important interview which she hoped would be her big ticket out of poverty, and help her forget her morally questionable past.
To convince her Ex, Mathew Gregor, that she is no longer interested, Lily pulls a crazy stunt halfway through their dinner in a restaurant. She passionately kisses a stranger, Tristan Hawthrone, and convinces him to play along. After a one-night stand with Tristan, Lily arrives late for her important interview the next day, only to be stunned by the sight of Mathew Gregor, who had just become the CEO of the company she was interviewing for. In a shocking twist, Mathew hires her for the job, but he has ulterior motives. Days later, Lily receives a call from Tristan, asking for a meetup. In exchange for money and a taste of luxury, he asks her to act as his fiancé to fool his visiting mother. Lily is ambivalent. At work, she confides in her friend/co-worker Elizabeth about the exasperating maltreatment from Mathew and the strange man she had met. Elizabeth also confides in Lily about a man she was supposed to meet. They have no idea they are talking about the same person...

title: My Weak Fiancé Is Actually a Kingpin
description: Top assassin Maya takes a high-priced contract to kill the powerful elite Cassian in order to treat her seriously ill sister, but the mission fails unexpectedly and her identity is fully exposed. Cassian hides a dual identity as Finn, the frail and gentle second young master of the Hayes Group. Saved by a young Maya ten years ago, he orchestrated the assassination attempt on purpose to draw her close and protect her. After the failure, Maya goes undercover in the Hayes family. She gradually falls for Finn, yet uncovers his true identity and finds that the family’s ruler, Victoria, is the source of all their grievances and conspiracies. In the end, the two join forces to expose the truth, settle their past feuds, and stay together.

title: My Alpha Cheated on Our Mating Day
description: On the morning Aria should become Dominic’s Luna, he leaves her at the cathedral to mark another woman. He thinks ten years of devotion means she will wait in white and forgive anything. Instead, Aria calls Alexander, the Alpha she once rejected and the fated Mate Dominic never knew she had. Before three hundred werewolf elites, she turns Dominic’s dream ceremony into her own revenge wedding. One bite, one contract, one public vow, and the Alpha who thought she had no choice loses the Luna who built his Pack.

title: He Called Our Dying Daughter a Liar
description: When billionaire Reid Vale finally wires his six-year-old daughter’s surgery deposit, Annie is already dead. His private finance team marks the payment as a loan. While Annie begged for approval, Reid spent $200,000 on another woman’s daughter and called his own child a liar. But Sloane has the death certificate, the school footage, and every cruel financial record. One upload turns a powerful CEO into the father who let his daughter die.

title: Mafia Princess Returns
description: After years of torment and abuse from her mafia family, Francesca Adolfi is given a second chance at life when she's sent back to age fourteen, the day she was brought back to her birth father. But this time, she's not going to make the same mistakes. This time, she chooses to ally herself with the Adolfi's disgraced eldest son, Enzo, and help him retake his place as heir. And by saving him, maybe Francesca can save herself too.

title: Six Years of Secret Marriage, I Choose to Leave
description:
For six years, my husband refused to let our son call him Dad.
This time, he missed our son's birthday again because of his secretary. So I pulled out the divorce papers and left with our son for good.
But the man who had always been calm and controlled finally lost it. He searched everywhere, desperate to find us.
This time, neither my son nor I would look back.

title: Come Home, Our Heart
description: The family's beloved heiress vanished without a trace eighteen years ago. Her three billionaire brothers have turned every stone, burned every bridge—and they're still losing their minds not knowing where she is.

title: The Auctioned Mate
description: Kaelen Ashfell bought me at the Mate Auction for a fortune. Three years later, after I gave him three hatchlings, his first love came back, and he crossed my name out of his Bond Ledger like I was property to return. He handed me and our babies to his brother Roran, then let his first love tear apart my den, my garden, and even hurt our child. Kael thought regret could bring me back. But the mate he discarded was about to learn what it felt like to be protected by someone else.

title: I'll Make Your Daddy Mine
description: All her life, farm girl Lenore Williams has been bullied by spoiled heiress Ada Thornton. When Ada steals Lenore's fiance and kills her father, Lenore swears revenge - by seducing Ada's hot bachelor father, the mysterious mogul of Thornton Estates. It's all for revenge, so why does he make her feel things she's never felt before?

title: Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother
description: Struggling to pay the bills to support her ailing mother and abusive step-father, Elaine turns to her work as a dancer at illegal street races. But, as fate would have it, she unknowingly runs into the world's most-feared and envied world-championship street racer... her step-brother. And gives him her virginity.

title: My Bride's Ex on Our Wedding Bed
description: On his wedding day, Nathan finds his bride's ex, Dylan, in the bridal suite, playing with his boutonniere; Sophie defends Dylan, so Nathan calls off the wedding. Deep in debt, Dylan twists the story with an edited video, but Nathan keeps the full footage and pursues legal action, while Sophie takes responsibility for the wedding losses. Dylan and his brother try to move assets and sway witnesses, but their plans fail; Nathan lets go of the relationship and starts over.

title: Rejected Bride, Reborn Dragon Queen
description: My mate crushed our newborn son in black fire, then ripped my heart from my chest. Death should have been the end—until I woke up years earlier at the royal Choosing. This time, I refuse to marry the prince who murdered us. Instead, I choose the kingdom's weakest prince... and the moment he touches me, fate explodes between us. "Did you really think I'd fall for it twice?" my killer sneers—because he remembers our past life too. But he's about to learn he threw away the true queen... and handed me the throne.

title: Broken contract and four cubs
description: After being accused of betraying her Alpha, Evelyn is publicly rejected by Kane White Lion, the powerful leader of the White Lion clan. He offers her a hundred million dollars to disappear, unaware that she is carrying his four rare silver-maned cubs. Refusing to be bought or humiliated, Evelyn runs to an Omega sanctuary, determined to protect her unborn children alone. But when the truth comes out, Kane’s regret arrives too late. As his clan, his enemies, and his own guilt close in, Evelyn must decide whether a broken bond can ever be repaired.

title: The Night He Pawned Our Dragon Child and Forgot Me
description: When Claire was three months pregnant, her husband Miles came to her Wish Pawnshop, wanting to trade the dragon child in her womb and her memories of him for the restored sight of Amber, his late brother's widow. Sitting behind the curtain, Claire recognized him but completed the transaction in despair. Over the following five days, Miles kept the truth from her while continually favoring Amber—even scolding and slapping Claire after Amber framed her. On the night the contract was fulfilled, Claire lost her child and gradually lost all memories of Miles, and was taken away by her friend Leo. Miles finally saw Amber's true nature and tried to make amends, but it was too late.

title: Mr. Walker, Your Ex-Wife is Your Boss
description: Emily marries Ronan Walker, but divorces him after discovering his affair with Vivian Hart. She returns to acting to regain independence and meets Ronan's friend William. Amid conflicts, the truth emerges. When Ronan is injured saving Emily, they reconcile and rekindle their love, starting anew.

title: Dark Notes
description: Based on the novel by Pam Godwin. When Ivory Westbrook catches the attention of her new music professor Emeric Marceaux, she discovers his dominating discipline goes beyond the classroom, unfurling a torrid and taboo relationship that could destroy everything she’s worked for, or fulfill desires she never knew she had.

title: A Kiss on Your Faded Heart
description: Ava's artificial heart is failing when she runs into her first love, Adrian. Five years ago, she was forced to leave him. Her mother had Ava’s real heart ripped out to save her supposed daughter, Madison. Worse, Adrian still believes Ava simply abandoned him, and he’s now about to marry Madison. But when he learns why Ava really left and what Madison did to her, the wedding begins to fall apart.

title: Secret Boss of the Five Keys
description: Grayson Rodgers is a gardener with a secret: Over the last five years, he's taken out the five heads of the Five Nation Syndicate, and taken their Gold Keys: The symbols of their authority, but also the keys to the vault that acts as a bank for their entire fortunes. He's now ready to stop, and give his wife a life of luxury and peace. But before he can reveal himself to her, he discovers her sleeping with a high ranking syndicate general, Ivan. Ivan wants Grayson to use his clearance as a gardner to help him break into the Golden Key Vault. Now Grayson must find a way to prove to everyone that he's the true leader, while catching Ivan in the act... all the while being thought of a just a gardener.

title: Your Uncle Is Obsessed with Me
description: Stella was LA royalty until her father's fraud charge ended in suicide, and her fiancé left. She spite-seduced his uncle, billionaire Nicholas. Her mother's stroke sent her back; he put her to work at his bar. Contract became closeness, closeness became taboo love, and a pregnancy raised the stakes. His probe into her father's death exposed a plot aimed at the Archer empire.

title: I'm Done Being Your Simp
description: In his last life, Caleb's cheating wife and her secret lover murdered him and took all his money. After rebirth, he went back to he day of winning the billion dollar lottery. In this life, he's done being a simp. As his toxic wife and her lover ruin themselves, he begins his revenge with a mysterious female CEO by his side.

title: ReelTalk EP 45-Blind Taste Test Challenge
description:
Can you tell the difference between Dominos and Pizza Hut? We put Jeff Lawless, Mariah Moss, and Eric Guilmette to the test! Watch our stars do the Blind Taste Test Challenge and see if they can guess some of our favorite snacks. From spicy noodles to sour candy, they race with their senses to come out on top! 
The products and brands featured in this episode are used for entertainment and reference only. All trademarks and product names belong to their respective owners.

title: I Can See Your Lies
description: Leah, pretending to be blind after recovering her sight, discovers her fiancé Dorian is conspiring with her stepsister to steal her assets and frame her for murder. Guided by the memories of the victim Chloe, she navigates a villa riddled with cameras, gathering evidence while enduring torment. At the engagement party, Leah publicly exposes all conspiracies, bringing the culprits to justice and reclaiming her life.

title: ReelTalk EP 44-Jesse's Tennis Bootcamp
description: Jesse Morales is taking our vertical stars to the court! Watch as he schools them on the basics of tennis, puts them through a series of warm ups, and challenges them to a thrilling 2v2 match. In the end, Fulop Budavari, Madeleine Rocha-Barnette, and Savannah Coffee face off for a special prize. Who will come out on top?

title: Eyes of Fortune, He Sees Everything
description: Alex, once a humiliated salesman, has his life turned around after saving CEO Evelyn. He gains the ability to see through jade, skyrocketing him to fame and fortune in the high-stakes world of antiques and gems. But his success draws the wrath of rival Logan. As Alex discovers his growing powers, he teams up with Evelyn to fight enemies and protect his family in a dangerous world where every move could make or break them.

title: Sage in the City: 24-Hour Comeback
description: College student Jason time-traveled to the Cultivation World. After cultivating for 10,000 years to become a Sage, he returns to Earth to find only one day has passed! Before he left, his father died, his adopted brother forced his mother into debt, his buddy Derek stole his patent money, and his crush Alyssa was stolen by his rival. Now back, Jason ruthlessly crushes those bullies! He dismantles loan sharks, saves the head of Reed Group, and helps his secret admirer Zoe make a stunning comeback. Facing hidden enemies on Earth, he uses his 10,000 years of cultivation power to crush everything in his path.

title: The Lost Daughter's Silent Cry
description: In a cruel twist of fate, Annabella Walton's perfect life is shattered. Ten years later, to save her disabled adoptive father, Annabella, now named Amelia, is forced to deal with the Walton family again...this time, as the target of their attacks. Will the Waltons figure out the truth? Or will it be too late for Amelia?

title: Boss, Your Wife Fights Back
description: A female soldier returns home to protect her children and her late husband's research. An accidental blind date leads to a contract marriage with her brother‑in‑law. At her sister's wedding, she's cornered and humiliated – until her new "husband" arrives to shut them all down.

title: Son, Your Dad's a Big Shot
description: James Vega is the founder of the world's largest crypto empire — richer than most nations — who spends his days dressed as a humble security guard, flying private jets just to buy half-price bread. His son Lucas has clawed his way up Wall Street and is dead certain the old man is a penniless nobody. So when Lucas and his wife finally scheme their way into an audience with Alice Cain, the untouchable queen of Wall Street, they walk in to find her perched on their security-guard dad's lap, eating cherries from his hand. James never asked anyone to believe him. He'll just keep letting the whole world underestimate the old man in the uniform — right up until the helicopter lands.

title: Two Husbands, Three Lives
description:
Before my Alpha husband poisoned me, he said, “You’ve fulfilled your purpose.”
I was reborn on the day he came to our door with the marriage contract. In front of everyone, I tore it apart and refused him.
My mother called me insane, but my younger sister dragged me into a room, trembling all over.
“Sister, after you died, he married me too. He cut off my limbs, gouged out my eyes, and left me only my voice, so I could sing for him every night.”
In our last life, both of us sisters were nothing but his tools.
In this life, he won’t get either of us.

title: The Alpha's Daughter
description: Daphne Sinclair was once the daughter of a powerful Alpha, until one fateful night on her 18th birthday, her father is killed and she becomes a prisoner. Enter Alpha Atlas, the man Daphne has loved all her life, until she finds out he's the one behind her father's murder. Atlas is after one thing, revenge. But revenge is painful when you fall in love with your enemy's daughter.  As the saying goes... before you seek revenge, remember to dig two graves.

title: Midlife Flash Marriage: My Billionaire CEO
description:
After her divorce, Amy lost her daughter and raised her son alone. One day, on the way to visit her grandson, she unexpectedly saves Sophie and is introduced to the powerful Mr. Smith. Hiding his true identity, Smith impulsively marries Amy. During their life together, Amy is often bullied by her in-laws, but Smith always steps in to defend her, humiliating the bullies and helping her build a better life.
Though Amy’s son is weak and not very capable, he is filial and kind-hearted. Eventually, when his wife’s family goes too far in mistreating Amy, he finally stands by his mother’s side. In the end, Amy discovers that Smith is actually the richest man in the city—and that Sophie is her long-lost daughter. At last, the family is reunited.

title: I'm Done Being Your Simp
description: In his last life, Caleb's cheating wife and her secret lover murdered him and took all his money. After rebirth, he went back to he day of winning the billion dollar lottery. In this life, he's done being a simp. As his toxic wife and her lover ruin themselves, he begins his revenge with a mysterious female CEO by his side.

title: My Four Beast Daddies' Regret
description:
Amelia lived in a novel world.
Her human mother had transmigrated here, completed a system-assigned mission to conquer four beastmen (a phoenix, a rabbit, a wolf, and a snake), and given birth to her. 
After her mother returned to the real world, Amelia was raised and fiercely spoiled by her four fathers
Later, they brought home another girl named Brielle, who constantly framed Amelia for abusing her. 
Blinded by the lies, the Dads locked Amelia up and tortured her, which tragically went too far and killed her.
After her death, her mother contacted her through the system and brought her soul back to the real world. 
Eventually, Brielle’s lies were exposed and she was beaten to death by the furious four dads.
The quartet were subsequently stripped of everything and sentenced to life imprisonment.
Meanwhile, Amelia lived a peaceful and happy life with her mother in the real world.

title: Reborn as My Kids's Saviour
description: Lydia dies and finds out she's the tragic ex in some trashy novel—ran off pregnant, died young, and her kids? Just there to make the heroine's perfect kids look good. Her son Cole ends up a thug in prison. Her daughter wrecks her hand going for first violin, loses it, gets dumped. Meanwhile the heroine steals her man and lives happily ever after. Lydia's pissed. Then she wakes up—18 again, but Cole's 17. Fine. She's gonna fix this. Game on.

title: Boss, Your Wolf Secret Is Out!
description: A broke small-town perfumer agrees to a $50,000 marriage of convenience—only to discover her "nobody" husband is the werewolf king who married her for the scent that calms his beast.

title: Beyond Your Reach
description:
For three years, Eliza lived as her twin sister’s replacement bride, trapped in a marriage where her husband only loved another woman.
She endured every humiliation for one reason: five million dollars and the chance to disappear forever.
Then, during a brutal snowstorm, her husband locked her outside on a freezing terrace just to prove his loyalty to his mistress.
As Eliza slowly froze in the dark, she realized one terrifying truth—No one in that house would care if she died......

title: The Genius Bride Returns
description: From the ashes of a legend, Grace Stoll emerges as an adopted daughter and a stand-in bride for her "sister." Everyone assumes she's just a country girl with no manners and that her husband is an outcast from his influential family. But is that really the case?

title: Your Highness, Your Family Doctor Is Actually a Girl!
description: A modern female doctor unexpectedly travels back in time to become Elara, second daughter of the disgraced Blair family. To save her family, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the close servant of the war god, Noah Croft. Using her talents and modern medical knowledge, Elara repeatedly saves lives in times of crisis. Noah develops feelings for her but struggles with his perception of her gender until her true identity is revealed. Then, together, they overcome challenges and forge a magical romance that transcends time.

title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
description: In search of the truth behind her sister’s death, Zoe Hale marries billionaire Ashton Cross, whom she suspects to be the killer. However, as she gets to know him better, she discovers truth more twisted, and love more powerful than she could’ve ever imagined.

title: ReelTalk EP 55-2025 Year in Review
description: ReelTalk’s 2025 Year in Review highlights everything our vertical stars loved, learned, and lived for this year. This New Year’s special brings us together to relive the memorable moments of 2025 and set our intentions for 2026. Come celebrate and tune in!

title: Three Years After I Died
description: In a planned car accident, I was told by the doctor that all the matching blood types had been adjusted by my husband to save his childhood sweetheart. Later, the doctor persuaded me to donate my heart to the mistress to fulfill my husband's wish. Finally, I died on the operating table in despair. However, my soul goes to the third year after my death...

title: Destiny in the Stars
description:
After helping her fiancé secure a multi-million-dollar deal, Stella York witnessed him cheating on her with her younger sister, Kim York. The pair brazenly flaunted their affair in front of her, while her grandma and her father pressured her to break off the engagement and surrender her fiancé, Henry Chase, to Kim.

In her darkest moment, Stella met Kevin Ford, the young heir of the Ford Group, and the two fell in love at first sight, embarking on a new life together.

title: CEO Ho,Your Bride Awaits
description: After the family reunited with their biological daughter, they expelled the fake heiress from their home. She was then taken in by the grandmother of a man, who arranged for her to work at his company. As they spent more time together, both fell in love, and the truth about her real identity began to unravel.

title: CEO Lu's Four Wonders
description: After getting drunk at a bar, Ye Lanxi accidentally spends the night with Lu Yanzhou, the CEO of Lu Group. To her surprise, a passionate night leads to an unexpected pregnancy with his child! Six years later, Ye Lanxi returns to her homeland with her four genius children, embarking on a mission to take down the scoundrels and seek retribution, all while attracting the attention of Lu Yanzhou.

title: Don’t Mess With My Baby's Mom
description: After one fateful night with Henry Moore, the ruthless tycoon, Hannah Sullivan's world shattered—she was thrown into prison. Ten months later, she gave birth to his child and made a desperate plea to her sister to deliver the child to him. When Henry discovered the cruel truth of her suffering, he vowed to make amends once she was free. Together, they turned the tables on their enemies, forging a powerful love from a broken past.

title: Mistress, You Picked the Wrong Mother
description: After returning home, Lee Group CEO Esther is publicly humiliated by a woman claiming to be her son's wife. She soon discovers her son's affair and his plan to use her welcome-back party to legitimize his mistress. Esther stays silent and strikes back at the party, stripping her son of succession and naming her daughter-in-law Rachel as the new heir.

title: Crowned in Silver Blood
description: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Nora Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Drake, her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she's responsible for his family's death. For three years, Drake torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Nora shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears. Years later, she returns not as Nora Reed, but as Nadia Moon, heiress to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power. Her mission is clear, protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Drake at all costs.

title: In Her Shadow
description: Jackie and her mother, Janet have spent most of their lives conning people to get what they want. They’ve never been caught because Janet’s too good at the game. Although, beneath the surface, Jackie strives to get a life of her own, making her own rules, and running her own cons. When Janet marries the affluent widower Job Sterling, the duo moves into his lavish estate. Janet sees the marriage as their biggest con yet, planning to drain his fortune. But Jackie’s plans start to diverge when she meets her new stepbrother, Andrew—a kind-hearted artist who sees beyond her façade.Andrew ignites something in Jackie and she begins to dream of a life completely devoid of her mother and her cons. She finds herself craving to do right and opening her eyes to the wrongs her mother’s been committing. But Janet is not ready to lose her little girl just yet. She tightens her grip on her threatening to destroy everything she holds dear...

title: In My Ex's Arms Again After Divorce
description: She loves him in secret for seven years and marries him at last. But he acts coldly towards her, so she decides to divorce him. Later, he regrets it. It's surprising how possessive a billionaire can be!

title: Captive In Mafia King’s Embrace
description: Driven by the desperate need to fund her mother’s surgery, Elena, a recent graduate, accidentally crosses into forbidden territory and encounters Dante Moretti, the ruthless King of the New York Mafia. He presents her with a seductive yet lethal ultimatum: become his 11th mistress for a million dollars, or watch her mother die. Trapped within his world of power struggles and dark desires, Elena finds her resistance crumbling. As their seven-day contract nears its end, she discovers a hidden side to the man who once terrified her—a man who risked his life to save hers. Elena must now face a pivotal choice: reclaim her freedom, or remain by Dante's side to embrace a perilous and sweeping romance.

title: Brides in Smoke
description: Best friends Ella and Leah married the Harper brothers, firefighter Charles and doctor Noah. On their third anniversary, Charles’s first love locks Ella inside a burning room. When Ella begs Charles for help, he brushes her off to find his ex's cat. Leah rushes in to rescue Ella and calls Noah to save Ella and her baby, but is met with mockery. Heartbroken and betrayed after years of miserable marriages, the best friends decide to file for divorce from the Harper brothers together.

title: I Invested in Her Future
description: In his past life, a man died from overwork. Reborn as a college junior, he gained an investment system — the higher his investment rating, the greater the returns. He invested in a female classmate who, ten years later, would transform completely and climb into the wealth rankings. After his rebirth, he invested in her and looked after her at every turn. Gradually, she fell in love with him.

title: Happiness in Her Own Way
description: Lydia, the "simpleton" of her village, was raised by her grandmother, who dreams of securing her future by finding her a husband. However, Lydia's heart belongs to someone. Mark, pressured by his family to be a househusband, refuses their arrangement. When he meets Lydia, he offers a bag of rice to marry her. Though he believes he will never find love, love secretly flourishes.

title: The Intern is the Undercover Boss
description:
Don't underestimate the intern because you don't know her true identity.
To investigate the truth behind a subsidiary's bullying scandal, CEO Claire goes undercover as an intern, enduring humiliation from the villains. With courage and ingenuity, she uncovers the truth, rebuffs the antagonists, and unexpectedly finds love in the process.

title: The Stand-in Bride
description:
Forced by her adoptive family to marry Henry Howard, a billionaire presumed brain-dead, Stella Sterling discovers on their wedding night that he is merely feigning incapacitation while plotting revenge against his treacherous uncle. They strike a deal: she will cure his poison, and he will grant her power. Together, they dismantle his uncle’s schemes.
However, when Stella’s jealous stepsister Vivian steals Stella’s heirloom jade to impersonate the lost heiress of the wealthy Grant dynasty, Stella publicly exposes the fraud and severs ties with her biological family. Soon after, a woman named Rose claims to be Henry’s savior and frames Stella for attempted murder. Blinded by guilt, Henry locks Stella away, leading to a staged accident where Stella is presumed dead.
Five years later, Stella returns as the chairwoman of a global financial empire, accompanied by her genius twins, Lucas and Luna. Henry, who has spent years mourning her, recognizes her and desperately seeks redemption. While the children initially prank him, the family unites when Rose kidnaps the twins. Henry takes bullets meant for the children, proving his devotion.
Stella reveals herself as the legendary healer "S" and saves Henry. Following his recovery, the family reconciles. Henry transfers his shares to Stella, and they welcome new twins, finally finding peace and love together

title: In My Ex's Arms Again After Divorce
description: She loves him in secret for seven years and marries him at last. But he acts coldly towards her, so she decides to divorce him. Later, he regrets it. It's surprising how possessive a billionaire can be!

title: Invisible Wife,Tragic Fallen Angel
description:
Five years ago, Grace saved NovaMind’s data in a server-room fire, suffering severe burns. Her parents died transporting the backup. Though she owns 51% of NovaMind, she stays out of the spotlight. Secretly married to Ethan, she hides her scars with gloves and endures his affair with assistant Sunny. Sunny and Ethan already have a daughter, Lily, and Sunny is pregnant again. They plot to seize Grace’s assets, backed by Marcellus—the true mastermind behind the fire.

Grace carries a fallen flame-angel bloodline, marked by a golden symbol on her wrist. Andrew, her father’s friend and an Alpha with moon-wolf blood, has loved her for years but kept away due to family ties and age difference. He returns to protect her as she awakens her powers. Together they gather evidence, expose the conspiracy, and confront the Hale family’s traitors. At a lakeside under the full moon, they complete a ritual binding their bloodlines. United, they defeat their enemies. Grace reclaims NovaMind, engraves her father’s name on a company landmark, and steps forward with Andrew to lead their future together.

title: I'm The One In Charge
description: Christopher Balcazar is the secret king of Imperial Andes Business Group, Inc. and the richest man in the world, but when he returns from the battlefield, his girlfriend brutally abandons him, thinking he's a clown. How will the king of all men make her regret it?

title: Love in the Shadow
description: Sara throws herself at Edward and becomes the city's biggest joke. Everyone thinks she is hopelessly in love until the truth comes out. Edward is just a stand-in for someone else, and she never loves him at all. But when Sara tries to walk away, the man, once incapable of love, snaps. Now, he'll do anything to keep her.

title: Trapped in Her Skin, Switched by Fate's Spin
description: Orphan Erin Bourn, consumed by jealousy, uses a mysterious candy to swap bodies with the privileged Sep Pena. Erin seizes Sep's life, reveling in her family, love, and opportunities, while the real Sep is unjustly declared insane and confined to a mental institution. As the deceitful heiress becomes ensnared in her own lies, Sep, armed with the trust and aid of her loyal friend, orchestrates a daring fight to reclaim her identity.

title: Blooming in the Cold
description: Raised in poverty by her fishmonger mother, Caroline Vance has an incredible gift for fashion design. At the Senior Showcase, she is discovered by Charles Sterling, the Chairman of Scarlet House Group, and wins a major design contest. She soon learns Charles Sterling is her biological father, and that her stepmother Evelyn Bancroft conspired with the butler, Simon Fletcher, to murder her mother. With the help of wealthy heir Julian Sinclair, Caroline exposes Evelyn Bancroft's plot, reclaims her shares, and brings the killers to justice. Ultimately, she finds love with Julian Sinclair and launches her own brand, 'House of Diana', making her dreams come true.

title: Help! I’m Falling In Love With My Rude CEO
description: Hailey Adams becomes the secretary of the rude CEO Mason Anderson. No one else would take the job as Mason had fired five secretaries in a month. Other employees bet on how long she'll last, and when Hailey finds out, she's determined to stay. Mason constantly criticizes her. After a breakdown, Hailey transforms her look and attitude, stunning everyone. Mason's jealous girlfriend, Scarlett, tries to frame Hailey for leaking company info. Mason calls the police, but later learns the truth and breaks up with Scarlett. He apologizes to Hailey and compensates her. Hailey quits but agrees to accompany him to visit his ill mother. There, they grow closer. Back at work, they realize they have feelings for each other. However, Scarlett returns, claiming to be pregnant. Eventually, they find out it's a fake. The story ends with Mason planning a surprise proposal party for Hailey with the help of the employees...

title: Redo in '83
description: In 2023, Jason dies -- betrayed by his wife. Then he opens his eyes. It's 1983. The morning of his wedding. When his future in-laws demand an extra TV on top of the already outrageous bride price, Jason doesn't beg or borrow. He walks away. Calls off the wedding. And starts over. With thirty years of restaurant experience from his past life, he turns ditch-dwelling crawfish into a culinary craze, builds a vegetable empire from nothing, and takes on corrupt officials, ruthless rivals, and the family who once destroyed him. Along the way, he finds a new love -- the broadcaster Valerie Stratton -- and a brand new reason to live.

title: I'm The One In Charge
description: Christopher Balcazar is the secret king of Imperial Andes Business Group, Inc. and the richest man in the world, but when he returns from the battlefield, his girlfriend brutally abandons him, thinking he's a clown. How will the king of all men make her regret it?

title: Art of Falling in Love
description: A mural artist and an architectural engineer are instantly drawn to each other, but their budding romance comes to a halt when the past comes back to haunt them.

title: Reborn in Flames
description: Eleonora Vaughn, the fallen Aurevian Princess, died in shame—only to awaken three years earlier, gifted with a second chance. Now, she must mastermind her rise in this land, outmaneuvering every enemy who wronged her. But in this lethal game of power and revenge, the most dangerous move might be losing her heart to the very man she vowed to use.

title: Not Settling in This Marriage
description: For three years, Maya played the perfect wife—dutiful, gentle, and devoted to managing the Sterling household. But everything changes when her husband's adoptive sister, Sophia, moves in and begins a campaign of subtle torment. On New Year's Eve, encouraged by Sophia, the entire family—including Maya's husband—forces her to eat a dish she is severely allergic to. She nearly dies. Waking up in the hospital, Maya finally sees the truth: her in-laws never cared, and her husband never protected her. Determined to reclaim her life, she files for divorce and strikes back.

title: Lady-in-Waiting vs. Lady Fake
description: Lola has been serving loyally by Nancy Sinclair's side. Together like sisters, they overcame countless obstacles, with Nancy eventually becoming the Empress of the Zhouland and Lola rising to the Court Lady. After a diligent career in the palace, Lola finds herself unexpectedly transported to a new life as the daughter of the Sinclair family's maid. To her astonishment, the true daughter from the countryside is the spitting image of the Empress. However, unlike the confident Nancy she knew, this young woman is timid and overshadowed by the fake heiress. Determined to help her doppelgänger, Lola sets out to empower this new Nancy. Together, they confront the manipulative impostor, challenge biased parents, and embark on a bold new chapter of life!

title: Love in Her Shadow
description: Gemma took the fall for a crime she didn't commit so her little sister, Wenny, could live a good life. But the day Gemma walks out of prison, she learns that Wenny is dead. Together with her brother-in-law, Ronan, they find a conspiracy bigger than they thought. Now with both families involved, who's the real murderer?

title: Stand-In Revenge: Cecilia is the actual stand-in
description: Abandoned as a child, Aria Sterling is manipulated by her mother and Cecilia, who falsely claim her sick foster mom was sent overseas. In reality, Cecilia fatally unplugged her life support. Discovering the dark truth, Aria vows ruthless revenge. Cecilia must pay for everything she took.

title: Pretending Poor in the Elite Clan
description: Logan Westbrook was abducted as a child and separated from his family. Having risen to become a renowned industry leader, he finally reunites with them. Yet the family business hits a crisis; their old allies turn against them and break off the childhood betrothal, publicly humiliating his father. Watch Logan strike back and shield his family from disgrace.

title: Revenge in My Ex's Brother's Bed
description: Three years ago, rising star Danny lost everything after being betrayed by the two people he trusted most. Everyone believed he was gone for good. Now he's back with a new identity and a carefully planned revenge. His target? The ex-lover who destroyed his life and the best friend who helped cover it up. But things take an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with Allen, the younger brother of the man he hates most. What starts as a dangerous game soon becomes something neither of them can control. As old secrets resurface and feelings grow stronger, Danny must decide, finish his revenge, or risk everything for the one person he never meant to love.

title: Love in My Hands
description:
Yeonju joins Perfect Match, a survival dating show where several men compete for one woman’s heart.
Moving into the “Match House,” she begins a seven-day experiment in love — a whirlwind of unexpected chemistry and temptation.
From poolside challenges and secret touches to one-night dates, each day brings new excitement, new connections… and new betrayals.
As emotions blur between sincerity and strategy, passion and hesitation, Yeonju finds herself sinking deeper into a storm of desire and confusion.
With every elimination and every choice she makes, her heart grows heavier — until the final day, when her decision will shape one of five completely different endings.
Who will you choose to complete your story of love?

title: Echoes in the Dark
description: Blind pianist Grace takes a gig at Arthur Mercer's home, only to overhear his murder by his wife Daphne Walsh and her lover Felix Thorne. When Daphne discovers Grace isn't fully blind, she poisons her, making her truly lose her sight. Felix's brother, Ian Thorne, deeply loves Grace but knows nothing of the crime. After Nora Hughes is killed for knowing too much, a deadly battle over dirty money erupts in a warehouse. With Ian, Grace, Daphne, and her sister held captive, lies and betrayals unravel. In the end, everyone must make the ultimate choice between greed and humanity.

title: Learning Love in the Storm
description: Harper endures relentless emotional and physical abuse from her husband Samuel, who deems her an unsatisfying wife and is influenced by his scheming assistant Ruby. He forces Harper into the "Perfect Wife Training Academy", a hellish suburban facility that subjects her to dehumanizing body examinations, graphic video training, violent coercion, and sexual violation under instructors Camilla and Daniel—all sanctioned by a contract Samuel signed. Broken by trauma, Harper complies with all demands, transforming into the obedient, sensual wife Samuel desired. During the academy’s inspection, Samuel watches edited footage of her torment and is consumed by rage and guilt, rescuing her and lashing out before descending into regret. Harper becomes a hollow, robotic version of the wife he wanted, losing her passion for the cello and her sense of self. Samuel uncovers Ruby’s role as a academy shareholder who orchestrated Harper’s suffering, avenges Harper by taking down the academy and imprisoning Ruby, then devotes himself to caring for her after she’s diagnosed with a rare illness. Refusing to forgive his unforgivable betrayal, Harper dies in the ICU, her final question—“am I finally a perfect wife?”—haunting Samuel forever.

title: The Stand-in Daughter-in-Law
description: Blind for six months. The day Eleanor's sight returns, she watches her daughter-in-law get killed by her own twin sister, who then takes the victim's place. Now, she must play along with the killer, act the loving mother, and destroy her from within.

title: New mother Moves In: Losing Everything
description: After Camilla gets Declan Vance drunk, they have a shotgun wedding, and he divorces his former spouse, Audrey. Camilla abuses her stepdaughter Mia, mistreats her spouse's mother, and conspires with her secret lover, Ezra. She lies about carrying Declan's baby, which is actually Ezra's biological child. She scams Declan for money and cars, even forcing him to sign IOUs. Eventually, the affair is exposed, Declan gets injured, and he divorces Camilla. Encouraged by Audrey and his daughter, Declan comes to his senses, leading to the family's reconciliation.

title: Tide of Forbidden Touch
description: Newlywed wife Emma was on her honeymoon in Hawaii when her husband Jack arranged for her father-in-law Victor to teach her how to surf. The husband was piloting a motorboat ahead, sharing a surfboard with Emma. Victor tightly hugged Emma from behind, experiencing a sustained and secretive desire that gradually spiraled out of control amidst the intense waves. Emma and Victor engaged in a forbidden love affair.

title: The Secret Recipe to Snatch a Billionaire
description: After being betrayed, Evelyn accidentally meets Leo, and they form a bond due to a misunderstanding. As they face family disputes together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. After helping Evelyn expose Madeline's lies, Leo falls deeply in love with her. And Evelyn, through her interactions with Leo, gradually lowers her guard and accepts him. Finally, after experiencing a series of twists and turns, they gain genuine love and find long-lost family members.

title: Country Gal to CEO's Bride
description: Emma, a self-made, country girl, has escaped a difficult life, and now works in the city. Life takes a turn for Emma, when she misidentifies handsome stranger William and is forced to marry him , unaware, that William is the CEO of Irving Corporation. Both William and Emma hope to get a divorce soon after, but sparks begin to fly when they move in together. To admit their love for each other and save Irving Corporation from falling into the wrong hands, Emma and William must tackle several obstacles and villains standing in the way of their blossoming romance.

title: The Virgin's Bucket List
description: High school student Lindsay's life takes a dramatic turn when Wayne Adams, a star football player recruited by her dad, Mike, the school’s football coach, moves into her home. Their initial encounter is tense, but Lindsay must suppress her feelings due to Mike's warnings. Determined to find a boyfriend before graduation, Lindsay's attempts often end in awkward situations with unreliable guys. However, Wayne is always there to help when she’s in trouble. As their bond deepens, they start a secret relationship. Meanwhile, bullying at school escalates, prompting Lindsay to take a stand for her peers. Her efforts earn the support and respect of the school community. In the end, Lindsay and Wayne are crowned Prom King and Queen, and Mike finally approves of their relationship.

title: Sold to the Wolf King
description: Elara was chained in a red wedding dress and dragged through the snow, sacrificed by her husband to save his pregnant mistress. He thought the Wolf King would destroy her. He thought she would die forgotten in the North. But seven years ago, Elara saved a starving wolf boy from a fighting pit and gave him a name. Now that boy is Kael, the ruthless Wolf King. When he returns to camp and sees Elara bleeding, burned, and whipped, the entire wolf army watches their king fall to his knees. The bride they mocked is the one woman he would burn the world for.

title: The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star
description: Jenna leads a double life: by day, she’s a quiet, unassuming student; by night, she secretly works as a stripper to pay for her sister’s medical bills. Her worlds collide one night when Casper, her cocky school rival and the star of the hockey team, walks into the club. He’s instantly drawn to the enigmatic dancer, Angel, unaware she’s the same girl he spars with at school. But the deeper their bond grows, the closer they come to unraveling each other’s truths.

title: The Quarterback Next Door
description: Forever invisible Skylar Heron hasn't started her senior year so hot. First, she's embarrassed in front of the whole school when trying to ask out her crush Jamie Donner, her childhood best friend and next-door neighbor. Then, she gets paired up with him to work on a class project together. And, finally, to top it all off, she's forced to live with him when his house burns down and he moves into her room! But now, Jamie's crazy ex-girlfriend is out to make their lives hell. The only thing that can save both their years is... to turn the school freak into the most popular girl in school!

title: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy
description: Jane Wellsy has a secret — she's got a crush on her step brother Nate Duncan. No one knows except for her worst enemy, hockey badboy Zach Gates. Even worse, Jane finds out Nate's new transfer student girlfriend was her bully from high school, Melissa! When Melissa finds Jane's smutty story and demands to know if it's about Nate, Zach swoops in to save her, kicking off their fake relationship to keep her secret safe. As they spend time together, Jane finds there's a warm, kind heart under Zach's cold bad boy persona, ready to heal her broken heart and face the world at her side...

title: Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky
description: Sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde, a sheltered northern princess must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.

title: The Way to Good Luck
description: Since childhood, her luck was stolen. Everyone around her pays the price. The village elder tells her: go to Cloud City, find your fated one, and break the curse. There she meets the richest man—her perfect opposite in every way. And accidentally becomes his fiancée.

title: The Reborn Wife's Redemption
description: After realizing she's been hating the wrong man her entire life, Elena dies in the arms of her husband Marcus. In a twist of fate, Elena is brought back in time. It's not too late, she still has time to change everything. In this life, she won't hate her husband... she will protect him at all cost.

title: Duke With Benefits
description: Small town girl Taylor puts her dreams on hold to follow her best friend and longtime crush to college, convinced he’ll finally ask her out…only for him to hook up with her roommate instead! With no friends and no place to live, Taylor thinks her life is over–until English royal Lord Travis Harrington swoops in and moves her into his mansion. Taylor vows to remain “just friends,” but with a hot British playboy for a roommate, that might be easier said than done…

title: Addicted to My Ex's Uncle: Forbidden Tenderness
description: Eve is haunted by steamy recurring dreams of a faceless mystery man. At a party, she meets him at last: Kai, a powerful mafia kingpin and also her boyfriend’s uncle.The dangerous Kai disregards morals to chase her. Eve struggles to resist him, but every heated entanglement stirs her hidden longing. She suffers a brutal inner battle between shame and craving.

title: Fatal Attraction: The Hybrid Princess
description: Natalie left everything behind to start a new life in the woods, until Alpha Jayce's invasion led to both her parents' deaths. Upon returning, Natalie learns that this new Alpha isn't who he seemed, and everything she knew about herself has been a lie. Can she trust this dangerous stranger when she can't even trust herself?

title: Stay-at-Home Dad Levels Up
description: The Stay-At-Home Dad Levels Up tells the story of Jack Parker, a penniless orphan deeply devoted to his wife and son. Unfortunately for Jack, his wife’s family has always disapproved of him, and are actively trying to sabotage their relationship. All that changes when Jack becomes the heir to one of the richest companies in the world. Now Jack must convince them that he is really a billionaire, before they sabotage his marriage, get his daughter taken away, or even have him killed.

title: I Swapped Bodies with My Nemesis
description: Lexey Ember and Nick Rivers hate each other’s guts. However, when they find themselves stuck in each other’s body, they must work together and find a way back into their bodies - and just maybe into love.

title: Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King
description: Harper's father sells her to a virgin auction to pay off his gambling debts. Her fate is sealed until Lucca Saviano, head of the Italian mob, steps in to save her. But what does the most dangerous man in the underworld want with Harper?

title: My Husband Killed Me, then I Won the Mega Ball!
description: Adoria Cummins gets murdered by her husband and is taken back in time! She uses the knowledge from her previous life to get revenge on all those who wronged her, starting with winning the Mega ball! Then comes Elijah Snyder, a lawyer who seems to have her best interest in mind, but there's just something about him… that seems too familiar.

title: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
description: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns into a heated bet that changes everything. Noah discovers the real reason: Liam is secretly obsessed with him. After Liam saves Noah from bullies, Noah decides to make peace with Liam and tries to straighten him out. But what Noah doesn't realize is that he's walking right into Liam's trap—and slowly being seduced by the one person he should hate most.

title: The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard
description: Three years ago, Jack Hawkins saved heiress Grace Christensen from an evil stalker, but when they reunite, a misunderstanding turns them into enemies. Now, with Grace's safety threatened again, her father hires Jack as her personal bodyguard. When they're forced to spend every second together, will they be able to resist each other?

title: Flash Marriage to the Wild Billionaire
description: After she supports him through law school, Vicente dumps her. His reason? He found a rich girl to marry! Heartbroken, Abril marries a stranger... only to discover he is the billionaire CEO Cristóbal Noriega!

title: Lethal Vows：Married to My Rival
description:
Former top assassin “Crescent Moon” Elena Sterling retires to live a normal life. On her wedding day, she discovers her fiancé and best friend’s betrayal. Her adoptive brother Lucas drugs her and sells her to a brutal underground death-match arena.

Saved by underworld godfather Dominic Rossi, who has searched for her for 15 years—ever since she saved his life in childhood—Elena signs a six-month fake fiancée contract with him. In return, Dominic helps her take revenge and uncover the truth of the Nightshade assassin camp’s fall.

Cold and guarded at first, Elena gradually falls for Dominic’s silent protection. When their enemy Bianca attacks, Dominic takes a deadly poisoned bolt for her. Forged documents later separate them, misleading Elena into believing his family killed her people.

After exposing the mole and clearing misunderstandings, they learn Elena is the sole survivor of the destroyed Sterling noble family, fallen to a criminal alliance’s plot.

The couple defeats all enemies and regains Elena’s inheritance. Dominic abandons his power, tears up the contract, and gives Elena a real lifelong promise. They leave the violent underworld behind, start a new life abroad, and welcome their child—two broken souls finally finding true, equal love.

title: My Billionaire Husband Doesn't Remember Me
description: Emma and Cameron were once in love until a fire tore them apart. Years later, Cameron returns seeking revenge, believing Emma betrayed him. After an accident causes him to lose his memory, he thinks Emma is his wife. Can their love survive the secrets, or is it too late for a second chance?

title: Taming My Bullies
description: Emma Parker is a new transfer to Maple Elite Academy - and she's picked a fight with The Big Four, on her very first day! Four rich heirs who rule the academy, they've decided she's public enemy number one! But maybe there's more than meets the eye. Rowan Calloway acts like a tyrant, but is he really a ruthless bully? And August Langford keeps helping her out. Have they met before? Who's Emma going to choose - her worst enemy, or her childhood friend?

title: Things I Wanted to Say
description:
Based on the novel by Monica Murphy. At an elite prep school ruled by legacy and power, Whit Lancaster is untouchable—dangerous, ruthless, and irresistibly magnetic. Then, a quiet outsider crashes into his path, and is faced with a dark bargain: Let him destroy her in private… or risk being ruined in public.
In a game of power, desire, and secrets—who will break first?

title: Forsaken for the Tyrant King
description:
Leora spent twelve years of blood, sweat, and tears training four dragon knights — only to be repaid with their indifference, betrayal, and the repeated machinations of her scheming, seemingly innocent cousin Isolde. Heartbroken beyond measure, at her eighteenth coming-of-age ceremony she publicly dissolved the dragon knight contracts and announced her marriage to the legendary bloodthirsty and brutal Dark Dragon Lord, Rian Draken.

After entering the Dark Dragon Domain, Leora unexpectedly discovered that Rian was nothing like the monster in the rumors. He bore a lethal curse — anyone who touched him would be burned, and she alone was the exception. Amid his respect, trust, and exclusive devotion, she felt, for the first time, the happiness of being firmly chosen.

By the time the awakened dragon knights knelt and begged for forgiveness, it was already far too late. Leora tore the past to shreds with her own hands, and together with her true king, she would rule the Dragon Domain side by side.

title: One Night or Forever
description:
Scorned by her husband, Kate drowns her sorrows in a bar—and wakes up next to a gorgeous escort named Felix. She pays him off. He won't let it go. When he shows up at her door, she offers a deal: "How much?" But Felix isn't just any gigolo—he's a billionaire duke in disguise. Soon she's riding private jets, dripping in jewels, and watching her cheating ex get publicly destroyed. Then comes the pregnancy—and her ex's desperate plea for forgiveness. Now Kate must choose: the gilded cage of marriage, or the wild, impossible truth of a love she never saw coming. Too bad Felix isn't giving her a choice. The ultimate showdown between two worlds is about to begin.

Please note that Episodes 50 and 51 of this series were AI-generated.

title: The Alpha's Forbidden Mate
description: Enslaved by the Alpha who slaughtered her family, Lyra is forced to the altar until his son Asher kills him and claims her. Their fated bond ignites, but Asher hides her and takes political Luna Selene to shield her. Selene's jealousy explodes into brutal torture, forcing his cruelty to mask his devotion. When Selene and brother Garrick's coup erupts into war, Lyra reveals she is a lost Alpha's daughter and helps crush it, killing Garrick herself. Selene is exiled, and Lyra is crowned his equal.

title: The School for Bad Boys
description: After being sent to Maplewood Reform School—a last stop before prison for the problem sons of wealthy families—openly gay teen Cody Calloway is NOT welcome. After all, the first rule of Maplewood is clear: any homosexual activity earns an immediate expulsion. Enter Beckett Hayes, the school's straight golden boy with a girlfriend, a dark past, and a growing obsession with Cody. Every stolen touch puts their freedom on the line…but some things are worth the risk.

title: Pregnant by My Ex's Professor Dad
description: On her first day of the semester, Emily catches her boyfriend cheating on her. That night, she has a wild one-night stand with a stranger named Charles. The next day, they are mutually shocked to find out that Charles is Emily's new professor. They maintain a professional student-teacher relationship, but there's an undeniable tension between them. Just when Emily thinks everything will get back on track, she unexpectedly finds out she's pregnant...

title: The Billionaire's Forbidden Nanny
description: Fresh out of prison, Graziela is desperate for a fresh start. Her only chance is a job as a nanny for Alex, a ruthless billionaire who cares about only one person—his daughter. Alex puts Graziela through a series of brutal tests, determined to keep the mysterious nanny away from his little girl. But Graziela proves herself, slowly winning over the child—and the cold heart of the billionaire father. Just when Graziela begins to believe she can finally leave her past behind, the secret she's been hiding threatens to destroy everything she's built. She finally found a family worth fighting for. But when Alex discovers the truth, will he ever forgive her?

title: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love
description: Simon Williams has one shot of saving his baby brother, find him the perfect bone marrow match. Fate would have it, there's only but one perfect match, Leslie Maddison! In return for Leslie's donation, Simon must marry her so she can stay in the United States. Leslie needs a green card, and Simon needs her bone marrow. But what happens when Leslie finds out... Simon is actually the heir to a multi-billion dollar company and not the average joe who he makes himself out to be?

title: Love Is a Dangerous Dance
description: Hannah, a Farm-raised Ballerina, uses a contract engagement to secure her place in the prestigious Hargrove Ballet Company, but she's interrupted by Jack, a handsome assassin, who coerces her to help him. He's a dangerous obstacle, until Hannah discovers he could actually give her everything. As she finally surrenders, he pulls away... But when they face death together, they realize, life's too short to waste true love.

title: Rent-A-Mom for the Billionaire Twins
description:
Ruby only meant to take a temporary nanny job for quick money, but she accidentally walks into the frozen world of billionaire Ethan Cole and his impossible twins. The children have already driven away sixteen nannies, Ethan runs his home like a boardroom, and every corner of the estate is ruled by cold order instead of warmth.
What begins as a one-week trial quickly turns into something much larger. As Ruby challenges the household’s rigid rules, the twins slowly begin to trust again, Ethan is forced to confront the way he confuses control with parenting, and an external power struggle over custody, inheritance, and corporate leadership starts closing in.
Caught between family politics and emotional chaos, Ruby becomes the first person who can truly reach the children—and the first one capable of changing Ethan himself. What started as a hired role becomes something real: she was brought in to play a mother, but she ends up becoming the heart of the family.

title: My Stepbrother's Dirty Secret
