description: Alice transfers to St. Mary's High School after her mom remarries a millionaire--only to butt heads with James, a hot classmate who turns out to be her new stepbrother! Will Alice and James learn to get along? Or will their irresistable chemistry turn into something else?

title: My Forbidden Hockey Coach
description: Cole Sutton's private video accidentally plays in front of his hockey team, and Coach Vaughn Knox is the only one who stays calm. Everyone thinks Knox hates him, but Cole soon finds the truth: Knox has been watching, writing about him, and waiting to cross the line. When their forbidden relationship leaks, Cole's first-line spot is taken and Knox's career is at risk. The team thinks Cole slept his way up. Cole answers on the ice. He wins the game, proves Knox chose right, and walks straight into a relationship built on control, obsession, and a ring.

title: A Recipe for Revenge
description: Wynne Sloan had it all: a business empire and a decade-long marriage to Frank Quinn—until a "car accident" took her unborn child and her ability to have more. She soon uncovers Frank's affair with her own sister, Yvonne, and realizes the crash was no accident. From CEO to betrayed wife, Wynne masterminds a cold, calculated takedown. She strips Frank of his titles, fortune, and sanity, while sending Yvonne where she belongs: behind bars.

title: My Forbidden Brother
description: After her mother's remarriage thrusts her into the glamorous yet unfamiliar world of a chaebol family, Yi Seo finds herself living under the same roof as Ji Seung-hyun—her seemingly perfect but emotionally distant stepbrother. From the moment they meet, the two clash relentlessly, unable to stand each other. But as their constant battles give way to stolen glances and undeniable chemistry, the line between family and forbidden desire begins to blur. In a world where every emotion comes with a price, can they resist a love that should never exist?

title: The Heiress Returns at Forty
description: Hart has everything: a loving husband, brilliant children, and a quiet life as the wife of Adrian Hart, founder and CEO of HartX Technologies. Her only wound is the family she never knew. When a DNA test confirms that she is the long-lost daughter of the Whitmore family, Serena returns home before Christmas hoping for answers, not inheritance. Instead, she finds a family obsessed with reputation and a false heiress, Sylvia Bellamy, determined to protect the life stolen for her forty years ago. Serena's daughter Ava, a Stanford-bound teen prodigy, is humiliated; Serena's husband is mistaken for a laborer; and every act of patience is repaid with suspicion. As Sylvia's schemes escalate from theft accusations to public slander, Serena's true status as Mrs. Hart becomes the weapon no one saw coming. The story promises a mature heroine's emotional awakening, high-society humiliation, and the ultimate choice between blood relatives and the family that truly chose her.

title: Finding Master Right
description: Kate's always fantasized about a sexy man who will dominate her in the bedroom, but finding one is way easier said than done. Until Catacombs' notorious Master, Banner Jennings, offers to help her find the perfect Dom. But once he finds her sexual match, will he be willing to let her go?

title: Too Late for Us
description: In her past life, Karol Eisen married Prince Harold Jackson by royal decree. She gave him her heart, only to discover he loved someone else. After a life of neglect and abuse, she died in despair. Reborn, she swears never to repeat her tragic mistakes!

title: Submitting to My Ex's Dad
description: After catching her fiancé cheating with her best friend just before their wedding, Flora runs away and has a wild one-night stand with a handsome stranger. Little does she know he's her ex-fiancé's father, and he has a dark secret. Will she surrender to the heat—or is it time to run again?

title: Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love
description: Madison was a Manhattan heiress with it all—until she loses everything, including her now-cruel fiancé who stranded her in Texas. Broke and desperate, Madison wanders into a local saloon…and into the arms of Beau Hayes—her ex’s rugged, dangerously sexy cowboy uncle. After a steamy night, Beau offers her a job -- and an unexpected shelter. Now Madison’s trading pearls for cowboy boots, riding bulls, horses—and maybe even a cowboy.

title: Beach Volleyball Virgin
description: Jenny Taylor dreams of losing virginity to her nemesis stepbrother, Chris Riggins, and accidentally kisses him the next day, resulting in public shaming by Chris' girlfriend Natalie and the rest of the volleyball team. However, Chris suddenly becomes caring and considerate, defending Jenny every step of the way. Could this actually be the start of a taboo relationship?

title: The Forbidden Desire
description:
Thirty‑two‑year‑old Alice has a middle‑class marriage that others envy. Her husband Richard is a senior bank executive who provides abundant material comforts, yet their marriage is frigid. Plagued by Richard’s physical issues, their relationship is little more than a hollow formality, leaving Alice trapped inside a gilded cage.
Richard’s younger brother Noah comes to spend the summer, and their old romance resurfaces. They had been lovers before Alice’s marriage. Back then, Alice’s father fell seriously ill. Richard forced Alice into marriage by offering to cover her father’s medical expenses, and the two were torn apart.

title: The Little Goddess of Family Fortune
description:
Five-and-a-half-year-old Wynne was thrown out of her home by her stepmother, Hannah Otto. Wandering the streets late at night, she unexpectedly stopped Silas — CEO of the Lennox Group — and helped ease the illness of his only son, Lucian. Deeply grateful, Silas claimed her as his daughter on the spot and named her Wynne.
After entering the Lennox household, Wynne cured her brother's grave illness and, through a dream, helped her father escape a deadly predicament — transforming from a little jinx everyone despised into the little lucky star acclaimed throughout all of Shanghai. The domineering CEO Silas, too, gradually became a fiercely overprotective father.

title: The Billionaire's Fake Wife
description: When an explosion destroys Dr. Jen Connor’s lab, billionaire heir Roman Johnson rescues her and her comatose sister. Jen offers Roman one impossible deal: she'll pose as his sweet, old-fashioned fiancée for one weekend, so his cold, powerful father may restore the foundation funding she desperately needs. But inside the lavish Johnson estate, Jen faces ruthless tests from staff, family and Roman’s venomous ex-fiancée Kim, who begins to suspect the truth. As romantic tension builds between Jen and Roman, so does the risk of discovery. What starts as a lie becomes dangerously close to real love, just as Kim uncovers the secret Jen hoped would stay buried.

title: Fallen for the Beast
description: Elizabeth was forced to marry the ugly Lucas. After marriage, she chose to cooperate with him to regain her family fortune, but she was repeatedly harmed by her family. Under Lucas's protection and help, Elizabeth gained a foothold in the company. She faced malicious suppression from her family. And a mysterious man showed up, she began to doubt her husband's true identity. As they worked together to deal with crises, they started falling for each other. Elizabeth not only knew Lucas's identity, but also gained true love and family affection.

title: Little Miss Fortune
description: When James loses his daughter Amy and his legs on the same day, he stops believing in magic. Little does he know, Amy is now Mia, a fortune-telling prodigy come to save James from his fatal bad karma.

title: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother
description: Olive Parry agrees to be her BFF Sam’s fake girlfriend, and in return, he would pay for her expenses to save her little brother from his evil foster mom. One condition: don't fall in love with Sam’s older brother. Everything was working perfectly until Olive found out that the man she’d secretly pined for after a one-night stand, and Sam’s off-limit older brother were the same person.

title: Love You 1,000 Years
description: Jacob, an immortal, has been searching for Princess Prisca's reincarnation for 1,000 years. In South City, he finds Sylvia, a CEO resembling Prisca, and becomes her driver to protect her. But is she really his love?

title: Nights With My CEO
description:
Kate is a workaholic Wall Street analyst whose body has stopped cooperating. After a clinic mix-up, she meets Landon — the stranger who becomes her unexpected recovery partner.
He can't sleep without intimacy. She needs it to restart her body. So they make a deal: no feelings, no strings, just a temporary arrangement.
But the one person who makes them feel alive is hiding the biggest secret of all.
Landon isn't just her recovery partner.
He's her new CEO.

title: Every Night With You
description:
Desperate for money, Lila Hale takes a high-paying private-care job at the Voss Estate. There she meets Ethan Voss, the sharp-tempered head of a powerful conglomerate, publicly believed to be wheelchair-bound after a severe injury. Wary, Ethan tests Lila relentlessly. But Lila, heir to her grandfather’s filigree-inlay craft, holds fast to her principles and slowly earns his trust.

They sign a one-year companion contract: Lila acts as his public partner through corporate conflicts; in return, Ethan helps her reclaim her grandfather’s jewelry studio, seized by her stepmother. As days pass, their wary dynamic blooms into real feelings, and the transaction-based agreement begins to shift.

Ethan hides a secret tied to a car crash three years prior. The hostile Reed family schemes to bring him down and target Lila. Together they face traps, rumors, and power plays, uncovering truths bit by bit. Free of their contract, they preserve the time-honored craft and build a life rooted in genuine love.

title: One Night with the Governor
description: After her brother steals her savings, Esther takes a maid job for Governor Sean. When Sean is drugged by a woman, he has a one-night stand with Esther, but a misunderstanding leads him to dismiss her as a gold-digger. Esther soon becomes pregnant with his twins, and her ruthless family attempts to sell her into marriage. Discovering the truth, Sean rescues her. To survive the scandal, they enter a marriage of convenience, where genuine love begins to blossom despite external threats.

title: Offside with the Hockey Star
description:
At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the figure skating team glides through elegant routines. Abby Williams is the golden girl of the ballet-on-ice program — obedient, disciplined, and desperate to land the lead role of the Black Swan in the Winter Showcase. There's just one problem: she has no idea how to be "bad."

Enter Tristan Beaumont, the university's most notorious playboy and captain of the hockey team — reckless, magnetic, and hiding a devastating secret behind his bad-boy reputation. When Abby asks him to teach her how to unleash her dark side, neither of them expects what happens next: a forbidden attraction neither can control.

Standing between them is Taylor Beaumont, Tristan's younger brother — Abby's skating partner, her best friend, and the "good" Beaumont everyone expects her to choose. As rumors, sabotage, and a jealous rival threaten to destroy everything Abby has worked for, she must decide who she really wants — and who she's willing to fight for.

Torn between two brothers, a forbidden romance, and the role of a lifetime, Abby will learn that becoming the Black Swan means learning to stop following the rules — and start listening to her heart.

title: Slept With My Fiancé’s Brother
description: Lois bids farewell to the escort who has accompanied her for a month and resolves to marry a man she doesn’t love at all for a marriage of convenience. However, on the day of the engagement banquet, she discovers that the escort is actually the younger brother of her fiancé, Sebastian Hanley.

title: Flee With Dragon Cubs
description: Three months into her pregnancy with twin dragon children, Seraphina finally saw her fiancé Miles for who he truly was—while his mother pressured her to abort the babies, he rushed off to attend to another female dragon, Peggy. She decisively broke off the engagement and, with her Aunt Victoria's help, fled to Mistwood in the Westlands. Peggy and Miles's mother had long conspired to steal the trust property that should have been Seraphina's. Seraphina gave birth to twin daughters, Audrey and Hazel, who took her surname Quinn. Miles later realized his mistakes and pursued her to Mistwood to beg forgiveness, but she no longer needed his apologies. She began a new life and formed a natural friendship with her neighbor Owen, finally living as a whole and free woman.

title: My Fated Deal with the Alpha King
description:
Luna Violet wants to divorce her unfaithful partner, Alpha Kylan, but their marriage is tied to the political stability of the empire. Alpha King Nicholas denies Violet when she asks him for his blessing to leave Kylan. After King Nicholas turns Violet away, he is struck by a surprising revelation: He and Violet are fated mates. Violet has no idea—she has no wolf, and therefore cannot feel her fated bond to the Alpha King.

Nicholas is poisoned by wolfsbane, and needs Violet to secretly come to his palace every full moon to bleed & replenish him. The two are irresistibly drawn to each other, yet forced to resist, for the sake of her marriage... and the entire empire.

title: You Belong With Me
description: Kristine Wilson has always done the right thing, been the perfect girlfriend, perfect daughter, but that all changes when she meets Henry Lockwood. After spending years being abused by her family and cheated on by her fiance, she's fed up and done! To exact revenge on those who wronged her, Kristine makes a bold move. she sedueces Henry, the UNCLE of her cheating fiance, and the heir apparent of the Lockwood family fortune...

title: One Night with  the Vampire Lord
description:
Elena Hart never expected to spend one unforgettable night with the heir of the powerful Voss vampire family.
Terrified by his dangerous world, she disappeared the next morning.
But she left behind a secret:
She was carrying his child.
While another woman stole her identity and took her place beside the vampire lord, Elena lived alone, hiding the truth.
Months later, the vampire lord’s friend discovers Elena and reveals the impossible truth:
The woman he has been protecting was never the one from that night.
The real woman he has been searching for is carrying his child.
Now the cold and ruthless vampire heir will stop at nothing to protect Elena.
Because this time, he won’t let her disappear again.

title: Goodbye, Ex-husband I'm Racing with a Billonaire
description: Wren buried her Ducati, her guitar, and her soul to marry Ethan, who repaid her by telling her to be more like Chloe. That night, she walked out and into the arms of Julian Ashford—billionaire heir and motorsport royalty. He didn't want her small; he wanted her flying. As Julian helped her reclaim every piece of herself, Ethan watched his empire crumble, realizing too late he'd traded a diamond for dust. Wren learned real love doesn't ask you to slow down—it keeps pace.

title: Don't Mess with That Beggar S2
description: Timothy, exiled prince and secret heir to the deadly Reaper legacy, now lives as a street beggar after his throne is stolen by his treacherous brother. When Winnie, a daring noble heiress, publicly proposes and elopes with him, she thinks she's saving a pauper, but Timothy has secretly mastered unmatched martial arts and lethal poisons. As the empire reels and assassins close in, he waits for the perfect moment to reclaim his throne and rule with unstoppable power.

title: Sleeping with My Ex Husband's Son
description: Natalie built a thriving company but endured a disastrous marriage. Her ex-husband, Harrison, was caught having an affair with her female intern in the office — then had the gall to mock her as “a dead fish in bed.” Enraged, Natalie slapped him and walked out without looking back. After the divorce, Natalie unexpectedly crosses paths with Harrison’s son, Sebastian. But this meeting is no accident — eight years earlier, when he was still underage, Sebastian had already developed a secret infatuation with her. Now, driven by a need for revenge against his father, he hides his true identity as a powerful heir and joins Natalie’s company as her new intern. By day, Natalie is Sebastian’s boss. By night, Sebastian controls her deepest desires. Bound by a sexual pact, they become entangled in a web of lust and deception, navigating corporate battles, family vendettas, and the messy entanglements of the heart.

title: Oh No! I Slept with My Husband!
description: Beth reunites with billionaire Nathan Wright, her actual husband, who doesn’t recognize her.

title: Don't Mess with Supermom
description: After quelling external disturbances, the best warrior of Republic of Valoria, Zoe Miller, returns to home. However, she discovers that her daughter has been mistreated by her relatives David's family. In a fit of rage, Zoe unleashes a massacre at the banquet, accidentally revealing herself to be the legendary Secretary of Defense. Later, she learned that her adopted son Jacob had already been betrayed by enemy spy Robert, and what was even more astonishing was that Mia's father, President Louis, was also deeply involved in a power vortex. With Mia critically injured and on the verge of death, can Zoe successfully protect her daughter?

title: Pregnant With My Rival CEO's Baby
description: Vivian, a strong career woman, has exceptional work abilities. Leo, the president of a rival company, secretly admires her but has been repeatedly rejected when trying to recruit her. In her personal life, Vivian has a hard time. After being diagnosed with infertility, she discovers her boyfriend's infidelity. In a drunken state, Vivian has a one-night stand with Leo and surprisingly gets pregnant. To keep this hard - won child, she tries every means to hide it, not expecting that her "rival" is even more eager for the child's birth.

title: Sinking With My Step‑sister
description:
After a one‑night stand, Shirley is horrified to discover her lover Sophia is her stepsister. Terrified, she tries to keep her distance, yet Sophia pursues her relentlessly with bold advances, and they are nearly caught by their blended‑family parents. Overwhelmed by intense attraction, Shirley yields and embarks on a thrilling, forbidden secret romance with her.
Professor Sophia grows increasingly reckless, even flirting openly with Shirley at the freshman speech event. Envious Amy sets Shirley up and spreads lies to drive them apart. Heartbroken, Shirley breaks up with Sophia. Abducted by hitmen Amy hired, Shirley learns Sophia is secretly the underworld kingpin.
They reconcile. Just as Shirley plucks up courage to go public with their relationship, Sophia’s first love Vivian returns home. Rejected suitor Klein exposes their affair to their families. Amid fierce opposition, Sophia lets go of old grudges. Standing firm in their love, the two finally break free from social prejudices and stay together.

title: Private Lessons with My Vampire Boss
description:
After years of being dismissed by her husband, Eric, as uptight, boring, and hopelessly inexperienced, Chloe finally decides she’s had enough. Desperate to save her dying marriage—and prove she can be the woman he wants—she ventures into an exclusive underground club for a private lesson in pleasure.
But Chloe walks into the wrong room.
What she mistakes for an elite adults-only training session is actually a secret gathering where vampires select their human blood thralls. And the man she approaches for guidance is no ordinary instructor.
Victor is a ruthless billionaire, a predator hiding at the very top of human society—and a powerful vampire Dom accustomed to complete obedience.
Unaware of what he truly is, Chloe asks him to teach her how to submit.
One forbidden night leaves Victor craving far more than her blood. Using her desire to save her marriage as bait, he offers her a dangerous arrangement: become his sub, obey his every command, and serve as his exclusive blood thrall……

title: My Secret Affair with the Duke
description: In Regency London, slum orphan Elle is bought by Duke Alistair Belgrave to impersonate his half-sister "Estelle" and marry Percy Vane, freeing Alistair from a forced engagement with the obsessive Beatrix Vane. What begins as a cold transaction turns into forbidden desire as the fake siblings fall for each other, complicated by a secret execution order Alistair prepared for Elle. When Beatrix exposes Elle's true identity at her engagement ball, scandal erupts and Elle flees, convinced Alistair planned to kill her. As Beatrix closes in with a gun, Alistair takes a bullet for Elle and confesses: the order was never signed. They discover matching childhood scars proving fate bound them long before the bargain.

title: Romance Lessons with My Quarterback
description: Leo has always been one rank behind Jaxon, the star quarterback who takes everything Leo wants, including his crush, the hottest girl on campus. What Leo doesn't know is that Jaxon is secretly in love with him. So Jaxon tanks an exam on purpose, then makes Leo an offer — Tutor me to keep my captaincy, and I'll teach you how to win your dream girl. Studying calculus by day, dating lessons by night — and one plan Leo never accounted for, falling for his romance coach, his biggest rival.

title: Late Love With A Tycoon
description: Fifty-year-old cleaner Joyce Abbott is kicked out by her greedy son and daughter-in-law. In despair, she impulsively marries a security guard, Richard Sterling. Little does she know, her sweet new husband is secretly a billionaire! Even more shocking, his daughter, Stella Sterling, is Joyce's biological child she lost in the ruins 30 years ago. When her snobby in-laws return to humiliate her, her security guard husband steps up to protect her, sparking a heartwarming journey of sweet revenge and family reunion.

title: Fated with the Alpha CEO
description: On a full moon night five years ago, Sienna Miller, in a drunken mishap, stumbled into the wrong room and had a one-night stand with Xavier Payne, resulting in the birth of her son, Zack Miller. Fast forward four years, her son Zack begins to show strange symptoms, causing fear and misunderstanding among people, and is labeled a monster and locked up. Just as things seem dire, Xavier appears and saves Zack. It is then that Sienna discovers the mysterious man from five years ago is, in fact, the legendary werewolf...

title: 7 Steamy Days with a Ganster
description:
In the chaos of a brutal gang shootout, Violet, a nurse, instinctively saves Mattia, the ruthless leader of a powerful crime syndicate, from the brink of death. Little does she know that this act of mercy will ensnare her in a dangerous web of obsession.
Caught in a deadly game of love and betrayal, Violet must confront a heart-wrenching dilemma: stay true to her promise or succumb to Mattia’s seductive yet perilous affection. With each passing moment, the line between love and deception blurs, leading to a suspenseful showdown where only one truth can survive.

title: Don't Mess with That Beggar S2
description: Timothy, exiled prince and secret heir to the deadly Reaper legacy, now lives as a street beggar after his throne is stolen by his treacherous brother. When Winnie, a daring noble heiress, publicly proposes and elopes with him, she thinks she's saving a pauper, but Timothy has secretly mastered unmatched martial arts and lethal poisons. As the empire reels and assassins close in, he waits for the perfect moment to reclaim his throne and rule with unstoppable power.

title: Reborn, I Became Dragon Queen with My Daughter
description: Alchemist Alya is betrayed and killed by her husband Carlos, while giving birth. Reborn ten years earlier. Carlos chooses a princess over her and pushes her off a cliff. Alya then meets Regnis, the drugged Dragon King. After one night together, she gives birth to their half-dragon son Eugene. Seven years later, Carlos and the princess target them again. Regnis returns to protect Alya and Eugene. He exposes the truth and punishes their enemies. After many trials and misunderstandings, Alya and Regnis finally find happiness together.

title: An Affair With My Boss
description: Lena is a driven, ambitious executive fighting to maintain control of her family's company in the face of a brewing power struggle. Her world is turned upside down when she begins a secret affair with Finn, a new and much younger employee, while her best friend Rachael is having an affair with her husband, Mark, who is campaigning for a political seat.Complicating matters further, Liam, a ruthless rival,schemes to undermine Lena's leadership and seize control of the company. He manipulates Zoe, Lena’s secretary, to gather information and undermine Lena from within. As the web of deceit and betrayal deepens, alliances shift and loyalties are tested...

title: Reigning with the Devil
description: Chloe thought escaping a dark wizard's obsessive cage meant a second chance at life.Instead, her newfound “family” betrayed her, kidnapping her to be sacrificed in an illegal life-draining ritual.Now, suspended over a vat of corrosive potion,with her face melting away, her only hope rests on a man whose life she once saved……

title: After One Night with the Dragon King
description:
Seraphina, a dragon‑blood half‑breed, is born unable to shift into dragon form. Her fiancé Damon publicly breaks off their engagement, and the pure‑blood princess Vexia crushes her scales to humiliate her. On the eve of her coming‑of‑age ceremony, she acts on impulse and spends the night with a stranger. Upon waking, she discovers he is none other than Silas, the youngest Dragon King of the dragon clan.
That night re‑ignites her long‑dormant dragon blood, leaving an invisible burning brand etched into her palm. At the coming‑of‑age ceremony, where everyone waits to witness her disgrace, she steps onto the high platform. The dragon flames bow and pay homage to her. The High Priest, stunned, proclaims: “This half‑dragon possesses one‑hundred‑percent dragon‑flame compatibility.”
The Dragon King, who had watched everything with cold detachment, had already transfused his own dragon blood into her veins the night before.

title: Boyfriend Sleeping with Another Woman
description: Verona is trapped outside as her boyfriend Brennan sleeps with her high school bully Talia. She discovers Brennan knew Talia’s identity but still betrayed her. Talia escalates, leaking old nude videos and photos. Verona attempts suicide. Later, Verona reveals she deliberately pushed Brennan toward Talia to destroy her—using him as a tool for revenge. Talia is expelled; Brennan is left broken. Verona leaves for a new life abroad, finally free.

title: Don't Mess With the Real Heiress
description:
The only daughter of the tycoon Miles, heir to Rong Group, Mirabel, has finally returned from studying abroad.
Miles's secretary and girlfriend, Regina, eager to gain Mirabel's approval and secure her marriage into the family, brings along a priceless medical reagent—personally gifted to her by Miles — to greet Mirabel at the airport.
But by a twist of fate, Mirabel stops a car and the reagent is shattered. In a fit of rage, Regina, not knowing Mirabel's true identity, does something to her that she will regret for the rest of her life.

title: A Moment with You
description: After a whirlwind marriage to Avery Yale, Blake Lander hides his true identity as a wealthy CEO, mistakenly believing Avery to be a gold-digger. Struggling through a difficult life, Avery faces bullying at work and betrayal by her family, whom she once trusted. Fortunately, Blake is always there to protect her from harm, forging a deep connection between them as they gradually fall in love. However, when Blake's real identity is revealed, a misunderstanding creates a rift in their relationship, which can only be healed when the truth comes to light. Determined to make her his, Blake proposes, and together they embark on a new chapter of their lives.

title: Oops, You Messed with the Mastermind Queen!
description: Chloe is a brilliant strategist and a master of deflection.When she’s framed for seducing the dean, she instantly throws the real mistress, her own supervisor, straight under the bus.In retaliation, the mistress sets a deadly $500K embezzlement trap.Cornered, Chloe makes her boldest move yet: she fakes a severe concussion and slides the damning authorization token straight to the Chancellor.The next day, the mistress storms the VIP ward with campus police, demanding thearrest of the token’s final holder—completely unaware of the titan standing right behind the curtain.

title: Accidental Triplets with the Billionaire
description: Urgently needing an heir to secure his position in the company, Oscar turns to surrogacy. But unexpectedly, his sperm is accidentally injected into Phoebe, who comes in for a gynecological exam. To ensure Phoebe keeps the baby, Oscar proposes a contract marriage, and the two embark on a journey filled with tests...

title: Besties with My Mother-in-Law
description: Elena Davis and her husband Jason Miller share a daughter, Penny. Elena faces constant extortion from her brother Tommy Davis and her mother Karen Davis, who favors boys over girls and abuses Grandma. To make things worse, Jason cheats with his mistress Samantha Reed and demands a divorce. But Elena finds an unlikely ally in her mother-in-law, the powerful businesswoman Eleanor Miller, who treats her like her own. Samantha soon fakes a pregnancy, steals confidential files, and even attempts to murder Eleanor by triggering an asthma attack with Aspirin. Elena swiftly exposes the deadly scheme, landing Samantha in jail. In the end, Elena divorces Jason, becomes besties with Eleanor, and starts a beautiful new life with Penny and Grandma.

title: Don’t Mess With Her
description: When Sheila Collin comes to visit her billionaire brother Nathan Collin, his fiancée Megan mistakes her for a poor nobody and unleashes torrents of abuse. Little does Megan know, Sheila is the real big boss of the Collins Group. At a lavish birthday gala, the truth unravels, sealing the arrogant fiancée's fate.

title: Never Cross the Cleaner
description: Wade, founder of Blackshield Group, lives incognito as a cleaner just to stay by his daughter Debbie’s side. When Debbie is bullied, injected with drugs and nearly drowned by Mark, heir of the Leonard family, Wade flies into a rage and steps back into the fray. He settles scores with his enemies with overwhelming force. Teaming up with neurologist Irene to save his daughter, he regains control of Blackshield and protects his family.

title: Don't Mess with That Masseur
description: After seeing gambling ruin many families, Ray Cooper, the Gamble Demon, vowed to eliminate the vice. He defeated top gambling legends and retired, living as a foot masseur. Years later, his sister-in-law's casino debt pulls him back. Vice still thrives. Disguised as a scruffy worker, Ray returns to underground casinos, using gambling as his weapon to clean up the vice.

title: My Three Ungrateful Brothers Come Crawling Back
description: Oriana's mom passed away when she was 6; her stepmother abandoned her at a trailer park. When she was 12, she saved the richest man on earth, Murray Morel, and was adopted as his granddaughter. 2 years later, her three brothers found her, and she decided to return to her biological family. In consideration of their egos, she hid her wealth from them but still secretly helped her brothers to succeed in school. However, the brothers are fooled by her evil stepsister and start to bully her. They kicked her out and almost beat her to death. After getting rescued by her adopted Grandfather, she finally sees the true colors of her brothers. She breaks up with them and plans to take everything back. The punished brothers eventually realize that Oriana is their real family and beg on their knees for her forgiveness.

title: The Boy Without Destiny
description: Cast aside as ordinary, Rowan never imagined he was born for destiny. But when the legendary chain Gleipnir chooses him, he becomes the only one capable of stopping Fenrir and the coming of Ragnarok. Now, the forgotten son must rise to save the Nine Realms.

title: From NYC with Warehouse
description: Adam Foster travels back from the future and becomes the son of a fallen official. He loses his family, title, and hope overnight. But fate throws him a lifeline—a cosmic glitch has bound him to a colossal warehouse at Yobor from his own time. Armed with modern resources, knowledge, and sheer audacity, Adam begins his impossible comeback. From turning trinkets into treasure to outsmarting the corrupt elite, he builds an empire where none should exist.

title: Addicted to My Fiancé's Uncle
description: Engaged for four years, Roberta Depp's fiancé changed girlfriends like clothes. She faked tears but secretly cheered, marrying into wealth with no wifely duties is a steal! After a wild one-night stand with a hot stranger, she thought she'd never see him again. Yet at a family dinner, the man sat at the head of the table. Guess who just slept with her fiancé's uncle?

title: My Secret Son with the Billionaire
description: Six‑year‑old Noah suffers from serious congenital heart disease. His mother Luna crashes her stepsister Melissa’s engagement party to seek medical funds, striking a three‑month courtship deal with powerful billionaire Ethan. Unbeknownst to Ethan, Noah is his biological son from a drugged one‑night encounter years before. Melissa frames Luna and forges DNA reports to seize the Monroe family fortune. After countless dangers, schemes and misunderstandings, the truth surfaces. Luna drops her guard, and the whole family finally gains true happiness.

title: One Night, One Forever
description: Lila Carter, a 24-year-old waitress from a modest background, is trying to find her footing in life. After a particularly rough breakup, she goes out for a drink at a local bar and meets Ethan Grayson, a wealthy and charismatic billionaire. One night of passion leads to unexpected consequences. Lila discovers she’s pregnant. Fearing the reaction of her strict and overbearing mother, Vivian, Lila keeps the pregnancy a secret. But the weight of her decision begins to take a toll. After a month of stress, guilt, and a barrage of verbal abuse from her mother, Lila is forced to confront her past and reveals the pregnancy to Ethan. In their marriage, the tension is palpable. Ethan continues his relationship with Sophia Blake, a glamorous but manipulative influencer, while Lila struggles to adjust to her new life as a wife to a man who doesn’t want her. As the months pass and Lila’s pregnancy progresses, Ethan finds himself torn. His initial bitterness fades as he begins to see Lila not as a golddigger but as a strong, independent woman with a heart of gold. The way she lovingly cares for their unborn child and the resilience she shows in the face of adversity draw Ethan closer to her...

title: On One Condition
description: Cassie has always been an ambitious lady, super competitive, smart, an overachiever and supposedly, heir to the Blue Empire. After the death of her father, she discovers she did not just inherit wealth but debts and her father's enemies. Her ego is challenged when she falls in love with Ethan, an employee at her company, embarrassed to admit it, she finds herself having a secret relationship with him. This went on for a while until she finds out that he had been dating her sister, Julia and it was all a scheme to get her to fund the luxurious wedding they plan to have. She blatantly refuses and threatens to fire the guy but then, he threatens to expose her and blackmails her with a deadly secret that Cassie has been hiding.In an attempt to free herself from their grasp, she does her own digging and finds out that Ethan is her step brother who is hell bent on destroying the Blue legacy and that her father’s death wasn’t an accident after all but a calculated plan gone wrong by her sister to take over the company but she has no proof that Julia actually attempted to kill their father. She still went ahead and threatened to expose her sister but can’t do so without dragging herself down and ruining the image of the company. Julia denies having anything to do with her father’s death so they are caught in an endless game of cat and dog...

title: I moved on, and he fell apart
description: Noble heiress Luna lost her memory after falling off a cliff, completely forgetting Evan, the heir to the empire’s overlord, whom she had humbly pursued for five years. After awakening, she cut off all affection, agreed to a family-arranged marriage, and coldly struck back at the provocations from Evan and the two-faced “white moonlight” woman. After a drowning incident in which Evan left her to die, Luna made a dignified farewell to the past at a banquet. Meanwhile, Evan, long accustomed to being favored, gradually lost control amid Luna’s coldness and headed toward an irredeemable wife-chasing crematorium.

title: One More Time
description: Alex has always loved Rachel but never made an attempt to ask her out. He finally gets a chance but unfortunately life had other plans.

title: His Only Exception
description: Nora was called a murderer's daughter and she was Ryan's kept woman. Ryan looked down on her and didn't want his family or friends to meet her. Ryan's uncle Paul was saved by Nora a long time ago, and he had loved this poor girl for many years. In his past life, Nora killed herself after knowing Ryan had a fiancee. In this lifetime, Paul would be Nora's loyal knight. Paul decided to help her shine in her career and earn respect again. Ryan only got to regret, but Nora would only choose Paul.

title: Dream On
description: Based on the novel by Jennifer Hartmann. When Lexington Hall, the biggest movie star, asks Stevie to be his fake girlfriend, it should have been her Hollywood dream come true. The problem? He's the ex who left her broken-hearted. Is this a dream, or her worst nightmare?

title: I Sent My Mom on a Blind Date
description: Joy is a successful woman, but to her mother, Camila, she's just a "leftover" daughter in desperate need of marriage. After a car accident, Joy wakes up in 1994. Determined to give her mother a taste of her own medicine, Joy drags her to blind dates, only to realize love isn't so simple. As Camila faces two suitors and relentless family pressure, Joy begins to wonder if her own existence should matter less than her mother's happiness until a shocking truth reveals she was never Camila's biological daughter at all.

title: Blame It on the KPIs
description: As The Heir, Vanguard Manufacturing Group newcomer Miles Foster works diligently to resolve crises, eliminate rivals, and successfully take the company public.

title: The Mic Was Still On
description: Jessamine spent nine years turning Dashiell Carrington from an undrafted nobody with two blown knees into the captain of the New York Comets. She rebuilt his body, ghostwrote his apologies, and quit her own career to manage his. He repaid her by sleeping with his twenty-one-year-old content producer, handing the girl a training program Jessamine had created, and telling the cameras his family was everything — while his pregnant wife sat in the ER alone. He forgot to take off his mic after the game. She downloaded three copies. Then she called his mother — who happened to chair the team's board — and said two words: "I'm leaving." She didn't take the nursery, the jerseys, or the baby skates with his number on them. She took four rehab journals, a passport, and the original manuscript he told her wasn't worth publishing. Six months later, the Comets had a new president. Her name was Jessamine. No last name required.

title: Torn Between the Mafia Twins
description: She discovers her mob boss husband's affair and loses one of her twin babies due to his adopted sister's schemes. She reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, she runs into him on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when he drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth. Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. The ruthless mafia boss only wants one thing—to win her love back.Based on Tempting the Mafia Twins by Tatienne Richard on MyFiction.

title: The Strongest God King on Earth
description: Zane Hayes, the Son of the God King, is sent to Earth for a trial. To keep him from cheating, the God King demands he use only Legal means and sends Aetherion to oversee him. Full of doubts, Zane Hayes begins his mission. He becomes a professional Warrior to achieve his goals, fighting for justice and protecting the weak. As the trial progresses and he sees the beauty of human nature, Zane Hayes gains a whole new perspective on the mortal world.

title: Spoiled by the Daddy CEO During Pregnancy
description: Dawn’s fling with a stranger just got a billion-dollar twist: surprise pregnancy, and the baby daddy is none other than billionaire heartthrob Isaac Stanton! You’d think Dawn’s hit the jackpot… except why is she running away?!

title: You've Got Male
description: Leila Reid, a local bookstore owner, promised her dying grandpa she’d marry and have kids. It all falls apart when her husband, Eric, cheats on her on their wedding day. In desperation to fulfill her promise, she sleeps with a callboy named Mark, unaware that he's actually Matthew Callaway, a billionaire hotel conglomerate, Eric’s long-term friend…and her business nemesis. Throughout the day, they clash as adversaries, but at night, they find solace in each other's arms. As Leila navigates loss and hardships in life, her feelings for Mark and Matthew grow complicated. When his double identity is finally revealed, Mark/Matthew is faced with the greatest challenge of his life: make Leila Reid fall in love with him, twice.

title: Tempting the Mafia Twins
description:
Genesis discovers her mob boss husband, Kiefer's affair, and loses one of her twin babies due to his mistress' schemes. Genesis reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant.
Seven years later, Genesis runs into Kiefer on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when Kiefer drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth: Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. Kiefer O’Reilly, the ruthless mafia boss, only wants one thing—to win Genesis’s love back.Based on Tempting the Mafia Twins by Tatienne Richard on MyFiction.

title: Legend in the Making [Season One]
description: Deemed a waste, he's a transmigrator who awakens a system in the womb! Mastering the Ancient Sacred Body, he stuns the Immortal Realm at birth. Humiliated? He awakens the Supreme Bone. Oppressed? He crushes foes instantly. From outcast to Supreme Being, his invincible path is destined from the womb.

title: Once Love Is Lost, It Never Returns
description: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated by her brother Maxwell and her family. As her trauma becomes impossible to ignore, Maxwell begins to doubt his judgment — but when Claire gives up on ten years of love and walks away, he finally realizes the truth was never what he believed.

title: Jilted at the Altar, I Flash-Married a Mysterious Billionaire
description: Sylvia, heir to the Slin Group in Los Angeles, was abandoned by her three adopted brothers on her eighteenth coming-of-age ceremony, all because of lies spun by Mia, the housekeeper’s daughter. Overwhelmed by despair, she chanced upon Silas, a mysterious tycoon, in a bar and married him on impulse. Faced with betrayal from her adoptive brothers and Mia’s relentless schemes, Sylvia grows from a dependent girl into an independent woman. Protected by her husband Silas, she reclaims control of the group, makes the wrongdoers pay for their crimes, and ultimately gains a thriving career, true love, and reconciled family bonds.

title: Married at First Sight
description: You married a stranger with a promise to divorce, but now he doesn't want to let you go!

title: From Mudblood to Atlantis' Owner
description:
In Atlantis, only godblood mermaids are allowed to live. Mudbloods are crushed at birth.

I, Princess Rosalie, am a mudblood.

My mother used dark magic to hide it. But on the day I gave birth, my husband Xavier discovered the truth, and I died by his hand.

Now I'm reborn. I reject Xavier and choose to marry a mute slave instead.

They all laugh. They say I've lost my mind.

But they don't know the truth. He's not just a slave. He's Pure Godblood. The rarest, most powerful bloodline in Atlantis."

title: I'm not waiting for you at the end
description: Ava crosses thousands of miles to watch Nolan's final, only to be humiliated by him and his new fiancee, Chloe. Armed with forum posts, access logs, model permissions, deepfake evidence, and hearing records, she exposes the theft of her research and the campaign to destroy her name. By the final whistle, she has taken back her future, built her own sports data company, and chosen the man who truly hears her.

title: Burn at Her Wedding
description: Evelyn Grant exposes Max Lang using the Grant family for power while cheating with Serena Rivers. She exacts revenge at her wedding and later finds true love with Adrian Preston.

title: Winds of the Atlantic
description:
Three years ago, 
Professor Elias took in a 
homeless boy, Arthur. 
Three years later, Arthur 
has grown into a young 
man whose secret crush on 
his professor has become 
an obsessive pursuit, 
dragging Elias into a 
forbidden affair. 
Rejection, a vengeful 
fiancée, and university 
pressure push them to the 
brink. To save Arthur's 
future, Elias takes all 
the blame, resigns, and 
flees to the Atlantic 
coast. But Arthur follows 
him in the most extreme 
way. Amid fireworks, 
violin music, and 
crashing waves, Elias 
finally drops his guard 
and admits his love. Two 
years later, at Arthur's 
graduation, Elias 
proposes in public. They 
overcome all boundaries 
and build a warm family 
together by the sea.

title: Reborn at Eight, Changing Dad's Fate
description: She faked his death and sold him out. Now he's back—with a trillion‑dollar foster father, a CEO partner who sees the future, and a plan to bury every last one of them. When the DNA test drops, he grabs her throat: "That fake death pill you sold? Just enough to buy their graves."

title: Died at Work, Got a Family
description: Adrian Vale, a worker at Elixir Works in the Immortal Realm, dies in a car accident, only to be reincarnated in the body of Henry, the neglected eldest son of the Lynch family. Once a bitter man mistreating his wife and in-laws, Henry is now touched by the warmth and care he receives. Inspired by this newfound love, Adrian, a thousand-year seeker of immortality, decides to lead his family on the path to power and eternal life.

title: Underestimate Her at Your Peril
description: Vivian Whitmore, a brilliant CEO with a perfect life, survives a car accident only to uncover a shocking betrayal: her fiancé is her stepfather's illegitimate son. He's plotting to steal everything from her and even plans to commit her to a mental hospital. Refusing to be defeated, Vivian hires a bodyguard and fights back, determined to reclaim what is rightfully hers.

title: Died at Work, Got a Family
description: Adrian Vale, a worker at Elixir Works in the Immortal Realm, dies in a car accident, only to be reincarnated in the body of Henry, the neglected eldest son of the Lynch family. Once a bitter man mistreating his wife and in-laws, Henry is now touched by the warmth and care he receives. Inspired by this newfound love, Adrian, a thousand-year seeker of immortality, decides to lead his family on the path to power and eternal life.

title: Love Finds Me at 45
description: At 45, Sophia takes a job as a cafeteria cook at Yard Group, unaware that CEO Jackson has spent five years searching for the woman from one unforgettable night. Mistaking Gemma for her, he brings her home and treats her like royalty. Meanwhile, the real woman he's searching for is cooking his meals every day. Then 5-year-old Rowan points to Jackson's mole and asks, "Why is yours just like mine?"

title: Was the Heiress Switched at Birth?
description: On the same day, two best friends give birth. But Edith, born into poverty, secretly swaps her baby with her CEO friend’s—hoping to give her daughter a life of luxury. What she doesn’t expect is that the CEO sees everything and quietly switches the babies back. Eighteen years later, just as Edith’s plan is about to succeed, she discovers the shocking truth: the daughter she’s mistreating all these years is her own.

title: The Chancellor at My Door
description: Awakening in an unfamiliar era, Vicky Shaw is unexpectedly thrust into the role of a mother. Time has transported her to a new world, where she must navigate life with two young children by her side. Armed with healing powers and an indomitable spirit, this once-outcast heiress is determined to claim the life she rightfully deserves.

title: Left at the Airport, Worth a Billion
description: For seven years, Lucas Cross did all the housework and paid every bill—while his wife's family called him a useless moocher. When they jet off on vacation without him, refusing to buy him an $890 ticket, they leave him stranded at the airport. What they don't know: the man they just abandoned is the chairman of a billion‑dollar conglomerate. That day, something in him breaks for good. He files for divorce. As his true identity comes to light, the family's world crumbles—her friend is exposed as a gambling fraud, and his wife comes crawling back. But Lucas has already closed the door. Some regrets come too late.

title: Married at First Sight
description: You married a stranger with a promise to divorce, but now he doesn't want to let you go!

title: Reborn: Female CEO at My Feet
description: Reborn on the very day Valerie Stanton breaks off their engagement and humiliates him publicly, Miles Sterling awakens the Goddess Conquest System. He opens lucky chests, crushes Felix Vance and the security guards with ease, and turns Valerie’s attitude around instantly. After unlocking a $50 million black card from a chest, he exposes her desperate funding crisis. Valerie begs and fawns over him for a loan, her favor skyrocketing. Dominating the system step by step, Miles rises to the very peak of success!

title: The Cursed Alpha's Mute Bride
description: Cursed mute, Wren believes no one will ever love her—until she meets Alpha Hunter Silver, who says they’re mates! But Hunter is cursed, too… Can they find love together and break their curses?

title: The Billionaire and the Baby Trap
description: To get out of her loveless marriage, Elara needs to get pregnant, but her husband refuses to touch her. One fateful night, she finds herself in Cole's arms, not knowing he's a secret billionaire CEO -- and her husband's uncle. When will Elara realize Cole's identity -- and that he's just the Mr. Right she's been looking for.

title: Humiliated at My Wedding
description: On the day of her wedding to Lucas Kirk, Angelina Alvarez, daughter of a billionaire, faces shocking accusations about the paternity of her unborn child. Defying medical advice, the Kirk family pressures her into an amniocentesis. Thankfully, her father's medical team intervenes, ensuring the child's safety and leaving the Kirk family full of remorse. Empowered by her newfound independence, Angelina inherits her family's fortune and embarks on a journey to live life by her own rules.

title: 30 Days Till I Marry My Husband's Nemesis
description: Blair Rose gets another chance in life after her husband murders her in cold blood. This time, she's out to teach him a lesson. The only thing she missed in her meticulous planning is falling in love with Nathan Forbes, the tall, handsome playboy heir to the Forbes family. Is this another mistake or her second chance at love?

title: Love Under Attack
description: Leading lady, Jess Gonzales, must whittle down 25 male suitors to four that she wants to actively date. After she makes her choice, the remaining singles she rejected have the opportunity to sabotage her dates for a cash prize!

title: Ruthless Mafia Daddy
description: The day Ellie's IVF process is a success, she finds out her fiance and her best friend are having an affair. Devastated, she decides to raise her child alone. The doctor reveals there's been a mix up at the sperm bank - she's pregnant with the Mafia Boss' baby. Ellie has been unwillingly dragged into a mafia war of succession. In order to protect her unborn baby, she agrees to a contract marriage with the mafia boss. They never thought this would lead them to true love.

title: You Ignored My Birthday So I Erased Myself From The Family
description:
My family never remembered my birthday. Ethan’s meant a steakhouse booked a month ahead; Chloe’s meant Six Flags and Mom’s Instagram carousel: “Happy birthday to our little princess.”
Mine is July 19th, mid-summer—always ignored. On my eighteenth, I woke early, put on makeup, and waited on the couch. Mom passed with Chloe’s dance bag: “Heat your own lunch. I’m taking her to intensive.” Dad left with Ethan to play ball. By noon I was alone.
I texted the family chat: “I’m eighteen today! 🎉” Silence. At seven they came home—Ethan’s ribs, Chloe’s mac and cheese. No cake. No candles. No song. Nothing missing, to them. Everyone got a birthday except me. I was eighteen now. I could finally choose where to go.

title: From Death Row to Throne
description: The top assassin Liam time-traveled to ancient times and became a death row prisoner, but he activated the Kill Enemies to Get Stronger System. He made a comeback in the army, killing bad rich men, but was blamed by the imperial court. To break the deadlock, he pretended to defect to the enemy and worked with a female general Eleanor. Liam defeated the enemy leader in battle, and achieved great success. His high achievements shocked the ruler and were framed by the fatuous monarch. Ultimately, he killed the monarch and established himself as the new ruler.

title: From Courier to CEO
description: After putting his wife through graduate school, courier Nate is kicked out by her greedy family—with nothing. On the day of his divorce, he saves the life of Archibald, a wealthy patriarch who collapses from a heart attack. To repay him, Archibald's granddaughter—icy heiress Evelyn—offers Nate a one-year marriage contract. When his ex-wife catches wind, jealousy drives her to team up with a spoiled rich kid to destroy him. But Nate stops holding back. With skill and grit, he fights back and builds his own business from scratch. And as the contract runs its course, a real bond begins to grow...

title: From Heartbreak to Fated Lover
description: For four years, Ava believed Mason Collins loved her. But when his first love returns, he calls Ava nothing but a "pastime." Humiliated and broken, she accepts a contract marriage with the tycoon, Anderson Lauren. But this marriage is more than a deal. Anderson has been searching for Ava for years, and he'll do anything to protect her—even if she doesn't remember him. As buried truths surface and hidden enemies close in, Ava discovers she was never just an orphan.

title: From Wicked Aunt to Famine Savior
description: After transmigrating into a famine-stricken world, an agronomist takes over the body of Jena, a woman despised for nearly selling her niece. Determined to rewrite her fate, Jena leverages her modern expertise to cultivate sweet potatoes, dumps her toxic partner, and lifts her family out of poverty. Her farming revolution ends the famine. She becomes the Harvest Deity!

title: From Prison to Palace_ Revenge of the Mad Queen
description: Default

title: From Fake Marriage to Forever
description: Exiled as a child by her stepmother, Ruth Sinclair returns to Veridia's capital to uncover the truth behind her grandmother's death. Forced into a marriage with Ryan Hayes – the most notorious playboy – she soon discovers he is secretly the head of the Whisperwind, an elite intelligence network. Together, they expose a deadly conspiracy involving her stepmother, Madeline, and a foreign power. As they hunt for justice, their calculated alliance ignites into a fierce, undeniable love.

title: From Orphan to CEO's Daughter
description: The orphan Emma was abandoned by her foster parents. Then she met the dying Andrew. After Andrew adopted her, he became healthy again and earned more money, even his mom's disease was cured. Andrew found Emma was his lucky girl who could help him achieve great success in the business world. Andrew exposed his uncle's scheme and reclaimed his family fortune with Emma.

title: From Trash To Cash: How I Found A Billionaire
description: Orphan Emily, betrayed and drunk, accidentally hits a man named Snoke in a pile of trash. He loses his memory and believes he is her fiancé. As Snoke’s gentle company and constant good luck heal her heart, Emily falls for him. Just as she’s about to tell him the truth, Snoke is recognized as a missing billionaire heir… Can Emily’s dream last? And who is he really?

title: From Ugly Duckling to CEO's Heart
description: After a childhood disappearance and a humble upbringing, Harper Foster returns to society following her grandfather's death—not only to reclaim his stolen legacy but also to uncover the truth about her biological parents. Disguising herself as unattractive to avoid alerting her enemy, she accepts an invitation to stay with the Hawthorne family. Mocked and underestimated, Harper repeatedly reveals her hidden identities, catching the attention of the three Hawthorne brothers. In the end, she reclaims her inheritance, finds her real family, and finds love with one of the Hawthorne heirs.

title: From Exile to Heiress
description: Her deeply loved husband poisoned her, cheated on her, and even kicked her out of the house! Maybe its time to let them know who she actually is...

title: From Death Row to Throne
description: The top assassin Liam time-traveled to ancient times and became a death row prisoner, but he activated the Kill Enemies to Get Stronger System. He made a comeback in the army, killing bad rich men, but was blamed by the imperial court. To break the deadlock, he pretended to defect to the enemy and worked with a female general Eleanor. Liam defeated the enemy leader in battle, and achieved great success. His high achievements shocked the ruler and were framed by the fatuous monarch. Ultimately, he killed the monarch and established himself as the new ruler.

title: From Prey to King
description: Left for dead. Powered by devouring. Destined to rule. As an abandoned cub climbs from the bottom of the food chain to a legendary beast, one truth becomes clear: the entire Beast Realm made a fatal mistake.

title: From Rags to Top Scholar
description: Born poor, Lily Vance studies relentlessly. Trusting her father that education is the best escape, she aces her exams and earns everyone's respect.

title: From General's Scorned Wife to His Final Judgment
description: A duke's daughter once propelled her husband to become a legendary general, only to face betrayal and execution at the hands of him and his mother. Reborn from the ashes, she returns with a steely resolve and a heart of ice. Methodically, she dismantles those who wronged her: vanquishing her cunning half-sister, executing her malicious stepmother, reclaiming her mother's stolen dowry, and ensuring her treacherous husband and his favored concubine meet their end by her sword.

title: From Forsaken to True Dragon
description: Abandoned as a frail snake by his dragon and phoenix parents, Draven was rescued by the Demon Queen Galora and raised as her sworn brother. In the Demon Realm, he mastered the Dragonforge, enduring heavenly tribulations, betrayal, and the schemes of the Celestial Prince Rylen. At the Abyssal Grand Trials, Draven unmasked Rylen as a false heir, defeated his father, and secured new lands for the Demon Clan, rising from exile to become the true dragon who restored their honor.

title: From Ex-Con to Cultivator
description:
Jovan Wiley spent three years in jail for the girl he loved, only to be betrayed the moment he walked free. On the brink of death, he heard his late grandfather's voice whisper that his trial had ended. When he awoke, his wounds were gone—and he had been thrust into a hidden world of cultivators!
Mystical arts, ancient martial techniques, talismanic magic, and unrivaled medical mastery all bent to his will. What began as heartbreak became the forge of his vengeance, and the world would soon witness his rise to unstoppable power.

title: From Housewife To Princess
description: After three years of marriage, she has endured constant oppression and humiliation from her mother-in-law. The mother-in-law forces her to care for her husband’s distant cousin, who is actually the husband’s mistress. Meanwhile, her long-lost brothers have just discovered her whereabouts and are on their way to bring her back home.

title: From Mocked to Millions
description: After Helly Riggs gave Ethan Wright her savings 3 years ago, he has returned in glory as the CEO of Apex Group. Hoping to share his wealth with her, he is met with the Riggs family's scorn and their plan to remarry her off. The tables turn instantly when Ethan reveals his identity as a big shot, leaving the family to face the crushing weight of their regret.

title: From Pushover to Underworld Big Shot
description: Ethan, raised as an illegitimate child, lives with his mother until his estranged father, Matthew Lewis, reappears on his 18th birthday. Matthew, a feared kingpin, brings Ethan into his world, but it's a family built on cold deals, not love. To save his mother's life, Ethan agrees to serve the underworld. Thrust into a brutal world of crime and loyalty, he fights for those he loves and rises to make the entire underworld tremble. No regrets, no turning back.

title: From Deliveryman to Cooking God
description: Deliveryman Nathan Hayes takes a chef job to fund his sister's surgery. Armed with his family's secret recipes, he battles a ruthless rival, clears his grandfather's name, and wins gold at a national cooking contest. Now a star chef, he opens free classes for the underprivileged and finds love along the way.

title: From Romance to Revenge
description: Time-traveled into a romance novel world meant for women, I became the villain who died pathetically. But romance is not my play, revenge is. I'll teach you guys how to behave yourself. If you don't work hard in cultivation, you'll end up being wiped out! You're calling for help? Then I'll send his entire family to hell! What should I do if I encounter a master and can't defeat him? I'll simply call, "Daddy!" My dad will kick his ass. As a villain, without morality, you won't be guilt-trapped!

title: From Trash to Godslayer
description: Time-traveling into the world of martial souls, Ethan awakened and was mocked as a useless loser. But later he summoned the ancient ferocious beast Qiongqi. Humiliated by a heartless bitch? Provoked by a genius? Both will be crushed! Upon returning home and seeing his parents humiliated and his sister taken away, he was so mad. To save his family, he went to see his enemy alone. Ethan's nine martial souls were all sealed by his enemies. In a deadlock, the tenth martial soul emerged, killing all...

title: From Veggie Vendor to Billionaire
description: Ashamed of his market-selling wife, Shannon, Barrett divorces her for money and ambition. After inheriting a vast fortune, Shannon unexpectedly becomes CEO of Paxwell Group. When Barrett later seeks a partnership with the company, she gives him a chance until the board reveals her true identity, leaving him utterly stunned.

title: From Flash Marriage To Destiny
description: In order to make her fiancé successful, she had been secretly supporting him, but she didn't expect that her fiancé would do something shameless on the wedding day! When she was bullied by her scumbag fiancé, a delivery man who passed by stood up and said he was her boyfriend, so the two of them got married quickly. But it seems that both of them have hidden identities that are unknown to the public......

title: From Poverty to Power: The Hidden Heiress
description: The daughter of the wealthiest man escaped her own wedding to look for her long-lost boyfriend. By chance, she encountered a college classmate who impersonated her, secretly wearing the jewelry of the wealthy man’s daughter and pretending to be the heir. When the real heir was being bullied, she met her boyfriend, who was cold towards her and was about to marry the impostor. At her boyfriend’s wedding with the impostor, the real heir exposed the impostor’s identity.

title: From His Cage to Her Empire
description: Locked away in a glass house by her fiancé’s lover, Valerie Pierce finally sees the truth—the man she trusted was her biggest trap. She escapes the storm, rebuilds her empire, and makes everyone who betrayed her pay.

title: Divorce Tears from the Alpha, but I Shine Alone
description: Ella fell in love with Holden, the Alpha of the High Mountain Wolf Clan, when they were children after he promised to protect her. Due to a witch's prophecy about destined mates, she became his Luna. However, Holden mistakenly thought she married him just to be Luna, so he grew to hate her. Due to the scheming of Ivy, Holden's childhood sweetheart, Ella thinks they're romantically involved and overhears Holden's plan to abort Ella's unborn child. She divorces him and leaves with the baby, then reuniting with her own clan, the Silver Snow Clan, and learns she's their long-lost princess.

title: From Forsaken to True Dragon
description: Abandoned as a frail snake by his dragon and phoenix parents, Draven was rescued by the Demon Queen Galora and raised as her sworn brother. In the Demon Realm, he mastered the Dragonforge, enduring heavenly tribulations, betrayal, and the schemes of the Celestial Prince Rylen. At the Abyssal Grand Trials, Draven unmasked Rylen as a false heir, defeated his father, and secured new lands for the Demon Clan, rising from exile to become the true dragon who restored their honor.

title: From Stranger to Favorite
description: When her husband ignored her desperate 911 calls to rescue his "first love's cat," Ella lost everything—her baby, her home, and her will to fight. While he played hero saving a kitten, she was trapped in a burning building, miscarrying alone. Now divorced and free, karma comes for the cheaters in ways no one saw coming. Sometimes the best revenge is watching their perfect world burn without you.

title: From page to king Arthur
description:
"Arthur, a page serving in the armory of Albion's royal palace, is secretly a prince. Twenty years ago, his father, King Uther—the ruler of Albion and humanity's greatest dragon slayer—was betrayed by his minister Mordred and met a brutal death on the battlefield.
Concealing his true identity, Arthur studied magic under Merlin. Merlin told him that to defeat Mordred once and for all and avenge his father, he must travel to the Isle of Avalon, compete in a tournament of mages, and draw the sacred sword of kings!
To gain passage to Avalon, Arthur chose to accompany Mordred's son, Agravain. Along the way, he endured humiliation and hardship, defeated a fearsome dragon, and rescued Guinevere—all to earn the right to draw the sacred sword, claim his vengeance, and lead humanity to victory over the dragons!"

title: Rebirth From Betrayal
description:
"Seven years ago, my parents'adopted daughter, my younger sister Selene, a delicate Omega, got drunk, caused a hit and run, and left blood spilled across the Human Territory Border.
My Alpha father, my Luna mother, and my biological younger sister all came to me with the same patronizing plea.
“Selene is an Omega. She’s too fragile for prison. If she goes to Silvermoon Penitentiary, her wolf won’t survive it. Lyra, take her place. Please.”
I refused.
But on a stormy night filled with thunder, my father used absolute Alpha Command. He crushed my will, took control of my mind, and personally delivered me to the prison transport.
My fiancé, my Fated Mate, Kaelen, the strongest Alpha in the Pack, held back his raging Wolf Aura and said to me, “Lyra, when you get out, we'll complete the Mate bond. Endure these seven years for now.”"

title: Boyfriend from the Future
description: When a future version of her rival crashes into the present with a terrifying warning, motocross star Tessa learns that falling in love with Riggs Heartstone will end in tragedy. Now she's stuck as his racing partner, fighting their chemistry while racing toward the biggest competition of her life. But the harder she tries to save him, the harder she falls.

title: My Alpha Boss Gave Me Triplets
description:
Evie, a talented but vulnerable human designer, becomes bound to Leopold, the ruthless Alpha of the Stonehearth Pack, leaving her pregnant with his rare triplets. To protect her, Leopold forces her to move in with him, presenting their relationship as purely transactional while privately struggling with uncontrollable mate-bond instincts that cause him to share Evie's pain and emotions.

As Evie is drawn into Leopold’s corporate and pack world, Darleen, a powerful she-wolf from another pack determined to claim Leopold, escalates from professional threats to phsyical ones. Evie's estranged family piles on by attempting to kidnap her. Will Leopold be able to prioritize his mate over everything, and save her from the whirlwind he brought her into?

title: The Billionaire Female CEO from the Trailer Park
description:
Elise Gray was called to serve her country the day of her wedding, developing cutting edge fighter jets for the military. She was also able to use found Lockheed Gray, the world's biggest aerospace and military defense contractor, becoming the richest billionaire in the world.
Four years later, she goes home to her husband Cato to give him the wedding they never had, hiding her identity in order to give him the surprise wedding of his dreams. However, when she returns to her small-town she finds trouble - Beatrice has been relentlessly pursuing Cato, plotting to destroy their marriage. Cato's family, especially his mother Stacy, are also trying to push Elise to divorce Cato so he can marry Beatrice, resorting to humiliating her to get their way. Cato's loyalty and earnest love for Elise gives her strength to fight back till the end. Elise won't back down - no matter the cost, she'll defend her marriage and take back her dignity.

title: I Married My Cheating Ex's Uncle
description: Wealthy heiress Vivian Sterling publicly breaks her engagement after catching fiancé Bryce with her stepsister. Having secretly recovered from paralysis months ago, she stands from her wheelchair to reclaim her power. That night, she meets Adrian, a dangerous, motorcycle-riding mechanic who saves her from harassment. After a one-night stand, she proposes a contract marriage to escape Bryce's stalking. Vivian believes Adrian is merely a handsome working-class man, unaware he is the true heir to the Hale dynasty—and Bryce's most feared uncle. A decade earlier, Adrian was the one who pulled her from a fatal car crash and bore the scars; Bryce stole the credit and her ten years of devotion. As Vivian falls for Adrian, Bryce and his father Gerald launch a campaign of kidnapping, media manipulation, corporate traps, and assassination. When Adrian is rushed into the ER covered in blood, Vivian finally discovers the man she married for revenge is her real rescuer and only true love. What began as a contract marriage escalates into a high-stakes war for love, fortune, and survival.

title: Rising from theAshes, I Cut All Blood Ties
description:
Clara takes the fall for her family's favored adopted daughter, and spends years behind bars.
The day she walks free, she makes a devastating discovery.
Every song, script and business plans she's ever created has been stolen by her own family.
They've disowned her completely.
No more begging for love. No more playing nice.
With her raw, buried talent, she’s fighting back to reclaim everything.
And they will pay.

title: Eight Years Gone Down the Drain
description: Eve helped Noah build Black Tech from nothing, only to discover he has married the intern Mia and plans to hand her Eve's biggest project. At the Grant signing ceremony, Eve reveals her true identity as the Grant Group heiress and exposes Mia's leak, Noah's entitlement, and the cost of eight wasted years. Walking away from his collapse, she signs back the life that always belonged to her.

title: Reborn Princess From the Madhouse
description: Her boyfriend chose a maid's daughter. Her father locked her in a mental ward. Her family let her die. Now Vivienne Lancaster is reborn, and she's coming for what's hers and every single person who ever betrayed her.

title: Mafia Diva: Reborn From The Flames
description: When Chloe was a child, she saved a little boy named Jonathan from the streets. Ten years later, he became a self-made billionaire. Rebecca, in order to take Chloe's place and reunite with Jonathan, didn't hesitate to push Chloe down the stairs, knock her unconscious, and bury her alive — saying she would take good care of Jonathan in place of Chloe, that ugly freak with a scar on her face. Chloe crawled out of the cold earth. Because she looked strikingly similar to the late granddaughter of mafia boss Bernardo, she was taken in by Bernardo, who happened to pass by and took pity on her. Three months later, after successful plastic surgery, Chloe made a glamorous return as Bernardo's granddaughter — the mafia princess — at the exact moment Jonathan and Rebecca were publicly announcing their upcoming wedding…

title: Private School Playboys
description: Head over heels for Ethan Sutton, it-boy of Lowell Private Academy, Maddie Sinclair has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with heiress Vanessa Archibald, Madeline hatches a grand escape plan with Ethan's opportunistic mother. Will Ethan capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Rhys Wyndham, mysterious new bad boy from London end up sealing the deal before Maddie even boards the plane?

title: The Heiress Prevented from Returning Home
description: Eleanor gave up her billion-dollar inheritance for love, marrying Jacob, a poor boy from Mississippi. Three years later, pregnant and ready to bring her husband home for Thanksgiving to reveal her true identity, she instead finds herself betrayed by Jacob and his family. Convinced his mistress is the key to his promotion, Jacob abandons Eleanor on the highway, locks her in a trunk, and drags her back South—costing her the baby. On the brink of despair, she’s rescued by her brothers, files for divorce, and rises from the ashes to reclaim her life.

title: Everything Plus, Everyone Else Shuts
description: Dumped by his ex-wife Kyla, Osbert's fortunes change with the Everything Plus System, letting him add 5cm to anything he touches — from finances to sports cars. Overnight, he rises as a top plastic surgeon, rescues the stunning Julia, and outshines Kyla at a reunion. As his powers grow, Osbert transforms from a ridiculed loser to a business titan, finding true love and ultimate respect along the way.

title: The Slum Girl Who Became a Billionaire's Wife
description: Five years ago, Evelyn, from the slums, was chosen by Adrian, a wealthy young man from New York, to be a surrogate mother to give birth to Chloe. However, after the child's birth, she was stripped of her maternal status and forced to remain at Blackwood Estate as a live-in nanny. For five years, she silently memorized Chloe's every habit, ailment, and fear, only to be repeatedly humiliated, forced to kneel, confined, and even distanced from her daughter by the nominal wife, Lillian. Chloe, however, instinctively relied on Evelyn, the one who truly cared for her, clinging to her through repeated crises of illness, fear, and abandonment.

title: Too Late: The Gambling Ace
description: In order to prevent the family casino from being shut down, the good-for-nothing eldest son took the blame and went to jail for his younger brother. However, after his release from prison, he was brutally expelled by his father.

title: Out of My Way! The Reborn Mafia Queen Is Here
description: Reborn after Felicia’s past-life bullying—where her identity was stolen and it ultimately led to her death—Arya is determined to claim her rightful place as a mafia heiress. She sets out to outwit and humiliate Felicia at every opportunity, protect her friends, move deftly under the radar while unleashing her past-life combat skills, when everyone gonna realize she is the real mafia heiress？

title: Billionaire Completes My Bucket List
description: On their anniversary, Tessa is finally ready to gift her boyfriend her virginity—only to discover he's already sleeping with her cousin. Meanwhile, her work life is no better, with a toxic manager who steals her ideas and makes her daily life a living hell. When she's blindsided with a terminal Leukemia diagnosis, she snaps: quits her job, dumps the cheater, and begins checking off the items on her bucket list.  After a chance encounter at her lowest, captivating CEO Cassian Vaughn can't get her out of his head. Knowing she needs help, he offers her a deal: he'll fund the entirety of her last wishes if she does him the small favor of posing as....his fiancée!

title: Restoring My Life: From Blood Bank to CEO's Bride
description: Betrayed by her own mother, her sister, and her fiancé during her last life, she won't repeat her mistakes this time. With her relic-storing skills and relationship with the tycoon in Kingcott, she's bound to make her way up to the highest. In this life, she'll only cherish true love and exact her revenge.

title: ReelTalk EP 64-Waterboy Duo Reveal Who’s Most Likely To
description: Sky Kawai and Declan Clifford from Waterboy get candid as they play a round of “Who’s Most Likely To?” From revealing who’s the better kisser to debating who rocks booty shorts best, they drop behind the secrets from the set of ReelShort’s hit LGBTQ series. Tune in for laughs, playful roasting, and insider stories you didn’t see on screen.

title: Sorry Sweetie, Mom Shouldn't Have Remarried
description: Five years ago, pregnant Lauren saved Max from a heart attack, triggering premature labor that left her daughter Mia with chronic health issues. Five years later, Lauren marries Max's father, Arthur Vance, becoming his stepmom. She endures constant torment from Max, bias from Grandma, and mistrust from her husband. When Mia suffers a life-threatening reaction after being forced to drink milk, a devastated Lauren demands a divorce.
