Only then does the Vance family realize the lifesaver they desperately sought is Lauren, the woman they ruthlessly bullied.

title: Deadly Affair with My Brother-in-Law
description: After being forced into a loveless engagement, Aurora finds herself tangled up in a toxic, addictive affair with her fiance’s brother, Noah Hayes. Meanwhile, the past she fled from is threatening to catch up with her.

title: Tyrant, I'm From Modern Society
description: Cultural relic restorer Luna was transported into a novel world and became a princess. Based on the original plot, her identity was exposed after only three days, and she was stabbed to death by the tyrant. To survive, she had no choice but to follow the original plot and deal with the tyrant Damian. Faced with repeated dead ends, Luna cleverly resolved the crises. Damian couldn't help but be attracted to her, and the two gradually developed feelings for each other. Luna healed his childhood trauma and warmed his lonely heart.

title: My Love from Another Star
description: In a galaxy far far away, Princess Raven Storm is the last woman of the Magori, a dying alien species. In order to continue her bloodline, Raven ventures to Earth to mate with a human male suitable enough to breed the next Magori offspring. She soon meets the handsome A-list actor Jack Atwood and becomes bonded to him, but when he consistently refuses her requests to sleep together, Raven realizes birthing the next Magori generation won't be as easy as she thought.

title: Back from the Dead: Code of Revenge
description: Programmer Finn is betrayed and killed by his girlfriend Millie and loan shark Rex. But when he's reborn with his memories intact, he returns to take revenge. Using his skills, he outsmarts the criminal underworld, saves his childhood friend Sadie, and leads his village in a fight against predatory loans. With tech and the law on his side, Finn exposes the conspiracy and takes down Rex, achieving both career success and love.

title: The Usurped Divine Daughter
description: When Supreme Goddess Aurelia returns from war, the child waiting in her temple is not her daughter, but a Siren wearing stolen Phoenix skin, divinity, and holy feathers. The lie leads back to Apathe, Aurelia’s own sister, who coveted the Supreme Throne and hated the daughter born from Aurelia and the Storm Titan she loved in vain. After forcing the truth from three traitorous demigods, Aurelia descends into Tartarus, finds only a fragment of her baby Arora’s soul, and brings it home. She destroys the stolen powers, abandons the throne, and waits centuries for her daughter to rise again as Phoenix.

title: By Your Side, I Fear No More
description: Clarissa Ainsworth unexpectedly discovers that Isabelle is not her biological sister, that her real sister, Celeste, was switched at birth and endured years of abuse. Determined to make things right, Clarissa brings the timid Celeste home, helping her establish her identity while navigating Isabelle's numerous schemes. As Clarissa delves deeper into the mystery, she uncovers that her great-uncle Walter is the mastermind behind the sinister switch. Ultimately, she ensures Walter faces justice for his actions.

title: Locked by the Mafia Boss
description: My cold, ruthless Mafia godfather guardian tore off his mask the night of my twenty-first birthday. He doesn't want me to call him uncle anymore. He wants me as his caged bird.

title: Dumped by My Ex, Chosen by the Dragon King
description: For seven years, Cecilia — a half-blood born between a powerful mage and an ordinary human — lived as nothing more than a servant in the prestigious Leon family. Married to Leon, the heir of a legendary magical bloodline, she was never treated as a wife. Instead, she was forced to brew potions, serve his family, and endure endless humiliation. Then her half-sister Lilian entered her marriage pretending to be the helpless victim. Little by little, she stole Leon’s affection — and even turned Cecilia’s own daughter against her. But everything changed the day Cecilia signed the divorce papers. The “dead egg” everyone mocked for years finally cracked open. Inside was not a worthless spirit, but Loki — the ancient Dragon Lord who had waited 600 years for her return. He gave her the legendary ring that commanded the entire dragon clan. More importantly, he gave her what she had never received before: respect, protection, and the power to choose her own destiny. Reborn as Luna Sera, a once-in-a-generation magical genius, Cecilia returns to the magical world. The people who once looked down on her are now forced to kneel before her. Only then does Leon realize the truth: The woman he abandoned was never beneath him. She was someone he could never reach. Desperate to win her back, Leon kneels and offers her the wedding ring. But Cecilia only smiles coldly. “Your love is something I no longer need.” And she walks away with Loki — the man who shares her soul, her destiny, and a bond that will last beyond life and death.

title: Bound by Marriage - Freed by Love
description: What began as a marriage of convenience soon became a maze of lies and hidden faces. Diana thought her cold husband was the enemy — until the real nightmare revealed itself. Now, trapped in a house of secrets, the only heart she might come to trust… belongs to the man she was never meant to love.

title: Claimed by My Boyfriend's Mafia Father
description:
A poor college student. A powerful mafia boss. One unforgettable mistake.
Rosy Walker’s life changes forever when a birthday surprise goes wrong and leads her into the arms of Leon Vittorio — her boyfriend’s father and the most dangerous man in New York.
Now, with secrets, betrayal, and desire pulling them together, there’s no escaping the forbidden love they never saw coming.

title: Chained by Fate, Claimed by Love
description: Soft-spoken and kind-hearted, Luna Quinn never expected love to find her at work—until she crosses paths with Kieran Scott. Despite enduring a string of blind dates, Kieran feels nothing for the elegant women before him—until Luna walks in, stealing his heart at first sight. Yet, Luna isn’t ready for romance, focusing instead on her career. When her parents arrange a marriage for her, she hesitates but agrees out of responsibility. Upon hearing this, Kieran makes his move—not as a guest, but as the groom, determined to win her heart. Choosing love over obligation, Luna marries into the Scott family, embraced by warmth and devotion. But just as she settles into her new life, a shocking truth emerges—she was switched at birth. As she reunites with her true family, Luna finally finds the life of love and belonging she was always meant to have.

title: Rejected by My Shifter Mates, So I Walked Away
description: As a fake‑born heiress, Ivy was betrothed to three elite beastmen: Lucian the fox, Kieran the tiger, and Caelen the serpent. After stumbling across their group chat, Ivy mistakenly believed they disliked her and favored her sister Lia. At her birthday banquet, she publicly gave the three beastmen to Lia and fled abroad to become a renowned pianist. Four years later, Ivy returns home, only to be tracked down by the trio. Those hurtful messages turned out to be their scheme against one another, each plotting to have her exclusively. As misunderstandings clear and Lia keeps making trouble, the beastmen fiercely defend Ivy. After her solo recital, Ivy faces her true feelings, accepts their affection and lives for herself.

title: Rejected by the Heir, Crowned by the Dragon
description: In this world ruled by dragon-hunting plutocrats, Elara, heir of the Vanguard House, is publicly jilted by her fiancé Arthur and exiled to the Forbidden Woods after her test reveals zero magical power. Trapped in desperate straits, she meets Ignis, a tyrannical dragon emperor cursed with severed wings. Drawing on her peerless mechanical talent, Elara crafts mechanical dragon wings for Ignis. The two forge a soul pact, bound by an incomplete symbiotic bond. Faced with Arthur’s relentless pursuit and hunting conspiracy, Elara and Ignis strike back from the brink of ruin. In the end, riding atop Ignis in his true dragon form, they pierce the clouds, overthrow the old order, and usher in a new era of peace between humans and dragons.

title: Broken by My Twin Alphas
description:
Ivy spent three years loving the twin Alphas who hid her in the shadows. While the entire pack celebrated another woman as their future Luna, Ivy endured the humiliation in silence—believing their bond was real.
Until one cruel night shattered everything.
Betrayed by the men she trusted most and forced to watch them choose someone else, Ivy finally realizes the terrifying truth: to the twins, she was never their mate… only a secret they were ashamed of.

title: Daddy by Accident, Love by Fate
description: Sebastian Sterling, heir to Sterling Global, has raised his twin sons alone for five years, their mother's identity a secret. Evelyn Cloud, the unloved adoptive daughter of the Cloud family, lives a lonely life until a chance encounter changes everything. One twin instantly clings to her, calling her "Mommy". Soon, his brother and their formidable father, Sebastian, draw her into their world. As bonds form with this intense trio, the shocking truth behind the twins' origins begins to emerge.

title: Mommy by Mistake for the Abyssal Tyrant’s Baby
description:
To survive falling into the hands of Kael, a ruthless Siren king who eats liars, Elena lies—claiming to be his long-lost fiancée. Surprising everyone, Kael’s five-year-old son, Lucian, instantly accepts her as "Mommy." Forced to navigate a dangerous ocean realm, Elena uses her wits and fake romance to stay alive alongside the lethal Siren and his child.
However, when ancient enemies attack and threaten their lives, Elena risks everything to protect them, unlocking a shocking truth: she isn't an impostor. Five years ago, she was Kael’s true mate, who sacrificed her memory to save him during a catastrophic rift explosion. With their memories restored and enemies defeated, Kael leaves the underwater throne behind to reunite with Elena on land, finally completing their family.

title: Her Baby’s Claimed by the Kingpin
description: Betrayed and reborn, Jennifer returns for vengeance. After exposing her fiancé‘s affair, a heartbroken night leads her to Jayden Yeats—the powerful man who has loved her in silence. Forced abroad by family cruelty, she comes back years later with her son, determined to uncover her mother’s death. Amid sabotage and a falsified DNA test, Jennifer fights to reclaim her legacy, unmask the truth, and claim a love that was always hers.

title: Claimed by Apollo's Son
description: In ancient Greece, Kallisa flees her father's brothel sale. A veiled night with drugged demigod prince Heron marks her with a golden sun sigil and leaves her pregnant. She bears son Lyros, unaware Heron is the father. Disguised as a palace laundress, she hides two taboos punishable by death, a secret child and infertility. When Apollo demands an heir or the city loses its light, three trials expose her. Kallisa refuses to sacrifice Lyros. Apollo sees his sun mark and declares him the heir.

title: Abandoned By My mom
description: In order to protect her brother in a car accident, she suffered rupture of the heart. However, her parents, who were only concerned about her brother, missed the best time to treat her, and she died in a corner where no one knew about it.

title: I Rule the Wasteland Harem
description: After World War III, I became a scavenger in a chaotic world, surviving by trading salvaged junk for supplies—while being bullied by classmates who would steal what I'd gathered. By chance, I discovered alien technology and rescued three beautiful women who became my wives. Now, I aim to use these assets to become the King of the Wasteland!

title: Taken by the Mafia Godfather
description: Mob boss Raine keeps bunny-girl Leah captive to break his blood curse—but falls in love and forfeits his cure. Leah falls into the sea, vanishing. Seven years later, she returns with their child. Together they unravel the conspiracy and reunite, proving love outlasts fate itself.

title: The Seduction Game
description: When a brilliant, dirt-poor teen earns a scholarship to an elite prep school, she becomes the target of a cruel queen bee and her bad-boy pawn who’s tasked with seducing and destroying her before Ivy League admissions are announced — but what no one expects is that the girl from the trailer is playing them all, and she might just take the crown, the scholarship… and his heart.

title: Stolen by My Fiancé's Uncle
description: A fallen noble girl, forced by her family to secure a marriage, tries to give herself to her fiancé, only to end up entangled with his powerful uncle, a duke whose rage disorder can only be eased by her touch.

title: Married by Mistake, Loved by Fate
description: A wedding mix-up sends gentle, gifted Natalie to Yale, heir to the Quill family, while fiery Lucy marries his timid half-brother, Calvin. But Yale is secretly being poisoned by Calvin's mother, who wants the family fortune for her son. A skilled healer, Natalie saves Yale and helps him defeat his enemies. When she is framed for poisoning, the truth comes out, and Yale finally wins both the family business and Natalie's heart.

title: Claimed by the Mafia Boss
description: College senior Camila accidentally saves the life of billionaire mafia Boss Matteo Alejandro. He immediately falls in love with her and pressures her to marry him. Is he as dangerous and cruel as he seems? Or is there a soul inside the man worthy of her love?

title: Tied By Fate
description: Mia and James, both grappling with personal and professional challenges, find themselves entangled in a contract marriage, a unique arrangement that promises to solve their individual problems. As they navigate the complexities of pretending to be a loving couple, their relationship evolves in unexpected ways. Bonded by secrecy, they embark on a journey filled with laughter, misunderstandings, and growing attraction...

title: Rejected by Three Alphas, Claimed by the Lycan King
description:
At eighteen, Riley was the girl three powerful Alphas fought over—her fiancé Chase, her childhood friend Mark, her stepbrother Ethan. They shattered their blood bond with her, chained her as a "blood bag," and drained her veins to heal a sweet-faced Omega named Chloe.

Everyone saw her as a wolf‑less freak.

Then the Blood Moon rose.

The Moon Spirit, sleeping for ten thousand years, awakened inside her—revealing Riley as the true Lycan Queen, the one who reigns above every Alpha. When her silver hair blazed to life, the whole hall knelt.

She turned away. "None of you. I choose no one."

She married Alex Reed, the cursed Lycan King who'd worn a silver muzzle for ten years—a beast who'd endure a thousand needles through his heart before hurting her. She purged his curse. He burned her enemies to ash.

When the three men who betrayed her crawled back begging, their Blood Moon wedding became her breathtaking reckoning. From a discarded girl to a goddess ruling beside her King—this time, they kneel and look up at her.

title: Raised by Power, Crowned by Baby
description: Five years after losing her twins, Ruan Jiarong was forced to marry Mu Shunfeng. After marriage, she discovered that Mu Shunfeng was actually Mu Yuandao, the wealthiest man in the country. Mu Yuandao's ex-wife, Xia Yuqing, attempted to reclaim her family. After Mu Yuandao's identity was revealed, Ruan Jiarong divorced him but later reconciled. They then discovered that Mu Yuandao's children were actually biologically Ruan Jiarong's. Eventually, Xia Yuqing's schemes were exposed, and Ruan Jiarong and Mu Yuandao embarked on a happy life together.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Bound by Crimson and Silver
description: Aria, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car, a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private high school. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Damon, the werewolf heir, and Levi, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities. One as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Aria later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.

title: Claimed by My Ex's Alpha Brother
description: Ella is wolfless amongst the wolves, but at least she has her mate, Beta Noah Gravens... until she catches him cheating with her rival Ava. Shattered, Ella falls straight into the arms of Noah's brother, Liam Gravens, the newly returned Alpha of the Crescent Pack, who has loved her since childhood and knows she's his fated mate. But with jealous rivals, bitter exes, and two worlds pulling them apart, can Ella and Liam embrace the love they are destined for?

title: Roaming the World Untamed
description: Rian, Duke Calder's disgraced second son, was secretly raised by the Holy Dragon Aurelian, the realm's last Dragon Speaker. When half-orcs threaten Princess Isabel, Rian defeats them one by one, exposing years of family abuse and clearing his mother Elena's honor. The Sovereign names him Dragon Speaker, but he must prove it against Starspeaker Aether before the Undead Legion's general invades. Betrayed by envoy Zoramus, Rian summons Aurelian, destroys the general, and returns to marry Isabel.

title: Mafia Son: Unbroken By Betrayal
description:
Sebastian Vale, founder and CEO of Vale Tech, was once the son of mafia boss Carmine Rossi. Twenty-five years ago, to escape his family's criminal destiny, he broke with his father, changed his name, built a world-leading technology company from nothing and developed an AI system powerful enough to change the world.

But just as the company nears a major breakthrough, Sebastian walks in on his wife and co-founder Claire in a compromising moment with his close friend and COO, Marco, and his marriage collapses. At the same time, the AI system he built spins out of control: power grids, hospitals, transport and aviation fail one after another across the globe, plunging the world into an unprecedented crisis — and every finger points at him.

Just as the board prepares to remove him and the world casts him as the villain, the mafia father who vanished twenty-five years ago suddenly reappears and reveals a long-buried truth: it was not his father who betrayed the family, but his mother. And the man who engineered the entire conspiracy to seize control of the company is Sebastian's half-brother — Marco.

To take the life he believes should have been his, Marco exploits a bloodline loophole to breach the AI system, steals the company's assets, kidnaps Claire and sets out to destroy Sebastian's business, family and faith entirely.

Facing a global crisis, a brother's revenge and old family blood debts, Sebastian must confront his mafia heritage, fight alongside his father to rescue his wife and stop the AI catastrophe, and make a final choice between revenge and justice.

Yet just when everything seems settled, the mother who disappeared twenty-five years ago appears at the wedding and reveals an even bigger secret behind it all, leaving Sebastian once again at the crossroads of his family's fate. The true war of the mafia family has only just begun.

title: Spoiled by My Ex's Uncle After Rebirth
description: Reborn on her engagement day, Chloe kisses her ex-fiance's uncle Dante Hayes, the LA Mafia King, and breaks from the family that sold her. She carries the triplets of a man declared infertile. As Jared plots to seize the empire through forged wills, snakes, and poisoned soup, Chloe uses past-life memories to thwart every scheme. DNA proves Dante the father; they marry on the spot. But when Jared torches the banquet hall, the same flames from her past life return. Can rebirth rewrite fate?

title: Find Your Way Back to Me, My Childhood Sweetheart
description: The richest man in the world's missing one last thing — his childhood sweetheart. He's determined to marry her, but never realizes she's right beside him! He searches everywhere for the girl who captured her heart. When will he realize he's already married to his Mrs. Right?

title: Love Me Before I Go
description: Adeline Rhodes is diagnosed with stage four kidney cancer and has months to live. Her husband, Blake Rhodes, seems preoccupied with her half-sister Rebecca, whom she constantly has to donate blood to. Blake mistakes Adeline for a calculating gold-digger, and she thinks he’s never loved her. All of this changes when Blake finds out Adeline’s dying, but it might be too late for him to tell her that it was her that he loved all this time.

title: Love You 1,000 Years
description: Jacob, an immortal, has been searching for Princess Prisca's reincarnation for 1,000 years. In South City, he finds Sylvia, a CEO resembling Prisca, and becomes her driver to protect her. But is she really his love?

title: Love Under Fire
description: When a disciplined former Secret Service agent is forced to partner with a reckless global pop star after his daughter is kidnapped by her obsessive ex, their race across the Philippines ignites a volatile romance- one that forces them to choose between control, trust, and the people they love most.

title: Ms. Billionaire's Love Business
description: Evelyn, a career driven single lady in her 20s, the general manager of the Smith Group, meets Daniel, a college student with a chivalry heart. During a blind date, she leans that Daniel is the neglected third child of the Johnson family. The two quickly agreed to marry and resolve their practical dilemma. Yet after the wedding, the fake couple started feeling something real towards each other, and become the light in each other’s shadowed heart.

title: Love After Lies
description: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?

title: Love Runs Deep
description: Seeking a Million-Dollar Baby Daddy, the female CEO Cecilia Sterling makes country boy Roman Sinclair her kept husband. Unbeknownst to her, Roman is a mysterious heir secretly in love with her, disguising himself to get close. Life in billionaire families is brutal. Surrounded by crazy Miriam, two-faced Vincent, and a biased Grandfather, Cecilia expects Roman to be her savior. Instead, he becomes the start of her nightmare.

title: Love Wasn't the Plan
description: Best friends Summer and Faye are unexpectedly thrust into the world of a novel, assuming the roles of the devoted wife to the shrewd Adrian Watson and the stand-in lover for the possessive Julian Watson. While they seem ensnared in unrequited love, they secretly revel in the opulent lifestyle of the elite. But, the return of Mia Piper, another key heroine, shatters their tranquil existence. To escape the looming tragic fate, they devise a daring plan to fake their own deaths. Unbeknownst to them, their "deaths" push Adrian and Julian to the brink of despair. Then, a chance encounter brings the four back together again...

title: Love Cruise
description:
Six strangers. One yacht. Sail through the Greek islands in this immersive  romance reality show — where every choice you make could win you love, money, 
  or both. Just don't expect smooth sailing.

title: Love Wasn't the Plan
description: Best friends Summer and Faye are unexpectedly thrust into the world of a novel, assuming the roles of the devoted wife to the shrewd Adrian Watson and the stand-in lover for the possessive Julian Watson. While they seem ensnared in unrequited love, they secretly revel in the opulent lifestyle of the elite. But, the return of Mia Piper, another key heroine, shatters their tranquil existence. To escape the looming tragic fate, they devise a daring plan to fake their own deaths. Unbeknownst to them, their "deaths" push Adrian and Julian to the brink of despair. Then, a chance encounter brings the four back together again...

title: Love After the Lie
description: A marriage built on deception ignites a dangerous obsession. Trapped in misplaced devotion and tender lies that cut like knives, she finally walks away, only then does he realize the truth. When the love of his life is still within reach, can shattered trust ever be restored?

title: Love, Lost and Found
description: For seven years, Summer and her childhood friend Shawn shared a bond brimming with unspoken affection. After a spontaneous, drunken kiss, Shawn, wary of intimacy, pushed Summer away with his erratic behavior. Disheartened, Summer becomes the object of affection for another childhood friend, Julian, despite Shawn's persistent interference. Just as her relationship with Julian deepens, he mysteriously disappears...

title: Love After Lies
description: Disguising herself as ugly, Clara marries elite heir Jace to honor her mother's wish. She thinks he loves her true self, but she's just his pawn to defy his family and shield his first love. After three years of abuse, she divorces him, unveils her beauty, and shocks everyone. Jace begs for a second chance, but Clara is done. Is his belated love too late?

title: Love Under Fire
description: When Leo begins his 'job' at a nightclub, he unwittingly crosses paths with the supervisor and inadvertently aids the charming general manager. This sets off a chain of events, all secretly orchestrated by an unseen mastermind from the moment Leo stepped into the club. As he pieces together the clues and delves deeper into the mystery, Leo uncovers a truth that leaves him completely astounded...

title: The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex
description: When Layla and Joshua break up, they sign a separation agreement: If they're both still single in five years, they get married. Five years later, after becoming the world's hottest and wealthiest chef, Joshua takes the position of head chef at the restuarant where Layla works. Joshua wants her to fulfill the contract, but with her health in an unstable condition, Layla lies and says she's already engaged. Still, an undeniable chemistry builds between them, and the flames of love become hard to suppress. Will Joshua ultimately discover Layla's lie? Can they bridge the gap of lost time and truly be together again, love conquering all?

title: Love Guru
description: When romance gets messy, one man claims to have the answers.. the Love Guru. Armed with ancient wisdom, awkward rituals, and spells that never quite land, he dives into the chaos of relationships. But in love, the cure is often crazier than the problem.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: I'm Pregnant, Let's Break Up!
description: Monica, a talent manager, and Adonis, an A-list star, have been in secret relationship for three years now. For Monica, it's all just unrequited love because Adonis has not even once expressed his feelings to her. Monica, now pregenant, decides to leave this relationship behind. It is only then that Adonis realizes all he needs is her. Years later, their paths cross again, and Monica is now an acclaimed film director. This time, will Adonis win back his love?

title: Love Me After My Death
description: Caroline has just been diagnosed with cancer and told she only has three months to live when Stacy, her husband Eric's old flame, shows up with a six-year-old kid that she claims is Eric's child. Eric goes on to repeatedly wrong Caroline, and as her cancer symptoms worsen and she slips into despair, she decides to divorce him. Only after their separation does Eric realize that he can't live without her, and he then finally learns of his ex-wife's cancer diagnosis. By then, it's too late for reconciliation, as Caroline is determined not to spend her final days loving him.

title: Take Me Hades, I'm Dying
description: When her sister gets blackmailed by a ruthless sex club owner, Dakota James is desperate enough to offer a contract relationship to Jaxon Shaw, a mysterious billionaire who never touches his lovers.  Until Dakota.  From her first touch, Jaxon starts to feel.  Their secret relationship ends brutally when Dakota discovers she's dying and breaks up with Jaxon to protect him.  When Dakota gets in too deep with the club owner, she is saved by the masked man Hades—Jaxon in disguise.  But time is running out for the fated lovers. Will Jaxon uncover Dakota’s deadly secret in time to save her?  Or will the forces against them destroy their love before it’s too late.

title: Love of Design
description: Vivian a passionate you designer chases her dream of breaking into the competitive Los Angeles fashion scene. Her days are filled with fabrics, endless rejections and an unshakable belief that she's meant for more. Standing by her side is Jake, her supporting boyfriend. As Vivian's talent begins to attract attention from people whom can open doors, Jake can't ignore that Vivian may need more than his devotion to reach her destiny. The series explores the delicate balance between love and ambition, sacrifice and self-worth. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Rock On! Band Beauty in Disguise
description: This story follows Astra, a determined girl gifted with extraordinary strength. When her twin brother loses his voice before a crucial band rehearsal, he’s threatened by a lawsuit. Astra steps in for him. Disguised as a boy, she resides in the boys’ dorm to uphold the ruse despite lacking musical talent and being unmistakably female. Amidst comedic mishaps and tense moments, Astra discovers unexpected love and genuine companionship.

title: Fatal Temptation: Between Two Alphas
description: Mia's life as the future Luna is beyond perfect, until a witch appears and announces herself as the Alpha's mate. Betrayed by her entire family, penniless, packless and pregnant, Mia encounters another Alpha who claims to be her one true love. Can she trust this mysterious stranger? Or is she a pawn in a dangerous game?

title: Fated to the Alpha
description: Bullied and mistreated, a young High School girl is shunned from her previous pack for not having a wolf. Upon entering a new pack, she meets a dashing man who falls in love with her – except this man is her superior Alpha and the nephew of the one man that wants her dead.

title: Billionaire's Contract Lover
description:
Charlotte, adopted daughter of the Harrington family, is drugged and framed by her stepsister Isabella at her engagement banquet. Locked in a tower, she becomes entangled with William, heir of the Ashford family. Pregnant and cast out, Charlotte raises her son Leo alone for eight years.

An alumni dance reunites them. William recognizes Charlotte by his mother's ruby pendant. Desperate for money, Charlotte works at his hotel, and they sign a three-month contract to fake a relationship. Spending time together, William discovers Leo shares his looks and peanut allergy — proof Leo is his son.

Isabella keeps scheming, but her past crimes are exposed. Charlotte is finally recognized as a true Harrington. Leo recovers from surgery, the contract blossoms into real love, and the family of three is happily united.

title: Billionaire's Borrowed Bride
description: After a job interview doesn’t pan out the way Stella Evans plans, she’s desperate to save her house and her mom. When Aston Montgomery gives her the offer of a lifetime — pretend to be his fiancée and mother of his love child in exchange for paying off her debts — she has no choice but to take it. Though it’s all temporary, Stella and Aston soon lose sight of what’s pretend and what’s real. Will Stella always be the borrowed bride, or will she win over the billionaire?

title: Billionaire's Return
description: Billionaire Blake Thorne returns on Chinese New Year's Eve to surprise his wife, only to find her pregnant. He reveals his true wealth, leaving her family in regret as he cuts all ties.

title: Billionaire’s Betrayal
description: Anya Petrova, a brilliant heiress seeking revenge against billionaire Damien Blackwood, infiltrates his inner circle under a false identity. She plans to ruin his reputation and business empire, as Blackwood's actions have led to the downfall of her family. However, as her plans unfold, Anya finds herself unexpectedly drawn to Damien. Despite her initial disdain for him, she is captivated by his charm and intelligence. Their forbidden romance is complicated by their families' bitter rivalry and the secrets of their pasts. Anya must navigate between her desire for justice and her growing feelings for Damien...

title: The Returns of Billionaire Mom
description: Harley Carson, the heiress of the Carson family, was betrayed by her stepsister Ivy Carson and fiancé Gavin Gray. She nearly lost her life, but survived by faking her death. Five years later, as the chairwoman of HyperNova Association, she returns with her son to take revenge on Ivy and Gavin. Unexpectedly, Nolan Hamilton, her one-night stand, reappears. For their son's sake, Harley decides to sign a marriage contract with Nolan. Unknown to her, Nolan is not a mere escort, but the heir of the prestigious Hamilton family…

title: My Billionaire Ever After
description: Aria Walker needs a husband to get out of an arranged marriage. When her long-term boyfriend reveals he's leaving her for her best friend, a heartbroken Aria turns to old acquaintance/"food truck worker," Stefan Hill. Little does she know Stefan Hill is actually a billionaire CEO. Aria's selfish family and bitter best friend try to sabotage her at every turn, but with Stefan's support, Aria's marriage only gets stronger.

title: I Married the Other Woman's Billionaire Brother
description: On the eve of her wedding, Sloane enters heiress Vivienne Vale's husband selection gala and finds her own groom holding the winning red card. Reid places Sloane's wedding ring on Vivienne and publicly casts her aside, certain she will crawl back. Instead, Sloane accepts a secret proposal from Vivienne's wheelchair-bound billionaire brother, Dane. When Reid and Vivienne leave Sloane beaten and her father fighting for his life, Dane steps in to protect the woman he has searched for and loved for ten years.

title: I Hired a Billionaire Manny
description: 5 years ago, Sienna and Damian had an one night stand. Now, she's back with their daughter Poppy as the CEO of a huge production company in LA. To reconnect with them, Damian hides his billionaire identity and becomes Poppy's manny. Will they stand against the world and build a new life as a family?

title: Billionaire Daddy, Don't You Escape
description: Charlene, an orphan, makes the ultimate sacrifice to save her gravely ill sister, only to end up in the wrong man’s bed and spend the night with Helmut. Nine months later, she gives birth to triplet sons and a daughter. Five years on, with her sister’s life once again hanging by a thread, Charlene returns home with her four children and runs straight into Helmut at the airport.

title: Escorting the Ruthless Billionaire Doctor
description: Violet, desperate to pay for her father’s surgery, decides to sell her virginity, but the good doctor she calls is determined to pull her back from the edge. However, as the two share a heated, unforgettable night, Dax finds himself hooked on Violet, despite thinking she’s just another gold-digger. When their darkest secrets are laid bare, will their fragile connection survive?

title: My Twins Picked a Billionaire Dad
description: Lena, who possesses extraordinary innate strength, saved Ryan, a framed heir to a financial conglomerate, five years ago. She left after unexpectedly giving birth to a pair of boy-and-girl twins. Five years later, to fend off forced marriage and the inheritance crisis from their families, the two enter into a contract marriage. Ryan has no idea that Lena is the savior he has been searching for for five years, nor that the twins are his biological children. They join forces to fight William, Ryan’s scheming uncle who covets the family fortune. With superior intelligence and unusual strength, the twins repeatedly help them out of dangers. After many twists and turns, the whole family is finally reunited.

title: Divorced and Billionaire
description: I'm Elena. Ten years I built his company with him. The day we went public, I walked in on himwith his pregnant secretary.He forced a divorce that night—cashed out my shares, gave me the house, the money. Hethought I was crying over him. He didn't know I was crying because the fraud evidence washitting the regulators the next morning.I took the money. I signed. I walked away.Let him and his empire burn together.This time, I'm not betting on anyone. Because I'm holding all the cards.

title: Wrong Bed, Right Billionaire
description: In high school, 180-pound Ginny was mocked by the entire school while secretly in love with the golden boy, Liam. After a passionate graduation night, she believed she was just a drunken mistake and fled in shame. Six years later, Ginny has slimmed down into a stunning actress named Louise. Desperate to save her blacklisted film, she is forced to beg the ruthless media mogul—Liam. Believing he sees her as just another starlet, Ginny prepares for humiliation. But Liam has recognized her from the start, and the graduation night was never an accident—he had been desperately in love with her all along.

title: The Billionaire I Married Overnight
description:
"Anna, a poor‑yet‑resilient graduate in jewelry design, takes on debt incurred from her mother’s medical treatment. One day at a hot‑dog stand, she comes to the aid of Walter, a billionaire who pretends to be a destitute old man. Determined to force his workaholic grandson Warren into marriage, Walter arranges a shotgun wedding between Anna and Warren.

Anna believes she is marrying a man with no money, status or prospects, while Warren assumes Anna is a gold‑digger driven by greed. The two enter the marriage each with their own hidden motives, unaware that Warren is the secret CEO of the design firm where Anna is interviewing. Amid misunderstandings, stark class divides and workplace bullying, Anna gradually uncovers her husband’s true identity. In the end, she earns respect and love through her sincerity and professional competence."

title: Sweet Debt, Secret Billionaire
description: Corrie Scott, a delivery girl who happened to help an old man. To repay her mother's medical debts, she married his grandson, Charles Francis. Charles is the richest man. At the beginning, he thought this girl was a gold digger, so he hid his true identity. As they lived together, their feelings grew deeper. But his lie gradually became a time bomb, and his childhood sweetheart also came back. Will Charles and Corrie get a happy ending?

title: The $50 Billionaire
description: The day Wade dumped Lena for a richer girl, lightning struck and every price on Earth collapsed to a fraction of a cent. A lipstick cost 0.4 cents. A penthouse cost a hundred dollars. And the $30,000 in Lena's account made her the world's richest woman. She bought out her factory, crushed her ex's sugar mama's supply chain, and turned a fifty-dollar bill into a business empire — all while still eating one-cent street wraps at the night market. That's where Adrian Grant, the one heir who didn't care about the Forbes list, first saw her. He didn't fall for the richest woman in the world. He fell for the girl who stayed exactly who she was after becoming her.

title: Taming My Ex's Billionaire Uncle
description:
Cora comes from an ordinary middle-class family. On a rainy night, she is first abandoned by her fiancé Finn, and then entrusted by her ailing father to Neo as someone under his guardianship. Neo is a cold, sharp minded lawyer and the man in power behind the Garcia family, the richest family of all. Forced to live under the same roof with him, Cora finds herself constantly confronting his presence.
Neo is rational and dangerous, a man who never lets anyone get close to him easily—yet Cora seems to be the exception. Through repeated clashes, Cora chips away at Neo's indifference with her intelligence and subtle allure. Meanwhile, Neo struggles between restraint and desire: he wants to push her away, yet cannot ignore the growing pull he feels toward her. Gradually, Cora realizes that what she wants is not merely revenge on Finn, but to take control of her own fate—and to shake the heart of this untouchable man.
But just as Neo finally begins to lower his guard, Cora discovers that deep in his heart there exists someone else: a “white moonlight” who has long since gone to Europe.

title: Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart
description: When Lyla Walker starts working at the world's most elite country club, she unwittingly brings chaos and temptation to her buttoned-up billionaire CEO Royce Kennedy. She's ready to risk everything for their forbidden relationship, unaware of the promise he made to her dying father.

title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas
description: Seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they’re fake-married—with a child he doesn’t know is his.

title: The Virgin and The Billionaire
description: Desperate to save her dying mother, Cindy Parks strikes a deal with her boss’s daughter, Nikki Jenkins: Pretend to be Nikki and give her virginity to billionaire Charles Kane. Nikki uses the scheme to trick Charles into marrying her but when she gets sick, Cindy is once again forced to play dress up and step in as a replacement bride.

title: One night with my billionaire CEO
description:
Kind-hearted Isabella always believed that being useful meant being loved. On the night she planned to propose to her boyfriend, she catches him cheating with her boss. Heartbroken and drunk, she stumbles into the hotel room of Owen—her company's cold, wealthy CEO, who's been drugged in a business trap. One night leaves her pregnant, binding two strangers in a marriage of convenience.

What starts as distrust slowly becomes real. But when Owen's glamorous ex Lisa returns, she fuels Isabella's insecurities, convincing her she'll never truly have his heart. After a devastating accident, Owen believes their baby has died—while Isabella disappears with their son.

Five years later, a stronger Isabella returns. Owen discovers the truth: she kept his child from him. Forced back into each other's lives, they must face old wounds, buried feelings, and Lisa's schemes—before they can finally choose love and become the family they were always meant to be.

title: The Billionaire's Secret Wife
description: Dumped at her own engagement party for her pregnant best friend, Aria walks away and marries Damien Sterling that same night. Three years later, she returns as the hidden Mrs. Sterling, co-ruler of a tech empire, only for her arrogant ex and his mistress to humiliate and assault her again. They think she is broke and desperate; they have no idea she controls the deal that can ruin them. When Damien and their son reveal the truth, every insult becomes payback.

title: Wake Up, My Billionaire Husband
description: Sofía is short on money and desperate to pay her mother's expensive medical bills. Her relatives agree to help her on the condition that she marries the billionaire Samuel, who is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it won't be long before the infamous Samuel wakes up from his coma and discovers he's engaged to a complete stranger.

title: Playing by the Billionaire's Rules
description: Becky agreed to a three-year contract as Nick's lover, bound by rules - with a $10 million penalty for each breach. Yet, she's broken this one of the rules: she's pregnant and in love, only to discover he's marrying someone else!

title: I Hid the Dragon Billionaire's Secret Son
description: "Rowan stole a dragon's moonstone and ran. He didn't plan to keep the baby too—but five years later, he's hiding in a basement, feeding the kid fake gold chains because Leo only eats real gems. At a charity gala, Leo escapes his backpack, chews Asher Drake's priceless signet ring off his hand, and crawls under his table. Asher finds his son—a tiny dragon with his exact face, raised on junk food in a damp box. The most dangerous ancient dragon in North America expected a thief. He found a starving mate and a dragon heir who eats diamonds. His first move? Drop the boy on a mountain of gold and say, ""Eat."" Then he turned to Rowan and said, ""You too."" He didn't come to punish. He came to collect what was always his."

title: The Ex-Wife's Comeback Strategy
description: After hooking up with her husband Benjamin who she's never met before, Aria learns that he wants a divorce with her. Her plan to just run away is demolished by her studio's new commission, which is to design Benjamin's new house. Aria hides her identity and starts working with Benjamin for the cash. Benjamin falls for his designer Aria during this time, as she develops feelings for him too...

title: The Billionaire Twins' Substitute Bride
description: Ava discovers her boyfriend wagered her away in a bet, but the man who spent the night with her was never him. It was his powerful twin brother, Killian. What neither brother knows is that Ava recognized the truth from the very beginning. While they fight to control her, she quietly turns their game into their downfall.

title: Pregnant by the Golden Billionaire Bachelor
description: After a one-night stand with an infertile billionaire silver fox, a 45 year old maid discovers she’s pregnant with his twins… as he strives to secure his company’s legacy by producing heirs, they must navigate their clashing worlds and unexpected feelings to see if they can build a family together.

title: The Billionaire’s Vow
description: After an unplanned night at a charity gala, the brilliant but down-on-his-luck financial engineer known as Sammy "Sam" Davis gets swept into a whirlwind romance with cold, calculating billionaire Gertrude Lawson. Sam attends the function to sell himself, but everything changes when a case of mistaken identity propels him into the life of Gertrude. With a need for a husband-or else her father will make her forfeit her CEO title-Gertrude sees an opportunity in Sam.In an effort to save his failing business, Sam agrees to a contract marriage with Gertrude, unaware that dangerous family secrets encircle the Lawson empire. As they navigate their fake marriage, emotions become real, but Gertrude’s vengeful ex-fiance, Victor King, and her ruthless sister, Molly, will stop at nothing to tear them apart. The stakes rise as Sam uncovers a mystery that ties his family to Gertrude’s dark past. With betrayal, hidden love, and a looming corporate takeover, Sam and Gertrude must figure out whether their relationship is just a business deal or something more – before it’s too late.

title: I Married a Secret Billionaire
description: After catching her boyfriend cheating with his boss, Sydney is devastated. Drunk and heartbroken, she accidentally runs into Evan, Riverton's richest man, outside a bar. The two had briefly met in prison six months earlier. On impulse, Sydney proposes a flash marriage, and Evan surprisingly agrees. After the wedding, her life suddenly turns around, leaving her cheating ex furious, while Sydney slowly discovers her new husband is far more powerful than she ever imagined.

title: The Billionaire’s Stand-In Wife
description: A million-dollar deal. A blind billionaire heir. A fake engagement that turns dangerously real. Desperate to save her dying brother, designer Emily agrees to become Alexander’s stand-in fiancée. But the cold, eccentric heir soon falls for the woman who was never meant to stay. When his ruthless stepmother threatens her brother’s life and demands Emily betray Alexander, she uncovers a terrifying secret: her fake engagement was part of a billion-dollar inheritance war. Now love could cost her everything.

title: The Blind Billionaire's Deal
description: 300 million reasons to marry a blind husband. Zero feelings allowed. That was the deal. Too bad no one told her heart—or his.

title: Sweet Debt, Secret Billionaire
description: Corrie Scott, a delivery girl who happened to help an old man. To repay her mother's medical debts, she married his grandson, Charles Francis. Charles is the richest man. At the beginning, he thought this girl was a gold digger, so he hid his true identity. As they lived together, their feelings grew deeper. But his lie gradually became a time bomb, and his childhood sweetheart also came back. Will Charles and Corrie get a happy ending?

title: The Billionaire's Secret Kids
description: After a fleeting night with the icy tycoon Michael, Remi vanishes without a trace. Ten months later, a baby is delivered to him. Years on, while raising his son Noah, he hires a girl, Bella, never realizing she is his own child, while a past illness keeps the truth buried and reunion painfully out of reach.

title: Blood & Silver: Rise of the Alpha's Rejected Mate
description: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Ann Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Dane Montague—her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she’s responsible for his family's death. For three years, Dane torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Ann shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears—leaving behind only a severed ribbon, a credit card, and a secret she hasn’t even discovered yet. Years later, she returns not as Ann Reed, but as Aurora Moon, heir to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power, and secrets. Her mission is clear: protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Dane at all costs. But when she walks back into his world, she triggers the one thing she feared most: his attention. As Dane fights the pull toward the mate he thought he hated, dark forces stir, old enemies rise, and the truth about the past—and their bond—is about to explode. Because Aurora didn’t come back to be claimed. She came back to conquer.

title: Back Off! I'm the Real Mrs. CEO
description:
Freya D'Lore is adored for being the wealthiest woman in America, for both having married a big CEO and crafting the #1 most desired jewelry under an alias. 
When she goes to the office to fill in for her husband, she discovers that another woman has taken up her name and is causing havoc in her personal and professional life.

title: Spoiled by the Daddy CEO During Pregnancy
description: Dawn’s fling with a stranger just got a billion-dollar twist: surprise pregnancy, and the baby daddy is none other than billionaire heartthrob Isaac Stanton! You’d think Dawn’s hit the jackpot… except why is she running away?!

title: Goodbye, My CEO
description: James Knight is your boss. Sexy, rich, and totally off limits. Dating him might destroy your career, but loving him will certainly break your heart. Because what’s worse than knowing you want something, besides knowing you can never have it?

title: Goodbye, My CEO
description: James Knight is your boss. Sexy, rich, and totally off limits. Dating him might destroy your career, but loving him will certainly break your heart. Because what’s worse than knowing you want something, besides knowing you can never have it?

title: How I became the CEO's darling
description: As the adopted daughter of the Getty family, Emily endured a lifetime of mistreatment. A single act of unintentional protection from Thomas kept her by his side for years—until the engagement banquet, where he stood by as others humiliated her. That night, she finally gave up on him and married Lyle in a flash wedding. Over time, Lyle’s unwavering care healed her insecurities, and she realized he had secretly loved her for the past ten years.

title: CEO and the Country Girl
description: When her sister betrays her and a ruthless CEO targets her family farm, fiery small-town cowgirl Avery Rogers clashes—and sparks—with Tyler Sinclair, the corporate heir sent to take her land. But as lust and loyalty collide, a small-town cookout—Tyler’s bold bid to save Avery and her father’s legacy—turns enemies into something dangerously close to lovers, and turning their worlds upside down.

title: Fake Husband, Hidden King
description: Lucas returns to LA as the mysterious CEO of Apex Group, ready to marry his beloved girlfriend, Evelyn. But Evelyn mistakes him for a nobody and leaves him for a "richer man." Little does she know, she just dumped the most powerful billionaire in LA. Then, a stunning female CEO enters Lucas’s life and she gets down on one knee and proposes to Lucas. CEO meets CEO. Together, they become the most powerful couple in the world and make every idiot who underestimated them regret it!

title: CEO, Your Wife Is Gone
description: She has a terminal illness, yet she sees her husband bringing her sister home. He doesn't believe her, tormenting her. An accident makes her forget everything. Yet he refuses to let her forget him...

title: CEO's Unrequited Love
description: Everyone thinks she is an ugly and dumb girl, only her husband and herself know the truth. When will be the day that the shocking truth is revealed? Anyways, he will protect her for always.

title: CEO's Pampered Sweet Wife
description: She entered a contract marriage with him because she bore his child, but they got divorced because she lost the baby. Later, after clearing up their misunderstandings and planning to remarry, he was arranged to marry the woman who caused her to lose the baby...

title: Tricked into Having my Ex-Husband's Baby
description: Erica Lemon hires an escort to get her pregnant after finding out she'll soon be infertile. When her ex-husband, Damon finds out, he replaces the escort and tricks Erica into sleeping with him instead. Now pregnant with her ex-husband’s baby, Erica must decide if it’s worth giving Damon another chance to love her.

title: My Sugar-coated Mafia Boss
description: Athena saves a mafia boss, Dax, but her friend takes the credit. Unexpectedly, Dax becomes Athena's pastry apprentice. Will he uncover Athena's true identity as his savior? What will Athena do when she discovers her pastry apprentice is the undercover kingpin of the underworld?

title: Cold CEO Reads My Silent Mind
description: Mia Hayes quits school to work in a factory cafeteria to pay her mom's medical bills, only to be bullied for being mute. After an unexpected encounter with aloof CEO Oliver Voss, Mia discovers she is pregnant. Miraculously, Oliver can suddenly read her mind! Hearing her inner thoughts, he fiercely protects and spoils her. Mia finally has someone to rely on, but a new crisis is looming...

title: CEO, Your Wife Is Gone
description: She has a terminal illness, yet she sees her husband bringing her sister home. He doesn't believe her, tormenting her. An accident makes her forget everything. Yet he refuses to let her forget him...

title: I Flash-Married My Best Friend?!
description: Chloe and Mateo have been best friends for years, until they accidentally spend one fateful night together and end up in a flash marriage! Will Mateo confess he's been in love with Chloe for years, and pull her out of their "friend-zone"? And what will Chloe do, when she finds out Mateo is secretly a billaionire CEO?

title: Secret Strangers in Love
description: When the fate of a business marriage seems inevitable, Emma Watson, the heiress of the Watson family, takes on an internship at Anderson Corporation. Meanwhile, Ethan Anderson, the heir of the Anderson family, steps in as the new CEO. Both hide their true identities while evaluating each other, but they unexpectedly fall in love at first sight. However, things take an unexpected turn when someone else mistakenly claims Emma’s identity, and she mistakenly believes another man is her “fiancé.” Determined, both Emma and Ethan set out to break off their "engagements" with their so-called "fiancés." Will they ever realize that the person they're searching for has been right in front of them all along?

title: Escorting the Heiress
description: Fiance dumps you, wake up next morning next to a hot escort who might solve your problems.

title: Stop Crying, I Married Someone Better
description: Scarlett Winters is devastated when her fiancé, Carlton Simmons, abandons her at the altar. Fleeing in humiliation, she’s nearly hit by a car, an incident orchestrated by Leo Forester, genius and legendary CEO who recognizes the runaway bride. Leo offers her an unusual solution: a contract marriage to help her regain her dignity and rebuild her life. As Scarlett heals, Leo secretly supports her, hiding his true identity and intentions. But when old enemies resurface and buried secrets emerge, Scarlett feels betrayed and considers leaving. Now Leo must decide: confess his feelings or risk losing her forever.

title: Boss Me Around If You Dare
description: Just after she is falsely accused of sleeping with her boss and fired, Olivia lands a new job at Wilder Conglomerate—only to realize her new boss is Theo Wilder, the man she hooked up with last night! Olivia says they can’t work together, but Theo challenges her to stay and take a bet: he says he can make her fall for him, while Olivia bets she can resist his seduction… but just how long can she last against her boss’ sexy advances?

title: Caution! Cute Baby Alert!
description: 5 years after losing her child at birth, Scarlett marries Bobby Clark on a whim, while his adorable son, Charlie, insists on calling her “Mommy”. When will Bobby reveal that he’s secretly a billionaire CEO? Who is the mysterious woman who claims to be Charlie’s mom? Is this just a fairytale, or will Scarlett find her happily ever after?

title: Yellowstone: King of Montana
description: Henry Conrad, the legendary founder of Yellowstone Ranch and the King of Montana, hid his identity as a school janitor. Now, after 10 years -- he's returning to his throne. However, before he can reveal who he is, his son gets bullied, beaten and humiliated. Henry vows to protect his son, make the bullies pay and right the wrongs in this valley like a real King.

title: Recipe For Faking A Marriage
description: Humble baker Everly agrees to flash marry Julian, a single-dad billionaire who needs a stand-in wife to keep custody of his daughter. What begins as a pretend marriage turns into a recipe for love as they figure out their feelings for each other while battling a jealous nemesis, a stalker ex-fiancé and a batshit crazy ex-wife who will do anything to break them up.

title: Revenge Groom Is My Ex's Uncle
description: Betrayed by Brian and his mistress, Hailey decides to seek revenge by marrying his uncle! But she doesn't realize that she has already met the man she wants to marry!

title: Revenge as My Uncle’s Wife
description: I died broken, my unborn baby killed by my fiancé Kael and his scheming sister Celestia. Reborn, I dumped him and married his mighty uncle Dravon to get revenge. Kael torments my silver dragon, insults me publicly, even kidnaps me on my wedding eve. Trapped in a cursed arena, chained and drained of magic, I thought all hope was lost—until ancient dragon power bursts from my veins. Everyone kneels, and a ghost reveals my hidden identity: the sacred Dragon Lord. Can I make Kael pay for two lifetimes of pain?

title: Revenge Heiress
description: Hailey's father adopted three boys from the orphanage - the Miller brothers, who showered her with endless love and care. She even thought she would end up with one of them. But everything changed when the maid's daughter, Blair, came. They robbed Hailey's family fortune and her life. Now reborn, Hailey chooses to punish the Miller brothers and allies with the one person they fear. This time, the Miller brothers' world is going to shatter.

title: Revenge Before Dawn
description: Skye, Marchioness of Everford, devoted her life to managing her estate, only to be betrayed and killed by the very children she raised. On the brink of death, she discovers the shocking truth: the heirs she loved were not her own, while her true-born children suffer in silence. Reborn on the night before her murder, Skye awakens with crystal-clear clarity and a plan for ruthless revenge.

title: The Mafia Wife's Revenge
description: Isabella believed Salvatore was the man who saved her. He killed her abusive father, built a mafia empire for her, and swore there would be no divorce, only death. Then she uncovered 1,800 photos of another woman. When the mistress stole everything she had bled to protect, Isabella fought back with blood instead. But exposing his betrayal uncovers an even crueler truth. The child she lost, the family they dreamed of, and the marriage she died to protect were all destroyed by the man she loved most.

title: Revenge Before Dawn
description: Skye, Marchioness of Everford, devoted her life to managing her estate, only to be betrayed and killed by the very children she raised. On the brink of death, she discovers the shocking truth: the heirs she loved were not her own, while her true-born children suffer in silence. Reborn on the night before her murder, Skye awakens with crystal-clear clarity and a plan for ruthless revenge.

title: Revenge of the Black Swan
description: Wendy, a naturally gifted ballet prodigy, had her identity maliciously swapped at birth by Helena, a former dancer consumed by jealousy. For eighteen years, she endured abuse and suppression, yet quietly clung to her dream of dancing. To cover her grandfather’s medicalsurgery expenses, she took a job at a theatre and signed up for a competition. However, Angela, the impostor heiress, repeatedly framed her. Worse still, her birth mother Sophia wrongfully accused her of plagiarism, getting her blacklisted across the industry.In her darkest hour, Alexander, a corporate CEO, recognized her talent and resilience. He funded her grandfather’s surgery and supported her as she competed in the International Dance Invitational. Wendy triumphed with her outstanding skill and staged a remarkable comeback. As the truth about her birth unfolded, Angela resorted to desperate measures and orchestrated a car crash, only for all her crimes to come to light. In the end, Wendy reunites with her birth mother, rises to the pinnacle of international ballet, and finds sincere loveachieving a double triumph in both her career and life.

title: Revenge On My Cheating Fiancé
description: Lyla's path to vengeance begins with her working as a waitress in a prestigious restaurant, a far cry from the life she once knew. With each passing day, Lyla's transformation is remarkable. She evolves from a broken-hearted waitress into a formidable and cunning businesswoman, fueled by a quest for revenge, works her way to the top. Does she get her desired revenge?...

title: Revenge After Centuries
description:
After centuries of silence, she rises again.
Buried in blood and betrayal, Scarlett has returned from death — resurrected by the only soul who ever truly loved her, Alexa.
Once sisters by choice and bound by destiny, their story was written in curses, torn apart by betrayal, and sealed beneath centuries of dust. But now, the dead walk again—seeking vengeance.
As Scarlett reclaims her power, she and Alexa wage war against the Salvatore brothers and the ancient vampire Edgar, the Original who cursed their bloodline. Shadows tighten around them, weaving together witchcraft, prophecy, and the unbreakable chain of the sire bond.
In a world ruled by immortality, love becomes both weapon and weakness. Old wounds burn brighter than ever, forcing Scarlett to face one haunting truth—revenge comes with a price, and sometimes that price is love itself.
REVENGE AFTER CENTURIES — a saga of resurrection, betrayal, and revenge that defies time.
Some loves never die. Some hatreds never fade.

title: Revenge-Uniting with My Rival
description: She sacrificed her career for her husband, only to discover he was cheating and secretly transferring marital assets. To gather evidence for a divorce, she guided her husband's mistress to see his true colors and convinced her to cooperate. Will the alliance between these two rivals be unbreakable or filled with jealousy?

title: Secret Love With My Billionaire Revenge Partner
description: Evelyn, who had been severely hurt by her scumbag biological father and vicious stepmother, was saved by Francis, who had secretly loved her for years. Evelyn had plastic surgery and changed her identity. She carried out her revenge plan as Francis' sister. Even though Evelyn was focused on revenge, she couldn't help falling in love with Francis. After going through many hardships, Evelyn and Francis finally got married.

title: A Soldier's Revenge
description: After three years away, Grant returns home with a brooch for his sister Ella—only to witness her fall to her death from the top of Vanguard Tech. In her final moments, Ella reveals that Kane orchestrated her downfall, stole her company, and drove her to her death. Grant gives himself three days to exact revenge. At a merger celebration, he unleashes his lethal skills—while his in-laws, the Richards, and other relatives continue to mock and belittle him, unaware that he has just been sworn in as the new FBI Director. As he protects his wife Laura and systematically dismantles Kane's conspiracy, Grant hunts down every last perpetrator—and reclaims the company his sister built with her own blood and tears.

title: Revenge Game: Temptation of the Wife
description: On the eve of her wedding, heiress Evelyn Vance is betrayed by her fiance Parker Crawford and half-sister Melody Vance. After her father is driven to death, she is poisoned and tossed into the sea. Surviving against the odds, she gets a new face and returns as the Sinclair Group heiress, Audrey Sinclair. Driven by vengeance, she orchestrates their downfall with debt, scandal, and murder charges. Ultimately, she destroys the Crawfords, sends her ex to prison, drives her wicked sister mad, and finds true love.

title: Revenge of the Fallen Guardian
description: Chris spent a thousand years guarding Fiendlocket Spire, holding back dangerous beasts like the Cinder Krin and Thunderstrike Phoenix. When the royal family demands that he give up control for a new Sea God, Chris leaves. Half a day later, the spire crumbles, releasing the creatures, and chaos ensues. The empire falls, and those who banished him beg for his help. But Chris walks away, carrying his sister. "I guarded, you cast me aside. Now, you beg me to return... It's too late."

title: Never Reject a Dragon Princess
description: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty only to be betrayed and rejected by her lover Derek. It's time for Lia to get her revenge and claim her place as the Dragon Princess. But why won't anyone believe her?

title: Seducing the Tyrant's Queen: The Apprentice's Revenge
description: Stripped of her powers and crushed under the heel of her tyrant husband, Mora—the fallen Valkyrie Queen—is forced to train Raven, a seemingly docile new apprentice. But the quiet girl is a predator in disguise. Piece by piece, Raven lures her icy mentor into a lethal game of illicit seduction, high-stakes revenge, and absolute power inversion. By day, their world is ruled by strict master-apprentice hierarchy. By night, their chambers transform into a battlefield of forbidden temptation and a reverse hunt.

title: Go Away Stepmom, You Have It All Wrong!
description: On the day of her father’s wedding, Margaret rushes home early from college exams to attend the ceremony, only to be mistaken by her future stepmother, Chloe, as her father’s mistress. While her father is away, Chloe takes every opportunity to humiliate and mistreat Margaret. Can Margaret clear her name and expose Chloe’s true colors before it’s too late?

title: The Bad-ass Heiress Returns After Divorce
description: Framed for cheating and losing her 8-month-old unborn baby, Sophia vows to get revenge on those who ruined her life—Ryan Allister and Lana Sullivan. When the Sullivan family tracks her down and reveals she's the real heiress, not Lana, Sophia sees her chance to make her ex-husband and the faker pay. She hides her newfound identity and starts her quest for revenge. Along the way, Ryan realizes he can't live without Sophia and he was fooled by Lana in the beginning.

title: The Revenge of the Forgotten Luna
description: Everyone believed Alpha Dominic Hale was obsessed with Lyra. He slaughtered for her, forced the mate bond on her, and kept her by his side for eight bloody years. Then he chose another Luna and called Lyra too dirty to stand beside him. On his wedding day, she drove a silver knife into his heart and vowed to make him repay every scar he had given her. But the deeper her revenge went, the more horrifying the truth became. The mate she loved was also the monster who destroyed her family.

title: Seducing Mr. Larsen
description: After being dumped by her ex, Nola unexpectedly finds herself in the arms of Ryan Laren—her ex’s future father-in-law, a man of immense wealth and power. Learning of her complicated bond with his daughter, Ryan tries to stay away. But Nola keeps breaking his rules, drawing him deeper into a dangerous attraction.

title: Alpha Mate Unchained
description: He killed his vicious father to save her.  Now the new Alpha King must hide his fated mate and use a decoy fake Luna to keep her alive. But while he’s away battling, she’s discovered by the Fake Luna and brutally tortured.  Can she survive long enough for the Alpha King’s return and vengeance?

title: Mother Warrior Unleashed
description: When her teenage daughter is grabbed by sex traffickers, the legendary warrior, Navy SEAL Lieutenant Phoenix Ryan, abandons her life of anonymity as a small town diner owner to rescue her daughter and destroy the Navarro Cartel that has taken her.

title: The Hidden Empire of Stephen Adams
description: Stephen Adams is just your average construction worker. A hardworking, single dad who stays humble... or at least that's what his son thinks. Turns out, Stephen actually runs the biggest construction corporation in America! But he's hiding his identity from his son to keep him humble and teach him the value of hard work. But, when an arrogant bully threatens his son, Stephen has no choice but to step in. Will Stephen's son finally discover his true identity?

title: The Lie Between Us
description: On the brink of death, Melody McGee uncovers a shocking secret: her husband, Paul Briggs, is alive and masquerading as his twin brother, Basil, while living with Basil's wife! Given a second chance, Melody is hell-bent on revenge.

title: Reborn to See the Football Stars Ruin Themselves
description:
The night before the State Championship final, cheerleader Jessica invites the Maple Giants football team to party with her at the bar.  Katlyn, as the team's manager, puts her foot down and demands they get a good nights rest instead of going out and drinking. The next day, the Maple Giants win the championship, only to be greeted with terrible news — Jessica went out alone last night, was assaulted and broke her legs. The team, led by Logan, pins the blame on Katlyn, claiming that if she hadn't stopped them from going to Jessica's party, Jessica would still be safe! Logan demands that Katlyn suffers the same fate and breaks her leg. While trying to escape, Katlyn falls off the roof and dies. The football team even frames her as a bully.
Katlyn suddenly wakes up the night before the Championship Final! Not about to waste her second chance at life, Katlyn swears to herself she'll never help these dumb jocks again. Instead, she'll watch and enjoy as they bring about their self-destruction!

title: Regret is the Punishment
description:
MC Karen is a stay at home mom, her husband Tom is a rich Lawyer. While Karen is out, her house catches on fire and their five year old daughter Anna falls to her death. 
Good samaritan Merry goes with the fire truck to take Anna to the hospital, driven by Bob, the fire captain. They need to take Anna to the ER for surgery as soon as possible.
The fire truck hits Karen's car, on her way back from cheating on her husband. She demands they grovel for forgiveness, then pay for damages, wasting their time. Merry and Eve, the paramedic, as well as kind passerbys, try to get her to move. Karen does not give in, not realizing the fire truck is trying to save her own daughter.

title: Fake Daughter, Real Heiress
description: Iris, a rich CEO's wife, harbored regrets for never meeting her biological parents. Upon receiving news of her mom, she took her daughter Eva back to reunite with them. However, the fake daughter Sophie and her brother Lawrence mocked Iris for being crude. At the family dinner, Sophie bragged about her daughter Clara's competition awards, but she didn't know Iris's daughter was a genius. Later, Sophie framed Eva of stealing, and Iris's mom just said Iris was only her goddaughter. Iris felt utterly disappointed. Then her billionaire husband came...

title: I Divorced on Delivery Day
description: Heiress Joy Quinn hides her identity and cuts ties with her family to marry broke boyfriend Ryan Zimmer. But just as she's about to give birth, betrayal strikes. With the baby in the wrong position, Joy checks into a private hospital. But Ryan's best friend Yasmine accuses her of faking it for luxury. Manipulated, Ryan tries to move Joy to a cheaper clinic, sparking explosive drama. Just then, Joy's father, billionaire Raymond Quinn, arrives bearing lavish gifts. But Ryan and Yasmine mock him, refusing to believe his identity. As three elite CEOs show up honor Quinn, the truth is revealed. But it's already too late. Joy loses the baby and demands a divorce. Desperate, Ryan spreads lies online, accusing Joy and her father of murdering the child. The internet turns vicious. Raymond strikes back with evidence, and calls the police. In the end, Ryan and Yasmine are convicted and sentenced.

title: Sadness Knows No Boundaries
description: Charlotte Hasting's life is turned upside down after her daughter dies due to her husband's negligence and favoritism for a pretty employee. To make matters worse, her husband won't believe her, and thinking that she's hiding their daughter from him, continuously makes her life a living hell.

title: True Heiress Saves High School
description: When Amelia Monroe finds out that hoemcoming queens are dying at her family's academy, she poses as a student to investigate the cause. But she meets her match with Kristy Troy - the baddest bully at Monroe Academy. When they face off for homecoming queen - who will win? And will Amelia save her family's school?

title: Modern Surgeon Became the Princess
description: Betrayed by her sister and fiancé, modern doctor Juliana Collins is forced to marry Prince Aubrey—a crippled war hero despised by the emperor. Armed with a secret medical system, she navigates deadly court conspiracies, heals the wounded, and uncovers the truth behind her mother's murder. As she fights for survival, she transforms from pawn to power—winning Aubrey's heart and threatening the throne itself.

title: Dominate Me Please, General
description: In her previous life, Amelia, the daughter of Grand Tutor, was schemed against by her half sister Marianne and the Crown Prince Julian. Her family was ruined, and she met a tragic end in the Cold Palace. Valen, the strongest general, died fighting to protect her corpse. Amelia was reborn to the night when she was sent to Valen's bed. She wouldn't be a love-struck fool this time. Taking revenge and protecting her family was all she wanted. She proposed to be Valen's ally. She didn't know Valen had also returned with memories about their last life...

title: Accidental Surrogate for Alpha
description: Ella is deathly afraid of werewolves; now she’s pregnant with one. Forced into a contract marriage with billionaire Alpha Dominic Moon, she must hide her identity to survive.

title: Dragonblood Alpha
description: Abandoned as an infant for lacking a "wolf spirit," Kyle is raised by three Legendary Beasts in the Beast Forest. Eighteen years later, he has not only grown into a fierce fighter but also awakened the hidden power of a dragon within him. Seeking his parents, Kyle rescues Freya, the Princess of the Silvermoon Pack, and follows her to the Crimson Flame City.  There, he discovers that Elina, a disgraced slave tormented by the pack's hypocritical Alpha, Alaric, is actually his birth mother. Just as they reunite, the Thunderclaw Pack launches a devastating invasion. While Alaric and the cowardly heir Kent surrender and betray Freya to save themselves, Kyle steps forward, unleashing his dragon-wolf bloodline to crush the invaders.  However, a darker conspiracy emerges: the Thunderclaw Pack has allied with the Liches, an evil undead race bent on destroying the world. Facing the terrifying Lich King and an endless army of ghouls, Kyle is empowered by Freya's holy light and the united strength of every werewolf worldwide. Transforming into a colossal silver wolf, Kyle defeats the Lich King and saves the realm. In the end, his father, the ancient dragon Vodar, awakens from his slumber, reuniting their family. Kyle claims his rightful place as the new Alpha of the Crimson Flame Pack and finds true love with Freya.

title: Alpha's only mate
description: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Yuna storms out with her heart shattered. Then she meets Jin—a dangerously sexy man whose magnetic presence she can't resist. But Jin is no ordinary man. He's an elite Alpha werewolf hiding a deadly secret: he's cursed, and the only way to survive is to bond with Yuna. As their forbidden attraction grows, Yuna finds herself trapped between desire and danger. Is Jin the monster she should fear—or the only man who can save her?

title: The Alpha King's Stolen Bride
description: The Bride's mate betrays her by eloping with her sister, who was originally meant to marry the most feared Alpha King in history. To protect her pack, the Bride agrees to marry the Alpha King in her sister's place. Her former mate remains unaware of the switch, still believing she is his bride. The two wedding ceremonies are held simultaneously. Just as the Bride is about to leave forever, her former mate realizes the truth and, consumed by regret, seizes her from the Alpha King in a desperate bid to win her back. But the Bride's heart already belongs to the Alpha King—and the two have become true mates. Can her former mate still reclaim what he lost?

title: Return of the Alpha’s Daughter
description: Aurora gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But, when he’s promoted to Alpha’s General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Aurora is the lost wolf princess--destined to be Alpha Queen--and he'll regret letting her go.

title: Fated to My Forbidden Alpha
