description: Rejected by your mate, you feel hopeless and dejected, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for you!

title: The True Alpha Princess
description: Vivian, as the true Alpha Princess, decides to hide her identity and transfer schools after her awakened wolf powers spiral out of control. However, on the first day of school, she encounters a fake princess who is impersonating her identity. The fake princess constantly uses false privileges to bully Vivian, even attempting to steal her fiancé, Seth. In the end, Vivian successfully exposes the fake princess in front of everyone, ensuring that she receives the punishment she deserves.

title: Alphas Never Kneel
description:
Ryan, the powerful Lycan King who rules seven wolf clans, endures a devastating betrayal from the people he holds dearest. Poisoned and thrown off a cliff, he narrowly escapes death and drifts to a desolate border territory. There he crosses paths with Sophia, a humble young Omega who turns out to be his long‑awaited true fated mate. 

Back in the royal capital, the traitors usurp power and unleash a terrifying corrupting dark force upon the wolf empire. Horrific mutated creatures sweep across the land, plunging countless territories into chaos and peril.

As Ryan recovers his strength, he and Sophia form an unbreakable soul bond. United by love and a sense of duty, they gather loyal followers and rally the great wolf clans. Facing overwhelming shadow threats and hidden foes within their ranks, the pair unlock their latent divine powers together. 

With the whole kingdom on the brink of ruin, Ryan and Sophia must stand side by side to confront the looming darkness.

title: Countdown to Leaving the Alpha King
description: Five days before the wedding, Princess Mina discovers that Alpha King Lucien is only marrying her to seize the Moon Goddess's power through her bloodline. Once he succeeds, he will reject her and wed her sister Elise, his true love. Heartbroken, Mina secretly swaps places with Elise and agrees to become the Vampire King's bride. On the wedding day, Lucien lifts the veil and finds Elise standing in Mina's place. In that crushing moment, he finally realizes that Mina is the one he truly loves. But it is too late. Mina is already sealed inside the vampire's coffin, lost to him forever. He kneels in the empty hall, screaming her name into the silence. No answer comes. Regret drowns him, and the woman who gave him everything is gone, never to return.

title: The Photo that Changed Everything
description: On their wedding night, the CEO of the Walker Group, Griffin Walker, is tied up to a chair and forced to witness his wife Isabella cheat on him with three men at the same time. Enraged, he seeks revenge, but Isabella stops him in his tracks with a single photograph. For the next eighteen years, Griffin willingly raises Isabella's twins - a boy and a girl - born from her and one of those men, Ethan. He endures humiliation and mockery from them and is forced to transfer his company and all assets to the twins when they turn eighteen. Everyone thinks Griffin is held captive by that single photo, but at the moment Isabella's family celebrates their triumph, Griffin finally reveals the truth...

title: My Hockey Alpha
description: Nina runs into hot hockey captain Enzo at a party after she catches her boyfriend Justin cheating. Since Enzo's a known player who only sleeps with girls once, Nina agrees to a no strings attached night of fun with Enzo, but when they both catch feelings, Nina learns that Enzo's player reputation is due to a rule: he can't have sex with anyone twice, or they'll die. The catch is...if Nina's his fated mate, she's safe. But that's not all. Enzo's got a crazy ex-hookup who won't let him go and wants to make Lisa's life a living hell. And once Nina lost her virginity, her true hybrid nature emerged, putting her sister Selena's crosshairs.  Selena wants to escape the Lycan World by switching places with Nina. While Enzo and Nina try to navigate their budding romance amidst never ending drama, the Sister kidnaps Nina to the Lycan World--all with the help of Nina's internship colleague James. All the while Enzo is fighting to stake his pack's place in the human world by winning a hockey tournament against his sworn enemy Ronan, while Enzo's father plans to marry him off to none other than Nina's sister Selena. In the end, Enzo wins his tournament, and Selena comes into the human world and pretends to be Nina, until Enzo's father blows her cover. Enzo races to the Lycan World to save Nina, and they finally have sex for the second time and learn that Nina is, indeed, Enzo's fated mate. Enzo has one more rule...no more sex without engagement, and he takes Nina as his fiance...and they live happily ever after.

title: The Alpha’s Substitute Bride
description:
The small town of Moonridge in the Pacific Northwest is secretly ruled by a werewolf clan. Ava, the eldest daughter of the declining Reed werewolf family, is branded a “useless outcast” for her inability to shift into a wolf. She is forced to toil endlessly for her kin.
Desperate to secure alliance gold to pay off family debts, her mother compels her to take her younger sister’s place — the sister refuses the match — and marry Damon, the ruthless new Alpha of the Blackwood Pack. Ava steps into Blackwood Lodge in despair, yet unexpectedly wins the affection of Damon’s mother, Martha. The cold‑hearted Damon is also gradually moved by her resilience as they spend time together.
Hidden deep within Ava flows the Moon‑Blessed Luna Blood, a power that begins to revive the fading wolf pack. Her parasitic birth family comes crawling back once more, and her jealous younger sister attempts to seduce Damon. This time, Ava refuses to back down. With the support of Martha and Damon, she severs all ties with the Reed family. What was once feared as a den of wolves ultimately becomes her true home.

title: The Alpha's Unclaimed Mate—I Rose to Lycan Royalty
description: Ava, a wolf-less Omega raised for four years by Alpha David, believes she is finally ready to awaken her wolf with a Moon Tear flower and become David's fated mate. But on the eve of their ceremony, she finds David in bed with Mia, a noblewoman of the pack, who steals her only chance at awakening. As David and Mia hold their bonding ritual, Ava reaches her lowest point—and in that moment of despair, her dormant royal bloodline erupts. She is not a nameless rogue. She is the long-lost Lycan Princess, hidden for twelve years. And her true fiancé is not the Alpha who betrayed her, but the Lycan Prince who has guarded her from the shadows for over a decade. When her repentant former Alpha comes crawling back and the rebel Dark Moon clan rises to claim her royal blood, Ava must wield her awakened power to reclaim her throne, her destiny, and everything that was stolen from her.

title: The Alpha King's Half-Blood Twins
description: Annie, a human, fell in love with Fenrir, the wolf king, and bore twin half-blood children. Yet they were brutally exiled due to blood prejudice and Mara’s malicious schemes. Five years later, the twins’ werewolf blood awakens unexpectedly, dragging the whole family back into power struggles and deadly hunts. Following the clues, Fenrir uncovers the truth of the past. While protecting his wife and daughters, he exacts revenge on the real mastermind behind all the crimes.

title: Fated to My Homeless Billionaire Alpha
description: Elara catches her fiancé, Victor, cheating on her with her best friend, Helena. Devastated, Elara impulsively marries a humble homeless man named Liam. Unbeknownst to Elara, Liam is actually the billionaire Alpha leader of the werewolf world. And he spoils Elara beyond her wildest dreams!

title: Cursed Alpha’s Fated Luna
description:
He's the strongest Alpha alive—cursed so that anyone who touches him burns to ash. She's a wolfless mage apprentice who fell from the sky straight into his arms… and didn't burn.
Desperate to find her fated mate, Aria takes a job as Kael's personal maid, unaware the cold, dangerous Alpha is already falling for her. But a dark prophecy looms: their child will carry a curse far deadlier than his—and bearing it could cost Aria her life.
When rivals attack and Aria's life hangs by a thread, Kael will face the deadliest mountain in the world to save her. Because some fates aren't written—they're fought for.

title: The Alpha Commander’s Long-Awaited Omega
description: “It’s just a formality.” Reynolds threw those words in Eliot’s face on their wedding day, leaving him behind to greet his comrade. Four years of lies, another Alpha’s scent on Reynolds’ skin.Eliot didn’t cry. He ripped off his ring, threw it at Reynolds’ feet, and walked into the hall across.Vaughn had been waiting there for four years. White roses. Starlight lamps. A ring he’d kept since they were kids. He spent four years climbing four ranks just to rewrite the law that locked Omegas out of the mech bay. He never told Eliot. He just pried the door open and waited.

title: The Alpha King’s Slave Bride
description:
Omega orphan Haiyi was married off to Beta Thomas at 18. Blamed for barren years, she suffered brutal abuse. When the council threatened exile, Thomas drugged her on a full moon night and abandoned her in a remote castle — planning to have rogues breed her by force.
The castle hides Wolf King Gareth, who goes feral every full moon from Wolfsbane poisoning. In beast form, he catches her heat pheromones and claims her, forging an unbreakable fated mate bond.
Gareth tracks her scent, executes pack justice on Thomas, and installs her as his personal maid. She strikes a deal: she guards his secret and soothes his feral episodes; he shields her from harm. No forced intimacy.
Surviving jealous maids and noble fiancée Cecilia's schemes, Haiyi pulls him back from madness each full moon. Dangerous nights spark an undeniable attachment.

title: The Pack's Doctor
description: After losing her family and her pack, pre-med student, Yara, wants to leave the wolf world behind and live as a normal college girl. But when she stumbles across Alpha Warren, a strong, sexy pack leader and saves his life, he’s hellbent on proving to her she belongs at his side. Convinced they’re fated mates, Warren takes Yara back to his pack to make her queen. When he crowns her pack doctor, Yara goes from shy student to leading Luna, and slowly falls for the Alpha who loves her as she is.

title: You Betrayed the Wrong Alpha Queen
description: Ravena Mooncrest, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Draven Nightfang. But Draven mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Ravena cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Draven to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?

title: Three Alphas Abandoned Me for that Omega, Then Regretted It
description: Evelyn, heir to the Crimson Moon Pack, once trusted her three Alpha fiancés completely, only to discover they were manipulating her for Mia—a fragile Omega who is secretly an enemy spy. Blinded by Mia's lies, the Alphas repeatedly crush Eve with their dominance. In her darkest hour, Eve’s ancient Moon Queen bloodline awakens, drawing Kyle, a top Alpha who has guarded her in secret for years. Kyle rescues her and seals their bond. At her mating ceremony, Eve publicly rejects the three Alphas and chooses Kyle. The spy is exposed and destroyed, leaving the three Alphas in eternal regret while Eve and Kyle claim the throne.

title: Worthless to Priceless The Alpha's Rejected Mate
description:
An unloved twin, betrayed by family and her only love.
Hunted and abandoned, she flees to the dark ruthless Alpha King.
Hidden power, deadly secrets, and a forbidden dark destiny.
The outcast she-wolf becomes the queen of the night.

title: Dumped by My Amnesiac Wolf Alpha
description: Mara Quinn agrees when her amnesiac Alpha husband asks for divorce. Rowan Hale has forgotten their marriage, but not his body's reaction to her: one collision at the clerk's office and he wants to court her "properly, with marriage as the goal." Mara tries a gentle cat orc, yet only Rowan can make her burn. During rut, the strongest Apex commander cuffs himself and gives her the key, proving he can stop when she says stop. When his memories return, the truth hits: he chose Mara before, and without memories, chose her again.

title: The Alpha’s Ugly Luna Awakened as the White Wolf
description: Willow celebrates a positive pregnancy test until she overhears a monstrous truth: her Alpha husband, Adrian, has never touched her. Every time she trusted him, his Beta took his place behind her blindfold, while Adrian built a lie to brand her unfaithful and crown his mistress Luna. Betrayed, pregnant, and trapped in a pack that calls her wolfless and ugly, Willow plans her escape. But under the full moon, her birthmark vanishes, a legendary white wolf awakens, and the men who used her begin hunting the woman they can no longer recognize.

title: My Wolf is the Sun God
description: Sun god Apollo angers Zeus, loses his power, and becomes a dying wolf. To survive, he bites Hecate, triggering an ancient fated-bond contract that shares their life and power. A fallen god and a shattered goddess—reluctant master and servant—struggle through Olympus trials. He regains strength by drinking her blood; she heals with his solar essence. From wolf to wolf-eared youth to human, Apollo evolves as Hecate sacrifices herself to save him. He builds her a sun-wolf pack and storms the underworld. When Hades unleashes the primordial god-king Cronus, Apollo realizes his fall and love for Hecate were all Zeus and the Fates' final move. They are the only answer to Ragnarök.

title: Wolf of the North
description: Avalyn, a lone girl raised by wolves in the northern wilderness, is brought back by her birth father Duke Snow only to get trapped in royal conspiracies. After her father is murdered, she bides her time and devises schemes. With her courage and beast-taming skills, she slays her enemies, quells barbarian uprisings and earns widespread renown across the kingdom. Eventually, she uncovers her true identity as the lost heir of the Sacred Court of All Beasts, returns to the divine realm, executes the usurper, and ascends the Throne of All Beasts.

title: Married as Her Sister’s Stand-In: I Accidentally Fell for the Billionaire Wolf Alpha
description:
Serena, the true heiress whose life was stolen from her, is forced to take another woman’s place and marry the cast-off Wolf King, a man rumored to be blind and brutally cruel.
On their wedding night, as she hovers on the brink of death, an ancient astral power awakens within her. Only then does she discover that she is no worthless failure, but a fully awakened witch—the only person capable of purifying the Wolf King’s curse. And he is no helpless cripple, but a trillionaire Wolf King who has been biding his time in the shadows.

She intends to reclaim her identity, her magic, and her dignity. In return, he will crush the powerful dynasties, the Mages’ Guild, the vampires, and even the gods for her.

When the entire world seeks to erase her from existence, the Wolf King chooses to defy the whole universe by her side.

title: The Raven Wolf King: Wolfless
description:
“Did you get rejected?!” My sister Jade laughs at me. “I knew it! I told you that you would. No one would ever want you. A wolfless. But I’m more surprised that you, of all people, found a fated mate. Kind of unfair if you ask me.”
It stings to hear this. It’s exactly what happened. She was right.
“Well, let’s not let this bring us down.” Mother smiles and claps. “It’s been decided that Jade is to be mated to the fourth wolf prince. ”
Jade smirks. “One of the bastard illegitimate princes, but I’m not complaining.” She smiles with pride. “He’s still a prince.”
The crowd suddenly grow noisy. The princes arrive. 
“Alpha Prince Dorian, the fourth prince, Antonio the fifth, and Emmet the sixth—all of them illegitimate.” All three men wave with broad smiles. Suddenly, another man hurries past them. “That’s Alpha Prince Raphael! Second born to a true royal‑blooded Luna.”
The stunning blond man—his hair lighter than even my mother’s or sister’s—strides forward with an imposing pace. His bright blue eyes gleam beneath the black suit and satin shirt, half‑unbuttoned to reveal the edge of his tattoos. I freeze as his gaze locks onto mine. Time itself seems to stop, because that man… is him. The one who broke my heart. The one who rejected me. The one who shattered our bond. 
My fated mate.

title: The Black Wolf They Cast Aside
description: Maeve is neglected and abused by her parents while her sister Bianca is adored. Bianca frames her, steals her allowance, and forges a letter selling Maeve to a rogue Alpha. Maeve escapes death, is rescued by Enforcer Adler, and rebuilds her life. She testifies against Harlan Briggs, transfers to a new Pack, and earns a place at Highspire Academy. When her parents beg forgiveness, she cuts all ties. Bianca is arrested. Maeve becomes the youngest Chief Enforcer, finds her fated mate Cassian, and builds a loving family.

title: White Wolf Returns, Mate Regret
description: Mae was mocked as a blind, wolfless Luna until her legendary White Wolf bloodline awakened and restored her sight. The first thing she saw was her mate betraying her with another woman carrying his pup. While he believed she knew nothing, Mae quietly chose to return to Crescent Hollow and claim the throne destined for her. By the time the Alpha realizes he abandoned the future Queen of all wolves, she is already gone. But some mistakes can never be undone.

title: The Wolf Commander's Wrong Bride
description: Ivy endured two years of cold marriage to Commander Ian, a wolf shifter who never wanted a human wife. When the Marriage Bureau reveals their perfect match was a system error, she finally asks for a divorce—only for Ian to refuse. The distant husband who once barely came home now won't stay away. As the truth about her real perfect match emerges, Ivy must choose: return to her own world, or stay with the man fighting fate to prove their bond was never a mistake.

title: Heir Abduction, Wolf King's Chase
description: Sienna Reed set out to reclaim the Jiang Group that had belonged to her late mother. In a twist of fate, she ended up sharing a night with Adrian Voss, the Wolf King. Three days later, the seal on his wolf stone broke, and she conceived his child. Four years later, they crossed paths again. Sienna returned with not one, but two of the Wolf King’s cubs. She fled relentlessly while he chased her down, leaving her with no escape at all. Just as she was convinced he harbored nothing but deep hatred for her, he doted on her beyond measure.

title: Mom & Dad: I Became the Savage Wolf You Craved
description:
Mom & Dad: I Became the Savage Wolf You Craved tells the story of Elara, heir to the millennium-old White Wolf bloodline of the wolf clan. Gentle and kind by nature, she is despised and abused by her parents—the Alpha and Luna of the clan—who push her to be cruel and bloodthirsty, even casting her into the Blood Moon Coliseum filled with feral mad wolves to “harden” her. Lyra, an adopted human girl, is secretly the daughter of the Dark Witch. She uses dark magic to fake a wolf spirit, seizes Elara’s birthright as heir, and brutally stabs Elara to death in the coliseum with a silver blade.
The Dark Witch turns Elara’s corpse into a mindless undead puppet forced to kill, disguising it as Elara having “evolved into a savage wolf” to win her parents’ approval. Only when the truth is exposed do her parents realize they have driven their only daughter—who alone could save the wolf clan—to her death. In the end, they meet their demise amid remorse and vengeance.
A heartbreaking tale of twisted reversal, it lays bare the despair of being misunderstood, abandoned, and sacrificed by one’s own flesh and blood, and reveals that belated repentance can never heal irreversible wounds.

title: My Wolf Queen Girlfriend
description:
Lyra, the heir to the Wolf Clan’s throne, takes on the role of Kai’s “girlfriend” to repay the human boy for saving her life twelve years ago. 
Together, they weather clan conflicts and a manhunt by the Wolf Clan, fall in love, and defeat the villain Sable.
In the end, Lyra is crowned queen, and Kai transforms into a werewolf to protect her. Together, they work to safeguard each other’s worlds.

title: My Wolf Guard Chose My Sister, So I Chose the Alpha King
description: Emma spent years protecting Ethan, a supposedly mute werewolf, only to hear him speak when he chose to save her sister from a deadly fire. Reborn on the day their father bought the twin wolf guards, Emma refuses to repeat her mistake. She gives both brothers to Sophia, enters the family empire, and builds the power she was once denied. But when betrayal turns into kidnapping and murder, Emma fakes her death and joins forces with Mason Astor, the ruthless Alpha King and her family’s greatest rival. This time, the abandoned heiress won’t beg to be chosen—she’ll destroy everyone who chose against her.

title: My Boss Is a Hungry Wolf
description: Emily Smith only wanted to survive another brutal week under Alexander Blackwood, the ruthless CEO of Obsidian and the most powerful Alpha in North America. But when her cat sends a wildly suggestive GIF from her phone, Alexander takes it as the signal he has been waiting for. Their office tension explodes during a business trip to Alaska, where Emily’s Omega instincts are triggered and Alexander protects her from a hostile wolf pack. Terrified of becoming his possession, Emily flees back to her family farm in Ohio, leaving him only $5.50 as “payment.” Furious, obsessed, and half-feral, Alexander tracks her across three states, wins over her family, crushes every rival, and drags their bond back into the heart of Manhattan. In the end, Emily may still dream of being an independent Wall Street woman, but the hungry wolf she works for has already chosen her as his mate.

title: Stolen Princess and Her Wolf Daughter
description: At eight, I watched low-rank Brett torture my mad mom, a stolen pureblood wolf princess, while the whole clan praised him as a devoted mate. I dug up her family crest pendant, stopped Alpha Ryker’s convoy to beg rescue. We exposed his cruel restraints, but Brett threatened revenge. Sneaking into his cell, I killed him alone. Later, hidden letters uncovered official Slade’s trafficking plot. I regained my Shen royal name, married gentle Prince Caden, yet I still hide the bloody secret buried deep inside me.

title: My Forced Alpha Mate
description:
Isabella, a lowly Omega, is sold by her greedy family as a bargaining chip to Blake—the notorious “Tyrant Wolf” and top Alpha—becoming his contract mate. Cold wedding night, family betrayal, wolf pack rejection—she’s trapped in despair. But during a deadly attack, she awakens her sealed Moon Wolf bloodline. The once meek Omega transforms into the most powerful ancient wolf heir. She systematically destroys her
traitorous family and wolf pack villains. Blake, once cold and ruthless, becomes completely devoted to her, drawn to her strength and resilience. Together, they fight for racial redemption and revenge in a journey of love and hate.

title: I’m Not a Forsaken Wolf, I’m the Lord
description:
For generations, the Wolf Clan has held the Silvermoon Sanctuary as their holiest ground—a place of ancient, unbridled power. Its ruler, Luna, gave up everything for love: she hid her true identity, married her mortal beloved Kael, raised a family with him, and quietly used her authority to maneuver him onto the throne as Wolf King.

Just as she was finally ready to reveal herself and hand over her power to the man she trusted, Kael returned from a victorious campaign—with a stunning new woman on his arm, flaunting her in front of the entire court. That was the moment Luna’s illusions shattered.

Now, she’s done playing the devoted wife. With the full weight of her hidden dominion behind her, Luna takes ruthless aim at the cheating king and his scheming mistress—and she makes sure they remember exactly who truly holds the power.

title: My Brothers Begged, But I'm the Dragon's Queen
description: In the Solis Empire, locked in eternal winter, only a marriage between a princess of pure royal blood and the Abyss Dragon can bring back the warmth of the sun. Princess Diana grew up happy alongside her three brothers — until Lorelei arrived. Using a stolen Dragon's scale, Lorelei seized all of Diana's love and standing. Deceived, the three brothers cast Diana aside — even offering her as a sacrifice to slay the dragon. Only after the dragon took Diana away did the truth emerge. By then, it was too late.

title: The Death Payout System: Escaping My Toxic Pack
description: Returning from three years of exile, Evelyn no longer resisted the torment and punishments, choosing instead to submit to it all. What her family didn't know was that she had awakened a system that converted her pain into cash rewards. The day she accumulated enough pain points would be the day she finally left them for good.

title: Alpha Revenge: Wolf King and His Human Luna
description: Her parents were cruelly killed by werewolves, yet she has now become the Fated Luna of the werewolf Alpha. However, their love defies werewolf traditions, sparking conflict as they face rogue wolves and ancient prophecies. With hidden powers and fierce rivalries at play, love, destiny, and power clash in this thrilling tale of passion and survival.

title: Destroy My Silver Wolf Bloodline？I'll Marry a Top Alpha Then
description:
Destroy My Silver Wolf Bloodline? I Marry the Top Alpha Instead is a thrilling, dark werewolf romance about ultimate revenge and transformation. Natalie, heir to the powerful Warwick silver wolf bloodline, carries the gift to call upon moonlight and protect her pack. She devotes six years to Alpha Liam, only to face brutal betrayal on the eve of their wedding. Zoe, Liam’s deputy, deliberately shaves off her sacred silver hair—the symbol of her legacy—and drugs her to weaken her power. Liam knows everything but chooses to condone, trampling her love and dignity.
In despair, Natalie awakens her long-buried True Mate bond, summoning Nicholas, the most supreme Alpha. Nicholas has waited patiently for years and rises to defend her with overwhelming power. He punishes the betrayers through clan and alliance authority, helping Natalie regain her strength and pride. Finally, she breaks free from the toxic love and marries Nicholas, rising from a humiliated fiancée to the revered Luna of the Lycan Clan. It is a dark epic of blood, loyalty, and true love, celebrating a glorious rebirth from ruin.

title: Too Late, Alphas
description: Aria was the beloved heiress, but on her birthday, she was abandoned by her two Alpha fiancés, Adrian and Julian. The scheming maid Selena took her place, using a potion to fake a mate bond and steal their trust. Drowned, forgotten on her birthday, even wounded by their own hands—Aria's heart turned to ice. Just as everyone thought she would submit, she declared: "I will marry Damien, the Alpha of the Blood Moon Pack!" The new engagement freed her and brought her a powerful guardian. When the truth was revealed, the regretful Alphas realized they had lost Aria forever—she was now the Luna of another pack.

title: Two Wolf Pups: The Lost Darling of the Heirless Alpha King
description:
Seven years ago, crown prince Kyle Silvermoon was soul-bonded to his fated mate Liya. After she gave birth to twins, his stepmother Rosa framed her. Liya plunged off a cliff with her babies—and Kyle lost his soul, believing them dead.

But Liya survived at the cliff's bottom with son Naz and daughter Alice. When Alice falls deathly ill from lack of her father's pheromones, Naz breaks into the palace—and a bloodline test reveals the truth: they are Kyle's children.

Liya returns to save her daughter, enduring humiliation from Selena, the false Luna. Kyle has lost his memory to Selena's curse and mistakes her for his true mate. Liya is framed and sentenced to death—until the truth of the cliffside betrayal surfaces.

Kyle shatters the seal on his memories. The "wolf-less" mother rises as the true Luna Queen. Under the moonlight, the family of four is finally whole again.

title: All My Pets That I Raised Turned Into Dark Realm Bosses
description:
Laila’s only goal is to find her lost “cubs.” But the problem is, the soft and adorable magical creatures she once raised are no longer weak. Harry, the little blood bat, has become a billionaire vampire progenitor and one of the giants of the dark world. Fenrir, the little black wolf, is now the terrifying wolf king who rules over all werewolves. Even Groot, the little tree spirit who always begged her to replant him, has grown into the “World Tree” while searching for her.
With milk tea in one hand and dragonfire in the other, Laila walks onto the battlefield and tames one ancient boss after another, turning world-shaking monsters back into obedient cubs fighting for her attention. Beneath the absurd comedy lies a family reunion five hundred years overdue: her cubs believed their mother had abandoned them, and now Laila is here to prove that Mom has finally come home.

title: Love Caught Fangs and Claws
description:
Yuri is a high school student who has been starved of love his entire life. His adoptive parents only care about their biological son, and Yuri is constantly bullied at school. Despite his loneliness and pain, he hides it behind a bright and gentle personality — a “smiling depression” type who always puts others before himself. His true identity is the descendant of the werewolf bloodline.

Brian, the fallen heir of the vampire clan, has lived for centuries following his father’s strict belief: vampires must never drink human blood. That changes when his enemy shatters half of his heart with a single blow. Gravely injured, Brian falls into Yuri’s swimming pool in the human world — and is unexpectedly saved by Yuri’s blood.

At first, Brian is only drawn to Yuri because of his extraordinary blood. He secretly follows and observes him, while growing increasingly jealous and possessive toward Lucius, the werewolf who has always stayed by Yuri’s side. But the closer Brian gets to Yuri, the more he is moved by this fragile yet kind-hearted boy. What begins as a hunger for his blood slowly turns into genuine love.

Lucius, the young heir of the werewolf clan, was the only source of light in Yuri’s life before Brian appeared. Disguised as an ordinary high school student, Lucius has always protected and supported Yuri. As the star player and ace of the school football team, he is confident, charismatic, and admired by everyone. He takes every hit meant for Yuri and uses his warmth to thaw the coldness Yuri has carried inside. The relationship between the three is pushed to its breaking point through enemy attacks, betrayal, misunderstandings, and impossible choices.


In the end,, Yuri realizes he cannot lose either Brian or Lucius. The story ends with the three of them overcoming hatred between the two races and celebrating a legendary happy ending — a century-defining wedding that unites vampire and werewolf bloodlines.

title: The Rogue-Marked Mom Is the Alpha King’s Luna
description: Hazel is dragged back to House Vance as the lost daughter Seraphine, but they only see a rogue-marked woman with two children. Her parents shame her, Roman rejects their birth contract for Celeste, and House Vance even tries to sell Hazel to a councilman by using her children as leverage. They all think her mate is a nameless rogue. Then the Alpha King's gala begins. Lucian arrives, names Hazel his only Luna and the mother of his heirs, and reveals the truth: the woman they called filthy is the War-Marshal who saved the Vale.

title: After 7 Alpha Rejections, I Became Queen
description: For seven years, Lena gave everything to Alpha Damian Blackwood: her love, her power, and the royal protection that kept his Pack alive. But every time his first love Celeste cried, Damian chose her instead. On the night of Lena’s seventh rejection, he forces her to give up her Luna title so Celeste can steal her place. This time, Lena doesn’t beg. She signs the agreement with her true name: Lena Ashburn, the last heir of a lost royal bloodline. As Damian’s Pack collapses, Lena rises from betrayed Luna to untouchable Queen.

title: Fated to My Forbidden Alpha
description: Rejected by your mate, you feel hopeless and dejected, but the Moon Goddess has other plans for you!

title: Fated to the Alpha
description: Bullied and mistreated, a young High School girl is shunned from her previous pack for not having a wolf. Upon entering a new pack, she meets a dashing man who falls in love with her – except this man is her superior Alpha and the nephew of the one man that wants her dead.

title: My Accidental Alpha's Desire
description: Heather found her mate James was cheating with his uncle's fiancee. She was so hurt that she went into his uncle Antonio’s room to seduce him, and kissed him... However, The cold man seems had feelings for her so that he couldn't control himself and kissed her hardly...

title: Emerald Eyed Luna
description:
On her eighteenth birthday, the Beta’s daughter loses everything. First, her childhood sweetheart, the Alpha heir, and her best friend are revealed to be fated mates. Then, a brutal attack leaves her pack in ruins and both her parents dead.
Determined to leave it all behind, she goes to say goodbye to the Alpha heir, only to catch him in bed with her traitorous best friend. That is the final blow. Turning her back on the pack, she becomes a rogue.
But exile changes everything. On the road, an extraordinary power awakens within her, revealing a shocking royal heritage. No longer a helpless wolf, she must now destroy a ruthless human trafficking ring and save the entire werewolf race. And along the dangerous path to reclaiming her throne, she will finally find her fated mate.

title: Reborn as the Shadow Luna
description: Elora Vance is the last White Wolf Healer, blessed with blood that can heal any wound. In her previous life, she sacrificed everything to restore Caleb, heir to the Blood Moon Pack, only to be betrayed. Blaming her for the death of the woman he truly loved, Caleb drained her healing blood until she died. Reborn with all her memories, Elora refuses to repeat the same mistake. Before the entire pack, she declares that Caleb can keep his crippled legs. Cast out without regret, she walks away and offers her priceless gift to the one man Caleb fears most—his sworn enemy, the Alpha of the Shadow Pack. This time, the miracle Caleb took for granted will become the weapon that destroys him.

title: The Destined Alpha
description: Seven-year-old Liam vanishes to save his wounded werewolf mother Elena per grandfather Alaric's deal. Twenty years later, amnesiac and a janitor, girlfriend Maya steals his research and humiliates him with Pureblood heir Jake. Elena, now Supreme Alpha, arrives to crush them, but Alaric blocks reunion. Kidnapped by renegade Mordak, Liam watches Elena nearly die for him. His grief awakens Progenitor-level power; he slays Mordak, reunites with his mother, and ascends as Supreme Alpha.

title: The Vampire Prince's Bride
description: Scarlett was a lonely orphan, living in the streets when the Vampire Lord Sean saved her. Moved to pity, Sean took her home as his Thrall and lover, swearing a Blood Oath and promising to keep her safe. Their happy, loving days came to an end when the sexy, dangerous human girl Chelsea swooped in, seducing Sean away. Not only did Sean Turn Chelsea into a vampire, he let Chelsea drink from Scarlett as well. Obsessed with his new lover, Sean missed the night of their Blood Oath, leaving Scarlett to die. Humiliated and hurt, Scarlett finally chooses to live for herself, risking her life to leave Sean behind and sever their bond as Thrall and Master. As her life hangs in the balance, Vampire Prince Alder suddenly appears to save her. Grateful and intimidated by his kindness, Scarlett doesn't realize her new prince charming is someone she's helped before.

title: Fated to My Forbidden Vampire
description: Her whole life, Heather has slaved for a vampire family, until she forms an unimaginable bond with Theo, a vampire king. Now she must find answers to all the mysteries -- what happened to her lost childhood memories? How did the bond happen? Is Theo the death of her, or the love of her life?

title: Blood and Roses: Tears of a Vampire
description: Aria has served vampire lord Alexander as his thrall for three years. He forgets their blood oath renewal night for his new lover Carmilla, leaving Aria to a lethal curse. Aria turns to Prince Cassius, who saves her from drowning with a bonding kiss. Alexander, regretful, abducts her and forces a wedding. Imprisoned by his father, Cassius breaks free, objects at the altar, and defeats Alexander. Alexander gets 800 years in prison, Carmilla is banished, and Cassius reveals Aria was his mate long before their bond began.

title: Goodbye Fiancé I Choose the Vampire King
description: In a world where elite vampire clans hold supreme power and vast wealth, ordinary girl Raina is saved by noble Justin, falls deeply in love with him and becomes his fiancée. When his ex-girlfriend Ellie returns, she repeatedly frames Raina. Justin always sides with Ellie and even demands Raina give up her hard-earned clan training spot. Heartbroken by his cold betrayal, Raina finally chooses to leave forever...

title: My Vampire King
description:
What is the end of darkness?
Many say it’s light.
For Clara, it was him — the Vampire King.
Once an ordinary student, Clara’s quiet life shatters when she meets her new chemistry teacher, the enigmatic and commanding Edison. His presence is magnetic, his eyes ancient — and his secret deadly. Edison is not human. He is the King of Vampires… and he came for her.
Bound by fate and blood, Clara becomes entangled in a world she never knew existed — one of royal vampire clans, ancient rivalries, and dangerous magic. She learns a truth buried within her own veins: she carries the bloodline of the Arné, a lineage tied to the origins of vampire power itself.
As enemies rise — including the ruthless vampire Fred, who seeks to claim Clara’s blood — she and Edison must fight side by side. What begins as fear turns into passion; what starts as defiance transforms into destiny.
In the end, under the crimson moon, Clara realizes that love isn’t the end of darkness — it’s the reason to walk through it.
MY VAMPIRE KING — a saga of forbidden love, blood, and fate.
Because even monsters can love… and sometimes, love makes monsters of us all.

title: My Vampire First Love Regretted Losing Me
description: Lilith, born with rare sacred blood, was raised from childhood by Adrian and Louis, the young masters of the Mar vampire clan. The three shared twenty years of deep affection and companionship. Yet when the scheming human Charlotte appeared, she sowed discord relentlessly. The two brothers believed her lies, imprisoned Lilith, and tormented her without mercy, crushing every trace of their former tenderness. Heartbroken and utterly disillusioned, Lilith agreed to marry the vampire prince, Dracula. Dracula had long cherished Lilith, who had once saved his life; he devoted everything to keeping her safe and protected. When Adrian and Louis finally awoke to the truth, they were consumed with frantic regret and went so far as to disrupt the wedding in a desperate attempt to win her back. In the end, the conspiracy was exposed, and all the villains were brought to justice. The two brothers exiled themselves far away, while Lilith and Dracula were crowned side by side, becoming the sovereigns — the Vampire King and Queen.

title: After Divorce, Four Vampire Kings Chasing Me
description: In order to marry her beloved partner, the female protagonist was willing to seal the power of the ancestral vampire to marry the male protagonist. Eventually, with the help of her family and the female protagonist's support, the male protagonist became the leader of the vampires.However, behind a secret door in her bedroom, she discovered the chamber where her husband have an affair with others.

title: Divorce Denied Caged by My Vampire Ex
description:
Human girl Aliyah takes a food delivery job to support her family farm, only to stumble into the ancient castle of Lucius, a two-hundred-year-old pureblood vampire. Mistaken by a witch as his perfect soulmate capable of bearing pureblood heirs, she is forced into a marriage contract with the vampire clan’s lord. On their wedding night, Aliyah receives a message from the witch revealing the horrifying truth—the compatibility reading was wrong, and she can never give Lucius pureblood offspring. If the secret comes out, she will be killed instantly. Desperate to escape, Aliyah is repeatedly confined by the possessive, obsessive Lucius. His half-blood younger brother Alan soon appears, claiming to be her true soulmate and offering her freedom, though he initially plans revenge against pureblood vampires. After fleeing to her grandparents’ quiet countryside farm, Aliyah briefly finds peace, yet she faces constant threats from Serena, a pureblood vampire infatuated with Lucius, and her cruel, money-obsessed birth father.
Through countless life-or-death ordeals, Lucius lets go of his obsession with bloodline reproduction and realizes his genuine love for Aliyah. Alan abandons his vengeance and leaves to travel the world. Free from the false bond of blood compatibility, the two resolve all misunderstandings, stay together out of true affection, and eventually welcome their own pureblood child.

title: The 99-Year-Old Woman's New Vampire Pet
description: Lady Eileen is ninety-nine, richer than kingdoms, and tired of being treated like a dried-up old woman. She spends eighty million gold coins on a beautiful pureblood vampire, Adrian, hoping he'll drink her aged blood and restore her youth. Instead, Adrian rejects her and kneels for her scheming cousin Vera. So Eileen buys Victor, a wounded, lowborn vampire from the blood market. One bite turns her back into an eighteen-year-old beauty, and one act of loyalty turns Victor into the only pet she wants to keep. Now Adrian is begging to return, Vera is trying to steal everything, and Eileen is ready to show them what happens when an old queen gets young again.

title: The Vampire King's Runaway Bride
description:
"Five years ago, on a blood moon night, Ruth, a hotel maid, stumbled into the room of Arthur, the Vampire King. Bound by the pull of soulmates, they shared one night, and Ruth fled the next morning.
Now, Ruth is a desperate single mother whose half-vampire son, Leo, suffers from a rare ""photophobia"" illness that requires a fortune to treat. When a chance encounter brings her to Arthur's castle for a high-paying job, he instantly recognizes his mate. Furious at her disappearance, he coldly torments her, but she endures it all for her son's life.
When Ruth's greedy aunt sells Leo to the extreme ""Exorcism Courtyard,"" Arthur, sensing his bloodline in danger, arrives just in time to witness Ruth shielding their son with her own body. He shatters their defenses with a roar: ""Who dares touch my son!"" The family is united. From protecting his wife and child from a jealous noblewoman to showering them with absolute devotion, Arthur proves that for the ones he loves, he will destroy anyone who stands in their way. Their story ends in a grand wedding and a long-awaited happily ever after."

title: My Vampire Lord
description: Default

title: Vampires Always Knock Twice
description:
Longing for adventure outside her small New England town, Lydia is drawn to a mysterious newcomer, but he just might be the vampire who kidnapped her best friend.
*Thriller*Vampires*Romance*Paranormal**This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Fated to My Forbidden Vampire
description: Her whole life, Heather has slaved for a vampire family, until she forms an unimaginable bond with Theo, a vampire king. Now she must find answers to all the mysteries -- what happened to her lost childhood memories? How did the bond happen? Is Theo the death of her, or the love of her life?

title: The Vampire Lord’s Final Salvation
description: At the engagement banquet, the Dark Lord Darius lifted my veil, his eyes filled with disgust. “The woman I wanted to marry is dead. Yet you are still alive.” He blindfolded me, forbidding me to speak, forbidding me to raise my head. That night, I cried away all the tears of my past life. Reborn, I returned to the day he mistook someone else for the one who had saved him. My sister Elise was pretending to be me, accepting his marriage contract in my place. This time, I knelt before the Duchess first. “Please, Madam, arrange my marriage as soon as possible too.” Later, I married the northern Frost Lord, a man infamous for his cold-blooded cruelty. On the day of my wedding, Darius fought his way to my bridal carriage.

title: Desired by Two: the Vampire and the Hunter
description: I'm a disaster. One minute I'm spilling coffee on my ridiculously hot boss, Simon, the next I'm discovering I have a secret power I can't control. My world is a mess of spilled coffee and tangled feelings, and I'm caught between two unbelievably hot guys. Simon, my mysterious boss, is as alluring as he is dangerous - a vampire who promises to teach me to harness my magic. Then there's Michael, my kind and loyal best friend. But he's hiding a deadly secret: he's a hunter sworn to destroy everything Simon stands for. They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?

title: Betrayal and Vampire
description:
What is betrayal?
Paisley learned it the moment her best friend stabbed her — literally.
What is a vampire?
She learned that too… when one saved her life.
Once a normal high school girl, Paisley’s world shattered when Charlotte — the person she trusted most — betrayed and killed her. But death wasn’t the end. In her final breath, she made a pact with Lucifer himself, rising again with the power of darkness burning in her veins.
Now reborn between life and death, Paisley hunts those who wronged her, guided by demons and protected by supernatural allies—vampires, werewolves, and creatures of the night. But vengeance isn’t the only thing awakening in her heart. The connection between her and Lucifer grows deeper, entangling passion, power, and damnation.
When the “Sin Eaters” threaten to destroy everything she’s become, Paisley must choose between revenge and her new destiny—as the Bride of Hell.
 BETRAYAL AND VAMPIRE — an Anime dark romance of revenge, desire, and rebirth.
Love can kill. Or resurrect.

title: The Vampire Lord's Lost Salvation
description:
At the engagement banquet, the Dark Lord Darius lifted my veil, his eyes filled with disgust. “The woman I wanted to marry is dead. Yet you are still alive.” He blindfolded me, forbidding me to speak, forbidding me to raise my head. That night, I cried away all the tears of my past life. Reborn, I returned to the day he mistook someone else for the one who had saved him. My sister Elise was pretending to be me, accepting his marriage contract in my place.
This time, I knelt before the Duchess first.
“Please, Madam, arrange my marriage as soon as possible too.” Later, I married the northern Frost Lord, a man infamous for his cold-blooded cruelty. On the day of my wedding, Darius fought his way to my bridal carriage.

title: Blood Queen: The Vampire's Revenge
description: The Blood Moon Ritual, which will determine the power structure of the vampire clans, is about to begin. Marcus, the pure-blooded ruler of the Vance Family, intends to secure permanent dominion over his clan through an ancient blood pact. The half-blood heroine Selene was framed by her elder brother Marcus and exiled for five years. Now she has returned to New York disguised as a top demon hunter advisor, biding her time to clear her name and reclaim what rightfully belongs to her.

title: Nest of Vampires
description: Nest of Vampires follows an MI5 agent who travels from London to rural England in search of the people who murdered his wife and kidnapped his only daughter. During his investigation, he uncovers a ruthless vampiric cult.

title: My Vampire Bodyguard
description: Vampire King Kyle was betrayed by his fiancée and his own brother, and ended up stranded in the human world — where he was saved by Alaina, a fallen heiress. To hide his identity, Kyle became Alaina's bodyguard. On the surface, he protected her safety; behind the scenes, he helped her rise step by step and reclaim her family's fortune. Kyle was deeply drawn to Alaina's blood. By her side, he constantly had to suppress his craving for it — and he began to suspect that Alaina might be his fated mate…

title: My Fiancé Lied, So I Chose His Brother
description: On the bloodmoon night, Catherine awakens her rare halfblood vampire power. She fakes amnesia and uncovers the betrayal of her fiancé Raven and adoptive sister Ilona, who turns out to be the surviving ShadowClan princess aiming to seize her power with forbidden magic. Together with Cassian, she foils plots and defeats the powerhungry high priest. She overthrows the old autocratic system, stays with Cassian, and ushers in a new era of coruling for the vampire clan.

title: I Was My Vampire Husband's Dead Wife
description: Lord Julian Thornfield burns Adeline’s village, turns her into a vampire, and forces her to become his dead wife’s replacement. Even his daughter, Eve, calls her “Mama.” When Adeline tries to die, Eve’s strange power hurls them a hundred years into the past. There, Julian is not a cruel lord yet. He is a scarred human slave in a circus cage, whipped as a monster. Adeline only wants to hand Eve back and escape, but the child’s broken heart ties her to them both. Then the caged man asks who she is, and Adeline answers, “I’m your future wife.”

title: Reborn to Build an Empire
description: Reborn in a fallen kingdom, Gavin Thorne is captured with a group of female refugees. Then he awakens a nation-building system: the more people he saves, the more powerful his rewards. With his fierce female army by his side, he'll turn a wasteland into an empire.

title: The Second Breath
description:
A thousand years after humanity’s extinction, vampires and werewolves rule the world together. Knox, a vampire baron, and Aurora, a werewolf hunter, are both sworn enemies and secret lovers.

To help Aurora win the Festival of the Twin Moons and save his mother, Knox binds their lives together with a forbidden spell—but conceals the truth that every wound inflicted on Aurora will be transferred to him.

After losing loved ones and becoming targets of both races, they publicly turn against each other while secretly investigating the conflict. Together, they uncover a conspiracy orchestrated by their rulers, who have spent a thousand years provoking war to preserve an ancient curse.

On the night of the final trial, Aurora gives up his only chance to become human and uses the Heart of the Twin Moons to save Knox. In doing so, their forbidden love breaks the curse and gives human civilization a chance to rise again.

title: Hunter's Prey
description:
The Witcher clan was massacred by the Vampire High Table. Silas, the sole surviving bloodline heir, ventured forth alone. He successfully assassinated one of the Elders before fleeing gravely wounded—only to inadvertently take Aion, a half-blood noble, hostage.
Seeking to overthrow the corrupt rule of the Elder Council, Aion forcibly turned Silas at the brink of death via the Embrace, chaining him to his side as a pawn for vengeance.
Within this fragile, uneasy alliance, the two men evolved from mutual suspicion to forging a bond forged in life-and-death peril, and an unspoken, forbidden affection bloomed between them. To save the dying Silas, Aion dared to cast a forbidden ritual to share their life force, permanently weaving their fates into one.

title: Breaking My Bodyguard
description: Vera Marchesa just wants one thing: freedom from the dangerous mafia world she grew up in, and her overprotective bodyguard Dante, who refuses to love her. Determined to prove she's not a helpless princess, Vera pushes the one line Dante swore never to cross… even if that means they will crash and burn together.

title: The Stone-Cursed King’s Blood Bride
description: The human girl Lena is sacrificed to Draven, a Vampire King afflicted by a petrification curse, and the two unexpectedly forge a life-binding blood pact. To save Draven—who is left dying and drained of his royal blood after the curse is broken—Lena endures seven years of perilous hardships to locate the source of the Blood Spring and rescue her true love. Ultimately, they ascend the throne side by side, ruling over a kingdom where humans and vampires coexist. Yet, just as peace dawns, the sigil of an ancient witch quietly begins to glow red deep within the Blood Spring...

title: ReelTalk EP28-Backstage: How to Kiss a Vampire
description: Sink your teeth into this dangerously addictive inside look at Seth Eden and Nicole Mattox’s new show, How to Kiss a Vampire. For the first time ever, we’re getting an intimate glimpse into their life on set and everything in between. From Seth’s morning routines to Nicole’s workouts and a few daring stunts shared between on-screen lovers, this is more than just a love story. Follow along this reunion told through video diaries. Get ready to fall for the ReelShort stars you already adore, all over again.

title: Runaway Princess Bride
description: When a drifter helps her run away from a dangerous groom, Riley Jones thinks she’s found her Prince Charming.  But what Riley doesn’t know is her protector actually IS a prince – and it isn’t fate that brought them together.  Prince Xander has deliberately sought Riley out because she is the key to saving his troubled kingdom.

title: The Siren's Vengeance
description: Reborn anew, Siren Princess Seraphina abandons Loke the werewolf—the man who exploited and murdered her in her past life. Instead, she chooses Kaelian, the Vampire Lord who has loved her quietly for a century. She strikes down her fake lover and scheming rival, breaks free from a cursed fate, and gains the obsessive, exclusive tenderness of a vampire overlord, along with a century’s worth of hidden devotion.

title: Bound to My Three Fated High Lords
description:
Three hundred years ago, Evelyn, the Supreme Witch, sealed the Demon King Lucifer in the underworld and reincarnated as Ivy, an orphan with feeble spiritual power. Seventeen years later, Lucifer’s minions infiltrated Silver Thorn Academy, plotting to awaken the Demon King through a dark magic circle.
After enrolling in the academy, Ivy formed fateful bonds with Kane, the Alpha Werewolf, Sebastian, the Vampire Patriarch, and Victor, the Demon Hunter Mentor — the three chosen guardians of the demon core. Lucifer set a trap to kill Ivy before her power awakened, but it instead triggered her dormant supreme abilities. Heirs of the three great clans joined forces to fight the Demon King, and Ivy, regaining her full power, banished Lucifer back to the abyss once more.

title: Bride To The Beast King
description: The story takes place in a bustling American city and tells the angsty yet sweet love story between elite scholar Serena and Leo, the Wolf King of North America. Six years ago, Serena, an Ivy League student, was framed out of jealousy by Vivian. She accidentally saved Leo, who was in heat, in a church and was forced to mate with him. Because she gave birth to a son, Liam, who bore wolf-like traits, she was expelled from school and plunged to the bottom of society. Six years later, in order to raise $150,000 for her son's surgery, Serena applied to become Leo's personal nutritionist. Although Vivian kept interfering and tampered with the paternity test report, the bond of blood compelled Leo to fiercely protect his own without even realizing it. After crushing workplace bullying and threats from old enemies, the truth about the fake report came to light, and the family of three was reunited. Meanwhile, a hidden vampire crisis quietly began to unfold.

title: Betrayed by the Champ, Loved by the Billionaire
description: Default

title: Blood contract
description:
Blood contract is an enthralling series that chronicles the captivating journey of Rosy, who after losing her job and her sense of purpose, meets Sam, a wealthy vampire who proposes to hire her as his contract bride. Although Rosy feels intimidated by Sam's dark world, she takes the offer, thinking that it could be her only chance to make something of her life.
As Rosy navigates her new position as a contract bride, she becomes increasingly aware of the dangerous and enigmatic world of vampires, as well as the ongoing power struggle between Sam and his younger brother, Ken. The competition is centered on who deserves to inherit their family's enterprise after their father's death – a ruthless and cunning vampire leader.

title: The Summer My Heart Stopped
description: High school senior, Isabel, will soon die from a serious heart condition. She has a secret crush on her best friend Alex, and plans to confess her feelings to him after graduation. However, a huge misunderstanding in the middle of senior year ruins their friendship. Alex now holds a grudge against Isabel. He even lets her classmates bully her. Ten years later, Alex finds a collection of short vlogs that Isabel left for him. The videos reveal a shocking truth, a truth that completely changes Alex's world.

title: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress
description: After three years of being married to Tristan Beckett and being his walking blood bank, Joyce Powell finally divorces him! Tristan thought Joyce was a vain girl who only married him for money, little did he know, she's a secret billionaire heiress! Will Tristan win back Joyce's heart? Or will she fall for a much younger cutie pie William Pope?

title: Return,Goddess of the Moon
description:
On a blood moon night, Lilith, daughter of Count Dracula, was born. Her power was too great—the crystal ball went dark. Her father declared her "worthless" and tried to kill her. Her mother Ileana threw her into the abyss to save her, losing her magic and youth, and was banished.

In the abyss, Lilith was adopted by Cain, leader of the "impure bloodline." Eighteen years later, she awakened the bloodline power of the "Moon Goddess." She returned to the surface, saved her withered mother, and was imprisoned by Mirela, the Count's fake daughter.

When werewolves attacked, Lilith turned the tide with raw combat power—but because she refused to reveal her true power, she was again dismissed as "worthless."

Ileana risked her life to seek help from Cain. In the final battle, Lilith unleashed the power of the blood moon, revealed her true origins, deposed her father, banished the impostors, and was crowned Countess. She abolished the old order of blood purity, restored her mother's youth, and brought the exiled home.

title: Contract Wife: Savage Stepmom Rules the Billionaire Empire
description:
Tess Miller, an MIT genius and tech partner, agrees to a $10-million-a-year contract marriage with Garrick Davenport—the head of a hundred-billion-dollar empire. Her sole mandate: take full control of his three notoriously rebellious, spoiled children.
Instead of trying to win them over with meek affection, Tess launches a high-IQ, savage takeover. She conditions the chaotic youngest son, cuts off the predatory parasites preying on the teenage daughter, and intellectually crushes the arrogant eldest heir using advanced options hedging formulas scribbled on scratch paper. When the children’s glamorous ex-wife mother tries to swoop back in and reclaim her place, she discovers that her former children now loyally stand behind their fierce, unstoppable stepmother.

title: Sun Knight Time-Travels to Slaughter the Blood Demons
description:
Urban security officer Alex Han is beaten to death by vampires. His father’s
lingering soul uses the Sun Seal to send him back to 1650, where he becomes a legendary demon hunter. Armed with future knowledge—repeating crossbows, gliders, financial futures—he slaughters the blood demons. He rescues his sacrificed aunt, snaps Dracula’s neck, and pierces the thousand-year-old Vampire Lord’s skull with three silver bolts. But victory comes at a price: all vampiric hunger floods into him, the golden seal transforms into a silver moon emblem, and an ancient “Night King” awakens in the East. The Empire’s emperor is revealed as the Vampire Lord’s vessel. Alex leads an army of half-bloods to storm the capital and personally breaks the emperor’s neck. In the final battle, he uses the silver key to lock the Night King—a giant of pure fear—back into darkness. The curse shatters. Humans and vampires stand together in the sunlight. Selena rides east, saying, “When you return to your own time, I will be there waiting for you.”

title: Campaigning For Love
description: After a one - night stand with a handsome stranger, Sarah, a young campaign intern, realized that he was her boss, Senatorial candidate Christopher. In a tough campaign, their affair would be a career - ending scandal for both of them, so she concealed her identity. But did Christopher fall in love with her or the role she was playing? Will their love story destroy them or can they survive the scandal and become a powerful couple in the political world?

title: Vampiñera
description: Two Latino vampires debate whether to crash their cousin’s Vampiñera, a Vampire Quinceañera.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: No Promotion? Fine, I′ ll Inherit a Business Empire
description:
Noah, a hard‑working junior advertising employee, was in line to compete for the Creative Director position. However, he was publicly humiliated by Tyler, his wealthy‑heir superior. His ex‑girlfriend Mia also betrayed him for money and status, and Noah was fired on the spot.

At his lowest point, he received notice from his family: he was the sole heir to the top‑tier Blackwell Conglomerate and had been living under an assumed name merely to observe human nature.

Noah returned to the industry as a senior group executive. With the help of his formidable ally Ava, he outmaneuvered Tyler at the bidding event and systematically dismantled Kingsley Media.

Unwilling to accept defeat, Tyler colluded with outsiders to plot against Noah. He even kidnapped Noah’s grandfather, Arthur. In the end, he reaped what he sowed and was sent to prison.

Noah acquired his rival’s company, consolidated the group’s standing, and let go of past regrets. He married the sharp‑witted and resolute Ava, successfully took over as Chairman of the Group’s Board of Directors, and embarked on a brand‑new business empire.

title: Taming My Five Beast Stepsons
description: Officeworker James transmigrates into a novel as vampire villain Valerius, fated to be killed by five beastkin adopted sons. Helped by a redemption system, he abandons cruelty and resolves their longheld resentment with kindness. Together they survive perilous trials and fight the ambitious younger brother Lucian to avert the original tragic ending.

title: Pregnant By The Luxury Empire Heir
description: Sofia, a sales associate at a luxury boutique, and Bryan, the domineering CEO of a luxury conglomerate, unexpectedly have a one-night stand that results in her pregnancy. At work, Sofia faces bullying and sabotage from jealous colleagues, while at home, she is exploited by her mother and younger siblings for money. Throughout her struggles, Bryan steps in to confront her toxic coworkers and family, gradually becoming captivated by her resilience. Eventually, he proposes to her formally, and the two embark on a happy life together.

title: One Night Stand with the Empire's General
description:
To reclaim the vast fortune left behind by her grandfather, Viscountess Melris takes a desperate gamble at a masquerade ball. She seduces a mysterious silver-haired, red-eyed attendant in hopes of bearing his child — a child she plans to use as leverage to secure her inheritance. What she does not realize is that the man she has entangled herself with is none other than Eric, a ruthless and unhinged grand general who takes pleasure in killing.

Now, caught in his relentless pursuit, Melris must deceive the world, outwit her scoundrel husband, and eliminate the scheming maidservant — all while struggling to survive the dangerous game she has set in motion.

title: Kneel or Die: My Demons, My Rules
description: Lin Shuang (Rachel), a modern-day corporate drone, unexpectedly finds herself transported into the otome game Demon Butler—as Lilith Klein, the villainous duchess destined to be slain by four demon butlers. In the original storyline, Lilith was notorious for her brutality, tormenting the World Serpent Yegad, the Lop-Eared Rabbit Lyle, the Hellhound Kerberos, and the Bat-Succubus Mord until their hatred festered to the brink of maxed-out Dark Values. Now bound to a Fate-Changing System, Rachel must teeter on the edge of death with every move: rescuing the abused and mute Lyle, using her own blood to heal him in exchange for trust; braving the dungeon to strike a bargain with the yandere protagonist Yegad, narrowly reversing her deadly fate. With the wit of a modern office veteran, she shreds the white-lotus heroine and a biased mother, wielding psychological tactics with surgical precision. One by one, she tames the four obsessive demons—from vengeance-driven enemies into fiercely possessive loyal butlers. In a gothic world where humans and demons coexist, Rachel seizes power and scripts her own legendary rise.

title: Three Kings Kneel for My Touch
description: Isabella, a celestial descendant blessed with a mysterious, soothing power, forms an unexpected bond of destiny with three non-human powerhouses while fleeing from witch hunters. To reclaim the werewolf throne usurped by his tyrannical uncle, they launch a bloody assault back on the wastelands. During the brutal conflict, Isabella's latent powers are unexpectedly unleashed. But just as the Werewolf King, Eric, washes away his humiliation in the arena and reclaims absolute power, the blood curse of the vampire, Sebastian, begins to backfire. When the elf Lynn’s family exposes a cruel truth—that they have hunted celestial descendants for generations—the four are forced into an ultimate conspiracy that threatens to engulf every race.

title: Pampered by the Tyrant
description: To pay for her grandmother's treatment, Savannah leaves her rural hometown and heads to Hadleyburg to ask her estranged father for help. On the train, she unexpectedly saves the life of Hudson, the ruthless, untouchable mafia king of Hadleyburg, after he's ambushed and severely wounded. When Savannah arrives in the city, Hudson returns for her, fiercely, publicly, and with an obsession the whole city fears.

title: Bloodbound Vengeance
description: Margaret was betrayed, abused, and poisoned by the Granda family—for her fortune. Rescued by a vampire count, she is reborn with the power to strike back. No longer a lamb, she uses wealth, foresight, and cunning to make the noble family kneel. But vengeance comes with desire—the cold count hides a forbidden love that could destroy them both.

title: The Reborn Queen Path of Dominion
description:
Freya, the eldest daughter and rightful heir of the Winterbourne family, is betrayed by her fiancé Julian and her younger sister Sigrid on her wedding day, dying tragically on the night of the Blood Moon.

Reborn with full knowledge of the future, Freya loses her inheritance rights but uses her spatial powers to stockpile supplies and build an impregnable fortress. Along the way, she rescues the vampire Silas and forms an alliance with him.

When the Blood Moon rises, the world is plunged into eternal night. Manipulated by the traitorous witch Morrigan, the Blackwood family seeks to destroy and absorb the other three great families. Freya joins forces with the vampires, Fenrir—the Silver Moon Wolf King—and the surviving members of the Grimm family to fight against an overwhelming army of undead and vampires.

In the decisive battle, Fenrir leads his wolf clan in a devastating self-sacrifice, opening a path to survival for the others. In the end, Freya fuses the powers of flame, life, and vampire blood to summon the “Crimson Griffin,” defeating Morrigan once and for all.

With the war finally over, Freya is crowned queen, becoming the guardian of peace among all races.

title: Maid's Vendetta
description:
Maid's Vendetta tells the story of Diana, whose perfect life was destroyed when her father had an affair, her younger brother died in a tragic accident, and her mother suffered a mental breakdown—all because of one woman. Swearing vengeance, Diana sets in motion a dangerous game of revenge.  
Twenty years ago, Diana lived a charmed life as the beloved heiress of a wealthy family—until her family tutor, Sophie, seduced her father and tore her world apart. Now, under the alias Raven, she infiltrates Sophie's household as a maid, determined to make her pay for ruining her family.

title: Empire of Secrets
description: Framed by Noble Consort Sheffield, Josephine died in a palace fire with her newborn prince. Reborn with a mysterious fertility system, she returns to the inner court determined to change her fate. Battling scheming concubines, a calculating emperor, and a ruthless empress dowager, she climbs the ranks through strategy, alliances, and the children she bears. In the end, Josephine helps Princess Serena claim the throne and secures ultimate power as Empress Dowager.

title: The Everlasting Scent Of Us
description: When Samuel, having regained his sight, meets designer Amanda.he is stunned by how much she resembles Emma his ex and the love he once lost. Determined to uncover the truth about who she really is, Samuel keeps testing and questioning her. As they get swept up in mounting pressures and tangled schemes, old flames reignite, pushing them to face the past head-on and fight against all odds for a future together.

title: The Ichorless Thrall Is The Primordial Queen!
description:
Twenty years ago, Queen Amelia gave birth to a daughter—but the temple flame went dark. High Priest Mordred forged an oracle, branding the infant a "bloodless curse." King Carl ordered her execution. Amelia tore out her Titan blood, forced it into her baby's mouth, and threw her into the River Styx. She was chained to a pillar and drained for twenty years.

The baby was rescued by Ryan, Lord of Tartarus, and raised as Zoe—trained as a top assassin. She returned to Obsidian disguised as a blood slave, freed her mother, and uncovered the truth.

Tiffany and Mordred activated the "Ten Thousand Blood Purgatory Array." Zoe's sealing ring shattered, awakening her Titan Primordial Queen power. She exposed the forged oracle. Tiffany fused with the ancient evil god, but Zoe tore it apart. Ryan fell protecting her—his soul shattered.

Zoe ventured to the Titan Temple, awakened the Titan Heart, split it in two—one half healed her mother, the other restored Ryan. She was crowned Supreme Queen, forging an eternal alliance. The "bloodless freak" became the guardian of all beings.

title: My Spirit Beast Girls
description: In a world where combat classes rule, orphan Evan Lawrence awakens the only hidden profession: God-Tier Breeder. Branded useless and dumped by his girlfriend, he hits rock bottom until he activates the God-Tier Breeding System. The beasts he raises evolve into powerful guardians, even taking human form. While his ex struggles for status, Evan rises with his formidable companions, charging straight to the top of the world.

title: Olympic Soccer the Reborn Champion
description: Winston, the star player of a top football club was secretly killed by the club for questioning a move to join the national team. Reborn, he refused the club's invitation and entered the national Olympic player trials. Despite sabotage and dirty tricks from the national football team, he joined the squad with unmatched skill, represented his country at the Olympics, defeated every opponent, and led the national team to the championship.

title: Dumping My Ex, Founding My Love
description: Five years ago, Thora Snider gave up everything to marry Marc Neel, transforming him from a broke nobody into a powerful CEO. But on their fifth wedding anniversary, Marc "surprised" her with his pregnant mistress, Ella Frost, and forced her to step aside for their true love. Disillusioned, Thora vowed to take back everything she had given him...

title: Swapped Daughters,Stolen Empire
description: Billionaire Victoria Hayes discovers her best friend Melissa swapping their newborn daughters. Victoria quietly switches them back—and waits eighteen years. At the birthday gala for her true heir Ava, Melissa exposes the "truth," claiming Ava is her daughter to steal Hayes Technologies. Victoria springs her trap: she's had proof all along. Ava is her blood. Melissa is publicly destroyed. But victory turns to ice when Victoria uncovers that Melissa wasn't acting alone. The husband sleeping beside her was the mastermind. Now the real war begins.

title: The Returned Luna
description:
Ever since she was a child, Lydia knew only pain—bullied, belittled, unwanted.
But the day she found her fated mate, she thought everything would finally change.
It didn’t.
In front of the entire pack, the future Alpha Aron rejected and humiliated her, shattering her fragile heart. Running from the only home she’d ever known, Lydia discovered a secret she was never meant to find—she isn’t just a werewolf, but a rare hybrid of vampire, angel, demon, and witch blood.
Lost and hunted, she was found by Harrison, Alpha of the powerful Sunset Pack, who recognized her not as a weak outcast, but as his second fated mate. Under his guidance, Lydia trained, fought, and rose—no longer the broken girl everyone pitied, but a Luna destined to reshape history.
Two years later, she returns to her old pack—not for forgiveness, but for justice. As war looms and dark enemies close in, Lydia must face the ones who betrayed her and embrace her true identity as the Lunar Goddess Reborn.
THE RETURNED LUNA — an anime fantasy of revenge, redemption, and rebirth.
Once rejected. Now unstoppable.

title: Mafia's Tender Torture
description: Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...

title: Mafia's Love Left Me No Way Out
description: Rosalia and Nick, the son of a mafia boss, were once a loving engaged couple — but a misunderstanding turned them into each other's killers' enemies. Torn between love and hatred, Nick decided to train Rosalia into the most lethal assassin in the mafia as atonement. After seven years of training, Rosalia began carrying out missions with outstanding results. One day, Nick gave her a new assignment: get close to Dominic, the son of a rival mafia family, and become his girlfriend to earn his trust. A tangled web of love, hate, and vengeance between the three unfolded from there…

title: Mafia's Little Grape
description: Default

title: Mafia Housewife
description: Juliet seems like the perfect housewife—calm, composed, and always smiling. But behind that polished exterior hides a woman with a painful past as the long-lost heiress of the notorious Blackstone mafia. She thought she left that life behind when she married Jack, trading power for a chance at a simpler life. But when her charming husband reveals a darker side, plotting to build his own underground empire and leaving her for dead, Juliet barely makes it out alive. Rescued by Simon—her father’s trusted confidant—she fakes her death and comes back as Lila. Gone is the devoted wife. Now, she seeks to tear down Jack’s ambitions piece by piece and save her family’s fading legacy. As she and Simon grow closer romantically, Juliet begins to rediscover her true self, realizing she might be just as dangerous as the world she left behind. In a twisted game of secrets, seduction, and power, Juliet is ready to reclaim what's hers.

title: The Mafia's Accidental Queen
description: Eun-soo gets unexpectedly pregnant due to a medical mix-up. Her initial shock is short-lived when she discovers the father of her unborn child is the ruthless Mafia King, Gio. Though he is a dangerous man who brutally kills his enemies, Eun-soo's heart begins to waver as she sees Gio risk his own life to shield her and their baby from every threat... Will Eun-soo accept Gio as her baby's father and become the Queen of the Mafia Empire?

title: The Mafia Boss My Husband Betrayed
description: Emma is alone after her husband leaves on a mafia mission, trapped by a painful blocked milk duct and a crying baby. Then Dante Vella, her husband’s wounded mafia boss, breaks into her home, hiding from killers outside. To keep the baby quiet, Emma has no choice but to let him help relieve her most private pain. But his steady hands and dangerous closeness awaken feelings she should never have. When her husband suddenly video-calls, Dante stays just outside the frame, his hand moving from the ache he was supposed to soothe toward the shadow beneath her skirt. As her husband talks about hunting Dante for a bounty, Emma realizes the real danger is no longer outside the door.

title: My Mafia Boss‘s Dirty Secret
description: A brilliant female doctor loses her family overnight. To save her younger brother, she has no choice but to submit to mafia tycoon Marcus.He dominates her completely, forcing her to go undercover and even seduce her own brother, while hiding his dark, extreme obsessions.Caught between a gentle young master and the ruthless mafia lord, she stumbles upon the shocking truth of her family’s murder and a huge hidden conspiracy.Trapped in forbidden love and deadly schemes, she gambles with her life to break the trap and fight her way out of despair.

title: The Return of My Mafia Husband
description: Leo has been concealed his identity as the Mafia King while dating an ordinary girl Olivia. Just as he prepares to reveal his identity to her, a car accident leaves him in a vegetative state. Olivia remains faithfully by his side. Eight years later, Leo awakens and his first action is to propose to Olivia. Olivia's relatives and friends think Leo is just a poor guy in a wheelchair, unaware that he is actually Don Gambino, the heir to the most powerful Mafia family in the world.

title: The Mafia Boss's Contract Bride
description: Elena signed the divorce papers, penniless, wandering through the rain with her suitcase. A "Wanted: Stepmother" flyer on a deli bulletin board caught her attention. She followed the address, only to find that her employer turned out to be the Marchetti family, the most powerful mafia dynasty on the East Coast.

title: I Married as the Replacement Bride
