description: Martina is the perfect Mafia daughter. Beautiful, quiet, and — most important of all — obedient. But to protect the one she loves most, she'll go against her father's orders and take her sister's place as bride to the deadliest, most notorious Mafia don of all... the Butcher.

title: I Faked My Death To Ruin My Mafia Husband
description: "You're lying." That's what my husband said when I begged him to save me. Six months pregnant, I was kidnapped, beaten, and left to lose our baby—while he chose his mistress over me again and again. So I gave him exactly what he deserved: my death. Now he thinks he buried his wife and daughter. But I'm still alive... and this time, I'll bury everything he loves.

title: The Mafia Don Got the Wrong Wife, So I Ran Away Pregnant
description: Helena fled in disgrace after a one-night stand with Mafia godfather Cole. Based on the information from a lost delivery, Cole mistakenly identified her stepsister Ivy as Helena. Ivy impersonated her and checked into the estate, but unexpectedly learned that Helena was pregnant. Ivy fed Helena an abortifacient and forged a pregnancy test report. Helena exposed the conspiracy in public, and Cole had to personally find the woman he truly loved amidst his mistakes.

title: The Mafia Boss Who Loves Me
description: 1994 Chicago. Lucy bandages a stranger, not knowing he is Ace Cavallo, a feared mafia boss who claims her as his wife. When her fiancé and uncle sell her at her wedding, Ace saves her, offering 30 days as his wife for her mother's surgery. She accepts, learns he already paid. Through betrayals and attacks, Lucy finds devotion beneath his violence and confesses love. The Carters kidnap her. Ace wins a deadly blackjack gamble but takes a bullet. They wed in an empty church and ride into the night.

title: Married to the Mafia King's Brother
description: On her wedding day, Jagger Hamilton abandons Avery for his adopted sister Tatum. She marries his dangerous uncle Beckett instead. Three years later, Jagger returns, attacks her pregnant belly, and causes her to lose the child. Beckett arrives, locks down the estate, and punishes them. Jagger and Tatum are broken and exiled. Avery and Beckett later have a second child. Jagger, now a beggar, begs to return but is rejected and dies alone. Avery finds strength as Beckett’s wife and mother of the new heir.

title: Betrayed, I married the Mafia King.
description:
For six years, I endured my fiancé Ethan's calculated cruelty, believing it was the only way to pay for my dying father's black-market lung medication.
 
Then, I overheard him talking to his secret lover—his late brother's widow.
 
"Once the old man suffocates, I'll put ivy in a fortified apartment as my personal whore, and you will wear the Capo's ring."

But Ethan didn't know that the night before, I had taken the last of my money to buy a silver Vendetta Rosary.
 
I had ventured into the shadows and pledged myself to Willian, the terrifying, newly ascended Don of the entire syndicate.
 
As I sobbed on the cold wooden floor, the courtyard fell dead silent, and a pair of large, scarred hands reached into my vision holding a flawless Crimson Rose. And in the heavy silence that followed, I understood: either salvation or damnation had come for me, and I was no longer the one choosing.

title: Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy
description: Daiana thought Enzo was the love of her life...until he murdered her entire family. Captured by the enemy, Daiana would have to face the consequences of hatred, find the impossible strength for forgiveness, and experience the cruel side of love.

title: Secret Life of A Mafia Sweetheart
description: Two heirs of rival mafia families fall in love under false identities. A gang war leaves Alyssa injured with amnesia, Dylan poses as her fiancé，entangling them in love, betrayal, and buried family secrets…

title: Oops! The Mafia Boss Is in My Body
description: A falling brick causes Jesse and the ruthless mafia boss Enzo to swap bodies. Now Jesse must play the most feared boss in the city, while Enzo is trapped in Jesse’s fragile body. Forced into one bed, one war, and one kiss too dangerous to take back, Jesse discovers he’s not only Enzo’s collateral, but also his only weakness—the one boy the mafia boss would risk everything to protect... Now the question is: do they even have to switch back?

title: A Mother's Vengeance
description:
In my past life, my husband's niece drowned my newborn. To protect their precious heiress, the mafia family told me to let it go. When I refused, my own husband murdered me.
Now, I’ve been reborn on the morning it all happened.
This time, I secretly send my son to my father, the most powerful Mafia Godfather in the city.
But when I return to the party, another baby still ends up in the pool. 
Predictably, my husband and his family rush to destroy the body to cover it up. 
Now there's just one question: whose child did their golden girl really kill?

title: Quads, Mafia Divorce ——I Took the Money and Ran
description: Serena marries the mafia boss Dante Santoro. Their marriage begins purely out of interests, with no love involved. After Serena discovers she is pregnant with quadruplets, she suddenly receives a divorce text offering one hundred million on condition that she signs papers and leaves Dante. Instead of breaking down or weeping, she calmly signs the documents and vanishes overnight. When Dante returns, he finds out the divorce message and papers are all forged by his childhood friend Vivienne. He realizes he has long been in love with Serena. He makes a public sincere apology and spares no effort to win her back. Serena refuses to forgive him easily...

title: The Double Life of Mr President
description: Claire, a small-town girl working at a fried chicken shop, accidentally stumbles into the hotel suite of U.S. President William. After helping him relieve an aphrodisiac’s effects with her body, she then aids the gunshot-wounded president in evading his pursuers. Grateful, William proposes a contractual marriage—but Claire mistakenly believes he’s just a presidential body double. The truth only comes crashing down when she’s kidnapped by the mafia and William storms in with a Special Forces team.

title: The Virgin's Christmas Wish
description:
Christmas Eve. After Thistle is publicly torn apart for still being a virgin, she makes a desperate wish to Santa: "Please let me lose it."
Thistle never expects the one who answers her wish to be the campus bad boy, mafia heir... and her soon-to-be stepbrother.

title: The Mafia Don's Secret Wife
description: Three years ago, Elena Vance was humiliated on her wedding day when her husband, Tristan, brought his pregnant mistress and forced her to sign divorce papers. That night, Elena disappeared and married Adrian Blackwood, the most feared Mafia Don on the East Coast. Now pregnant with Adrian’s second child, she returns to Edenport, only to be slapped by Tristan, who thinks she is pretending to be Mrs. Blackwood. When Chloe crushes Elena’s black onyx signet ring at a gala, Adrian arrives with their son. One word exposes everything: “Mommy.” Now the city will learn who Elena really is.

title: You Chose the Maid,Now You Beg
description: After waiting five years for Hunter to marry her, mafia princess Celine is betrayed when he chooses her maid instead. Rather than pulling the trigger, she blesses their marriage and accepts an alliance with the ruthless Rossi boss. As Hunter slowly uncovers the truth behind the betrayal, everything he believed begins to crumble. But by then, Celine is already standing beside a far more dangerous man, and the revenge she has planned is only just beginning.

title: The Mafia Boss's Stolen Bride
description: After her fiancé leaves her to die in a kidnapping, Elena Hart is rescued by ruthless mafia boss Dante Moretti—and one drug-fueled night binds them together. When Elena finally walks away from her cheating fiancé, he uses her sick mother to force her back into marriage. Dante crashes the wedding and steals the bride, igniting a dangerous war of obsession, betrayal, captivity, and sacrifice. But the man Elena fears most may be the only one who has loved her all along.

title: The Mafia Don Refused My Ransom
description: Ava Moretti loved Luca Conti for nine years, believing the Conti family’s blood oath would always protect her. But when the Petrov brothers kidnapped her and demanded a six-hundred-thousand-dollar ransom, Luca listened to Valentina Russo and refused to pay, letting Ava “learn obedience.” After three months of captivity, Ava escapes barefoot back to Manhattan, broken, terrified, and no longer in love. While Luca keeps mistaking her trauma for rebellion, Dante Vitale, the Conti security chief and former detective, becomes the only person who truly protects her. As Valentina’s role in the kidnapping is exposed and Luca’s regret comes too late, Ava chooses the man who saved her, not the Don who abandoned her.

title: The Double Life of My Mafia Husband
description:
Three years ago, Raymond had a one-night stand with a mysterious stranger he met at a bar.
Lured by his aunt with the excuse of attending a funeral, Raymond soon realizes he has been set up in a marriage trap — his aunt plans to sell him off to a wealthy man with disturbing intentions.

Just when he is in danger, Alan steps in to save him. Alan is not only a world-renowned neurosurgeon, but also the heir to a powerful mafia family.

To protect their own interests, the two enter into a contract marriage. But as they grow closer, Raymond begins to fall for Alan. Then he discovers the shocking truth: the man from that night three years ago was Alan all along — and his mother’s tragic car accident may be connected to Alan’s family.

title: Mafia Heiress’s Forbidden Obssession
description: Mafia Camorra family boss Michael is assassinated, forcing his 20-year-old only daughter, Gloria, to take over the family business. While dealing with internal and external threats to the clan, she falls in love with Theo, her late father's close friend and a 34-year-old former FBI agent turned bodyguard. After spotting her own photo inside Theo's pendant, she becomes convinced that he loves her back—only to later discover that the photo is actually of her mother. As their romance intensifies, Theo's past as an FBI agent leads Gloria to suspect he may have been involved in her father's murder, plunging their relationship into crisis.

title: I'm the Mafia Heiress Who Saved My Auctioned Sister
description: I’m  Aurora Draven, the hidden heir of North America’s deadliest arms syndicate. I came back after three years, only to find my little sister caged and auctioned in my own house—sold by her fiancé and my traitor father. My broke mom fought to buy her with priceless family relics, while those villains mocked her ruthlessly. I stepped out of shadow to crush them all. But the coward Christian survived, plotted with cartels and my dad to leak Lily’s humiliating footage and blow up our charity gala. Can I protect my family and wipe out every betrayer for good?

title: The Godfather’s SAT Guide
description: Mafia Godfather Vito Moretti loses his life while rescuing abused teen Leo Grayson, and his soul awakens inside the high‑schooler’s injured body. Once a weak, mistreated outcast, Leo is now inhabited by the sharp, domineering don. He stands up to his cold‑blooded biological family the Graysons and cruel school bullies including Chris and Brad. Balancing secret mafia duties with ordinary campus life, he chases his long‑held dream of getting into an Ivy‑League university. He goes through kidnapping incidents and dangerous showdowns. In the end, he scores a perfect mark on the SAT, defeats his vicious rival Chris, and builds a sweet bond with kind‑hearted school beauty Ella.

title: The Mafia's Sweet Cure
description:
Fifteen years ago, orphan Chloe saved bloodied boy Kevin with her star necklace. Now Kevin is New York’s fearsome mafia godfather plagued by manic disorder, while Chloe, a top fashion designer, is framed by her cruel stepsister and stumbles into Kevin’s room by accident. Her unique scent is the only cure for his outbursts, so they enter a contract marriage.
Kevin becomes an overprotective husband, crushing perverted investors, hostile rivals and the stepsister who tries to impersonate his long-lost savior. He clears all hurdles for Chloe, who fights back against her toxic family and enters the top international haute couture contest with her stunning talent.
The hidden star stitch on her design finally uncovers their 15-year fated bond. The two powerhouses hold a romantic grand wedding on the glittering global runway, standing side by side at the peak of their respective fields.

title: My Ex-wife the Mafia Princess
description:
Vera and Lucas enter a marriage of convenience—a contract built on duty, inheritance, and cold practicality. Lucas believes their relationship is nothing more than a transaction. Vera, however, slowly falls for him through their daily life together. At a public banquet, Lucas announces important news but shines the spotlight on another woman, leaving Vera heartbroken.

Then an accident steals Vera’s memory. As she rebuilds her life, her true identity emerges: she is the long-lost heiress of the Costa family, one of the world’s most powerful mafia clans. With a new identity and formidable background, Vera stops waiting for love and takes control of her own life.

Meanwhile, Lucas finally realizes what he lost and begins searching for the wife he neglected. When they meet again, old misunderstandings, hidden truths, and family conflicts surface. Faced with status differences, emotional wounds, and outside obstacles, Lucas must earn Vera’s trust again—while Vera must choose between love, family duty, and her own growth.

title: Boss, Your Wife's a Whole Detective!
description: After a flash marriage arranged by her late mother’s best friend, Jenny waits three years for her husband Charles, who left abroad right after the wedding. When he returns, misunderstandings, accusations, and missed chances drive them toward divorce. Just as Jenny is framed by rivals, Charles steps in to protect her, but new twists and family schemes continue to keep them apart.

title: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas
description: Damian, the CEO of the world's most powerful military-industrial group, is mistaken for a poor salesman earning only $3,000 a month. Unexpectedly, he enters into a quick contract marriage with Iris, a company’s boss. Damian accompanies Iris to her hometown for a Christmas dinner, where he faces constant belittlement from her relatives and ridicule from Iris's suitor. Damian continually turns the tables on the antagonists, proving his power and status, and ultimately finds true love with Iris.

title: King of the Dead
description:
On Christmas Eve, a lavish party is underway inside a luxury estate.Alex, the estate's lowly maintenance worker, is publicly humiliated over a minor mistake by Victoria—the former president's daughter—and a group of wealthy socialites.Then the zombie outbreak begins.As the privileged guests become helpless prey, Alex discovers something impossible: the zombies will not attack him.
Overnight, money, status, and power become meaningless.Armed with his survival instincts, combat skills, and a mysterious immunity, Alex rises from a humiliated worker to the leader of his own survivor base. The women who once looked down on him must now abandon their pride and trade skills, labor, and resources for the right to survive.
But zombies are not the only danger in the new world.Ambitious survivors, traitors, ruthless mercenaries, and unknown forces hunting Alex's blood soon emerge. As the estate is repeatedly threatened by massive zombie hordes and brutal human conflicts, Alex becomes the one man everyone depends on.When the survivors finally set out for a rumored safe haven in Nevada, a mysterious transmission changes everything:“Possible complete antibody carrier identified.”“Capture the target alive.”The apocalypse has only just begun.

title: King of the Flooded World
description: After a global flood forces humanity into an ocean survival game, Calvin starts with nothing but a broken raft. He soon unlocks the hidden class of Supreme Machinist, allowing him to upgrade and rebuild almost anything. While others struggle to survive, Calvin turns scrap into powerful equipment and sea monsters into valuable resources. As his raft grows into a mighty warship, he rises from castaway to ruler of the seas, setting his sights on the legendary Ark Continent.

title: Fated To The Lycan King
description: On the night of her eighteenth birthday, Leila Winters witnessed her parents being murdered by the Wolf King Colt, and she herself was taken captive. She was shocked to discover that Colt was actually her fated mate, which made it impossible for her to take revenge with her own hands. As she was forced to get close to Colt, Leila gradually uncovered that the truth was far from what she had assumed. Her father was not a traitor, but had killed the king to protect her. Colt, though the son of the former Wolf King, despised pure-blood supremacy. The true mastermind was Colt’s half-sister Snell, who had murdered Leila’s biological mother and impersonated her for ten years, manipulating everything. In the end, Leila saw through the deception and plunged a dagger into Snell’s heart. Colt voluntarily relinquished the throne and walked hand in hand with Leila toward a future determined by love rather than prophecy.

title: Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King
description:
Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten Dragon God Marks and forges a soul-deep bond with Akura, bearer of the ancient Golden Dragon bloodline.
Betrayed by his own family, stripped of his name, and tormented by the very Sanctum that should have been his home — when the buried truth finally breaks free, the outcast of old rises in the full wrath of a Dragon God and grinds every last humiliation to dust.
From that moment on, the young dragonlord sets forth across the land with his dragon at his side, and the entire continent shudders as the sky itself begins to change.

title: Return of the racing king
description: The racing king, Alexander, was framed by his adopted brother Cade during the championship and ended up at the Apollo Club, working as a mechanic. But the Apollo Club was threatened by Cade’s underlings. Alexander had no choice but to return to the racing world — the king of racing is back...

title: Return of the Racing King
description: The racing king, Alexander, was framed by his adopted brother Cade during the championship and ended up at the Apollo Club, working as a mechanic. But the Apollo Club was threatened by Cade’s underlings. Alexander had no choice but to return to the racing world — the king of racing is back...

title: Return of the King
description:
Leon Taylor takes the blame for his girlfriend Ginny and spends three years in prison. On the day of his release, Ginny shows up with her new boyfriend, Jack, to humiliate him. She also reveals the truth: the real hit-and-run culprit was Jack, and Ginny had been using Leon from the very beginning.
But Ginny has no idea that Leon met two godfathers inside Tartarus Prison: the Eastern Taoist master Zhang and the Western gentleman Zeus. The two godfathers taught Leon top-tier martial arts and qigong, then passed the leadership of Elysium to him. Elysium is a mysterious organization standing at the peak of the world, with trillions in assets and the power to manipulate the fate of nations.
After inheriting Elysium, Leon discovers that his two godfathers also arranged a marriage for him: an engagement to Emma Bellamy, CEO of the Bellamy Group and the most beautiful woman in the Big Apple. Meanwhile, Ginny and Jack, desperate to attach themselves to the Bellamy Group, keep provoking Leon.
Leon finds his parents, who have been tortured by Ginny and the Black Crow Gang for three years, and moves them to a safe place. At the engagement party, Ginny and Jack once again humiliate Leon and his parents, only to be slapped down by Leon in front of everyone. When Richard Foster, the underground emperor of the Big Apple and secretly an agent of Elysium, kneels on one knee and shouts, "Chairman," everyone finally learns Leon's true identity.
Ginny and Jack throw themselves behind Quick, Emma's older brother, who is about to return to the Big Apple. Quick is the third-in-command of the Commandment Gang in Mexico. James, the boss of the Black Crow Gang, uses his connections to summon Kai the Nightmare to deal with Leon. But the moment Kai sees Leon, he drops to his knees. Leon once beat him into submission in prison.
With no other choice, James uses his treasured Elysium Platinum Card and asks a mid-level member of Elysium to kill Leon. The executor arrives on site. It is Richard. Richard kneels before Leon and swears his loyalty. Leon steps on Jack and coldly watches Ginny, Jack, and James collapse into despair.
Tone: Power fantasy. The male lead crushes every opponent in his path. He hides his true strength. His enemies think Leon is useless, but he is actually the Chairman of the world's most powerful organization. Revenge / Comeback / Power Struggle

title: Sister Stole My Mate, I Got the Dragon King
description: At their mate-selection ceremony, Grant rejects Mara in front of both tribes and gives her place to her crying younger sister. He swears it is only temporary. He has forgotten one thing: Mara turns twenty-two in three days. Under tribal law, an unmated woman loses her right to choose, and Mara has already been assigned to the dying Dragon King. Grant expects her father to stop it. Mara accepts the decree. Three days later, as Grant comes to bond with Brenna, one hundred dragon guards arrive at the Hale gates to escort Mara away as their future queen.

title: Return of the racing king
description: The racing king, Alexander, was framed by his adopted brother Cade during the championship and ended up at the Apollo Club, working as a mechanic. But the Apollo Club was threatened by Cade’s underlings. Alexander had no choice but to return to the racing world — the king of racing is back...

title: Betrayed, Broken, But Crowned the Dragon King's Queen
description: Aurora, a descendant of the White King, is betrayed by her ex-husband Darian and offered as a tribute to Drake, the Black King. The resonance of their ancient dragon blood awakens unexpectedly, pulling her into the power vortex of the Nibelungen realm. Chloe, the arrogant Water Dragon Princess, repeatedly plots against and humiliates her, while Xavier, a half-blood black dragon, secretly orchestrates a rebellion to seize the throne. Through her tangled bond with Drake, Aurora transforms from a downtrodden abandoned wife into the rightful White King wielder of the Purifying Flame. In the end, the two join forces to crush the rebellion, uncover the truth of their bloodlines, affirm their love, and ascend the twin thrones together.

title: My Serpent King
description: Betrayed by her lover and adopted sister, the ancient goddess Lyra is stripped of her divine power and condemned to the Underworld for a crime she didn’t commit. As she's tortured to the brink of death, the feared Lord of the Underworld shocks everyone by kneeling before her. Three hundred years ago, she saved a dying black snake. Now he's back to destroy the gods for her.

title: The Dragon King 's Bride
description:
Celestia, the goddess, was drugged and betrayed by her stepsister Mortis. She spent one fateful night with Dragon King Azriel and later gave birth to a pair of dragon-god twins. Coveting the Dragon Queen’s throne, Mortis stole their baby daughter Joey, raised her as her own, and plotted to execute Celestia.
Fleeing to the barren wasteland, Celestia lived in anonymity for five years with her son Aion. Born with an incomplete divine core, Aion could only survive with his biological father’s essence. To save her son, Celestia returns to the divine realm. There she unexpectedly meets the Dragon King’s “daughter” Joey and feels an instinctive bond with the child.
Azriel senses an inexplicable familiarity with Celestia and takes her and her son into the dragon palace. The story culminates in a grand wedding between Celestia and Azriel. The Dragon King swears to love only her for eternity, as their twin children witness their parents finally reunite.

title: The Nether King's Bride
description:
Typhon attacks Olympus and is sealed beneath Mount Etna, but the seal weakens every 600 years. As the Age of Gods ends, Hades lacks power to reinforce it. The Prophecy Stone reveals that a divine heir—born of Hades and a mortal woman with witch blood and different-colored eyes—can permanently strengthen the seal.

In the mortal world, Saintess Layra is blamed for volcanic disasters and nearly burned alive. Hades saves her, taking her to the Underworld. The Prophecy Stone has chosen her as his bride: she must bear his child or die. Bound by the Serpent Soul Pact, Layra resists at first, but Hades’ care and protection win her over. They consummate their marriage.

Jealous Minthe, who loves Hades, torments Layra. Nyx, the Goddess of Night, imprisons her and claims Layra carries a God-Devouring Curse. Heartbroken and misled, Layra tries to escape through the Well of Reincarnation, but Hades saves her, confessing his love. They grow deeply in love, and Layra becomes pregnant. Hades weakens, avoiding her. Then Alector, the high priest who raised her, lures Layra back to the mortal world and captures her—he has discovered her witch blood and has his own plans.

title: The Dragon King's Secret Baby
description:
My stepmother hung my son over a crocodile pit to force me to become a sacrifice for my sister.
With my son’s life in her hands, I had no choice but to agree.
Everyone thought I was as good as dead.
But I came back alive—with a “husband” by my side.
No one knew that this man was the Black Dragon himself.
They sent me to the dragon as a sacrifice.
So I turned the dragon into my husband.
Now, it’s their turn to pay the price.

title: The Delivery King
description: To find a good wife for his son Ivan, the richest man, Richard Lee, hides his identity and has Ivan work as a deliveryman. Little does he know, after six years of battles, Ivan has become the foremost of the four great vassal lords, known as Prince Redflame, and has also hidden his identity. As New Year's Eve approaches, at Richard's request, Ivan brings Lillian Hades home for the holiday, unaware that Lillian, the governor's daughter, is already preparing for a wedding with the Wilder family. At this moment, Jason Wilder arrives to confront them.

title: Feeding the Dragon's Desir
description: TZyrthos, the king of the dragon clan, is mortally cursed. Only by drinking the milk of the human woman Vera can he live. Vera broke into the Dragon Nest to apply for a nanny in order to save her young son, but she didn't know that she was the antidode that the Dragon King was looking for - not tole that Toby, the sick son in her arms, was actually the bloodline left by the Dragon King in the foggy forest a year ago. He thirsted for her body like a bloodthirsty, and she ran away desperately, and fate had already written this immortal love into the curse of the keel and blood.

title: Reborn, I Gave Birth to the True Dragon King's Twins
description: Pierce threw Sloane's newborn into lava, carved out her dragon heart-core, and left her to die on the storm altar. Reborn seven years earlier, Sloane watches him choose her sister, convinced Mira will bear the golden heir Sloane never could. She lets him walk into his own ruin and binds herself to Corvin, a cursed raven everyone mocks. Then Mira's golden egg hatches a black serpent, while Sloane's single egg reveals twins: a Supreme Gold Dragon and a Blackwing royal. Pierce was only a serpent in stolen scales, and the raven he despised was the true Dragon King.

title: Curse of the Dragon King
description: It's forbidden. It should be impossible. But you — a human — have been Marked: claimed forever as a dragon's mate. And not just any dragon... the Dragon King. A man whose dark beauty and lethal power are only whispered about. Will this mark mean your end? Or will it unlock a secret that could change everything?

title: Fool No More, King Returns
description: Holden Stone wakes from a 3-year daze with immortal powers. Armed with godly healing and martial arts, he conquers the city, enjoying supreme power, loyal friends, and romance!

title: The Beast King Worships the Worthless
description: Wren Calloway spent three years saving Dorian, a voiceless siren heir. He calls Wren a worthless null and tears their bond apart to protect Wren'sister, Celeste. But Wren was never worthless. Her devouring aura had been suppressed, and Celeste's genius was stolen from her. The unwanted white lion sent as Wren's replacement bond-partner is Kane, the kitten she once loved, now the beast king the rift monsters obey. When Wren takes back every stolen power, Dorian learns too late he was only holding Kane's light.

title: The Blacksmith You Dumped Is the Red Dragon King
description: Blacksmith Arthur is secretly the Red Dragon King. After five years funding fiancee Elaine's studies, she publicly crushes his ring and dumps him for Lord Kendrick. Princess Guinevere, fleeing a forced marriage to warlord Duke Fletcher, turns to Arthur. In palace halls and at the Holy Dragon Altar, he shows terrifying power yet hides his identity — until Archmage Merlin kneels and Arthur draws Excalibur, unleashing golden light and a spectral dragon's roar that shatter five years of silence.

title: The Valet King
description:
Six years ago, Reed Carlisle, the secret power behind Apex Group and known as Mr. Big, was ambushed and poisoned at Saint Laurent Hotel. In a mistaken memory, he believed Selena Voss was the woman who saved him, so he quietly supported her career for years. But when Selena finally rose to fame, she cruelly dumped Reed and mocked him as nothing more than a lowly valet parker.

On the same night, Reed rescued Vera Monroe and her young daughter, Lia Monroe, from Damian Thorne’s forced marriage scheme. To avoid being trapped by the Thorne family, Vera impulsively proposed marriage, and Reed accepted. As their fake marriage slowly turned real, Reed protected Vera and Lia in secret, using Apex’s vast resources to crush Thorne’s attacks, expose Selena’s lies, and help Vera fight back in the fashion world.

As the truth unfolded, Reed discovered that the real woman who saved him six years ago was Vera all along. In the end, Damian and Selena were brought down, Reed formally proposed to Vera, and the family of three finally found their happy ending.

title: The Dragon King's Fertile Bride
description:
To save her younger brother, Elara willingly agrees to marry the legendary dragon, determined to claim his heart. But she soon discovers that Caelum—the last dragon, feared by the world—is the one who is truly kind.

As a conspiracy to hunt dragons begins to surface, Elara must choose between family and love. Meanwhile, a secret about the fate of dragonkind threatens to change both of their lives forever.

title: The Heiress Blacklisted Her Husband
description: Giselle, the Duke's daughter and rightful heiress of the Von Howard's family, married Patrick Hilton three years ago after he saved her life. She secretly helped his company go public, but constant harassment from Patrick’s mother and relentless taunts from Becky leave Giselle, now pregnant, feeling hopeless. She decides to divorce Patrick. Despite everything, Patrick’s heart belongs only to Giselle. After the divorce, he realizes how much he needs her and begins a long journey to win her back.

title: The Deep-Sea King
description: After being betrayed and cheated out of his fortune by his own cousin, Lin Ye builds a powerful fish-tracking system from scraps to take his revenge. Joining a rundown crew, he easily locks onto massive deep-sea schools, turning the tide. But as he ventures into uncharted waters, his tech picks up a signal that shouldn’t exist. In the deep ocean, he’s no longer just fishing—he’s hunting a mystery that might hunt him back.

title: He Chose My Sister, So I Chose the Serpent King
description: Olivia saved Adam, the silent serpent shapeshifter no one wanted, and spent years nursing him back to health. Yet when fire trapped her and her sister Chloe, Adam chose Chloe and left Olivia to die. Reborn on the day the twin serpent guards are chosen, Olivia gives both brothers to Chloe and fights her way into the family business. When Chloe arranges Olivia's kidnapping, Adam once again sacrifices her safety for Chloe's birthday. But this time, Olivia has planned her escape. Declared dead, she becomes the secret ally of Jason Astor, the ruthless Serpent King and her family's greatest enemy. As Olivia destroys the family that treated her as disposable, Adam returns desperate for forgiveness, only to find she no longer belongs to him.

title: Secret Billionaire Returns on Christmas
description: This Christmas, Eddie travels to his loving wife’s hometown to finally reveal he’s the billionaire CEO of the nation’s hottest start-up. But in a house and town full of Scrooges, will Eddie’s arrival be a Christmas present, or go down like a lump of coal?

title: The Desert King's Lucky Bride
description: Sent to the desert as a bride no one wanted, Elara Thorne refuses to die quietly. As a modern agricultural scientist, she heals the wounded, grows crops, builds businesses, and turns barren land into a thriving granary. While everyone waits for her downfall, she builds a life—and a kingdom—of her own.

title: The Delivery King
description: To find a good wife for his son Ivan, the richest man, Richard Lee, hides his identity and has Ivan work as a deliveryman. Little does he know, after six years of battles, Ivan has become the foremost of the four great vassal lords, known as Prince Redflame, and has also hidden his identity. As New Year's Eve approaches, at Richard's request, Ivan brings Lillian Hades home for the holiday, unaware that Lillian, the governor's daughter, is already preparing for a wedding with the Wilder family. At this moment, Jason Wilder arrives to confront them.

title: The Fashion Queen Returns
description: Once the Queen of the Red Carpet, Eve Corbelle is content with her new life as a housewife--until a sudden betrayal brings her back to the center of her fashion empire at the Grand Maple Gala.

title: My Double Proxy Marriage to a Billionaire
description: Family outcast Ella Davenport's father arranges for her to marry a scumbag, but when she shows up to sign the papers, she realizes she's already married. And this mystery hubby isn't just anyone - it's smoking-hot CEO Cole McBride! Cole refuses to believe that they're really married, but with his aging grandmother taking an instant liking to Ella, getting rid of her might prove harder than he thought. Can this accidental couple take the unlikely path from mystery marriage to real love??

title: Three Princes Regret Deeply, I'm Already Dragon Queen
description:
Lyora, a white dragon princess born with divine healing powers, is sent to grow up alongside the three dragon princes—Kael, Victor, and Finn—to fulfill her clan's fate. When civil war erupts, she risks her life and plucks out her healing scales to save them, draining her power. But her handmaiden Sylvia steals the credit.

For five years, Lyora endures humiliation and mockery while the princes defend Sylvia and trample her dignity. Finally, she abandons them all and agrees to marry Darien—their royal uncle and the new Dragon King.

On the wedding day, the three princes arrive to sabotage the ceremony, still believing she will choose one of them. But Darien arrives in time and completes the marriage rites before all. The truth comes out: Lyora was their true savior. Sylvia's lies collapse. The princes awaken to their mistakes—and drown in endless regret.

title: Reborn Queen in the Modern World
description: Vivian, a 200-pound mother of three, is neglected by her husband and bullied by his childhood friend who covets her place. But fate intervenes when the soul of an Empress awakens within her. The ancient ruler wastes no time—shedding weight, reclaiming beauty, and seizing her own destiny. As a dazzling new Vivian emerges, her husband scrambles to win her back. But her eyes are set on a far grander prize: building an empire of her own.

title: Reborn Heiress: Total Takeover
description: Battle queen Chloe died saving trafficked Nora, then woke up in her body. Nora was exiled and sold by her own father to the Naka Valley, just so her stepsister could steal her fiancé. Now, Chloe unleashes hell, ruthlessly reclaiming everything stolen from Nora!

title: Widow to Queen: The Alpha's Resurrection
description: Terminally ill and impoverished, Isla seeks one last reckless night—only to accidentally sleep with Jared Camsey, a ruthless mafia boss. When Jared is supposedly assassinated, Isla, now pregnant with his heir, inherits his criminal empire overnight. But Jared isn’t dead—he’s a werewolf who survived the shooting. Disguised as her bodyguard, he secretly protects her, and passion ignites between them. Everything shatters when Damon, the ambitious underboss, forces Isla to choose: her unborn child or the 'bodyguard' she’s grown to love. In a desperate moment, the bodyguard tears off his mask—revealing Jared’s face…

title: Release the queen's daughter
description:
Natalie, the dragon-slaying heroine, abdicated her throne to protect her adopted daughter Lily. Unable to bear being torn apart from the child, she returned Lily to her birth mother Iris. Unbeknownst to her, it was a cruel scheme devised to harvest Lily’s heart.
Upon learning that Lily was imprisoned, tortured and hanging by a thread, Natalie reclaims her crown. She storms the castle with the full might of a queen, exposes all the lies, resolves to rescue her daughter and make everyone who harmed her pay dearly.

title: You Fired a Fashion Icon
description: Dani, a mousy, plain-looking designer saves her company's Paris Fashion Week show only to have her success stolen by lazy but stylish intern Brynn, who gets Dani FIRED by her boss's power-hungry daughter. But when a rival fashion house recruits Dani, she gets the glow-up of the century and becomes determined to show off her design skills and reclaim her title as the true couture QUEEN.

title: Ocean Apocalypse: Hooked on My Undead Bride
description: In a world swallowed by the sea, the Fishing System is survival—but Nate was the ultimate loser until his ex publicly humiliated him. Then, he reeled in a thousand-year-old beauty from the abyss who calls him "Hubby." Now, Nate isn't fishing for scraps; he's ruling the ocean with an immortal queen at his side.

title: Dragon blood Uprising
description: Kyle is an abandoned half‑dragon outcast living in a human town. After his adoptive father Arthur is killed by the lord’s guards, he flees and forms a soul‑bond with the young dragon Aurelia, gaining the Crimson Dragon Gauntlet. Along his journey, he rescues the wolf‑kin girl Luna, who can transform into Shadow Twin‑Blades; the wind‑spirit Seraphina, who can turn into a Storm Longbow; and recruits the phantom fox Vex, who takes the form of a Psionic Diadem. He founds the Dawnbreaker Army to fight against the Holy Inquisition of mankind. Marco, the Grand Inquisitor‑Knight Commander of the Inquisition, leads troops to hunt him down. At Despair Canyon, Kyle repels an army of thirty‑thousand with his four‑fold armament.

title: Dragon Girl's New Choice: All 3 Fiancés, Get Lost
description:
Fifteen years ago, Princess Serafina of the White Dragon Clan shattered her dragon crystal to save three dying alien youths—Kael the wolf, Dorian the merman, and Soren the vampire. She lost three‑quarters of her power in exchange for their vow of eternal marriage.

On the night of her father's funeral, she caught them cheating with her stepmother Lilith in the mourning hall. Heart‑turned‑ash, she tore up the tri‑clan contract on the spot. Her ex‑fiancés, who had risen on her power, felt their strength crumble as the dragon crystal shards inside them backfired.

They begged. She walked away.

Now Serafina is on a path to recover her complete dragon crystal and reclaim the Dragon Clan's throne. And a mysterious man who never owed her anything, yet would burn himself for her, is stepping out of the shadows.

title: Dragon King's Unlikely Cousin
description: Spencer, a modern young man, is thrust into a world of beast taming. Betrayed by his girlfriend and left with a failed contract, he unexpectedly awakens a pay-to-win system. Alongside his cousin, a fellow time-traveler Black Dragon, Spencer captures SSS-tier dragons, topples his enemies, destroys the Shaw clan, and puts an end to rampaging beasts. From powerless outcast to unstoppable dragon master, his rise is as fierce as it is legendary.

title: Secret Dragon
description:
On the continent of Vester, Iso—Supreme Ruler of the Hidden Dragon Dominion—goes into hiding under a humble identity to investigate his mother Saintess Esara's murder. Disguised as an ordinary man, he takes residence in Silvermoon Castle and, honoring an old betrothal, becomes the fiancé of Sera, heiress to the saintess lineage.
Sera, however, is obsessed with the legendary Dragon Lord—a mythical figure she has worshipped from afar—and feels only disappointment toward her unremarkable-looking betrothed. She frequently mocks and belittles him, unaware of his true identity.
Cardinal Taren of the Orthodox Church, coveting the saintess's power, secretly hires eight renowned Dragon Slayers and rallies noble conspirators to ambush and assassinate Sera time and again. Each time, Iso secretly intervenes, wielding his silver-dragon might to save her. At Dragon Ridge Altar, he finally reveals his true form as the Dragon Lord—yet Sera fails to recognize him.
The perils continue: a tavern trap, a royal council coup, and a siege by dark Dragon Slayers—all quietly thwarted by Iso from the shadows. At the climactic final banquet, the Church launches its all-out assault. Iso summons a thousand dragons before the entire assembly, shattering the enemy's ranks. Only then does Sera realize that the "ordinary" fiancé who stood by her all along is the Dragon Lord she so longed to meet. Together, they join forces to counter the Church's conspiracy and uncover the truth behind the past.

title: The Dragon Lord' Daughter
description:
Leonardo, the Ancient Dragon Lord, conceals his true identity and lives as a blacksmith in the royal city to protect his daughter Fiona. On her deathbed, his wife Sophia transforms into a dragon crystal, bidding him safeguard Fiona, whose dragon‑kind bloodline has yet to awaken.
King Glen uncovers Leonardo’s real identity. Hoping to harness the dragon clan’s power, he arranges for Prince Adrian to marry Fiona, promising that Fiona will awaken her dragon inheritance at their wedding

title: Dragon King's Unlikely Cousin
description: Spencer, a modern young man, is thrust into a world of beast taming. Betrayed by his girlfriend and left with a failed contract, he unexpectedly awakens a pay-to-win system. Alongside his cousin, a fellow time-traveler Black Dragon, Spencer captures SSS-tier dragons, topples his enemies, destroys the Shaw clan, and puts an end to rampaging beasts. From powerless outcast to unstoppable dragon master, his rise is as fierce as it is legendary.

title: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride
description: Medieval times. Dragons rule the continent. Lydia is forced by her family to marry the "savage" Dragon King, Lucian, in her sister's place. She flees into the night — and in a blizzard-buried cabin, she encounters a dragon-shifter whose power is spiraling out of control. To save him, she gives him her virginity... The next day, she is captured. Her secret dragon pregnancy is exposed, and she is branded an unclean sinner, dragged onto the trial platform. Meanwhile, Lucian searches for her frantically, tearing a scale from his own heart to cast a tracking spell. When the crystal ball reveals the truth — that Lydia is the woman who saved him, unintentionally carrying his heir — and with Lydia's life hanging by a thread, he descends from the sky to pull her into his arms and declare to all: she is his only bride.

title: My Fireplace Ships to Dragon Realm
description: Wealthy heiress Emily is hunted down by her relatives over her massive inheritance. She flees to her family’s rural farm for shelter, only to accidentally discover that their fireplace connects to a dragon‑ruled otherworld. She keeps sending modern supplies to this realm, aiding Kael, the metal dragon lord, in protecting his people and homeland. To the dragons, she becomes the "Dragon God". From firewood and medicine to modern weaponry, she reshapes the dragon‑race war step by step — and rewrites her own destiny.

title: My Dragon Daughter's True Sight
description: Former Marine Harper rescues orphan Sophie, who possesses the Dragon’s True Sight to see values and curses. They soon meet Gavin, a pure-blood dragon tycoon, who turns out to be Sophie’s birth father. The family faces constant schemes, dark magic and kidnapping plotted by vicious rivals. With awakened dragon blood and perfect teamwork, they defeat all enemies, reunite happily, and Sophie is recognized as the legitimate dragon heir

title: Golden Dragon Mother’s Rampage
description:
In my past life, I was a pure-blooded white dragon who gave everything to help him seize the throne—only to have that hypocrite  Igon  sever my wings, steal my child, shatter my egg, and summon heavenly thunder to strike me down. With my dying breath, I swore on my blood: if I ever returned, I would make him pay a hundredfold!

I open my eyes to find myself back at the royal consort selection ceremony—the very day he chose my half-sister Jean  instead, and tried to ruin my name with a so-called "divine prophecy." Fine. I sneak straight into the forbidden depths and claim the legendary ancient Golden Dragon, Cedric, as my mate—conceiving the supreme dragon heir!

The scumbag gloats as his egg hatches a golden dragon, taunting me that my black egg could only produce a lowly black dragon. But when my egg cracks open—a rainbow-colored Supreme Saint Dragon emerges, crushing his shadowy black dragon whelp in an instant! With our bet sealed, I raise my blade and sever his wings, ripping off his false golden dragon disguise for all to see—

Wait. The "black dragon" mate I picked up on a whim… is the undisputed pinnacle of all dragonkind?!

"My dear, for the sake of saving dragon bloodline, we'll just have to try a few more times." He chuckles, pulling me closer by the waist.

This rebirth? Totally worth it.

title: Never Look Back: The Dragon's Contract Bride
description: Illegitimate princess Callista trades bridal engagements with her half-sister Elle to claim one billion gold coins and buy the world's only Dawnlight Petal to save her dying mother. In Elle's place, she marries Isvel, the feared Black Dragon of the Abyss—only for Elle and Prince Gareth to steal the petal, leaving her mother to die. Gareth finally realizes he loved the wrong woman and chases after her too late. The supposedly bloodthirsty dragon is in truth gentle and loyal, shielding her again and again. Callista never looks back, falls for him, and becomes his queen as evil gets its due.

title: Dragon knight
description: The princess was cursed by the god of death in hell, and the dragon knight prince rode a dragon to defeat the god of death.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: ‌My dragon husband‌
description:
Madison Foster was maliciously retaliated against by her classmate Chloe Thompson, and was thrown into the Dragon Tower Castle, where she encountered
Noah Lewis, who was cursed and imprisoned by the dragon race, escaped alone after one night, only to find herself pregnant with twin dragon twins.
Six years later, Elias and Amelia gradually exhibited dragon characteristics. To raise money for their medical expenses, Madison went to
Oak Manor is hiring a maid, and unexpectedly reunites with Noah. A paternity test confirms that the two children are Noah's
They are related by blood, but someone has tampered with the bloodline test using witchcraft, and Sophie is secretly colluding with the Dark Forest Witch Clan from within.
Madison had to contend with repeated attacks from Chloe and Sophie, while also accepting herself and her child
The fate of the dragon race. After experiencing kidnapping and the crisis at the altar, Madison awakened the dragon queen's blood seal and joined hands with Noah to fight
"The Witch Retreat Tribe. In the end, she chose to stay with Noah and the children, following her heart. The past turmoil came to an end, and she embarked on a new journey."
A new life for a family.

title: Awakened Dragon Oath
description: Medieval Europe was ravaged by calamities; monsters and plagues had brought kingdoms totheir knees. Six desperate kings journeyed to the Dragon's Gorge to forge a secret pact withLunara, the one and only True Dragon. In exchange for six of her ventral scales to stave offthe apocalypse, the six kingdoms pledged the souls of all their royal bloodlines to the dragonfor eternity upon their death. Lunara honored the pact, surrendering her scales anddamaging her core. She fell into a deep slumber atop a mountain of gold in the gorge.Decades later, she awoke to utter betrayal. The six kingdoms reneged on the soul contract,used the dragon scales to conquer and expand their territories, and allied with the Church torewrite history, branding the oath-keeping True Dragon as a world-ending menace. Sir Cyrus,a royal knight ordered to hunt her down, saw through the hypocrisy of men, abandoned hisfaith, and became her loyal guardian. He vows to help her reclaim the scales, enforce thecontract, and reset the rules of the world.

title: Ashen Knight: The Return of Dragon Blood
description: Ethan, a former knight who had been in a coma for five years was widely perceived by the nobility as the greatest liability in his wife Claire's life. However, when a Duke's son forced Claire to remarry and members of the aristocracy publicly demeaned her, Ethan woke up. And Ethan's long-lost sister Sophia, a rich Duchess, also came to help him. In fact, Ethan is the Dragon King of the Dragon Oath Dynasty, a lineage bearing direct royal blood.

title: The Virgin Sacrifice the Dragon King Claims
description: Princess Valerie marries the ruthless Dragon King Therak to save her kingdom. But their wedding night hides a deadly game. Beneath her pillow lies the dagger meant for his heart. In his veins flows a curse: devour her before the Blood Moon, or die. Yet when danger strikes, Therak risks his life to protect her. Enemies by fate, lovers by choice. The Blood Moon rises. One must die.

title: Goodbye My Ex, I'm Marrying the Dragon Prince FINAL
description:
Mira is the long-lost biological daughter of the Hale family of Ashen City. Yet after returning home, she repeatedly gives way to their adopted daughter, Lia—surrendering her room, her place as a dragon rider, and even half of her mother’s inheritance.

Before the wedding, Draegoth—the bonded dragon Garrick personally tamed and the only keepsake Mira has left from her mother—is trained to obey Lia alone and nearly kills Mira. Realizing that Garrick, her fiancé of eight years, has always seen her as nothing more than a gullible woman, Mira walks barefoot across burning coals, breaks off their engagement, and turns to marry Theron, the Lord of the North, who has waited eight years for her.

When Garrick, Lia, and Mira’s brother Cael arrive at the magnificent Northern wedding and discover that Mira is the bride, they are overwhelmed with regret—but it is already too late. In the end, Mira is surrounded by the love she deserves, and her mother’s dragon finally returns to her side.

title: My Dragon, Not Hers
description: Mira's betrothed spent three years taming a wild dragon for their wedding—but he trained it to obey Lia, her family's adopted daughter. They took everything from her: her place in the clan, her inheritance, even her mother's dragon. When they demanded she kneel and wipe Lia's boots, Mira walked barefoot across burning coals instead. She broke the betrothal. Then a column of black war-dragons descended, and their lord claimed her—with a bloodwing dragon and three thousand acres of dragonland. He was the man who had waited eight years for her answer. On her wedding day, her old betrothed watched from the crowd as Mira married another man. And the dragon he had stolen finally threw Lia to the ground and flew home—to Mira.

title: The Dragon Lord's Regret: Rejecting His Slave Mate
description:
Aria, the Dragon Princess, hid her identity as an Omega Slave just to stay by Draven's side — until she found out he was marrying someone else. To him, she was never a lover. Just a tool to break his curse. 
So she walked away and took back her crown. When Draven sees her again, she's untouchable. A princess in full power — and there's a dangerously powerful, strikingly handsome man standing beside her, calling her "my wife."
Now Draven is the one begging. But is it already too late?

title: The Dragon's Cinder
description:
Elodie, an orphan, is forced to take her stepsister Nina's place as a bride sacrifice to the last dragon on Deep-Sea Dragon Isle. On the isle, she finds all previous brides dead. She tries to flee but is recaptured. She saves an injured man named Karen and discovers she is immune to dragon-fire.

Selene, a jealous witch, exploits Elodie's worry for her brother, setting traps to drive her away and create conflict with the dragon.

Elodie returns home, only to see her stepmother's cruelty—she plans to use Elodie as a pawn. Selene then fabricates betrayal to enrage Karen. The dragon descends upon the mortal realm for vengeance.

Karen meets Elodie's brother, learns the truth, rescues the siblings, and brings them back to Dragon Isle. Selene's conspiracy is exposed—she colluded with the royal court to besiege the isle. Elodie awakens her curse-breaking power to fight the witch.

Selene is defeated. The royal army halts. Karen breaks his curse and regains human form. Elodie frees herself from her family, protects her brother, and stays with Karen on Dragon Isle. Their love ends three hundred years of lonely fate.

title: Curse of the Dragon King
description: It's forbidden. It should be impossible. But you — a human — have been Marked: claimed forever as a dragon's mate. And not just any dragon... the Dragon King. A man whose dark beauty and lethal power are only whispered about. Will this mark mean your end? Or will it unlock a secret that could change everything?

title: Dragonborn The Four Flames
description: In ancient Aetheran, dragonborn royalty rules seven kingdoms—but a thousand-year curse causes purebloods to die before age one hundred, with heirs growing rarer each generation. Princess Elena, from a fallen noble house, sells her bloodline at a sacred ritual to save her dying mother. There, Crown Prince Drake discovers her. Mistaking her for a gold-digger, he completes the ancient "Dragonflame Union" with her out of desperation. Months later, Elena discovers she carries quadruplets—four dragon flames burning within her. This miracle could save Drake's bloodline and break the curse—if his power-hungry nephew doesn't destroy them first.

title: Vindication: Blood of the Archmage
description: After his father dies saving the world, he is branded a traitor and his entire clan is destroyed. Ryan vanishes into exile, training in secret for fourteen years. Now Ryan returns to expose the dark mage's conspiracy, clear his father's name.

title: After I was sacrificed to the evil dragon, my brothers regretted it
description: Princess Mira of the Silver Moon Kingdom was rescued from the ruins of war by the royal family as a child and raised under their constant protection for seventeen years. However, when Serla—who claimed to be her "biological sister" —returned to the royal household, everything changed: her family began to neglect her, misunderstood her, and even repeatedly pushed her toward the abyss. On the surface, Serla appeared gentle and kind; beneath this facade, however, she was ruthless and cruel—she stole Mira's music box, her evening gown, and her room, and even framed and accused her, leaving her three elder brothers and parents utterly disillusioned with Mira. Mira endured all of this in silence, secretly entering into a covenant with the Dragon Clan—sacrificing herself in exchange for a century of peace for the kingdom—and exchanging her heart for that of her second brother, Solin, who suffered from cardiac disease. On her 18th birthday, her family expelled her from the royal palace due to Serla's lies. Without offering any defense, Mira walked alone toward the altar and was consumed by flames, vanishing into nothingness. Only when the truth was finally revealed did her family, consumed by endless remorse, forever lose the girl who truly loved them.

title: Wrath of the Sea Goddess: Married to the Twin Gods
description: Goddess Dara's blissful marriage to Prince Pollux of Atlantis shatters when she discovers he and her maid, Pandora, are plotting to sacrifice her. After Pandora opens a forbidden magic box – throwing Dara into the abyss – Pollux's brother Castor saves her. After awakening, Dara pretends she lost her memory and calls Castor her husband. But Dara's amnesia is only an act — and her revenge has just begun.

title: Found A Homeless Dragon Husband
description: Beggar Killian, secretly the Crown Prince of the Dragon Clan, saved Eva during his tribulation. Eva's family demanded she choose between Killian and her home; she chose him. Moved by her loyalty, Killian crowns her, sealing their bond.

title: The Devil Dragon's Substitute Bride
description: In order to save her terminally ill sister, she was forced to take the place of her selfish cousin and be sacrificed to the rumored cannibalistic and brutal dragon duke. However, she unexpectedly discovered that the ""terrifying beast"" was actually a peerless beauty. Not only did he dote on her after marriage, but he also allowed her to make a stunning comeback. She married another seemingly good man who treated her cousin poorly, and after learning about the heroine's life, the cousin went insane with jealousy.

title: The Tyrant's Max-Level Dragon Bride
description:
Aurora is the last true dragon of the Abyss—and its most ferocious world-destroyer.
After an unexpected transmigration, she finds herself in the body of a supposedly useless bride sent as a substitute to marry the empire’s unhinged tyrant, Alexander. Armed with a body that grants her absolute immunity to physical harm, Aurora plans to keep a low profile and live a carefree life in the imperial harem.
However, Alexander is afflicted with an exceptionally vicious curse known as the “Death God’s Curse,” and he spends every day devising new ways to uncover her hidden identities.
Thus begins a fated bond forged by one inescapable truth:
I am your one and only salvation.

title: On the Day of the Broken Engagement, I Married a Half-Blood Dragon
description:
This is a short story blending the wildness of primitive tribes with the fantastical fate of dragon clans. Set in a primitive dragon clan tribe with a muted, low-saturation color palette, the story revolves around the revenge plan of Luke, the half-blood dragon protagonist. The main storyline is interwoven with the core conflict of the female lead welcoming a new life through childbirth.
Amidst the dark and oppressive power struggles within the tribe, the arrival of the new life breaks the shackles of the original fate, echoing the core theme of new life emerging from darkness. The overall style is gloomy and profound, filled with the hidden vibe of primitive wilderness and the fateful tension of the ancient dragon clan. Through a unified muted and low-saturation visual tone, it finally delivers the story's core: all colors are reborn after darkness.

title: My Contract Husband Is a Dragon
description:
Three months ago, at the Imperial Midsummer Ball, seamstress Sera Bennett caught her fiancé Michael and her fake friend Laura cheating. Michael, soon to be a duke's guardsman, sneered that she was just a ""lowly sewing girl"" unworthy of his rising status. She slapped him and fled, only to crash into the cold, noble embrace of Duke Alexander Drake, the empire's guardian and Michael's ultimate patron.
Burning with rage, Sera seduced him that very night. After one night, he handed her not gold, but a church‑blessed marriage contract. She assumed it was a deal: she'd gain a duchess's power to crush her betrayers, while he seemed to want her body. One year, then they'd part.
What Sera never knew: Alex is the last ancient black dragon, sealed for centuries. Her kiss is the only cure for his volatile dragon power, and the blood pact binds their souls forever. Married life reveals his strange fevers and odd behavior… and their one‑year agreement becomes anything but simple."

title: Doting Snake Lord
description: Reborn before her tragic fate unfolds, Elena falls victim to betrayal in her past life at the hands of her sister Veronica and her fiancé Grayson. They swap her golden‑dragon egg, leaving her to die under false accusations. In this new life, she resolutely turns to the imprisoned Dragon Lord Nidhogg to conceive a child for self‑preservation and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with nine offspring. On the day of her labor, the villains strike again with slander. Nidhogg appears majestically to shield his mate. He exposes Veronica’s true identity as a wyvern and crushes all her foes. Elena rises to become the Divine Mother. She embarks on a sweet‑romance life alongside the Dragon Lord, and her nine dragon‑born children shake the Three Realms.

title: Ice Dragon’s Thoughts Drive Her Husbands Obsessed
description:
Overworked and dropped dead, Earth girl Lira transmigrates into an interstellar beast world as the infamous vicious Ice-Dragon female. The original host—manipulated by the Third Princess—abused beastmen and sold her own brother, earning the hatred of four top-tier Alpha beastmen.

Lira awakens a Purification System—and her inner thoughts are broadcasted to all four men. She uses her power to heal frenzied beastmen and reveals conspiracies with her unfiltered monologues. Slowly, the four Alphas shift from loathing to obsession, fighting for her affection.

A shocking conspiracy surfaces: the Queen forged the Ice-Dragon bloodline and imprisoned Lira's parents. With the strength of her four partners, Lira ascends to divinity, crushes the royal conspiracy, and becomes the sole Holy Maiden—reunited with her brother and her lovers in peace.

title: The Dragon's Contract Bride
description: In a world where humans and dragons coexist, dragonkind—though capable of taking human form—are inherently violent and must rely on the magic of human women to suppress their frenzy. To secure power and compete for the throne, Dragon Lord candidates enter marriage pacts with women from powerful magical families. Anastasia, born into one such family and gifted with immense magic, once devoted her life to helping her husband Dmitri rise to the throne—only to be betrayed by him and her own sister, and die a tragic death in prison. On the brink of death, she casts a forbidden spell and is reborn on the eve of his proposal. This time, she refuses to be a pawn—she will rewrite her fate and take revenge on those who destroyed her.

title: Found A Homeless Dragon Husband
description: Beggar Killian, secretly the Crown Prince of the Dragon Clan, saved Eva during his tribulation. Eva's family demanded she choose between Killian and her home; she chose him. Moved by her loyalty, Killian crowns her, sealing their bond.

title: The Dragon Dame
description: She's the mightiest ruler in the Dragon Kingdom, but a year ago, she lost her memory. Hoping to remember and wed properly, she caught her husband with another woman just before their wedding. Furious, she pulled a random young man to pose as her boyfriend and revealed her true identity, shocking everyone!

title: Sea of Lust
description: Sea King Alex regains century-old memories and sails the Western Ocean to find his ghost bride Scarlett, who has waited for him for a hundred years. Stranded on a deserted island, he tames three stunning ghost bodyguards. To recapture the stolen Scapegoat Ship, he braves traps, battles the ship spirit and the Kraken’s forces, uncovering the century-old sacrifice plot. Blending revenge and tangled love, human and ghost passions collide, stirring a violent ocean storm.

title: Marrying the Dragon Lord He Mocked
description: After losing her sight saving Darion, Elara believes eight years of love will end in marriage. But when her vision returns, she discovers he is using her blindness to cheat with Cassia and planning to skip their wedding while another man stands in for him. Instead of breaking down at the altar, Elara exposes him before every noble, summons the man who loved her in silence, and turns her stolen wedding into Darion’s public ruin.

title: The Professor’s Forbidden Dragon Prey
description: At Asgard Academy, underdog Elena is relentlessly bullied for her pathetically weak magic. Ice-cold, stoic Professor Cassius notices her for one thing. Her scent feels hauntingly familiar, and it inexplicably awakens his long-sealed curse mark. He offers her private tutoring as cover, helping her rein in her wildly unstable magic. Until he makes the shocking discovery...

title: The Professional's Vow of Blood
description: Adrian, the deadliest hitman from Villains' Vale, descended from the mountains on a routine mission. But nothing was routine about finding Vivica—the Crime Lord's daughter—poisoned with a lust-inducing toxin. He saved her without a second thought. The Crime Lord was grateful. The reward? Vivica's hand in marriage. But Trenton, the most eligible bachelor of the underworld, had loved Vivica for years. Furious and humiliated, Trenton was dead-set a trap on destroying Adrian. To which, the hitman smiled, "Extermination it is."

title: The Cyber General Returns
description: In a cyberpunk world, Kael, the hidden ruler behind the system, secretly helps his wife, Serena, rise to the top. But on the day Serena becomes a legend, the first thing she does is demand a divorce, humiliating and abandoning Kael in front of everyone. With their love destroyed and all ties severed, Kael decides to take back everything he once gave her. Before the eyes of the entire world, he begins a ruthless reckoning against everyone who ever betrayed and humiliated him.

title: A Golden Dragon Made Me Rich Overnight
description: Honoring his father's final wish, Henry returns home to bury his ashes in the Lynch family cemetery, but accidentally awakens a dormant Golden Dragon beneath the ancestral tomb. Gifted with the Dragon's Scroll and powerful abilities, he discovers a hidden gold mine and quickly builds a fortune through rare fish and seafood ventures. When mining tycoon Lincoln targets the treasure, Henry uses his powers and ingenuity to protect his family's legacy, defeat his enemies, and secure both love and success.

title: I Gave My Flame Up
description:
Three years after leaving Onyx Stormfire, Serafina meets him again at the Grand Clan Gathering hosted by the Ravenwing clan—only to find another woman at his side.

No one knows that Serafina once gave up half of her own dragonfire to save Onyx from death, then pretended she had fallen for his younger brother, Corin, so Onyx would hate her and stop searching for the truth. The divided flame has left her unable to shift, and the last of her dragonfire is fading. She has returned only to see him one final time.

When Corin reveals the truth, Onyx risks everything to reach her. Their twin dragonfires finally reunite, saving them both. Locke is exposed as the poisoner behind the conspiracy, while Vessa’s false pregnancy scheme falls apart. At last, Serafina and Onyx become bonded mates, vowing to grow old together.

title: Princess Strikes Back
description: The princess who conquered a kingdom for her brother retired to the countryside with her daughter. Eighteen years later, on her daughter's wedding day, she discovers the emperor has given her daughter's betrothed—a top scholar—to another woman, and the groom's mother wants her daughter as a concubine. Enraged, she storms back to the capital, determined to get justice—even if it means hanging the emperor upside down and whipping him.

title: His Surgeon Princess Consort
description:
Olivia, a highly skilled modern surgeon, accidentally travels back to the medieval Kingdom of Valentia. She wakes as an orphan also named Olivia, whose vicious aunt plans to sell her as a bride—and living burial sacrifice—to the exiled Prince Leon.

Leon survived a brutal battle a year ago but is crippled, covered in festering wounds, and imprisoned in the White Tower, framed for treason and awaiting death. Queen Sophia and Crown Prince Thorne are determined to end his life.

Olivia’s only way to survive is to keep the half-dead prince alive. Using her surgical expertise and modern medical supplies brought through the time rift, she heals Leon. Side by side, they unravel Sophia and Thorne’s conspiracies, clear Leon’s name before the king, and pave his path to the throne. Along the way, they fall deeply in love and finally find lasting happiness together.

title: Hades' Mafia Princess
description: Born with the sealed bloodline of Hades, Lia Thorne is raised as the lost daughter of the wealthy Lancaster family. But when her return exposes their crimes and shatters their "lucky" adopted daughter Ava's perfect life, Lia is branded a curse. On her twelfth birthday, her parents drug her and leave her at Black Rose Manor, the most feared mafia estate in Black Bay. They expect her to die. Instead, mafia queen Veronica Knight and executioner Damian Wolf protect her as their little princess. As enemies close in, Lia's hidden power awakens, turning every betrayal into deadly karma.

title: The Mermaid Princess They Betrayed
description:
Princess Ella, a mermaid, possesses the mystical power to sense the Black Tide, yet the royal family regards her merely as a tool to guard their secrets. She is deeply in love with her fiancé Cedric and once sacrificed her life to save him. But on the eve of their wedding, she discovers Cedric has been misled by her younger sister Vivian. Not only does he betray her, but Vivian also pushes Ella into the deadly Black Tide.
Trapped in mortal peril, Ella is rescued by Ronan, the Black‑Sailed Pirate King. This man, whom she once saved by chance, takes her away from the cold royal palace and grants her freedom for the very first time. As the two venture deep into the Black Tide to uncover the truth, Ella stumbles upon a staggering conspiracy concealed by the mermaid royal family to manipulate the seas.
Plagued with regret after losing Ella, Cedric is too late. The mermaid princess who was once sacrificed has fully awakened. She commands the Black Tide, leads the pirate fleet, and exposes the royal family’s lies. From a manipulated pawn, she rises to become the Queen of the Black Tide who holds the ocean’s fate in her hands.

title: My Princess, Return to Me
description: Gloria Cooley is reborn on the day she was married to Alistair Payne. In her past life, she managed to marry him, only to earn his hatred and witness her country fall. This time, she chooses to marry Alvin Walsh, the King of Sabulon, and finds that the King falls in love with her. Meanwhile, Alistair realizes too late that he has always loved her.

title: The Princess Who Heard My Secrets
description: Julian Hart was reincarnated into ancient times with a system. His mission? Save the kingdom. His response? Hard pass. He wanted nothing more than to lounge around and do nothing. So the system improvised. Instead of forcing Julian to act, it gave the princesses around him extraordinary abilities—including the power to hear his every thought. Now Julian can't escape. He ends up solving impossible math problems, outsmarting traitors, and accidentally becoming the realm's most unlikely hero...

title: A Princess's Return
description:
After a terrible car accident, I was rushed into the emergency room.
The nurse called Cassian, but he was out of town with his lover.
All he asked the nurse to tell me was:
“This is the punishment she deserves.”
Just because I refused to give his lover the Moonstone my late father left me… he treated me like this.
What he never knew was that I am the last daughter of the Evenrose bloodline—
and the only rightful heir.

title: The Lost Princess's Journey Home
description: The emperor's beloved princess was kidnapped by human traffickers during an outing and spent over a decade living as a child bride in a peasant family. Years later, the emperor finally finds his daughter's whereabouts, but mistakenly identifies the wrong person... With schemes and plots inside and outside the palace, can the real princess reclaim her identity?

title: The Tyrant Emperor's Lucky Princess
description:
The Emperor yearns for a daughter after 28 royal sons in a row. He vows to cease his ruthless ways. In response to his prayers, Lady Quinn gives birth to Nora, a girl blessed with luck and foresight. Cherished from a young age, Nora uses her abilities to prevent the Emperor's violent impulses, saving lives along the way. Among those she rescues is Simon, a wolfish boy of unmatched strength, who becomes her loyal guardian and protector.
Join Nora and Simon as they outsmart spies from enemy nations and safeguard their empire's future.

title: Professor Luke's Sweet Mafia Princess
description: To get out of an arranged marriage, Jane, the fearless daughter of a gang boss, rushes into a marriage with Luke, a brilliant scientist from an elite family. What starts as a marriage of convenience soon shakes up Luke's quiet, research-driven world, as Jane's bold charm brings color and chaos to his once predictable life.

title: In This Life, Crown Princess Steals the Spotlight
description: The Crown Princess of the Qoit Dynasty unexpectedly time-travels to the modern entertainment world, inhabiting the body of a struggling actress named Aurora. Armed with exceptional skills, she captivates everyone, including the initially disdainful superstar Julian. Just as their relationship blossoms, Julian's first love, Claire, returns and schemes to create misunderstandings between them. Despite these challenges, Julian remains determined to win Aurora back.

title: Villain Princess, Four Lovers
description: Audra Valecrest, a 9-9-6 corporate drone, dies and wakes up as the Empire’s vicious Second Princess in a world ruled by women. The original princess abused her four S-rank mates and was obsessed with Damien Vale, a little schemer, until she was poisoned. But this time, Audra gets a luxury-spending system: spend on her mates to unlock 10x cashback and special powers. She saves the badly wounded General Hawthorne Adrian Hawthorne, calms the raging White Tiger War God Rhett Valecrest, rescues the merfolk marshal Nereus Blackwell at sea, and wins over Lucien Ashbourne, the scheming nine-tailed fox council president. As she puts First Princess Celia Valecrest and every villain in their place, she awakens her SSS golden bloodline, stops the Empire’s beast transformation crisis and rebellion, then rises as Queen to rebuild the Empire with her four lovers.

title: The Princess's Cash Multiplier: To Spoil Her Men (updating)
description:
Catherine wakes up in a new world, where she's the notorious second princess. She has four beastmen husbands who hate her. To make matters worse, she's completely broke. And on top of that, the crown princess is plotting against her.
Then she unlocks a tycoon system. Every time she spends money, it returns to her tenfold. With unlimited leverage and a modern mindset, Catherine begins her rise. She turns from the most hated princess into the most untouchable woman in the empire.

title: Never Reject a Wolf Princess Queen
description: This is a new spin on the vertical Never Reject a Wolf Princess! The Drama! The lore! The love! Oh my...*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: That Beggar's Dad Is the Crown Prince!
description: Starving beggar Zoey eats the Crown Princess' funeral offerings and gets caught by the ruthless Crown Prince! Luckily, she can understand plants, and they tell her how to save the princess. Now she's the Crown Prince's whole world!

title: 99 Cracks：The Scorned Siren’s Final Goodbye
description: Sera, the scorned Siren princess of Atlantis, is forced by fate to serve Ares ninety-nine times for an old rescue. The war god thinks she is a shameless worshipper, making her dance on bleeding feet, crawl before Aphrodite, and nearly drown for a false crime. But every humiliation cracks the contract. When Sera finally repays the debt, she returns to the deep sea as royalty. Only then does Ares learn she was his true savior, his obsession, and the princess he can never own again.

title: The Unchaste Charge:Plaything of My Husband's Godfather
description: Elena, a wealthy merchant's daughter, spent her entire fortune to buy her husband Julian a baron title, only to endure his brutal abuse. To marry the Empire's Princess, Julian and his wicked mother conspire to frame Elena for adultery at the Holy Court and banish her to hard labor. To survive and seek revenge, Elena sets her sights on Julian's godfather—Duke Alistair, the most powerful man in the empire and Commander of the Knights Templar. Offering herself as the ultimate prize, she engages in a dangerous, taboo game of seduction with the cold-blooded Duke. Just as her mother-in-law drugs her and locks her in a room with a filthy beggar, with Julian and the Princess arriving to bust the door open and ruin her reputation, will the ruthless Godfather descend in time to save her...?

title: Summoned Again: The Unwanted Consort
description: Modern star Aurora Valmont transmigrates, becoming Princess Aurora sent from Sylvania to Valoria. She tries to lay low in the harem, even faking illness to avoid the Emperor. But the cunning Emperor sees through her act. Captivated by her wit as she outsmarts rivals, saves the Empress Dowager, and sells miracle cures, he falls deeply in love and disbands his entire harem for her!

title: The Wingless God
description: Cassia, the Wingless Goddess, was born a scapegoat for fake‑princess Celine. Mis‑prophesied as a doomsday omen at birth, she was abandoned by her birth father. Raised under the protection of her adoptive father, she awakens the legendary divine wings. She exposes that fake‑princess Celine is the real destroyer behind everything. Finally, she overthrows the corrupt Wing‑Caste system and ascends the throne as the new queen.

title: Fatal Attraction: The Hybrid Princess
description: Natalie left everything behind to start a new life in the woods, until Alpha Jayce's invasion led to both her parents' deaths.
