Upon returning, Natalie learns that this new Alpha isn't who he seemed, and everything she knew about herself has been a lie. Can she trust this dangerous stranger when she can't even trust herself?

title: Crushing All Realms: The Playboy Heir?
description: What! Real transmigration? I'm the Lord Heir engaged to this Princess?

title: Share a husband? You're not worthy
description: Princess Helena is ordered to share her wedding day, her husband, and her throne with Damon, Leah, and a child passed off as his heir. Instead of yielding, she removes her ring and activates the Black Shield Guard left by her late father. With Cassius at her side, Helena exposes treason, stolen army grain, a false heir, and the murder of the king, then rebuilds Sparta on her own terms.

title: When Love's Sorrow Plays Again
description: Christy Lane, famous violinist, is forced to betray the love of her life. Pregnant and destitute, an illness slowly robs her of her ability to perform. All she has left now is an instrument she can no longer play--and a seven year old daughter, determined to bring Daddy back.

title: The Unwanted Goofy Son-in-Law
description: Dylan Wilson time-travels to Valoria, becoming the goofy Marquess of the Wilson family. He wants a lazy life but finds himself engaged to Princess Valerie! To stay carefree, he tries everything to annul the marriage. However, he accidentally turns into the pillar of the state and the God of War! With titles piling up, Dylan is in despair. Why is annuling this marriage so hard?!

title: My Loser Daddy is a Big Shot
description: With the help of their daughter Cassie, Ethan, a veteran, and Leanne, CEO of Osborne Group, marry on a whim. Despite facing scorn from friends and family, Leanne stands by Ethan as he uses his exceptional skills to protect them from various threats. Unfairly labeled as a deserter and gold digger, Ethan eventually reveals his true identity as the leader of the secret justice group, 'GUARDIAN FORCE.' He hides his identity to root out traitors and dismantle an evil organization, all while being a devoted husband and father.

title: Destined to My Prince's Embrace
description: Felicia Snook donates a fortune to aid her cousin, Crown Prince Ollie Gill, with disaster relief, in return for his promise to make her his Crown Princess. Yet, upon his victorious return, Ollie and his father strip her of her title and status and grant them to her half-sister. Feeling betrayed, Felicia empties the marquis's estate, expels the scoundrel, aids her mother in obtaining a divorce, and uses her fortune to secure her position as a princess. With a strategic grip on commerce, she is determined to make all those who wronged her regret their actions.

title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince
description: Prince Philip of the young Kingdom of Lavinia went to the US to avoid being pressured into marriage. There he met and helped Anna, an American girl who had just been betrayed by her boyfriend. Philip claimed to be a royal gardener and agreed to a flash marriage with Anna. After their marriage, the two worked together to take on Anna's stepmother and stepsister, helping Anna successfully inherit her mother's company and obtain the authorization for royal portraits. In the end, Philip revealed his true identity, got his parents to accept Anna, and the two lived a happy life in California.

title: Falling For Her Bodyguard
description: When fearless news anchor Colette uncovers dangerous secrets,she becomes the target of a deadly assassin, her only protection is Luke—a top-tier elite agent and the ex-lover who once broke her heart. Thrown together in a high-stakes fight for survival, they must navigate a whirlwind of bullets and buried feelings, reigniting a passion as intense as the danger pursuing them. But as old wounds resurface and new enemies close in, love may be their only way out—or the ultimate risk.

title: I Married a Star Lord
description: A Vex princess poses as a urologist and flash-marries the Draven Ruler she misdiagnosed as “broken.” They hide their identities, fall in love, and at the betrothal gala both masks drop—revealing they were each other’s arranged match all along. Fake marriage, real love.

title: Prince, Thief, to Warrior King
description: A prince torn from his throne. A peasant girl who risked everything to save him. Years later, he returns as king, only to be betrayed, beaten, and forced to fight for love, honor, and revenge.

title: The Branded Witch is the Prince's Bride
description:
Framed by the deceitful adopted daughter Eleanor, Matilda suffered three years of unbearable torment in a dark monastery. Returning home with deep scars and a branded heart, she found only cold violence from her cruel father and blind brother.
Cutting all tied blood bonds, Matilda chooses to marry Killian—a seemingly wild, disgraced prince. But behind his reckless guise lies an unwavering loyalty. When her past burns open and long-buried secrets unravel, the vicious imposter is unmasked, and her family is crushed by brutal regret. Matilda steps out of the ashes, no longer a victim, but a queen.

title: Mind's Eye: From Banishment to Blessing
description: Unexpectedly transported into the body of a five-year-old princess, she faces the threat of being banished to the cold palace. Armed with the "Mind Reading System," she grants her family the power to read minds. In the treacherous court, she cleverly outwits schemers, overcoming numerous challenges to protect her family and ensure the peace of her nation.

title: The Prince and His Precious Vixen
description: After an accident, modern weapons expert Wendy awakens in ancient times in the body of a notorious lovestruck girl and must marry by twenty or face prison. She chooses the shy yet handsome Prince Zeller, but when war descends, she turns genius into firepower, forging weapons, saving the kingdom, and turning a forced match into true love.

title: My Nephew, The Crown Prince
description: Yvette, orphaned daughter of a fallen general, once married Crown Prince Jeremy and suffered endless humiliation. Reborn on the day of the imperial marriage decree, she refuses to repeat her fate. This time, she chooses the Emperor's injured brother, Prince Yale. Miraculously awakened, Yale gives her respect and protection, and love grows between them, while Jeremy, recalling the past, realizes too late he has lost her forever.

title: Prince Wants Fish, Why Bring the Family Tree?
description: Arthur Sterling wakes up to find a scantily clad beauty in his arms. Before he can rejoice, Duke Edward Sterling bursts in, accusing Arthur of assaulting Edward's fiancée. Arthur realizes he has time-traveled to Valoria, becoming the despised, useless Crown Heir! Facing this blatant frame-up, Arthur refuses to back down. He exposes the lie and summons his eunuch attendant to testify. To his shock, The Crown Estate has been entirely bought off by Duke Edward—everyone is a mole! Enraged, Arthur strikes down the traitor with his sword and slaps Duke Edward. Expecting a fight to the death, he discovers a pleasant surprise: he has unlocked The Prestige System, allowing him to buy modern weapons with prestige points! Now, planes, cannons, and firearms are at his disposal. Furious about the slap, Duke Edward vows to impeach Arthur at the morning court. The next day, Duke Edward and his cronies pressure the throne. The weak King wants to protect Arthur but lacks real power. Armed with his system, Arthur feels invincible. Right in the royal court, he uses modern weapons to ruthlessly execute the traitors, taking the reins on his father's behalf to purge the realm! Failing his first plot, Duke Edward preys on superstition, claiming the ten-year drought is due to the Crown Heir's lack of virtue and that he has lost The Celestial Mandate! Arthur shatters this myth by creating artificial rain! Just as he prepares to finish off Duke Edward's faction, arrogant foreign envoys arrive. It turns out Duke Edward is colluding with them to rebel. At the critical moment, Arthur turns the tide, saving the nation, wiping out the rebels and foreign foes, and restoring Valoria's glory!

title: Time-Traveling Crown Prince
description: Lysander, a modern man, becomes a prince in ancient times and uses his knowledge to change the fate of the Great Zhou. Betrayed and killed by the third prince Thaddeus, he wakes up before the very night and discovers a jade amulet that summons modern technology. He goes for a brutal power seizure, easily resolves the barbarian crisis using modern weapons, and finally ascends the throne.

title: The Beggar Prince & His Runaway Bride
description: Sasha Tyler happens to save the drugged Crown Prince, Felix Wayne, and takes his token by mistake. Disguised as a little beggar, Felix sets out to find his savior and the token. Their paths cross again when Sasha, desperately needing money and food, signs up for Crown Princess selection, unaware that the beggar she knows is actually the Prince seeking a bride!

title: I choose that halfblood prince
description:
She died on an altar with her Divine Core ripped from her chest by the man she loved.Now, Aurelia has been sent back to the day she must choose a husband before all of Mount Olympus.Everyone expects her to kneel for the golden prince who once betrayed her. But this time, Aurelia chooses differently.
Instead of the celebrated heir to the Throne of Storms, she turns to the silent half-blood prince mocked by the gods—a man who, in her last life, was the only one who mourned her death.
And when the heavens unleash the deadly Ninefold Thunder Trial, Olympus is about to witness a choice that will change the fate of the gods forever.

title: The Elf Bride’s Impossible Choice
description:
After the sudden death of her father, Charlotte is cruelly abused by her succubus stepmother and two stepsisters. At an elven banquet, the Orc Queen arrives to choose a new bride with a magical goblin. After being secretly framed by her stepsister, Charlotte is chosen by the goblin and taken back to the orc castle as a “bargaining chip.” She is ordered to choose between two orc princes and marry one of them at her 18th birthday ceremony.
At Saint Elaine’s Supernatural Academy, Charlotte meets two orc princes with completely opposite personalities: Vesper, an aloof, restrained snake prince with dark hair, and Claude, a charismatic, sunshine-bright lion prince with golden hair. As her stepsisters Skyler and Blair relentlessly torment her at school and the lecherous hyena Logan repeatedly schemes against her, the two princes transform into fiercely protective mates. They publicly declare Charlotte as theirs in front of the entire school, and time and again, they unleash their full beast forms—the Golden Berserker Lion and the Black-Armored Giant Serpent—to rescue her from danger.
As they spend more time together and their intertwined fates pull them deeper into one another’s lives, Charlotte finds herself torn between the possessive, jealous Vesper and the gentle, devoted Claude. Caught between their overwhelming affection, she gradually falls hopelessly in love with both. On the eve of her coming-of-age ceremony, she even takes the final step with Vesper inadvertently awakening the rare and supreme bloodline of the “Holy Elf,” an ancient elven lineage of unparalleled power.

title: Royal Twist: The Powerhouse Prince
description: Elite agent Neve Flower is thrust into the past, inhabiting the body of the Prime Minister's dim-witted second daughter, destined to marry the infamous Prince Kivar. Tasked with producing an heir, she sets her sights on the capital's most alluring man to secretly father her child. Little does she know, he is actually the true Prince Kivar in disguise...

title: Christmas with a Prince
description: Dr. Tasha is off to St. Savarre to spend Christmas with Prince Alex. He proposes, and they immediately begin making plans. Princess Miranda, unhappy about the news, concocts a plan to halt the nuptials.

title: Ancient Prince, Modern Arsenal
description: A modern special forces soldier, Arthur Lancaster, dies and reincarnates as the worthless Third Prince of Valorian Dynasty. Framed for assault by Crown Prince Victor and his scheming sister-in-law Isabella, Arthur awakens a modern military arsenal and strikes back. The arrogant Viperian army provokes Valoria with matchlock guns. After Victor’s humiliating defeat, Arthur steps up to defend his nation’s honor. Overconfident in their weapons, the Vipers wage war under a false pretense. Unleashing tanks, warplanes and carriers, Arthur crushes their expansion. In the final battle, nuclear fire wipes out the Viperians and levels their island realms.

title: The Exiled Prince's Bloody Comeback
description: Yale Cole, the Ninth Prince, is betrayed by his brother and Consort Hudson, who frame him for treason and rip out his Sovereign Bone, leaving him powerless. Abandoned to die, Yale awakens a mysterious ancient tower within him. With Voragos revealing his Primordial Physique, he forges powerful halos, devours his enemies' strength, and wields the Hellfire Blade. Now, the fallen prince begins his brutal rise to power.

title: Kidnapped a Prince to Be My Husband
description: Amidst her divorce from Quentin, Nora unexpectedly travels back in time, awakening in the body of a 300-pound woman who narrowly escapes a murder attempt. To survive, she transforms into a formidable bandit leader on a mountain, where she raises four children. With their clever help, she captures Quentin, who once again becomes her husband as they rule over the mountain stronghold.

title: Empathic Link with the Prince
description:
"I was a hostage prince from a defeated kingdom. The duke’s daughter crushed the bones in my hand, drenched me in ice water, set dogs on me, and seared the flesh of my shoulder with a branding iron.
She wanted to flay my skin and spread it over her marriage bed.
But she did not know that the prince and I shared a bond of sensation.
Every wound I suffered would cross any distance and appear on his body.
On the border battlefield, bruises burst across the back of his hand, blood holes opened in his calf, and a charred mark burned into his shoulder.
He abandoned the enemy commander’s banner and led his black cavalry back to the castle, pressing his sword to his fiancée’s throat.
Even in death, she never understood.
She wanted to strip off my skin, but the shame branded onto my shoulder had burned through the bones of the man she loved most."

title: The Divine Prince's Mortal Bride
description: That night, Liola mistook the heir of the Thunder Temple for a divine male attendant. After it was over, she tossed a handful of gold coins his way and walked off without a backward glance. The very next day, the man showed up with his troops surrounding her, claiming he was there to arrest the thief who had stolen the sacred stone. Worse still — she was carrying his child. But he refused to acknowledge it, instead forcing her to leave the child behind and walk away. She awakened the bloodline of Athena, tore apart every injustice in her path, and turned to leave. That was when he dropped to one knee before her: "I'm sorry. Can you give me a chance to be the father of our child?"

title: The Royals
description: When the British heir dies suddenly, a modern royal family spirals into chaos. Party-loving twins Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor are forced to grow up fast—Liam is thrust toward the crown while falling for Ophelia, the palace security chief’s American daughter, and Eleanor hits rock bottom after a dangerous betrayal. As King Simon grieves and the monarchy teeters, ruthless Queen Helena joins forces with scheming Prince Cyrus to keep control at any cost. A dynasty built on glamour is about to face its darkest reckoning. Buy full season: https://www.lionsgate.com/shows/the-royals/the-royals-season-1

title: The Beggar Prince & His Runaway Bride
description: Sasha Tyler happens to save the drugged Crown Prince, Felix Wayne, and takes his token by mistake. Disguised as a little beggar, Felix sets out to find his savior and the token. Their paths cross again when Sasha, desperately needing money and food, runs for Crown Princess, unaware that the beggar she knows is actually the Prince seeking a bride!

title: The Rise of Talia
description: Talia Greene's life takes a dramatic twist when the Crown Prince violates her, sparking a burning desire for revenge. Once inside Ylego Palace, her resolve is unshakable: bring down the prince. But when she becomes pregnant with his son—while his other wives remain childless—a bold new plan takes shape. Talia sets her sights on raising her son to become emperor and leaving the prince behind...

title: The Strongest Male Obstetrician
description: Hades Mason, a modern obstetrician, is in a death row convict's body alongside his sister-in-law for not providing a child as a remedy for the prince. Luckily, the palace is seeking someone to help induce the noble consort's lactation. Using his medical expertise, Hades seizes the opportunity, survives the ordeal, and gradually establishes himself in the palace by resolving multiple crises with modern gynecological techniques.

title: Hidden Values
description: One morning, Zoe wakes up with a strange new power: when she narrows her eyes, she can see the hidden stats of anything — objects, prices, and even people's secrets. Her best friend Tiffany's dazzling new boyfriend? The words above his head read: "A married man with $1 million in debt." Her own boyfriend Daniel, the sweet guy she's been splitting discount groceries with for three years? "Heir to a $150 million fortune." The catch: Daniel has no idea either. The treasure has been hiding in his late grandmother's locked room all along — antique desks, oil paintings, and gold bars buried under the floorboards. As Zoe and Daniel's life transforms overnight, Tiffany spirals from heartbreak to jealousy to sabotage, determined to take everything Zoe has — including Daniel. Turns out the hardest thing to appraise was never the antiques. It was the people.

title: Hidden Agenda
description:
David and Mia are crazy about each other and have decided to get married. They move in together and their love grows stronger. Mia brings some changes to the house. She employs Sara, an older lady, as the maid.
Strange things begin to happen in the house. David falls ill and he hires a nurse, Amy, to care for him. David grows accustomed to her care, which may affect his affection for Mia.
Soon, Amy realizes the cause of David’s illness.
Would Amy be able to reveal the true identities of his lover and maid?

title: Hidden Heiress: Spoiled by Five Billionaire Brothers
description: Emma was switched at birth and raised by the Miller family. Once the truth came to light, she was cast out. After returning to her biological family, the Hayward clan, she discovers her five elder brothers are all powerhouses in their respective fields. To support her humble ambition of building a life through her own efforts, the whole family hides their trillion-dollar fortune and joins her in running a street stall business. Meanwhile, Fred, the head of the Vance Conglomerate, is desperately searching for his savior from years ago. Chloe fakes a scar to claim the identity and repeatedly plots against Emma, yet every scheme is uncovered and backfires, defeated by the Hayward family and Fred. In the end, Emma’s true identity is revealed. She joins forces with Fred to take down all the villains and gains a fulfilling love.

title: Hidden Blood, Hidden Wrath
description: Hidden for a century, the ageless Celeste emerges to save her descendant, Claire Winslow. Returning to the Winslow family, she finds Patriarch Richard Winslow dying. Hindered by suspicious relatives, she uncovers a trap set by her nemesis Severin Blackwood and a shocking bloodline secret. Celeste must use her ancient skills to root out traitors and restore the family!

title: The Godfather’s Hidden Wife
description: Evelyn is the Godfather Damian Moretti’s secret wife, carrying his only heir. Hidden away for her safety, she is mistaken for a discarded mistress by Bianca, who brutally humiliates her and kills her unborn child. When Damian discovers the truth, he gives Evelyn the power to punish everyone involved. One month later, the gentle wife returns as the true Lady Moretti, and no one who wronged her will escape.

title: Hidden Companionship
description: After a car accident, Memi falls into a coma—but her soul awakens and witnesses a nurse secretly swapping her newborn son. Powerless to act, Memi watches for seven years as her real son, Nick, suffers abuse. Just as the nurse plans to harvest his corneas to cover the truth, Memi miraculously wakes up and rushes to save him.

title: No More Hidden Love
description: Desperate for her mother's medical fees, poor college student Lyla Miller enters the wrong room and gets involved with Elias Thorne. Madam Thorne insists Lyla is the perfect match. Elias saves Lyla from her abusive father, leading to a contract marriage. Misunderstandings over her father's debts clear up when Elias discovers she is working while pregnant. He fiercely defends his wife from school bullies. After Lyla's true identity is revealed, the couple tears up their contract and celebrates with the wedding of the century.

title: Heiress Hidden In The Clouds
description:
Kate, an airline heiress, wanted to work as a regular flight attendant without revealing her true identity. But on her first day, Jasmine stole her identity and turned the crew against her.  
Meanwhile, Glen—the captain Kate was supposed to marry for business—fell for her without knowing who she really was. He even wanted to call off their arranged marriage!  
When Kate’s true identity was finally exposed, Jasmine got the humiliation she deserved—and Kate got her happy ending with Glen.

title: The Hidden Heiress Strikes Back
description: Vivian Tyler, the world's top billionaire and sole heiress of the Tyler family, willingly builds her penniless husband, Julian, into a business tycoon. This devotion lasts until his mistress, Bianca, publicly trashes Vivian at a grand opening party—even launching a viral live stream to relentlessly humiliate her, fully exposing the bitter betrayal. Facing the heartless scumbag Julian, a completely disillusioned Vivian no longer hides her true identity. She exposes Julian and Bianca’s hypocrisy and personally destroys the very business empire she built from scratch.

title: The Hidden Master
description: Ordered by his master, Gideon Locke leaves the mountain for an arranged marriage, only to be rejected by the Bancroft family. He strips them of the luck his master bestowed and enters the city. With unmatched medical and martial skills, Gideon conquers the urban world, wins over Vicky Carter, and reaches the pinnacle of success!

title: The Hidden Billionaire in First Class
description: They all thought Jett Hawkings was a lowly baggage handler and threatened to throw him off the flight. But when their plane is about to crash due to a storm, he's actually the secret billionaire that can save them.

title: No More Hidden Love
description: Desperate for her mother's medical fees, poor college student Lyla Miller enters the wrong room and gets involved with Elias Thorne. Madam Thorne insists Lyla is the perfect match. Elias saves Lyla from her abusive father, leading to a contract marriage. Misunderstandings over her father's debts clear up when Elias discovers she is working while pregnant. He fiercely defends his wife from school bullies. After Lyla's true identity is revealed, the couple tears up their contract and celebrates with the wedding of the century.

title: The Hidden Master
description: Ordered by his master, Gideon Locke leaves the mountain for an arranged marriage, only to be rejected by the Bancroft family. He strips them of the luck his master bestowed and enters the city. With unmatched medical and martial skills, Gideon conquers the urban world, wins over Vicky Carter, and reaches the pinnacle of success!

title: Hidden Billionaire Mom's Elite Kids
description: Helen, Chairwoman of Radiance Corp, is mocked for her plain look at her father's birthday party. But she once dropped out to work and supported her siblings. Then her three prominent kids arrive to defend her. Later, her son's fiancée Kelly bullies her on a flight. Helen exposes Kelly at a meeting, punishing the wicked and rewarding the kind flight attendant Emma, bringing peace to her family.

title: My Bodyguard Is A Hidden Tycoon
description: On the eve of her wedding, Vivian is shattered when she catches her fiancé cheating. Unexpectedly, she shares a passionate night with her bodyguard, who has secretly loved her for ten years. Together, they make a bold public statement by calling off the wedding. As their relationship begins to flourish, secrets about his identity surface.

title: Pregnant and Hidden：The Billionaire's Runaway Maid
description:
A poor small-town girl in a secret contract marriage with a cold billionaire CEO.
Bullying, schemes and endless misunderstandings test their bond.
Hidden talent shines against all odds.
He drops everything for his wife, crushes all enemies, and loves her with no regrets.

title: Rise of the Hidden Heiress
description: Valerie looks like a nobody, but she's the secret daughter of crime lord Arthur Morgan. To save her mother, she's thrown into the underworld, a pawn in a deadly game. But she survives. Feeding intel to the police, she orchestrates a bloody trap, watching the syndicate destroy itself. When the smoke clears, she walks away from the bloodshed, aces her exams, and rewrites her destiny.

title: My 60-Year-Old Apprentice Dad Is a Hidden Boss
description: 60-year-old father applying for a job as a trainee in my company?! But I am astonished to learn that my father's hidden identity is...

title: My Husband Is a Hidden Big Shot
description: Wendy got pregnant after a one-night encounter at a hot spring. Five years later, now a stunning and powerful CEO, she launches a city-wide hunt for her mystery baby-daddy, only for her daughter to find him in the countryside, living as a humble farmer. Determined to secure her company's future, Wendy brings him home as a live-in husband until she discovers the "simple farmer" is actually the hidden Lord of the Dragon Sanctum, a man far more powerful than she ever imagined.

title: Still Waters, Hidden Secrets
description: Zorii, a teacher longing for freedom, falls for Nolan, a single dad hiding a dark history. He sees the lonely rebel in her, and a fierce bond ignites. But when buried secrets rise, they must clear his name and fight for the future they both deserve.

title: Twilight Romance: Flash Marriage to Mature Tycoon
description: Ray, a middle-aged businessman who has given up on love. Posing as a construction worker, he enters into a flash marriage with Jocelyn, a woman who has just been kicked out of her house. Their union starts off with a sweet and dreamy honeymoon phase, but their love is interrupted by persistent bullying from the family of Jocelyn's daughter-in-law. After repeatedly saving Jocelyn from disaster, Ray reveals his hidden billionaire identity to her, and the two of them embark on a life of luxury. That's when Ray's ex-wife returns to drive a wedge betwen Ray and Jocelyn, and as Jocelyn prepares to sacrifice herself for the sake of her husband's career, Ray gives her the most romantic of surprises...

title: The Heiress's Dilemma
description:
Lucille Scott, secret heiress of Brookston's wealthiest family, must live in poverty for 20 years to break a curse that ties her fate to money. Raised in a rundown home by quirky parents, she crosses paths with Bryan Hawkins, a powerful heir dodging an arranged marriage. He offers her a million to pretend to be his girlfriend. But fate takes over when her parents unknowingly pick him as her blind date.

Pretending to be a rich heiress, Lucille enters high society only to be humiliated at a charity gala. Just as things fall apart, a mysterious billionaire claims her as his daughter, flipping the tables on everyone.

From secret identities and fake relationships to sudden love, kidnappings, and outrageous family tests, Lucille and Bryan must navigate chaos, sacrifice, and a curse on the verge of breaking. When she turns 23, her true identity is revealed. And with Bryan giving up everything to be with her, Lucille finally claims love and power on her own terms.

title: The Rockstar's Secret
description:
Juniper is hopelessly, recklessly in love with Tristan—the dark, intoxicating rockstar who rules their campus. The catch? He’s her protective older brother Carter’s best friend, and as far as Tristan is concerned, Juniper is nothing more than an invisible little sister.
Until the night the lights go out.
Trapped in the pitch-black darkness, a wild, uninhibited flame ignites between them—a night of unforgettable passion with a mysterious girl whose face Tristan never saw. All he has to trace his secret lover is a delicate butterfly bracelet left behind, and the vivid memory of a butterfly birthmark.
He is obsessively hunting for the stranger who shattered his world, unaware that the girl he craves is sitting right across his kitchen table. But if Tristan discovers Juniper was the woman in the dark, and if Carter finds out his best friend touched his sister, the fallout could destroy them all. Can a love born in the shadows survive the brutal light of truth?

title: His Longest Secret
description: Emma stood by Spencer through his darkest days. But he abandoned her in the wilderness on her birthday just for a call from his first love. Emma met two drunk punks and almost got assaulted by them. Luckily, she was saved by Joshua. Calling off the wedding, Emma flash married Joshua, Riverton's newly returned billionaire heir. Little did she know, Joshua has harbored a secret crush on her for eight years and is ready to spoil her endlessly.

title: Bringing Home the Woman in Black Stockings, My Parents’ Secret Is Exposed
description:
Samuel Sterling, a secret‑heir wealthy scion, was raised in poverty by his parents and remained completely unaware of his true background. After being humiliated and dumped by his gold‑digging girlfriend, he receives help from the brilliant CEO Irene Thornton. The two agree to pretend to be romantic partners to meet each other’s parents. Unaware of Samuel’s real identity, Irene’s father visits Samuel’s home, intending to humiliate him with money and ostentatious displays of wealth, only to end up thoroughly embarrassed. It is at this moment that Irene Thornton falls for Samuel.

Burning with jealousy, the ex‑girlfriend teams up with Julian Lancaster, a rich heir pursuing Irene Thornton, to target Samuel Sterling. Following a high‑stakes contest of connections and social status against the Lancaster family, the true identities of Jonathan Sterling and Margaret Sterling are finally revealed. Samuel Sterling learns the truth about his origins, comes to understand his parents’ well‑intentioned motives, and embarks on a new life as a top‑tier wealthy heir.

title: The Secret Cargo
description: Life on the road. She drives the truck while her husband rests in the cargo hold. But every time, he comes out more exhausted, eats meals in secret, and never lets her near the back. Curious but trusting, she keeps driving—until one day, a strange woman's voice drifts from the trailer. She looks. And finds her husband has been hiding a woman inside all along.

title: The Silent Luna’s Secret
description: Before I left for the Rogue Wars, my best friend Selene made me memorize one warning: if I ever came home and saw her eating almonds, that woman was not her. Three months later, I returned to Blood Moon Pack and found the Luna smiling at the dinner table, chewing the one food that should have killed her. Same face. Same scent. Same memories. She even called me by our childhood nickname. But Selene had never given false warnings. If the woman in front of me was not her, then where was my real Luna?

title: Cheating Husband, Your Secrets Stream Live
description: Married 10 years, top gynecologist Clara Reynolds wholeheartedly trusted her husband Brian Harrington — until she uncovered his affair, and his mistress Britney is pregnant. On top of this devastating betrayal, she had long endured endless abuse from her mother-in-law Karen Harrington for being infertile. Betrayal, humiliation, unrelenting pressure. She will no longer stay silent. Armed with sharp wits, professional medical knowledge and live-stream public influence, Clara launches an all-out counterattack. She lays bare the Harrington family’s hideous secrets, fights to claim her assets, and takes back every bit of her dignity.

title: The Secret Cargo
description: Life on the road. She drives the truck while her husband rests in the cargo hold. But every time, he comes out more exhausted, eats meals in secret, and never lets her near the back. Curious but trusting, she keeps driving—until one day, a strange woman's voice drifts from the trailer. She looks. And finds her husband has been hiding a woman inside all along.

title: I Found My Husband's Secret
description: Sarah Curren, an emergency room doctor, receives a call from her husband Harrison about a "canceled flight" during a surgery break, unaware he's actually at a hotel with her sister-in-law Mandy. Later, Harrison is hospitalized in a coma due to expired medication, revealing the truth to Sarah. Heartbroken, she also discovers her miscarriage was caused by Harrison and Mandy. Determined to reveal their betrayal, she exposes the scandal at Mandy's wedding to Harrison's brother...

title: Surrender to My Professor
description: College student Sylvia Parker finds herself in a dangerous love affair with Lawrence Calhoun, the last man she should want. He's hot, he's harsh -- he's her professor. As Sylvia struggles to survive in a cutthroat campus and toxic family, never has she thought her hero would be the cold, strict and sexy Professor Calhoun. As their connection deepens, a forbidden romance blooms, threatening to destroy everything if discovered.

title: The Secret of My Billion-dollar Marriage
description: Emma, the heiress of the Coffman family ​​who is dumped by her ex, meets Lucas, the billionaire of the Fischer family, in a strip club. At this time, she happened to meet her ex and his cheating partner again. In order to slap her fiancé in the face, Emma asked Lucas to pretend to be her husband, and Lucas took advantage of the situation and proposed a fake marriage. But Emma thinks Lucas is a stripper/escort, and Lucas thinks Emma is a ghetto girl/gold digger. Both of them misunderstand each other, and they don't want to reveal their identities. Therefore, they must carefully conceal their identities from each other during the process of getting along after marriage, and at the same time fight against two villains who are always causing obstacles. In the process, they gradually create sparks, resolve misunderstandings, and eventually move towards a real marriage.

title: The CEO's Secret Sniper
description: A sniper with superhuman sight just wants a quiet life until he's forced to marry a stunning CEO and finds himself in a new kind of battlefield: love, lies, and corporate war.

title: I Secretly Gave Birth to God's Five Babies
description: On a stormy night, during a divine rebellion, the drugged King of Gods Zeus stumbles into the restaurant of the mortal chef Ruby. After a passionate night, he leaves behind a silver ring and disappears. Ruby gives birth to five adorable demigod children and raises them alone. Eight years later, Zeus returns as the billionaire CEO Alexander, while the five powerful kids secretly test their absentee father. The jealous goddess Amelia teams up with Hades to hunt down the family. In their darkest hour, Zeus fights valiantly while the children awaken their divine powers to protect their mother. With the crisis resolved, Zeus kneels before his mortal wife in the divine realm, making her a solemn promise.

title: Triplets' Revenge: A CEO’s Regret
description: Six years ago, Aria Denton was set up by her fiancé and sister and forced to leave. Now, she returns with her three genius children. She’s determined to expose the lies, reclaim her legacy, and make the man who once shattered her pay for what he did. But as secrets unravel, Aria finds that revenge comes with a price she may not be ready to pay.

title: After the Breakup, My Triplets and I Took the World by Storm
description: A car crash leaves Brooks Hawthorne with amnesia and infertility, forcing Kendall Abbott away. She secretly raises their triplets alone. When Brooks regains his memory, he fights for custody, sparking a fierce family power struggle. Ultimately, he wins the kids back and chooses a future with Kendall.

title: The Boss's Baby: Triplets on the Way
description: Elise Hayes, a top finance graduate, struggles to support her mother with Alzheimer’s. After a fateful night with drugged Blake Kensington, she secures her job but runs away from him in guilt. When he discovers her pregnancy, he brings her home and spoils her like a queen.

title: Unconditionlly Loved by the Lycan Billionaire
description: After a one-night encounter with Miguel, the young Alpha of the Darkmoon Wolf Clan, Dalina discovers she is pregnant. Miguel leaves without a word, and Dalina raises their son Theo alone for six years. When Theo falls critically ill due to his wolf bloodline, he is recognized by Miguel’s father, the former Alpha Jagger. Desperate for money, Dalina becomes a nanny at Miguel’s estate — unaware that he is the man from her past. As the two fall in love again, Dalina finds herself pregnant with Miguel’s triplets. Secrets, wolf politics, and family bonds collide in this fateful reunion.

title: Three Babies, One Love
description: Five years ago, Evelyn Anderson was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, spending one night with a stranger, Gavin Foster. Her father died, her company was stolen, and she fled—giving birth to triplets alone. Now back as a jewelry designer seeking revenge, she discovers Gavin is raising her eldest daughter. To get close, Evelyn becomes the child's babysitter, hiding her true identity. But Gavin starts to realize her two other children are tied to him in ways he never imagined.

title: My First Love Pays to Watch Me Strip
description: Once a straight A freshman, Emma Lucas lost everything when Adrian Cole filmed her in bed and let her nudes spread across campus. He said her brother owed his sister a life, then made Emma pay for it. Three years later, Emma strips to keep Ryan alive, only to find Adrian in the VIP booth, paying men to humiliate her. “How did you get this cheap?” But when her family shatters and the truth about Lily resurfaces, Adrian’s revenge starts looking like the cruelest mistake of his life.

title: Falling for My Nemesis Stepbrother
description: Nicole has always been the good girl. While Kane, her stepbrother, is the opposite. To the world, he’s a dangerous bad boy. To Nicole, he’s the boy she never stopped loving. On the night of a deadly street race, Nicole runs into the road to stop Kane from destroying himself, while Kane fights feelings he knows he shouldn’t want.

title: Love After Rebirth: Spoiled by My Husband's Uncle
description: In her past life, she was betrayed and killed by her husband. Now reborn, she finds herself back on the day they met each other's families. This time, she makes a bold choice—she leaves her husband-to-be and chooses his powerful, enigmatic uncle instead. Despite rumors about his supposed shortcomings, their union quickly blossoms into a life filled with unexpected surprises, including triplets!

title: Oops! I Carried the Cursed Billionaire's Quadruplets
description: To save her dying mother, she sells her eggs. He witnesses this, mistaking her desperation for greed, and an unexpected night follows. Believing himself cursed and childless, he plans to disinherit his nephew. But then, she’s pregnant with his quadruplets. Seeking child support, she lands a job at a hotel, only to find her ex-boyfriend – the heir – attempting to seize her lover’s fortune. When her ex attacks her unborn children, the truth about her pregnancy and his impending doom crashes down on him.

title: Love After Rebirth: Spoiled by My Husband's Uncle
description: In her past life, she was betrayed and killed by her husband. Now reborn, she finds herself back on the day they met each other's families. This time, she makes a bold choice—she leaves her husband-to-be and chooses his powerful, enigmatic uncle instead. Despite rumors about his supposed shortcomings, their union quickly blossoms into a life filled with unexpected surprises, including triplets!

title: His Morning Sickness Alert & Her Love Signal
description: Chloe Lynch, hailing from a humble rural background, struggles under the scrutiny of her superiors during her probation and faces pressure from her family. An unforeseen encounter with CEO Adrian Hawthorne not only secures her position but changes her life dramatically. Expecting triplets, Chloe discovers a newfound ally in Adrian, who supports her through professional hurdles and familial challenges. Together, they embark on a journey toward lasting happiness.

title: Why My Contract Ex-Husband Keeps Chasing Me
description: Natasha marries Jaxon to be able to pay for her mom's hospital bills. Jaxon's grandfather had offered her a contract to be Jaxon's wife. While the two started their marriage happily, things got twisted when Jaxon is tricked into believing Isabella saved him. He grows resentment towards Natasha, who finally had enough when Isabella was attempting to frame her and sabotage her pregnancy. Natasha divorces Jaxon, who believes she is a cheater and was only ever after his money. Ultimately, Jaxon learns everything he knew about Natasha was wrong, and that she is a lost heiress herself. He learns that she genuinely loved him, and he lives in his regret trying to win her back.

title: The Christmas Switch
description:
Sixteen years ago, Molly has an affair with Colton, the son-in-law of the powerful Grant family. When she gets pregnant, Colton heartlessly tells her to get an abortion. Furious and heartbroken, Molly secretly swaps her newborn daughter with the baby girl born to the Grant family’s heiress, Rachel.
That baby—Rachel’s real daughter—grows up as Dolores, raised in the slums. Meanwhile, Molly’s biological daughter, Sara, is brought up as the Grant family’s beloved princess.
Now, both girls attend the same prestigious school. Their paths cross again. Dolores, strong and kind, catches the attention of Aaron—Rachel’s father and the Grant family patriarch. At the same time, Sara’s longtime crush, Ryan, starts falling for Dolores. Feeling threatened, Sara begins scheming against her, afraid of being replaced. As tension builds, the secret behind their true identities slowly starts to unravel...

title: Insta-Married
description: Syrena and Harrison wake up next to each other one morning to find out they've announced their engagement through Instagram. To protect both of their company's reputations, Syrena and Harrison decide to fake their relationship for the public.

title: Falling for My Divorce Lawyer
description: Evie wants to get away from her abusive, cheating husband, but he refuse to let her go. She finds herself broke and homeless, until she meets Hunter. Can Hunter be the lifeline Evie needs to escape her dangerous asshole husband who'd rather see her die than let her win?

title: Beg for My Return After Kicking Me Out
description: The U.S. nuclear medical professor Charlie Clare quits his career for family, but is abandoned as his wife and daughter favor his love rival Isaac. After suffering his family’s ignorance, he decides to leave for the Unicorn Project, which he designed for healing his daughter’s neuro-skel birthmark as his life work. But unaware that Charlie’s burning his life for them, his wife and daughter deepen the rift with Charlie upon reunion and eventually destroy everything Charlie left for them with their own hands before realizing their errors, only to find it too late.

title: My Daughter Has Three Dads
description: Six years ago, Clara Windsor spent one night with a masked man and had a daughter. Five years later, her daughter looks exactly like the Sterling triplets did as kids. A DNA test reveals a shocking truth: all three are a perfect match! As the brothers fight to claim their daughter, Shen's scheming stepsister tries to drive her out. But the biggest twist? Clara is the Sterling family's true lifesaver—and the child's father is finally revealed!

title: Crashed into the Beast Realm, Claimed by the Serpent King
description: A modern office worker, Aria, dies in a car crash—only to wake up in the Animus Realm as a rabbit beastkin. Cast out by the Leonine Tribe for having no male to claim her, she is saved by Valerius, the last of the legendary Orme Clan and the most powerful being in the realm. Cold, distant, and deadly, he never expected her to survive—let alone carry his triplets. By a twist of fate, their lives become inextricably bound. Together, they defy the gods, shatter a conspiracy, and rebuild their world.

title: ReelTalk EP 75-ReelTrip: Thailand
description: Join Savannah Coffee and Chris Quartuccio as ReelTalk goes international for its first-ever ReelTrip to Thailand. From the vibrant streets and skyline of Bangkok to iconic landmarks like Wat Pho, these costars dive into Thailand’s culture through unforgettable food, shopping, sightseeing, and makeovers. Experience the flavors, fashion, and beauty of Thailand through their adventure abroad.

title: The Triple Life of My Billionaire Husband
description: To avoid marrying a old man, I have a one-night-stand with a stranger and impulsively got married to him. I thought he was just a penniless nobody, but it turns out he’s the richest billionaire man in the world! Now, we're teaming up to make everyone who looks down on us pay for it.

title: Complete Strangers
description: A recovering alcoholic returns to his hometown after a hiatus, and falls in love with a man who will turn his world upside down.

title: Runaway Wife, Relentless Lord
description: Forced to become a mistress, Celine Shern flees to the Marquis's Residence, only to spend a night with Damian Shaw. She soon discovers she's pregnant—impossible, as Damian's chill poison has left him infertile. Betrayed by her family and targeted by Damian’s betrothed, Cathy Swift, Celine learns her blood marks her as Medicine King Valley's lost heiress and Cathy as the impostor. Celine reclaims her birthright, marries Damian, and gives birth to triplets, ending the Shaw family's curse.

title: Apocalypse: The Sanctuary is Full of Triple-S Beasts
description: In a mutant beast apocalypse, a blind youth tames deadly Triple-S beasts with nursery rhymes, believing he is just tending to the weak and disabled in his Sanctuary. This sweet illusion risks exposure only with enemies at the gates.

title: Any Global Tycoon Is My Disciple
description: Ethan Lance, at Deity Transformation Stage, descends the mountain to find his disciples ruling the city.

title: Leveling Up by Rewarding My Disciples
description: Orion Vance inherits Nine Swords Peak during a crisis. About to flee, he unlocks the Disciple Reward Multiplier System. Granting his disciples cultivation power, techniques, and Magical Treasure triggers up to a 10,000x return. Thus, the ultimate selfless master is born!

title: My Disciples Are Mutants
description: Betrayed as the apocalypse began, Wesley Rubin activated the Apocalyptic Discipleship System and reopened Rise Martial Arts in the ruins. He trained a zombie in Tai Chi, a cat in Ghoststep, a rock giant in Golden Bell Shield—accepting all races. As enemies closed in, he and his disciples fought back with Lion's Roar, Myriad Swords Return, and Buddha's Palm, forging a path for martial arts in the broken world.

title: Carter Reed
description: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. Emma killed a mafia prince to save her best friend, and now the city wants her dead.  There’s only one place left to turn: Carter Reed - the most feared man in the city and the man her dying brother trusted with her life.   Carter promised to protect her from monsters, even from himself.  But the more time she spends under his protection, the more Emma realizes she’s falling for a monster. And the more Carter wants the one woman he swore to never touch.  Will they give in, or will their enemies catch them first?

title: Do Not Disturb: Lady Boss in Disguise!
description: To become the heiress of her family hotel chain, Violet Trenton goes undercover as a cleaning lady and takes out the troublemakers one by one. Will she succeed and save the hotel? And is her sexy new COO Kasey Johnson just a powerful ally, or something more?

title: Do Not Disturb: Lady Boss in Disguise!
description: To become the heiress of her family hotel chain, Violet Trenton goes undercover as a cleaning lady and takes out the troublemakers one by one. Will she succeed and save the hotel? And is her sexy new COO Kasey Johnson just a powerful ally, or something more?

title: Do Not Disturb: Lady Boss in Disguise!
description: To become the heiress of her family hotel chain, Violet Trenton goes undercover as a cleaning lady and takes out the troublemakers one by one. Will she succeed and save the hotel? And is her sexy new COO Kasey Johnson just a powerful ally, or something more?

title: My Handsome Bodyguard
description: Three years ago, Jack Hawkins saved heiress Grace Christensen from an evil stalker, but when they reunite, a misunderstanding turns them into enemies. Now, with Grace's safety threatened again, her father hires Jack as her personal bodyguard. When they're forced to spend every second together, will they be able to resist each other?

title: Ms Mission Complete
description: Mission: Marry Xander. Mayas move? Reject him. Because Xander was not the prize. He was just the tutorial.System update: Freedom unlocked. Reward: Financial Freedom and A New Identity. New Game Plus: Available.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: HEADTRIP
description: A woman wakes up in a deserted forest with no recollection of how she got there. As she tries to escape, she's confronted with her disturbing reality. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Any Global Tycoon Is My Disciple
description: Ethan Lance, at Deity Transformation Stage, descends the mountain to find his disciples ruling the city.

title: Baby, You Had It Coming
description: Marry the man of her dreams was supposed to be the key to Ivy Donahue's happily-ever-after. Instead, it was only the start to an endless cycle of misery and heartbreak. But when her husband crosses the ultimate line, Ivy reveals she's not just any housewife—she's a billionaire heiress, and she's going to make him pay.

title: Rags to Riches: My Baby is a Money Magnet
description:
The little elf in charge of the wealth of the celestial realm, tired of the monotonous labor of a thousand years, descended to the mortal world and was reborn. Unexpectedly, he suffered along
with his noble mother who was in a desperate situation. She was naturally endowed with an extraordinary fortune of wealth. Secretly, she advised her mother to seize countless business opportunities. In a desperate situation, she turned the tables step by step and rose from a despised abandoned woman to a respected business legend across the country. The heartless
ex-husband and the scheming lover of the past reaped what they had sown and ended up in a miserable situation. The powerful Regent immediately recognized her tenacity and talent, and with a heart full of love, promised her a lifetime of favor. The female protagonist engages in business to help the people, breaking the shackles of the mundane world on women. The little elf is also willing to give up her divine position and stay with the human world forever. It is a story of rising to wealth that combines both excitement and warmth.

title: A Baby's Adventure and A Wife's Awakening
description: A celestial being with the power of a nine-tailed spirit fox is reborn as a mortal baby. To regain immortality, she must earn good karma through good deeds. Labeled a “demon child” by her father, she is unexpectedly understood by her mother, who can hear her thoughts. Together, they uncover the father’s betrayal and the mistress’s schemes, breaking free from abuse. In the end, the mother escapes, and the child rises as a blessed star through accumulated karma.

title: Baby Don't Cry, Mommy is Sorry
description: Rita Sanchez was overly preoccupied with her first love, Aiden Hughes, and his daughter, Ella Hughes, and repeatedly neglected her own daughter, Mona Barnes. After Mona became completely disappointed with Rita, her father, Elliot Barnes, took her away. Only after they left did Rita realize she had ignored her daughter, and she was filled with remorse.

title: The Billionaire's Forbidden Secret My Sister's Baby Daddy
description: A Manhattan billionaire reunites with his amnesiac first love—now a cold obstetrician—only to discover that the baby his sister is carrying via sperm donation was fathered by the very man he never stopped searching for.

title: Dear, the Baby Isn't Yours
description: Isabella and Alexander were bound together by a marriage arranged for the sake of their families. They never expected a marriage built on obligation to become the real thing. Everything falls apart when Lily—the spitting image of Alexander’s first love—suddenly appears. Again and again, Alexander takes Lily’s side, pushing Isabella past her breaking point. Finally, Isabella has had enough. She chooses to raise their child on her own and walks away from Alexander. Only then does Alexander realize what he has lost. He will do anything to earn Isabella’s forgiveness and get her back. But Isabella has already moved on and found happiness of her own.

title: He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive
description: Heiress Iris gave up her family fortune to marry Dorian, a poor average-joe. Three years later, she's about to welcome her first child, when suddenly, her crazy control-freak mother-in-law (Tessa) insists the hospital she's staying at is too expensive. Tessa manages to convince Dorian that they should switch to a cheaper hospital. Dorian, being a spineless mama's boy, gives in to all of Tessa's demands and starts bullying Iris too. Iris fights off increasingly unreasonable demands, all while dealing with unbearable pain in her heavily pregnant belly. Just as she can't take it anymore, Iris's father finally appears, bearing gifts for his new grandchild. How will Alec defend his daughter? When will Iris give her husband and mother-in-law a slap in the face?

title: Carrying His Alpha Brother’s Baby
description: Sloane was a fake mate assigned to heir Royce. For three years, he never marked her, spiked her drinks with suppressants, and humiliated her in public. His brother Kael, whose Thorne blood Sloane recognized at a ceremony, returned and proposed a deal: “Three months, he never pleased you once. I need one night.” One true bite shattered the fake bond. Sloane carried Kael's pup. Royce killed Magnus for the seat, kidnapped seven-months-pregnant Sloane, and confessed to everything—recorded live by the ring she wore. Royce was caged for life. Kael knelt before the pack and asked Sloane to be his Luna.

title: Marrying A Millionaire with My Baby
description: The framed CEO had sex with the woman, but the person who framed him arranged a scumbag man to lie that he had sex with the woman in order to escape the blame. After the woman gave birth to quadruplets, she was told that only one child survived. Many years later, the scumbag man got a promotion and got the woman's house, so he kicked the woman out of the house. At this time, the woman and the CEO reunited...

title: The Godfather's Guardian Angel
description: On a snowy Thanksgiving, young healer Rita lives with her ungrateful uncle William and his cruel family. They exploit her powers, sabotage her feast, and secretly hire a thug to drive her away. Hunted and alone, she is rescued by mafia godfather Richard Genovese and his wife. Discovering their kindness and lack of an heir, they adopt her. On the journey, Rita's powers save them from crises, alarming Richard's rival. At the manor, she heals Richard's dying father, Arthur, and finds a lost heirloom. Her courage and abilities win the family's trust. Rita becomes a true Genovese, protecting her new family with everything she has.

title: Baby Girl Summoned Her Daddy to Rule All
description: Once the head of all gods, Dominic searched lifetimes for his daughter. Near death, he finally senses her and wakes up—summoned by his 8-year-old daughter as a Hero Soul! A scanner labels him a lowly Wandering Soul, making them a laughingstock. Later, an arrogant prodigy steals his daughter's jade pendant to summon a god. To protect his daughter, he begins unleashing his true past-life powers!

title: True Heiress, Stolen Light
description: Elena Nye, the true heiress of the Nye family, was found after going missing as a child but faced only coldness at home. Fake heiress Natalie Nye stole her boyfriend Caleb Harrington and tricked her into sleeping with a stranger, Adonis Sinclair. Elena later gave birth but, believing her baby had died, fled in heartbreak.

title: Divorced and Back with His Baby Girl
description: After two years of marriage without conceiving, pressured by her mother-in-law, she left with the baby after getting a divorce...

title: Mind-Reading Ultimate Guardian
description: Ava Reed is accused of murdering Lilian Winslow, the precious baby heiress of a billion-dollar family trust. Surrounded by guns, fake evidence, and a flatlining monitor, Ava suddenly hears Lilian’s tiny voice begging for help. From poisonous perfume to forged medical records, fake pregnancy schemes, and trust-fund murder plots, Ava follows the baby’s clues and tears the whole conspiracy apart.

title: Apocalypse: I Have a Super Fortress in Advance
description: Ray gave up everything for his family, only to be betrayed before the zombie apocalypse. Now he hides with his daughter in a doomsday bunker while the elites starve above. But when she is infected, Ray returns to the surface as The Silent Reaper. To save her, he will kill, conquer, and make the wasteland kneel.

title: Mending Hearts
description: After losing her grandma, Mila meets Xavier, a disgraced rich heir who pays for her grandma's funeral. Mila decides to use her special powers to clear his name. Though not blood-related, they form an unbreakable bond. Two broken hearts start to mend.

title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain
description: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.

title: Pregnant and Quit: The CEO is the Baby’s Dad
description:
I didn't expect to have a one-night stand with my billionaire CEO boss on the night before resigning from the company! 
The next morning, fearing consequences, I left anonymously. Unexpectedly, my stepsister assumed my identity, and the CEO mistook her as the one-night stand! 
Worse still, I'm pregnant, and the CEO rejected my resignation as the secretary! What should I do?

title: Daddy's Regret Comes Too Late
description: In her past life, she donated bone marrow to her father, but died full of resentment after being tormented by his family. Reborn right before the marrow match, she gives up on seeking his love and escapes the family. As she skyrockets to fame through her incredible acting, he finally learns the truth and is consumed by regret.

title: Star Prison
description:
Set in an American Western town in the 1960s, kind and resilient waitress Evelyn Hart falls pregnant with the child of ranch heir Colton Sterling after a one-night affair. However, her stepsister falsely claims credit for saving Colton’s life and frames Evelyn, landing her in prison with a wrongful conviction.
Evelyn gives birth to their son Ethan alone behind bars. Six years later, a paternity test uncovers the truth. Learning of the terrible misunderstanding from years past, Colton embarks on a desperate quest to win Evelyn back and atone for his mistakes. He fiercely stands by her side, takes down the villains, and the three finally live happily together as a complete family.

title: Reborn to Raise Two Future Villains
description: Foodie Clara Winslow enters a novel as the lazy guardian of two villains. Caring for the kids to survive, she bonds with them, falls for her nominal hubby, and builds a thriving life.

title: The Veteran’s Promise
description:
"Marine veteran Jack Holt built Ridgeline Farm Supply from nothing — a lifeline for the 200 disabled vets who served beside him. But the one brother he could never repay was Sam Russo, the man who gave his leg to save the entire squad.
Now Sam is gone. And the wife and nine-year-old daughter he left behind stand alone against Derek Malone — a market boss who thinks a grieving widow is his for the taking.
Sam left his little girl only one thing: a phone number, and a promise that whoever answers will come. When Sofia finally dials it… Jack picks up.
Saving them was the easy part. Derek's brother is Connor Malone — the tycoon who owns half of Pittsburgh. Overnight, he tears away every contract Ridgeline has, and brings Jack to his knees.
They stripped him bare. They made him beg. But they forgot one thing:
You do not humiliate a fallen soldier's widow in front of the men who bled for this country.
The reckoning is coming —"

title: Famine, Space, and a Second Life
description: An apocalypse survivor time-travels with a pocket dimension packed with supplies into six-year-old Heidi during a famine. Abandoned by her wealthy family and saved by Matt, the poorest villager, Heidi uses her endless supplies to help him find a wife, grow food, and revive an orange grove. But just as they prosper, her greedy birth father returns to claim her.

title: My Long-Lost Wife Comes Back With A Baby
description: An accident brings together a wealthy heir and a neglected heiress, resulting in an unplanned pregnancy. Six years later, unable to bear her stepmother's oppression, she decides to go on blind dates and unexpectedly reunites with the man who has been searching for her and their child. After their flash marriage, he had to hide his true identity to avoid misunderstandings caused years ago.

title: Destined Twins
description: Vivian Hayes, CEO of Phoenix Group, finally reunites with her long-lost twin sister, Quinn Sinclair, only to find she has endured years of abuse in her marriage. Stepping up to protect her, Vivian helps Quinn divorce her toxic husband and win custody of her daughter. With her sister's support, Quinn finally finds hope for a brighter future.

title: Spoiling My Husband and Twins!
description: Waking up as 24, Evelyn finds herself married to her crush and has twins! But she's only 18! Threats of divorce, family drama, child abuse... She decides to change. Start with the CEO crush!

title: When My Twins Found Their Dad
description: Seven years ago, at a charity banquet, she became his antidote and gave birth to twins. Seven years later, the two kids hacked his computer, drawing the attention of this powerful billionaire. For the sake of the kids, she had to enter into a contractual marriage with him.

title: Single Mother's Counterattack With Adorable Twins
description: Rich heiress Olivia Jones was framed and spent one night with Calvin Murphy, the CEO of a major group, then cast out. Seven years later, she returns as a top healer with brilliant twins. The twins secretly run a "husband hunt" to find their dad — who shows up as a job applicant. But she hates the rich, so Calvin hides his identity and marries her. Her stepsister's schemes keep backfiring, thanks to the twins and her hidden husband. When the truth finally comes out, the four become a happy family.

title: The CEO's Fake Twins
description: Five years after a passionate one-night stand with billionaire James, elite hacker Olivia fled while secretly pregnant. Now, she infiltrates his estate as a staff member alongside her genius boy-girl twins, having them take turns playing one child to conceal their true identities—unaware that James saw through her charade from day one. Caught in high-stakes mind games, simmering tension, and life-or-death threats, the two must join forces to crush their enemies and reclaim the family they were always meant to be.

title: The Twins' Mom is a Heiress
description: While pregnant with the CEO's child, she was framed and pushed down the stairs by her sister and became a vegetable. Five years later, she met the CEO again with her child.

title: Destined Glass Slipper: Twins Matchmaker
description: After being drugged, Cynthia has a one-night stand with a mysterious man and gives birth to twins—only for her stepsister to tell her the babies didn't survive. Five years later, she marries Richard, a poor stable hand, and helps raise his two adorable children. Little does she know: he is secretly the Prince of the Moon Kingdom, and those kids are her own flesh and blood! With his royal identity exposed, her stepsister scheming to seize the throne, and her mother's wrongful conviction still unavenged, can a marriage built on lies ever bloom into true love?

title: The Fraternal Twins
description: Framed by her half-sister, Blair, during childbirth, Aria is cast out by her family. Blair seemingly kills Aria's newborn, Noah, and leaves Aria to burn alive. Surviving the ordeal, Aria discovers she is still carrying a second child. She flees the city, vowing revenge. Five years later, she returns with her child to crush the family business. During a clash with Blair, she crosses paths with the city's top wealthy heir, Vincent Sterling. To prevent him from interfering with her plans, she arranges a fake engagement with him. But once she gets involved with the Sterlings, Aria realizes Vincent's Noah is actually her supposedly dead baby stolen by Blair. Reunited with her lost child and his father, the two kids ultimately help turn their fake marriage into true love.

title: Beast Cubs Matchmake Their Parents
description: Tiger Cat Lyra Dawn meets White Tiger Cassian Frost by fate. Horrified by his true form, Lyra flees, bears twins, sends the white tiger cub to Cassian, and raises the other alone. The twins reunite and try to mend their parents' bond. Cassian's admirer Cleo plots to hurt the cub. When Lyra is outmatched while protecting her child, Cassian saves them. Vengeful Cleo keeps stirring trouble, yet with Cassian's awakened power, Lyra's strength, and the cubs' help, the family overcomes hardships and reunites forever.

title: The Hockey Captain That Hates Me
description:
Plus-size figure skater Skylar Carter hates the arrogant hockey team captain, Mason Reed, with good reason. When Skylar’s prank against the team leaves Mason injured, she’s forced to be his assistant or risk losing her own sports future. 

Forced together, their rivalry turns into undeniable chemistry. But after the school announces only one program will survive to next season, Skylar and Mason may be falling for the one person whose victory could destroy their dreams.

title: A Blessed Pair of Twins: Finding My Daughter
description: Margaret Sullivan's baby was abandoned, leaving only half a jade pendant. Years later, she scavenged to find her child while Oliver Sullivan went to college. Now battling cancer, Margaret attends Oliver Sullivan's wedding. To marry into her family, Oliver Sullivan claimed his mom was abroad and chased her away, unknowingly keeping her medical report. Later, Margaret shares her story. Elena Sinclair recognizes her but faces doubts. Soon, Elena Sinclair's husband William Thorne arrives. Elena Sinclair ruins Lancaster Technologies and leaves with Margaret, leaving Oliver Sullivan kneeling in remorse.

title: The Christmas Twin Miracle
description: After losing her newborn twins on Christmas Day, Beth rebuilds her life—until she meets Ethan, a powerful CEO and single father whose twins claim she’s their mother. A marriage of convenience turns real, but when Ethan’s hidden identity and ex-wife resurface, love is pushed to the breaking point.

title: Chained Wings
description: Archangel Lucien and Draven, Lord of the Fallen Angels, are sworn enemies. On the battlefield, Lucien hesitates to strike the killing blow—and Draven seizes the moment to trap him. He breaks Lucien's white wings, locks him in a meteoric-iron cage, and subjects him to relentless humiliation. When Lucien's subordinate witnesses the degradation, shame consumes him. He feigns unconsciousness and flees—but every move is under Draven's control. Recaptured, Lucien is branded with Draven's name and forced to face his true desires before a mirror. As he cries out Draven's name, his final resistance shatters. Light and darkness collide in the bedchamber of the Dark Realm—where dignity is crushed, and both body and soul remain bound in the abyss.

title: Reins of Desire
description: Amber Ryder, a rugged horse breeder, is forced to sell her most dangerous stallion to billionaire polo heir, Henry Harding to keep her father's ranch afloat. Amber doubts if Henry has the grit to tame this wild stallion, but as they train the difficult horse, they realize the real fight isn't the horse... it's each other. Will these two horse-lovers rein in their desires… or let the flames of passion burn brighter?

title: Blood&Daughters
description: Six years ago, beneath a flowering tree, Sera spent a single night with a man whose face she never saw—and conceived twin girls. Ten months later, her own sisters cut one infant from her womb, threw her off a cliff, and told her the child was dead and the man would never come. Sera survived the fall, awakened the golden phoenix bloodline within her, and alone gave birth to and raised her other daughter, Luna. The man, and all her tenderness, she buried deep in her heart. What she never knew: the daughter torn from her, Nova, was still alive—raised as his own by the very man from that night, Cael, the Dragon Lord of Drakenfall. Cael had been deceived too, told the mother of his child had died in childbirth. For six years he searched for her, and touched no other woman. Six years later, Sera returns with her daughter to take revenge on the family that destroyed her life. Cael conceals his identity as the Dragon Lord and stays at her side as a humble lamplighter—guarding her in silence, never daring to speak a word. And the two daughters, sharing one face and hidden behind masks, recognize each other—and their parents—and one careful step at a time, nudge these estranged lovers back toward one another. When the blade of vengeance finally turns toward Drakenfall, the stolen child appears before them all, and her golden eyes lay bare every lie: the man Sera hated for six years, the man she believed dead, had been standing within arm's reach the whole time. Love and hatred detonate together amid blood and fire—until a family of four stands shoulder to shoulder at last, to reclaim the six years that were stolen from them.

title: ReelTalk EP 48-Flirting, First Kisses, and Fighting
description: It’s back to school for the cast of Taming My Bullies! Meg Bush, Cameron Porras, and Travis Owens face off in a series of games in this High School Challenge episode to see who really rules the school. Plus, they spill stories about flirting on set, first kisses, and even a few fights!

title: The Prodigy's Rebellion
description: Ethan Smith holds the title of the youngest scientist on Earth. However, contrary to expectations, his life is marred by family conflicts and tragedy. After being reborn, he chooses to distance himself from his family and live for himself. This time, Ethan refuses to be weak. He not only proves his brilliance to his family but also to his deskmate, his school, and ultimately, the entire world—showcasing that he is a genius who will not be underestimated.

title: Pregnant with Attitude
description: The heroine marries a man in a coma to cure her grandmother. He wakes up on his wedding night and drives her away. She leaves pregnant and works hard to survive. Afterward, the man is attracted to her and pursues her, not realizing she is his wife. When she is about to give birth, they discover the truth. He realizes his love and supports her through the childbirth.

title: Second Chance, Double Trouble
description: Lorraine discovered she was pregnant and was about to share the good news with Andrew — but instead, Andrew brought his first love, Lucy, home with him. Provoked by Lucy's schemes, the two argued and impulsively divorced. Nine months later, Andrew accidentally found Lorraine's pregnancy report and searched the entire city for her. By then, Lorraine had given birth to twins and was forced to give their firstborn, Chris, to Andrew, then faked her own death to escape. Eight years later, Lorraine returned to the country with her second child, Alex, for work, and reunited with Andrew. With the twins' help, the two gradually noticed the changes in each other — and their prejudice toward one another began to shift…

title: Song of My Mother's Tears
description: Faith searches for her lost family when she learns that she doesn't have long to live. But turns out, they're the people she hates the most!

title: Horror Isekai: Twin Beauties Turn Me On
description: Audric Lane enters an apocalypse overrun by eldritch beings, seeing terrifying apex eldritch and Eldritch Sovereigns as stunning hotties.

title: Do Not Disturb: Chasing My Wife
description: Emilia had loved Grayson for years, but their arranged marriage brought only coldness. Exposed as a fake heiress, she leaves heartbroken, unaware she's pregnant with twins. When Grayson's mother steals her baby boy, their rift deepens. Six years later, Grayson and their son return, desperate to win her back.

title: My Kids' Daddy is a Secret Billionaire
description: Twenty-one-year-old Lisbeth got pregnant after a one-night stand. Desperate for affection, Lisbeth decided to keep the twins and raise them. But the unexpected death of the twins was a constant pain in Lisbeth's heart. Because of her boss's difficulties, Lisbeth decided to quickly find a man to marry. But then she realized that the man she was married to was actually rich? And the Twins did not die.

title: The Cursed Twin: Substitute Bride
description: The Langley family regarded one of their twin girls Adela as a jinx due to the ignorant ancestral teachings of "twin sisters jinxing their father". Adela was almost suffocated at birth and later found as a drug guide and substitute for her twin sister Kelly. Adela was imprisoned and tortured for many years. When attending an appointment for her sister, Adela met Frank, who turned out to be the person she saved as a child. But Frank mistakenly identified Kelly as the savior. After the tragic death of Adela's nanny, Adela completely awakened and reached a deal with Frank to marry him and escape from the Langley family.

title: Darling, Please Come Home
description: As the CEO of a multi-million dollar company, Mrs. Hearth lives a happy life with her 8-year-old twins, Dennis and Stella, and their older sister, Amy. That all changes when her secretary, John, attempts to kidnap Dennis but things go sideways when he mistakenly grabs Stella, Dennis's twin sister. Worried about getting caught, he tries to murder Stella but a Janitor named Michael saves her and adopts her, renaming her Lia. As Lia grows up with Michael as her father, she forgets her previous life of luxury. Ten Years Later, Lia and Dennis are attending the same school where he and his friends bully her relentlessly, not knowing she’s his twin sister. Mrs. Hearth and her family never stop searching for Stella while not knowing Lia, the girl they despise and pick on, is actually Stella. Lia and Michael endure humiliation after humiliation until Lia is eventually expelled. To make matters worse, Michael is diagnosed with leukemia and Lia has to take up a job to make ends meet. Upon discovering Lia is their long lost daughter and sister, Mrs. Hearth and Dennis desperately beg Lia to come back home, showering her with over-the-top gifts, but the damage is done and she wants nothing to do with her old family. While John attempts to thwart them in secret, the Hearth family must redeem themselves and help Lia with her father’s treatment to mend their broken family!

title: His Cruelest Obsession
description: He bought her as a plaything and broke her on purpose. But the man who ruined her life wasn't her boyfriend at all. He was the twin she never knew, hiding behind a stolen face. The truth changes everything.

title: Swapping Fated Mates: The Twin Vixens
description: Reborn on the day their family signs two ruthless marriage contracts, twin red fox shifters Roxy and Lexie Moretti refuse to repeat their ruined past. In their first lives, fierce Roxy was crushed by a violent lion alpha, while gentle Lexie wasted away beside a cold snake heir. This time, they swap fated mates. Roxy storms into Cedric Hylian’s gothic empire and turns his icy restraint into obsession, while Lexie softens Arthur Walker’s savage pride. But old rivals, corporate conspiracies, and black-market attacks threaten their second chance. To survive, the sisters must outwit two predator clans and claim love on their own terms.

title: Marry The Wrong Bride
description: Bianca Anderson has been contracted by her father to marry Angelo de Rossi, the heir to the Rossi multimillion company since she was just a child. But growing up to be an independent woman, she finds it off to marry a man she has never seen before. She tricks her twin sister, CAMILLA Anderson, into taking her place a few days before the wedding. On the wedding day, Bianca is shocked to see a very handsome man at the end of the aisle. Desperately, she asks Camilla to call off the pretense, but it's already too late. Her twin sister is already very attracted to Angelo. Bianca is so pained that she moves into the mansion with CAMILLA and Angelo under the guise of being uninterested in the marriage. She has one goal on her mind, to take back Angelo. A couple of weeks later, a popular blog surfaced with DNA test results claiming that CAMILLA had a child and abandoned him while she was a teenager. The evidence is damning and she is unable to defend herself. Angelo is disappointed and following an advice from his best friend, Leo, he seeks solace in Bianca’s arms. He gets close to her and finally, Bianca lures him to bed. Being a decent man, he fixes a date for their wedding.
