Not long after, Camilla finds out that it was her sister, Bianca, behind all the plotting after all. She is furious at her betrayal and goes all out for revenge, putting everyone on the edge. How far would she go in her quest for love and vengeance?

title: Distant Blood Love
description: 18 years ago, the Knox matriarch drained Isabella Knox's Rh-negative blood to save Theodore Knox and abandoned her. Kenneth Hayes, a man with the same rare blood type, saved and raised her as Bella Hayes. 18 years later, Bella starts working at Knox Group...

title: Marriage Masquerade
description: A promise made in their youth has haunted both Lewis and Yasmin for years. Yet they never realize that the "white moonlight" they've been desperately searching for is none other than their own arranged fiancé / fiancée. Determined to find each other, they try every possible scheme to break off their engagement—never suspecting that the person they fake-married just to escape the arrangement… is the very white moonlight they've been longing for all along.

title: Flash Marriage to My Comatose Wife
description:
Fresh graduate Elliot is crushed under a mountain of overwhelming medical debt after his parents fall seriously ill. When he hits rock bottom, a mysterious elderly woman offers him a million-dollar reward on one condition: Elliot must marry a nearly forty-year-old vegetative woman and work as her psychological caregiver.
Elliot thinks his life is doomed—until he discovers his vegetative wife Elowen is breathtakingly beautiful and the sole heir to the Hastings family fortune.
Fleet upon fleet of luxury cars, an estate spanning tens of thousands of square feet, private jets and yachts… Elliot soon realizes the comatose woman he hastily married is a billionaire tycoon worth hundreds of billions.
As Elliot continues his care and therapy, Elowen finally regains consciousness. She comes face-to-face with the man who pulled her back from the grip of illness.

title: A Marriage Mishap Gone Right
description: After her grandfather's death, she unexpectedly discovers that both her sister and boyfriend betrayed her, taking away the family fortune left by her grandfather. Determined to seek revenge, she decides to get married, only to realize that she married the wrong person. She immediately files for divorce, but her husband disagrees...

title: My Marriage with the God of Death
description: When Naomi accidentally summons Thanatos, the God of Death, a desperate kiss awakens his heart after ten thousand years. Revealed as his destined Bride of Death, Naomi is the only one who can break his curse, while the immortal reaper discovers that even a god can fall in love.

title: Marriage on Paper, Fire in Heart
description: After Tessa's parents passed away, she lived with her sister. To avoid burdening her sister, she agreed to a blind date with George, the grandson of Madam Vale, whom she had accidentally saved. At their first meeting, George misunderstood Tessa as a gold digger, so he hid his identity as the richest man and the CEO of Vale Group. After marriage, George gradually changed his mind and fell in love. Later, a rival lady from a rich family showed up and tried to steal George. George realized his feelings and pursued Tessa, while Tessa also fell for him. This contract marriage became a true love story.

title: Wrong Marriage, Fated Groom
description: Emily's fiance Henry breaks up with her on their wedding day. Pushed by her toxic best friend, Fiona, she agrees to enter a fake marriage with another man, but mistakes William, her mysterious billionaire CEO, for the man she's supposed to marry. After the wedding, William finds out that Emily is one of his employees, while Emily mistakenly believes that William is drowning in debt. William hides his identity till the day of the design competition when Fiona and Henry plot to sabotage Emily.

title: Flash Marriage Sweet Love
description: To save her late grandmother's bakery, Lila marries a stranger named Silas in a paper-only deal—both hiding secrets. He carries her flour, stands by her side, but never reveals who he really is. Until the dessert gala, when a rival frames her in front of the entire city. Silas steps onto the stage, and the room goes silent: he's Sinclair—the most powerful man in the city. A contract marriage, a twenty-year fate sealed by a lemon tart.

title: My Flash Marriage Wife Is A Business Genius
description: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her sister, she broke up with him ruthlessly. Then, she married the CEO of a major business empire. But that's not all, she's also a business whiz. She started her own company, making big stars. The CEO is always worried about her leaving him!

title: My Deadly Marriage with Ms. CEO
description:
Forced into a cold political marriage, a wealthy heiress has a reckless one-night encounter with a hidden elite.
A fake marriage forged by danger pulls them into a bloody battle among top families.
Conspiracies, framing and brutal hunts unfold.
The retired powerhouse strikes back, crushes the evil tycoon, and wins the heiress’s heart at last.

title: My Flash Marriage Husband is a Movie Star
description: I was a fallen heiress, struggling with life. I met him in an elevator, and the paparazzi made it a great rumor, causing a big problem. To revenge me, he bought the only house property my dad left me! To deal with the rumors, we decided to flash marry. After our contract marriage, we gradually fell for each other, and he decided to return the house to me. However, more challenges are to be faced…

title: Flash Marriage After One-night Stand
description: Stella is deceived by her fiancé and sister and ends up in someone else's bed. Fortunately, she meets Kevin, the CEO of Galkin Group, but she thinks he’s a gigolo. To save her company, Stella has a flash marriage with him. She’s afraid of encountering troubles, but actually she meets her true love.

title: The Fake Marriage Got Too Real
description: A 3-month trial marriage turns into forever! Billionaire heiress Sophie hides her true talents from her cold fiancé, Alex Prescott. By day, she uses hacking and medical skills to save him; by night, she's the woman of his dreams. When Alex realizes his fiancée is actually his childhood crush, Lola, the contract burns away in this super sweet romance!

title: Flash-Married and Utterly Spoiled
description: Her fiancé is snatched by her sister, then she flash-marries a trillionaire and gets showered with love!

title: My Arranged Marriage to the Beast King
description: In her previous life, Clarice was married to the leader of the Wolf Clan and became the Queen Mother. Her stepsister, Bella, out of jealousy, burned her alive. Clarice is reborn alongside Bella, who beats her to the punch and marries the Wolf Clan leader this time around. Clarice is instead forced to marry the despised and lowly Serpent Clan leader. But what Bella didn't know was that she can't get luxury and glory by stealing other's successes. Clarice finds out that her lowly husband is actually the King of All Beasts!

title: Secret Marriage Swap, The War God’s Late Remorse
description: Titaness Cassandra accidentally discovers that Perseus, her fiancé of five years, has long been head over heels for her stepsister and would even sacrifice her life to keep the girl safe. She calmly agrees to swap marriages and takes Leah’s place to wed Abel, the cursed son of Hades. On their wedding day, Perseus finds his bride has been switched, yet he feels no joy. All his past fondness was merely gratitude for who he thought saved him as a child—only he got the wrong person. He has actually fallen for Cassandra over the years, but by the time he realizes it, she is already married to another.what fate awaits them both?

title: Unexpected Knot: Married to a Billionaire Nurse
description: After learning that her boyfriend is cheating on her and is only after her fortune, Madeline decides to break up with him and accidentally gets married to Caden, a male nurse. She thought both of them were just hard-working poor people, but she gradually realized that her husband seemed to have hidden wealth and power.Caden Wilson Cashmore, the mysterious CEO of the group, became a male nurse volunteer in order to fulfill his brother's last wish. He's been searching for the recipient of his brother's heart, and could that person be the wife he married on the spur of the moment?

title: Married Ex-Fiancé's Uncle
description: On her big day, she caught her fiancé with her best friend in bed. Furious, she married a random guy on the spot. But guess what? this "nobody" was her ex's uncle—and the richest man alive!

title: Sweet Temptation
description: Based on the novel by bestselling author Cora Reilly. 21 year old Giulia Rizzo suddenly finds herself engaged to the ruthless crimelord Cassio Moretti against her will. Rumor has it he's responsible for the bloody, untimely death of his wife, whom Giulia is not only replacing as a wife, but as the mother of their two young children. Will rebellious Giulia manage to make a life for herself alongside Cassio, or will his refusal to let her into his heart create yet another broken marriage?

title: Nothing Escapes My Eyes
description: Liam is a delivery driver cuckolded by his gold-digging girlfriend. One day, he gets hit by a car belonging to Ivy, a gorgeous CEO. From the accident, he gains the superpower of "God's Sight', allowing him to see how much time is left in people’s lives, as well as the true value of things.

title: My Flash Marriage Husband Is A CEO
description: After discovering my cousin was pregnant with my husband's child, I divorced him. On the night of the divorce, I found a cowboy. Little did I know, this cowboy was actually a billionaire, and he insisted on marrying me!

title: The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife
description: On her wedding day, a fire breaks out, and Chloe's fiancé, Kevin, abandons her to save his stepsister, Rachel, leaving her in danger. Leo rushes into the flames to rescue her. To reclaim her mother’s inheritance, Chloe impulsively marries Leo, unaware that he’s actually a billionaire CEO. As time passes, Leo begins to fall for Chloe ultimately becoming utterly devoted to her.

title: A Fated Encounter
description: Emma is forced to marry in place of her half sister in order to get her dad to continue paying her mom's medical bills. Everyone thought she was marrying an old, ugly, rich man, but it turns out to be the handsome Tommy, black sheep of the Anderson family. Tommy develops a soft spot for Emma, secretly supporting her career and protecting her when she needs it. But when the truth comes out about why Tommy agreed to marry Emma in the first place, will Emma choose her pride, or financial stability for her mom's hospital bills?

title: My Powerful Caretaker
description: Roman Hawthorne, heir to a hidden dynasty, is forced into a marriage with Diana Stratton, a ruthless CEO who despises men. To avoid a blind marriage, he becomes her nanny undercover. Can he break through her walls and heal her wounded heart?

title: Flash Marriage with a Billionaire
description: Forced into marriage by her family, she flash-married a beggar she found on the street, only to discover he was a wealthy CEO who had lost his memory in a plane crash. Under her care, his memories returned, and the secrets behind the crash were revealed!

title: The Marriage Contract
description: Philippe Bastien is the heir to one of the wealthiest conglomerates owned by Émile Bastien in Paris. He is used to having the world at his feet and people at his beck and call. Unknown to him, the source of his family's wealth is deeply tied to a society and to a clause that guides its members. It’s stated that as the heir, Philippe would have to marry one of the daughters of his father's business partners and fellow society members, in order to renew their partnership and in turn, preserve their wealth. Ava Dubois, the only daughter of an equally wealthy French businessman, Martin Dubois has always hated the life she was born into. The dislike for excesses, party lifestyle, and intrusion from the paparazzi has made her become a low-key person. She avoids anything that would bring her back to the spotlight so imagine her surprise when she's summoned to fulfill the marriage contract. Ava is irritated by Philippe's image and rich playboy persona but is obligated to marry him to please her father. When Philippe, who never goes for plain-looking ladies, meets Ava, he is taken aback by her simple appearance and wonders how she could be from such a family. Their personalities clash and it becomes clear that their marriage would be anything but rosy except they find a way out or magically fall in love with each other...

title: My Homeless Bride Is a Culinary Legend
description:
After claiming her fifth World Culinary Championship, the legendary Chef Sage goes undercover as a homeless beggar to find a partner with genuine character. Ignored by the masses and ruthlessly mocked by her ex, she encounters Jasper, a kind-hearted man who offers her his food. Desperate to save his family's failing restaurant from a vicious corporate takeover, Jasper hires Sage to play his wealthy fake fiancée.
As rival factions push the Vance family to the brink with a high-stakes "Culinary Death Match," all hope seems lost. But when cornered, the beggar bride sheds her disguise. With a flash of her blade and her signature blue flame, she turns the tables against world-class chefs, exposing her true identity and sparking a legendary romance.

title: Paper Marriage, Real Pregnancy
description: Orphaned young and sold to a remote village, Lorris Seth is forced to marry Derek. On their wedding night, she escapes under duress and has a passionate encounter with Luke Garrison. Unable to find her afterward, Luke searches in vain, while Lorris discovers she's pregnant. To survive, she sells lunchboxes at Garrison Group's construction site. When Derek finds her, Luke appears and unexpectedly proposes a fake marriage.

title: The Deceitful Marriage
description: On a snowy night in Northhaven, Sarah is abandoned by her first love, Sean, and reluctantly marries Simon, who has secretly loved her for over a decade. After four years of a cold marriage, with her ex returning, family pressure, and rumors swirling, Sarah discovers the truth: Simon's love for her was always real, and their marriage was his deep, unwavering devotion. As the truth comes to light, she runs into his arms, saying, "For the rest of my life, please guide me."

title: CEO: My Flash Marriage Husband
description:
I married the brother of the man I had always loved, not only to get my mind off of him but to prove to him that I could still get along without him! 
I thought I could win his heart someday, but all I got was the news that he was engaged to someone else. And it was only when I was about to get married to his brother that he realized how precious I was. At my wedding, I looked at the man I once loved with mixed emotions. 
"You didn't want it when I was with you, but you preferred to grab it, isn't that bitchy?"
Moreover, his brother who I flash-married turned out to be a billionaire CEO! How surprising...

title: Repaying a Favor with Marriage
description: The Montgomery daughter, Caroline Montgomery, is reborn to destroy her scumbag ex-husband and reclaim the Montgomery Group. Along the way, she crosses paths with Elias Kensington, CEO of Kensington Group, and an accidental encounter blossoms into true love. In her past life, Miles Prescott abandoned her on their wedding day to cheat with her two-faced sweetheart stepsister, Elena Montgomery. Tormented by them, her father Arthur Montgomery, and stepmother Evelyn Montgomery, a pregnant Caroline lost everything. They stole her fortune and used her Grandpa, Charles Lancaster, to force her to drink poison. Awakening on her wedding day, Caroline vows revenge. She forces her ex's nemesis, Elias Kensington, to marry her instead. What begins as a calculated plot turns into genuine romance, and the couple overcomes countless obstacles as Caroline takes back everything that is rightfully hers.

title: 100-Day Contract：Mafia’s Dangerous Desire
description: To save her daughter, Harper Reed marries Klaus Wolfe—New York's most feared mafia godfather—in her stepsister's place. On the wedding day, he sees right through her and calls her a gold digger. He gives her one choice: jump into a shark pool, or watch her whole family die. Then she jumps without hesitation. That shatters his frozen heart. But she finds out that—this marriage is way worse than death. Lydia deeply hates her. Uncle Richard wants the Don's chair. And "Black Fox" is dragging everyone to hell...

title: Flight Changed, Marriage Ended
description: Celia meticulously planned a family trip, only to have her husband Vince cancel her ticket at the last minute so his childhood friend Dana could join them. Realizing her years of unappreciated efforts, Celia embarks on a journey of revenge and self-discovery...

title: My Contract Wife is Actually a Fashion Genius
description: Talented designer Sophie is forced to endure humiliation when her best friend Vivian publicly strips off her wedding dress at a church wedding in order to save her grandmother. Naked and devastated, Sophie walks out of the church and unexpectedly collides with the cold, domineering CEO Alex, entering into a one-year contract marriage as his stand-in wife. Faced with the traps of a wealthy family and schemes from rivals, the two gradually fall in love. In the end, Alex discovers that Sophie is not only the mysterious benefactor who once saved his life, but also the brilliant fashion designer he has been desperately searching for all along.

title: Rise of a Tycoon
description: Betrayed by his fiancée, a poor farmer storms into Steelhaven to uncover the truth. After saving a tycoon’s daughter and facing humiliation, he vows to start over. With nothing but courage, he rises from a laborer to a billionaire legend.

title: Married to the Devil
description:
Married To The Devil is an original short-form drama that blends modern fantasy, dark romance, and a story of destiny and redemption.
The story follows Angela, a young woman whose life is shattered by betrayal, suffering, and forces beyond her control. At the darkest point of her journey, she encounters Lucifer — a mysterious and powerful man who carries the loneliness of eternity and possesses a hidden identity that will change everything.
As their fates become intertwined, Angela discovers that Lucifer is not an ordinary human, but the ruler of Hell. Caught between Heaven, humanity, and his own destiny, Lucifer must choose between the overwhelming power he possesses and the love that has awakened something within him. Meanwhile, Angela transforms from someone defined by her pain into a woman who finds her own strength and chooses her own destiny.
Centered around the forbidden love between a demon and a human, Married To The Devil explores themes of identity, sacrifice, redemption, and the power of choice through dramatic revelations, emotional conflicts, and supernatural challenges.
With a gothic visual aesthetic, a modern fantasy mythology, and an intense emotional core, the series reimagines the legend of the Devil — revealing that the greatest power is not the ability to destroy the world, but the courage to change for someone you love.

title: Married to the Demon King, the Sun God Begs for My Return
description:
On the eve of her wedding, Alicia, the Saintess of Order, is secretly drugged by her elder sister
Lina and catches her fiancé, the Sun God Apollo, in an affair with Lina. The two turn the
accusation against Alicia, framing her for an illicit relationship with a guard. Humiliated before
the gods, Alicia has her engagement annulled and her divinity stripped away before being cast
into the Abyss as a sacrifice.
At the brink of death, the dormant royal blood of Lilith awakens within her, transforming her into
a succubus. She falls into a cavern where Lucifer, the Demon King, has been sealed for a
thousand years. Through an unexpected twist of fate, Alicia forms a soul-seal bond with him and
breaks his ancient imprisonment.
When Alicia awakens, she is no longer the obedient and innocent saintess others once
controlled, but a reborn queen empowered by seductive royal blood and a burning desire for
revenge. She strikes a bargain with Lucifer and follows him to the Demon Palace, where she is
scorned and challenged by its maids and the elders of the Abyss. Faced with humiliation and
attack, Alicia reveals the ancestral mark of Lilith’s royal blood. Its overwhelming power forces
the nobles of the Abyss to kneel before her.
From that moment on, Alicia joins forces with Lucifer to wage war against the Divine Court,
expose the hypocrisy of Lina and Apollo, and make everyone who betrayed her pay the ultimate
price.

title: Married in a Flash to the Healing Fairy
description: Her father's mistress and her daughter stole Christina's engagement to the Lu family, then sent her away to a remote village. There, she met a mysterious old man—who turned out to be the legendary Wuji Healer. Years later, the crippled fiancé is dying, and the family wants his billion-dollar bride price. So they drag Christina back... to take her sister's place and marry a broken man.

title: Married My High School Nemesis
description: Wealthy, snarky investor Nathan Pierce and sassy, money-loving designer Harper Vance suddenly tie the knot. The two have been bitter rivals since high school. After their sudden shotgun wedding, they bicker and butt heads nonstop in the workplace, neither willing to back down. Harper believes their marriage is nothing but a random twist of fate, never knowing Nathan has been plotting to win her over all along.

title: Married a Delivery Guy
description: My brother wanted revenge for his adopted sister. On the dating reality show I was filming, he shoved a random food delivery guy onto the stage, and turned my life into a spectacle. Under the spotlight, his Uber Eats uniform was ridiculously out of place. The audience erupted in laughter. "What's this delivery guy doing up there?" "Oh my god! The Williams heiress is going to marry a delivery guy?" I stood frozen. My brother strode up, wrapped his arm around me, and whispered, "Emily, last time you gave Sophie food poisoning and she had to have her stomach pumped. She's still holding a grudge. I had no choice but to let you make a bit of a fool of yourself to make her feel better. "She's young. Just indulge her a little." "Don't worry, it's just for show." "There's no way the family would actually let you marry a delivery guy."…

title: Married to a Fisherman, But He Is Poseidon
description:
Betrayed and killed by her jealous sister, noble Aloryn is reborn. She casts a silver token into the sea to choose her husband, and Poseidon, disguised as a fisherman, claims it.
Despite mockery, Aloryn marries him. Her sister and the arrogant prince torment her, forcing her to walk over burning embers. Enraged, Poseidon reveals his divine identity and punishes the villains.
Poseidon’s mother Rhea subjects Aloryn to cruel trials. Through kindness and self‑sacrifice, Aloryn gains Rhea’s approval. She becomes Queen of the Seven Seas, bound to Poseidon forever.

title: Married to the Vagabond King
description:
King Damon, weary of the constraints of court life, disguises himself as a vagabond and travels alone to the Northern Territories to observe the lives of his people. He collapses from a high fever along the way and is nursed back to health by Elena, an apprentice at a small‑town apothecary, with bread and medicinal pills.
Meanwhile, Elena catches her fiancé Caleb having an affair with her cousin Mira and is publicly jilted. To fulfill the dying wish of her gravely‑ill grandmother, Elena enters a rushed contract marriage with Damon, whom she has known for only two days, and the two pretend to be a loving couple.

title: Married My Boss by Accident
description: Zoe works to pay for her father's prosthetic surgery until a party mishap humiliates Hall Group CEO Jeremiah. A chance encounter at a bar leads to one reckless night, and soon she becomes his secretary. Facing workplace sabotage and an unexpected pregnancy, Jeremiah proposes. What begins as a convenient marriage slowly turns into true love as they navigate corporate schemes and life's challenges together.

title: Married The Richest Man After Being Dumped
description: Cassie finds out that her sister Lisa is having an affair with her richest boyfriend, Eric. But instead of feeling ashamed, Lisa says Cassie and her mother Helen are a drag because they were born poor. The injured mother nearly died of a heart attack. In order to get back at her sister and her ex-boyfriend, Cassie decides to marry the richest man, Johnny Brisson, and becomes her sister's mother-in-law and her ex's stepmother.

title: Married to My Brother’s Ex
description: After the mysterious passing of his father, Gabriel Ortega, the sole heir to the multi-million dollar Ortega fortune and estate, has become a shadow of himself, distant and reclusive. The only person who has been able to get through to him is Mary, their young family help. In a bid to snap him out of his befogged state, his overbearing stepmother, Catherina Ortega decides to impose a beautiful young woman, Estelle Castor, on him, in his hopes that they would hit things off and eventually marry, so Gabriel will assume his father's fortune, as was stipulated in the will. Catherine’s intentions are not as pure as they seem. She intends to use Estelle as a pawn to covet Gabriel's inheritance and keep it for her and her complacent son Jonas Ortega, while still leaving a cut for Estelle. Things go awry when Gabriel begins to show little to no interest in Estelle. He refuses to touch or even speak with her, even though his stepmother insists they sleep on the same bed. Gabriel finds himself growing fonder of their help, Mary. He finds a connection with her like none other, but his stepmother would never approve of their union. Estelle noticing things were spinning out of her favor decides to connive with Catherina to fake a pregnancy. Catherine drugs Gabriel without his notice and he ends up in bed with Estelle. With the baby in view, Gabriel is forced to do the right thing and wed Estelle, while still harboring strong emotions for Mary who increasingly gets maltreated by his stepmother...

title: Married to the Dead King,l Became Empress
description: On her wedding day, common-born healer Mara is abandoned by the prince she loves and forced to become the Death Bride of Ronan, the supposedly dead King of Vargan. Buried alive beside him, she discovers the impossible—the dead king is still alive. Betrayed by their own kingdoms, Mara and Ronan rise from the grave as allies. Through love, conspiracy, and a brutal fight for power, a rejected bride begins her journey to become Empress.

title: My Sister Ran, So I Married the Don
description:
Isabella saved a mob boss's grandmother. Her sister stole the credit.

When the Moretti family demands the real hero's hand in marriage, Isabella's own fiancé abandons her for her sister — leaving Isabella to marry the man they call The Butcher.

They say he's a monster. They're wrong.

Now her ex won't let go, her sister won't stop scheming, and the most feared man in the city has only one soft spot: her.

title: Married Fast, I’m a Secret Healer!
description: A legendary healer hides her identity and marries into the Gu family to study secret medicine, while the Gu family’s CEO is desperately searching for a healer to cure his son’s mysterious illness. By chance, they enter into a marriage contract—will love blossom between them?

title: Married to the Enemy
description: Sean Carter gave up his powerful family name to live as an ordinary DoD civilian analyst, hoping his wife Morgan Hayes loved him for who he was. But when he caught Evan Brooks assaulting her, Morgan protected Evan’s military future by giving false testimony and sending Sean into three years of punishment in Alaska. The day Sean returns, Morgan brings him straight to her wedding with Evan, humiliating him in front of everyone who thinks he is powerless. But Sean has one secret left: he is the son of General William Carter. When the truth comes out, Morgan and Evan finally learn that the man they destroyed is the one who can bring them down.

title: I Married the Rival My Ex Couldn’t Beat
description: Humiliated when her fiancé Arthur stole another man's bride, Vivian married that very man—Sebastian, a rumored playboy. What began as revenge became real when she discovered Sebastian had secretly loved her since childhood. As Vivian fell for him, Arthur unraveled, begging for a second chance. But she had already found the devotion he never gave her.

title: I Married the Groom's Uncle
description: On her wedding day, Jagger Hamilton abandons Avery for his adopted sister Tatum. Jagger's uncle Beckett, Manhattan's feared "Ice Blade," marries her instead. Three years later, Avery carries Beckett's long-awaited child, but Jagger and Tatum return and brutally kill the baby. Beckett exacts brutal revenge, crippling and disowning them. Years later, Avery and Beckett welcome a healthy son, while a ruined, disabled Jagger—rejected by the family—takes his own life.

title: I Married My Cheating Ex’s Uncle
description: Disgraced tech heiress Aria publicly flirts with Victor, the city’s most powerful tycoon, at her own engagement party in a bid to reclaim her father’s AI technology and get revenge. She believes she is merely using his power, unaware that she is the very prey he has secretly pined for for eight years.When a mole’s scheme sparks a crisis of trust, Victor takes the fall to protect her. In the end, Aria uncovers the full truth, and the two join forces to take down their enemies, finally coming together in a true two-way rush of love.

title: My CEO Mom Married a Security Guard
description: Five years ago, Samantha was set up and unexpectedly met Landon, a retired Ultimate Soldier, and they had a daughter, Sabrina. Five years later, to escape a forced marriage by the Jiang family, Samantha took Sabrina to find her father, and the two quickly married. Landon went undercover as a security guard but repeatedly intervened during crises at Shen Group and as the Jiang family conspired with the Blackstone Society, revealing his true strength. In the end, he exposed the Qin family's crimes, avenged his sister, reclaimed his identity as the Dragon Lord, and protected his wife, daughter, and Shen Group.

title: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love
description: Simon Williams has one shot of saving his baby brother, find him the perfect bone marrow match. Fate would have it, there's only but one perfect match, Leslie Maddison! In return for Leslie's donation, Simon must marry her so she can stay in the United States. Leslie needs a green card, and Simon needs her bone marrow. But what happens when Leslie finds out... Simon is actually the heir to a multi-billion dollar company and not the average joe who he makes himself out to be?

title: I Athena Married the Demon of Sparta
description: Athena, Olympian goddess of wisdom and war, is exiled to the mortal world and reborn as Althea, the illegitimate daughter of an Athenian noble. She is forced into a proxy marriage to Charis, the notorious cruel young lord of Sparta. On their wedding day, she seizes the upper hand with her wit, only to discover that Charis is actually biding his time. The two join forces to foil the power-grabbing plot hatched by his elder brother and sister-in-law, and fend off repeated provocations from their divine foe Aphrodite. In the end, Athena abandons her immortality for love, spending her remaining mortal life with Charis until old age.

title: Goodbye, I’m Getting Married
description: She gave him everything as his secret lover. He never saw her. The moment she witnessed him get down on one knee for someone else, her heart shattered. She walked away and married a stranger. Only then did he realize what he'd lost—but she was already gone.

title: I Married the Story's Villain
description: After waking up inside a novel, Gigi is forced to marry the infamous villain, Iain Lane. An accidental kiss binds them, then he can hear her thoughts and feel her pain. Staying for opportunity, she builds her own business while helping Iain confront his wounds and reclaim his company from scheming relatives. Fighting side by side, they rewrite the story, and the villain finds his happy ending.

title: I Got Married Without You
description: Rosalyn gave her heart blindly to Andrew Kingston for three whole years, just to have him abandon her like she was nothing. At her wedding with someone else, he shows up to tell her that...she was everything to him all along?

title: I Married a Nobody, Now He Owns the City
description: Betrayed and ruined after a scandalous night with a stranger, Lena is thrown out into a storm—only to return six years later as a ruthless billionaire CEO. To secure her mother's stolen empire and comfort her senile grandmother, she hires a rugged "construction worker" as her $100,000-a-month intern husband. Little does she know, her fake spouse isn't a broke laborer, but the country's most elusive defense tycoon—the mysterious stranger from that fateful night. And he’s spent six years turning the world upside down to find her.

title: The Enemy I Married
description: Ivy Stone, the daughter of the Duke, commits suicide in front of Austin Grayson, the man suspected of killing her father and her whole family. Given a second chance, Ivy's reborn as Maid Tyler. When she realizes her brothers are still alive, they have become rebellious. To protect her brothers and restore her family, Ivy reveals her identity to discipline them. However, she is forced to marry Austin by the imperial decree. Will this marriage help her find the truth or lead her to death?

title: One Wrong Toss, I Married the Richest Man
description: Betrayed by her stepsister Sera and fiancé Henri, Elara is pushed off a cliff on her wedding day. She drags Sera down with her—and both are reborn. On the eve of the Flower-Bond Ceremony, Elara tosses her bouquet. Sera shoves her; the bouquet lands among commoners, caught by a disguised man—Cassian, CEO of the British East India Company, hiding from an arranged marriage. Mocked for marrying a “penniless commoner,” Elara fiercely defends him. He falls for her on the spot. Meanwhile, his mother learns the truth and heads for the venue.

title: My Fiancée Carried My Brother's Child — I Married Another
description: Elliot and his fiancée Betty were getting married. But Betty cheated on him and carried his brother's baby. Elliot felt very frustrated. But Betty still wanted to marry him and take away his house. Elliot rejected her and chose to marry a rich heiress, Amelia. Betty thought she got a successful career on her own. Actually, it was all Elliot's credit. In the end, Betty regretted it and tried to win Elliot back, but it was too late. Elliot was in love with Amelia...

title: Flash-Married and Utterly Spoiled
description: Her fiancé is snatched by her sister, then she flash-marries a trillionaire and gets showered with love!

title: My Fiancée Carried My Brother's Child — I Married Another
description: Elliot and his fiancée Betty were getting married. But Betty cheated on him and carried his brother's baby. Elliot felt very frustrated. But Betty still wanted to marry him and take away his house. Elliot rejected her and chose to marry a rich heiress, Amelia. Betty thought she got a successful career on her own. Actually, it was all Elliot's credit. In the end, Betty regretted it and tried to win Elliot back, but it was too late. Elliot was in love with Amelia...

title: The 100-Day Bride I Married Is A Legend
description: In the countryside, Sarah Peay discovers the gravely injured Ted Vaughn and performs life-saving surgery on him. Due to his weakened state, Ted never clearly sees Sarah's face. Unexpectedly, Sarah enters a 100-day marriage with Ted as part of a contract arranged by her grandfather, embarking on a transformative journey as his wife.

title: Flash-Married to My Rightful Fiancé
description: A young woman saved a billionaire's grandfather, and they ended up getting married as arranged by the old man. However, when her bestie discovered the woman was a missing heiress, she plotted to steal her identity...

title: The CEO Married the Wrong Woman
description:
"His family picked him up from the hospital in a helicopter!"
I've been in love with my handsome boyfriend for years, but he tragically had an accident and then disappeared!
My parents opposed us being together because he was poor, forcing me to marry a wealthy old man. They even told me I wasn't their birth daughter. In despair, my boyfriend was my solace, but a sudden accident tore us apart! Many clues suggest that my boyfriend's true identity might be significant. Now, I've also discovered that I'm pregnant. Should I keep this child?

title: Wedding Night, Slept With Another Man
description: On the wedding night, she was forcefully kissed by a stranger at the hospital. The next day, she discovered that the stranger was actually her husband. What's more surprising, her husband didn't recognize her and wanted a divorce.

title: Love, Lies, and a Wedding Surprise
description: Struggling under family poverty, she was compelled to wed a man she loathed. Her desperate solution? Secretly enlisting a mob boss to stage her "kidnapping" during the wedding. The twist? After exchanging vows, her contractually-bound husband developed profound feelings for her – an awakening of the heart he hadn't yet acknowledged, even in his private thoughts.

title: A Very Country Wedding
description: Country superstar Zane and Jeannette’s wedding is interrupted, sending them on a journey back to each other. Meanwhile, Jolene confronts her past, and Quinn and Nanna Suze share a lesson that may lead to a perfect wedding—if it happens.

title: My Sister Dies at Her Wedding Every Day
description:
ER nurse Emma returns home for her younger sister Sophie’s lavish wedding, only to discover a terrifying truth: every night at 11:54 p.m., Sophie is thrust into a deadly crisis—and whenever Emma dies trying to save her, she wakes up again at 8:07 the same morning.
Trapped in an endless time loop, Emma uses each reset to search for the killer and uncover the truth. But the deeper she digs, the more she realizes that Sophie’s death is tied to a medical secret buried twelve years ago—and a dark conspiracy hidden within their own family.
Even crueler is what happens between Emma and Noah. She remembers every moment they shared, every promise, and every time they fell in love. But with each reset, Noah forgets her completely.
And somehow, every single time, he chooses to trust her—and fall for her all over again.

title: My Mother-in-Law Forced Me to Transfer the Deed on My Wedding Day
description: On 28-year-old Natalie Carter and 30-year-old Bradley Lawson's wedding day, mother-in-law Martha Dawson demands Natalie transfer the deed of her dowry house to her brother-in-law. Martha uses Natalie's pregnancy to blackmail her, while Bradley urges her to be the bigger person. Pretending to agree, Natalie strikes back by calling off the wedding. Furious, the Lawson family causes a scene at her neighborhood and the company, spreading malicious rumors. Natalie calmly fights back, recording evidence and calling the cops. After her brother-in-law is jailed for attempting to seize the house, Bradley and Martha try to force her to drop the charges. However, their threats are caught on a security camera, leading to their arrest. Ultimately, Natalie reveals her pregnancy was a misdiagnosis. The Lawson family gets what they deserve, leaving Natalie free from the toxic family to start a brand-new life.

title: My Father Outside the Spotlight
description: On her wedding day, Ava discovers the truth: her father has been pushed to the back of the room while a rich girl’s dog gets a seat at the main table. One public humiliation exposes her fiancé’s family for who they really are. So Ava walks away from the perfect wedding and chooses the man who gave her everything, building a future where her father finally stands in the light.

title: Spurned Bride, His Indispensable CEO
description: On her wedding day, Mira's fiancé Dante lets his childhood friend Alessia wear a white dress, kiss him, and drink champagne with him—all livestreamed. Mira reveals she's ending both the engagement and all business ties with the Romano family. Flashbacks show years of Dante choosing Alessia over Mira. After the wedding falls apart, Mira rebuilds her career, launching a successful brand. Dante begs for forgiveness, but Mira refuses. Later, Dante and Alessia's relationship fractures. Mira moves on, stronger and independent.

title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire
description: Archer is nowhere to be seen on his wedding with Alice—rumor has it he died in an explosion during a firefighting mission. Alice’s greedy parents try to marry her off to a sleazy suitor, Philip. At the new wedding, Alice finally sees her husband again—but he’s now engaged to someone else.

title: After Reading My Mind
description: A mystic master reincarnates as a young general's wife. He wants to divorce her—but she foresees his death in battle and his family's ruin. Worse, they all overhear her inner voice. Now they spoil her rotten, she reads fate and rewrites it, and the once-cold general begs her to stay with all he has.

title: Anti-Simp System: Loved by the Heiress
description: After courting Kira Lawson for seven years, Eli Bennett becomes a laughingstock on their wedding day when her first love, Trent, steals her away. In despair, Eli awakens the Anti-Simp System, which rewards him for not being a pushover. He immediately cancels the wedding and has a flash marriage with Nina Quinn, who is disguised as a cleaner. Little does he know, she's a billionaire heiress!

title: The Villainess’s Fifth Life
description: Duke’s daughter Violet has died four brutal deaths—burned at the stake, beheaded, hanged, and stabbed. In every lifetime, she meets her end at twenty at the hands of her stepsister Seraphina and former fiancé Dodolo. Reborn for the fifth time, Violet casts aside her wedding gown, dons riding attire, and crashes her stepmother’s wedding. Determined to reclaim her reputation as a villainess, she vows to bring down everyone who once destroyed her. When Malloris, a mysterious silver-masked man with violet eyes, offers an alliance, Violet soon realizes that even she cannot see all the cards in play this time.

title: Transmigrated, I Married the Reborn Bride
description: Desmond Finley wakes up to find he's transmigrated into a romance novel as a playboy. Betrayed on his wedding night by his fiancée and cousin, he awakens the Playboy's Comeback System. Meanwhile, Elowen Hawth is reborn on the very day of the wedding. Realizing Desmond isn't the good-for-nothing rumors claim, she decides to swap places to marry him. With a system and a reborn bride, Desmond is ready to conquer this era.

title: Unveiled Desires: A Twisted Romance
description: Zoe Smith unexpectedly has a fling with Julian Snider. While she's tormented by guilt over betraying her boyfriend, she discovers that her boyfriend had already been cheating on her with her bestie. Upon learning the truth, Zoe decides to marry Julian, unaware of his true identity...

title: Wildfire Between Us
description: Against the backdrop of raging wildfires in Los Angeles, the contractual marriage between firefighter Liam and novelist Natalie is thrown into crisis due to misunderstandings, betrayal, and life-and-death trials. As the wildfires spread, Liam gradually realizes his true feelings for Natalie, while she reexamines their relationship through the pain. The two grow closer amid disaster and conspiracy, ultimately rekindling their love from the ashes.

title: Bride Swaps Groom on the Spot
description:
She spent seven years with the wrong man. On her wedding day, at 8:58, she texted the one who'd been waiting: "Come get me."
He showed up — with cars, timing, and seven years of patience.
She chose wrong at first.

title: Fated Reunoin
description: On the night before her wedding, amnesiac Evelyn spends the night with a mysterious man, only to discover the next morning that he is her future husband, Julian. Julian publicly cancels their wedding, unaware that they are already legally married. After Evelyn joins his company, she faces workplace bullying, plagiarism accusations, and corporate conspiracies. As her hidden identity is gradually exposed, Julian realizes that the mysterious designer he has fallen for is actually the wife standing beside him.

title: Mending a broken love
description: After enduring a seven-year relationship, the couple ultimately breaks up due to various misunderstandings and betrayals. Subsequently, one partner completely loses the other to an idealized love, leading to a profound realization. Determined to make amends, he attempts to win her back through various means.

title: The Long Game of Seduction
description: Dumped on her wedding night, Quinley ends up in bed with Enzo, the capital's returning heir, by accident. With videos as leverage, he pulls her into his orbit and asks her the same question daily, "So… when are you leaving your husband?"

title: Hot on Upgrading Mecha Girls
description: In a world where Mecha Girls rule, Caesar Leat was nothing—F-rank trash, written off by everyone. Then the Upgrade System awakened. A dying Mecha Girl became his first masterpiece: SSS-rank, born from scrap and sheer grit. Now he's climbing, one upgrade at a time. But power doesn't go unnoticed. The Mechanicus, the shadowy elite pulling strings from the top, thinks they're untouchable. They just haven't met a guy who turns junk into legends. And his Mecha Girls? They'd burn the world for him.

title: Reborn: My New Groom Is My Fiancé's Uncle
description: In her past life, Sloane was betrayed and killed by her fiancé, Liam, and her stepsister, Gemma, who stole her family fortune. Reborn on her engagement night, she calls off the wedding and marries Tristan Hawth, Liam's ailing uncle. Together, they uncover the massive secret plot crafted by Jonathan and Valerie. After gathering evidence against their enemies, Sloane and Tristan fall in love and have a real wedding, starting their new life together.

title: I'm Reclaiming What's Mine
description: Clara, true heiress of the affluent Sinclair family, was switched at birth by a nanny and grew up in hardship in the countryside. Just as she was found by the Sinclairs, the false heiress Yasmin, desperate to hide her true origins, kills her own parents and frames Clara for the murder, resulting in a three-year prison sentence. Upon her release, Clara finds her family absent, celebrating Yasmin's birthday instead. Determined to reclaim her rightful place, Clara vows to expose Yasmin's deceit and rebuild her life, skillfully turning the tables to reclaim her ultimate destiny.

title: Marrying My Ex's Worst Nightmare
description: Humiliated when her fiancé Arthur stole another man's bride, Vivian married that very man—Sebastian, a rumored playboy. What began as revenge became real when she discovered Sebastian had secretly loved her since childhood. As Vivian fell for him, Arthur unraveled, begging for a second chance. But she had already found the devotion he never gave her.

title: Ex's Fortune, My Fame
description: Transmigrated as the lovesick villainess, Lynn has her husband's black card, but she'd rather blow it at a host club. James is certain it's just a ploy. Until she signs the divorce papers with a smile, pivots to her career, and her family, and is surrounded by different guys. Too late, James realizes the woman who only ever saw him has gone. But an old video and a secret become the final bargaining chips. In their marriage war, who actually let go first?

title: My Worthless Ex-Husband Is Poseidon, God of the Sea
description:
A hundred years ago, Thalen the Sea God saved the Maris Sea from monsters and a prophesied tsunami. Kael, saved by him, received an Oath Emblem that could grant any wish.

A century later, the sea citadel faces ruin. Dying Kael summons Thalen to form a three-year soul bond with his granddaughter Serena to protect their clan. Thalen hides his divine identity, marries into the family as a blacksmith, and silently sustains the Sea Barrier—but Serena sees him as a disgrace.

When noble Lord Cedric returns, he steals Thalen's achievements, frames him for treason, and claims credit. Blindly believing Cedric, Serena demands the bond be broken. Thalen agrees without protest and withdraws his power.

The divine runes on the barrier fade—and the apocalyptic tsunami finally arrives, as the whole truth is about to break.

title: My Hot Firefighter Ex
description: I called 911 because I accidentally handcuffed myself to my bed. I expected a locksmith. Instead, my ex-boyfriend kicked down my door—with three firefighters behind him. He thinks another man tied me up and abandoned me. Then I blurt out, "No, I didn't use protection." Now he's furious, jealous, and refusing to believe the truth. My biggest embarrassment just became his biggest misunderstanding... and neither of us is ready for what comes next.

title: How I Bankrupted My Cheating Ex
description: At Adrian Shaw’s company, everyone knew her simply as "Georgia Hale"—a manager who had worked by his side for eight years and his secret girlfriend. No one knew that "Hale" was merely her middle name; her real name was Georgia Hale Harrison, the sole heiress and Vice President of the Harrison Group. When she humbled herself for the first time in her life to beg her father, Richard Harrison, to approve the crucial thirty-million-dollar contract Adrian had been desperately chasing for months, Adrian repaid her by publicly announcing his marriage to an intern, Chloe Vance. Georgia withheld the deal, resigned, severed ties with Adrian, and agreed to marry Julian Prescott—the heir to the Prescott family who had waited twelve years for her. At the grand signing ceremony, her father appeared in person to reveal her true name and identity; she terminated the contract on the spot and exposed Chloe’s betrayal. As Adrian’s company collapsed and he spiraled into regret, Georgia’s life soared—cherished by Julian and welcomed back into the fold of her family, she finally lived life on her own terms, no longer anyone’s secret.

title: My Exclusive Client
description:
The story of a girl on the brink of crisis becoming a call-girl to save herself.
Jennifer, the star columnist of Vanity Queen magazine, finds herself on the brink of an unexpected layoff crisis. Her only hope of retaining her position is to craft a captivating story about a call-girl, a predicament thrust upon her by her cold, expressionless boss, Charlie. Determined to gather firsthand experience for her article, she ventures into the heart of a club. There, she encounters a mysterious masked man, who offers her to serve him exclusively. Little does she know, this enigmatic client is none other than her arch-nemesis, Charlie...

title: The Extraordinary Mother of a Billionaire
description:
Roger, chairman of the trillion-dollar group WestDream, wantsto do something special for his single mother and introduce his fiancée Vivian to her, so he brings his mother Susan, who works at a small-town restaurant, to the city to celebrate her birthday.

However, Vivian’s cousin Lisa, unaware of Susan’s true identity, mistakes Susan for a thief and humiliates her. Later, Susan is again targeted by her future daughter-in-law Vivian, who treats Susan as a fraud and humiliates her. Susan tries again and again to defend herself, but no one listens.After suffering repeated humiliation, she is finally rescued by Roger.

Only then does everyone realize that the humble Susan really is Roger’s mother. But by then, it is too late for regret. Roger resolves to punish the villains who bullied his mother and help her regain her dignity.

title: Auctioning My Ex
description: Wendy, the adored wife of the elite Henry Lewis, faces betrayal on their third anniversary when Henry returns with his first love and demands a divorce. Quietly signing the papers, Wendy launches a live-stream auction titled "Ex-Husband's Secret Auction." After just three bids, her stream goes viral, and the Lewis family's stocks crash. As Henry begs her to stop, Wendy smiles and declares, "The final item is here…"

title: My Ex-Wife Wants Me Back Too Late
description: For five years, Tucker sacrificed everything as the Turner family's live-in son-in-law, helping his wife become a top CEO, only to be mocked and divorced. Betrayed after leaving, he awakens the hidden power of an ancient jade pendant, gaining the ability to heal the dying and defeat any foe. The once-disdained husband rises to become the man everyone wants on their side, leaving his former family to regret losing him.

title: Soul Exchange under the Blood Moon
description: Ava is framed by her sister Leah and her fiance Cayden, then marked by a silver bracelet meant to steal her body, wolf soul, and destiny during the blood moon. She saves Nora, joins forces with Grayson, and uncovers the curse trade behind her mother's death. When the blood moon rises, Ava turns the trap back on everyone who tried to replace her.

title: The Extraordinary Mother of a Billionaire
description: Roger, chairman of the trillion-dollar group WestDream, wantsto do something special for his single mother and introduce his fiancée Vivian to her, so he brings his mother Susan, who works at a small-town restaurant, to the city to celebrate her birthday. However, Vivian’s cousin Lisa, unaware of Susan’s true identity, mistakes Susan for a thief and humiliates her. Later, Susan is again targeted by her future daughter-in-law Vivian, who treats Susan as a fraud and humiliates her. Susan tries again and again to defend herself, but no one listens.After suffering repeated humiliation, she is finally rescued by Roger. Only then does everyone realize that the humble Susan really is Roger’s mother. But by then, it is too late for regret. Roger resolves to punish the villains who bullied his mother and help her regain her dignity.

title: Divorced Over a Fake Ticket
description: Pamela Frost is promoted to partner and awarded shares worth billions. Amidst the festivities, she receives a prank lottery ticket. She brings the ticket home, but her husband, Drew Tyson, and her mother-in-law mistake it for a genuine two-billion-dollar jackpot. Their greed is laid bare, and Drew confesses to an affair with Pamela's best friend. Pamela planned to reveal the truth, but she's changed her mind. Let the truth crush the villains.

title: Divorced Queen Returns to The Stage
description:
After enduring six humiliating years of her husband Jake’s public infidelity, Anna finally snaps. She files for divorce and reignites her long-abandoned dream—reclaiming her status as a world-class pianist. 
Enter Ethan, her seemingly ordinary piano teaching assistant who’s actually a billionaire tycoon in disguise. With his unwavering support, Anna stages a breathtaking comeback, humiliates her ex-husband, and reclaims her glory. And as for Ethan? He gets the happy ending Jake threw away.

title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors
description: A wealthy girl keeps her true identity secret and marries a guy who's not as rich. But his family disrespects her because she sells fish for a living. She calmly agrees to divorce, but now, three brilliant men rush towards her, each claiming her as their fiancée!

title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors
description: A wealthy girl keeps her true identity secret and marries a guy who's not as rich. But his family disrespects her because she sells fish for a living. She calmly agrees to divorce, but now, three brilliant men rush towards her, each claiming her as their fiancée!

title: Divorced, Betrayed, and Claimed by Her Rival
description:
Ethan Carter, a brilliant algorithm prodigy, gave up his career to secretly marry into the Lin family and support his wife Evelyn Lin's dream. For ten years, he was treated as the family's "free housekeeper" and "human ATM" — until he caught her cheating with Damian Rivers, who also fathered a secret child with her.
The decade of silence ends. Ethan Carter files for divorce and strikes back: recovering transferred assets, reclaiming pre-marital property, and leveraging his hidden identity — the creator of "Pangu," the core algorithm keeping Evelyn Lin's company alive — to plunge her empire into crisis.
Meanwhile, Charlotte Shaw, president of Charlotte Group and his longtime "rival," confesses she has secretly loved him for ten years. Under her pursuit,Ethan Carter heals, severs his past, and embraces a new life.

title: Divorce the Fake, Marry the Throne
description: Reincarnated as the Bingley family's abandoned wife, Cordelia is betrayed, slaved for them, then cast out. When her ex returns to steal her fortune after faking his death, she divorces, takes her inheritance, and vanishes. At a royal banquet, the Bingleys realize: the kingdom's most powerful Regent is Cordelia's new man, who truly loves her and has the power to back it up.

title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors
description: A wealthy girl keeps her true identity secret and marries a guy who's not as rich. But his family disrespects her because she sells fish for a living. She calmly agrees to divorce, but now, three brilliant men rush towards her, each claiming her as their fiancée!

title: After the Divorce, the Heiress Takes It All
description: After divorcing her indecisive husband, the mysterious writer Dorothy chose to prove herself through her talent — she created her most important work, silenced her jealous sister-in-law, and finally found her true love.

title: Divorce Trial, Exposing Her Betrayal
description: After seven years of marriage, everyone believed Xenia was a devoted wife. But her husband, Frederick, uncovered her secret betrayal. To end it all, he goes to the Bar Association and demands that Xenia — his own wife — handle his divorce case. She has no idea. He feeds her evidence of her own affair, piece by piece, and forces her to win the lawsuit for him. Until the trial begins. And she comes face to face with the husband she never thought she'd lose. Now, it's too late for regret.

title: Ticket Denied, Divorce Filed
description: A woman's vacation plans leave her husband stranded at the airport, despite his years of support. She refuses to buy his $890 ticket but gives $15k to a friend, who turns out to be a scammer. Unbeknownst to all, the "useless moocher" is actually the billionaire chairman of the Loxley Group.

title: Divorce Me？Bow to My Billionaire Daughter!
description: The day Rose gives birth, she discovers her husband Tyler and protégée Sarah have been having an affair—and have just swapped her newborn daughter for their illegitimate son, leaving her real baby to die in the rain. Rose rescues her daughter in secret and spends the next two decades raising her into a billionaire heiress, while quietly playing the doting “mother” to the impostor child. When her revenge finally lands, no one will be left standing.

title: Never Enjoyed Divorce Like This
description: She is a wealthy heiress and a renowned fashion designer who gave up her career for her husband. However, his coldness and distrust broke her heart. After their divorce, she met a handsome, wealthy, and caring new man who helped her slowly forget the pain of her past. She thought she had found her true love, but little did she know that he was only after her money and power. When she discovered the deception and left him, he realized he had truly fallen for her. At the same time, her ex-husband wanted to reconcile. Who will she choose?

title: Divorced on Day One: The Commander Wants Her Back
description: Lyra married the most feared commander on Alpharis. Her only plan? Escape. She never wanted this arranged marriage. But the ruthless war hero everyone fears turns soft the moment she's near, whispering, "Babe, are you leaving me again?" In public, he's ruthless. In private, he's all puppy eyes and desperate pleas. Every word, every touch is designed to keep her close. This man would burn the galaxy down before he ever signs those papers.

title: Reborn in '83: From Divorce to Fortune
description: In his previous life, Chase Sharp had a failed marriage, a brain-damaged daughter, and died penniless. Reborn in 1983, he divorces Jennie Grey, wins custody of sick daughter Lily, and rides the reform wave with young Mayor Senela Zane's help.

title: I Signed My Divorce Papers on the Operating Table
description: I was dying from a difficult childbirth, yet my husband stayed outside the delivery room of his subordinate’s widow. I signed the divorce papers and left without hesitation. He was filled with deep regret and ended up abandoned by everyone around him.

title: My Ex-Wife Blooms After Divorce
description: She was once kidnapped and saved by him. To repay the favor, she married him, while he mistook another woman for her and proposed a divorce. After the truth came out, he wanted to win her back.

title: The Divorce That Crowned Her
description: Naomi and Francis have enjoyed three years of marriage, with Naomi wholeheartedly supporting Francis's successful career as a top lawyer. But when Iris, Francis's first love, reappears, Naomi's comfortable life is shaken. As her role as a good wife is challenged, memories of her past as the formidable "Queen of Law" resurface, reigniting her inner strength and ambition.

title: Divorced on Day One: The Commander Wants Her Back
description: Lyra married the most feared commander on Alpharis. Her only plan? Escape. She never wanted this arranged marriage. But the ruthless war hero everyone fears turns soft the moment she's near, whispering, "Babe, are you leaving me again?" In public, he's ruthless. In private, he's all puppy eyes and desperate pleas. Every word, every touch is designed to keep her close. This man would burn the galaxy down before he ever signs those papers.

title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress
description: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress* tells the story of Aurora Vance. On her third‑wedding anniversary, she is publicly abandoned and left penniless by her husband Marcus. In despair, she makes a contract‑marriage deal with wealthy heir Ryan Winslow. Meanwhile, she finds her true identity and takes back the Vance Group. They dig out the truth, bring mastermind Victor Kane to justice. After fierce struggles, the contract turns into genuine love. Aurora achieves self‑redemption and marries Ryan.

title: The 500,000 Divorce
description: David Bennett thought he had found happiness in his remarriage to Madeline. But when his ex-wife, Evelyn Hart, reappears, the façade of his new life begins to crumble. Dark secrets surface. As David's company teeters on the brink of collapse, Madeline prepares to dump him. In his darkest hour, only Evelyn steps forward, offering not just financial salvation but a chance at redemption.

title: Divorced and Now a Billionaire's Granddaughter
description:
I always thought my husband was just distant, but he loved me.
Until a plane crash, as a survivor, I saw my husband accompanying another woman for a prenatal examination in the hospital.
I realized that I had never walked into this man's heart. The moment I decided to let go, I would hide my true identity no more! 
As the world's richest man's granddaughter, I'd like to make him regret what he'd done!

title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors
description: A wealthy girl keeps her true identity secret and marries a guy who's not as rich. But his family disrespects her because she sells fish for a living. She calmly agrees to divorce, but now, three brilliant men rush towards her, each claiming her as their fiancée!

title: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress
description: After three years of being married to Tristan Beckett and being his walking blood bank, Joyce Powell finally divorces him! Tristan thought Joyce was a vain girl who only married him for money, little did he know, she's a secret billionaire heiress! Will Tristan win back Joyce's heart? Or will she fall for a much younger cutie pie William Pope?

title: Reborn in '83: From Divorce to Fortune
description: In his previous life, Chase Sharp had a failed marriage, a brain-damaged daughter, and died penniless. Reborn in 1983, he divorces Jennie Grey, wins custody of sick daughter Lily, and rides the reform wave with young Mayor Senela Zane's help.

title: Cold CEO Regrets After Divorce
description:
After being framed by my husband's first love, I was driven out of my home! 
As an orphan, I had diligently managed household chores after marrying my husband, only to suffer a miscarriage at the hands of his first love, who then falsely accused me of orchestrating it. Feeling disheartened, my father and brother finally acknowledged me. It was then that I learned I was the heiress to a wealthy family!
Reclaiming my identity, I leveraged the power of my influential family to embark on a revenge plan, confronting everyone who had bullied me in the past!

title: Divorced and Back with His Baby Girl
description: After two years of marriage without conceiving, pressured by her mother-in-law, she left with the baby after getting a divorce...

title: I Divorced My Husband Over a Birthmark
description: Vivienne and Adrian are moments away from adopting a sweet little girl when Vivienne notices a pea-sized birthmark on the child's hand. She immediately refuses to sign and demands a divorce. Adrian kneels. His family calls her cruel, barren, and heartless. Even the child begs her not to leave. No one understands why Vivienne would destroy a loving marriage over such a tiny mark, and she refuses to explain. Not until Vivienne unveils three reports at a live press conference does the truth behind that tiny birthmark finally begin to surface.

title: I Divorced His Whole Family
description: For three years, Emily is treated like a free watchdog by her toxic husband, Liam, and his parasitic family, who always leave her behind during their lavish vacations. This year, the moment they jet off to the Maldives, Emily quietly sells her pre-marital home and files for divorce. When the family returns to find themselves locked out and homeless, Emily delivers the ultimate blow by exposing Liam's secret affair to his entire social and professional circle. Left with absolutely nothing, the toxic family faces total ruin while Emily embraces her wealthy new life of independence.

title: Contracted CEO Husband Regrets On Divorce Eve
description: Two years ago, we entered into a marriage contract. For two years, we never met each other. Just when we were about to divorce, we ended up having relations. And he doesn't even remember that the person he had a one-night stand with is me! Now, he wants to divorce me. But knowing the truth, he regrets it.

title: Marry My Ex's Boss After Divorce
description: After catching her husband cheating, she was kicked out with nothing. After the divorce, her ex-husband's company boss offers a contract relationship to fend off other women. Little does she know, the billionaire has already fallen for her and will always cherish her.

title: You'll Regret Cheating on a Superhero
description: The star superhero Bryan left his gravely injured secret wife Rachel to die in an explosion for better publicity. After sacrificing her career for their hidden marriage for 5 years, a devastated Rachel underwent agonizing genetic experiments in Vought’s Aurora Project. Reinvented as the first female superhero Lumina, she erased her former identity completely. All Bryan had left was her death certificate, doomed to gaze up at the woman he threw away.

title: I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear
description:
After three years on the battlefield, the wife returns victorious, but unexpectedly pregnant! The former Grand Marshal of the empire's army had retired due to his parents' last wishes and married a woman known for her bravery and ambition. She aspired to achieve greatness on the battlefield, and before she left, he gifted her a legendary spear forged from thousand-year-old cold iron.

Three years later, she returns clad in silver armor, pregnant, and holding another man's hand. She presents a letter of divorce, declaring, "My husband must be a heroic figure who stands tall, not a weak scholar with no strength."

Unbeknownst to her, the seemingly powerless man she had married was actually the empire’s guardian deity. When he dons his marshal armor once again and takes up his legendary weapon, she finally realizes the true identity of the man she once scorned.

title: It's Too Late To Regret Divorce, Mr. CEO
description: Three years ago, jewelry designer Emma was rescued by billionaire Will. However, in the three years of their marriage, she was reduced to a substitute for Will’s late white moonlight, Casey, and suffered constant indifference. During a fatal kidnapping, Emma made a desperate call to Will for help, but he hung up coldly. Heartbroken, Emma resolutely proposed a divorce, only to be mocked by Will.

title: 99 Divorces, Then My Husband Died for Me
description: Joelle believed her husband wanted nothing more than to get rid of her. He demanded divorce again and again, flaunted a pregnant mistress, and even drugged her before sending her back to the ex she once loved. Only after her tragic death did she learn the truth. There was never another woman. Every betrayal was a lie, every cruel word a performance, because Sutton was dying of terminal cancer and wanted her to hate him before he was gone. Reborn on the day he asked for their ninety-ninth divorce, Joelle refuses to let the man who loved her more than his own life sacrifice everything again. This time, she's determined to rewrite their ending before it's too late.

title: The CEO's Wife is A Badass
description: Cora, a modest artist and the wife of billionaire Brandon Pearson, finds herself managing his gallery while he's away on business. However, her role as the CEO's wife is unexpectedly eclipsed by her college classmate Ashley, leaving Cora scorned by her colleagues. Can Cora reclaim her place and prove her worth?

title: Boss, You've Got The Wrong Wife
description: Jennifer, an intern at the Wilson Group, had a drunken one-night stand with her boss, James. She also accidentally left her best friend Tina's resume in the hotel room. While James was looking for Jennifer, Tina cheated on him, moved into Wilson's house, and became his woman. Jennifer, who wanted to be a good intern but was unexpectedly promoted to secretary, stayed by James's side and carefully guarded the secret of the night. But James had developed a soft spot for Jennifer, and suspected she was the woman of the night.

title: Not My Child: Ex-Wife to the Rescue
description: After his divorce, Jonathan Sterling thought he had a perfect life with his new wife. But she soon revealed her malicious true colors: secretly abusing his daughter, forcing his elderly mother to slave away, and cheating with her guy best friend. When Jonathan's business faces bankruptcy, she plots to run off with his money. At his lowest point, his ex-wife steps in with massive funds to save his company. Finally seeing the truth, Jonathan leaves his current wife and reconciles with his ex.

title: 100-Year-Old Man Got a Young Wife
description: Jim time-traveled into a different world. At 100, he activates a system right when the war goddess Evelyn Yates holds her martial arts tournament to get a husband. He steps onto the stage and defeats her. Evelyn's sister takes her place in marriage, and Jim's lifespan extends. His adventure follows. His actions change the fates of both Evelyn and her sister, ultimately winning both their hearts. Together, they head to the Celestial Altar Assembly, where he meets Eve Winton and becomes the Grand Elder. In the end, Jim becomes an immortal, free to roam the world for all eternity.

title: Don't Cross a Good Wife
description: After moving away for marriage, Lauren Bennett and her husband Derek Hayes build a life together, but face constant leeching from a biased mother-in-law and roguish brother-in-law, Travis Hayes. The mother-in-law secretly sells her son's house to fund Travis. Travis also sexually harasses a client, abuses his wife, and assaults Lauren, nearly causing a miscarriage. Fed up with Derek's cowardly enabling, Lauren awakens from her trauma, chooses divorce, and fights back legally. Ultimately, Travis receives an eight-year prison sentence, and the mother-in-law is sent away. The story follows a woman breaking free from a leeching family to reclaim her life.

title: A Wife's Sacrifice
description: A legendary female warrior of a great nation was humiliated by representatives of multiple countries on the battlefield. With unwavering will and formidable strength, she struck back with a powerful blow, defeating the provocateurs and upholding the dignity and glory of her homeland. Though she has long concealed her true identity from her husband and daughter, causing them much trouble, she vows to press forward without hesitation, defending her country against all challenges ahead.

title: The Wife's Disguise
description: I was bankrupt, and to provide my wife live a comfortable life, I worked like a slave on the construction site. However, when I got home from work, I saw my wife, who was just an office clerk, was picked up by a man in a luxury car! And there were suspicious scratches on her body!

title: A Perfect Wife
description: Grace Bennett remarries Ethan Foster, bringing her daughter Emma. But she faces relentless bullying and suspicion from Mrs. Foster and Chloe. Enduring it all, Grace uses sincerity and wisdom to resolve family conflicts. She saves Chloe from a romance scam, cares for Mrs. Foster, and uses her $30 million savings to help Ethan make a comeback after his bankruptcy. Ultimately, her kindness moves everyone. Mrs. Foster and Chloe apologize, bringing true harmony to the family.

title: Second Life, Second Wife
description: Ethan Scott, the best doctor in the country, marries injured military officer Zoe Lane, seeing through his cousin's schemes. Despite rumors and doubts about her abilities and fertility, Ethan uses his exceptional skills to heal Zoe and dispel the gossip. Together, they stand strong, united through every challenge.

title: President's Sexy Wife
description: Gianna, the disowned heiress of a wealthy family, suffers a devastating blow overnight: her fiancé cheats on her with her younger sister, and her family calls off their engagement. Overwhelmed with grief, she meets Logan, an icy tycoon, in a bar. The two hit it off instantly, drawn to each other's looks. Under the influence of alcohol, Gianna spends a passionate night with Logan. When she wakes up, she is shocked to find out that she has become the wife of this billionaire.

title: Blind No Longer: My Wife's Betrayal
description: Two years ago, a car accident left me blind. My sense of sight finally returned to me one day... and the very first thing I saw... was my wife cheating on me.

title: Reborn As The CEO's Darling Wife
description: She's framed by her fiancé and best friend, left ruined and eventually killed. Upon her rebirth, she becomes a billionaire's wife. Seeking revenge, he stands by her side, always ready to help.

title: Synced Senses with my CEO Wife
description: After five years of war, Carter Vance, the "God of Slaughter," retires to the city as a delivery driver, only to have a one-night stand with famous CEO Elena Thorne. Their matching destinies trigger a Sensory Transfer—Elena can drink endlessly, while Carter suffers the hangovers. Forced to confront her, he repeatedly shatters the cold CEO's defenses, fiercely protects his wife, and crushes the villains to help her launch Genesis One and break the foreign drug monopoly. Can this legendary warrior conquer the city, or will sharing his senses with the CEO be his ultimate undoing?

title: My Wife Replaced Me With An AI Lover
description: Wealthy heiress Vanessa grows tired of her husband Ethan's lack of spark, so she leaves him for her robot boyfriend and coldly commits Ethan to an AI re-education facility for "upgrading." Three years later, Ethan returns—cold, mechanical, and hollow. Manipulated by her robot lover 233, Vanessa torments Ethan at every turn, treating him like a malfunctioning machine. But when an AI ethics officer uncovers the truth and helps Ethan track down his long-lost biological parents—who turn out to be billionaires—the officer exposes Vanessa's cruelty in public. Abandoned by everyone, Vanessa watches as Ethan seizes control of the empire and rises from the ashes, a man reborn.

title: 100-Year-Old Man Got a Young Wife
description: Jim time-traveled into a different world. At 100, he activates a system right when the war goddess Evelyn Yates holds her martial arts tournament to get a husband. He steps onto the stage and defeats her. Evelyn's sister takes her place in marriage, and Jim's lifespan extends. His adventure follows. His actions change the fates of both Evelyn and her sister, ultimately winning both their hearts. Together, they head to the Celestial Altar Assembly, where he meets Eve Winton and becomes the Grand Elder. In the end, Jim becomes an immortal, free to roam the world for all eternity.

title: Claimed by My Hunter Husband
description: Ethan, the village's toughest hunter, lives by two rules: hunt wild beasts and stay feared. But when time-traveling Molly insists on marrying him, the man everyone avoids finally meets someone who won't run and maybe even tames his wild heart.

title: My Poor Husband is a Big Shot
description: The man worked hard outside for many years, eventually escaping poverty and becoming a well-known tycoon.After achieving success and fame, he returns to the small town, hoping to hold a belated wedding ceremony for his wife. However, his wife's family believes he is a down-and-out loser. In order to force the poor woman to remarry a social elite, they insult, beat the hero, and even force him to divorce. Faced with such bullying, the wife remains calm and works together with his wife to resolve various crises. He ultimately reveals his true identity to everyone, reclaiming his dignity.

title: My Husband Pretended to Be Poor
description:
After her parents’ death, Olivia Hart lives with her sister Claire. To avoid being a burden, she agrees to a blind date with Ethan Sterling, grandson of the elderly Eleanor she once saved. Mistaking Olivia for a gold-digger, Ethan hides his wealthy identity and marries her quickly—unaware that this choice will spark a love full of misunderstandings and redemption.
Their awkward cohabitation slowly turns to love as Ethan defends her secretly. A misunderstanding over dowry leads to a 6-month contract, cooling their relationship. Jealousy and a new rival push Ethan to chase her back, with Olivia’s sister helping them reconcile.
