Just as Ethan plans to reveal his truth, a persistent heiress exposes his identity, sparking a cold war. Ethan fights to win her back, eliminates the heiress’s threats, burns the contract, and finally proposes to Olivia properly.

title: The Landlady and Her "Broke" Husband
description: Chloe Lawson has it all — a secret fortune in real estate, a cozy cake shop dream, and a cheating ex-boyfriend she just caught red-handed. But when a car accident steals her memory, she wakes up convinced that Sterling Vance — the cold, mysterious CEO of Vance Group — is the childhood hero she's been searching for. Desperate to dodge an arranged marriage, Sterling doesn't correct her. Instead, he marries her. What begins as a convenient lie turns into a hilariously chaotic "poor" newlywed life in a tiny rental apartment. But as the villains circle and her memory returns, Chloe discovers the truth: her fake husband was never a stranger...

title: My Husband Runs the Syndicate
description:
Four years ago, Taylor Marchetti waited in the rain while the man she'd loved since sixteen chose a Russo heiress and two seats at the Syndicate Table over her. That same night, she wrote to the Northern Chapter and honored the marriage her dead father had arranged — to Jax Logan, the youngest Head Enforcer the Syndicate has ever had, and the most dangerous.
Now she's back in the South, luggage lost, dressed like nobody, and they all assume she's crawled home broke. Jude mocks her. Cora tears the wedding ring off her hand and wears it to four Chapter parties. Nobody thinks to ask whose wife she is.
They're about to find out. And so is Taylor — because the reason Jax married her goes back ten years, to a freezing night, a blanket, and a girl who was thirteen and kind to a stranger.

title: My Contract Husband is Hades
description: On his twenty-second birthday, Nick is dying from a cursed underworld mark. His late guardian leaves him one chance: offer a silver coin to the “Queen of the Underworld.” But the one who answers is Hades himself, a silver-haired god who seals Nick’s life with a black wedding ring. Every time Hades saves him, their marriage contract grows deeper—and Nick becomes harder to let go. When a fallen priest kidnaps Nick to force Hades to open the Underworld Gate, Nick must choose: escape the god who owns his heartbeat, or claim him as an equal.

title: My Accidental Billionaire Husband
description:
On the day Julie was supposed to marry her ex, she caught him cheating—so she grabbed the nearest stranger and got hitched instead. One-year contract: divorce, cash out, walk away. But her billionaire husband changed the rules—because he wanted her for real. And to her own surprise, she wanted him back. His whole family adored her.
Of course, the scheming ex–best friend sneered that a nobody like Julie didn't deserve her ""Charles,"" and her ex kept telling her to face reality and ditch the rich husband. Then came the joint gala of B‑Country’s top dynasty and New York’s Warfield family—where Mr. Gale Henderson took Julie’s hand and announced: “This is my only granddaughter, Gale Henderson’s flesh and blood. Treat her well.” And her husband wrapped his arm around her waist, leaving no room for doubt: “This woman is mine. Divorce? Not a chance

title: Trophy Husband Turned Tycoon
description: When his wife was insulted, he stopped being just a stay-at-home husband. He was actually the young master of a prestigious family! Watch how he deals with anyone who tries to take his wife away!

title: Spoiled by My Husband in a Coma
description: Samantha Brooks desperately needs $150,000 for her daughter's leukemia treatment. Instead, her husband Bradley and his mother scheme with homewrecker Tiffany Sparks to steal her assets, forcing her to leave with nothing. With no way out, she accepts a marriage settlement to marry Nathaniel Sinclair, a man currently in a coma. After they wed, his mother treats Samantha like her own daughter, and Nathaniel miraculously awakens. It turns out he is the Chairman of Sinclair Group and the richest billionaire in Silver Bay. Falling for Samantha, Nathaniel crushes her vile ex, pays for her daughter's care, and sends her to an elite private school. The ex and the homewrecker face their karma, while Samantha finally finds lasting joy and is expecting Nathaniel's baby.

title: Abandoned Husband, Titan Lord
description: For years, the Federation’s top mech pilot has lived incognito. He lifted his wife’s family to the heights of power, only to be met with divorce papers and public humiliation.When he steps into the awardceremony hall in his true identity and draws the Tyrant’s Sword, everyone falls to their knees. Only then do they realize the “worthless man” she discarded is the god they all look up to.

title: The Husband Delivered by Fate
description: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.

title: Who Is the Bride's Husband?
description: Natalie was forced to marry the Kingsley son in place of her sister. She didn't know the Cousin Adrian she met on her wedding night was actually her husband Victor, who was rumored to have disfigured his face. Victor hid his identity to test her. Their feelings gradually grew amidst interactions. Facing the calculations of the Kingsley family, old family grudges, and a kidnapping crisis, the disguised couple worked together to reveal the truth, and move from mutual testing to mutual love.

title: The Forgotten Husband
description: A submissive husband is secretly the billionaire chairman. Unaware, his wife scorns him and neglects their daughter for a deal. David Collins reveals the truth to make them pay.

title: My Husband Is An American Hero
description: They bullied a hero's pregnant widow on her way to his funeral, hurling insults. At the service, their cruelty escalated, nearly making her lose her child. But their horror began when her father, General Thomas, arrived. The woman they tormented was his daughter. In that moment, their dreams of power shattered, and justice was swiftly delivered.

title: I Hid My Husband's Daughter
description: After spending years in prison for a crime she didn't commit, Leila returns home determined to find the daughter stolen from her at birth—only to discover the little girl is being raised as a servant by the ex-husband and vicious bully who destroyed her life.  Leila must protect her secret daughter while battling the woman who framed her, manipulated everyone around her, and will stop at nothing to keep the truth buried. But this time, Leila isn't the naive girl they remember—she's a mother with nothing left to lose.

title: MY MAFIA HUSBAND WATCHED ME BURN
description:
"No one helps her. Let her burn."
My husband said those words while I was trapped inside a burning car—with a steel bar through my chest. Then my phone somehow connected to him... four years in the past. The boy who once begged me to marry him watched me die while the man he became refused to save me. He thinks I'm lying. He doesn't know I'm carrying his baby... or that this is the last time he'll ever hear my voice.

title: The Double Life of My Ex-Con Husband
description: The heir of a wealthy family, Lucas, voluntarily went to prison to overthrow his half brother. His fiancée abandoned him and went to live with his half brother. After being released from prison, he concealed his wealthy identity and entered into a contractual marriage with the orphaned girl, Ava. Gradually, true feelings developed between them. Ava discovered that she was the long-lost heiress of a rich family. When her old enemies came after her, Lucas revealed his true identity and embarked on a desperate revenge to help her.

title: Go to Hell, My Husband
description: During a medical examination, I learned that my husband had cancer When I wanted to face the disease together with him, he filed for divorce because he thought I was the one with cancer! And my mother-in-law, started to make a series of unreasonable troubles. In the end, my husband died tragically due to delayed treatment!

title: Bound to the Ruthless Beast
description:
Beast King Elden bears a lethal lightning curse—any living thing he touches burns to cinders. Human girl Vera is the only one who can endure his touch. To break the curse, he forces her into marriage by holding her mother hostage.

Vera resents him, but glimpses his sincere heart: he heals her, shields her, and crumbles when she prays for him barefoot through brambles. The curse can be broken by consummation—but Vera would die from the backlash. Elden makes an antidote, but the villainess Lia swaps it for poison.

On their wedding night, the curse lifts—but Vera collapses, never to wake.

Elden mourns her for six years at her grave. But Vera is alive, raising twin children with golden beast ears in the human slums. One snowy day, her daughter clings to a passing man's leg—"Daddy."

Elden finds his lost family. But Vera cannot forgive his deception, and an old enemy's father has raised a poison bow, vowing blood revenge.

title: My Husband's Colleague
description: Gentle housewife Sarah meets her husband’s new colleague Diego at a family dinner, only to be drugged and assaulted by him, filmed, and blackmailed. Forced to assist in stealing commercial secrets, she endures prolonged mental manipulation and abuse. Gradually awakening from silent fear, Sarah secretly cooperates with the police, lays a trap, and engages in a life-and-death struggle to bring down the entire criminal network. In the end, she walks out of the trauma and rediscovers herself.

title: My Dear Husband, Please Go Bankrupt
description: After dying from overwork, Sasha wakes up in a novel as the doomed wife of Emmett. Toxically obsessed with her billionaire husband and eventually banished abroad, the old Sasha had a bad end. But this time, Sasha finds a prenup loophole to save her life: if Emmett goes bankrupt, his family will force a divorce. Now she's ready to bankrupt her husband!

title: The God They Called a Fool
description:
In the ancient Greek era, when gods ruled the heavens and the earth, a single pure love — steadfast for five long years — stood against the prejudice and malice of the entire world, weaving a tale of redemption between god and mortal.
Elena, a fallen noble girl, endured mockery and family pressure without flinching. For five years, she held on — never wavering, never abandoning Aether, a man with a broken mind.
Her family, eager to climb the social ladder, forced her into marriage with Drakon, an ambitious temple priest.
On the eve of the wedding, the two bid each other a painful farewell — only to be cruelly ambushed by Drakon. Aether was mortally wounded, teetering on the brink of death.
In that desperate hour, Aether awakened the primordial origin of the Chaos God — a power sealed for ten thousand years. The supreme divine force that once towered above all the heavens surged back to life.
The once-submissive mortal transformed into a ruthless sovereign of the divine realm. To protect the one he loved, he defied the odds, overturned their fate, and rewrote their destiny with his own hands.

title: The Husband Delivered by Fate
description: After four years of slaving away for an unfaithful girlfriend, deliveryman Glenn inherits the Ghost Valley Legacy, unlocking godlike skills. He vows revenge and takes Oakhaven by storm. Discovering Lyra is key to his cultivation, he marries her to save her father. Despite a rocky start and attacks from the Eclipse, they bond. Glenn crushes enemies, builds an empire, and wins Lyra's heart, melting her cold exterior. Together, they find their happily ever after.

title: Boss in Disguise
description: Mia York impersonated heiress Chloe Lynn to attend CEO Silas Ford's matchmaking, demanding huge dowry but unmasked. Silas later became her boss. He enforced a "Ten-Date Pact"; Mia faced false accusations defending Hart Studio but got Silas' covert aid. Posing as "Eve York" to ease his family's marriage pressure, she became his fake girlfriend. Their charade revealed her authenticity and his hidden warmth.​

title: Saving My Villainess Boss
description: Penny Stirling transmigrates into a romance novel as the loyal sidekick and lackey to the villainess Evelyn Sterling. In the original plot, Evelyn meets a ruinous end after crossing the lead couple—and Penny is dragged down to the same tragic fate right alongside her. Now, the Overseer tasks Penny with fixing Evelyn's foolish obsession with love. She helps Evelyn expose the scumbag. While completing her mission, she sticks close to Miss Sterling, achieving both career success and massive wealth!

title: Pretend to Love, End up Obsessed
description: When lawyer Chloe used her boss as a cover to pretend to confess her love during a blind date, she was overheard by her boss Vincent. After a misunderstanding leading to flash marriage, she married rich. From setting boundaries to gradually getting closer, through high tension flirting and office romance, she managed to flirt the cold-faced boss out of control and also reaped a unique love that was favored and firmly protected.

title: My Father's Billionaire Boss Treasured Me as His Bride
description: Julia, a bartender, was drugged by Pete — her father's direct superior — who had taken a liking to her. She begged her father for help, but he turned a blind eye. In her struggle to escape, she accidentally crashed into Eric, the group's CEO, and they ended up spending the night together by chance. A month later, Julia discovered she was pregnant. After being beaten by her mother, she ran right into Eric, who had come looking for her. He rescued her. Her friend George suspected she had deliberately set a trap to seduce Eric, but Eric didn't believe it — until he overheard a phone call between Julia and her father, leading him to misunderstand her as a gold digger who had seduced him for money. He gave her money and told her to leave. At the same time Julia was drugged by her parents and handed over to Pete as a "gift" once again, Eric learned that Julia was actually pregnant — and rushed to find her…

title: My 5 Mini Boss Crew
description: After one fateful night, her boyfriend disappeared without a trace, and Lin Moru was framed and exiled by her greedy stepfamily. She returns six years later with five brilliant kids, who’ve made it their mission to find their long-lost father.

title: Flood: Lady Boss's Teammate Is a Janitor
description: Reborn after her colleagues betrayed her in a flood, elite exec Robyn Shaw tears up her termination notice and becomes a badass. With janitor Martha, she turns an unfinished tower into a fortress. When the flood comes, the former chairman begs. When cold comes, Martha's salted fish saves them all. Nobody could help them, but these two women survived.

title: Falling for a Mafia Boss After Pregnancy
description:
He is a mafia don walking in the shadows—cold-blooded, ruthless, a stranger to tenderness.
She is a white-coated nurse bathed in sunlight—resilient, unyielding, the one who shatters every one of his rules.
One accident, one night of tangled fate, one unplanned child, binds two souls from opposite worlds together, irrevocably.
There are misunderstandings, fiery clashes, and life-or-death devotion; there is unwavering preference, quiet redemption, and a love hidden deep beneath the blade.
What is it like to fall for a crime lord? It is honey on the edge of a knife. It is light in the depths of the abyss.

title: Cursed Island: Survive Me
description: Ten years ago, the Heller family was murdered, but Jace survived. Now a top mercenary undercover as a heiress's bodyguard, he returns to hunt his enemies. He boards a flight to a private island. But the plane is full of his past tormentors: the ex-fiancée who humiliated him, relatives who left him for dead, and his abusive boss. Everyone he despises is on this very flight...

title: Please don't die, Alpha! I Can Heal You Every Night
description: Brief Synopsis: Vesper, bent on raising funds to save her father, strikes a deal with Raymond, the Hell's Gang boss, to become his contract lover. Unaware to Vesper, Raymond has been nursing a secret affection for her. How will they navigate the tangled web of money and love's misunderstandings...

title: The Lady Boss's Small Town Valentine
description: A workaholic's life is turned upside down when she finds out her fiance is having an affair with her horrible assistant. She blows the biggest deal of her life when she has a breakdown over it during the pitch. Now, her grandfather, the CEO of her hotel company, relocates her to a tiny mountain town to take over one of their failing properties. To make matters worse, she's stuck with a small town (but devilishly handsome), co-manager, who cares more about people than profits. And she has to live with the co-manager in a little chalet...

title: Vicious Dog
description: She accepts a president position to find evidence against the man who murdered her parents. But her new boss adds a condition: turn his ferocious youngest son into a proper heir. The son fights her at every turn—until he falls for her. Now she's trapped between revenge and a forbidden flame, with danger lurking at every kiss.

title: The Mafia Boss's Wrong Bride
description:
Anya loved Keller deeply, yet because of her sister Victoria’s schemes, she lived for years trapped in misunderstanding and pain. Five years ago, she risked her life to donate a kidney and save Keller, only for Victoria to steal the credit. After their marriage, Anya was treated coldly and even lost her unborn child.
Heartbroken, she left for overseas studies. Five years later, she returned in power as a medical doctor and the head of Life Medical Group. By then, Keller was on the verge of death from organ rejection. At last, he uncovered the truth: Anya was his real savior, and the woman he had always loved was her.

title: Saving My Villainess Boss
description: Penny Stirling transmigrates into a romance novel as the loyal sidekick and lackey to the villainess Evelyn Sterling. In the original plot, Evelyn meets a ruinous end after crossing the lead couple—and Penny is dragged down to the same tragic fate right alongside her. Now, the Overseer tasks Penny with fixing Evelyn's foolish obsession with love. She helps Evelyn expose the scumbag. While completing her mission, she sticks close to Miss Sterling, achieving both career success and massive wealth!

title: The Mafia Boss Has a Gun, Darling Don't Run
description:
Gangster William was attacked and saved by a passing nurse, Hannah. William fell in love
with Hannah at first sight. He didn't care that Hannah had someone to marry. He wanted
Hannah. Hannah came from a family of policemen. His father was a policeman and his
brother died fighting crime. What happens to Hannah's relationship with gangster William?

title: The Mistress in My Hospital
description: Billionaire heiress Aurora Ashford gave her cheating husband the hospital, the black card, and her whole heart—then walked in on his mistress smashing his mom's $10M cochlear implant and claiming the VIP suite as "the boss's wife." Big mistake. Because the real boss just came home.

title: All the Wrong Reasons
description: Andrea is the last person who should be writing a sex advice column, given the fact she has ZERO experience, but her jerk boss won't budge! Desperate, Andrea hits up the local bar for an emergency hookup, but instead, she finds a sexy stranger with a tantalizing proposition: seduction lessons in exchange for torpedoing his arranged marriage?!

title: The Foolish Stand-in Bride Is a Boss
description: Framed in a conspiracy, she leaves the asylum as a stand-in bride for a lucky marriage to the world-famous Winslow heir, Sebastian Winslow. As he weds the simpleton, the whole nation waits for a joke. The loser and the simpleton? A dragon cannot be confined to a shallow pool; once it meets the storm, it will soar into the sky! She is capable of miraculous healing, destroying the scum and settling scores, and her secret identity holds unimaginable wealth! When the tearful socialites of Oakmont complain to Mr. Winslow, Sebastian Winslow declares: The fragile bride is completely helpless.

title: My Ungrateful Ex Never Knew I Was the CEO
description: Emily Rosenthal spent billions secretly funding the education and career that made him successful. Then she comes home ready to propose and Jason dumps her for someone richer. Emily turns to Frederick instead—Jason's boss. Now, with the man at the top by her side, she's ready to reveal the empire she built and tear down every dream Jason left her to chase.

title: Tempting the Mafia Boss
description: To avoid being sold off by her aunt, destitute orphan Chloe Winters tries to manipulate Silas Thorne—her aunt's lover and the second-in-command of Port City's top gang—to fund her escape abroad. Silas sees through her scheme and forces her to stay. Trapped in a dangerous world, Chloe plays the obedient pet until she glimpses the villain's true heart: Silas risks his life to protect her in a gang shootout and secretly secures her study abroad application. Betrayed and ambushed, Silas vanishes into the sea before giving it to her. Heartbroken, Chloe leaves the country, only to unexpectedly reunite with an amnesiac Silas. Embracing her hidden feelings, they share a peaceful life until a cartel attack forces them back to Port City. There, the illusion shatters: Silas's amnesia was nothing but a calculated ruse for his ultimate revenge...

title: Contract Love with My Fiancé's Wheelchair Uncle
description: On the eve of her engagement, her family went bankrupt, and her fiancé called off the wedding! Mocked by everyone, she mustered the courage to marry a wheelchair-bound billionaire to fulfill her grandmother's wish. Little did she know, the rumors were false! The billionaire's disability was all a facade!

title: Contract Ends, Love Never Does
description:
Jewelry designer Allison Grant is drowning in debt, and the jewelry store left by her father is on the verge of being seized. One rainy night, she crosses paths with Alexander Walker, CEO of the Walker Group. The two sign a six‑month contract‑marriage agreement: Alexander pays off all her debts, while Allison acts as his fiancée to appease family pressures.

As they spend time together, genuine affection gradually grows out of their cold transaction. Allison stumbles upon a sapphire necklace, which unearths a fifteen‑year‑old case. A wealthy‑family conspiracy lies behind her father Grant’s bankruptcy all those years ago. Alexander protects Allison while investigating the long‑buried past.

Ethan, the privileged and ambitious false younger brother, is the mastermind who secretly sabotaged Grant’s jewelry business back then. He keeps engineering crises and sowing discord in an attempt to seize control of the Walker Group. Refusing to lean on the powerful family amid all the turmoil, Allison builds her own career with her design talent. Together with Alexander, they gather evidence and expose all of Ethan’s crimes.

After cutting through layers of conspiracy, the two break free from the shackles of their contract and let go of past grief. Allison revives her father’s jewelry brand, and Alexander prevails in internal family conflicts. Having weathered misunderstandings, dangers and numerous trials, they hold a genuine wedding, evolving from a paper‑based deal into lasting love built on mutual devotion.

title: Contract Lover, Pregnant Ex-Wife
description: She sold herself to save her father. The heir who'd loved her for years took her as his contract lover. He thought she was a gold‑digger. She fell for him anyway. When she got pregnant, he was about to marry another. Threats, lies, and his secret protection pushed her away. Nine years later, their child reunites them. He uncovers the truth, clears every misunderstanding, and finally claims the family he lost.

title: Honey Cut
description: Based on the novel by Sierra Simone. When her father forces her to marry billionaire Mark Trevena, good Catholic girl Isolde expects a monster. Instead she finds herself falling for two men — her dangerous new husband and his fiercely loyal bodyguard Tristan. As jealousy, betrayal and forbidden desire push all three to their breaking point, they must choose between destroying each other... or risking everything to stay as one.

title: Love Under Contract
description: Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister. In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.

title: The Tycoon’s Contract Bride
description: To save her father's bankrupt studio,brilliant designer Ella enters a two-year contract marriage with business tycoon Nicholas. He clears her $50 million debt; she plays his wife to handle family and business pressures. They agree to keep things strictly professional. But on their wedding night, Ella discovers her old designs covered in Nicholas's detailed annotations. At a gala, her ex Andy and Nicholas's admirer Vivian publicly humiliate her—until Nicholas pulls her into a passionate kiss and threatens to cut ties with anyone who speaks against her. Ella's heart wavers. Back home, Nicholas coldly insist sit was all for appearances, then confines her to the villa, banning her from his study. One drunken night, he forces himself on her, confessing years of secret love—only to dismiss it the next morning. Disillusioned, Ella resolves to break free. When she discovers Nicholas plagiarizing her designs, she tears up their contract and starts her own studio. His sabotage and Andy's harassment follow. Nicholas rescues her from Andy but gets slapped for demanding she return to him. He then uses his power to support her career, but Ella remains cold. When she wins a major design award, a desperate Andy attacks her with a knife—Nicholas saves her but ends up critically injured. At the hospital, Ella learns she's pregnant while Nicholas fights for his life. On his deathbed, he finally confesses everything was to win her love. Ella accepts her role as his wife and becomes the new head of the Thorne Group.

title: Pregnant by Contract
description: Diagnosed as infertile, wealthy heir Adrian Graham is forced into a marriage of convenience with pregnant girl, Marina Shaw. What begins as a transactional union soon unravels amidst corporate schemes and hidden dangers. But when a shocking truth emerges—the baby she carries is his own—their world turns upside down. Now, they must navigate family secrets, deceit, and a love that defies all odds.

title: Alpha's Fated Contract
description: With a single contract, the blooming wild rose became the Wolf King’s caged bird! She was a prey forced into sacrifice, a kept woman existing only for his lust. He thought he could possess and control her forever. But once the contract ended, the wild rose withdrew and walked away—and the one who descended into madness was the once-imperious Tyrant of the Night!

title: Double Contract Love
description:
After a passion wild night, Renee married a unknown man for revenging her mom on her stepmother and stepsister, and surprisingly found her new husband just the man she shared one night love with!
They both have a great interest in each other, but meanwhile they both hide something from each other. Would their one night love come into true love? And how would Renee carry out her revenge?

title: The Contract Wife’s Vengeance
description: Enduring six years of humiliation as a contract wife, Belle received nothing but her husband Nicholas's indifference, her rival's scheming, and even the betrayal of her own son. When she finally walked away battered and broken, the mysterious billionaire Sebastian stepped in with unwavering protection—only to reveal that this marriage had been nothing but a transaction all along. True love, after all, is never something you beg for. When the truth finally comes to light, who will be her ultimate destination?

title: The Billionaire's Masquerade
description: Hidden behind dazzling masks at Mardi Gras, Sergeant Shelby Trudeau and billionaire Griffin Roy let go of all inhibitions.  Three years later, a desperate Shelby marries a homeless man she doesn’t recognize is Griffin.  For reasons of his own, he lets her believe he’s poor.  Now two perfect strangers who aren’t actually strangers at all find themselves in the ultimate masquerade of the heart.

title: My Dear Brother is Obsessed With Me
description: Clyde enlists small time actress, Violet, to play the role of his long-lost sister, fulfilling his father's dying wish. Together, they face constant scrutiny and challenges from the antagonist. Living together , they inadvertently developed a forbidden romance. Determined to prove their taboo relationship, the antagonist sought to tarnish their reputation, leading Clyde's father to arrange Violet's marriage to another. In a desperate bid to reclaim their love, Clyde resolved to interrupt the wedding ceremony...

title: Falling for the Contract
description:
Forced into a marriage scandal by her stepmother, Grace Collins goes viral overnight.
To shut it down, she signs a contract marriage… with a patient she just met.

title: Savage Prescription
description: Emergency room nurse Clara is burdened with her husband’s massive gambling debts and scrapes by with endless backbreaking shifts. In a rainy alley, she saves the dying mafia godfather Dante, who immediately buys out all the debts and holds her captive as his exclusive doctor via a contract. Amid gang wars, her ex-husband’s betrayal and repeated life-or-death trials, she sheds her docile mask and fully darkens, transforming from an exploited underdog into a night queen who can wield guns and mastermind strategies. The two evolve from a twisted dynamic of control and captivity to mutual salvation, ruling the underworld side by side.

title: I Only Have Brisket for You
description: master Katelyn clashes with her cheating ex at a fancy restaurant, accidentally splattering Texas brisket on elite surgeon Benjamin. He hires her to pretend to be his fiancée for ten dollars to disrupt his rigid medical family. Her bold, down-to-earth personality melts the household’s cold etiquette, cures Benjamin’s long-term anorexia, and unravels his trauma over his late brother. As they bicker and bond over homemade barbecue, the fake engagement blooms into genuine love, with Katelyn’s secret rich uncle shocking high-society gossips.

title: Real or Fake? I Decide
description: Down on his luck, Caleb McGovern awakens the "Make-It-Real" System, where any fake becomes reality! When a scam text from a stock genius's "illegitimate son" pops up, Caleb plays along and receives $10 billion! He even buys a supreme combat skill for just $9.99, gaining the strength to fight 10 men at once! Now, reality bends to his will. His word is law! He can turn any fake into reality!

title: Hollywood Star's Fake Girlfriend
description: Ben, a famous celebrity actor, is on the height of success. But soon, his career comes at a risk when he is rumored to date another famous male celebrity. Allen(Ben's manager) offers Blake to be Ben's fake date for a while, until the rumors settle down. Ben and Blake start to blend in together, and go exclusive to suppress the rumors. Hearing the ongoing drama, Ria(Ben's ex-girlfriend) suspects their relationship, hence digs more into their lives. Soon, Ria unveils Blake's reality and the whole set-up to the world...

title: My Fake Girlfriend Is My Fiancée
description: Alexander gets tricked off his mountain and lands in the city with nothing. A mystery beauty offers him a fake boyfriend job. Plot twist? She's his runaway fiancée Kathryn. One fake date. One real marriage. Plus lots of fighting.

title: Fake Bankruptcy, Furious Heiress
description: On Alexis Bancroft's wedding day, her father, Raymond Bancroft, plans to name her Chairman. But his retirement post sparks rumors of the Bancroft family's bankruptcy! Snobs show their true colors, and her fiancé's family publicly humiliates her. Seeing their betrayal, Alexis calls her sister, Supreme Commander Natasha. Now, the Bancroft heiress is out for blood!

title: Faked My Death, Destroyed The Billionaire
description: She faked her death. Three years later, Sierra comes back to her own funeral with a new identity. She takes down her unfaithful ex and her best friend who betrayed her. She vows to take her three-year-old son back. For revenge, she teams up with Julian, the heir to the most powerful family. In a game of power, they go from sworn enemies to each other's only hope. Finally the truth comes out. They take everything back and find their way back to each other.

title: Oops!  My Fake Husband Got Me Pregnant!
description: A broke young woman agrees to be a stranger's wife for ninety days to save her brother from prison — only to learn her "husband" is the billionaire who has spent seventeen years searching for the girl who once saved his life.

title: Real or Fake? I Decide
description: Down on his luck, Caleb McGovern awakens the "Make-It-Real" System, where any fake becomes reality! When a scam text from a stock genius's "illegitimate son" pops up, Caleb plays along and receives $10 billion! He even buys a supreme combat skill for just $9.99, gaining the strength to fight 10 men at once! Now, reality bends to his will. His word is law! He can turn any fake into reality!

title: Fake Heiress? I'm the True Boss
description: Heiress Caroline Sterling's wedding is sabotaged by her fiancé Nathan Prescott's jealous sister, who questions her unborn child's paternity. A risky amniocentesis confirms the baby is a Prescott. Caroline's father announces the baby as a girl, causing the Prescotts to reject her. Planning to divorce after the baby is born, Caroline shocks the Prescotts on divorce day when they realize she has a son, not a daughter. She leaves to claim her fortune, leaving the Prescotts heirless.

title: The Fake Debutante and the True Billionaire
description: Driven to save her dying brother, Olivia Bennett is forced to pose as a debutante to win over wealthy Lian Cullen-until she catches the eye of his uncle, the powerful and intimidating Ethan Cullen. By day, she plays the elegant debutante; by night, a masked stripper in a dimly lit club. But as Lian's kindness hides hidden agendas, and Ethan's scheming fiancée Kim Smith closes in, Olivia finds her lies crumbling under Ethan's relentless pursuit.

title: My Fake Boyfriend Owns the World
description:
Jack Morgan, a top-tier capital tycoon, goes undercover as a maintenance worker to board the maiden flight of his own Skyline Airways, seeking firsthand insight into his company's actual operations. On board, he is belittled and humiliated by Sophie, a snobbish flight attendant, and Derek, a senior executive.
Mid-flight, the aircraft is struck by a severe thunderstorm and cannot land at any nearby airport. Jack arranges for an emergency landing on his private racetrack, and his true identity comes to light for the first time.
Emma, the chief purser, pleads with Jack to pose as her boyfriend to escape a forced marriage arranged by her family. Later, at the racetrack and a luxury car dealership, Jack repeatedly puts Emma's dismissive best friend and his romantic rival Tyler in their place for looking down on him. When his rebellious son Noah is exploited by Blackwood Capital and triggers a group-wide equity crisis, Jack effortlessly defuses the entire business conflict.

title: After My Faked Death, They Lost Their Minds
description: The White Wolf Priestess Eileen was loved by Alphas Joseph and Locke. To protect Joseph from a curse, she married Locke—but suffered abuse and lost her unborn child. Joseph returned claiming to heal her, but conspired with Locke and her sister Rona to destroy her. Eileen faked her death. Truths emerged—Joseph loved Rona, and the poison was real. Eileen awakened in the forbidden forest and learned the curse was a lie. After Rona's exposure and a final sacrifice from both Alphas, Eileen was reborn. She chose freedom, carrying her child's soul into the northern forest, never looking back.

title: Fake Sect, Real Genius
description: Desperate to survive, our failing sect pretended to be legendary masters to trick one guy into joining. Turns out, he’s a transmigrator who literally wrote the book on cultivation. He just created spirit roots—a concept that never existed here. Now the whole world wants him. And we have to keep lying to keep him.

title: Puck Perfect: My Sex Education Tutor
description:
Olivia, an art student harboring a secret crush on a star hockey player, accidentally stumbles upon the shocking truth: Liam, the campus playboy, is secretly an anonymous adult content creator.
To keep his secret safe, the two enter into a dangerous "fake dating" pact. As they navigate endless teasing, power struggles, and joint battles against campus bullying and malicious schemes, their pretend romance begins to blur into real passion.
However, just as they finally face their true feelings for each other, a deadly blackmail scheme threatens to destroy everything Liam holds dear...

title: Real vs. Fake Heiress
description: Jane Lynch was sponsored by a rich billionaire, Mr. James. Because of a misunderstanding, Jane thought she was Mr. James's long-lost daughter. But it was not true. At the billionaire's house, she met his real daughter, Maya, whom he also sponsored. Jane kept bullying the true heiress Maya, and she caused many problems in Mr. James's company. Jane almost ruined Mr. James's company. Will this evil and mean girl get punished?

title: The Fake Heiress's Revenge
description: My best friend died with an Ivy League acceptance in one hand... and a billionaire heir's secrets in the other. So I reinvented myself as a Silicon Valley heiress and started dating the man who destroyed her. His family mocked me, used me, and treated me like their personal ATM. I smiled through every insult—because I was collecting evidence. But when I overheard them plotting to drug me, get me pregnant, and steal my fortune... the hunt officially began.

title: Leaving the Fake-Poor Alpha
description: Elena and her son Noah spend a year collecting scrap energy cans just to afford one night at the Moonlight Carnival, only to find her husband Kyle has secretly rented the entire place for his first love, Selena, and her son. For seven years, Kyle claimed he was a penniless outcast, while saving his money, tenderness, and public status for another family. Elena finally files for divorce, takes Noah away, exposes Selena’s lies, and makes Kyle learn that late compensation may help his son, but it will never win back his wife.

title: A Spicy Text to My Nemesis
description: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?

title: The Strongest Bodyguard
description: Bennett Lilley is dispatched on a covert mission to protect Rachel Snyder, a formidable billionaire. Disguised as a security guard, Bennett delves deep into Rachel's life. As a host of wealthy adversaries closes in, their worlds become inextricably intertwined.

title: Testing the Fake Bride
description: After elite spouse Victoria catches her husband Bradley Sterling cheating, she plots revenge. When pregnant mistress Jessica Harper arrives to taunt her, she mistakes elegant Victoria for Bradley's mom. Victoria plays along, controlling Jessica with a 'bride test' and demanding to meet her parents. Eager for wealth, Jessica arranges this at her father's birthday, where Victoria publicly exposes her affair and pregnancy. Victoria then pretends to plan their wedding while gathering evidence. At the ceremony, she airs surveillance footage, forcing Bradley to surrender all assets. Victoria wins the divorce and keeps her wealth, leaving the duo utterly disgraced.

title: My Commander Husband Chose a Cat Girl Over Me
description:
For seven years, Silver Wolf soldier Ella and Northern Guard commander Kane were seen as the perfect couple. To support Kane’s role in the Catfolk settlement's reconstruction and garrison duties, Ella turned her back on her own family, gave up her promotion opportunities, and even taught herself the Catfolk language—all just to be closer to him.
But when she finally understood the Catfolk girl Naira's whispered confession at the bonfire—"I'm pregnant. It's yours"—Ella realized her seven years of devotion had been nothing but a joke. Fire, false accusations, and a plunge off a cliff… Ella was betrayed, misunderstood, and abandoned. Only when the truth finally surfaced—Naira's pregnancy was fake, and Naira's brother Riven hadn't died saving Kane, but had faked his death to become the leader of a border smuggling ring—did it become clear that Kane had been trapped in an elaborate deception from the very beginning.
But love that arrives too late is worth nothing. By the time Kane saw the truth and regretted everything, Ella had already left the North with her wounds and found a new life teaching in a remote community in the Southern Valley.

title: Death Touch
description: Ivy was raised in a lab because her touch can kill — an ability she doesn’t understand and can’t control. Now, she’s been sent to a military high school to become the government’s greatest weapon. Xaden, the elite soldier forced to train her, hates that she’s replacing him. But as they grow closer, the one thing Ivy wants most—to be touched—might kill the only person who’s ever cared about her.

title: The Sister Who Stole My Fate
description: Seraphina and I both died once. In my last life, she stole my face, pretended to be the Oracle, and was exposed by the king. Then she poisoned me in the dungeon, screaming that I had stolen her fate. When we were reborn, she changed her plan. In front of the royal proclamation, she pointed at me and sent me to the palace, certain the fake Oracle would be executed. But I was never fake. I was the true Oracle, and this time, I would make the king kneel before the future she tried to steal.

title: He Faked Illness To Betray Me
description:
For three years, Ava believed her husband was slowly dying after saving her father’s life.
While her family begged for help in the freezing streets of Brooklyn, she spent every dollar trying to save him.
Then one snowy night, Ava follows a tracking chip to a luxury penthouse—and finds him perfectly healthy, wrapped around another woman, laughing about how easy she was to fool.
But the man who scammed her made one dangerous mistake:He chose the wrong woman to betray.......

title: The Fake Hero Never Saw Me Coming
description: Yale's younger brother steals the coveted SSS-class mech core, believing it will make him humanity's savior, unaware it's actually bait for disaster. Seeing through the trap, Yale chooses the ridiculed F-class "junk" core and is exiled to a frontier star system. Teaming up with three fellow outcasts, he unlocks its hidden power and builds the galaxy's strongest mech squad. When the false hero falls, Yale becomes humanity's only hope.

title: Forced to Marry My Ruined Ex: The Duke's Revenge
description:
When the Duke dies suddenly, his greedy brother Richard steals the title and fortune. Overnight, Cordelia—the Duke’s only daughter—is stripped of her nobility and secretly blinded in a vicious plot. To protect her commoner lover, Luke, she brutally breaks his heart and drives him away. Believing she abandoned him for status, Luke leaves for the frontier, fueled by hatred.

Years later, Luke returns as Luciano Thorne, the Empire's most powerful war hero and new Duke. Meanwhile, Cordelia is trapped at home, desperately guarding what's left of her inheritance. When her uncle forces the blind Cordelia to marry a 70-year-old merchant, Luciano arrives with an immense dowry to claim her himself.
Luciano intends to punish her for the "betrayal." But seeing her scars and suffering, his hatred turns back into obsession. As they get caught up in revenge and irresistible attraction, the truth finally comes to light.

Ultimately, the feared war god bows only to her, restoring her sight and placing the ducal crown back on the woman he has always worshiped.

title: My Forced Alpha Mate:Our Blood Calls
description: The opening masterpiece of the Moon God Trilogy—Clara, a forsaken mixed-blood orphan, is publicly rejected by an Alpha and branded with a mark of shame. After awakening the bloodline of the Moon God, she transforms into a Silver Moon Warwolf, rises from the ruins, rallies the outcasts, is crowned queen, and seals away the evil god. All the humiliation and betrayal of her past vanish the moment she gains immortality. But this is only the beginning of the Moon God’s legend—the shadows are not yet extinguished. A thousand years later, Isabella, the last survivor of the Moon Wolf Clan, will embark on a destiny entangled with Lycan King Blake in the second installment. And in the even more distant future, the third generation’s bloodline will bring the trilogy to its final chapter in the war of the end times.

title: This Child Is a Legendary Sorcerer
description:
Cole was the undisputed Supreme Sorcerer — until he died in a cataclysmic magical war. His soul reincarnated into the body of a young boy named Leo — a boy afflicted with a Death Curse, with little time left to live.
The only hope: the Starlight Potion, guarded by the arrogant Westwood family.
Leo’s mother, Clara, a powerless ordinary woman, humbled herself before the Westwoods, begging for the potion to save her son.They ridiculed her. Humiliated her. But Clara never backed down. 
Until Leo could take it no more.Something inside Leo shattered.
A pressure so immense it cracked the marble floor exploded from his tiny frame. The entire Westwood mansion trembled. Every sorcerer in the room was forced to their knees — their faces pressed to the ground, unable to breathe, unable to speak.
But no one knew: Clara herself had also been struck by the Death Curse. And in the end, for the sake of her child, she gave the only life-saving potion to Leo.

title: Primarch Genesis
description: Kane, once the Empire’s youngest war god, was framed by his closest ally and exiled to a junkyard planet as a lowly outcast. To clear his name of treason, he pilots the ancient mecha Primarch and infiltrates the Empire’s top mecha academy, where he plays the underdog while uncovering a massive conspiracy. When an army of Void Beasts descends, he is forced to join forces with his former enemies—only to discover that Primarch’s core holds his mother’s Star Core bloodline. In the end, Kane chooses to protect the common people as a knight, rejects the lure of power, and soars across the stars with the princess. This is a fiery mecha epic of betrayal, redemption, revenge, and guardianship.

title: Unworthy No More
description: Kyle, once deemed unable to cultivate, was forced into a deadly succession trial as a disposable pawn. His parents were killed protecting him. After three years in hiding, he returns, awakened by a mysterious black tome through his unyielding will, inheriting a forbidden power. Reborn through suffering, Kyle rises step by step to the peak of strength, no longer the boy they discarded, but a force that challenges so-called invincibility.

title: How to Land a Movie Star
description: When ambitious casting assistant Cleo Marlowe risks everything to convince movie star Blake Wilder to act in her movie, she doesn’t expect him to say yes, or for the paparazzi to catch her walking out of his house. Branded as the girl who slept her way to a get ahead, Cleo becomes Hollywood’s favorite rumor. But while her reputation takes a nosedive, the notoriously cold and gruff Blake starts to show up for her in ways she never saw coming.

title: Watch Out! You Cheated on a National Hero！
description: After seven years in the military, Alex returns home hoping to spend Christmas with his wife, Chloe—only to discover her betrayal with Brandon, the rich bully who once humiliated her. At their high school reunion, Chloe forces Alex to sign divorce papers, while Brandon mocks and threatens him in front of everyone. To them, Alex is just a broke, powerless loser. But they have no idea who they are provoking. When Alex makes one quiet phone call, a mysterious force races toward the hotel—and everyone who laughed at him is about to face the truth.

title: Unworthy No More
description: Kyle, once deemed unable to cultivate, was forced into a deadly succession trial as a disposable pawn. His parents were killed protecting him. After three years in hiding, he returns, awakened by a mysterious black tome through his unyielding will, inheriting a forbidden power. Reborn through suffering, Kyle rises step by step to the peak of strength, no longer the boy they discarded, but a force that challenges so-called invincibility.

title: Daughter of Poseidon Forsakes you
description:
"Lorde, the Daughter of the Sea‑God, was betrayed by her husband Demos and her handmaiden Chloris, who cast her off the cliffs of Mount Olympus. As she lay dying, she finally learned that Helios, the deposed Sun‑God, had always loved her deeply — and he traded his divine status for her rebirth.
Returned to the age of eighteen, Lorde rejects her old betrothal to seek out Helios, only to face forced marriage imposed by Zeus once more. The two join forces to hatch a plot, reclaim the Sun‑God’s staff, expose the truth behind the murder in their past life, and make the wrongdoers pay for their crimes. In the end, they hold their wedding on the island of Rhodes and embrace a new beginning."

title: Heiress of Luck
description: A banished goddess crash-lands into the life of a bullied heiress. Forced to fix her new family's drama and foil a deadly plot, she discovers that even in poverty, her luck—and love life—is just getting started.

title: Ex-Warrior King & His Heiress
description: Retired Warrior King Jayson Hinds mistakenly ends up on a blind date with Tamara Britton, a CEO avoiding a forced marriage. After an unexpected night together, Tamara proposes a contract marriage to evade marrying Abe Krause. But there's always more trouble coming their way...

title: Peerless in the Mundane
description: A mild-mannered office worker awakens to his true power, as he's forced into a marriage with a deadly goddess to save the world, only to uncover that his "ordinary" life was the greatest lie of all!

title: The Diary of a Workshop Veteran
description: After being forced into retirement, factory expert Theresa is replaced by her ambitious mentee, who refuses her guidance. As Theresa starts a new life elsewhere, her former company begins collapsing without the one person who truly understood its machines.

title: Divorced: Spoiled Rotten by an Adorable Daughter and Three Billionaire Brothers
description: Audrey Sterling endured three years of abuse after marrying into The Crawford Family. Her mother-in-law forces her to care for her husband's pregnant cousin, Veronica, who is actually the homewrecker. Meanwhile, Audrey's three long-lost brothers finally find her, and Master Tristan heads to Oakmont to bring her home.

title: Return of the Lost Tycoon
description: Left to die in a river, the boy is raised by a poor couple who give him everything. Years later, he returns a billionaire, only to find his adoptive father dead, his mother forced to remarry, and the family grave set for demolition. Now they'll all pay.

title: Demon Hunters: Home Edition
description: The apocalypse forces a choice: bow to the beasts or bleed for home. Marcus Joyce assembles the unlikeliest heroes to win the battle. Together, they protect what's left.

title: His Mistress Drives My Car
description: My husband's mistress just rammed my car with her brand-new luxury car—and now she's demanding I pay for it. She doesn't know I'm the one bankrolling her lifestyle. Or that I have the receipts.

title: Mistaken as the Mistress
description: Vivian comes home early to celebrate her son Noah's engagement party, but his fiancée Mia mistakes her as his mistress, resulting in Vivian's public shame and abuse. When Noah arrives and finds his mother missing, he quickly erupts in anger and vows to find his mother at all costs!

title: Pregnant Yet Mistaken for a Mistress
description:
"Sophia, the secret chairwoman of a Wall Street conglomerate, lets her husband Richard run the firm. Jealous secretary Chloe mistakes the pregnant Sophia for a mistress. Aided by corrupt directors, Chloe attacks her and tries to terminate her baby.

Richard rescues Sophia. Sophia exposes Chloe’s crimes of espionage and bombing, and crushes her corporate ally with a clever financial trap. Chloe ends up insane in prison. Richard recovers from severe wounds. Sophia holds onto her empire, and the couple have a new baby."

title: The Mistress Trap
description:
Betty Bennett is a beautiful woman wanted by every rich man in Fraudensia. After all, she is the best escort for a high-end group of personnels. She is approached to murder Austin by his wife, Janice, who promises her a sizeable portion of Austin’s inheritance.
However, the night of the murder turns out to be the beginning of the fight for her life. Frightened for her safety, she runs to her brother for help. Betty needs to find out what is really going on. Her stubborn nature won’t let her sit around and let everything fall into place. Terry learns that Janice was once his ex-lover. The end to their relationship was bitter with one almost killing the other.
Determined to get revenge on Terry and his family, Janice is blind to how everything will eventually affect her. Betty learns the truth. Betty chases after Janice so she pays for ruining her life and reputation. Betty sets her trap, making sure that Janice never hurts anyone again.
A murder, a cover up and a conspiracy story is what drives this series of the Mistress trap. Will Betty finally emerge on top? What secrets will be uncovered in this series?

title: The Escaping Mistress
description: In Thoman Estate two families—the affluent Kane's and the middle-class Sands —become close due to an unspoken bond they share. Ann Kane is married to Noah, a powerful businessman known for his shrewdness. Across town, Joan Sands is married to Mark, a kind but flawed artist who often feels overshadowed by his wife’s steady determination and grit being the breadwinner. Things become more tense when the Joan discover, Noah and Mark are having affairs with the same person Sandra. Ann learns this from her. At first, they each plan separate schemes to deal with their cheating spouses. However, after confiding in each other, the two women decide to work together to rein in the mistresses, whom they assume are different people. Joan realizes that her husband’s mistress, Sandra, has been encouraging him to treat her better, subtly building up his self-esteem. Intrigued by the positive influence Sandra has on Mark, Ann decides to hire Sandra to “tame” Noah and perhaps even bring him back to her. But things go awry when Ann and Joan discover that both of their husbands have been seeing Sandra...

title: Falling Objects, Fallen Mistress
description: CEO Tristan Kelly's mistress, Vivian Camp, injures his wife, Clara Finch, with a falling object. Tristan's mother, Katherine, rushes to save her daughter-in-law only to face more hostility...

title: The Heiress Strikes Back
description:
On her birthday, Serena, female chair of the Sterling Consortium on Wall Street, discovers that her husband Hunter has used her trust fund to buy luxury cars for Chloe. At the car‑crash scene, Chloe arrogantly humiliates Serena, unaware that the woman she is confronting is the legal wife.
At the charity gala, Serena makes a spectacular entrance. She publicly exposes the sordid deeds of her husband and Chloe, initiates divorce proceedings and asset‑forfeiture measures, leaving the betrayers to suffer the consequences of their own actions.

title: My Husband's Mistress is Dead
description:
Seattle's relentless rain brings a chilling nightmare to Marilyn's doorstep: her husband's secret mistress has been brutally murdered. Overnight, the illusion of her perfect marriage completely shatters. Four months pregnant and seemingly blindsided, Marilyn is thrust into a terrifying police investigation where her husband, David, is named the prime suspect.
Yet, as Detective Sarah Green digs deeper into the dual tragedies, eerie inconsistencies begin to surface—most notably, a ghostly figure caught on a neighbor's security camera in the dead of night. Everyone has a deadly motive, and no one is truly innocent. Trapped in a twisted game of cat and mouse, how far will a desperate widow go to survive? In a city where the truth is obscured by deception, the most chilling question remains: who is the real puppet master orchestrating this bloodbath?

title: My Husband Cheated on Me With His Dad's Mistress
description: Claire witnessed her husband Julian's abnormal relationship with 50-year-old nanny Debbie in her previous life, and was tragically killed by Julian, his mother-in-law Barbara, and the nanny. After rebirth, she returned to the time before the tragedy, no longer weak and crying, but calmly plotting her revenge. Claire made Julian and the nanny embarrass themselves in public. She also exposed the shocking scandal that the nanny was carrying her father-in-law's baby. She tried to reclaim her assets, sending the bad people to their doom, and ultimately breaking free from the nightmare life.

title: The Karmic Heiress
description:
"I had been switched at birth for seventeen years.
When my wealthy biological parents finally found me, they showed up in patched shirts, pretending to be poor. Together with the fake heiress, Seraphina, they threw me into a condemned building and forced me to repay them fifty thousand dollars every month.
Then one day, my mother publicly cursed whoever had framed me, saying they would “go blind and have their legs broken.”
The next morning, on the red carpet at a ball, Seraphina’s eyes bled and both her legs snapped.
Only then did they fall to their knees before me, screaming, “Who the hell are you?”
I lowered my eyes. A flash of dark gold passed through my pupils.
“The witch who didn’t burn on the Salem stake three hundred years ago.”"

title: Reborn Heiress: My Ex Regrets Everything
description: After Damian chooses his mistress Luna over Serena and their child, Serena is reborn. She exposes their lies, reclaims her family business, and takes back control of her life. Serena divorces Damian, brings Luna to justice, and returns as CEO with Adrian by her side.

title: The Wastrel & The Assassin
description: Mother's mysterious death, stepmother's deadly conspiracy, hateful brother... Thomas decides to pose as a wastrel to fool everyone.  But his father hires Harper, a bodyguard known as the God of Slaughter, to protect him. Now, who'll outsmart whom?

title: Wall Street to Wilderness: The Montana Druid
description: Exhausted by the endless corporate grind of Wall Street, elite executive Lauren quits her job and sinks her life savings into an abandoned, 200-acre farm in the remote mountains of Montana. Seeking a peaceful escape, she unexpectedly awakens a "Druid" superpower—the ability to hear and communicate with wild animals. Using smart management strategies and gourmet food, Lauren recruits an incredible crew of wildlife employees: porcupines as automated farm equipment, a massive black bear as a bulldozer, hydro-engineer beavers, and a pack of wild grey wolves acting as her ultimate security team. With their help, the barren wasteland transforms into a luxurious ecological estate. However, when her farm's ultra-premium products go viral on TikTok, they attract the greed of her ex-fiancé Chad and corrupt local tycoon Miller. Facing cyber-smears, power grid sabotage, and a brutal night raid by heavily armed poachers, Lauren leads her multi-species army in an epic counterattack, crushing the capitalist threats with the raw power of nature and rising as the undisputed queen of her "Montana Druid Empire".

title: The Heiress Strikes Back
description: Amelia Everhart has been a maid her whole life, until she realizes she’s the long-lost heiress of the Keller family, the most powerful family in LA. However, her evil-stepsister steals her identity and her 3 brothers kick her out. Now, she’s risen up from the ashes – and she vows to take her sweet sweet revenge.

title: ReelTalk EP 89-Bound By Blooper
description: Jesse Morales and Grandma Dana couldn’t keep it together while reading Bound by Love and Sweet Temptation. Watch their funniest outtakes!

title: The Mafia Heiress Crashes Her Sister's Auction
description: I’m Scarlett Moretti, the hidden heir of North America’s deadliest arms syndicate. I came back after three years, only to find my little sister caged and auctioned in my own house—sold by her fiancé and my traitor father. My broke mom fought to buy her with priceless family relics, while those villains mocked her ruthlessly. I stepped out of shadow to crush them all. But the coward Christian survived, plotted with cartels and my dad to leak Lily’s humiliating footage and blow up our charity gala. Can I protect my family and wipe out every betrayer for good?

title: Reborn Heiress Strikes Back
description: Lila Wilson is reborn back in time after her evil adoptive sister Paris tricked her six brothers into sending her to her death. With her second chance in life, Lila is determined to not make the same mistakes she ignoring her brothers, choosing to focus on her studies and robot fighting and streaming career. However, this time, Lila isn’t alone. Seth Campbell, the secret heir of Campbell family and the man who caused the car accident that took her parent’s lives, is determined to take care of her and support her career and dream of getting into her parents’ university. With his help, Lila is able to get a good score in her ACT test, get a leg up into the AI robot streaming industry, and get into her parents’ university. Seeing this, Paris tries to enact her original plan of pretending to be sick and making the brothers force Lila to donate her kidney to her, so that she can kill Lila on the operating table. But this time, Lila and Seth successfully prove that Paris bribed the doctors into faking her medical condition, her father who the brothers thought saved Lila’s life actually planned to kidnap their parents, and she has been lying about Lila to ruin the brothers’ relationship with her. Lila cuts ties with her abusive and unsupportive brothers and earns her own happy ending with Seth.

title: Tarpped in the Summer Heat
description: When Marin’s five-year-old daughter is locked in a sweltering car, her husband Ryan ignores her desperate calls—too busy playing “daddy” to his mistress’s son. By the time Marin tears across the city to save her, Lily is barely breathing. Devastated and clear-eyed at last, Marin walks away from the marriage and rebuilds her life, only to find that the man who betrayed her—and the woman who stole him—are far from done with her.

title: The true heiress returning is the grand priestess of fat
description: After completing her final trial, Elena, the High Priestess of the Hidden Order, learned that fragments of her soul were missing and that she needed to go to the Sterling and Forrester families—where her biological parents were—to retrieve them. The two families were on the verge of a marriage alliance, and she seized the opportunity to return. But she soon discovered that both families were riddled with schemes and intrigue, and there were villains coveting the power of the Hidden Order and the wealth of the Forrester family. While fighting against these conspiracies, Elena searched for her missing soul fragments, ultimately uncovering the truth, protecting her identity and the one she loved, and completing her self-redemption and the closing of her fate.

title: Hale Heiress Strikes Back
description: After Serena, the wealthy heiress of Renwick Bay, uncovers her fiancé Jake’s betrayal, she is framed and embroiled in an unexpected entanglement with Marcus, a ruthless mafia godfather. To save her wrongfully accused father, she struggles to survive amid Marcus’s overpowering dominance and vengeful schemes. Weathering successive blows of betrayal and family ruin, she rises from the ashes of despair. In the end, Serena and Marcus resolve the long-standing feud and misunderstanding between their families, walking hand in hand into a grand wedding.

title: When Heaven Made a Mistake
description: Audrey Beck, a fortune fairy who disrupted the balance of karma, is punished by being sent to the mortal realm with a mission to change the fate of the nation. Unexpectedly, she encounters her reincarnated sister, a biased father, and ends up in an arranged marriage with a notorious playboy! Yet, why does his family all seem to be cursed with short lives? But Audrey is ready to defy destiny and change everyone's fate!

title: Blood and Betrayal
description:
A wealthy heiress hides her identity for love, only to be betrayed and destroyed by her husband and a vicious mistress.
Cruel abuse, painful miscarriage, and endless humiliation push her to the edge.
When her powerful family arrives, the scumbags kneel in regret.
She divorces, takes back her throne, crushes her enemies, and becomes the ultimate female ruler.

title: Mistaken as the Mistress
description: Vivian comes home early to celebrate her son Noah's engagement party, but his fiancée Mia mistakes her as his mistress, resulting in Vivian's public shame and abuse. When Noah arrives and finds his mother missing, he quickly learns that Mia's claims stemmed from a misunderstanding, and he manages to rescue the distressed Vivian. Everyone involved in abusing Vivian is questioned. Mia lies and claims she's pregnant with Noah's child. This prompts Noah and Vivian to demand a DNA test to confirm the baby is Noah's. Meanwhile, her efforts to charm Noah's grandmother, Catherine, backfire when Catherine uncovers that Mia has given her fake birthday gifts. Infuriated, Catherine declares that Mia cannot marry into the Harper family. In a desperate act, Mia plans to poison Vivian using tea but is asked to drink a cup before Vivian. When confronted, she blames her friend for her actions. The truth unfolds when the actual father of Mia's child arrives, unveiling her scheme. The villains are dragged away as the Harper family reunites across three generations.

title: Waitress Pregnant, CEO Fell in Love
description: As a waitress, Lily had a one-night stand with the rich CEO, Damon. Then Damon proposed a contract marriage for the baby. Lily thought marrying Damon was just a deal. She thought Damon would ask for a divorce after she gave birth to the baby. She worked hard to prove her worth, only to realize he had secretly cleared her path and supported her dreams all along. True love helps you become your best self.

title: The Empress's Final Wish
description: On her deathbed, Empress Rosa clings to life over an unfulfilled wish, while her three sons ruthlessly vie for the throne. Meanwhile, Celeste arrives to help the Empress. Dismissed by the skeptical princes, Celeste enters the palace, where the dying Empress miraculously revives, kneels, and addresses her as her lady...

title: Cheat on Me? Then Go Bankrupt
description: For five years, Evelyn Lane poured everything—her wealth, her name, her future—into building Darren Foster's empire. But when he lets his junior, Claire, wear her late grandmother's costume on stage, the betrayal cuts deeper than any wound she's hidden. Evelyn pulls the funding, files for divorce, and sells her shares. Darren thinks she's broken. But he doesn’t know she's been the legendary “God of Opera” all along—or that the biggest stage of all is where she’ll take back what's hers.

title: Cheater's Game
description: As a seasoned gambler and master of the game, I've seen it all. Here's a simple truth: steer clear of gambling. In this world, nine out of ten bets are a con.

title: My Fiance Cheated, So I Chose His Billionaire Dad
description: When Lia catches her arrogant fiancé cheating on Christmas Eve, a steamy one-night stand with a dominant older stranger seems like the perfect revenge. But the next morning brings a terrifying revelation: the ruthless billionaire who handcuffed her to the bed and demanded her total submission is Silas Sterling—her cheating fiancé’s father. Buried under her grandmother’s crushing medical debts and caught in Silas’s dark, possessive obsession, Lia is forced into a dangerous game of taboo seduction...

title: Make my cheating husband pay the price
description:
Catherine, pregnant and controller of FG Group, catches her husband Jesse cheating on video with mistress Mia. She brings his disabled father Walter to the billiard parlor, where Mia shatters Catherine's family crest necklace, smokes illegally, and brutally assaults both the pregnant Catherine and elderly Walter—almost killing the unborn child.

When Jesse arrives, he takes Mia's side—until he learns Walter is his biological father and Mia has committed grievous bodily harm. Business tycoon John Morgan, who had cut ties with Jesse, watches Catherine's abuse live. He arrives, reveals his true identity, and shatters Jesse's business hopes.

Jesse and Mia slander Catherine, but she files suit with full evidence of assault, adultery, and illegal fund diversion. They are arrested and imprisoned. A year later, Catherine makes the Forbes list. John Morgan proposes publicly. Catherine lets go of the past and begins a new life.

title: Cheater's Game
description: As a seasoned gambler and master of the game, I've seen it all. Here's a simple truth: steer clear of gambling. In this world, nine out of ten bets are a con.

title: Say Goodbye to My Cheating Wife
description: After five years of marriage, Nicholas discovered that his wife lsabelle had long found a new lover. He decided to erase all traces of himself and disappear forever—never to see those who betrayed him again.

title: My Royal Rebound
description: Head over heels for Preston, the Principal's son, Mia has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with the rich heiress Vivian Walden, Mia hatches a grand escape plan with Preston's opportunistic mother. Will Preston capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Sebastian, the mysterious royal boy from London get Mia's love?

title: The Billionaire's Accidental Bride
description: In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of modeling, Claire Duval discovers her fiancé's betrayal on the eve of their wedding. Teaming up with mogul Christian Cross for a marriage of convenience, she embarks on a journey to reclaim her life and career, navigating love, deception, and a desire for justice against the backdrop of the high stakes fashion industry.

title: Darker Shades of Elise
description: Housewife Elise's life takes an exciting but dangerous turn when she begins an affair with Felix, who encourages her to experiment sexually. When Elise tries to end the affair, Felix blackmails her, in this tale of love, fantasy, and sexual obsession.

title: Fated Bride: Uncle Became the Lover
description: Anne has been chosen as Gavin's little bride since childhood. But on their engagement day, Gavin cheated on her with Grace. Anne was heartbroken and had a one-night stand with a man called Robert. She was forced to be Robert's secret lover for three years. However, she didn't know Robert was exactly Gavin's uncle, Arman. Anne thought she was saved by Gavin many years ago, but actually it was Arman who saved her. She and Arman finally got together and lived happily ever after...

title: Rules of Protection: The Bodyguard I Hate
description: Elena and Ace used to be engaged for marriage. But, after Ace is disabled from the war, he pretends to cheat on Elena to save her from his new disability. Three years pass until the CEO of a medical insurance company gets shot. Elena needs a personal bodyguard, and Ace just happens to be the one for the job. Will Elena and Ace repair their rocky past and reignite the love they once had for each other?

title: Her Double, His Trouble
description: Identical twins Erin and Elise were torn apart as kids.  20 years later, gently Elise is betrayed by the two people she trusted most — her husband and best friend — then tortured and left for dead.  Grief-stricken and furious, badass CEO Erin steps into her dead sister’s life to exact revenge.  Their faces may be carbon copies, but  Erin is no one one to mess with as she systematically and pyschologically pits her sister’s husband and  best friend against each other in a cat and mouse game to destroy the murderers.

title: Scorched Heart
description: Samantha Hughes waited a whole year for AURA’s final farewell concert, only to find her childhood sweetheart Logan kissing Sierra outside the venue after giving away Sam’s VIP ticket. When Logan keeps choosing Sierra, exposes Sam’s family trauma, and later abandons her during a fire, Sam finally sees the boy she loved is gone. She withdraws from Berkeley, moves to New York, rebuilds her life with her mother, and refuses every attempt Logan makes to drag her back. Even when Sierra tries to ruin her reputation and Logan begs for another chance, Sam chooses peace, dignity, and a new love who actually stays.

title: Doctor, Sleep with Me, Heal My Heart
description: Shanley buries her fiancé's affair behind a forced smile. But sleepless nights bring her to Simon, a healer who sees through her. Under his gentle guidance, she finds her voice. On the day she was supposed to say "I do," she says "I'm done" instead. And when their families' history comes to light, in the clinic where she first asked for help, he proposed to her.

title: Betrayal Served Hot
description: Eighth-gen Donovan cook Ethan spent a decade turning Crest into a top restaurant, only to be paid just $3,000 a month. Right before New Year's Eve, his friends Olivia Monroe and Avery Kane fired him, manipulated by apprentice Wyatt Blake. Wyatt thought he could easily replace Ethan, but the guests hated his food and demanded refunds. Facing total ruin, Olivia and Avery begged Ethan to return. But Ethan had finally seen their true colors.

title: Betrayal and Rebirth
description:
Seven years ago, my parents'adopted daughter, my younger sister Selene, a delicate Omega, got drunk, caused a hit and run, and left blood spilled across the Human Territory Border.
My Alpha father, my Luna mother, and my biological younger sister all came to me with the same patronizing plea.
“Selene is an Omega. She’s too fragile for prison. If she goes to Silvermoon Penitentiary, her wolf won’t survive it. Lyra, take her place. Please.”
I refused.
But on a stormy night filled with thunder, my father used absolute Alpha Command. He crushed my will, took control of my mind, and personally delivered me to the prison transport.
My fiancé, my Fated Mate, Kaelen, the strongest Alpha in the Pack, held back his raging Wolf Aura and said to me, “Lyra, when you get out, we'll complete the Mate bond. Endure these seven years for now.”

title: Betrayal. Beef. Billions.
description: Evan Cooper runs a butcher shop in Silverport with his cousin Nolan.  He was slaved away at this shop, helping make over $2 million a year—yet only earned $80,000. Sick of being exploited, he risked a $200,000 debt to open his own honest, fresh meat shop and quickly won loyal customers. His greedy cousin Nolan used rotten, tainted meat to cut costs, leading to a $3 million ruin, a broken family, and total disgrace. When relatives tried to frame Evan, his parents stood by him. Evan went on to secure huge contracts, took over a meatpacking plant, paid off all debts, and brought his family to Silverport. Nolan, however, was left crippled and homeless, crushed by his own greed. A brutal, inspiring story: integrity wins, greed destroys.

title: The Day of Betrayal, I Took Everything
description: Former beauty queen Wendy thought marrying into the Carter family was her fairy-tale ending, only to discover it was a living nightmare. Her husband Jonathan sees her only as his "No. 113 collectible" and is secretly having an affair with her sister-in-law, Chloe. Betrayed and belittled, Wendy refuses to suffer in silence. Armed with an IVF pregnancy and a strategically swapped piece of underwear, she ignites a path of calculated revenge. Teaming up with Sean, her husband's scorned illegitimate brother, she exposes Jonathan's litany of sins at the climax of the family's farewell banquet. Just when everyone believes she is only fighting for a divorce, Wendy reveals her true fangs—she demands not just her freedom, but for the entire Carter dynasty to pay for their arrogance.

title: Doted by the Big Shot After Betrayal
description: Orphan Aria dreams of jewelry design but is betrayed—her work stolen, her uncle selling her out, and framed by a spiked drink. She escapes into the suite of Dominic, a mysterious biker. They fall in love in a tiny garage—but she doesn't know he's the tycoon her cousin was set to marry. Investigating her parents' "accident," she uncovers murder tied to a smuggling ring and her uncle. Aria wins a world jewelry competition, exposes the theft, and with Dominic's hidden help, brings the killers to justice. She reclaims her family company—and he proposes with a pull-tab ring.

title: Orbiting Betrayal
description: Star astronaut Maya discovers her husband in bed with a TV reporter. His excuse? A fake twin brother. She plays along, boards her shuttle to explore a black hole—and returns a different woman.

title: Diagnosis: Betrayal
description: Sadie, a top urologist in Riverton, secretly seeks treatment for her infertile husband, Scott, to protect his pride. But when Scott becomes obsessed with having a child, Millie fakes a pregnancy to seduce him. Shockingly, Scott gifts Millie a real diamond necklace and gives Sadie a fake one. With help from her assistant and patients, Sadie uncovers the truth and, no longer willing to stay silent, fights back against the betrayal.

title: Sweet Revenge: From Betrayal to Beloved
description: Jorie is reborn before her life was stolen, before her fiancé and stepsister destroyed her future. This time, she flips the script by marrying Uncle Theodore, a steadfast, powerful man fourteen years older, and kicks her ex-fiancé out of the family for good.

title: The Coldest Betrayal
description: While loading his truck, Ethan was too busy on the phone with his mistress to notice he had locked his wife, Lila, inside the refrigerated container—and turned the cooling on. A passerby, Calvin, heard her faint cries and tried to pry the door open, only to be accused of theft. But Calvin didn't give up.
