He found Lila—barely alive, frozen, and unconscious—and rushed her to the hospital. Yet again, Ethan made things difficult for him. Only when confronted with the horrifying truth—that he had nearly killed his own wife—did Ethan break down.

title: After Their Betrayal, the Ancestor Blood Awakened
description: On her eighteenth birthday, her contract partner kneels before the crowd—and kisses her sister's fingertips instead. He snaps her ring, tears their blood oath, and calls her a useless nobody. The backlash makes him cough blood. But the moment the contract shatters, something ancient stirs inside Ella. Something that has been waiting for eighteen years. And now, it wakes up......

title: Loving You For The Price Of Betrayal
description:
On her 7th anniversary with her boyfriend, aspiring filmmaker Sia plans a surprise celebration, only to catch him cheating. 
Reflecting on her past, she sees a pattern of love and betrayal. In the aftermath, three men seek her forgiveness: Woo-jin, her long-time friend and secret admirer; Min-seong, 
a film company rep she drunkenly kissed; and her unfaithful boyfriend, who won’t let go.
As Sia struggles to find love and follow her dreams, a shocking truth surfaces: the man she kissed that night wasn’t Min-seong but Woo-jin. Can she overcome the chaos and discover her true feelings?

title: Nobody Hurts My Mother
description: Natalie uncovers a shocking betrayal after her mother is bullied at the plaza. The mastermind's backer turns out to be her own husband. Facing family, lies, and betrayal, Natalie vows to expose the truth and make them pay.

title: Bridal Betrayal: Poison and Trap
description: Victor, the iron-blooded ship king, held immense power in his hands. When he reached his fifties, he considered retirement, intending to marry the young and beautiful Jessica. He not only planned a grand wedding, but also wanna transfer his company worth 80 million to his fiancee. However, Jessica had an affair with her childhood sweetheart Frank. She tried to poison Victor to death, intending to seize his property after marriage. But Victor had already known their scheme. He set up a big trap for Jessica...

title: That Soldier You Betrayed Is The War Master
description:
After three years on the front lines, Leon Bosch — a decorated war hero — finally returns home, only to walk into a nightmare. His fiancée Grace is seven months pregnant... with his own brother Jack's child. His family has carved up his property and savings, and he is even forced to serve as best man at their wedding.

Refusing to stay silent, Leon exposes Jack's forged medical records at the ceremony, tearing off the family's mask of hypocrisy. But the real storm is just beginning — the truth emerges that Leon is no ordinary soldier. He is the War Master, an elite special-forces legend entrusted with a top national mission.

At a military supply bidding banquet, Jack tries to climb to power with substandard weapons. Leon gambles with his own life, provoking Jack into firing a gun whose barrel explodes — exposing the defective-arms scandal on the spot. Jack's reputation crumbles as his crimes come to light.

Just as Leon prepares to settle the final score with the family that betrayed him, Jack's hidden protector — Colonel Angelo — storms in. Corruption reaches the highest levels, and the former War Master must fight a new war: against the system itself. Can he turn the tables and reclaim everything they stole from him?

title: Betrayed, Then Birthed Titans
description: At her engagement ceremony, Evadne is slapped, shamed, and rejected by Valerius, the Black Dragon prince, after her scheming twin sister steals the sacred power meant to protect her future. Branded impure before the entire realm, Evadne makes one impossible choice: she marries Aurelius, the cursed god-king everyone fears. But her sister’s stolen power hides a cruel secret—every shameful child she conceives can be forced into Evadne’s body. What they don’t know is Evadne’s own gift can purify any bloodline and awaken extinct Titans. The more they try to ruin her, the more divine monsters she gives birth to.

title: Lost Empress: Coronation of Betrayal
description: On her deathbed, the Empress searches for her lost daughter, Laurel. Unbeknownst to her, Laurel is now a devoted wife to scholar Matt and lives a life of service. After Matt achieved high honors in the imperial exams, he conspired with the Governor's sister to accuse Laurel of adultery, forcing her to divorce him. Now, Laurel's true identity as the Empress's daughter is finally revealed.

title: The Verdict of Betrayal
description: When Oliver—lawyer Natalie's first love—hits and kills an elderly man in a hit-and-run, her husband Weston wants to bring him to justice for the victim's sake. But Natalie, believing the dead man is Weston's father, uses her legal expertise to block the case and personally defend Oliver. She successfully argues in court that the death was a staged accident. Oliver walks free. Then the truth shatters her: the victim was not her husband's father, but her own. Consumed by guilt, Natalie faces the wreckage of her choices—and a justice that can no longer be served.

title: The Godfather's Redemption and Betrayal
description: Trapped in the Summer Heat is a 54-episode English short drama of family ethics & realistic tragedy. Set in extreme summer heat, it tells a heartbreaking story that 5-year-old Lily is locked in a scorching car by her father Ryan for hours, because Ryan chooses to stay with his mistress Sienna and her son Miles. Lily eventually dies of heatstroke. Her mother Marin frantically searches for her daughter, confronts her husband’s coldness and betrayal, and ushers in a broken ending and cruel truth. The drama focuses on three realistic pain points: marriage betrayal, parental neglect, and fatal danger of leaving kids in hot cars, with high emotional tension and dense conflicts, which is a realistic short drama with strong warning significance and payment appeal.

title: Betrayed Brutally, I Purge the Magic Academy
description: Ethan spent years protecting Chloe, only to be stabbed through the heart when she chose another man over him. Branded a monster by the entire academy and abandoned by the Dean he trusted most, he finally stopped pretending to be weak. One betrayal after another pushed him past the point of mercy. As his enemies began to fall, they realized too late that the man they had mocked was the strongest mage alive. But even greater betrayals were still waiting for him.

title: ReelTalk EP 74-Gabrielle Brown: Surviving Betrayal and People Pleasing
description: For Mental Health Awareness Month, Gabrielle Brown opens up about the unglamorous side of the industry and overcoming hardships. From setting boundaries to navigating healing after marriage, Gabrielle discusses growth, resilience, and protecting your peace. Tune in for a vulnerable discussion on mental health and advice for anyone navigating a difficult time.

title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal
description: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.

title: The Long Lost Son Is Now a Commander
description: Twenty years ago, Ethan disappeared. Twenty years later, he returns as the Empire’s youngest Commander. When he discovers his parents have spent a lifetime searching for him while enduring abuse and betrayal, Ethan vows to protect his family and bring every enemy to their knees.

title: The Groom’s Inferno
description: On the eve of their bonding ceremony, Ivy discovers that Lucien, the Alpha she has loved for five years, has crossed the line with his childhood sweetheart. Instead of confronting him, she secretly moves her assets, stages her disappearance, and exposes their affair during the ceremony—leaving the betrayers trapped in regret while she begins a new life under a new identity.

title: The Luna Swap
description: Luna dies after Ronan and Sophia’s betrayal costs her son his life. Given a second chance, she returns to the night the babies were switched and turns their scheme against them. Twenty years later, Sophia sacrifices her own son to protect the heir, pushing Lucas toward the truth.

title: Son's Whispers Unveil Betrayal
description: Realizing the danger he is in, Eliot believes adopting Nolan is the only way to stop the tragedy. He chooses Nolan instead of Mia, seeing the boy as his only ally. With Nolan's constant inner reminders, Eliot carefully collects evidence of Lila's conspiracy. He also seeks help from his sisters, who stand by him against Lila's manipulation.

title: Blood & Betrothal
description: Adrian Shaw, the Night Monarch, returns home after his grandpa's sudden death. He must uncover the truth, revive the Shaw family, and handle an arranged marriage to Celia Vaughan. Faced with the Vaughan's snobbery, Adrian mercilessly crushes them. He forms the business aliance with Eva Vane, to fight their enemies. Adrian eventually learns the mastermind behind his grandpa's murder is the Vaughan head, Jonathan Vaughan. He defeats him, finally avenging his grandpa.

title: The Crown of Thorns and Tide
description: After three years of healing lost souls in a cursed wasteland, Astraia, the hidden daughter of Zeus, returns to Athens to marry her mortal lover. Instead, she is met with cruel betrayal. By fate, she encounters Leon Thalos, the powerful son of Poseidon, who desperately seeks divine reinforcements for a looming war. Bound by shared adversaries and family pressures, Astraia and Leon forge a strategic alliance. As hidden divine powers awaken and noble conspiracies unravel, they must stand together to punish the betrayers and alter the continent's destiny. Will love and divine justice prevail?

title: Betrayed Luna, Now Awakened
description: Natalie thought the Alpha King had rescued her from rejection and given her the perfect life. Three years later, after ten miscarriages, she discovers every loss was planned by the mate who swore to protect her. The poison came from his own hands, and her unborn pups became sacrifices for the woman he truly loved. He believes keeping her as his obedient Queen is mercy. He never expects her to burn their mate bond, disappear without looking back, and leave him with a truth that destroys everything he fought to protect.

title: Rewriting the 1980s
description: In her past life, her husband's betrayal cost her everything. Reborn at the lowest point, she refuses to be a victim again. With a second chance and a secret space, she's done playing nice!

title: Love Under the Dotted Line
description: Ivory finds herself coerced into a contract marriage with Wayne. She feigns compliance but attempts to escape, only to be personally caught by Wayne. Betrayal, ex begging her back, and family drama. This marriage born of convenience teeters on the brink of either a grand wedding or a dramatic divorce.

title: Abandoned, Betrayed... Now I Rise
description: With only seven days to live after sacrificing himself, Sword Master, Caelan Evans, watches Empress Lydia Lockwood become convinced of his jealousy and selfishness—even as she sends him divorce papers. His final battle at Heavenate and the blossoming of the Eon Lotus will reveal a truth: every step of his fall was a step taken to protect her throne… and her heart.

title: Save Me: Ties and Betrayals
description:
They tried to send the multimillionaire Nadia Santinos to the other world. Her husband, Roberto, and her sister, Lorena ,secret lovers,  thought they had gotten rid of her forever. But she returns from beyond with the help of Joel, a man who saves her and becomes her accomplice in planning a revenge as meticulous as it is ruthless.

Nadia and Joel are bound not only by the kindness that unites them, but also by a shared wound: both need to be saved.

What begins as a game of apparitions soon turns into a nightmare of paranoia and terror. Because behind that supposed ghost, there is nothing supernatura, only the relentless vengeance of a woman who refuses to be silenced. *This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village
description: In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.

title: Return to 1992
description: After a night of drinking, a billionaire tycoon unexpectedly time-travels back to 1989. Seizing the opportunities in this era, he smartly grows his business empire, earning the title 'God of Investment.' Eventually, he becomes a respected business magnate, crafting an unmatched legend.

title: Return of the Strongest Beastmaster
description: After vanishing in a time rift during a demonic battle, the beastmaster genius returns to find his sect in ruins. Unbeknownst to all, he brings back five "ordinary" pets— each a divine beast in disguise. Now the strongest beastmaster's ready to show the world his true power.

title: Return of the Urban Ascendant King
description: Caleb Wright, a Heavenly Sovereign with 600 years of cultivation, failed his Tribulation Transcendence. Reborn on Earth with the supreme Empyrean Godstone, he seeks vengeance for his ruined family and dead wife. His vow for all past grievances: In my current life, blood will be paid with blood! Watch him crush elite families and wipe out ancient sects with a snap of his fingers. Wealth, women, and power are his for the taking as he stages an epic comeback against all odds!

title: Return my daughter's school-district property
description: Single mother Evelyn Bennett spends everything on a school-district property to get her daughter Lily into a State-ranked elementary school. On registration day, she is shocked to find Lily's enrollment slot maliciously stolen by the neighbor's son, Bradley Crawford. The ruthless neighbors, Vance Crawford and Diane Crawford, not only steal the enrollment slot but constantly harass and vandalize her home, traumatizing Lily and putting her in the hospital. With her husband Arthur away on business, Evelyn faces the bullies alone, only to be smeared in the media. In the battle for the enrollment slot, Evelyn is forced to fight fire with fire. A fierce war for her child's future, family dignity, and justice erupts over the school-district property.

title: Return to Rosewood Manor (updating)
description: Reborn at fifteen, Sebastian Whitmore vows to rewrite his destiny. He urges Amelia to cherish life, rejects Caroline, and angers Cornelius Whitmore by defying traditions. Exposing Valerie Kensington's corruption, he helps Katherine reorganize the estate. Placed under house arrest for criticizing strict etiquette, he shares a moonlit confession with Amelia. At the Harvest Moon Banquet, Valerie falsely accuses Sebastian and Amelia of a secret romance, but Sebastian counters with proof of her embezzlement. Later confined, Valerie dies suddenly, leaving a blood testament accusing Bartholomew Whitmore. As Sebastian discovers a secret letter, Bartholomew pays an unexpected visit, brewing a hidden crisis.

title: The Immortal's Return
description: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.

title: The Immortal's Return
description: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.

title: The Return of Brothel Heiress
description: The true daughter of a royal manor was switched at birth and sold into a brothel. Sixteen years later, she returns — not to reclaim her family, but to take back everything that belongs to her. With sharp wit and ruthless resolve, she tears apart her enemies, restores her honor, and ultimately wins both power and love. A satisfying revenge drama.

title: Memory's Return: Love's United Front
description: After barely surviving her family’s attempt to kill and bury her, a powerful female CEO loses her memory and is left with the mind of a young child. Wandering the streets as a beggar, she’s taken in by a seemingly frail but influential CEO. The two enter a whirlwind marriage, only to face constant humiliation from his family. A heated clash with his stepmother unexpectedly restores her memories, but she chooses to keep her true identity hidden...

title: The Godmother Returns
description: Adopted daughter Olivia is betrayed by her own brother, her fiancé and her family. Her wedding is stolen, and she is exiled to the border for eight years. Over those eight years, she evolves into a top‑tier intelligence strategist and protects eight heirs from major powerful families. Her old enemies track her down and force her to abandon the children. Conflicts erupt on all fronts, and Olivia is pushed to the brink of danger. When Don MacRae arrives with armed reinforcements, layers of lies are exposed one after another. All parties return to the East Coast Committee for a public trial, and the betrayers receive their due punishment. Olivia cuts off her toxic bond with her birth family and gradually climbs to the apex of power within the East Coast Committee. The eight children she once protected become her most loyal backing.

title: The Return of the Beggar: Starting from Being Picked Up by a Beauty
description: I once possessed remarkable martial skills, but after a girl risked her life to save me, I sacrificed all my power to bring her back to life, losing my memory in the process and becoming a fool. Grateful for my sacrifice, she took me in as her husband and protected me for three years. However, my foolishness made me an easy target for bullying. Now, as her family pressures her to marry for profit, I unexpectedly regain my memories and powers. I decide to keep pretending to be a fool, secretly guarding her while outsmarting those who underestimate me...

title: The Return of the Lioness Queen
description: Nala Gomez, once a privileged heiress, falls victim to her cousin's jealousy and betrayal. Conspired against by her own best friend, she loses her fiancé and is sold overseas. Hitting rock bottom, she rises with ferocious determination and swears to turn the tables on her tormentors. Crowned as the Lioness Queen, she returns with a storm of vengeance.

title: The CEO Lady's Grand Return
description: The CEO of the Pearl Group, in order to support her husband's career, had been secretly delivering takeout for three years, only to be publicly abandoned. The world's richest man, who had known her since childhood, arrived just in time to propose to her, defying everyone’s expectations. It was then that her husband discovered her true identity as the CEO, deeply regretting his actions.

title: a fortune lost will always return
description: Twenty years ago, Raymond Crawford killed his best friend for gold and adopted his young sons, Arthur Gallagher and Desmond Gallagher. Discovering the truth, Arthur faked his death to escape. He founded Torrent Group, waited in the shadows for twenty years, and returned with five hundred tons of gold to launch a full-scale commercial assault on Vanguard Corporation. Blinded by lies, Desmond ended up taking the enemy as a father and even attacked Arthur under Raymond Crawford's coercion. Ultimately, Arthur used the gold for short selling Vanguard Corporation, acquired 60% of its shares, completely crushed Raymond Crawford, and avenged his parents.

title: The Shadow Lord's Return to Glory
description: A betrayed young man, once crippled and left for dead, rises to power and returns to repay the girl who saved him. Mistaken for a criminal by her family, he soon discovers it was her cousin who saved him all along and proposes to her instead.

title: The Last Daughter of House Vale
description: Seraphina, the hidden pureblood heir of House Vale, returns to fulfill an arranged marriage, only to be publicly humiliated and scarred with poisoned silver by her fiancé Damian and his vile foster sister. Unbeknownst to them, Damian’s family owes their entire empire to Seraphina’s mother, who arrives with crushing dominance. Scarring the wicked woman in return, Seraphina forces the toxic pair into an unbreakable, eternal blood oath—dooming them to torment each other until they turn to ash.

title: Displaced War God
description: The alien bugs invaded, and humanity retreated to the "Ark" mobile fortress. Four years ago, hero Kevin piloted the mech "Silver Scar" to defeat the swarm, but retired after his entire squad fell. When the bugs returned, Kevin reapplied—only to show 0% compatibility. Spy Marshal Sam framed him for treason, sentenced him to death, and sent his mech to the scrapyard. As the swarm breached the gates and Kevin faced execution, "Silver Scar" self-activated, rescued him, and synced at 100%. Kevin repelled the swarm, and the whole city witnessed the war god's return.

title: Crowned: The Son-in-Law's Return
description: Kai, an orphan turned soldier, led Valerano's fleet to defeat the Kyte Empire. Recognized as King Eddy's long-lost second prince, he returned to find his wife Sara and daughter Diana enslaved by his in-laws. He crowned Diana a Countess, crushed a Kyte invasion with his Underwater Fleet, and exposed the traitors. After Eddy's death, Kai faced his brother Jake's treachery, summoned the Airship Fleet to obliterate the Kyte army, and was crowned king. Sara became queen, Diana princess.

title: The Genius Returns
description: Ada, a math genius reclaimed by the noble Selivis family, is treated as an outsider and framed by her scheming sister. But they picked the wrong genius to cross.

title: The Master Returns After Sixty Years
description: The supreme martial arts master, having secluded himself for sixty years, was dug out of his tomb by two grave robbers — only to discover six decades had passed. His once-mighty family had been destroyed by a traitor, with only one descendant left clinging to life. Now rejuvenated and wearing his burial shroud, he returned to the world. His overwhelming power drew doubt from the traitor's descendants, but the eldest daughter stood firmly by him. When the traitor learned of his return, he struck back furiously — but his son was killed with a single word at a birthday feast. Enraged, the traitor sealed himself away and emerged as a celestial warrior to attack. In their final showdown, the master settled the blood debt with one ultimate martial arts strike.

title: Heaven Sent
description: Banished from the Celestial Court, Destiny must grant her destined mortal's deepest wish to return to heaven. She lands beside Naomi, a powerful CEO, and awakens the ability to read minds. With magic and mischief, she helps defeat corporate rivals and protect Naomi. After completing her trial, Destiny ascends only to return, drawn back to the family she found on earth.

title: The Beauty's Trap
description: A general's daughter fights in war for her country. Returning in glory, she is betrayed by the emperor and her own cousin—her entire family destroyed. She survives and returns to the palace under a new identity, using forbidden charms to seduce the emperor, outsmart her enemies, and uncover deadly secrets. But a forbidden bond with a fool prince from the enemy kingdom complicates everything.

title: Shattered Past, A Father's Return
description: Once the Sutton heiress, Katy now scrubs toilets to pay for her sick daughter's meds. When her husband tries to sell her 19-year-old Nina to a man of 60, she fights back. What she doesn't know is that the CEO whose floors she cleans has been hunting for her for 20 years... and Nina is his.

title: Kneel For My Foolish Wife's Return
description: She is the heiress of a wealthy family, but an accident causes her to lose her memory, turning her into the foolish wife of a tycoon. However, he deceives her into divorcing him after she becomes pregnant. Abandoned, she regains her lost memories. Returning to her status as the heiress, she believes she can lead a peaceful life with her child. Yet, unexpectedly, a business alliance brings her back into contact with him.

title: The Devouring Avenger's Return
description: Charles was brutally killed in his past life. Reborn with the powerful Devouring Bloodline, he sets out to avenge his enemies and right the wrongs of his past. As he devours power to grow stronger, he fights to protect his family and stands against foreign races, determined to save humanity from destruction.

title: Loving You is a Death Wish
description: Trapped in a novel, Clara Hayes seeks death to return home. But the tyrant won't let her go, even teasing her escape. Frustrated and furious, Clara plays along, plotting her next move. Until she uncovers the truth...

title: The Real Heiress Returns
description: Reborn as the neglected true heiress of a powerful family, Supreme Seer Zenna Wynn is mocked, exploited, and set up to fail. When her aunt demands her blood and the fake heiress schemes to disgrace her, Zenna casually reveals her true power, ancient martial arts, lost medicine, and shadow empires, forcing the world’s elite to bow and leaving her family speechless.

title: The Exiled Heir Returns
description: Chester Wilson, the most gifted assassin from Villains Valley, crosses paths with Isabel Evans, who is being hunted by Black Dragon, and is forced to unleash his deadly skills. When he returns to his family, he finds his mother murdered, his grandmother kidnapped, and his inheritance stolen by his stepmother and half-brother. To reclaim his birthright, Chester must navigate a web of family treachery, criminal power plays, and his own vow of vengeance.

title: Twelve Years of Lies: The Gymnast's Rebirth
description: After being publicly humiliated at gymnastics camp by her childhood friend Ethan and teammates enabled by Jessica, Savannah preserves the evidence, quits the gymnastics team, gives up her athletic scholarship, and starts over from scratch in the dance department. With the help of Professor Miller, a choreographer, and her mentor, she transforms her pain into the power of dance and gradually becomes a successful dancer. Time and again, she draws clear boundaries with Ethan as he sinks deeper into regret and decline, and after his eventual death from illness, she continues choosing a future of her own.

title: Rebirth and Cut Ties: My Love-Blinded Son Regrets
description: After dying alone due to pampering her love-blinded son, she’s reborn with memories of her past life. This time, she’s determined to take control, build her empire, and get revenge on her clueless son, his fiancée, and their parasitic relatives.

title: Sister's Rebirth
description: Elaine Carver is reborn on the day her brother, Ryan, demands she buy him a luxury car. In her past life, this single act buried her under crippling debt and led to her death. Now armed with foresight, she watches coldly as Ryan runs up an astronomical bill at the dealership. When the final invoice—a staggering 100 million—is presented, Elaine refuses to pay. Her family is left in shock. This time, Elaine is fighting back, and they are about to face the full consequences of their greed.

title: Sister's Rebirth
description: Elaine Carver is reborn on the day her brother, Ryan, demands she buy him a luxury car. In her past life, this single act buried her under crippling debt and led to her death. Now armed with foresight, she watches coldly as Ryan runs up an astronomical bill at the dealership. When the final invoice—a staggering 100 million—is presented, Elaine refuses to pay. Her family is left in shock. This time, Elaine is fighting back, and they are about to face the full consequences of their greed.

title: The Blind Girl Who Sees Souls
description: I was born blind, but I could see every soul. In my last life, I used that gift to put Leon on the throne. He repaid me with poisoned wine, buried my sister as queen, and left my body for wild dogs. When I woke at the ball where princes chose brides, Leon had been reborn too. He chose Vanessa and laughed at the “useless blind girl.” Good. This time, I picked Duke Silas, the so-called cripple with the soul of a true king, and put the right man on the throne beside me.

title: Bound to the Fallen: A Seraph's Rebirth
description:
Six-winged Archangel Seraphina spent a thousand loveless years married to Heavenly Commander Michael, who loved her sister, Lyra. When Lyra died and Lucifer waged war on Heaven, Michael died begging Seraphina to let him go in the next life. Heartbroken, she burned her divine power to rewind time.

Reborn at the altar, she severed all ties, took Lyra’s place in an ancient pact to marry Lucifer, and gave Michael his freedom. Michael, unaware, wounded her with cruel accusations. After Lyra’s deceit, Seraphina quietly left. On his wedding day, Michael lifted the veil expecting his “true love”—and found Lyra. Realizing Seraphina had sacrificed herself for him, he raced to the Demon Abyss in regret.

There, Lucifer proved no monster, but a refined protector. He used his last drop of Angelic Grace to heal her and defended her against his own dark legion. They fell deeply in love, and he abandoned his vengeance for her.

When Michael invaded the Abyss to “rescue” her, Seraphina coldly rejected him. In the end, she burned her divinity again to save Lucifer, purifying his dark core. Together they found redemption beyond Light and Darkness.

title: Reborn as a Fish, I Fought Back
description: Asher Vale, CEO of the Vale Group and a fishing enthusiast, never expected his own life to end in water. Betrayed by his wife Talia and her scheming friend Blaine, he was drowned in a lake—only to wake up as a fish. But death was not the end. The Human Shock System activated within him: every time he shocks someone, he gains evolution points. Meanwhile, the Grand Fleet is closing in on Arcton, and Talia and Blaine are racing to seize Asher's inheritance. What they don't know is that Asher—now watching from the water—has just unlocked a mission: revenge, and more importantly, save his parents.

title: The Predator's Vow: Rebirth of the Stolen Bride
description:
The Glamorous Transformation and Vengeful Journey of Jewelry Designer Elena
Elena devoted herself entirely to caring for her fiancé Sebastian, who supposedly lost his memory after a car accident. Yet she soon discovered it was a cruel farce: Sebastian had conspired with his stepsister Isabella to stage the whole incident, merely to test her loyalty.
She endured having her identity stolen, her mother's relics destroyed, and being ruthlessly cast out by her own family. Having endured a hundred heartbreaks, Elena let go of all affection and left without hesitation.
At her lowest point, Alexander Sinclair, a towering tycoon, stepped forward resolutely. He backed Elena fully in her career, and uncovered a fated bond spanning two decades between them. Elena had once been the only ray of light that chased away the darkness of Alexander's lonely childhood.
Under Alexander's protection, Elena rebuilt herself with her outstanding talent and founded the jewelry brand Aura. Through legal means, she brought her father, who was responsible for her mother's death, to justice, and left the traitors with nothing but eternal regret.
In the sea of anemones, a symbol of rebirth, the two exchanged lifelong vows. From a forsaken woman whose identity was stolen, Elena rose like a phoenix, finally becoming a queen who held her own destiny firmly in her hands.

title: Reborn Into High Society
description: She was deceived by a villain, left broke, and saw her son die. After rebirth, she's back for revenge with her billionaire CEO hubby, raising her son and living happily ever after.

title: Please Love Me in This Life
description: In her past life, Janie Sutton silently loved Austin Sterling for seven years but ended up in an unhappy marriage. Reborn into her high school days, she decides to focus on herself instead. However, Austin is also reborn and suddenly starts to court her relentlessly. Will she give him a second chance, or just leave him?

title: When the Snow Stops — Vengeance Rises
description: In his past life, Eric gave everything for his family, but got betrayed. He went to jail for his adopted brother Felix, but only got contempt. Abandoned by his family, Eric died. After rebirth, he refused to take the fall for Felix and exposed the truth. But his mom and sisters didn't believe him. Heartbroken, he cut ties with them and rose as a radio star. Using his creative talent, he did better than his sisters and Felix. His family realized Eric was the real genius. Felix was only a thief who stole Eric's works...

title: Eternal Dragon Emperor
description: This series follows the journey of a man betrayed by his lover and left at the lowest point in his life. Despite these challenges, he never gives up, persevering with hope. He rises from the ashes, protecting his family, finding true love, and ultimately reclaiming his former glory and success.

title: Swap Brides? Reborn to Ruin Your Family
description: General Ashford's two daughters, Ashley and Lydia, in their last life, died of ill treatment after marrying into the Marquis House. They swore revenge and quit marriage after rebirth, and won by relying on the memory of previous lives. This time, two poor noble ladies wouldn't yield to those evil people, but to fight back!

title: My Firefighter Husband Was Once a White-Haired Punk
description: Sammi learns she's pregnant the same day she's told her firefighter husband Fred has died. A diary of his secret, years-long love triggers her rebirth back to 2007, still expecting their child. But the man she returns to isn't her calm, heroic husband, but a rebellious, white-haired teenager who doesn't know her at all. Now Sammi must win his heart from the very beginning and rewrite the fate that once stole him away.

title: Reborn to Marry the Man I Dumped
description: She died, taking the man who loved her with her, only to be killed by the one she loved most. Reborn, she faces an inevitable loss and must gamble everything, trusting that the man who truly loves her will never let her fall. Meanwhile, the deceitful couple who betrayed her will pay the ultimate price this time.

title: After Being Reborn, I Got Married to My Ex-boyfriend’s Uncle
description: In a past life, I wed my childhood sweetheart, Drake Elledge, only to find heartbreak as he remained tangled with his first love, resulting in a tragic end for me and our unborn child. Little did I know, his uncle had been silently in love with me for seven years. Now, with a second chance at life, I refuse to repeat the past. When my mother asks if I'll marry Drake, I say no and choose Jace, sparking a new journey fraught with Drake's relentless attempts to win me back...

title: This Life, My Comeback
description: On his wedding day, the heir to Jiangcheng’s wealthiest family gives up everything to save his fiancée, only to be framed and killed. Granted seven days to exact revenge and achieve true rebirth—alongside his also-reborn childhood sweetheart—He vows to protect his loved ones and crush those who conspired against him.

title: After Being Reborn, I Got Married to My Ex-boyfriend’s Uncle
description: In a past life, I wed my childhood sweetheart, Drake Elledge, only to find heartbreak as he remained tangled with his first love, resulting in a tragic end for me and our unborn child. Little did I know, his uncle had been silently in love with me for seven years. Now, with a second chance at life, I refuse to repeat the past. When my mother asks if I'll marry Drake, I say no and choose Jace, sparking a new journey fraught with Drake's relentless attempts to win me back...

title: The Billionaire Groom Exchange
description: Yvonne is murdered by her jealous sister right as she's giving birth. She wakes up one year in the past, the day they picked their husbands! Fiona remembers the "future" and chooses Oliver, who was Yvonne's husband. Yvonne picks Fiona's past/future wheelchair-bound husband, Ethan. What no one knows, is that Ethan is secretly the richest man in the world!

title: Crown of Vengeance
description: In her past life, she was betrayed by her mother and sister, who conspired against her. Her newborn baby was swapped with her sister’s stillborn child, leading to her disgrace and a tragic death at home. Her husband was also framed by her sister and ended up dying as well. After being reborn, she uses her memories from her previous life to expose her mother and sister's schemes, ultimately helping her husband rise to power.

title: Alpha's Regret After His Pregnant Luna's Death
description:
Alpha Declan is tricked by his brother's treacherous widow, Olivia, into locking his pregnant Luna, Evelyn, in a Silver Cage for three days. He thought he was teaching her a lesson, but it was all part of Olivia's schemes to take Evelyn's place as Luna! 
Declan refuses to believe Evelyn, even as she begs him to save her, convinced it's all an act. He only realizes he's condemned his own Luna and their pup to death when he sees their dead bodies with his very own eyes.

title: Reborn and Became a Legend
description: Carson, the last heir of the Imperial Ascendant Lineage, is betrayed and forced to self-destruct by the Three Supreme Lords. Reborn at 20 with his memories intact, he vows revenge. With the help of Victor Yates and his family, Carson exposes his manipulative ex, crushes arrogant elites, and defeats Grandmaster Cyrus. Rising to power, he becomes the most feared figure in Newhaven, ready to claim his rightful place at the top.

title: Love Dies That Night
description: Tycoon Ethan Fuller weds his 'dying' muse Natalie Song, abandoning lover Jessica Lane. After a fatal crash, Jessica trades her Soulstrand to resurrect, watching coldly as Ethan's empire crumbles—until medical truths expose deadly lies.

title: A Birthmark Exposed My Husband’s Secret
description: Vivienne and Adrian are moments away from adopting a sweet little girl when Vivienne notices a pea-sized birthmark on the child's hand. She immediately refuses to sign and demands a divorce. Adrian kneels. His family calls her cruel, barren, and heartless. Even the child begs her not to leave. No one understands why Vivienne would destroy a loving marriage over such a tiny mark, and she refuses to explain. Not until Vivienne unveils three reports at a live press conference does the truth behind that tiny birthmark finally begin to surface.

title: Luna Reborn: Alpha's Second Chance
description:
Edward, a powerful Alpha, plans to reject his fated mate to make his savior Katherine his Luna.
But during the deadly Soul Fire Ritual, he gradually falls in love with his true mate, Scarlett—only to destroy her.
After her death, he discovers the truth from her diary: Scarlett was the real one who saved him all along. Katherine lied to him and it was all a set up.
Now, with everything lost, will fate give Alpha a second chance to redeem himself and win her back?

title: 8 Years Wasted: Now Payback Time, My Ex!
description: For eight years, Deron Crane, heir to Crane Corp, devoted himself to Beth Hart, fulfilling her every wish. Little did he know, Beth conspired with his brother, Odin Crane, leading to his untimely demise. Reborn with a second chance, Deron awakens to the truth, cutting all ties with Beth and embarking on a journey to find his true love.

title: Second Chance: The Tech Billionaire’s Secret Family
description:
Six years ago, heiress Milo left penniless Asher to save her failing family, keeping her pregnancy a secret.
Now a ruthless tech billionaire still bitter about the past, Asher reunites with Milo at a gala — she’s now a desperate single mom, scrambling to pay for their son Leo’s life-saving heart surgery.
As the truth of her sacrifice unfolds, a guilt-stricken Asher sets out to win her back, secures top care for their son, brings the real culprit to justice, and earns his second chance at love...

title: The Second Wound
description: Nora Hayes is a brilliant drug researcher and the true daughter of the Hayes family, but her brother Mason, her best friend Emma, and the adopted Lily all choose to erase her. To steal Nora’s drug launch and hand the spotlight to Lily, Mason arranges a brutal attack, destroys Nora’s reputation, and even delays the surgery that could save her future. After uncovering years of stolen credit, including the kidney she gave Emma and the fire where she saved Mason, Nora stops begging to be believed. With Professor Voss’s help, she disappears into a protected life in France, relearns how to work, creates a breakthrough drug, and returns as someone they can no longer break.

title: My Second Act
description: Nora Sheridan was silenced for years. On the night she was supposed to marry, her fiancé and half-sister murdered her in cold blood. But death was just the beginning. She awakens moments before her execution, reborn as her former self—the mute Princess Nora. This time, the pawn becomes the player. Armed with the knowledge of her past life, she transforms from a gentle soul into a merciless "madwoman," dismantling her enemies’ schemes one by one.

title: The Black Drakes Second Vow
description: Aurora Pyrelyn dies with her black drake husband Rowan’s claws in her chest, only to wake on the day of their Soulflame Bond. This time, Rowan remembers too, and he chooses Aurora’s golden sister Celeste for the throne she was promised. But Aurora no longer begs for a love built on ambition. She gives Rowan away, chooses the mocked white dragon Silas Frost, and discovers his vow is the one loyalty she was always denied. As Celeste, Rowan, and Aurora’s father chase bloodline power, the Old Flame Law reveals its truth: Aurora is not the heir, but the one who chooses who deserves the Throneflame. Betrayed again, she takes back her stolen fire, breaks the old bloodline order, and flies free with the dragon who chose her first.

title: Second Spring, First-Class Tech
description: At fifty, Helen Vance is forced out of her own home by her daughter-in-law. With nowhere to go, she strikes a marriage-of-convenience deal with Harrison—a man with secrets of his own. But Helen is no ordinary woman. A master of precision equipment tuning, she gathers a team of fellow laid-off women workers and founds Vance Tech. Facing fierce rivalry from young tech boss Craig and his AI-driven system, Helen fights back with old‑school craftsmanship and sheer grit. In the end, she wins the industry's highest recognition, earns back her dignity, and finds true love with Harrison.

title: The Childhood Friend I Couldn't Resist
description: Ethan, the richest man in the Capital, met the spirited young Sia while recovering from a serious childhood illness. Her encouragement helped him survive, but she disappeared before their promised reunion. Eighteen years later, they meet again. Afraid of losing her, Ethan rushes into marriage, only to discover that Sia has been part of the plan all along. From the very start, their love has been a two-way chase, culminating in a long-awaited, perfect ending.

title: Storybound? Now Let me Modify Your Fate
description: Elizabeth time-travelled into a novel world as the Villainess and got a System. The System also gave her a Golden Finger, which allowed her to change the novel storyline. Every time she changed the plot, the fate of those roles in the novel world also changed. The original male lead Wyatt and female lead Ivy became unlucky. Elizabeth knew a guy Adrian who was reborn...

title: Love Ages Like Fine Wine
description: Advertising strategist Grace's new client, Austin Beaufoy, is European nobility. Not only is he the heir to a billion-dollar winery, but he's also the ex-boyfriend who dumped her a year ago! She didn't want to get tangled up with her ex, but now the jerk who heartlessly dumped her is suddenly acting like her lapdog? Her ex mistakenly thinks she's head over heels for someone new, driving him crazy with jealousy. Little does he know, that "someone new" is actually her best gay friend! Grace didn't want to explain, but her ex keeps groveling for a reconciliation. Turns out, there's more to their breakup a year ago than meets the eye, and everything he's done since then has been for her...

title: Golden Threads of a Second Chance
description: At 50, facing her mother’s life-threatening illness, Ophelia Jones uncovers a devastating secret—her husband has been secretly sending money to his first love for the past 30 years. Heartbroken, she contemplates selling her embroidery to pay for her mother’s treatment and decides to divorce him. Just when she feels lost, she unexpectedly reunites with her childhood sweetheart, Jacob Hunt. Not only does Jacob selflessly donate a kidney to save her mother, but he also offers unwavering support and protection. Moved by his genuine love and devotion, Ophelia’s heart is rekindled, and after finally leaving her husband, she and Jacob begin a new life together, bound by love and trust.

title: The Unseen Wife Became a Badass
description: After a two-month hospital stay with zero visits from her husband, a three-year contract wife finally wakes up: She was invisible in her own marriage. Now? She's done playing nice. She fires his snobbish staff, replaces every piece of furniture he picked out, and adopts the one thing he hates most: cats. Then she returns to the workforce—starting at the bottom as a designer, crushing office politics, and landing the client her bosses couldn't close.

title: Madam, Give the CEO Another Chance
description:
In childhood, we made an engagement. Eighteen years later, he accidentally became mentally retarded, but I still married him. 
In an accident, he regained his memory and learned that the one who killed his parents was my foster father! 
After waking up, he vented his anger on me. Now, it's time to reveal my true identity!

title: One More Chance, My Nurse Girlfriend!
description: Adrian Sterling avoids intimacy but is pressured to produce an heir. Sophie Carter, desperate to save her grandmother, agrees to a fake marriage with Adrian. Sophie's uncle Alex and Lillian Lane plot against her, making her believe Adrian doesn’t want their child. After her prenatal report is swapped, she leaves. Five years later, as Beatrice with her son, she’s found by Adrian, who learns the truth, protects them, and rekindles their love.

title: Blood and Silver
description:
Ann’s family destroyed Dane’s entire pack. Dane hates her, but he is forced to marry her. On their wedding night, he marks her in front of everyone, throws morning-after pills at her feet, and leaves her for another woman. But Ann is already pregnant with his twins. Heartbroken, she breaks their bond, fakes her death, and runs away. When Dane finally realizes he loves her, it is too late.
Now he must spend his life chasing the wife and children he threw away.

title: Daddy, your three chances are up
description: Audrey Sterling, heiress of the Sterling family of Highcrest, has been married to Stephen Vance for seven years but could never outshine the one that got away, Vivian Mercer. Catching them kissing on the day Vivian returns, Audrey decides to divorce. Their six-year-old daughter Mia hates to see her parents split and begs for three chances for Stephen. Yet, Stephen only focuses on Vivian and her child Ava, turning all three chances into deep pain for Audrey and Mia. After Audrey leaves with Mia for good, Stephen still accuses them of betrayal. When the truth finally comes out, his regret comes way too late.

title: A Taste of Destiny
description: When Chef Stella flees a one-night stand with CEO Mason Pierce, she leaves only a bowl of chicken congee that steals his heart. But someone steals her identity to become Mason's fiancée! Now, Stella takes a prep job at his restaurant. Will fate bring the true lovers back together?

title: Destiny in the Stars
description:
After helping her fiancé secure a multi-million-dollar deal, Stella York witnessed him cheating on her with her younger sister, Kim York. The pair brazenly flaunted their affair in front of her, while her grandma and her father pressured her to break off the engagement and surrender her fiancé, Henry Chase, to Kim.

In her darkest moment, Stella met Kevin Ford, the young heir of the Ford Group, and the two fell in love at first sight, embarking on a new life together.

title: Rule the Destiny Arena
description: Teleported to a universe where a large part of the culture is missing, Ezra Lane competes with other god summoners on the Destiny Arena. The lost country will be devoured. Each country summons unique gods from its culture, yet Catharia is falling behind. Ezra steps in at the critical moment and starts his turn with a prayer, hoping the gods from the lost culture can intervene and help him win.

title: Switched Heiresses- A Destiny Misplaced
description:
18 years ago, vengeful maid Brenda swapped her baby with her mistress Victoria's daughter.
The real young lady Charlotte suffered abuse and poverty, while the imposter Lily enjoyed a wealthy life.
After Charlotte was hired by her birth mother, Brenda and Lily framed her repeatedly.
As birthmarks and DNA revealed the truth, Victoria uncovered her husband and Brenda's poisonous conspiracy.
Evil schemes were exposed, the wicked were expelled, and Victoria finally reunited with her long-lost daughter.

title: Pregnant with Sweet Destiny
description: To save her grandma, Clara marries a man in a vegetative state and got pregnant. Eight months later, Clara is struggling to survive, she bumps into the man who has already awakened while delivering food. Little does she know, this man is her secret husband!

title: Throne of Destiny​
description: Disgraced heir Julian Creed, pursued by the royal family and facing execution, forges alliances with allies like Sophia to seize the throne. By rooting out corruption and restoring order, he ultimately rises to become a legendary emperor.

title: Sparks of Destiny
description: Sherley Chapman and Alexander Lynch, once childhood sweethearts, are unexpectedly thrust back into each other's lives with a twist of fate that forces them into marriage. As Alexander, a mysterious expert, consistently supports Sherley, a determined CEO, through numerous obstacles, their bond evolves and flourishes.

title: Rewriting Destiny: An Heiress's Comeback
description: Fay Reeves, after becoming comatose in the modern world, finds herself inside her own novel. A cute pet informs her that to return to reality, she must complete a mission: return to the Louis family and win back Ronald Pates. Armed with determination, she navigates the challenges posed by her adoptive parents and fights to reclaim her love. More challenges ahead? She's more than ready!

title: A Stolen Destiny
description:
Two women, intertwined lives, and secrets that change everything. Nina loves with intensity and ambition, while Maria Clara faces betrayals and dangers that challenge her heart. When fate brings them together, lost memories and impossible choices reveal that no one is entirely good or evil just human.

Love, passion, suspense, and twists: how far would you go to protect the ones you love?*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: National Destiny Arena: Rise of the Demon God
description:
In a world that forgot its gods, Ethan Hayes awakens an SSS-rank Demonkin affinity—and memories no one else has.
While others doubt him, he summons lost Huaxia deities and shatters rising invasions from every side, igniting a war of true names.

title: The Reaper's Fated Bride
description:
A mad prophecy circulates in the divine realm: whoever can conceive the "God-Child of Destiny" will overthrow Zeus and become King of All Gods.

In her past life, Elara married Eros, the God of Love and symbol of romance, only to have her "soul fire" sucked by him day and night, eventually dying a miserable death of exhaustion after giving birth. Reborn at the ceremony where the gods choose their wives, her sister Cassia the coveted golden arrow of the God of Love, while Elara proactively grasped the black scythe symbolizing death and barrenness, choosing Thanatos, the God of Death whom all gods fear most.

Everyone waited to see her fall into hell, but they never expected—the romance of the God of Love is devouring, while the death the God of Death is salvation.

When her sister falls into the dark arts of necrophagy to give birth to a divine child, Elara is reborn under nourishment of the God of Death, who spares no cost to his own divine lifespan, and conceives an heir truly capable of severing the laws of fate.
time, she will not only rewrite her own destiny but also force the entire divine realm to change its master.

title: Dear Brother, You Loved Me Too Late
description: For sixteen years, Angelica has lived with a guilt she never deserved — her mother died giving birth to her. Neglected by her father, Martin, and despised by her brother, Christopher, she holds on to the only warmth he ever showed her. But when their cousin Madison moves in, even Christopher turns on her, wishing she were the one who had died. And in a way, he gets his wish when Angelica is diagnosed with cancer. But after her death, it’s Christopher’s world that begins to fall apart.

title: The Destined One
description: Victoria, the secret head of a powerful aristocratic family, rejects an arranged marriage for her longtime boyfriend, Julian. On her way to see him, she saves billionaire CEO Alexander Blackwood from an accident, unknowingly awakening his wolf-spirit mark that identifies her as his destined mate. Victoria rejects Alexander's sudden proposal and heads to Julian's promotion party—a position she secretly secured for him. However, Julian publicly humiliates her, offering her a buyout check so he can marry Chloe, the daughter of a Blackwood executive, to secure his status. When Victoria reveals she is the true mastermind behind his success, Julian and the elite guests mock her as a delusional beggar. Just as security corners Victoria to throw her out, Alexander violently crashes the party...

title: Reborn Lady Rules the House
description: In her past life, a noble matriarch was betrayed and ruined by the daughter she once favored most. Reborn, she changes her fate—repaying the illegitimate daughter who once saved her life and arranging her marriage to the prince, whose heart truly belongs to her. The jealous daughter’s schemes all fail, and just as everything collapses, the matriarch’s husband returns after ten years missing, finally rewriting the family’s destiny.

title: The God of Tides
description: Rejected by his royal family and cast into the ocean as a child, Kai secretly becomes the legendary God of Tides. Years later, he returns home in disguise to find the pirate kingdom under siege. Now, Kai must save his family, all the while dealing with a father who thinks that he's worthless.

title: Submitting to My Best Friend's Dad
description: Becca needed the break after a rough year attending Yale and a break-up with her boyfriend. She didn’t expect for her summer of fun to include sleeping with James, the Italian Stallion–her best friend's father. Knowing it’s wrong, she allows James to pull her into a vortex of pleasure that has her breaching the surface of reality and grasping for survival. Can Becca endure this pleasure without Tally finding out? Or will her secrets cause her world to crash around her?

title: Golden Eyes, Golden Life
description: Elian Wright was a down-on-his-luck salesman, crushed by debt and forced to swallow his pride just to survive. Yet even in hardship, he remained kind. One night, he saved Elvia Malone from a predatory playboy—never realizing she was his CEO. Beaten for his bravery, Elian awakened with the power of the Golden Eyes—a gift that let him see through everything. With this newfound ability, he aided Elvia, struck fortune in stone gambling, and began rewriting his destiny from the ashes of defeat.

title: The Dragon's Descent
description: Raised at The Hidden Orchid Retreat, Vincent Vance is a gifted disciple who uses his supreme skills to heal locals. When his three mentors arrange for him to marry the eldest Caldwell heiress, her sudden rejection unexpectedly leads him to his true destiny with Cecilia Sinclair.

title: Accidentally Pregnant, Irresistibly Loved
description: Born unwanted by her family, Zoey is betrayed by her brother and left with nothing. At her lowest, she meets Steven, a cold billionaire who keeps everyone away. Their fateful encounter brings two hearts together, helping them heal, love, and rewrite their destiny.

title: The Immortal Guard
description: After a decade of cultivation, Asher returns as an immortal — to cancel an arranged marriage and find his lost love. Posing as a guard, he outwits nobles, heals royals, quashes rebellion, and humbles gods. To protect the people around him, he shatters every foe, settling old debts to claim his true destiny.

title: Jerk Killed My Bestie, I Avenge
description: Right after finishing a mission, the Strategy Queen Victoria Sinclair learns from the system that her modern-day best friend, Lucy Lancaster, was murdered. Seeking revenge, Victoria returns to the 21st century as the true heiress of the Vance family. She replaces the fake heiress, Felicity Vance, to marry the disfigured eldest son of the Prescott family, Julian Prescott. Her new task: make Julian fall in love with her. Everyone expects the Prescott family to reject the country-raised Victoria. Instead, she wins Julian's deep devotion and becomes the general manager of Prescott Corporation, making sure the scumbag who killed her friend, Felix Prescott, finally pays the price.

title: Destined to Meet You
description: The niece of a wealthy merchant family, a rising star in the business world, was framed by her half-sister and assaulted by a male model at a nightclub. By a twist of fate, she ended up in the body of the heir to the richest family in the city. The heir, upon waking, fearing media gossip, left his family heirloom jade pendant with her and left. The half-sister then discovered the situation and took her place. Meanwhile, the niece was falsely accused of the incident with the male model and driven out of her family, forced to work as a waitress in another city. Ten months later, the half-sister brought the newborn son to the heir and successfully entered the wealthy household. Perhaps by fate, the niece's son and the heir's son attended the same school. When the niece's son was bullied, both parents were called in and discovered the two children looked exactly alike. The truth from six years ago gradually came to light.

title: Crimson Storm: Lone Avenger
description:
Two decades ago, the esteemed Big Nine clans conspired to annihilate the Reid family. Craig Reid, the only survivor, was rescued by a sagacious master who recognized his potential. Under his guidance, Craig's extraordinary talent propelled him to the zenith of earthly cultivation, poised for ascension. Yet, the anticipated heavenly tribulation never came. His master, sensing that Craig's destiny was tangled with unresolved karma, expelled him from the sect.
Now, Craig crosses paths with Zoe Zimmer and finds himself drawn into her battle against one of the Big Nine. Maybe this is the key to his long-awaited breakthrough.

title: Through Every Life to Find You
description: Rita Carr, an ancient Channeler, returns as the Carr family's daughter after experiencing a hundred wrongful reincarnations. Amid family feuds, gang conflicts, and the conspiracies of the Krana Empire, she breaks the chains of destiny, achieves female awakening, and ultimately rekindles her past connection with Louie Bale, the young leader of Aegis Syndicate, concluding this time-transcending legend.

title: They Called Me Worthless Until My Cards Destroyed Their Academy
description: Twenty years ago, rifts tore open the world, and 5% of humanity awakened superhuman abilities. The rest became fuel. Cole Brennan was born into the rest, powerless, disposable, nobody. Then a pendant left behind by his missing parents helped him activate a system no one has ever seen. Now he's walking into the elite academy in the country, surrounded by prodigies who want him gone. They have no idea what he's holding. Neither do the people who made his parents disappear.

title: Swapped Destinies Love’s Hidden Path
description: Two girls swapped identities as children. One grew up as the rich family's daughter—and the young master's sister. When the real heiress finally returned, the impostor was cast out. But her departure only made the young master realize his true feelings. Now he's chasing the girl he once called "sister," with countless obstacles standing in their way.

title: Destined To Be
description: When Adia Nordstrom steps into her sister's wedding shoes to save her family's honor, she finds herself tied to the elusive Stefan Vaughn, a man who exudes coldness and does not fail to show his disappointment at the union altogether. Their forced union, put together by a long-standing family pact, swoops Adia into a whirlwind of conflicting emotions as she struggles with her own shattered dreams and a husband who remains a mystery. As Adia and Stefan navigate the unfamiliar territory of their reluctant marriage, unexpected bonds form, unraveling secrets and desires neither anticipated. However, the shadow of Adia's vanished ex-love, Elvis Pratt, looms large, casting doubt and longing over her fragile new beginning. With Blake's return stirring up jealousy and betrayal, Adia stands at a crossroads, torn between loyalty to her sister and the beckoning call of her own heart. Will she choose duty over passion, or will she forge a path to a love she never imagined possible, despite the odds stacked against them?

title: Arena of Gods
description: When history student Ryan West time-travels to a world where traditional myths are forgotten, he awakens a Divine Atlas. From humiliating defeats to summoning Chang'e to slay the moon god, he leads China's lost deities in an epic showdown against global pantheons, reigniting the nation's destiny.

title: Reborn Queen in the Modern World
description: Vivian, a 200-pound mother of three, is neglected by her husband and bullied by his childhood friend who covets her place. But fate intervenes when the soul of an Empress awakens within her. The ancient ruler wastes no time—shedding weight, reclaiming beauty, and seizing her own destiny. As a dazzling new Vivian emerges, her husband scrambles to win her back. But her eyes are set on a far grander prize: building an empire of her own.

title: Human Luna, Golden Heir
description:
One wild night. One stranger Ivy can't remember.
Months later, an ultrasound reveals the impossible—the baby inside her is a wolf.
Desperate to hide the truth, Ivy has no idea the father is Asher Kane, the ruthless Alpha King searching for the mate who vanished from his bed.
But when their paths cross again, an old mark awakens, buried instincts stir, and the secret inside Ivy begins to show its power.
Because this is no ordinary pregnancy—and no ordinary pup.

title: When I Meet Another Alpha
description:
10 years ago I begged him to stay. 
He said: "She'll come crawling back to me."
I never did.
Now I rule every pack in the South. And that Alpha who ignored me for 10 years?
He's been waiting. Alone.

title: The Rejected Mate: Rise of the Silver Luna
description: A betrayed pure-blood Luna, Lyra, is killed by her fated mate Cassian on his coronation day. She wakes up on the day she must choose her new mate—and refuses him. Cassian, humiliated, teams up with Lacey to destroy her nest and demand her wolf soul. But Lyra chooses Kael, a rogue Alpha with a dark past. During the Blood Moon trial, Cassian fails the shift without her scent. Lacey’s body crumbles. Stripped of rank, exiled, the pair turn on each other and are devoured by rogues. Lyra finds true devotion in Kael, who builds her a new nest and offers his life as proof—this time, she chooses power, revenge, and a love that burns.

title: A Rogue Becomes Luna
description:
A year ago, her pack was slaughtered. Only she and a young boy survived. Since that day, Aubrey — an 18-year-old rogue she-wolf — has been on the run, hiding from the demons that destroyed her world. Her only mission: to keep little Daniel, the last Alpha heir, alive.
But destiny has other plans. During a hunt gone wrong, she crosses into the territory of Cliff — a powerful, cold-hearted Alpha. When she’s captured, Cliff is stunned to discover the truth: Aubrey is his fated mate, the Luna he’s been waiting for across centuries.
Torn between survival and desire, Aubrey must fight to earn her place in his pack while protecting Daniel. Together, they uncover lost bonds, reunite with the Alpha’s missing daughter Iris, and face enemies lurking in the shadows — including the jealous half-demon she-wolf, Giselle.
Blood, betrayal, and love ignite under the full moon. Through pain and sacrifice, Aubrey rises from the ashes — not just as a survivor, but as a queen.
A Rogue Becomes Luna — a wolf saga of destiny, revenge, and unbreakable love. Are you ready to witness her awakening?

title: Bound by Secrets: Her Billionaire Doctor
description: Five years ago, Luna, a girl from the slums, was forced by Alan, her wealthy mother-in-law, to jump off a building. She later gave birth to their son Neo alone. Five years on, Neo was diagnosed with leukemia and urgently needed a bone marrow transplant. Luna crossed paths again with Ken, her former boyfriend, who had become a chief orthopedic surgeon. To protect her son, Luna concealed the truth about their relationship and signed an agreement with Ken. However, trapped in a series of plots hatched by Alan and Tina, Ken’s fiancée, she suffered a miscarriage and fled to France. After uncovering the whole truth, Ken had his mother committed to a psychiatric hospital and sent Tina to prison. Eventually, he tracked down Luna, and the family of three was reunited.

title: Fated to the Cruel Falcon
description: After being publicly rejected by her promised mate on her 18th birthday, bunny "defect" Snow finds herself at the mercy of the Falcon Kingdom that conquers her herd. Now she's trapped in the ordbit of the ruler she holds responsible for her mother's death, and losing a battle against the bond pulling her straight toward him.

title: Fate's Betrayer: Saving Grace
description: After years of learning mystic arts, Killian proves his skills by saving Pete from death. To repay Grace for saving his life, he leaves the sect to protect her and uses his powers to break her deadly curse.

title: Fate Decides: I'll Give You All
description: Huo Tingyu, the powerful CEO of Yao Ting Group, sees his life change unexpectedly when delivery girl Qiao Menghan spends a night with him by accident. Wanting to protect her, Huo offers her a choice between marriage and financial support.As Menghan joins his company, Huo must handle jealous coworkers like Bai Ruyan and uncover hidden family secrets. With betrayals and challenges at every step, Huo fights to protect his business and his relationship with Menghan. Can he balance love and power, or will the pressures destroy everything?

title: Fate's Chosen: The Last Exorcist
description: Finn, a kid haunted by the demon Mota, is raised by Damian Lowell. With his senior, Elara, he hunts supernatural threats—until a ratfolk's conspiracy and a warlord's bloody crusade force him to confront his destiny. As the Blood Moon rises, will Finn save the world… or destroy it?

title: Fate Reborn: Switched to True Love
description:
In her past life, Samantha married Iain, a penniless man who later rose to wealth and success, while her sister Nina married military officer Evan and went mad after Evan died shortly after their wedding. Blinded by jealousy, Nina killed Samantha and was killed in return.
Now, the sisters are reborn.
This time, Nina plots to steal Iain. But she doesn’t know that Samantha also remembers everything. This time, she's already saved Evan's life and is on her way to an even better future.

title: Forbidden Bonds: Fated to the Ocean God
description: For years, demigod Elena endured the arrogance and cruelty of Alec, Sovereign of Olympus—only to have him reject her on her eighteenth birthday. But fate gives her a second chance when she meets Stefano, the powerful King of the Titans. His choice is immediate and public, "I want her. No one else." Just as Elena finally finds her true match, Alec and his lover set out to destroy them. Can Elena escape their trap, and will Stefano save her in time?

title: Magic Failure's Phoenix Fate
description: Bullied and hunted as a Soulless, Raven is thrown into Fire Academy to die. Instead, she awakens mind control, turns her fate around—and makes Blake, the deadliest phoenix-fire heir, gentle only for her. A comeback in both power and love.

title: Fate Restarted: I Found My Mom a Perfect Husband
description: In a society where sons reign supreme, she endured a lifetime of neglect. Her dream of college was her ticket to freedom with her mother. But at the station, her father's fury ended in tragedy, leaving her mother lifeless. "I'll follow you, Mom," she whispered, as the icy river claimed her. Awakening in 1980, she found her mother alive, bathed in sunlight. With newfound resolve, she vowed to rewrite their fate and fight for justice.

title: The Fighter Who Stole My Pulse
description:
Mia's impulsive kiss with mysterious bartender Troy pulls her into the violent underground fighting world where he reigns undefeated. When she saves his opponent's life during a police raid, their dangerous attraction ignites. 
But Troy harbors a devastating secret. His manipulative girlfriend Amanda uses this pain as a weapon, while crime boss Serge plots revenge for his own dark reasons. 
When Mia is kidnapped and used as bait to destroy Troy in the ring, she must save the man she loves from becoming the monster he fears. In this brutal world, love becomes the ultimate fight for redemption. 
He stole her pulse. She might save his soul.

title: The Silver Tiger Mate's Gentle Pampering
description: At her sacred bonding ceremony, snow leopard princess Diana is rejected by all three fated mates and betrayed by the maid who stole her first love. Desperate to protect her dying tribe, she invokes an ancient Moonstone law and chooses Carl, a chained arena slave, as her beast husband. Everyone mocks her for marrying beneath her, until Carl’s Silver Tiger bloodline awakens and Diana carries his legendary heir. As jealous ex-lovers, rival tribes, and royal conspiracies close in, Diana rises from public disgrace to unstoppable queen, while the man everyone called a slave reveals himself as Emperor Yuan.

title: True Mate's vengeance
description: At the sacred mate ceremony, Alpha Mavrik publicly abandons his fiancée Juniper for his new lover Rosette, humiliating her as a mere breeding tool. Unknown to him, Juniper is the direct heir of the First Wolves, holding the pack’s supreme power and wealth. She secretly tears off their engagement and turns to the Moon Goddess. At the auction and her awakening party, Mavrik keeps bullying her, even destroying her late mother’s robe and flaunting his bond with Rosette. But Juniper has long awakened. She rejects Mavrik and chooses her true mate—Alpha Ryker Darkmore, who once saved her life and guarded her for years. Finally, the arrogant Mavrik loses everything and meets his tragic end. Juniper regains her glory, bonding with Ryker and living a peaceful, happy life.

title: The Orphan Is My Fated Mate
description:
When she was young, her true mate died, now it is time for her to be wed and together they will rule the most powerful pack.  But everything changed when the impossible happens! Her fated mate is revealed...in her own clan.  When love finds a way will the Luna find a way too? Timing is everything and threats are closing in. Could these fated mates survive the clashes of power and control? 
From www.twoglassesfourlenses.com*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: My Fated Mate is the Bloodline Key
description: After being publicly rejected and hunted by her tyrannical Alpha fiancé, Elara is saved by a scarred, mysterious rogue wolf—unaware he is the exiled heir she once rescued as a child. When her brutal ex drives them into a dead end, her tears and love become the only catalyst to awaken his Ancient Lycan bloodline and shatter the tyranny.

title: Summer with a Superstar
description: Straight-A bookworm Georgia Pruitt accidentally shoves rockstar Riot Cross off his stage, so her strict father ships her to Silver Pines reform camp, where Riot's label sends him too. Bound as accountability buddies, the enemies fall in love through bullying storms, lakeside rescues, a stolen kiss, and a rewritten love song. When leaked photos force a breakup, Riot leaps from his departing car to sing with her onstage, and they choose each other and music school over Harvard and the tour.

title: When The Black Out Comes
description: Meteorologist Julian Parker discovers that a catastrophic megastorm will cripple the city's power grid within hours. After interrupting a live news broadcast to warn the public, he is fired and dismissed as a conspiracy theorist. Refusing to give up, Julian races against the clock to deliver portable power stations to hospitals, first responders, and vulnerable families, enduring ridicule, arrest, and rejection along the way.

title: Black Card The Reckoning
description: Cassius, a former top-tier bodyguard, retired to the countryside. After his family was persecuted by criminal forces, he wielded the Valerius family's supreme black card to settle scores with all his enemies. Standing side by side with Celine, the family head who admired him, he protected his loved ones and dismantled a transnational criminal network.

title: Irresistible love with my brother in law
description: Amelia, a young widow, was pregnant with the posthumous child of her late husband Daniel. She was taken back to the Tuscan estate of the ancient and powerful Di Maggio family in Italy for protection. At first, Anthony, Daniel's older brother, was hostile towards Amelia, seeing her as a threat. But through repeated conflicts and time spent together, he was deeply attracted to her resilience and sincerity. Under the pressure of family disputes and traditional responsibilities, Amelia and Anthony overcame suspicion and prejudice and gradually developed a sincere and passionate relationship. In the Tuscan sunshine and the shadow of the ancient estate, they jointly protected the unborn child and the future of the family while experiencing a new chapter of love for each other.

title: I'll Steal You Back
description: To save her sick boyfriend Daniel, Emily marries wealthy James in exchange for money—and lies to Daniel that she left him for greed. Three years later, Daniel returns as a billionaire. He deliberately gets close to Emily, manipulates James into making her his personal assistant, and seduces her into an affair of lust and moral destruction.

title: Supreme War God Strikes Back
description: Ethan, the Supreme War God, hides his true power to help his wife, Evelyn, rise. But on the day she's crowned War God, she divorces him and mocks him at every turn. Vowing to reclaim every ounce of power he bestowed upon her, Ethan makes a startling discovery: the girl who once saved his life was never Evelyn, but Aria. Now, he is determined to elevate Aria to the pinnacle of glory, leaving Evelyn with nothing but regret.

title: ReelTalk EP 79-Jackson Tiller Is a Girl Dad!
description: What better way to celebrate Father’s Day than with a very special announcement: Jackson Tiller is going to be a girl dad! In this heartfelt episode of ReelTalk, Jackson sits down with Sarah Moliski for an emotional conversation about fatherhood, family, and life in the spotlight. From preparing to welcome a daughter to balancing a growing career with being a devoted husband and father, Jackson opens up about the moments that matter most.

title: Lost Heir's Comeback Plan
description: Reborn into betrayal, Theo Lee, the rightful heir of the Lee family, was deceived by his girlfriend, Michelle, and two others, leading to his tragic demise. Now, back from the dead, Theo's done pretending. He dumps his manipulative girlfriend, reconnects with his real parents, kicks out the fake heir, and takes down his scheming step-sister. This time, Theo is taking back everything that's rightfully his, no more compromises.

title: Back to 1994
description: Mother-in-law Irene Sullivan stabs gambler Conrad Pierce in the chest after he refuses to halt his divorce from her daughter, Mia Gallagher. But Conrad survives—and time-travels back to 1994! Armed with future knowledge, he sets out to conquer the world. Conrad saves his friend Dustin Boyd and discovers fraudster Vito Moretti is posing as a tycoon to marry Mia. Conrad rushes to the Gallaghers to expose Vito's scam. He then partners with Ruby Sullivan and Dustin to sell cordless city phones, though Vito's sabotage puts their business at risk. Using his past-life skills, Conrad fixes a limited-edition sound system for Southport City's wealthiest man. This connection helps him win big on the World Cup finals in Macau. With his first pot of gold, Conrad expands his empire, eventually becoming the richest man in Southport City. Later, Irene and her secret lover, Otis Caldwell, steal Conrad's office buildings. Conrad traps them, forcing Otis to confess and face justice. Using the newly emerging DNA paternity test, Conrad discovers Irene is not Mia's real mother—Irene and Dominic Hawthorne actually kidnapped her! When Mia's biological father dies abroad, leaving her a massive inheritance and an ancestral estate, Irene plots to kill her for the money. Conrad intervenes just in time, exposing Irene and Dominic and sending them to prison. With the truth revealed, Conrad and Mia finally get their happy ending.

title: The Backup Bride's Revenge
description:
The night before her wedding, Elena catches her fiancé in bed with another woman.
After five years of helping him rise to power, she’s discarded as a traitor and thrown out without mercy.
But Matteo never realizes the woman he humiliated is actually the daughter of one of New York’s most powerful mafia families.
And on the very day he claims his throne and new bride, Elena decides to destroy everything he built.

title: The Mob Boss Substitute
description: She was an ordinary school teacher. After discovering her husband’s affair, she angrily divorced him, only to be mysteriously kidnapped while on the run.
