Upon waking, she is told that she has been mistaken for the deceased leader of a powerful crime syndicate and is forced to take control of the underground empire. To survive, she must navigate both the criminal underworld and the law, all while secretly investigating the conspiracy behind this case of mistaken identity. When the true culprit’s identity is revealed, she discovers that this impersonation scheme is shockingly linked to her own origins.

title: The True Alpha's Silver Luna
description: A young woman's silver hair—her family's magical bloodline—is shaved off on the eve of her wedding by her fiancé's pack as a cruel joke. She realizes her chosen mate, Liam, knew and let it happen. Heartbroken, she finally accepts her fated True Mate bond with Nicholas, a powerful Alpha who has waited six years for her. On her wedding day, Nicholas arrives with a convoy, reveals her unilateral dissolution of the contract, and publicly claims her. He brands Liam and his pack as rogues. In the end, her hair grows back, her power returns, and she finds true love and belonging with Nicholas.

title: I Took It All Back
description: During seven years of marriage to Ethan Grant, Vivian Whitmore has endured endless neglect as her husband openly favors his "dream girl", Angela. On their child's full-month celebration, Vivian reaches her breaking point. She announces divorce before all the guests, reveals the baby isn't Ethan's, and pulls her investments—plunging the Grant empire into chaos. The truth exposed and her revenge served, Vivian walks away with her child, leaving Ethan drowning in regret he can never undo.

title: The Black thrones
description:
John and Jack Blackthorne are the twin sons of a billionaire and the heirs to their father's empire. When the older Mr Blackthorne dies after a prolonged illness, the will he left behind isn't what his sons expected. In a bid to teach his boys a lesson, he edited his last will to include a stipulation of an arranged marriage for both of them. They twins are to try and win the hand of his caretaker's daughter, Evangeline Herrera. Her mother agreed to this because she sees her daughter as wasting away her youthful years and decides that a marriage to one of the Blackthorne sons will be good to uplift their family.
John Blackthorne falls in love with Evangeline on first sight, and when it seems to be mutual, he feels like he has won already. But his brother Jack also lusts after Eva and wants to have her all to himself even though his feelings aren't as pure as that of his brother. He is cunning enough to gain the favour of her mother, and he promises her all the expensive things if she can convince her daughter to choose him.
Will her mother's pressure push Eva over to Jack's side? Or will the warm love she feels for John be able to fight and win in just six months?

title: Love Across Time and Space
description: During the Wanli era, a deputy minister of the Ministry of Revenue is framed and killed, then transmigrates to the modern world. He learns to navigate contemporary society, falls in love with a woman, and strives to save his past self.

title: The Twenty-Year Promise
description: After making a heartfelt promise to reunite two decades later, a man returns to propose, only to discover that his beloved has been forced into marrying another. Determined to uncover the truth and expose the wrongdoer's actions, he embarks on a quest to fight for their love. Can true love prevail and justice be served, allowing them to finally be together?

title: Fox Queen & My Apocalypse Payback
description: When Epoch of Beasts becomes reality, the world turns into a living hell. Grinder Gideon leads humanity through countless battles, collecting seven Spire Keys to resurrect his grandmother. But right before the world reboots, his girlfriend Chloe and best friend Tyson betray and kill him. The mastermind, Nightwraith King, then descends to plunge the world into an eternal Icebound Deathscape. Unexpectedly, Gideon is reborn 12 hours before the apocalypse. Armed with past memories, he uses his knowledge of the game to win. Before the servers shut down, he spends wildly, drawing the server's only SSS-Rank Spirit Pet, Nine-Tailed Sacred Fox and forms an early pact with her.

title: Back to Reckoning
description: After ten years in prison for avenging his foster parents, Victor Warren returns to find the Titan Group still ruling the city—and now they're targeting his sister. Armed with skills forged behind bars and a burning need for justice, Victor wages a one-man war to dismantle the empire and unearth the dark secrets buried a decade ago.

title: Mother, I Have Your Back
description: Rose Hawkins passed out giving birth to boy-girl twins, Trent and Lily. Lily was saved by Maxwell Sterling and renamed Aurora Sterling. Twenty-five years later, Trent is a company VP, while Aurora inherits the Sterling Group. A blood test reveals Aurora's true paternity, prompting her to search for her birth mother in Oakhaven County with half a jade pendant. There, she rescues a fainted fruit vendor, Rose. Facing $20,000 in medical bills for his mother, Trent is coaxed by his girlfriend, Jade Monroe, into selling Rose to Otis Hawkins for a ghost marriage to fund his bride price. Aurora soon discovers Rose is her mother, crashes the wedding to expose Trent, and reunites with Rose using the pendant. Ultimately, Trent and Jade are banished to the African mines, while Otis Hawkins's family is driven out of the village.

title: Back to the 1920s as a Tycoon
description: Traveled back to the old times, he accidentally witnessed his great-grandmother being killed, and his family becoming paupers. He used his foresight to try to save his family time and time again and finally accumulated trillions of wealth.

title: Love Lost in the Space
description: In 2036, heiress Flora is betrayed by her husband Kai and left to die in space, but Jasper—her secret admirer—saves her, and they are thrown back to 2026 through a wormhole. Reborn, Flora exposes Kai’s lies about being the heir, his infidelity, and fraud, then proposes to Jasper, whom everyone mistakes for a mechanic. As the truth unfolds, Flora learns Jasper is actually the CEO of a global tech empire. At the succession ceremony, Kai takes Flora hostage and sabotages the satellite core, but Jasper rebuilds it overnight and uses a hidden defense system to stop Kai. Flora inherits the company, the Starlink launch succeeds, and Jasper proposes aboard a starship—they finally find their happy ending.

title: Oops! My Vegetable Alpha is Awake
description: Ethan, the Alpha of the Nightshade pack, falls into a coma after being poisoned by Moonshade Flowers. A sorcerer's divination reveals that the only antidote is a blood pact with the daughter of the Hill family from the Moonlight pack. Emily, a lonely Omega, is forced to marry in place of her cousin, believing this marriage will lead to endless despair. However, Ethan unexpectedly awakens from his vegetative state and showers her with boundless affection. Under Ethan’s unwavering support, Emily grows stronger, outsmarting villains and facing challenges. Will they ultimately become each other’s destined mates?

title: ReelTalk EP 38-Backstage: Cooking My Way Back to Love
description: Get ready for a fresh slice of Cooking My Way Back to Love! Host Laze stirs things up with Adam Daniel, taking us behind the scenes of this fiery new show. From the exciting BTS footage to Adam’s take on what makes the series special, you won’t want to miss it. Plus, keep your eyes peeled for another furry guest in this Backstage episode!

title: 10,000x Payback: Master, Please Stop Gifting!
description: Broke and ridiculed, Sect Leader Ethan unlocks the 10,000× Disciple Payback System. The more miserable a disciple, the richer the rewards. By linking his power to their breakthrough and gifting infinite resources, Ethan eventually crushes the Seven Sects Tournament and helps his disciples get revenge.

title: Attack Speed x10: Rise to the Top
description: When the game Aethelgard launches globally, players from every nation race to seize resources and dominate the game. Quinn Flynn awakens a god-tier talent at launch — Tenfold Attack Speed. His unmatched DPS lets him farm mobs and slay bosses at a fast speed no one can match. He secures top-tier resources, leads the Atherian region to the top of the server rankings, and monopolizes the global in-game economy. His rise catches the attention of a hot guild leader. He's the super hero in the game.

title: Moonlit Wilds, A Secret Yearning
description: To pay off her father’s debts, Diana Banning unexpectedly shares an intimate night with billionaire CEO Ethan Vance and ends up marrying him out of guilt and obligation. She is determined to fulfill her dream of being a designer, yet she winds up with an overly clingy, jealous husband.An ex-boyfriend, a young female rival chasing Ethan Vance, and an imposter pretending to be the CEO’s wife keep stirring up trouble. Ethan Vance fakes illness to hold her close while fiercely standing up for her against anyone who dares to hurt her. A hilarious, heart-fluttering tug-of-war filled with love and jealousy kicks off!

title: The Silver Moon Heiress
description:
Ava married into the Blackwood werewolf family. When she was five‑months pregnant, her husband Noah was killed in a trap set by hunters. For seven years, she single‑handedly cared for her paralyzed mother‑in‑law Eleanor, only to be mocked by the entire clan.

Following the distribution of Eleanor’s estate, Ava inherited nothing but an old silver soup spoon. Unexpectedly, she discovered a key and a note hidden inside it. With assistance from Eleanor’s old confidant, she learned that Eleanor had secretly founded the Silver Moon Sisterhood — an underground organization that sheltered abandoned supernatural beings, holding assets worth over 18 million US dollars.

Eleanor had left all the organization’s rights and life‑saving funds to Ava. Her seven years of cold indifference had been nothing but a ruse to deceive her own biological children. Transformed from a humiliated widow, Ava rose to become the new Speaker of the order and uncovered the hunter conspiracy behind her husband’s death.

title: The Moon Laurel
description:
Cynthia is the spirit of a century-old laurel tree. To save her fiancé Luke, she drained all her magical power and helped him become the Second Royal Magus. In his hunger for status and power, Luke abandoned Cynthia. He framed her as a mere "flower vendor" and plotted to cut down the laurel tree that housed her true form.
At this perilous moment, Arthur, the Chief Magus, stepped forward. He protected Cynthia by taking her as his wife, and the two were united in marriage. Side by side, they fought against oppression from the aristocracy.
Using natural magic, Cynthia cultivated Dark Gold Blazing Sunblooms and won the Queen’s favour. Luke and the Marcus family repeatedly tried to poison her and unleash the Withering Curse, yet Cynthia and Arthur thwarted every scheme. The necromancer master pulling the strings behind the Marcus family was slain by Arthur. Luke had his magic stripped and was exiled, while Mary was imprisoned.
Prince Silas sought to seize Cynthia’s royal essence blood to brew an immortality elixir. He summoned an Abyssal Hound to frame her, locked her away and drained her blood. Arthur stormed the prison alone. Silas detonated the Abyss Core in a mutual destructive blast. Cynthia exhausted her life essence to seal the Abyssal Rift, transforming into a laurel leaf and falling into slumber.
After forty-five years of endless waiting, Arthur’s loving call awakened Cynthia at last. Together they sealed the Abyss, retreated to seclusion deep within the rainforest, and became eternal lovers.

title: The Hidden Moon
description: Two kids survive a terrifying kidnapping. Trapped in the dark, they rely on each other and promise to escape together. During their breakout, the boy gets hurt protecting the girl. To save him, she acts as a decoy but is caught. The kidnappers poison her to keep her quiet, leaving her permanently mute. Years later, the grown-up girl is still haunted by nightmares. She wakes up crying, desperately missing the boy. She often thinks, C, are you okay? You said we would marry when we grew up. I broke my promise. Fate has other plans. Her family arranges a marriage, and she has no idea her future husband is her beloved C. He also fails to recognize his childhood companion, treating her as a polite stranger during their wedding preparations. One day, she finds the old pendant he gave her during their captivity and bursts into tears. Seeing the pendant, his memories come rushing back. He finally realizes she is the girl he has been searching for all these years.

title: Rejected: The Moon Goddess Rises
description:
Weakness is a sin in the wolf world, and Kai treated me like the worst sinner. He snapped our fated bond, cast me into the dark forest to die. 
But the moon did not let me fade. It woke me up. 
Now I am not Lyra, but the Moon Goddess. His pack burns, his strength drains, he kneels begging for mercy. 
And I don not even glance down. Wolves worship the moon. Now they will learn to fear it.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Alpha's Regret: Blood Moon
description:
He was my fated mate, and the butcher of my entire pack.
He forced me to destroy his child. He made me wait upon the woman he truly cherished. I endured every humiliation in silence, counting down the days until the poison in my body finally claimed my life.
And yet, when he learned the truth, his hair turned white in a single night, and he fell to his knees before me, begging for forgiveness.

title: Canceled Honeymoon
description: Claire discovered that her husband Julian had secretly canceled their honeymoon and showed favoritism toward his childhood friend Bobby. She also learned that their marriage had not been legally registered, and suffered a miscarriage caused by Julian's partiality and business oppression. Heartbroken, she moved to London to start a new life. Julian tried to win her back but remained obstinately unrepentant. Claire decisively severed all ties with him and wished him a lifelong union with Bobby, who was skilled at feigning illness to elicit sympathy. Ultimately, Claire found a worthy partner and lived a stable life, while Julian and Bobby's marriage was plagued with conflicts, the cooperation between their two families collapsed, and they spent the rest of their lives trapped in endless regret.

title: Rise of a Tycoon
description: Betrayed by his fiancée, a poor farmer storms into Steelhaven to uncover the truth. After saving a tycoon’s daughter and facing humiliation, he vows to start over. With nothing but courage, he rises from a laborer to a billionaire legend.

title: Alpha's Tender Torture
description:
Calla has been an orphan since childhood and was adopted by the werewolf Rogue "Nico". On a full moon night, she got lost in the forest and accidentally encountered Kael, the Wolf King, during his estrus cycle. He recognized her as his destined mate, leaving behind a token and a promise symbolizing her as the Future Luna.
However, fate played a cruel trick. Nico fell seriously ill, requiring a huge sum for surgery. Left with no other options, Calla had to turn to Kael for help. Yet, because Nico's family was once exiled for betraying the Blood Moon Pack, Calla dared not reveal the true reason for needing the money.
Kael, misunderstanding her intentions, thought she was a gold-digger. To humiliate her, he forced her to sign a three-year kept woman contract. Throughout those three years, love and misunderstanding entangled them in a painful struggle.
As the contract nears its end, Calla learns that Kael is set to marry the daughter of another Wolf King for an alliance. Choosing to leave, she unexpectedly discovers she is pregnant. Torn between her choices, where will she go? And when will Kael finally learn the truth behind Calla's sacrifices...

title: Rejected & Rebel, Tycoon Rise
description: After a bad date, Ryan activates the Rebel Girls System: gets rebel girls' love to unlock rewards. Unlimited wealth ahead!

title: Rejected & Rebel, Tycoon Rise
description: After a bad date, Ryan activates the Rebel Girls System: gets rebel girls' love to unlock rewards. Unlimited wealth ahead!

title: Lightening Marriage with a Tycoon Husband
description: Professional Ginny was arranged by her grandmother to marry the man she first met, Kesten, who disappeared without a trace after the wedding. Ginny also forgot about getting married and worked hard to get into M Group. A year later, M Group President Allis Miller returned to the United States from Europe. Ginny always thought Allis looked familiar, but couldn't remember where she had seen him. At work, she chanced to discover that Miller and Kesten were the same person?

title: Mid-Autumn Ancient Style Moonlit Night
description: Before Xiaohong's company holiday, they hold a Mid-Autumn ancient style moonlit team building activity. What interesting things will happen~*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Masked Socialite: My Cellmate Is a Top Tycoon Heir
description:
Fresh out of prison, Amelia uses the family details she learned from Isabella—the real Walker heir—while incarcerated to craft an elaborate disguise. She's welcomed back to the opulent Walker estateastheirlong-lostdaughter.Navigatingaminefieldof hypocritical relatives and scheming suitors, her mission is crystal clear: seize the family fortune and destroy the scumbag who framed her. Just as she's about to get engaged to her wealthy fiancé at a lavish gala, the real Isabella appears—as a guest. Also recently released from prison, Isabella knows every single one of Amelia's secrets. Stunned but
quick-thinking, Isabella proposes a deal: she'll help Amelia maintain her fake heiress status and get revenge, while Amelia helps Isabella reclaim her mother's inheritance and Walker Group shares stolen by her stepmother. Oneoperatesinthelight,theotherfromtheshadows—perfectly synchronized. Amelia uses her position as "Walker family heiress" to gatherdamningevidence,whileIsabellamastermindseverythingfrom behind the scenes. Together, they repeatedly humiliate the stepmother and sister who try to expose Amelia, and completely destroy the scumbag's reputation.When the battle for Walker family inheritance reaches its climax, the stepmother hires someone to eliminate Amelia in a staged "accident." Isabella gets injured saving her. In that life-or-death moment, their true feelings surface, and they decide to drop all pretenses. At the explosive Walker Group shareholder meeting, Isabella reveals the DNA report and share transfer documents, while Amelia publicly exposes ironclad evidence of the stepmother's crimes—murdering the original wife and embezzling assets. The true heiress returns triumphant; the fake heiress bows out gracefully. Isabella reclaims everything that's hers and gifts Amelia enough money to start a completely new life. Two women who once found themselves in the deepest mire have found redemption in each other and now walk toward their own bright futures.

title: Red Carpet, Hot Kiss
description: Destroyed by those she trusted, top star Aurora dies knowing her greatest rival, Pierce, was the only one who truly loved her. Reborn, she's on one mission: to court Pierce, crush her enemies, and rewrite her fate.

title: My Racing Nemesis Kissed Me
description: Ethan, the navigator of the ESO racing team, and his arch-rival, the racer Lucas, are paired up as a new duo in the new season. Ethan is shocked to discover that his arch-rival actually has a secret crush on his sister. To ease their hostile relationship, the coach devises an intimate ice-breaking plan for them. However, during the process, Ethan is surprised to find that Lucas actually seems to like him.

title: Shadows of the Departed
description: She thought it would be a normal flight... until the pilots disappeared.*This entry is participating in the ReelShort Reel Vertical Impact contest

title: Hating and Loving My Adopted Brother
description: After Abigail's parents both die in an accident, she gets adopted by her dad's friend. She transfers to a new high school and clashes with Chris, who acts like a total selfish prick — only to discover that he's her new adopted brother! Living under the same roof, she falls for him... but does he like her back?

title: My Mother the Shadowguard
description: Phoenixhold lies on the Southern Frontier of Valoria, bordering the Empire of Ostia. Vivian Vance, founder of The Shadowguard known as Lord Vance, retreated here after her husband died. Living in seclusion with her daughter Amelia Vance, she runs a butcher shop. Years pass quietly until Commander Fiona Frost of The Shadowguard appears at her door.

title: Glory in the Shadows
description: The security guard Theo might seem ordinary, but he possessed business talent, which had amazed countless business giants. It was not until the truth was revealed that everyone realized that this ordinary security guard was actually a top business tycoon in the past. However, when his family didn't know the truth, his son bullied him and his adopted daughter...

title: Rise of the Fallen Mage
description: After quelling the magical beast crisis, Edmond, the Empire's Supreme Archmage, falls victim to a conspiracy. Crashing into the Shadow Wasteland, he loses both his memory and magic, adopting the alias "Cole" and surviving alongside Lily, the orphan girl who saved his life. Twenty years later, while working as a stable slave for the Octavius family, he accidentally offends the young master, Sebastian, and endures endless bullying and humiliation. However, Sebastian discovers that "Cole" possesses the family badge crafted by his mom. Cole is his dad he's been desperately searching for all along.

title: Broken Strings, Unchained Melody
description: Ten years ago, Amelia was framed for a fire by her adoptive sister Lucy and sent to a remote island prison. Her parents, her brother, and even her fiancé Louis all helped send her away. Now she’s out. Gaunt, scarred, and broken, she returns home—only to find her family celebrating Lucy’s birthday. Lucy smiles sweetly and asks for Amelia’s fiancé as her gift. No one objects. Then a phone call comes: Professor Lucas, who once believed in her art, offers her a new life in Paris. One month. She only has to endure one more month. But will they let her go?

title: Blood Oaths and Broken Thrones
description: After Dante Conti let his mistress Selena Russo torment their six-year-old daughter Sofia, Isabella Moretti fought back and was locked inside Ashford Sanitarium. Years later, Dante forced her to sign away her rights with Sofia’s urn as a threat, believing he had broken her forever. But Sicily turned the abandoned wife into Don Moretti. Backed by Luca Ricci, the Don of Palermo, and the hidden power of her father Vittorio, Isabella returns to New York’s Five Families banquet to expose Selena’s lies, reclaim her empire, and make Dante watch the Conti throne collapse for every drop of blood he spilled.

title: Bitten, Not Broken
description: Left for dead in a sea of zombies, Zane discovers he can control any undead that bites him. What was meant to be his end becomes his rise. As the world falls, he builds an army of the infected and claims the apocalypse as his own.

title: Vow Broken, Debt Paid
description: Kate Zimmer returns home to find her dad swindled into crushing gambling debt. Scammers bully him, scheming to take their house. Breaking a promise to her late mom, Kate takes the poker table, using sleight of hand to crush the cheats. After winning, she uncovers the dark truth behind her mother's death and sets out for revenge.

title: Cruel Boss, Broken Heart
description: Penny and Elliot have been married for three years when she is suddenly betrayed by him and her best friend, Viola. Elliot suspects Penny isn't the woman who saved his life years ago. While struggling to pay her mother's medical bills, Penny is kidnapped and disfigured, after which Elliot demands a divorce. Though he covers the surgery costs, he forces Penny to work as a waitress at Buckingham, a shady men's club. Enduring constant abuse from customers and imprisonment by Elliot, her only comfort is her tough but kind-hearted friend, Fay. However, Viola soon discovers their bond and murders Fay to crush Penny. Viola burns down Buckingham to destroy the evidence and threatens their parents to stop Penny from testifying. Penny assumes the torment is over, but it is just beginning. To completely isolate her, Viola kills Penny's sick parents and nearly murders Nelson, the sole heir of the Fords. Pushed to the absolute limit, Penny realizes enduring the pain is useless. She risks everything and teams up with Nelson to unleash ruthless revenge on Elliot and Viola.

title: Twisted Stars & Broken Hearts
description:
Nora Shepard, born into wealth, is the daughter of a corporate chairman and an art school graduate. Her parents insist she stays home to help with the family business after graduation. 

Galen West, a family friend, grows up with Nora and plans to marry her.
Meanwhile, Luna Keats orchestrates a car accident to kill her own parents, gaining sympathy and becoming the adopted daughter of the Shepard family. She studies art alongside Nora, often copying her ideas, and later works as Nora's assistant. 

Luna's ultimate plan is to destroy Nora and take everything, including Galen. She succeeded by killing Nora.

But what she didn't know is that Nora is reborn.

Konwing what will happen in the future, Nora is determined to reclaim everything and tear Luna up! This time, she will have her revenge!

title: Dance of the Broken
description: Eileen Carter was once a gifted dancer and heiress, but after her family collapsed, she gave up everything to secretly support Theo through law school. Years later, he repays her with humiliation, betrayal, a fake mistress, and a divorce agreement. When his cruelty costs Eileen her stage and nearly her life, she stops explaining, stops waiting, and starts rebuilding. With Noah by her side, she exposes every lie, protects girls like her, and proves that even a broken dancer can still command the spotlight.

title: The Broken Triangle
description: For five years, Milo Reed and two childhood friends, Gloria Wade and Sarah Steele, built their startup from the ground up. But their loyalty wavers when a charming newcomer spins his web of deceit. Feeling betrayed, Milo decides to sell his shares and return to his family for an arranged marriage. Gloria and Sarah dismiss it as a rash decision until Milo's wedding invitation forces them to face the harsh truth...

title: Mending a broken love
description: After enduring a seven-year relationship, the couple ultimately breaks up due to various misunderstandings and betrayals. Subsequently, one partner completely loses the other to an idealized love, leading to a profound realization. Determined to make amends, he attempts to win her back through various means.

title: The Duke's Unwanted Bride
description: When Emilia is forced to marry a criminal to save her dying mother, she has no idea his true identity. Edward is secretly a duke, the richest man in England, who wed her only for revenge. Now bound under one roof, their marriage of necessity blazes into all-consuming desire. But the secret Edward’s keeping could cost him the one thing he didn't plan for: his beloved, Emilia.

title: Beauty in the Broken
description: The worlds of a depressed psychologist and an emotionally disturbed unhoused woman collide. As he tries to rescue her they fall in love, and each gets a second chance at a new life.

title: From Broken Engagement to Marrying a Billionaire
description:
Only right before our wedding, did I realize the true side of my boyfriend! He only wanted money and didn't care about my thoughts at all. 
Luckily, god has given me a second chance! I met a handsome CEO, and I decided to start my new life. He thought it was a new romance, but he doesn’t know, I was the girl he met and had been looking for seven years ago!

title: Misplaced Heart
description: Lawyer Claire wins her best friend Sunny's domestic violence case, then gets chased by the very man Sunny claimed to fear. While Claire bleeds behind a fire door, her fiance Ian is at home comforting Sunny. As Claire uncovers the affair and the setup behind the attack, she turns every piece of evidence into a weapon and finally chooses a life where her pain is believed the first time.

title: Borrowed Heart, Stolen Love
description: The ailing General Julian is reluctantly ordered to marry Eleonora Lee, a returning hostage. Julian resists the union, while Eleonora remains guarded, both testing and balancing each other within the confines of the general's residence. As imperial conspiracies and familial betrayals surge, the two find themselves bound together, repeatedly facing challenges side by side amidst the chaos.

title: The Kidnapper Who Stole My Heart
description: Raina Elliott lost her voice at seven—and found Rhett Southwell, a broken boy who became her sun. Thirteen years later, she's forced to marry him when her sister flees the altar. She says nothing. But inside? She's screaming yes. On their wedding night, danger strikes—and he sends her abroad to keep her safe. Four years pass. She returns, hoping. He pushes her away. Desperate and heartbroken, Raina stumbles upon a voice-changing phone during a robbery. She becomes "the kidnapper"—texting him divorce demands from the shadows.

title: Silent Heart, Stolen Love
description: A car accident stole Sabrina's voice when she was just eight years old. Mute but not broken, she grew up surrounded by love—especially from Julian, her childhood sweetheart who promised her forever. But forever ended three years into their marriage. Julian's heart wandered. Then Adrian came back. Seeing her shattered by Julian's betrayal, Adrian made a choice. He broke through the walls around Sabrina's heart—and reminded her that love doesn't always need a voice.

title: Silent Heart, Stolen Love
description: A car accident stole Sabrina's voice when she was just eight years old. Mute but not broken, she grew up surrounded by love—especially from Julian, her childhood sweetheart who promised her forever. But forever ended three years into their marriage. Julian's heart wandered. Then Adrian came back. Seeing her shattered by Julian's betrayal, Adrian made a choice. He broke through the walls around Sabrina's heart—and reminded her that love doesn't always need a voice.

title: You Are My Heart's Desire
description:
Years after a forced breakup, my ex-boyfriend's mother took the money and begged me to get back together with him! 
“The affection of poorness is worthless.” My family company went bankrupt, my father committed suicide, my mother was critically ill, and I had no choice but to take my boyfriend's mother's money and leave him! Unexpectedly, many years later, his mother once again came to me with a huge amount of money, and begged me to return to his side! Little did I know, he had become a dominant CEO and all he wanted was to get back together with me! Should I say yes this time?

title: Blood, lies and Hitman
description:
Former doctor Sarah flees into the rainforest with her 8-year-old son Tommy after her drug-addicted, abusive husband Sean turns violent. When their car blows a tire, they seek shelter in a secluded cabin—only to discover that its mysterious 28-year-old owner, Vance, is actually “Lone Wolf,” an elite assassin.
As danger closes in, an unexpected attraction sparks between Sarah and Vance. But just as they begin to lose control, a laser sight locks onto them. Sean has tracked Sarah down—and he’s determined to take her and Tommy back by force.

title: Mask of Lies
description: After his scheme is exposed, social climber Arthur Cross frames Stella Sterling, sending her to prison before stealing her wealth and murdering her parents. Behind bars, Stella adopts the alias Lexi Lane and masterminds her revenge. She uses Arthur's son to get close to his new wife, Diana Montgomery. Playing along with Arthur, she teams up with her prison ally Fiona Brooks to infiltrate the Montgomery family. Fiona pretends to bully Lexi but secretly helps her catch them red-handed to expose Arthur's true colors. Lexi also leaves clues for Roman Montgomery to uncover the truth. When Arthur plots to kill his wife again, Lexi and Roman join forces to expose his crimes, kicking off a thrilling battle of justice and revenge.

title: Where Lies Bloom
description: Once the heiress to the Wild Group, Lyssa was slandered and betrayed. Her comeback plan is to use Greg Ryder as her pawn in her revenge game. Yet, she finds another shadowy figure pulling the strings from behind the scenes. To her surprise, Greg's sister, whom he cherishes deeply, is entwined in the Wild family's power struggles, holding secrets that could change everything.

title: Stardust and Lies
description: After five years stranded on Mars, Evelyn Carter returns to Earth expecting a reunion, only to be branded unstable by Ethan, Mia, and the powerful Vaughn family. Her mother's final message was hidden, her commendation was suppressed, and her sacrifice was rewritten as a scandal. With Noah's help, Evelyn restores the black box records, exposes the cover-up, and takes back the name they tried to bury.

title: The Stepmother's Lies
description: Stepmother Miranda Lockwood seems sweet, but secretly abuses her stepdaughter Sophie Sinclair. Teaming up with her lover Victor Donovan, Miranda steals from the company to bankrupt her husband Richard Sinclair. Sophie begs her father for help, but he falls for Miranda's lies. Finally, Sophie records evidence on her smartwatch. Nathan arrives in time to expose the truth. Miranda and Victor are arrested for child abuse and corporate theft, leaving a remorseful Richard behind.
